                                         const SessionState& ss, const ModelGeometry& g,
                                         const QsaState* draft, size_t& bytes, std::string& error) {
    if (!conversation_snapshot_bytes(view, ss, g, draft, bytes, error)) return false;
    if (reuse.kv.empty()) return true;
    const size_t layers = owned_qsa(ss) + (draft ? 1 : 0);
    if (reuse.kv.size() != layers || reuse.unchanged_tokens < 0 ||
        reuse.unchanged_tokens > reuse.captured_tokens || reuse.unchanged_tokens > int64_t(view.ids.size()))
        return fail(error, "invalid retained K/V prefix");
    for (size_t i = 0; i < layers; ++i) {
        const bool index = i < owned_qsa(ss);
        const auto& st = index ? owned(ss, i) : *draft;
        if (!conversation_kv_validate(reuse.kv[i], st, g, reuse.captured_tokens, index, error)) return false;
        const size_t fresh = conversation_kv_bytes(st, g, int64_t(view.ids.size()), index);
        size_t retained = 0;
        if (!conversation_kv_capture_bytes(reuse.kv[i], st, g, int64_t(view.ids.size()), index, retained, error)) return false;
        bytes -= fresh;
        if (!add(bytes, retained)) return fail(error, "retained K/V allocation overflow");
    }
    size_t directory = 0;
    if (!product(directory, {reuse.kv.capacity() - layers, sizeof(ConversationKv)}) || !add(bytes, directory))
        return fail(error, "retained K/V directory overflow");
    return true;
}

bool conversation_snapshot_save(SavedConversation& image, const ConversationView& view,
                                const SessionState& ss, const ModelGeometry& g,
                                const QsaState* draft, std::string& error,
                                ConversationKvReuse reuse, size_t* reused_bytes) {
    size_t estimate = 0;
    if (!conversation_snapshot_capture_bytes(reuse, view, ss, g, draft, estimate, error) || !sync(error)) return false;
    // Build into a new object so a failure cannot publish a partial snapshot.
    SavedConversation captured;
    captured.geometry = geometry_key(g);
    captured.layer_lo = ss.layer_lo; captured.layer_hi = ss.layer_hi;
    captured.live.ids = view.ids; captured.live.imgs = view.images;
    captured.cvec = view.cvec; captured.checkpoints = conversation_detail::copy_checkpoints_beating(view.checkpoints);
    const int64_t unchanged = reuse.kv.empty() ? 0 : reuse.unchanged_tokens;
    captured.kv = std::move(reuse.kv);
    const size_t layers = owned_qsa(ss);
    captured.kv.resize(layers + (draft ? 1 : 0));
    if (!conversation_checkpoint_save(captured.live, ss, g, error)) return false;
    const int64_t upto = (int64_t) view.ids.size();
    for (size_t j = 0; j < layers; ++j)
        if (!conversation_kv_save(captured.kv[j], owned(ss, j), g, upto, true, error,
                                  unchanged, reused_bytes)) return false;
    // The draft's final cell may not have been computed when the output cap was
    // reached. Refresh that page even when the main prefix continued unchanged.
    if (draft && !conversation_kv_save(captured.kv.back(), *draft, g, upto, false, error,
                                       std::max<int64_t>(0, unchanged - 1), reused_bytes)) return false;
    image = std::move(captured);
    return true;
}

bool conversation_snapshot_sources(SavedConversation& meta, std::vector<SessionKvSource>& sources,
                                   const ConversationView& view, const SessionState& ss, const ModelGeometry& g,
                                   const QsaState& draft, std::string& error) {
    if (!view_validate(view, ss, g, error) || !sync(error)) return false;
    SavedConversation captured;
    captured.geometry = geometry_key(g);
    captured.layer_lo = ss.layer_lo; captured.layer_hi = ss.layer_hi;
    captured.live.ids = view.ids; captured.live.imgs = view.images;
    captured.cvec = view.cvec; captured.checkpoints = conversation_detail::copy_checkpoints_beating(view.checkpoints);
    if (!conversation_checkpoint_save(captured.live, ss, g, error)) return false;
    const int64_t upto = (int64_t) view.ids.size();
    const size_t layers = owned_qsa(ss);
    std::vector<SessionKvSource> out(layers + 1);
    for (size_t j = 0; j < layers; ++j)
        if (!conversation_kv_source(out[j], owned(ss, j), g, upto, true, error)) return false;
    if (!conversation_kv_source(out.back(), draft, g, upto, false, error)) return false;
    meta = std::move(captured);
    sources = std::move(out);
    return true;
}

bool conversation_session_read_limits(SessionReadLimits& limits, const SessionState& ss, const ModelGeometry& g,
                                      const QsaState& draft, uint64_t max_tokens, uint64_t max_checkpoints,
                                      std::string& error) {
    ConversationStateSizes z;
    if (!conversation_session_sizes(g, ss, z, error)) return false;
    if (ss.max_cells < 0) return fail(error, "invalid session cells");
    const uint64_t tokens = std::min<uint64_t>(max_tokens, (uint64_t) ss.max_cells);
    const size_t layers = owned_qsa(ss);
    if ((owned_qsa(ss) && !ss.qsa_states)) return fail(error, "invalid session running-state targets");
    size_t tails = 0, dead = 0, block_pos = 0;
    if (!product(tails, {layers, z.tail}) || !product(dead, {layers, z.dead}) ||
        !product(block_pos, {layers, z.block_pos})) return fail(error, "indexer byte count overflow");
    SessionReadLimits l = limits;   // keeps the caller's admit / progress / max_file_bytes
    l.max_tokens = tokens;
    l.max_checkpoints = max_checkpoints;
    l.max_kv_layers = layers + 1;
    l.geometry = geometry_key(g);
    l.layer_range = std::make_pair(ss.layer_lo, ss.layer_hi);
    l.max_state_bytes = {z.gdn, ss.ple_hist ? z.ple : 0, tails, dead, block_pos};
    l.max_kv_bytes.assign(layers + 1, {});
    for (size_t j = 0; j < layers; ++j) {
        const auto& st = owned(ss, j);
        const int64_t upto = (int64_t) std::min<uint64_t>(tokens, (uint64_t) std::max<int64_t>(st.max_cells, 0));
        if (!conversation_kv_part_sizes(st, g, upto, true, l.max_kv_bytes[j], error)) return false;
    }
    const int64_t dupto = (int64_t) std::min<uint64_t>(tokens, (uint64_t) std::max<int64_t>(draft.max_cells, 0));
    if (!conversation_kv_part_sizes(draft, g, dupto, false, l.max_kv_bytes.back(), error)) return false;
    limits = std::move(l);
    return true;
}

bool conversation_snapshot_validate(const SavedConversation& image, const SessionState& ss,
                                    const ModelGeometry& g, const QsaState* draft, std::string& error) {
    if (!image.live.stage_parts.empty())
        return fail(error, "a running checkpoint's stage parts belong in the stage images, not in live.stage_parts");
    if (image.geometry != geometry_key(g)) return fail(error, "incompatible runtime geometry");
    // an image holds exactly one carve's running state and K/V: same layer range or nothing
    if (image.layer_lo != ss.layer_lo || image.layer_hi != ss.layer_hi)
        return fail(error, "snapshot from another session layer range");
    const ConversationView view{image.live.ids, image.live.imgs, image.checkpoints, image.cvec};
    if (!view_validate(view, ss, g, error) || !conversation_checkpoint_validate(image.live, ss, g, error)) return false;
    const size_t layers = owned_qsa(ss);
    if (image.kv.size() != layers + (draft ? 1 : 0)) return fail(error, "invalid K/V layer count");
    const int64_t upto = (int64_t) image.live.ids.size();
    for (size_t j = 0; j < layers; ++j)
        if (!conversation_kv_validate(image.kv[j], owned(ss, j), g, upto, true, error)) return false;
    return !draft || conversation_kv_validate(image.kv.back(), *draft, g, upto, false, error);
}

ConversationRestore conversation_snapshot_restore(const SavedConversation& image, SessionState& ss,
                                                   const ModelGeometry& g, const QsaState* draft, std::string& error) {
    if (!conversation_snapshot_validate(image, ss, g, draft, error)) return ConversationRestore::invalid;
    if (!sync(error)) return ConversationRestore::transfer_failed;
    const int64_t upto = (int64_t) image.live.ids.size();
    for (size_t j = 0; j < owned_qsa(ss); ++j)
        if (!conversation_kv_restore(image.kv[j], owned(ss, j), g, upto, true, error))
            return ConversationRestore::transfer_failed;
    if ((draft && !conversation_kv_restore(image.kv.back(), *draft, g, upto, false, error)) ||
        !conversation_checkpoint_restore(image.live, ss, g, error)) return ConversationRestore::transfer_failed;
    return ConversationRestore::restored;
}

// the draft layer's K/V included (the stage that owns the draft head, or no layer split)
bool conversation_snapshot_bytes(const ConversationView& view, const SessionState& ss, const ModelGeometry& g,
                                 const QsaState& draft, size_t& bytes, std::string& error) {
    return conversation_snapshot_bytes(view, ss, g, &draft, bytes, error);
}
bool conversation_snapshot_capture_bytes(const ConversationKvReuse& reuse, const ConversationView& view,
                                         const SessionState& ss, const ModelGeometry& g, const QsaState& draft,
                                         size_t& bytes, std::string& error) {
    return conversation_snapshot_capture_bytes(reuse, view, ss, g, &draft, bytes, error);
}
bool conversation_snapshot_save(SavedConversation& image, const ConversationView& view, const SessionState& ss,
                                const ModelGeometry& g, const QsaState& draft, std::string& error,
                                ConversationKvReuse reuse, size_t* reused_bytes) {
    return conversation_snapshot_save(image, view, ss, g, &draft, error, std::move(reuse), reused_bytes);
}
bool conversation_snapshot_validate(const SavedConversation& image, const SessionState& ss, const ModelGeometry& g,
                                    const QsaState& draft, std::string& error) {
    // the whole-session form: a layer split's image (stage images) is restored stage by stage, never through here
    if (!image.stage_images.empty()) return fail(error, "a layer split's image restored as a single session");
    return conversation_snapshot_validate(image, ss, g, &draft, error);
}
ConversationRestore conversation_snapshot_restore(const SavedConversation& image, SessionState& ss,
                                                   const ModelGeometry& g, const QsaState& draft, std::string& error) {
    return conversation_snapshot_restore(image, ss, g, &draft, error);
}
ConversationRestore conversation_snapshot_restore_prefix(const SavedConversation& image, int64_t upto,
                                                          SessionState& ss, const ModelGeometry& g,
                                                          const QsaState& draft, std::string& error) {
    return conversation_snapshot_restore_prefix(image, upto, ss, g, &draft, error);
}
ConversationRestore conversation_snapshot_restore_prefix(const SavedConversation& image, int64_t upto,
                                                          SessionState& ss, const ModelGeometry& g,
                                                          const QsaState* draft, std::string& error) {
    // a layer split's image (stage images) is restored stage by stage, never in part
    if (!image.stage_images.empty()) {
        fail(error, "a layer split's image restored as a single session");
        return ConversationRestore::invalid;
    }
    if (!conversation_snapshot_validate(image, ss, g, draft, error)) return ConversationRestore::invalid;
    const int64_t captured = (int64_t) image.live.ids.size();
    if (upto < 1 || upto > captured) {
        fail(error, "the borrowed prefix is not inside the parked conversation");
        return ConversationRestore::invalid;
    }
    if (!sync(error)) return ConversationRestore::transfer_failed;
    for (size_t j = 0; j < owned_qsa(ss); ++j)
        if (!conversation_kv_restore_prefix(image.kv[j], owned(ss, j), g, captured, upto, true, error))
            return ConversationRestore::transfer_failed;
    if (draft && !conversation_kv_restore_prefix(image.kv.back(), *draft, g, captured, upto, false, error))
        return ConversationRestore::transfer_failed;
    return ConversationRestore::restored;
}
} // namespace strata::core


## src/core/conversation_validation_test.cpp

// Host-only validation fixtures. CUDA is linked but must never be initialized:
// invalid restores must return before the first CUDA call or destination write.
#include "strata/core/conversation_snapshot.hpp"
#include "strata/kernels/kv_q4.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <functional>
#include <limits>
#include <cstring>

#if defined(CONVERSATION_TEST_TRANSFERS)
// GNU/ELF link wrapping exercises the actual restore control flow without
// initializing CUDA or deliberately poisoning a real device context. This is
// host-backend fault injection, not a claim of hardware-failure recovery.
namespace {
int copy_calls = 0, sync_calls = 0, fail_copy = 0, fail_sync = 0;
size_t copied_bytes = 0;
}
extern "C" cudaError_t __wrap_cudaMemcpy(void* dst, const void* src, size_t n, cudaMemcpyKind) {
    if (++copy_calls == fail_copy) return cudaErrorInvalidValue;
    copied_bytes += n;
    std::memcpy(dst, src, n);
    return cudaSuccess;
}
// the snapshot/checkpoint copies go through a private non-blocking stream (conversation_copy.hpp)
extern "C" cudaError_t __wrap_cudaGetDevice(int* dev) { *dev = 0; return cudaSuccess; }
extern "C" cudaError_t __wrap_cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(cudaStream_t* s, unsigned int) {
    *s = reinterpret_cast<cudaStream_t>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(1)); return cudaSuccess;
}
extern "C" cudaError_t __wrap_cudaMemcpyAsync(void* dst, const void* src, size_t n, cudaMemcpyKind, cudaStream_t) {
    return __wrap_cudaMemcpy(dst, src, n, cudaMemcpyDefault);
}
extern "C" cudaError_t __wrap_cudaStreamSynchronize(cudaStream_t) { return cudaSuccess; }
extern "C" cudaError_t __wrap_cudaDeviceSynchronize() {
    return ++sync_calls == fail_sync ? cudaErrorUnknown : cudaSuccess;
}
extern "C" cudaError_t __wrap_cudaGetLastError() { return cudaSuccess; }
#endif

using namespace strata::core;
namespace {
int checks = 0;
void check(bool ok, const char* label) {
    ++checks;
    if (!ok) { std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: %s\n", label); std::exit(1); }
}
struct Pools {
    QsaState st;
    std::array<std::vector<uint8_t>, 8> data;
    Pools(const ModelGeometry& g, int format) {
        st.max_cells = 96; st.n_pages = st.n_slots = 24; st.idx_pooled_rows = 26;
        st.kv_int8 = format == 1; st.kv_q4 = format == 2;
        const size_t per = format == 2 ? strata::kernels::kv_q4_bytes_per_head((int) g.head_dim)
                                      : g.head_dim * (format == 1 ? 1 : 2);
        data[0].resize(96 * g.n_head_kv * per, 0xa5); data[1] = data[0];
        data[2].resize(format == 1 ? 96 * g.n_head_kv * (g.head_dim / 64) * 2 : 0, 0xa5); data[3] = data[2];
        data[4].resize(26 * g.idx_key_dim * 4, 0xa5);
        data[5].resize(3 * g.idx_key_dim * 4, 0xa5);
        data[6].resize(g.idx_key_dim * 4, 0xa5); data[7].resize(4, 0xa5);
        if (format == 2) { st.k_q4 = data[0].data(); st.v_q4 = data[1].data(); }
        else if (format == 1) {
            st.k_q = (int8_t*) data[0].data(); st.v_q = (int8_t*) data[1].data();
            st.k_scale = (uint16_t*) data[2].data(); st.v_scale = (uint16_t*) data[3].data();
        } else { st.k_pool = (uint16_t*) data[0].data(); st.v_pool = (uint16_t*) data[1].data(); }
        st.idx_pooled = (float*) data[4].data(); st.idx_tail = (float*) data[5].data();
        st.idx_dead = (float*) data[6].data(); st.idx_block_pos = (int32_t*) data[7].data();
    }
    ConversationKv image(const ModelGeometry& g, bool index) const {
        ConversationKv k;
        k.format = qsa_kv_format(st); k.cells = 12; k.page_size = 4;
        k.heads = g.n_head_kv; k.head_dim = g.head_dim; k.idx_dim = g.idx_key_dim;
        k.pooled_rows = index ? 3 : 0;
        k.k.resize(data[0].size() / 8, 13); k.v = k.k;
        k.k_scale.resize(data[2].size() / 8, 13); k.v_scale = k.k_scale;
        k.pooled.resize(k.pooled_rows * g.idx_key_dim * 4, 13);
        return k;
    }
};

void fixture(int format, int experts, bool zero_qsa, bool ple) {
    ModelGeometry g;
    g.n_layers = zero_qsa ? 3 : 8; g.n_expert = experts;
    g.ssm_state_size = 2; g.ssm_v_heads = 2; g.ssm_conv_channels = 8;
    g.n_head_kv = 1; g.head_dim = 64; g.idx_key_dim = 8;
    std::string error;
    ConversationStateSizes z;
    check(conversation_state_sizes(g, z, error), "checked canonical/pruned/zero-QSA sizing");
    Pools first(g, format), last(g, format), draft(g, format);
    std::array<QsaState, 2> layers{first.st, last.st};
    std::vector<uint8_t> gdn(z.gdn, 0xa5), history(ple ? z.ple : 0, 0xa5);
    SessionState ss;
    ss.max_cells = 96; ss.gdn_state = (float*) gdn.data();
    // the whole-model carve, as session_init leaves a one-GPU session
    ss.layer_hi = g.n_layers; ss.gdn_alloc = g.n_gdn_layers(); ss.qsa_alloc = g.n_qsa_layers();
    ss.ple_hist = ple ? (float*) history.data() : nullptr;
    ss.qsa_states = zero_qsa ? nullptr : layers.data();
    SavedConversation image;
    image.geometry = {g.n_embd,g.n_layers,g.qsa_interval,g.ssm_state_size,g.ssm_k_heads,g.ssm_v_heads,
                      g.ssm_d_conv,g.ssm_conv_channels,g.ssm_value_dim,g.n_head,g.n_head_kv,g.head_dim,
                      g.idx_q_heads,g.idx_key_dim,g.hc,g.hc_lr,g.n_expert,g.n_ff};
    image.layer_hi = g.n_layers;
    auto checkpoint = [&](size_t tokens) {
        ConversationCheckpoint c;
        c.ids.resize(tokens);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < tokens; ++i) c.ids[i] = (int32_t) i + 1;
        c.imgs = {{1, 44}};
        c.gdn.resize(z.gdn, 13); c.ple.resize(ple ? z.ple : 0, 13);
        c.tails.resize(g.n_qsa_layers() * z.tail, 13); c.dead.resize(g.n_qsa_layers() * z.dead, 13);
        c.block_pos.resize(g.n_qsa_layers() * z.block_pos, 13);
        return c;
    };
    image.live = checkpoint(9); image.checkpoints.push_back(checkpoint(5));
    image.kv.reserve((size_t) g.n_qsa_layers() + 1);
    if (!zero_qsa) { image.kv.push_back(first.image(g, true)); image.kv.push_back(last.image(g, true)); }
    image.kv.push_back(draft.image(g, false));
    check(conversation_snapshot_validate(image, ss, g, draft.st, error), "complete image validates without CUDA");
    size_t estimate = 0;
    check(conversation_snapshot_bytes({image.live.ids,image.live.imgs,image.checkpoints,true},ss,g,draft.st,estimate,error),
          "capture estimate works without CUDA");
    check(estimate == image.bytes(), "estimate covers checkpoint/indexer/spare payloads");
    auto unchanged = [&] {
        auto pristine = [](const auto& bytes) { return std::all_of(bytes.begin(),bytes.end(),[](uint8_t b){return b==0xa5;}); };
        if (!pristine(gdn) || !pristine(history) || ss.ple_prev[0] != -1 || ss.ple_prev[1] != -1) return false;
        for (const auto* p : {&first,&last,&draft}) for (const auto& bytes : p->data) if (!pristine(bytes)) return false;
        return true;
    };
    auto reject = [&](const std::function<void(SavedConversation&)>& mutate, const char* label) {
        auto bad = image; mutate(bad);
        check(conversation_snapshot_restore(bad,ss,g,draft.st,error) == ConversationRestore::invalid,label);
        check(unchanged(), "invalid restore did not touch any layer or running-state buffer");
    };
    reject([](auto& s){s.kv.back().k.pop_back();}, "late draft corruption rejected before first layer write");
    reject([](auto& s){s.geometry[16] = 128;}, "different expert geometry rejected");
    reject([](auto& s){s.live.stage_parts.emplace_back();}, "layer-split live state rejected before writes");
    reject([](auto& s){s.checkpoints[0].stage_parts.emplace_back();}, "layer-split checkpoint rejected before writes");
    reject([](auto& s){s.kv.pop_back();}, "missing KV layer rejected");
    reject([](auto& s){s.live.gdn.pop_back();}, "bad live recurrence rejected");
    reject([](auto& s){s.checkpoints.back().gdn.pop_back();}, "bad retained checkpoint rejected");
    reject([](auto& s){s.checkpoints.back().ids[0] = 99;}, "foreign checkpoint prefix rejected");
    reject([](auto& s){s.checkpoints.back().imgs[0].hash++;}, "foreign checkpoint image rejected");
    reject([](auto& s){s.live.imgs[0].start = -1;}, "negative image position rejected");
    reject([](auto& s){s.live.ids[0] = -1;}, "negative live token rejected");
    reject([](auto& s){s.live.ple.push_back(0);}, "PLE size/enabled mismatch rejected");
    reject([](auto& s){s.live.tails.push_back(0);}, "tail size/zero-QSA mismatch rejected");
    if (!zero_qsa) {
        reject([](auto& s){s.kv[1].pooled.pop_back();}, "late indexer spare row corruption rejected");
        reject([](auto& s){s.live.dead.pop_back();}, "missing indexer spare key rejected");
        reject([](auto& s){s.live.block_pos.pop_back();}, "missing indexer metadata rejected");
        ss.qsa_states = nullptr;
        check(!conversation_snapshot_validate(image,ss,g,draft.st,error), "missing QSA targets rejected");
        ss.qsa_states = layers.data();
        reject([](auto& s){s.layer_lo = 4;}, "snapshot from another layer range rejected");
        // #216's carve: a split stage owning layers [4, 8) holds GDN rows 3..5 and QSA ordinal 1 only
        SessionState stage = ss;
        stage.layer_lo = 4; stage.gdn_alloc = 3; stage.qsa_ord0 = 1; stage.qsa_alloc = 1;
        ConversationStateSizes zs;
        check(conversation_session_sizes(g,stage,zs,error) && zs.gdn == z.gdn / 6 * 3 && zs.tail == z.tail,
              "carved session sizes cover the owned rows only");
        check(!conversation_checkpoint_validate(image.live,stage,g,error), "whole-model checkpoint rejected by a carve");
        ConversationCheckpoint part = image.live;
        part.gdn.resize(zs.gdn); part.tails.resize(zs.tail); part.dead.resize(zs.dead);
        part.block_pos.resize(zs.block_pos);
        check(conversation_checkpoint_validate(part,stage,g,error), "carve-sized checkpoint validates");
        check(!conversation_snapshot_validate(image,stage,g,draft.st,error), "whole-model snapshot rejected by a carve");
        stage.qsa_alloc = 2;
        check(!conversation_session_sizes(g,stage,zs,error), "carve past the last QSA ordinal rejected");
        stage.qsa_alloc = 1; stage.gdn_alloc = 7;
        check(!conversation_session_sizes(g,stage,zs,error), "carve past the GDN rows rejected");
    }
    auto bad_geometry = g; bad_geometry.ssm_state_size = std::numeric_limits<int64_t>::max();
    check(!conversation_state_sizes(bad_geometry,z,error), "running-state arithmetic overflow rejected");
    bad_geometry = g; bad_geometry.qsa_interval = 0;
    check(!conversation_state_sizes(bad_geometry,z,error), "zero layer interval rejected before division");
    bad_geometry = g; bad_geometry.n_head_kv = std::numeric_limits<int64_t>::max();
    check(conversation_kv_bytes(draft.st,bad_geometry,9,false)==0, "KV byte overflow rejected");
#if defined(CONVERSATION_TEST_TRANSFERS)
    auto reset = [&] {
        for (auto* p : {&first,&last,&draft}) for (auto& bytes : p->data) std::fill(bytes.begin(),bytes.end(),0xa5);
        std::fill(gdn.begin(),gdn.end(),0xa5); std::fill(history.begin(),history.end(),0xa5);
        ss.ple_prev[0] = ss.ple_prev[1] = -1;
        copy_calls = sync_calls = fail_copy = fail_sync = 0;
    };
    reset(); fail_sync = 1;
    check(conversation_snapshot_restore(image,ss,g,draft.st,error)==ConversationRestore::transfer_failed,
          "pre-transfer CUDA synchronization failure is fatal");
    check(copy_calls==0 && unchanged(), "pre-sync failure did not mutate state");
    reset(); fail_copy = 1;
    check(conversation_snapshot_restore(image,ss,g,draft.st,error)==ConversationRestore::transfer_failed,
          "first CUDA transfer failure is fatal");
    check(unchanged(), "first-copy failure did not mutate state");
    reset(); fail_copy = 2;
    check(conversation_snapshot_restore(image,ss,g,draft.st,error)==ConversationRestore::transfer_failed,
          "partial CUDA transfer failure is fatal, not an invalid-image fallback");
    check(!unchanged(), "fault fixture genuinely produced partial state");
    reset(); fail_sync = 2;
    check(conversation_snapshot_restore(image,ss,g,draft.st,error)==ConversationRestore::transfer_failed,
          "post-transfer CUDA synchronization failure is fatal");
    check(copy_calls>0 && !unchanged(), "post-sync failure occurred after state writes");
    reset();
    check(conversation_snapshot_restore(image,ss,g,draft.st,error)==ConversationRestore::restored,
          "injected host transfer backend completes a valid restore");
    check(gdn==image.live.gdn && history==image.live.ple && ss.ple_prev[0]==8 && ss.ple_prev[1]==9,
          "successful restore publishes correct running state and PLE window");
    uint64_t fingerprint = 0;
    check(conversation_kv_verify(image.kv.back(),draft.st,g,9,false,fingerprint,error), "read-back verifies complete draft payload");
    draft.data[0][0] ^= 1;
    check(!conversation_kv_verify(image.kv.back(),draft.st,g,9,false,fingerprint,error), "read-back detects corrupted draft byte");
    draft.data[0][0] ^= 1;
    fail_copy = copy_calls + 1;
    check(!conversation_kv_verify(image.kv.back(),draft.st,g,9,false,fingerprint,error), "read-back transfer failure is not a successful fingerprint");
    reset(); copied_bytes = 0;
    const ConversationView view{image.live.ids,image.live.imgs,image.checkpoints,true};
    SavedConversation full,incremental;
    check(conversation_snapshot_save(full,view,ss,g,draft.st,error), "full capture through host transfer backend");
    const size_t full_copies = copied_bytes;
    ConversationKvReuse reuse{full.kv,9,9};
    size_t peak = 0, reused = 0;
    check(conversation_snapshot_capture_bytes(reuse,view,ss,g,draft.st,peak,error), "incremental capture admission without transfers");
    copied_bytes = 0;
    const bool saved_incrementally = conversation_snapshot_save(incremental,view,ss,g,draft.st,error,std::move(reuse),&reused);
    if (!saved_incrementally) std::fprintf(stderr,"capture error: %s\n",error.c_str());
    check(saved_incrementally, "incremental capture through host backend");
    check(reused > 0 && copied_bytes + reused == full_copies, "reused byte count measures transfers actually omitted");
    check(incremental.bytes() <= peak && incremental.live.gdn == full.live.gdn, "running state refreshed within admitted allocation");
    for (size_t i=0;i<full.kv.size();++i)
        check(incremental.kv[i].k==full.kv[i].k && incremental.kv[i].v==full.kv[i].v &&
              incremental.kv[i].k_scale==full.kv[i].k_scale && incremental.kv[i].v_scale==full.kv[i].v_scale &&
              incremental.kv[i].pooled==full.kv[i].pooled, "incremental and full capture agree across every payload");
    reuse = {full.kv,9,9};
    reuse.kv.back().k.pop_back();
    copy_calls = sync_calls = 0;
    check(!conversation_snapshot_capture_bytes(reuse,view,ss,g,draft.st,peak,error), "malformed retained draft rejected before admission");
    check(!copy_calls && !sync_calls, "invalid retained storage performs no CUDA calls");
    reuse = {full.kv,9,9};
    fail_copy = copy_calls + 1;
    SavedConversation unpublished;
    check(!conversation_snapshot_save(unpublished,view,ss,g,draft.st,error,std::move(reuse)), "incremental capture copy failure is reported");
    check(unpublished.kv.empty() && unpublished.live.ids.empty(), "failed incremental capture cannot publish a partial image");
#endif
}
}

int main() {
    for (int format : {0,1,2}) for (int experts : {256,512})
        for (bool zero_qsa : {false,true}) for (bool ple : {false,true}) fixture(format,experts,zero_qsa,ple);
    std::printf("conversation_validation_test: %d host-only checks passed\n", checks);
}


## src/core/coupled_draft_test.cpp

// src/core/coupled_draft_test.cpp - coupled draft sampling's host-side arithmetic (include/strata/core/coupled_draft.hpp).
//
// No GPU.  A simulated decode - windows of random size, random accepted counts, the serve loop's first window of one
// token and the CLI's `draft_first` - checks that
//   1. every draft the MTP chain makes is drawn with the Philox counter of the verify row that checks it: the verify
//      window at pos0 draws row t with pos0 + t (verify.cpp run()), and row t checks the draft in row t + 1;
//   2. the MTP cell of each draft predicts exactly the position that draft occupies in the next window;
//   3. the penalty window each draft sees in the device ring (the staged base, then the chain's earlier drafts) is
//      token for token the history row `penalty_rows` gives the verify row that checks it;
//   4. the penalty window length matches the target's (serve caps the history at 4,096).
#include "strata/core/coupled_draft.hpp"

#include <cstdio>
#include <random>
#include <vector>

using namespace strata::core;

namespace {
int g_fail = 0;
int64_t g_checks = 0;
void check(bool ok, const char* what, long long a = 0, long long b = 0) {
    ++g_checks;
    if (!ok) {
        if (++g_fail <= 20) std::printf("  FAIL %s (%lld vs %lld)\n", what, a, b);
    }
}

// verify.cpp run(): sp.counter = pos0, and the kernel draws row t with sp.counter + t
uint64_t verify_row_counter(int64_t pos0, int t) { return (uint64_t) pos0 + (uint64_t) t; }

// The counters and positions of a chain of `n` drafts made after a window at `p` with `a` accepted (draft()), or for
// draft_first (cell0 = p - 1, a = 0), checked against the next window at `p_next`.
void check_chain(int64_t p, int a, int n, int64_t p_next) {
    for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
        const int64_t cell = coupled_draft_cell(p, a, j);
        // mtp.hpp: cell c predicts the token at c + 2; the next window's row j + 1 holds position p_next + j + 1
        check(cell + 2 == p_next + j + 1, "draft position = its row in the next window", cell + 2, p_next + j + 1);
        // row j + 1 is kept iff it equals row j's pick, drawn at p_next + j
        check(coupled_draft_counter(cell) == verify_row_counter(p_next, j), "draft counter = verifying row's counter",
              (long long) coupled_draft_counter(cell), (long long) verify_row_counter(p_next, j));
    }
}

// The device ring for one chain: base staged at [cap - h, cap) by the host, draft i at cap + i; draft j's window is
// [coupled_hist_start(cap, j, h), + h).  Compared with penalty_rows over (consumed, [next, drafts...]).
void check_history(std::mt19937& rng, int cap, int h, int n_consumed, int n_drafts) {
    std::uniform_int_distribution<int> tok(0, 999);
    std::vector<int32_t> consumed((size_t) n_consumed), drafts((size_t) n_drafts);
    for (auto& t : consumed) t = tok(rng);
    for (auto& t : drafts) t = tok(rng);
    const int32_t next = tok(rng);
    std::vector<int32_t> mapped((size_t) cap, 777777), ring((size_t) (cap + n_drafts), 888888);
    coupled_hist_base(consumed.data(), (int64_t) consumed.size(), next, h, mapped.data() + (cap - h));   // set_draft_history
    for (int i = cap - h; i < cap; ++i) ring[(size_t) i] = mapped[(size_t) i];                           // coupled_stage_kernel
    // the next window: [next, drafts...], T = n_drafts + 1 rows; row j checks draft j (row j + 1)
    std::vector<int32_t> window;
    window.push_back(next);
    window.insert(window.end(), drafts.begin(), drafts.end());
    const int T = (int) window.size();
    std::vector<int32_t> rows((size_t) T * (size_t) h);
    strata::kernels::penalty_rows(consumed.data(), (int64_t) consumed.size(), window.data(), T, h, rows.data());
    for (int j = 0; j < n_drafts; ++j) {
        const int s = coupled_hist_start(cap, j, h);
        check(s >= 0 && s + h <= cap + n_drafts, "the window lies inside the ring", s, cap + n_drafts);
        for (int i = 0; i < h; ++i)
            check(ring[(size_t) (s + i)] == rows[(size_t) j * (size_t) h + (size_t) i], "draft history = verify row history",
                  ring[(size_t) (s + i)], rows[(size_t) j * (size_t) h + (size_t) i]);
        ring[(size_t) (cap + j)] = drafts[(size_t) j];   // coupled_merge_kernel appends the draft after sampling it
    }
}
}  // namespace

int main() {
    std::printf("coupled_draft_test\n");
    std::mt19937 rng(20260930);
    // ---- 1 + 2: a serve-style decode (the first window is the last prompt token alone, then MTP windows)
    for (int run = 0; run < 200; ++run) {
        std::uniform_int_distribution<int> tdist(1, 8);
        int64_t p = 100 + run * 37;   // n - 1
        int T = 1;
        for (int round = 0; round < 300; ++round) {
            std::uniform_int_distribution<int> adist(0, T - 1);
            const int a = adist(rng);
            const int64_t p_next = p + a + 1;
            const int n = 7;   // the chain makes up to max_t - 1 drafts, whatever T the next window takes
            check_chain(p, a, n, p_next);
            p = p_next;
            T = tdist(rng);    // --spec-min-p / the draft policy choose the next window's size
        }
    }
    // the CLI's draft_first: the first window at p, drafts from cell p - 1 with a = 0
    for (int64_t p = 1; p < 5000; p += 13) check_chain(p - 1, 0, 7, p);
    // ---- 3: the penalty ring against penalty_rows
    for (int cap : {8, 64, kCoupledHistCap}) {
        for (int h : {1, 3, 8}) {
            if (h > cap) continue;
            for (int n_consumed : {0, 1, 2, 5, 7, 20, 100})
                for (int n_drafts : {1, 3, 7}) check_history(rng, cap, h, n_consumed, n_drafts);
        }
        check_history(rng, cap, cap, 3, 7);        // the window is the whole ring base
        check_history(rng, cap, cap, 5000, 7);
    }
    // ---- 4: the window length the target uses: min(penalty_last_n, history_len) with history_len =
    // min(penalty_last_n, 4096) in serve (0 = off)
    for (int pln : {-1, 0, 1, 64, 4095, 4096, 4097, 100000}) {
        const int hist_n = std::min(std::max(pln, 0), 4096);
        const int target = hist_n > 0 ? std::min(pln, hist_n) : 0;
        check(coupled_hist_len(pln, kCoupledHistCap) == target, "penalty window length = the target's",
              coupled_hist_len(pln, kCoupledHistCap), target);
    }
    std::printf("  %lld checks, %d failed\n", (long long) g_checks, g_fail);
    std::printf("%s\n", g_fail == 0 ? "PASS" : "FAIL");
    return g_fail == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}


## src/core/device_main.cpp

// src/core/device_main.cpp - `strata-device`: report the GPU, the plan, and exercise the arena.
//
// This is P2.S1's "startup prints the memory plan vs actual cudaMemGetInfo" bullet, on its own so it can run
// without the model.  It is also the run-time half of the sm_120 policy: CMake refuses to COMPILE for another
// architecture, and this refuses to RUN on one.
#include "strata/core/device.hpp"
#include "strata/plan/plan.hpp"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#if defined(STRATA_USE_HIP) && defined(_WIN32)
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>
#endif

static std::string human(uint64_t b) {
    char buf[64];
    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%.3f GiB (%llu B)", (double) b / (1024.0 * 1024 * 1024),
                  (unsigned long long) b);
    return buf;
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    bool selftest = false;
    bool list_devices = false;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "--selftest") == 0) selftest = true;
        else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "--list-devices") == 0) list_devices = true;
        else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "--help") == 0 || std::strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
            std::printf("usage: strata-device [--selftest] [--list-devices]\n"
                        "  --list-devices  every GPU the runtime enumerates, numbered as HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES /\n"
                        "                  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES number them, and whether this binary can run it\n");
            return 0;
        } else {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "unknown argument: %s\n", argv[i]);
            return 2;
        }
    }

    // The runtime's numbering, which setup needs on Windows: there an integrated Radeon is HIP device 0 and pushes the
    // discrete card to 1, while setup finds the cards in the display-adapter order (#325).  No arch check here - the
    // cards this binary has no code for are part of the answer.  Format (setup.py's hip_devices parses it):
    //   device N: <name>
    //     arch gfx1201, 15.9 GiB, wave32          (CUDA: compute capability 12.0, 11.9 GiB)
    //     cannot run: <why>                       (only for a card this binary cannot run)
    if (list_devices) {
        const int count = strata::core::device_count();
        if (count == 0) std::printf("(no GPU device)\n");
        for (int ordinal = 0; ordinal < count; ++ordinal) {
            std::string name, detail;
            if (!strata::core::device_summary(ordinal, name, detail)) {
                std::printf("device %d: (the runtime cannot describe it)\n", ordinal);
                continue;
            }
            std::printf("device %d: %s\n  %s\n", ordinal, name.c_str(), detail.c_str());
            if (const std::string why = strata::core::gpu_arch_problem(ordinal); !why.empty())
                std::printf("  cannot run: %s\n", why.c_str());
        }
        return 0;
    }

    try {
        const strata::core::DeviceInfo d = strata::core::device_info(0);
        std::printf("device %d: %s\n", d.ordinal, d.name.c_str());
#if defined(STRATA_USE_HIP)
        std::printf("  HIP arch            %s wave32 (compiled for %s)\n", d.arch.c_str(),
                    strata::core::compiled_gpu_archs());
#else
        std::printf("  compute capability  %d.%d   (sm_%d%d)\n", d.cc_major, d.cc_minor, d.cc_major, d.cc_minor);
#endif
        std::printf("  multiprocessors     %d\n", d.multi_processor_count);
        std::printf("  VRAM total / free   %s / %s\n", human(d.total_bytes).c_str(), human(d.free_bytes).c_str());
        std::printf("  driver / runtime    %d / %d\n", d.driver_version, d.runtime_version);
#if defined(STRATA_USE_HIP) && defined(_WIN32)
        // #468 #461: which HIP runtime this process loaded - the one beside the exe, or an AMD driver's System32 copy
        if (HMODULE h = GetModuleHandleA("amdhip64_7.dll")) {
            char path[MAX_PATH] = {};
            if (GetModuleFileNameA(h, path, MAX_PATH) > 0) std::printf("  HIP runtime         %s\n", path);
        }
#endif

        // The planner's view against the card's.  A plan that does not fit in what is actually FREE is the
        // failure this print exists to make visible at startup rather than at token 4000.
        const auto plan = strata::plan::make_plan(20480, strata::plan::Geometry{}, strata::plan::Costs{});
        std::printf("\n%s", strata::plan::to_string(plan).c_str());
        std::printf("  card free           %s\n", human(d.free_bytes).c_str());
        std::printf("  plan + KV vs free   %s\n",
                    plan.vram_budget <= d.free_bytes ? "FITS" : "*** DOES NOT FIT ***");

        if (selftest) {
            // Exercise the arena for real: allocate, write from the host, read back, and check the poison
            // path leaves NaNs rather than zeros.  A GPU test that only asks the driver for its name does not
            // test the runtime this file exists to provide.
            const uint64_t bytes = 64ull << 20;      // 64 MiB, small enough to be safe on any card
            strata::core::DeviceArena arena(bytes, 0, /*poison=*/true);
            void* a = arena.alloc(1 << 20, 256);
            void* b = arena.alloc(1 << 20, 4096);
            if (((uintptr_t) a % 256) || ((uintptr_t) b % 4096)) {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "selftest: alignment not honoured\n");
                return 1;
            }
            std::printf("\nselftest: arena %s, used %s after two 1 MiB allocations\n", human(arena.capacity()).c_str(),
                        human(arena.used()).c_str());
            // and the arena must REFUSE rather than wrap
            try {
                arena.alloc(bytes * 2);
                std::fprintf(stderr, "selftest: over-allocation did NOT throw\n");
                return 1;
            } catch (const strata::core::CudaError&) {
                std::printf("selftest: over-allocation refused as required\n");
            }
            std::printf("strata-device selftest OK\n");
        }
        return 0;
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "strata-device: %s\n", e.what());
        return 1;
    }
}


## src/core/dflash2.cpp

// src/core/dflash2.cpp - see include/strata/core/dflash2.hpp.
#include "strata/core/dflash2.hpp"

#include "strata/core/native_head.hpp"
#include "strata/core/on_device.hpp"
#include "strata/core/weights.hpp"
#include "strata/kernels/dflash2.hpp"

#include "strata/kernels/native_mmvq.hpp"
#include "strata/kernels/native_qsa.hpp"
#include "strata/kernels/verify_kernels.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <exception>
#include <atomic>
#include <initializer_list>
#include <stdexcept>

namespace strata::core {
namespace {

using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;
double ms_since(Clock::time_point t) { return std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(Clock::now() - t).count(); }

bool mapped(size_t bytes, void** h, void** d) {
    if (cudaHostAlloc(h, bytes, cudaHostAllocMapped) != cudaSuccess) return false;
    std::memset(*h, 0, bytes);
    return cudaHostGetDevicePointer(d, *h, 0) == cudaSuccess;
}

constexpr int GGML_Q8_0 = 8;

}  // namespace

Dflash2Drafter::~Dflash2Drafter() {
    if (device_ < 0) return;
    prof_report();
    prof_free();
    const OnDevice on_device(device_);
    if (cs_) cudaStreamSynchronize(cs_);
    for (cudaGraphExec_t& e : exec_)
        if (e) cudaGraphExecDestroy(e);
    auto fr = [](void* p) { if (p) cudaFree(p); };
    fr(blob_); fr(d_meta_); fr(xq_); fr(xqp_); fr(xdp_); fr(xqc_); fr(xdc_); fr(rt_ctx_); fr(rt_blk_);
    for (int l = 0; l < 8; ++l) { fr(kring_[l]); fr(vring_[l]); }
    fr(fcy_); fr(hctx_); fr(kc_); fr(vc_); fr(h_); fr(xn_); fr(xc_); fr(dyn_); fr(q_); fr(qn_); fr(k_); fr(v_); fr(kblk_); fr(ao_); fr(o_);
    fr(gate_); fr(up_); fr(mlp_); fr(part_); fr(fn_); fr(logits_); fr(topval_); fr(hsel_); fr(toptok_); fr(topscratch_);
    fr(dvocab_); fr(dhead_);
    if (h_meta_) cudaFreeHost(h_meta_);
    if (h_out_) cudaFreeHost(h_out_);
    if (cs_) cudaStreamDestroy(cs_);
    if (cs2_) cudaStreamDestroy(cs2_);
    if (ev_fork_) cudaEventDestroy(ev_fork_);
    if (ev_join_) cudaEventDestroy(ev_join_);
    for (cudaEvent_t e : ev_ctx_) if (e) cudaEventDestroy(e);
    if (ev_a_) cudaEventDestroy(ev_a_);
    if (ev_b_) cudaEventDestroy(ev_b_);
}

// STRATA_DF2_PROFILE=1 (measurement only): the round runs without its graph and an event follows every stage; the per-stage averages print at exit
struct Dflash2Drafter::Prof {
    std::vector<cudaEvent_t> ev;
    std::vector<std::string> name;
    std::vector<std::pair<std::string, double>> total;
    int64_t rounds = 0;
};

void Dflash2Drafter::prof_free() {
    delete prof_;
    prof_ = nullptr;
}

// STRATA_DF2_SKIP=attn,head,ctx,mlp,qkvo (measurement only): leaves those parts out of the round, so the graph's GPU time without them can be read
static bool skip_part(const char* what) {
    static const std::string list = [] { const char* e = std::getenv("STRATA_DF2_SKIP"); return std::string(e ? e : ""); }();
    return !list.empty() && list.find(what) != std::string::npos;
}

void Dflash2Drafter::stamp(const char* name) {
    if (!prof_) return;
    cudaEvent_t e;
    cudaEventCreate(&e);
    cudaEventRecord(e, cs_);
    prof_->ev.push_back(e);
    prof_->name.push_back(name);
}

void Dflash2Drafter::prof_collect() {
    if (!prof_ || prof_->ev.size() < 2) return;
    cudaStreamSynchronize(cs_);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < prof_->ev.size(); ++i) {
        float ms = 0;
        cudaEventElapsedTime(&ms, prof_->ev[i - 1], prof_->ev[i]);
        auto it = std::find_if(prof_->total.begin(), prof_->total.end(), [&](const auto& t) { return t.first == prof_->name[i]; });
        if (it == prof_->total.end()) prof_->total.emplace_back(prof_->name[i], ms); else it->second += ms;
    }
    for (cudaEvent_t e : prof_->ev) cudaEventDestroy(e);
    prof_->ev.clear();
    prof_->name.clear();
    ++prof_->rounds;
}

void Dflash2Drafter::prof_report() const {
    if (!prof_ || prof_->rounds == 0) return;
    double sum = 0;
    for (const auto& t : prof_->total) sum += t.second;
    std::fprintf(stderr, "strata dflash2 profile (%lld rounds, ms per round, total %.3f):", (long long) prof_->rounds, sum / (double) prof_->rounds);
    for (const auto& t : prof_->total) std::fprintf(stderr, " %s %.3f", t.first.c_str(), t.second / (double) prof_->rounds);
    std::fputc(10, stderr);
}

const Dflash2Drafter::Tensor& Dflash2Drafter::find(const std::string& name) const {
    for (const Tensor& t : tensors_)
        if (t.name == name) return t;
    throw std::runtime_error("dflash2: tensor " + name + " is missing from the pack");
}

bool Dflash2Drafter::load(const std::string& path, int device, std::string& err) {
    device_ = device;
    const OnDevice on_device(device_);
    std::FILE* f = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "rb");
    if (f == nullptr) { err = "dflash2: cannot open " + path; return false; }
    struct Closer { std::FILE* f; ~Closer() { std::fclose(f); } } closer{f};
    uint32_t hdr[3];
    if (std::fread(hdr, 4, 3, f) != 3 || std::memcmp(hdr, "DF2P", 4) != 0 || hdr[1] != 1) { err = "dflash2: " + path + " is not a DF2P v1 pack"; return false; }
    std::string index(hdr[2], ' ');
    if (std::fread(index.data(), 1, hdr[2], f) != hdr[2]) { err = "dflash2: the pack's index is cut short"; return false; }
    const long data_off = 12 + (long) hdr[2];
    uint64_t total = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < index.size();) {
        const size_t j = index.find('\n', i);
        if (j == std::string::npos) break;
        const std::string line = index.substr(i, j - i);
        i = j + 1;
        char a[256], b[64], c[256];
        long long v1, v2, v3, v4;
        if (std::sscanf(line.c_str(), "cfg %63s %255s", b, c) == 2) {
            const std::string key = b;
            if (key == "hidden") N_ = std::atoi(c);
            else if (key == "layers") L_ = std::atoi(c);
            else if (key == "heads") NH_ = std::atoi(c);
            else if (key == "kv_heads") NKV_ = std::atoi(c);
            else if (key == "head_dim") HD_ = std::atoi(c);
            else if (key == "inter") I_ = std::atoi(c);
            else if (key == "window") window_ = std::atoi(c);
            else if (key == "rope_theta") theta_ = (float) std::atof(c);
            else if (key == "eps") eps_ = (float) std::atof(c);
            else if (key == "conv_group") group_ = std::atoi(c);
            else if (key == "rank") rank_ = std::atoi(c);
            else if (key == "mask_token") mask_token_ = std::atoi(c);
            else if (key == "vocab") vocab_ = std::atoll(c);
            else if (key == "taps") {
                taps_.clear();
                for (const char* q = c; *q;) { taps_.push_back(std::atoi(q)); while (*q && *q != ',') ++q; if (*q == ',') ++q; }
            }
        } else if (std::sscanf(line.c_str(), "t %255s %63s %lld %lld %lld %lld", a, b, &v1, &v2, &v3, &v4) == 6) {
            Tensor t;
            t.name = a; t.dtype = b; t.rows = v1; t.cols = v2; t.off = (uint64_t) v3; t.bytes = (uint64_t) v4;
            tensors_.push_back(t);
            total = std::max(total, t.off + t.bytes);
        }
    }
    if (tensors_.empty() || NH_ != 32 || NKV_ != 8 || HD_ != 128 || rank_ != 256 || N_ != 2560 || L_ > 8 || window_ + 16 > kRing) {
        err = "dflash2: the pack's shape is not the Flash-Next drafter this engine was written for";
        return false;
    }
    if (cudaMalloc((void**) &blob_, total) != cudaSuccess) { err = "dflash2: the pack does not fit in VRAM (" + std::to_string(total >> 20) + " MiB)"; return false; }
    vram_ += total;
    uint64_t max_bytes = 0;
    for (const Tensor& t : tensors_) max_bytes = std::max(max_bytes, t.bytes);
    std::vector<uint8_t> stage(max_bytes);
    uint8_t* tmp = nullptr;
    if (cudaMalloc((void**) &tmp, max_bytes) != cudaSuccess) { err = "dflash2: upload scratch"; return false; }
    struct TmpFree { uint8_t* p; ~TmpFree() { cudaFree(p); } } tmp_free{tmp};
    for (const Tensor& t : tensors_) {
#if defined(_WIN32)
        _fseeki64(f, data_off + (long long) t.off, SEEK_SET);
#else
        fseeko(f, data_off + (off_t) t.off, SEEK_SET);
#endif
        if (std::fread(stage.data(), 1, t.bytes, f) != t.bytes) { err = "dflash2: the pack is shorter than its index"; return false; }
        if (t.dtype == "q8_0") {   // GGUF blocks -> the tiled qs plane at the tensor's offset, then the d plane (same total bytes)
            if (cudaMemcpy(tmp, stage.data(), t.bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) != cudaSuccess) { err = "dflash2: weight upload failed"; return false; }
            kernels::df2_q8_tile(tmp, blob_ + t.off, blob_ + t.off + (uint64_t) t.rows * (uint64_t) t.cols, (int) t.cols, t.rows * t.cols / 32, nullptr);
            if (cudaDeviceSynchronize() != cudaSuccess) { err = "dflash2: weight conversion failed"; return false; }
        } else if (cudaMemcpy(blob_ + t.off, stage.data(), t.bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) != cudaSuccess) {
            err = "dflash2: weight upload failed";
            return false;
        }
    }
    // the draft round runs while the verifier's async commit still has work on the card: a high-priority stream keeps it from queueing behind that
    // (CUDA by default; on HIP only with STRATA_DF2_PRIO=1, where the engine's other streams keep the default priority)
    int prio_lo = 0, prio_hi = 0;
#if defined(STRATA_USE_HIP)
    static const bool hi_prio = [] { const char* e = std::getenv("STRATA_DF2_PRIO"); return e && e[0] == '1'; }();
    if (hi_prio) hipDeviceGetStreamPriorityRange(&prio_lo, &prio_hi);
    if (hipStreamCreateWithPriority(&cs_, hipStreamNonBlocking, hi_prio ? prio_hi : 0) != cudaSuccess ||
        hipStreamCreateWithPriority(&cs2_, hipStreamNonBlocking, hi_prio ? prio_hi : 0) != cudaSuccess) {
#else
    static const bool hi_prio = [] { const char* e = std::getenv("STRATA_DF2_PRIO"); return !(e && e[0] == '0'); }();
    cudaDeviceGetStreamPriorityRange(&prio_lo, &prio_hi);
    if (cudaStreamCreateWithPriority(&cs_, cudaStreamNonBlocking, hi_prio ? prio_hi : 0) != cudaSuccess ||
        cudaStreamCreateWithPriority(&cs2_, cudaStreamNonBlocking, hi_prio ? prio_hi : 0) != cudaSuccess) {
#endif
        err = "dflash2: stream";
        return false;
    }
    if (cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&ev_fork_, cudaEventDisableTiming) != cudaSuccess || cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&ev_join_, cudaEventDisableTiming) != cudaSuccess) {
        err = "dflash2: events";
        return false;
    }
    for (int l = 0; l < 8; ++l)
        if (cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&ev_ctx_[l], cudaEventDisableTiming) != cudaSuccess) { err = "dflash2: events"; return false; }
    if (const char* e = std::getenv("STRATA_DF2_PROFILE"); e && e[0] == '1') prof_ = new Prof();
    if (const char* e = std::getenv("STRATA_DF2_TIMING"); e && e[0] == '1') {
        timing_ = true;
        cudaEventCreate(&ev_a_);
        cudaEventCreate(&ev_b_);
    }
    return alloc(err);
}

bool Dflash2Drafter::alloc(std::string& err) {
    auto dev = [&](auto** p, size_t n) {
        using T = std::remove_pointer_t<std::remove_reference_t<decltype(*p)>>;
        if (cudaMalloc((void**) p, n * sizeof(T)) != cudaSuccess) return false;
        vram_ += n * sizeof(T);
        return true;
    };
    const size_t B = kRows;
    bool ok = dev(&d_meta_, 32) && dev(&xq_, kernels::native_q8_1_bytes(N_, kRows) + 4096) && dev(&xqp_, (size_t) 5 * N_ * 8 + 4096) && dev(&xdp_, (size_t) 5 * N_ / 32 * 8 + 64) && dev(&xqc_, (size_t) 5 * N_ * 8 + 4096) && dev(&xdc_, (size_t) 5 * N_ / 32 * 8 + 64) && dev(&rt_ctx_, B * 128) && dev(&rt_blk_, B * 128) &&
              dev(&fcy_, B * N_) && dev(&hctx_, B * N_) && dev(&kc_, B * NKV_ * HD_) && dev(&vc_, B * NKV_ * HD_) && dev(&h_, B * N_) && dev(&xn_, B * N_) &&
              dev(&xc_, B * N_) && dev(&dyn_, B * 640) && dev(&q_, B * NH_ * HD_) && dev(&qn_, B * NH_ * HD_) && dev(&k_, B * NKV_ * HD_) && dev(&v_, B * NKV_ * HD_) &&
              dev(&kblk_, B * NKV_ * HD_) && dev(&ao_, B * NH_ * HD_) && dev(&o_, B * N_) && dev(&gate_, B * I_) && dev(&up_, B * I_) && dev(&mlp_, B * N_) &&
              dev(&part_, (size_t) kernels::kDf2MaxChunks * 8 * 32 * 130) && dev(&fn_, B * N_) && dev(&topval_, kDrafts * 16) && dev(&toptok_, kDrafts * 16) &&
              dev(&hsel_, kDrafts * rank_) && dev(&topscratch_, (size_t) kDrafts * kernels::kDf2TopBlocks * kernels::kDf2TopK * 2);
    for (int l = 0; ok && l < L_; ++l) ok = dev(&kring_[l], (size_t) kRing * NKV_ * HD_) && dev(&vring_[l], (size_t) kRing * NKV_ * HD_);
    if (!ok) { err = "dflash2: the drafter's buffers do not fit in VRAM"; return false; }
    void* hd = nullptr;
    void* dd = nullptr;
    if (!mapped(32 * 4, (void**) &hd, &dd)) { err = "dflash2: mapped staging"; return false; }
    h_meta_ = (int32_t*) hd;
    m_meta_ = (int32_t*) dd;
    if (!mapped(64 * 4, &hd, &dd)) { err = "dflash2: mapped output"; return false; }
    h_out_ = (int32_t*) hd;
    out_tok_ = (int32_t*) dd;            // the select kernel writes the 7 picks here (host-visible) ...
    out_prob_ = (float*) dd + 16;        // ... and their probabilities at +16 ints
    cudaMemset(rt_ctx_, 0, B * 128 * 4);
    cudaMemset(xqp_, 0, (size_t) 5 * N_ * 8 + 4096);
    cudaMemset(xdp_, 0, ((size_t) 5 * N_ / 32 * 8 + 64) * 4);
    cudaMemset(xqc_, 0, (size_t) 5 * N_ * 8 + 4096);
    cudaMemset(xdc_, 0, ((size_t) 5 * N_ / 32 * 8 + 64) * 4);
    for (int l = 0; l < L_; ++l) { cudaMemset(kring_[l], 0, (size_t) kRing * NKV_ * HD_ * 4); cudaMemset(vring_[l], 0, (size_t) kRing * NKV_ * HD_ * 4); }
    return cudaDeviceSynchronize() == cudaSuccess;
}

bool Dflash2Drafter::bind_raw(EmbedFn embed, const void* head_w, int head_type, int64_t head_rows, const std::vector<int32_t>& vocab, std::string& err) {
    const OnDevice on_device(device_);
    embed_ = std::move(embed);
    head_w_ = head_w;
    head_type_ = head_type;
    n_dvocab_ = head_rows;
    if (!vocab.empty()) {
        n_dvocab_ = (int64_t) vocab.size();
        if (cudaMalloc((void**) &dvocab_, vocab.size() * 4) != cudaSuccess) { err = "dflash2: draft vocabulary"; return false; }
        vram_ += vocab.size() * 4;
        cudaMemcpy(dvocab_, vocab.data(), vocab.size() * 4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
    }
    if ((n_dvocab_ + kernels::kDf2TopBlocks - 1) / kernels::kDf2TopBlocks > 4096) { err = "dflash2: the head has too many rows for the top-k"; return false; }
    if (!logits_ && cudaMalloc((void**) &logits_, (size_t) kDrafts * (size_t) n_dvocab_ * 4) != cudaSuccess) { err = "dflash2: the draft logits do not fit"; return false; }
    vram_ += (uint64_t) kDrafts * (uint64_t) n_dvocab_ * 4;
    bound_ = true;
    return true;
}

bool Dflash2Drafter::bind(const WeightTable& wt, const NativeHead* head, const std::string& vocab_file, std::string& err) {
    const OnDevice on_device(device_);
    if (head == nullptr || !head->loaded()) { err = "dflash2: the drafter needs the native head (--native)"; return false; }
    const WeightRef* we = wt.find("token_embd.weight");
    if (we == nullptr) { err = "dflash2: token_embd.weight is missing"; return false; }
    EmbedFn embed = [we](const int32_t* tok, int n, float* out, cudaStream_t cs) {
        if (const NativeEmbed* ne = native_embed()) {
            ne->gather_dev(tok, n, out, cs);
        } else {
            const auto* codes = (const uint8_t*) we->data;
            const auto* scales = (const float*) (codes + we->codes_bytes);
            const auto* offsets = we->has_offset ? (const float*) (codes + we->codes_bytes + we->scales_bytes) : nullptr;
            kernels::embedding_gather_dev(codes, scales, offsets, tok, n, we->ne0, we->code_bits, we->code_bias, we->group_elems,
                                          (uint64_t) (we->ne0 / (8 / we->code_bits)), (uint64_t) (we->ne0 / we->group_elems), out, cs);
        }
    };
    std::vector<int32_t> vocab;
    if (!vocab_file.empty()) {
        if (std::FILE* vf = std::fopen(vocab_file.c_str(), "rb")) {
            std::fseek(vf, 0, SEEK_END);
            const long size = std::ftell(vf);
            std::fseek(vf, 0, SEEK_SET);
            if (size >= 4 && size % 4 == 0) {
                vocab.resize((size_t) size / 4);
                if (std::fread(vocab.data(), 4, vocab.size(), vf) != vocab.size()) vocab.clear();
            }
            std::fclose(vf);
        }
    }
    const void* hw = head->weights();
    const int64_t row_bytes = (int64_t) head->row_bytes();
    int64_t head_rows = row_bytes > 0 ? (int64_t) (head->weight_bytes() / (uint64_t) row_bytes) : 0;
    if (!vocab.empty()) {
        int32_t* dv = nullptr;
        if (cudaMalloc((void**) &dv, vocab.size() * 4) != cudaSuccess || cudaMalloc((void**) &dhead_, (size_t) ((int64_t) vocab.size() * row_bytes)) != cudaSuccess) {
            if (dv) cudaFree(dv);
            err = "dflash2: the draft vocabulary's head rows do not fit";
            return false;
        }
        cudaMemcpy(dv, vocab.data(), vocab.size() * 4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
        kernels::gather_rows((const uint8_t*) hw, row_bytes, dv, (int64_t) vocab.size(), dhead_, nullptr);
        cudaDeviceSynchronize();
        cudaFree(dv);
        vram_ += (uint64_t) ((int64_t) vocab.size() * row_bytes);
        hw = dhead_;
        head_rows = (int64_t) vocab.size();
    }
    if (!bind_raw(embed, hw, head->type(), head_rows, vocab, err)) return false;
    std::fprintf(stderr, "strata dflash2: %lld-token draft head (%.1f MiB), drafter %.0f MiB of VRAM\n", (long long) n_dvocab_,
                 (double) (n_dvocab_ * row_bytes) / 1048576.0, (double) vram_ / 1048576.0);
    return true;
}

void Dflash2Drafter::gemm(std::initializer_list<const char*> names, std::initializer_list<float*> outs, int ncols, cudaStream_t cs, const uint8_t* xq, const float* xd) {
    kernels::Df2Mat mats[3];
    int n = 0, n_in = 0;
    auto o = outs.begin();
    for (const char* name : names) {
        const Tensor& t = find(name);
        mats[n] = kernels::Df2Mat{blob_ + t.off, *o++, (int) t.rows};
        if (n == 0) n_in = (int) t.cols;
        ++n;
    }
    kernels::df2_gemm(mats, n, xq, xd, n_in, ncols, cs);
}

bool Dflash2Drafter::record_context(const float* taps, int n, cudaStream_t cs, std::string& err) {
    using namespace kernels;
    if (skip_part("ctx")) return true;
    try {
        const int tap_n = (int) taps_.size() * N_;
        df2_rope_table(d_meta_ + 0, n, theta_, rt_ctx_, cs);
        stamp("df2_rope_table");
        df2_quant_rows(taps, tap_n, n, xqc_, xdc_, cs);
        stamp("df2_quant_rows");
        gemm({"fc.weight"}, {fcy_}, n, cs, xqc_, xdc_);
        stamp("gemm:fc");
        df2_rms_quant(fcy_, f32("hidden_norm.weight"), nullptr, n, N_, eps_, xqc_, xdc_, cs);
        stamp("df2_rms_quant");
        for (int l = 0; l < L_; ++l) {
            const std::string p = "layers." + std::to_string(l) + ".";
            const std::string kp = p + "self_attn.k_proj.weight", vp = p + "self_attn.v_proj.weight";
            gemm({kp.c_str(), vp.c_str()}, {kc_, vc_}, n, cs, xqc_, xdc_);
            stamp("gemm:kp");
            df2_kv_ring(kc_, vc_, f32(p + "self_attn.k_norm.weight"), d_meta_ + 0, rt_ctx_, kring_[l], vring_[l], kRing, n, NKV_, eps_, cs);
            stamp("df2_kv_ring");
            if (fork_) cudaEventRecord(ev_ctx_[l], cs);   // layer l's keys and values are in the ring
        }
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        err = e.what();
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool Dflash2Drafter::record_block(cudaStream_t cs, std::string& err) {
    using namespace kernels;
    try {
        const int B = kRows;
        df2_rope_table(d_meta_ + 8, B, theta_, rt_blk_, cs);
        stamp("df2_rope_table");
        embed_(d_meta_ + 24, B, h_, cs);
        stamp("embed_");
        df2_rms_quant(h_, f32("layers.0.input_layernorm.weight"), xn_, B, N_, eps_, xqp_, xdp_, cs);
        stamp("df2_rms_quant");
        for (int l = 0; l < L_; ++l) {
            const std::string p = "layers." + std::to_string(l) + ".";
            const float* base_a = f32(p + "attention_conv.base_kernel");
            const float* base_m = f32(p + "mlp_conv.base_kernel");
            const std::string akp = p + "attention_conv.kernel_projection.weight", mkp = p + "mlp_conv.kernel_projection.weight";
            const std::string qp = p + "self_attn.q_proj.weight", kp = p + "self_attn.k_proj.weight", vp = p + "self_attn.v_proj.weight";
            const std::string gp = p + "mlp.gate_proj.weight", up = p + "mlp.up_proj.weight";
            if (!skip_part("tiny")) gemm({akp.c_str()}, {dyn_}, B, cs, xqp_, xdp_);
            stamp("gemm:akp");
            if (!skip_part("small")) df2_conv_quant(xn_, dyn_, 640, base_a, B, N_, group_, xqp_, xdp_, cs);
            stamp("df2_conv_quant");
            if (!skip_part("qkvo")) gemm({qp.c_str(), kp.c_str(), vp.c_str()}, {q_, k_, v_}, B, cs, xqp_, xdp_);
            stamp("gemm:qp");
            if (!skip_part("small")) df2_norm_rope_qk(q_, k_, f32(p + "self_attn.q_norm.weight"), f32(p + "self_attn.k_norm.weight"), rt_blk_, qn_, kblk_, B, NH_, NKV_, eps_, cs);
            stamp("df2_norm_rope_qk");
            if (fork_) cudaStreamWaitEvent(cs, ev_ctx_[l], 0);   // the context update has written this layer's ring
            if (!skip_part("attn")) df2_attention(qn_, kring_[l], vring_[l], kblk_, v_, d_meta_ + 17, kRing, window_, part_, xqp_, xdp_, cs);
            stamp("df2_attention");
            if (!skip_part("qkvo")) gemm({(p + "self_attn.o_proj.weight").c_str()}, {o_}, B, cs, xqp_, xdp_);
            stamp("gemm:o_proj");
            if (!skip_part("small")) df2_conv_rms_quant(o_, dyn_ + 320, 640, base_a + 2 * N_, h_, f32(p + "post_attention_layernorm.weight"), xn_, B, N_, group_, eps_, xqp_, xdp_, cs);
            stamp("df2_conv_rms_quant");
            if (!skip_part("tiny")) gemm({mkp.c_str()}, {dyn_}, B, cs, xqp_, xdp_);
            stamp("gemm:mkp");
            if (!skip_part("small")) df2_conv_quant(xn_, dyn_, 640, base_m, B, N_, group_, xqp_, xdp_, cs);
            stamp("df2_conv_quant");
            if (!skip_part("mlp")) gemm({gp.c_str(), up.c_str()}, {gate_, up_}, B, cs, xqp_, xdp_);
            stamp("gemm:gp");
            if (!skip_part("small")) df2_swiglu_quant(gate_, up_, B, I_, xqp_, xdp_, cs);
            stamp("df2_swiglu_quant");
            if (!skip_part("mlp")) gemm({(p + "mlp.down_proj.weight").c_str()}, {mlp_}, B, cs, xqp_, xdp_);
            stamp("gemm:mlp.down_proj");
            // the next layer's input norm, or after the last layer the final norm (-> fn_, the rows the head and the selector read)
            const std::string next_gamma = l + 1 < L_ ? "layers." + std::to_string(l + 1) + ".input_layernorm.weight" : std::string("norm.weight");
            if (!skip_part("small")) df2_conv_rms_quant(mlp_, dyn_ + 320, 640, base_m + 2 * N_, h_, f32(next_gamma), l + 1 < L_ ? xn_ : fn_, B, N_, group_, eps_, xqp_, xdp_, cs);
            stamp("df2_conv_rms_quant");
        }
        native_quantize_q8_1(fn_ + N_, xq_, N_, kDrafts, cs);   // rows 1..7, the head's format
        df2_quant_rows(fn_ + N_, N_, kDrafts, xqp_, xdp_, cs);   // and the selector projection's
        if (!skip_part("head")) native_mmvq(head_type_, head_w_, xq_, logits_, N_, (int) n_dvocab_, kDrafts, cs);
        stamp("native_mmvq");
        df2_topk(logits_, (int) n_dvocab_, dvocab_, kDrafts, topscratch_, topval_, toptok_, cs);
        stamp("df2_topk");
        gemm({"candidate_selector.hidden_projection.weight"}, {hsel_}, kDrafts, cs, xqp_, xdp_);
        stamp("gemm:candidate_selector.hidden_projection");
        df2_select(hsel_, topval_, toptok_, reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(blob_ + find("candidate_selector.predecessor_codebook").off),
                   reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(blob_ + find("candidate_selector.successor_codebook").off), rank_, kDrafts, d_meta_ + 16, out_tok_,
                   out_prob_, cs);
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        err = e.what();
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool Dflash2Drafter::capture(int n, const float* taps, std::string& err) {
    if (exec_[n]) return true;
    if (cudaStreamBeginCapture(cs_, cudaStreamCaptureModeThreadLocal) != cudaSuccess) { err = "dflash2: begin capture"; return false; }
    kernels::copy_i32_from_mapped(d_meta_, m_meta_, 32, cs_);
    // the context update (fc, the keys and values) and the block's front run side by side: they meet before each layer's attention
    // measured: -0.3 ms a round on an RTX 3060, +0.0..0.7 on a Strix Halo (gfx1151), so the HIP builds keep one stream (STRATA_DF2_FORK=1 / 0 overrides)
#if defined(STRATA_USE_HIP)
    static const bool fork_default = false;
#else
    static const bool fork_default = true;
#endif
    static const bool fork_on = [] { const char* e = std::getenv("STRATA_DF2_FORK"); return e && e[0] ? e[0] == '1' : fork_default; }();
    fork_ = fork_on && prof_ == nullptr && cs2_ != nullptr;
    if (fork_) {
        cudaEventRecord(ev_fork_, cs_);
        cudaStreamWaitEvent(cs2_, ev_fork_, 0);
    }
    bool ok = record_context(taps, n, fork_ ? cs2_ : cs_, err);
    if (fork_) cudaEventRecord(ev_join_, cs2_);
    if (ok) ok = record_block(cs_, err);
    if (fork_) cudaStreamWaitEvent(cs_, ev_join_, 0);
    fork_ = false;
    cudaGraph_t graph = nullptr;
    const cudaError_t ce = cudaStreamEndCapture(cs_, &graph);
    if (!ok) { if (graph) cudaGraphDestroy(graph); return false; }
    if (ce != cudaSuccess || cudaGraphInstantiate(&exec_[n], graph, 0) != cudaSuccess) {
        if (graph) cudaGraphDestroy(graph);
        err = std::string("dflash2: capture: ") + cudaGetErrorString(ce);
        return false;
    }
    cudaGraphDestroy(graph);
    cudaGraphUpload(exec_[n], cs_);
    cudaStreamSynchronize(cs_);
    return true;
}

bool Dflash2Drafter::prepare(const float* taps, std::string& err) {
    if (!bound_) { err = "dflash2: not bound"; return false; }
    if (prof_ != nullptr) return true;   // the profile runs without graphs
    const OnDevice on_device(device_);
    const Clock::time_point t0 = Clock::now();
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) h_meta_[i] = i;
    for (int n = 1; n <= kRows; ++n)
        if (!capture(n, taps, err)) return false;
    graph_taps_ = taps;
    ms_capture = ms_since(t0);
    return true;
}

bool Dflash2Drafter::context(const float* taps, int64_t n, int64_t pos0, std::string& err) {
    const OnDevice on_device(device_);
    const int tap_n = (int) taps_.size() * N_;
    for (int64_t r0 = 0; r0 < n; r0 += kRows) {
        const int m = (int) std::min<int64_t>(kRows, n - r0);
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) h_meta_[i] = (int32_t) (pos0 + r0 + i);
        std::atomic_thread_fence(std::memory_order_seq_cst);
        kernels::copy_i32_from_mapped(d_meta_, m_meta_, 32, cs_);
        if (!record_context(taps + (size_t) r0 * (size_t) tap_n, m, cs_, err)) return false;
        if (cudaStreamSynchronize(cs_) != cudaSuccess) { err = std::string("dflash2: ") + cudaGetErrorString(cudaGetLastError()); return false; }
    }
    have_ctx_ = std::max<int64_t>(have_ctx_, pos0 + n);
    return true;
}

bool Dflash2Drafter::draft(const float* taps, int n_new, int64_t pos0, int32_t anchor, int32_t* drafts, float* probs, std::string& err) {
    if (!bound_) { err = "dflash2: not bound"; return false; }
    if (n_new < 1 || n_new > kRows) { err = "dflash2: draft rows out of range"; return false; }
    const OnDevice on_device(device_);
    const Clock::time_point t0 = Clock::now();
    if (graph_taps_ != nullptr && graph_taps_ != taps) { err = "dflash2: the taps buffer moved after capture"; return false; }
    if (!prof_ && !exec_[n_new]) {
        // the staging must hold valid positions while the capture runs the (empty) kernels' parameter checks
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) h_meta_[i] = (int32_t) (pos0 + i);
        if (!capture(n_new, taps, err)) return false;
        graph_taps_ = taps;
    }
    const int64_t s = pos0 + n_new;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) { h_meta_[i] = (int32_t) (pos0 + std::min(i, n_new - 1)); h_meta_[8 + i] = (int32_t) (s + i); }
    h_meta_[16] = anchor;
    h_meta_[17] = (int32_t) s;
    h_meta_[24] = anchor;
    for (int i = 1; i < 8; ++i) h_meta_[24 + i] = mask_token_;
    for (int i = 0; i < kDrafts; ++i) { ((volatile int32_t*) h_out_)[i] = -1; }
    std::atomic_thread_fence(std::memory_order_seq_cst);
    if (timing_) cudaEventRecord(ev_a_, cs_);
    if (prof_) {   // the same round without its graph, an event after every stage
        cudaStreamSynchronize(cs_);
        for (cudaEvent_t e : prof_->ev) cudaEventDestroy(e);   // the stamps of context() calls are not a round
        prof_->ev.clear();
        prof_->name.clear();
        kernels::copy_i32_from_mapped(d_meta_, m_meta_, 32, cs_);
        stamp("start");
        if (!record_context(taps, n_new, cs_, err) || !record_block(cs_, err)) return false;
        prof_collect();
    } else
    if (cudaGraphLaunch(exec_[n_new], cs_) != cudaSuccess) { err = std::string("dflash2 draft: ") + cudaGetErrorString(cudaGetLastError()); return false; }
    if (timing_) cudaEventRecord(ev_b_, cs_);
    (void) cudaStreamQuery(cs_);
    if (cudaStreamSynchronize(cs_) != cudaSuccess) { err = std::string("dflash2 draft: ") + cudaGetErrorString(cudaGetLastError()); return false; }
    for (int i = 0; i < kDrafts; ++i) {
        drafts[i] = ((volatile int32_t*) h_out_)[i];
        if (probs) probs[i] = ((volatile float*) h_out_)[16 + i];
    }
    if (timing_) {
        float ms = 0;
        if (cudaEventElapsedTime(&ms, ev_a_, ev_b_) == cudaSuccess) ms_gpu += ms;
    }
    have_ctx_ = std::max<int64_t>(have_ctx_, s);
    ms_draft += ms_since(t0);
    ++rounds;
    return true;
}

bool Dflash2Drafter::debug_rows(std::vector<float>& rows, std::string& err) {
    rows.resize((size_t) kRows * (size_t) N_);
    if (cudaMemcpy(rows.data(), fn_, rows.size() * 4, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) != cudaSuccess) { err = "dflash2: debug copy"; return false; }
    return true;
}

}  // namespace strata::core


## src/core/dflash2_attn_bench.cpp

// src/core/dflash2_attn_bench.cpp - the drafter's attention (kernels/dflash2.hpp df2_attention) on random K/V: time per call and GB/s of K/V read.
//
//     dflash2_attn_bench [iters] [context]
#include "strata/kernels/dflash2.hpp"

#include <cuda_runtime.h>

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <vector>

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    const int iters = argc > 1 ? std::atoi(argv[1]) : 100;
    const int ctx = argc > 2 ? std::atoi(argv[2]) : 2047;
    const int ring = 2064;
    using namespace strata::kernels;
    float *q, *kr, *vr, *kb, *vb, *part, *out;
    int32_t* pos;
    cudaMalloc((void**) &q, 8 * 32 * 128 * 4);
    cudaMalloc((void**) &kr, (size_t) ring * 1024 * 4);
    cudaMalloc((void**) &vr, (size_t) ring * 1024 * 4);
    cudaMalloc((void**) &kb, 8 * 1024 * 4);
    cudaMalloc((void**) &vb, 8 * 1024 * 4);
    cudaMalloc((void**) &part, (size_t) kDf2MaxChunks * 8 * 32 * 130 * 4);
    cudaMalloc((void**) &out, 8 * 32 * 128 * 4);
    float* xdb;
    cudaMalloc((void**) &xdb, 8 * 128 * 4);
    cudaMalloc((void**) &pos, 4);
    std::vector<float> h((size_t) ring * 1024);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < h.size(); ++i) h[i] = (float) ((int) (i * 2654435761u >> 20) % 2001 - 1000) / 1000.0f;
    cudaMemcpy(kr, h.data(), h.size() * 4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
    cudaMemcpy(vr, h.data(), h.size() * 4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
    cudaMemcpy(q, h.data(), 8 * 32 * 128 * 4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
    cudaMemcpy(kb, h.data(), 8 * 1024 * 4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
    cudaMemcpy(vb, h.data(), 8 * 1024 * 4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
    const int32_t s = ctx + 5000;
    cudaMemcpy(pos, &s, 4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
    cudaEvent_t a, b;
    cudaEventCreate(&a);
    cudaEventCreate(&b);
    for (int v : {0, 1, 2, 3}) {
        df2_attention_variant(v);
        df2_attention(q, kr, vr, kb, vb, pos, ring, 2048, part, out, xdb, nullptr);
        cudaDeviceSynchronize();
        cudaEventRecord(a);
        for (int i = 0; i < iters; ++i) df2_attention(q, kr, vr, kb, vb, pos, ring, 2048, part, out, xdb, nullptr);
        cudaEventRecord(b);
        cudaEventSynchronize(b);
        float ms;
        cudaEventElapsedTime(&ms, a, b);
        std::vector<float> o(8 * 128);
        cudaMemcpy(o.data(), xdb, o.size() * 4, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost);
        double sum = 0;
        for (float x : o) sum += x;
        const double kv_bytes = 2.0 * (ctx + 8) * 1024 * 4;
        std::printf("variant %d: %.1f us per call, K/V %.1f GB/s   (checksum %.6f)\n", v, 1000.0 * ms / iters, kv_bytes * iters / (ms / 1000.0) / 1e9, sum);
    }
    return 0;
}


## src/core/dflash2_gemm_bench.cpp

// src/core/dflash2_gemm_bench.cpp - the drafter's Q8 GEMM (kernels/dflash2.hpp df2_gemm) on random planar weights: GB/s per shape and column count.
//
//     dflash2_gemm_bench [iters]
//
// Weight sets are cycled through 2 GiB of distinct matrices so the L2 cache cannot hold them (the drafter reads each matrix once per round).
#include "strata/kernels/dflash2.hpp"

#include <cuda_runtime.h>

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <vector>

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    const int iters = argc > 1 ? std::atoi(argv[1]) : 50;
    struct Shape { const char* name; int n_in, n_out; int mats; };
    const Shape shapes[] = {{"gate+up 2560->7680 x2", 2560, 7680, 2}, {"down 7680->2560", 7680, 2560, 1}, {"qkv 2560->(4096,1024,1024)", 2560, 4096, 3},
                            {"o 4096->2560", 4096, 2560, 1}, {"fc 12800->2560", 12800, 2560, 1}, {"kv 2560->1024 x2", 2560, 1024, 2}};
    cudaEvent_t a, b;
    cudaEventCreate(&a);
    cudaEventCreate(&b);
    for (const Shape& sh : shapes) {
        const size_t wbytes = (size_t) sh.n_out * sh.n_in * 34 / 32;
        const size_t per_set = wbytes * sh.mats;
        const int sets = (int) std::max<size_t>(2, ((size_t) 1 << 30) / per_set);
        std::vector<uint8_t*> w((size_t) sets * sh.mats);
        for (auto& p : w) {
            if (cudaMalloc((void**) &p, wbytes) != cudaSuccess) { std::fprintf(stderr, "alloc\n"); return 1; }
            cudaMemset(p, 0x11, wbytes);
        }
        uint8_t* xq;
        float *xd, *y;
        cudaMalloc((void**) &xq, (size_t) sh.n_in * 8);
        cudaMalloc((void**) &xd, (size_t) sh.n_in / 32 * 8 * 4);
        cudaMalloc((void**) &y, (size_t) 8 * sh.n_out * 3 * 4);
        cudaMemset(xq, 3, (size_t) sh.n_in * 8);
        std::vector<float> ones((size_t) sh.n_in / 32 * 8, 0.01f);
        cudaMemcpy(xd, ones.data(), ones.size() * 4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
        for (int var : {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9}) {
            strata::kernels::df2_gemm_variant(var);
            const int ncols = 8;
            cudaDeviceSynchronize();
            cudaEventRecord(a);
            for (int it = 0; it < iters; ++it) {
                strata::kernels::Df2Mat m[3];
                for (int i = 0; i < sh.mats; ++i) m[i] = {w[(size_t) (it % sets) * sh.mats + i], y + (size_t) i * 8 * sh.n_out, sh.n_out};
                if (sh.mats == 3) { m[1].n_out = 1024; m[2].n_out = 1024; }
                strata::kernels::df2_gemm(m, sh.mats, xq, xd, sh.n_in, ncols, nullptr);
            }
            cudaEventRecord(b);
            cudaEventSynchronize(b);
            float ms;
            cudaEventElapsedTime(&ms, a, b);
            const double bytes = sh.mats == 3 ? (double) (4096 + 1024 + 1024) * sh.n_in * 34 / 32 : (double) per_set;
            std::printf("%-30s variant %d: %7.1f us  %6.1f GB/s\n", sh.name, var, 1000.0 * ms / iters, bytes * iters / (ms / 1000.0) / 1e9);
        }
        for (auto p : w) cudaFree(p);
        cudaFree(xq); cudaFree(xd); cudaFree(y);
    }
    return 0;
}


## src/core/dflash2_parity.cpp

// src/core/dflash2_parity.cpp - the engine's DFlash2 drafter against the torch port, on a synthetic case (GPU, no model).
//
//     dflash2_parity <pack> <case.bin> [rounds]
//
// case.bin comes from tools/dflash2/mk_parity_case.py: n_ctx random tap rows, an anchor, a random Q8_0 head over a draft-vocabulary subset, the
// target embedding rows of the anchor and the mask token, and the torch answer (tokens, probabilities, the 8 final normalized rows).  The engine's
// drafter reads the same pack (Q8_0 weights, Q8_1 activations), so the rows agree to quantization noise, not bitwise: the test checks the rows'
// cosine similarity, the walk's tokens and the time of a round.
#include "strata/core/dflash2.hpp"

#include <cuda_runtime.h>

#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <vector>

using strata::core::Dflash2Drafter;

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc < 3) { std::fprintf(stderr, "usage: dflash2_parity <pack> <case.bin> [rounds]\n"); return 2; }
    const int rounds = argc > 3 ? std::atoi(argv[3]) : 20;
    std::FILE* f = std::fopen(argv[2], "rb");
    if (!f) { std::fprintf(stderr, "cannot open %s\n", argv[2]); return 2; }
    int32_t hdr[4];
    if (std::fread(hdr, 4, 4, f) != 4) return 2;
    const int n_ctx = hdr[0], anchor = hdr[1], vp = hdr[2];
    const int H = 2560, tapn = 5 * H;
    std::vector<float> taps((size_t) n_ctx * tapn), emb(2 * H), fn_ref(8 * H);
    std::vector<int32_t> dvocab(vp), tok_ref(7);
    std::vector<float> prob_ref(7);
    const size_t row_bytes = (size_t) (H / 32) * 34;
    std::vector<uint8_t> head((size_t) vp * row_bytes);
    bool ok = std::fread(taps.data(), 4, taps.size(), f) == taps.size() && std::fread(emb.data(), 4, emb.size(), f) == emb.size() &&
              std::fread(dvocab.data(), 4, dvocab.size(), f) == dvocab.size() && std::fread(head.data(), 1, head.size(), f) == head.size() &&
              std::fread(tok_ref.data(), 4, 7, f) == 7 && std::fread(prob_ref.data(), 4, 7, f) == 7 && std::fread(fn_ref.data(), 4, fn_ref.size(), f) == fn_ref.size();
    std::fclose(f);
    if (!ok) { std::fprintf(stderr, "case file is cut short\n"); return 2; }

    std::string err;
    Dflash2Drafter d;
    if (!d.load(argv[1], 0, err)) { std::fprintf(stderr, "load: %s\n", err.c_str()); return 1; }
    float *d_taps = nullptr, *d_emb = nullptr;
    uint8_t* d_head = nullptr;
    cudaMalloc((void**) &d_taps, taps.size() * 4);
    cudaMalloc((void**) &d_emb, emb.size() * 4);
    cudaMalloc((void**) &d_head, head.size());
    cudaMemcpy(d_taps, taps.data(), taps.size() * 4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
    cudaMemcpy(d_emb, emb.data(), emb.size() * 4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
    cudaMemcpy(d_head, head.data(), head.size(), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
    auto embed = [&](const int32_t*, int n, float* out, cudaStream_t cs) {
        cudaMemcpyAsync(out, d_emb, (size_t) H * 4, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, cs);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) cudaMemcpyAsync(out + (size_t) i * H, d_emb + H, (size_t) H * 4, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, cs);
    };
    if (!d.bind_raw(embed, d_head, 8, vp, dvocab, err)) { std::fprintf(stderr, "bind: %s\n", err.c_str()); return 1; }
    std::printf("drafter VRAM %.0f MiB\n", (double) d.vram_bytes() / 1048576.0);

    // the context but the last row, then one draft round that adds the last row
    if (!d.context(d_taps, n_ctx - 1, 0, err)) { std::fprintf(stderr, "context: %s\n", err.c_str()); return 1; }
    int32_t drafts[7];
    float probs[7];
    const float* last = d_taps + (size_t) (n_ctx - 1) * tapn;
