## src/core/weights.cpp

// src/core/weights.cpp - the dense-weight loader.  See the header for the engine-vs-pack distinction.
#include "strata/core/weights.hpp"
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>

#include "strata/kernels/f16_bits.hpp"
#include "strata/platform/memory.hpp"

#include <cinttypes>
#include <cuda_runtime.h>

#include <chrono>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>

#if defined(_WIN32)
#include <io.h>
#else
#include <unistd.h>
#endif

namespace strata::core {
namespace {

constexpr uint64_t CHUNK = 8ull << 20;   // 8 MiB of SOURCE per staging round

double now_ms() {
    using namespace std::chrono;
    return duration<double, std::milli>(steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
}

struct IndexRow {
    std::string name;
    int file = 0;
    WeightKind kind = WeightKind::Verbatim;
    uint64_t src_off = 0, src_bytes = 0, dst_off = 0, dst_bytes = 0;
    int64_t ne0 = 0, ne1 = 0;
    int code_bits = 0, code_bias = 0, group_elems = 0, codebook = 0, has_offset = 0;
    uint64_t codes_bytes = 0, scales_bytes = 0, offset_bytes = 0;
    int scales_fp16 = 0;
    int act_kind = 0;
    bool raw16 = false;   ///< plan v0.3 P6: already 16-bit in the file (kinds 4/5)
};

/// How a segment's bytes must be transformed on the way from the pack to the arena.
enum class Conv : int {
    Copy = 0,      ///< the bytes are already the engine form
    Bf16High = 1,  ///< f32 container holding a bf16 value: take the high 16 bits
    ToF16 = 2,     ///< f32 container holding an f16 value: a real round-to-nearest-even conversion
    WidenF16 = 3,  ///< fp16 bits to be held as f32: EXACT, and the reason this path exists at all
};

/// One contiguous run of a tensor's source span with a single destination range and one transform.
///
/// THE SEGMENT LIST IS WHY THIS LOADER CAN CHANGE WIDTHS PLANE BY PLANE.  A quantized tensor used to be one
/// verbatim span, which is only correct when every plane is already in engine form - and for 90 of the 303
/// quantized tensors the scale plane is fp16 in the pack and must be f32 in the arena.
struct Seg {
    uint64_t src_off = 0;   ///< relative to the row's src_off
    uint64_t src_bytes = 0;
    uint64_t dst_off = 0;   ///< relative to the row's dst_off
    uint64_t dst_bytes = 0;
    Conv conv = Conv::Copy;
};

const char* file_name(int id) {
    switch (id) {
        case 0: return "dense.bin";
        case 1: return "embd.bin";
        case 2: return "experts.bin";
        case 3: return "extra.bin";   // plan v0.3 P6: a native pack's float tensors that the base pack quantized
        default: return nullptr;
    }
}

/// UTF-16 path for CreateFile-free portability: the loader uses `std::fopen`, which on Windows takes an ANSI
/// path.  The pack lives beside the executable in practice, but a pack under a user directory with a
/// non-ASCII name would silently fail to open, so the caller gets the errno rather than a null pointer.
bool read_at(std::FILE* f, uint64_t off, void* dst, size_t n, std::string& err, const char* what) {
#if defined(_WIN32)
    if (_fseeki64(f, (long long) off, SEEK_SET) != 0) { err = std::string(what) + ": seek failed"; return false; }
#else
    if (fseeko(f, (off_t) off, SEEK_SET) != 0) { err = std::string(what) + ": seek failed"; return false; }
#endif
    if (std::fread(dst, 1, n, f) != n) { err = std::string(what) + ": short read"; return false; }
    return true;
}

}  // namespace

bool WeightTable::pool_bytes(const std::string& pack_dir, uint64_t& out, std::string& err,
                             const std::set<std::string>* skip) {
    const std::string path = pack_dir + "/index.txt";
    std::FILE* f = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "rb");
    if (!f) { err = "cannot open " + path; return false; }
    char line[1024];
    out = 0;
    uint64_t pool = 0, compact = 0;
    int align = 0;
    while (std::fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {
        if (line[0] == '#') {
            unsigned long long p = 0;
            int a = 0, tensors = 0;
            if (std::sscanf(line, "# align %d pool %llu tensors %d", &a, &p, &tensors) == 3) { pool = p; align = a; }
            continue;
        }
        if (skip == nullptr) continue;
        char name[256] = {0};
        unsigned long long dst_bytes = 0, dummy = 0;
        int i1 = 0, i2 = 0;
        if (std::sscanf(line, "%255s %d %d %llu %llu %llu %llu", name, &i1, &i2, &dummy, &dummy, &dummy, &dst_bytes) != 7)
            continue;
        if (skip->count(name)) continue;
        const uint64_t a = align > 0 ? (uint64_t) align : 256;
        compact += (dst_bytes + a - 1) / a * a;
    }
    std::fclose(f);
    if (pool == 0) { err = "no '# align ... pool ...' header in " + path; return false; }
    out = skip ? compact : pool;
    return true;
}

bool WeightTable::index_code_bits(const std::string& pack_dir, const std::string& name, int& code_bits,
                                  std::string& err) {
    const std::string path = pack_dir + "/index.txt";
    std::FILE* f = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "rb");
    if (!f) { err = "cannot open " + path; return false; }
    char line[1024];
    code_bits = -1;
    while (std::fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {
        if (line[0] == '#') continue;
        char row[256] = {0};
        unsigned long long dummy = 0;
        long long ne = 0;
        int i1 = 0, i2 = 0, bits = 0;
        // the first ten fields of the row `load` parses: name file kind src_off src_bytes dst_off dst_bytes ne0 ne1 code_bits
        if (std::sscanf(line, "%255s %d %d %llu %llu %llu %llu %lld %lld %d", row, &i1, &i2, &dummy, &dummy, &dummy,
                        &dummy, &ne, &ne, &bits) != 10)
            continue;
        if (name == row) { code_bits = bits; break; }
    }
    std::fclose(f);
    return true;
}

bool WeightTable::read_bf16_host(const std::string& name, std::vector<uint16_t>& out, std::string& err) const {
    const auto it = table_.find(name);
    if (it == table_.end()) { err = name + ": no such tensor"; return false; }
    const WeightRef& r = it->second;
    const char* fn = file_name(r.file_id);
    if (fn == nullptr || r.kind != WeightKind::Bf16InF32) { err = name + ": not a bf16 row of a pack file"; return false; }
    const uint64_t elems = (uint64_t) r.elements;
    const bool raw16 = r.src_bytes == elems * 2;
    if (!raw16 && r.src_bytes != elems * 4) { err = name + ": unexpected source size"; return false; }
    std::FILE* f = std::fopen((pack_dir_ + "/" + fn).c_str(), "rb");
    if (!f) { err = "cannot open " + pack_dir_ + "/" + fn; return false; }
    out.resize((size_t) elems);
    bool ok = true;
    if (raw16) {
        ok = read_at(f, r.src_off, out.data(), (size_t) (elems * 2), err, name.c_str());
    } else {
        std::vector<uint32_t> tmp((size_t) std::min<uint64_t>(elems, 1u << 22));
        for (uint64_t done = 0; ok && done < elems;) {
            const uint64_t n = std::min<uint64_t>(tmp.size(), elems - done);
            ok = read_at(f, r.src_off + done * 4, tmp.data(), (size_t) (n * 4), err, name.c_str());
            for (uint64_t i = 0; ok && i < n; ++i) out[(size_t) (done + i)] = (uint16_t) (tmp[(size_t) i] >> 16);
            done += n;
        }
    }
    std::fclose(f);
    return ok;
}

bool WeightTable::load(const std::string& pack_dir, void* arena_base, uint64_t arena_bytes, std::string& err,
                       const std::set<std::string>* skip) {
    const std::string path = pack_dir + "/index.txt";
    std::FILE* idx = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "rb");
    if (!idx) { err = "cannot open " + path + " (run tools/pack_index.py)"; return false; }

    uint64_t pool = 0;
    int align = 0;
    std::vector<IndexRow> rows;
    char line[1024];
    while (std::fgets(line, sizeof line, idx)) {
        if (line[0] == '#') {
            unsigned long long p = 0;
            int a = 0, t = 0;
            if (std::sscanf(line, "# align %d pool %llu tensors %d", &a, &p, &t) == 3) { pool = p; align = a; }
            continue;
        }
        IndexRow r;
        char name[256] = {0};
        int kind = 0;
        // The format is written by tools/pack_index.py and is space-separated with no quoting; a name with a
        // space in it would break the parse, which is why the parser REFUSES rather than taking what it got.
        const int n = std::sscanf(line,
                                  "%255s %d %d %" SCNu64 " %" SCNu64 " %" SCNu64 " %" SCNu64 " %" SCNd64 " %" SCNd64 " %d %d %d %d %d %" SCNu64 " %" SCNu64 " %" SCNu64 " %d %d",
                                  name, &r.file, &kind, &r.src_off, &r.src_bytes, &r.dst_off, &r.dst_bytes,
                                  &r.ne0, &r.ne1, &r.code_bits, &r.code_bias, &r.group_elems, &r.codebook,
                                  &r.has_offset, &r.codes_bytes, &r.scales_bytes, &r.offset_bytes,
                                  &r.scales_fp16, &r.act_kind);
        if (n != 19) {
            // A malformed index line is a WRONG BYTE OFFSET waiting to happen, and a wrong offset decodes to
            // a plausible weight.  Refuse loudly instead of loading the rows that happened to parse.
            err = "index.txt: could not parse a row (" + std::to_string(n) + " of 19 fields)";
            std::fclose(idx);
            return false;
        }
        r.name = name;
        // plan v0.3 P6: a standalone native pack (tools/iq_pack.py) stores 16-bit floats as they are in the GGUF:
        // index kinds 4 (BF16) and 5 (F16) are copied and take the engine forms of kinds 1 and 3
        if (kind == 4 || kind == 5) {
            r.raw16 = true;
            kind = kind == 4 ? (int) WeightKind::Bf16InF32 : (int) WeightKind::F16InF32;
        }
        r.kind = (WeightKind) kind;
        rows.push_back(r);
    }
    std::fclose(idx);

    if (pool == 0 || rows.empty()) { err = "index.txt has no header or no rows"; return false; }
    // Plan v0.3 P1: a skip set compacts the arena.  Kept rows are re-placed in index order at the index's
    // alignment; skipped rows keep their metadata and get no bytes.
    std::vector<bool> skipped(rows.size(), false);
    if (skip != nullptr) {
        const uint64_t a = align > 0 ? (uint64_t) align : 256;
        uint64_t at = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < rows.size(); ++i) {
            if (skip->count(rows[i].name)) { skipped[i] = true; continue; }
            rows[i].dst_off = at;
            at += (rows[i].dst_bytes + a - 1) / a * a;
        }
        pool = at;
    }
    if (arena_bytes < pool) {
        err = "arena is " + std::to_string(arena_bytes) + " B but the index needs " + std::to_string(pool);
        return false;
    }

    // Two pinned staging buffers, both reused.  Pinned because a 5 GB pageable upload spends its time in the
    // driver copying through a bounce buffer, and bounded by CHUNK rather than by the largest tensor.
    //
    // STAGE_OUT IS NOT OPTIONAL.  The first version of this loop converted the values straight into the
    // destination pointer - which is DEVICE memory - from host code.  A host write to a device address is
    // undefined behaviour, and on this driver it does not fault: it corrupts whatever the address maps to in
    // the host's own space, which is nothing at all, so the tensor would have loaded as the UNCONVERTED pack
    // bytes and every BF16 weight would have been read as 32-bit garbage.  Converted data goes to a host
    // buffer and crosses the bus once.
    //
    // STAGE_OUT IS TWICE STAGE_IN because a conversion can now GROW: widening an fp16 scale plane to f32
    // doubles it.  Sized at CHUNK it would have written 8 MiB past the end of a pinned allocation for every
    // one of the 90 widened tensors - a heap corruption that would have been blamed on whatever ran next.
    void* stage_in = nullptr;
    void* stage_out = nullptr;
    if (cudaHostAlloc(&stage_in, CHUNK, cudaHostAllocDefault) != cudaSuccess ||
        cudaHostAlloc(&stage_out, CHUNK * 2, cudaHostAllocDefault) != cudaSuccess) {
        err = "cudaHostAlloc for the staging buffers failed";
        if (stage_in) cudaFreeHost(stage_in);
        if (stage_out) cudaFreeHost(stage_out);
        return false;
    }

    uint8_t* dst_base = (uint8_t*) arena_base;
    std::FILE* cur = nullptr;
    int cur_file = -1;
    table_.clear();
    report_ = LoadReport{};
    pack_dir_ = pack_dir;

    const double t_read0 = now_ms();
    double upload_ms = 0;
    for (size_t row_i = 0; row_i < rows.size(); ++row_i) {
        const IndexRow& r = rows[row_i];
        if (skipped[row_i]) {
            WeightRef wr;
            wr.data = nullptr;
            wr.resident = false;
            wr.bytes = r.dst_bytes;
            wr.ne0 = r.ne0;
            wr.ne1 = r.ne1;
            wr.elements = r.ne0 * (r.ne1 > 0 ? r.ne1 : 1);
            wr.kind = r.kind;
            wr.code_bits = r.code_bits;
            wr.code_bias = r.code_bias;
            wr.group_elems = r.group_elems;
            wr.codebook_iq4nl = r.codebook != 0;
            wr.has_offset = r.has_offset != 0;
            wr.codes_bytes = r.codes_bytes;
            wr.scales_bytes = r.scales_bytes;
            wr.offset_bytes = r.offset_bytes;
            wr.src_off = r.src_off;
            wr.src_bytes = r.src_bytes;
            wr.file_id = r.file;
            wr.scales_fp16 = r.scales_fp16 != 0;
            wr.act_kind = r.act_kind;
            table_[r.name] = wr;
            ++report_.tensors;
            continue;
        }
        if (r.code_bits != 0 && r.dst_bytes == 0) {
            // plan v0.3 P6: a native pack's row that carries a shape only - the GGUF form must serve it
            err = r.name + ": this pack holds the tensor only in its GGUF form (run with --native SHARD1)";
            cudaFreeHost(stage_in); cudaFreeHost(stage_out);
            return false;
        }
        if (r.file != cur_file) {
            if (cur) std::fclose(cur);
            const char* fn = file_name(r.file);
            const std::string p = pack_dir + "/" + (fn ? fn : "?");
            cur = std::fopen(p.c_str(), "rb");
            if (!cur) { err = "cannot open " + p; cudaFreeHost(stage_in); cudaFreeHost(stage_out); return false; }
            cur_file = r.file;
#if !defined(_WIN32)
            // ask for this file's remaining rows up front so their reads overlap
            for (size_t j = row_i; j < rows.size(); ++j)
                if (rows[j].file == r.file && !skipped[j])
                    strata::platform::advise_willneed(fileno(cur), rows[j].src_off, rows[j].src_bytes);
#endif
        }

        // ---- the segment list: what this tensor's bytes are, plane by plane, in both forms
        Seg segs[3];
        int n_segs = 0;
        bool bad = false;
        uint64_t sum_src = 0, sum_dst = 0;
        if (r.codes_bytes != 0) {
            // A quantized tensor: codes, then scales, then the optional offset plane, each contiguous in the
            // source span in that order (pack_index.py verifies the contiguity and refuses otherwise).
            segs[n_segs++] = Seg{0, r.codes_bytes, 0, r.codes_bytes, Conv::Copy};
            if (r.scales_bytes) {
                const uint64_t src_scale_bytes = r.scales_fp16 ? r.scales_bytes / 2 : r.scales_bytes;
                if (r.scales_fp16 && (r.scales_bytes % 2 || src_scale_bytes * 2 != r.scales_bytes)) {
                    err = r.name + ": an fp16 scale plane of an odd byte count";
                    bad = true;
                }
                segs[n_segs++] = Seg{r.codes_bytes, src_scale_bytes, r.codes_bytes, r.scales_bytes,
                                     r.scales_fp16 ? Conv::WidenF16 : Conv::Copy};
            }
            if (r.offset_bytes) {
                const uint64_t after = r.codes_bytes + (r.scales_fp16 ? r.scales_bytes / 2 : r.scales_bytes);
                segs[n_segs++] = Seg{after, r.offset_bytes, r.codes_bytes + r.scales_bytes, r.offset_bytes,
                                     Conv::Copy};
            }
        } else {
            // Everything else is one run whose transform is the row's kind.  The two promoted types shrink
            // 4 B/elem to 2; the rest are already the engine form.
            Conv c = Conv::Copy;
            if (r.raw16) c = Conv::Copy;
            else if (r.kind == WeightKind::Bf16InF32) c = Conv::Bf16High;
            else if (r.kind == WeightKind::F16InF32) c = Conv::ToF16;
            const uint64_t elems = (uint64_t) r.ne0 * (uint64_t) (r.ne1 > 0 ? r.ne1 : 1);
            if (c != Conv::Copy && (r.src_bytes != elems * 4 || r.dst_bytes != elems * 2)) {
                // A promoted type is 4 B/elem in and 2 B/elem out, and nothing else.  If those two numbers do
                // not say so, the shape and the byte counts disagree and the element count this loop would
                // use to walk the source is not the element count the pack wrote.
                char buf[320];
                std::snprintf(buf, sizeof buf,
                              "%s: a promoted tensor of %llu elements is %llu B in and %llu B out, not %llu/%llu",
                              r.name.c_str(), (unsigned long long) elems, (unsigned long long) r.src_bytes,
                              (unsigned long long) r.dst_bytes, (unsigned long long) (elems * 4),
                              (unsigned long long) (elems * 2));
                err = buf;
                bad = true;
            }
            segs[n_segs++] = Seg{0, r.src_bytes, 0, r.dst_bytes, c};
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n_segs; ++i) { sum_src += segs[i].src_bytes; sum_dst += segs[i].dst_bytes; }
        // The segment list is this loop's own idea of the layout, and it is the ONLY thing standing between a
        // mis-sized plane and a wrong byte offset.  It is checked against both recorded totals, not trusted.
        if (!bad && (sum_src != r.src_bytes || sum_dst != r.dst_bytes)) {
            char buf[360];
            std::snprintf(buf, sizeof buf,
                          "%s: the segments cover %llu/%llu B but the index says %llu/%llu - the plane layout "
                          "this loader built is not the one the index describes",
                          r.name.c_str(), (unsigned long long) sum_src, (unsigned long long) sum_dst,
                          (unsigned long long) r.src_bytes, (unsigned long long) r.dst_bytes);
            err = buf;
            bad = true;
        }
        if (bad) { cudaFreeHost(stage_in); cudaFreeHost(stage_out); return false; }

        for (int si = 0; si < n_segs; ++si) {
            const Seg& s = segs[si];
            const bool widening = (s.conv == Conv::WidenF16);
            if (widening && (s.src_bytes & 1ull)) {
                err = r.name + ": an fp16 plane with an odd source byte count";
                cudaFreeHost(stage_in); cudaFreeHost(stage_out);
                return false;
            }
            uint64_t done = 0;
            while (done < s.src_bytes) {
                uint64_t n = std::min(CHUNK, s.src_bytes - done);
                // WIDENING NEVER SPLITS AN ELEMENT.  CHUNK is even, so a full chunk cannot, but the tail of a
                // plane whose length is odd would - and half an fp16 is a plausible-looking scale.
                if (widening && (n & 1ull)) {
                    if (n == 1) { err = r.name + ": an fp16 plane ending on a half element"; cudaFreeHost(stage_in); cudaFreeHost(stage_out); return false; }
                    n -= 1;
                }
                if (!read_at(cur, r.src_off + s.src_off + done, stage_in, (size_t) n, err, r.name.c_str())) {
                    cudaFreeHost(stage_in); cudaFreeHost(stage_out);
                    return false;
                }
                const uint8_t* src = (const uint8_t*) stage_in;
                const void* host_src = src;
                uint64_t out_bytes = n;
                uint64_t out_at = s.dst_off + done;

                switch (s.conv) {
                    case Conv::Copy:
                        break;
                    case Conv::Bf16High: {
                        // THE HIGH 16 BITS ARE THE BF16 ENCODING, exactly - not a rounding.  A bf16 value is
                        // the top half of its f32 image, and the pack promoted it without changing it, so
                        // this is a copy with a stride.
                        const uint64_t elems = n / 4;
                        out_bytes = elems * 2;
                        uint8_t* o = (uint8_t*) stage_out;
                        for (uint64_t i = 0; i < elems; ++i) {
                            uint32_t v;
                            std::memcpy(&v, src + i * 4, 4);
                            const uint16_t h = (uint16_t) (v >> 16);
                            std::memcpy(o + i * 2, &h, 2);
                        }
                        host_src = stage_out;
                        out_at = s.dst_off + done / 2;
                        break;
                    }
                    case Conv::ToF16: {
                        const uint64_t elems = n / 4;
                        out_bytes = elems * 2;
                        uint8_t* o = (uint8_t*) stage_out;
                        for (uint64_t i = 0; i < elems; ++i) {
                            float v;
                            std::memcpy(&v, src + i * 4, 4);
                            const uint16_t h = strata::kernels::f16_from_f32(v);
                            std::memcpy(o + i * 2, &h, 2);
                        }
                        host_src = stage_out;
                        out_at = s.dst_off + done / 2;
                        break;
                    }
                    case Conv::WidenF16: {
                        // fp16 bits -> f32.  EXACT: every fp16 value is an f32 value, including the
                        // subnormals, so this cannot change a single weight - which is why the engine may do
                        // it at all, and why doing it costs 10.88 MiB rather than a second kernel family.
                        const uint64_t elems = n / 2;
                        out_bytes = elems * 4;
                        float* o = (float*) stage_out;
                        for (uint64_t i = 0; i < elems; ++i) {
                            uint16_t h;
                            std::memcpy(&h, src + i * 2, 2);
                            o[i] = strata::kernels::f32_from_f16(h);
                        }
                        host_src = stage_out;
                        out_at = s.dst_off + done * 2;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                const double u0 = now_ms();
                if (cudaMemcpy(dst_base + r.dst_off + out_at, host_src, out_bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) !=
                    cudaSuccess) {
                    err = "cudaMemcpy failed for " + r.name;
                    cudaFreeHost(stage_in); cudaFreeHost(stage_out);
                    return false;
                }
                upload_ms += now_ms() - u0;
                done += n;
            }
        }

        WeightRef wr;
        wr.data = dst_base + r.dst_off;
        wr.bytes = r.dst_bytes;
        wr.ne0 = r.ne0;
        wr.ne1 = r.ne1;
        wr.elements = r.ne0 * (r.ne1 > 0 ? r.ne1 : 1);
        wr.kind = r.kind;
        wr.code_bits = r.code_bits;
        wr.code_bias = r.code_bias;
        wr.group_elems = r.group_elems;
        wr.codebook_iq4nl = r.codebook != 0;
        wr.has_offset = r.has_offset != 0;
        wr.codes_bytes = r.codes_bytes;
        wr.scales_bytes = r.scales_bytes;
        wr.offset_bytes = r.offset_bytes;
        wr.src_off = r.src_off;
        wr.src_bytes = r.src_bytes;
        wr.file_id = r.file;
        wr.scales_fp16 = r.scales_fp16 != 0;
        wr.act_kind = r.act_kind;
        table_[r.name] = wr;

        ++report_.tensors;
        if ((r.kind == WeightKind::Bf16InF32 || r.kind == WeightKind::F16InF32) && !r.raw16) {
            ++report_.re_rounded;
            report_.bytes_saved += r.src_bytes - r.dst_bytes;
        }
    }
    if (cur) std::fclose(cur);
    cudaFreeHost(stage_in);
    cudaFreeHost(stage_out);

    report_.arena_bytes = pool;
    report_.read_ms = now_ms() - t_read0 - upload_ms;
    report_.upload_ms = upload_ms;
    if (cudaDeviceSynchronize() != cudaSuccess) { err = "cudaDeviceSynchronize after the load failed"; return false; }
    return true;
}

const WeightRef* WeightTable::find(const std::string& name) const {
    const auto it = table_.find(name);
    return it == table_.end() ? nullptr : &it->second;
}

void WeightTable::hc_q8_names(int64_t n_layers, std::set<std::string>& out) {
    for (int64_t l = 0; l < n_layers; ++l)
        for (const char* h : {"hc_attn_", "hc_ffn_"})
            for (const char* m : {"down", "up"})
                out.insert("blk." + std::to_string(l) + "." + h + m + ".weight");
}

bool WeightTable::load_hc_q8(const std::string& pack_dir, uint64_t& bytes, std::string& err) {
    bytes = 0;
    std::vector<WeightRef*> todo;
    for (auto& [name, w] : table_) {
        const bool hc = name.find(".hc_attn_down.") != std::string::npos || name.find(".hc_attn_up.") != std::string::npos ||
                        name.find(".hc_ffn_down.") != std::string::npos || name.find(".hc_ffn_up.") != std::string::npos;
        if (!hc || w.resident) continue;
        // the pack holds BF16 either promoted to f32 (4 B/elem) or as it is in the GGUF (a native pack, 2 B/elem)
        if (w.kind != WeightKind::Bf16InF32 || w.ne0 % 32 != 0 ||
            (w.src_bytes != (uint64_t) w.elements * 4 && w.src_bytes != (uint64_t) w.elements * 2)) {
            err = "STRATA_HC_REQ8: " + name + " is not a BF16 tensor of whole 32-value blocks";
            return false;
        }
        todo.push_back(&w);
    }
    if (todo.empty()) return true;
    auto al = [](uint64_t b) { return (b + 255) & ~(uint64_t) 255; };
    uint64_t total = 0;
    for (const WeightRef* w : todo) total += al((uint64_t) w->elements) + al((uint64_t) w->elements / 32 * 4);
    uint8_t* dev = nullptr;
    if (cudaMalloc((void**) &dev, total) != cudaSuccess) { err = "STRATA_HC_REQ8: cudaMalloc failed"; return false; }
    std::vector<float> src;
    std::vector<int8_t> q;
    std::vector<float> sc;
    uint64_t at = 0;
    for (WeightRef* w : todo) {
        const char* fn = file_name(w->file_id);
        const std::string path = pack_dir + "/" + (fn ? fn : "?");
        std::FILE* f = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "rb");
        if (!f) { err = "STRATA_HC_REQ8: cannot open " + path; return false; }
        src.resize((size_t) w->elements);
        const bool raw16 = w->src_bytes == (uint64_t) w->elements * 2;
#if defined(_WIN32)
        bool ok = _fseeki64(f, (long long) w->src_off, SEEK_SET) == 0;
#else
        bool ok = fseeko(f, (off_t) w->src_off, SEEK_SET) == 0;   // 64-bit: a pack's dense file can pass 2 GiB
#endif
        if (ok && raw16) {
            std::vector<uint16_t> h(src.size());
            ok = std::fread(h.data(), 2, h.size(), f) == h.size();
            for (size_t i = 0; ok && i < h.size(); ++i) {
                const uint32_t b = (uint32_t) h[i] << 16;   // bf16 -> f32 is exact
                std::memcpy(&src[i], &b, 4);
            }
        } else if (ok) {
            ok = std::fread(src.data(), 4, src.size(), f) == src.size();
        }
        std::fclose(f);
        if (!ok) { err = "STRATA_HC_REQ8: cannot read the source bytes"; return false; }
        const size_t nb = src.size() / 32;
        q.resize(src.size());
        sc.resize(nb);
        for (size_t b = 0; b < nb; ++b) {   // Q8_0's rule: d = amax / 127, q = round-to-nearest-even(x / d)
            float amax = 0.f;
            for (int j = 0; j < 32; ++j) amax = std::max(amax, std::fabs(src[b * 32 + j]));
            const float d = amax / 127.f, id = d > 0.f ? 1.f / d : 0.f;
            sc[b] = d;
            for (int j = 0; j < 32; ++j) q[b * 32 + j] = (int8_t) std::nearbyint(src[b * 32 + j] * id);
        }
        uint8_t* codes = dev + at;
        at += al(q.size());
        float* scales = (float*) (dev + at);
        at += al(sc.size() * 4);
        if (cudaMemcpy(codes, q.data(), q.size(), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) != cudaSuccess ||
            cudaMemcpy(scales, sc.data(), sc.size() * 4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) != cudaSuccess) {
            err = "STRATA_HC_REQ8: upload failed";
            return false;
        }
        w->data = codes;
        w->q8_scale = scales;
        w->resident = true;
        w->bytes = q.size() + sc.size() * 4;
    }
    bytes = total;
    return true;
}

}  // namespace strata::core


## src/dsv41/ds4_gg_cpu.cpp

// Strata. The CPU lane of the DeepSeek-V4.1 engine path for ggml's block types (IQ2_XXS .. Q4_K, the experts of a requantized model):
// ggml-cpu's own row dots (type traits: vec_dot over the Q8_K / Q8_0 activation of vec_dot_type), one row at a time.  Maya's lane for
// these types (native_expert split-base rows) is not in Strata's tree; this one is plain and complete, not tuned.
#include "ds4_gguf_cpu.hpp"

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>

#if defined(STRATA_DSV41_TQ_CPU)
#include "ggml-cpu.h"
#include "ggml.h"
#include "strata/kernels/cpu/expert_layout.hpp"
#include "strata/kernels/cpu/iq_avx2.hpp"
#include "strata/kernels/cpu/iq_avx512.hpp"

#include <mutex>
#include <vector>
#if defined(_MSC_VER)
#include <intrin.h>
#elif defined(__x86_64__)
#include <cpuid.h>
#endif

namespace strata::ds4::gguf {
namespace {
void init_once() {
    static std::once_flag f;
    std::call_once(f, [] { ggml_cpu_init(); });
}
size_t row_size(int type, int64_t k) { return ggml_row_size((ggml_type) type, k); }
}  // namespace

bool gg_cpu_type(int type) {
    // every type ggml-cpu has a row dot for (ds4_gguf.cu's known types); the i-quants with a device kernel are usually
    // placed in VRAM, but a pack may hand any of them to this lane
    switch (type) {
        case 10: case 11: case 12: case 13: case 14: case 16: case 17: case 18: case 19: case 20: case 21: case 22:
        case 23: case 29: return true;
        default: return false;
    }
}

static bool dbg() { static const bool on = std::getenv("DS4_DBG_GG") != nullptr; return on; }
bool gg_cpu_fmt(int tg, int td, int n_embd, int n_ff, IqCpu& f, std::string& err) {
    if (dbg()) std::fprintf(stderr, "gg_cpu_fmt %d %d\n", tg, td);
    init_once();
    if (!gg_cpu_type(tg) || !gg_cpu_type(td)) {
        err = "not ggml block types";
        return false;
    }
    const ggml_type_traits_cpu* a = ggml_get_type_traits_cpu((ggml_type) tg);
    const ggml_type_traits_cpu* b = ggml_get_type_traits_cpu((ggml_type) td);
    if (a == nullptr || b == nullptr || a->vec_dot == nullptr || b->vec_dot == nullptr) {
        err = "ggml-cpu has no row dot for these types";
        return false;
    }
    f.tg = tg;
    f.td = td;
    f.n_embd = n_embd;
    f.n_ff = n_ff;
    f.gu_act = (int) a->vec_dot_type;
    f.d_act = (int) b->vec_dot_type;
    f.gu_row = row_size(tg, n_embd);
    f.d_row = row_size(td, n_ff);
    f.act_bytes = row_size(f.gu_act, n_embd);
    f.h_bytes = row_size(f.d_act, n_ff);
    return true;
}

// x (k values) -> the activation type (Q8_K, Q8_0 ..) ggml-cpu's dot takes
void gg_cpu_quant(int act, const float* x, int k, void* dst) {
    init_once();
    if (dbg()) std::fprintf(stderr, "gg_cpu_quant act %d k %d\n", act, k);
    const ggml_type_traits_cpu* tc = ggml_get_type_traits_cpu((ggml_type) act);
    if (tc != nullptr && tc->from_float != nullptr) {
        tc->from_float(x, dst, k);
        return;
    }
    const ggml_type_traits* t = ggml_get_type_traits((ggml_type) act);
    if (dbg()) std::fprintf(stderr, "gg_cpu_quant: no cpu from_float, ref %p\n", (void*) (t ? t->from_float_ref : nullptr));
    t->from_float_ref(x, dst, k);
}

// Strata's AVX2 multi-token rows for the i-quants (iq256x_rows: each 32-value chunk decoded once, every token applies it).  They
// are ggml-cpu's vec_dot bit for bit (the integer sums are ggml's and the float additions come in ggml's order: ds4_gg_bench --exact,
// and own_ok() below checks it once per type on this CPU against the ggml-cpu build in use), so taking them or not never changes an
// answer, at any number of tokens - the choice is speed only.  Measured on the rows alone: no faster than ggml's dot at one token
// (both wait for the codebook lookups), x1.7-2.9 at 2-4 tokens, x1.4 on IQ3_S already at one; so by default ggml's dot below
// min_tokens(type) and these rows from there.  DS4_GG_IQ256=0 never takes them, =1 always (the old opt-in).
static int g_iq256 = -1;   // -1: from the environment and the CPU, 0 off, 1 always, 2 from min_tokens(type)
void gg_cpu_set_iq256(int mode) { g_iq256 = mode; }
static int min_tokens(int type) { return type == 21 ? 1 : type == 29 ? 3 : 2; }
static bool own_ok(int type, int impl) {
    static std::once_flag once[2][32];
    static bool ok[2][32];
    const int k = type & 31;
    std::call_once(once[impl][k], [&] {
        ok[impl][k] = false;
        const ggml_type_traits_cpu* tc = ggml_get_type_traits_cpu((ggml_type) type);
        const ggml_type_traits_cpu* q8 = tc ? ggml_get_type_traits_cpu(tc->vec_dot_type) : nullptr;
        if (tc == nullptr || tc->vec_dot == nullptr || q8 == nullptr || q8->from_float == nullptr) return;
        const int n = 1024, rows = 7;
        const size_t rb = ggml_row_size((ggml_type) type, n), bb = ggml_type_size((ggml_type) type), ab = ggml_row_size(tc->vec_dot_type, n);
        uint64_t st = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull + (uint64_t) type;
        auto next = [&st] { st ^= st << 13; st ^= st >> 7; st ^= st << 17; return st; };
        std::vector<uint8_t> w(rb * rows);
        for (auto& b : w) b = (uint8_t) next();
        for (size_t o = 0; o < w.size(); o += bb) {
            const ggml_fp16_t d = ggml_fp32_to_fp16(0.002f + 0.001f * (float) (next() % 16));
            if (type == 29) {   // IQ1_M keeps its f16 in the top nibbles of the four scale words
                uint16_t sc[4];
                std::memcpy(sc, &w[o + 48], 8);
                for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) sc[j] = (uint16_t) ((sc[j] & 0x0fff) | ((d >> (4 * j)) & 0xf) << 12);
                std::memcpy(&w[o + 48], sc, 8);
            } else {
                std::memcpy(&w[o], &d, sizeof d);
            }
        }
        for (int nt : {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 16, 33}) {
            std::vector<std::vector<uint8_t>> a((size_t) nt, std::vector<uint8_t>(ab));
            std::vector<const void*> ap((size_t) nt);
            std::vector<std::vector<float>> o0((size_t) nt, std::vector<float>(rows)), o1 = o0;
            std::vector<float*> p1((size_t) nt);
            for (int t = 0; t < nt; ++t) {
                std::vector<float> x((size_t) n);
                for (auto& v : x) v = ((float) (next() % 2001) - 1000.0f) * 1e-3f;
                q8->from_float(x.data(), a[(size_t) t].data(), n);
                ap[(size_t) t] = a[(size_t) t].data();
                p1[(size_t) t] = o1[(size_t) t].data();
                for (int r = 0; r < rows; ++r) tc->vec_dot(n, &o0[(size_t) t][(size_t) r], 0, w.data() + (size_t) r * rb, 0, ap[(size_t) t], 0, 1);
            }
            if (impl == 1) strata::kernels::cpu::iq512x_rows(type, w.data(), rb, n, ap.data(), nt, p1.data(), 0, rows);
            else strata::kernels::cpu::iq256x_rows(type, w.data(), rb, n, ap.data(), nt, p1.data(), 0, rows);
            for (int t = 0; t < nt; ++t)
                if (std::memcmp(o0[(size_t) t].data(), o1[(size_t) t].data(), rows * sizeof(float)) != 0) {
                    if (dbg() || std::getenv("DS4_GG_VERBOSE")) std::fprintf(stderr, "ds4: CPU lane type %d: AVX2 rows differ from ggml-cpu's dot at %d tokens, not used\n", type, nt);
                    return;
                }
        }
        ok[impl][k] = true;
    });
    return ok[impl][k];
}
// the AMD family (0x19 Zen 3/4, 0x1A Zen 5), 0 on any other vendor or if it cannot be read
static int amd_family() {
    static const int fam = [] {
#if defined(_MSC_VER)
        int r[4];
        __cpuid(r, 0);
        char v[13];
        std::memcpy(v, &r[1], 4); std::memcpy(v + 4, &r[3], 4); std::memcpy(v + 8, &r[2], 4);
        v[12] = 0;
        if (std::strcmp(v, "AuthenticAMD") != 0) return 0;
        __cpuid(r, 1);
        const unsigned eax = (unsigned) r[0];
#elif defined(__x86_64__)
        unsigned a, b, c, d;
        if (!__get_cpuid(0, &a, &b, &c, &d)) return 0;
        char v[13];
        std::memcpy(v, &b, 4); std::memcpy(v + 4, &d, 4); std::memcpy(v + 8, &c, 4);
        v[12] = 0;
        if (std::strcmp(v, "AuthenticAMD") != 0) return 0;
        if (!__get_cpuid(1, &a, &b, &c, &d)) return 0;
        const unsigned eax = a;
#else
        return 0;
#endif
        const unsigned base = (eax >> 8) & 0xF;
        return (int) (base == 0xF ? base + ((eax >> 20) & 0xFF) : base);
    }();
    return fam;
}
// DS4_GG_IQ512: 1 takes the AVX-512 rows (bit-identical too) where the CPU has AVX-512 F/BW/VL/DQ/VNNI/VBMI, 0 never; unset: the rule
// below, from the measurements on Zen 4.
static int g_iq512 = -1;
static bool want_512(int type, int nt) {
    if (g_iq512 < 0) {
        const char* v = std::getenv("DS4_GG_IQ512");
        g_iq512 = !strata::kernels::cpu::cpu_avx512_ok() ? 0 : v == nullptr ? 2 : std::atoi(v) != 0 ? 1 : 0;
    }
    if (g_iq512 == 0 || !strata::kernels::cpu::iq512x_supported(type)) return false;
    if (g_iq512 == 1) return true;
    // by CPU (measured, ds4_gg_bench --expert; the rows are bit-identical to ggml's dot everywhere):
    //  Zen 5 (AMD family 0x1A, Strix Halo, 16 threads, GB/s of weights ggml -> AVX-512 rows): one token IQ2_XXS 35 -> 44, IQ2_XS 37 -> 48,
    //  IQ1_M 32 -> 36 (the sign masks by popcount, IQ1_M's indices by pdep: no table loads), IQ3_XXS 43 -> 45; 4 tokens x2.5-3.5; 16 tokens x4.4-4.8;
    //  Zen 4 (family 0x19, Ryzen 5 7600, 6 threads): one token IQ2_XXS 15.9 -> 19.7, IQ2_XS 20.6 -> 24.2, IQ1_M 16.7 -> 17.6-18.2, IQ3_XXS 22.4 -> 23.8
    //  (noise-level); 2 tokens x1.5-2.2; 4 tokens x2.4-3.3; 16 tokens x2.8-4.6;
    //  anything else with AVX-512 (Intel): not measured, so the AVX2 rows
    const int fam = amd_family();
    if (fam < 0x19) return false;
    if (type == 16 || type == 17) return true;
    if (type == 18) return nt >= 2;
    if (type == 29) return nt >= 2 || fam >= 0x1A;
    return false;
}
// 0: ggml-cpu's dot, 1: the AVX2 rows, 2: the AVX-512 rows
static int use_iq256(int type, int nt) {
    if (g_iq256 < 0) {
        const char* v = std::getenv("DS4_GG_IQ256");
        // (ggml-cpu's own answer: built with AVX2 + FMA + F16C, which is also what makes its dots the AVX2 ones these rows match)
        const bool avx2 = ggml_cpu_has_avx2() && ggml_cpu_has_fma() && ggml_cpu_has_f16c();
        g_iq256 = !avx2 ? 0 : v == nullptr ? 2 : std::atoi(v) != 0 ? 1 : 0;
    }
    if (g_iq256 == 0) return 0;
    if (want_512(type, nt) && own_ok(type, 1)) return 2;
    if (!strata::kernels::cpu::iq256x_supported(type)) return 0;
    if (g_iq256 == 2 && nt < min_tokens(type)) return 0;
    return own_ok(type, 0) ? 1 : 0;
}

static void dots(int type, const uint8_t* w, size_t rb, int n, const void* const* act, int nt, float* const* out, int r0, int r1) {
    if (nt > 0) {
        const int impl = use_iq256(type, nt);
        if (impl == 2) {
            strata::kernels::cpu::iq512x_rows(type, w, rb, n, act, nt, out, r0, r1);
            return;
        }
        if (impl == 1) {
            strata::kernels::cpu::iq256x_rows(type, w, rb, n, act, nt, out, r0, r1);
            return;
        }
    }
    const ggml_type_traits_cpu* tc = ggml_get_type_traits_cpu((ggml_type) type);
    if (dbg()) std::fprintf(stderr, "gg dots type %d n %d rows %d..%d nt %d\n", type, n, r0, r1, nt);
    for (int r = r0; r < r1; ++r)
        for (int t = 0; t < nt; ++t) tc->vec_dot(n, &out[t][r], 0, w + (size_t) r * rb, 0, act[t], 0, 1);
}

void gg_cpu_gate_up(const IqCpu& f, const uint8_t* gate, const uint8_t* up, const void* const* act, int nt, float* const* ff, int r0,
                    int r1, float limit) {
    constexpr int kMaxTok = 64;   // (the prompt path: a chunk's tokens an expert)
    static thread_local std::vector<float> tmp[kMaxTok];
    float* uo[kMaxTok];
    if (nt > kMaxTok) {   // (more than a pass takes: in pieces)
        for (int t0 = 0; t0 < nt; t0 += kMaxTok)
            gg_cpu_gate_up(f, gate, up, act + t0, nt - t0 < kMaxTok ? nt - t0 : kMaxTok, ff + t0, r0, r1, limit);
        return;
    }
    for (int t = 0; t < nt; ++t) {
        tmp[t].resize((size_t) r1);
        uo[t] = tmp[t].data();
    }
    dots(f.tg, gate, f.gu_row, f.n_embd, act, nt, ff, r0, r1);
    dots(f.tg, up, f.gu_row, f.n_embd, act, nt, uo, r0, r1);
    for (int t = 0; t < nt; ++t)
        for (int r = r0; r < r1; ++r) {
            float g = ff[t][r], u = uo[t][r];
            if (limit > 0.0f) {
                g = g < limit ? g : limit;
                u = u < -limit ? -limit : (u > limit ? limit : u);
            }
            ff[t][r] = g / (1.0f + std::exp(-g)) * u;
        }
}

void gg_cpu_down(const IqCpu& f, const uint8_t* down, const void* const* hq, int nt, float* const* out, int r0, int r1) {
    dots(f.td, down, f.d_row, f.n_ff, hq, nt, out, r0, r1);
}

// a row of any ggml block type -> BF16 on the host (the embedding table's reader; Q5_K / Q4_K / Q6_K / Q8_0 rows of a
// GGUF whose dense tensors are not BF16): ggml's own to_float, then the same round-to-nearest-even to BF16 the Q8_0 path uses
bool gg_row_to_bf16(int type, const uint8_t* row, int k, uint16_t* out) {
    init_once();
    const ggml_type_traits* t = ggml_get_type_traits((ggml_type) type);
    if (t == nullptr || t->to_float == nullptr) return false;
    static thread_local std::vector<float> f;
    f.resize((size_t) k);
    t->to_float(row, f.data(), k);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        uint32_t u;
        std::memcpy(&u, &f[(size_t) i], 4);
        u += 0x7fffu + ((u >> 16) & 1u);
        out[i] = (uint16_t) (u >> 16);
    }
    return true;
}
}  // namespace strata::ds4::gguf
#else
namespace strata::ds4::gguf {
bool gg_cpu_type(int) { return false; }
bool gg_cpu_fmt(int, int, int, int, IqCpu&, std::string& err) {
    err = "this build has no ggml-cpu lane (STRATA_NATIVE_EXPERTS=OFF)";
    return false;
}
void gg_cpu_quant(int, const float*, int, void*) {}
void gg_cpu_gate_up(const IqCpu&, const uint8_t*, const uint8_t*, const void* const*, int, float* const*, int, int, float) {}
void gg_cpu_down(const IqCpu&, const uint8_t*, const void* const*, int, float* const*, int, int) {}
bool gg_row_to_bf16(int, const uint8_t*, int, uint16_t*) { return false; }
}  // namespace strata::ds4::gguf
#endif


## src/dsv41/ds4_gguf_cpu.cpp

// Copyright (c) 2026 Peasant Smith and the Project Maya contributors (MIT; https://github.com/mw00/project-maya, v1.1.17).
// Ported into Strata (third_party/project-maya/NOTICE.md, LICENSE); changes are in the git history of this file.
// src/ds4/ds4_gguf_cpu.cpp - a GGUF's MXFP4 experts on the CPU lane (see ds4_gguf_cpu.hpp).
#include "ds4_gguf_cpu.hpp"

#include "strata/dsv41/exl3_cpu.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(_M_X64)
#define MX_X86 1
#include <immintrin.h>
#if defined(_MSC_VER)
#include <intrin.h>
#else
#include <cpuid.h>
#endif
#endif

// a function's instruction set (GCC / Clang, clang-cl too; MSVC compiles any intrinsic as it is): the file is built for
// the baseline x86-64, and each tier's code runs only where detect() says the CPU and the OS take it
#if defined(MX_X86) && (defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__))
#define MX_TARGET(s) __attribute__((target(s)))
#else
#define MX_TARGET(s)
#endif
#define MX_AVX2 MX_TARGET("avx2,fma")
// AVX-VNNI's intrinsics: GCC 11, Clang 12, MSVC 2022
#if defined(MX_X86) && (defined(_MSC_VER) || (defined(__clang__) && __clang_major__ >= 12) || \
                        (!defined(__clang__) && defined(__GNUC__) && __GNUC__ >= 11))
#define MX_AVXVNNI 1
#endif

namespace strata::ds4::gguf {
namespace {

constexpr int kBlock = 32, kBytes = 17;
constexpr float kValues[16] = {0.0f, 1.0f, 2.0f, 3.0f, 4.0f, 6.0f, 8.0f, 12.0f,
                               0.0f, -1.0f, -2.0f, -3.0f, -4.0f, -6.0f, -8.0f, -12.0f};
constexpr int kCodes[16] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 0, -1, -2, -3, -4, -6, -8, -12};

float e8m0_half(uint32_t e) {   // 2^(e - 128), as the device's
    const uint32_t bits = e < 2 ? 0x00200000u << e : (e - 1) << 23;
    float f;
    std::memcpy(&f, &bits, 4);
    return f;
}
struct E8m0Table {
    float v[256];
    E8m0Table() {
        for (int e = 0; e < 256; ++e) v[e] = e8m0_half((uint32_t) e);
    }
};
const E8m0Table& e8() {
    static const E8m0Table t;
    return t;
}

void rows_scalar(const uint8_t* w, size_t rb, int k, int r0, int r1, const float* const* x, int n, float* const* y) {
    for (int r = r0; r < r1; ++r) {
        const uint8_t* p = w + (size_t) r * rb;
        float acc[kMxCpuMaxN] = {};
        for (int b = 0; b < k / kBlock; ++b, p += kBytes) {
            const float d = e8m0_half(p[0]);
            float wv[kBlock];
            for (int j = 0; j < 16; ++j) {
                wv[j] = kValues[p[1 + j] & 15] * d;
                wv[j + 16] = kValues[p[1 + j] >> 4] * d;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                const float* xb = x[i] + b * kBlock;
                float s = 0.0f;
                for (int j = 0; j < kBlock; ++j) s += wv[j] * xb[j];
                acc[i] += s;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) y[i][r - r0] = acc[i];
    }
}

#if defined(MX_X86)
MX_AVX2 float hsum(__m256 v) {
    const __m128 a = _mm_add_ps(_mm256_castps256_ps128(v), _mm256_extractf128_ps(v, 1));
    const __m128 b = _mm_add_ps(a, _mm_movehl_ps(a, a));
    return _mm_cvtss_f32(_mm_add_ss(b, _mm_shuffle_ps(b, b, 1)));
}

// a block: the 16 code bytes -> 32 int8 values through a shuffle table (low nibbles: values 0..15, high: 16..31),
// widened to F32 in 4 x 8, times the block's scale (exact), FMAs against each activation
MX_AVX2 void rows_avx2(const uint8_t* w, size_t rb, int k, int r0, int r1, const float* const* x, int n,
                       float* const* y) {
    const __m128i lut = _mm_setr_epi8(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 0, -1, -2, -3, -4, -6, -8, -12);
    const __m128i m4 = _mm_set1_epi8(0x0f);
    for (int r = r0; r < r1; ++r) {
        const uint8_t* p = w + (size_t) r * rb;
        __m256 acc[kMxCpuMaxN];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) acc[i] = _mm256_setzero_ps();
        for (int b = 0; b < k / kBlock; ++b, p += kBytes) {
            const __m256 d = _mm256_set1_ps(e8m0_half(p[0]));
            const __m128i q = _mm_loadu_si128((const __m128i*) (p + 1));
            const __m128i lo = _mm_shuffle_epi8(lut, _mm_and_si128(q, m4));
            const __m128i hi = _mm_shuffle_epi8(lut, _mm_and_si128(_mm_srli_epi16(q, 4), m4));
            const __m256 w0 = _mm256_mul_ps(d, _mm256_cvtepi32_ps(_mm256_cvtepi8_epi32(lo)));
            const __m256 w1 = _mm256_mul_ps(d, _mm256_cvtepi32_ps(_mm256_cvtepi8_epi32(_mm_srli_si128(lo, 8))));
            const __m256 w2 = _mm256_mul_ps(d, _mm256_cvtepi32_ps(_mm256_cvtepi8_epi32(hi)));
            const __m256 w3 = _mm256_mul_ps(d, _mm256_cvtepi32_ps(_mm256_cvtepi8_epi32(_mm_srli_si128(hi, 8))));
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                const float* xb = x[i] + b * kBlock;
                __m256 a = acc[i];
                a = _mm256_fmadd_ps(w0, _mm256_loadu_ps(xb), a);
                a = _mm256_fmadd_ps(w1, _mm256_loadu_ps(xb + 8), a);
                a = _mm256_fmadd_ps(w2, _mm256_loadu_ps(xb + 16), a);
                a = _mm256_fmadd_ps(w3, _mm256_loadu_ps(xb + 24), a);
                acc[i] = a;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) y[i][r - r0] = hsum(acc[i]);
    }
}

// ---- the int8 path's vector tiers (ds4_mx_kern.inc)
#define MXK_NS mx_avx2
#define MXK_ATTR MX_TARGET("avx2,fma")
#define MXK_256 1
#include "ds4_mx_kern.inc"
#if defined(MX_AVXVNNI)
#define MXK_NS mx_avxvnni
#define MXK_ATTR MX_TARGET("avx2,fma,avxvnni")
#define MXK_256 1
#define MXK_VNNI 1
#include "ds4_mx_kern.inc"
#endif
#define MXK_NS mx_avx512
#define MXK_ATTR MX_TARGET("avx512f,avx512bw,fma")
#define MXK_512 1
#include "ds4_mx_kern.inc"
#define MXK_NS mx_avx512vnni
#define MXK_ATTR MX_TARGET("avx512f,avx512bw,avx512vnni,fma")
#define MXK_512 1
#define MXK_VNNI 1
#include "ds4_mx_kern.inc"
#endif

// ---- the int8 path's scalar tier: ds4_mx_kern.inc's order (8 accumulators, block j of a group of 8 into L(j)), so it
// gives the vector tiers' bits - also the tests' check on them.  The activation's layout (ds4_mx_kern.inc), for any k
// % 32 == 0: the int8 values in quads (a partial last quad padded), then per group of 8 blocks the scales and the
// offset corrections in lane order (a partial last group padded)
inline int act_lane(int b) { return 8 * (b >> 3) + ((b & 7) & 1) * 4 + ((b & 7) >> 1); }
inline size_t act_qbytes(int k) { return (size_t) 128 * (size_t) ((k / kBlock + 3) / 4); }
inline size_t act_groups(int k) { return (size_t) ((k / kBlock + 7) / 8); }
inline int act_q(const uint8_t* act, int b, int j) {   // block b's value j (0..31)
    return ((const int8_t*) act)[(b >> 2) * 128 + (j >= 16 ? 64 : 0) + 16 * (b & 3) + (j & 15)];
}
inline float act_d(const uint8_t* act, int k, int b) { return ((const float*) (act + act_qbytes(k)))[act_lane(b)]; }

void quant_scalar(const float* x, int b0, int b1, uint8_t* act, int k) {
    int8_t* q = (int8_t*) act;
    float* dx = (float*) (act + act_qbytes(k));
    int32_t* corr = (int32_t*) (act + act_qbytes(k) + 32 * act_groups(k));
    for (int b = b0; b < b1; ++b, x += kBlock) {
        float am = 0.0f;
        for (int j = 0; j < kBlock; ++j) am = std::max(am, std::fabs(x[j]));
        const float sc = am / 127.0f;
        int8_t v[kBlock];
        int s = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < kBlock; ++j) {
            v[j] = am > 0.0f ? (int8_t) (int) std::nearbyint(x[j] / sc) : (int8_t) 0;
            s += v[j];
        }
        int8_t* lo = q + (b >> 2) * 128 + 16 * (b & 3);
        for (int j = 0; j < 16; ++j) {
            lo[j] = v[j];
            lo[64 + j] = v[16 + j];
        }
        dx[act_lane(b)] = sc;
        corr[act_lane(b)] = -12 * s;
    }
}

void rows_q_scalar(const uint8_t* w, size_t rb, int k, int r0, int r1, const void* const* act, int n, float* const* y) {
    const float* t = e8().v;
    for (int r = r0; r < r1; ++r) {
        const uint8_t* p = w + (size_t) r * rb;
        float acc[kMxCpuMaxN][8] = {};
        for (int b = 0; b < k / kBlock; ++b, p += kBytes) {
            int wv[kBlock];
            for (int j = 0; j < 16; ++j) {
                wv[j] = kCodes[p[1 + j] & 15];
                wv[j + 16] = kCodes[p[1 + j] >> 4];
            }
            const int l = act_lane(b) & 7;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                const uint8_t* a = (const uint8_t*) act[i];
                int s = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < kBlock; ++j) s += wv[j] * act_q(a, b, j);
                acc[i][l] = std::fma((float) s, t[p[0]] * act_d(a, k, b), acc[i][l]);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            const float* A = acc[i];
            y[i][r - r0] = ((A[0] + A[4]) + (A[2] + A[6])) + ((A[1] + A[5]) + (A[3] + A[7]));
        }
    }
}

// ---- which tiers this CPU runs
struct Cpu {
    bool avx2 = false, vnni256 = false, avx512 = false, vnni512 = false, vbmi = false, bmi2 = false;
};
Cpu detect() {
    Cpu c;
#if defined(MX_X86)
    unsigned r[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
    auto cpuid = [&](unsigned leaf, unsigned sub) {
#if defined(_MSC_VER)
        int x[4];
        __cpuidex(x, (int) leaf, (int) sub);
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) r[i] = (unsigned) x[i];
#else
        __cpuid_count(leaf, sub, r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3]);
#endif
    };
    cpuid(0, 0);
    const unsigned max_leaf = r[0];
    if (max_leaf < 7) return c;
    cpuid(1, 0);
    const bool fma = (r[2] >> 12) & 1u, osxsave = (r[2] >> 27) & 1u, avx = (r[2] >> 28) & 1u;
    if (!fma || !osxsave || !avx) return c;
#if defined(_MSC_VER)
    const unsigned long long xcr0 = _xgetbv(0);
#else
    unsigned lo = 0, hi = 0;
    __asm__ volatile("xgetbv" : "=a"(lo), "=d"(hi) : "c"(0));
    const unsigned long long xcr0 = ((unsigned long long) hi << 32) | lo;
#endif
    if ((xcr0 & 0x6) != 0x6) return c;   // the OS saves the YMM state
    cpuid(7, 0);
    const unsigned b7 = r[1], c7 = r[2];
    c.avx2 = (b7 >> 5) & 1u;
    const bool zmm_os = (xcr0 & 0xE6) == 0xE6;
    c.avx512 = c.avx2 && zmm_os && ((b7 >> 16) & 1u) && ((b7 >> 30) & 1u);   // F, BW
    c.vnni512 = c.avx512 && ((c7 >> 11) & 1u);
    c.vbmi = c.avx512 && ((c7 >> 1) & 1u);   // AVX-512 VBMI
    c.bmi2 = (b7 >> 8) & 1u;
    cpuid(7, 1);
    c.vnni256 = c.avx2 && ((r[0] >> 4) & 1u);   // AVX-VNNI
#endif
    return c;
}
const Cpu& cpu() {
    static const Cpu c = detect();
    return c;
}

// The tier for this CPU, measured: every vector tier it runs times the same small warm job (64 rows of a 5120-wide
// matrix, in L2, against 1, 2 and 4 activations - the compute a row takes, which is where the tiers differ; streaming
// from RAM they all reach the memory's speed) in interleaved rounds, the best round of each counting.  The choice never
// changes an answer (the tiers give the same bits), only the speed.  DS4_MX_TIER=<name> picks one by hand.
std::string g_tier_report;
int measure_tier(const std::vector<int>& cand);
int pick_tier() {
    if (const char* f = std::getenv("DS4_MX_TIER"))
        for (int t = 0; t < kMxTiers; ++t)
            if (std::string(f) == mx_tier_name(t) && mx_tier_ok(t)) {
                g_tier_report = std::string("DS4_MX_TIER=") + f;
                return t;
            }
    std::vector<int> cand;
    for (int t = 1; t < kMxTiers; ++t)
        if (mx_tier_ok(t)) cand.push_back(t);
    if (cand.empty()) return kMxScalar;
    if (cand.size() == 1) return cand[0];
    return measure_tier(cand);
}
int measure_tier(const std::vector<int>& cand) {
    constexpr int K = 5120, R = 64, NT = 4;
    const size_t rb = (size_t) K / kBlock * kBytes;
    std::vector<uint8_t> w(rb * R), act(mx_act_bytes(K) * NT);
    uint32_t s = 0x9E3779B9u;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < w.size(); ++i) {
        s = s * 1664525u + 1013904223u;
        w[i] = (uint8_t) (s >> 24);
    }
    for (size_t b = 0; b < w.size() / kBytes; ++b) w[b * kBytes] = (uint8_t) (118 + b % 6);
    std::vector<float> x(K);
    for (int i = 0; i < NT; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < K; ++j) {
            s = s * 1664525u + 1013904223u;
            x[(size_t) j] = (float) ((int) (s >> 16) - 32768) / 32768.0f;
        }
        quant_scalar(x.data(), 0, K / kBlock, act.data() + (size_t) i * mx_act_bytes(K), K);
    }
    const void* ap[NT];
    for (int i = 0; i < NT; ++i) ap[i] = act.data() + (size_t) i * mx_act_bytes(K);
    float y[NT][R];
    float* yp[NT] = {y[0], y[1], y[2], y[3]};
    std::vector<double> best(cand.size(), 1e30);
    for (int round = 0; round < 6; ++round)
        for (size_t c = 0; c < cand.size(); ++c) {
            const auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            for (int rep = 0; rep < 8; ++rep)
                for (int n : {1, 2, 4}) mx_rows_tier(cand[c], w.data(), rb, K, 0, R, ap, n, yp, 0);
            const double us = std::chrono::duration<double, std::micro>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0).count();
            if (round > 0) best[c] = std::min(best[c], us);   // (round 0: the clock and the caches warm)
        }
    size_t bi = 0;
    for (size_t c = 1; c < cand.size(); ++c)
        if (best[c] < best[bi]) bi = c;
    char buf[64];
    for (size_t c = 0; c < cand.size(); ++c) {
        std::snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%s%s %.0f us", c ? ", " : "", mx_tier_name(cand[c]), best[c]);
        g_tier_report += buf;
    }
    return cand[bi];
}
int prefetch_bytes() {
    const char* f = std::getenv("DS4_MX_PF");
    return f != nullptr ? std::max(0, std::atoi(f)) : 0;
}

}  // namespace

void q8_round(const float* x, int k, float* out) {
    for (int b = 0; b < k / kBlock; ++b) {
        const float* xb = x + b * kBlock;
        float am = 0.0f;
        for (int j = 0; j < kBlock; ++j) am = std::max(am, std::fabs(xb[j]));
        const float sc = am / 127.0f;
        for (int j = 0; j < kBlock; ++j)
            out[b * kBlock + j] = am > 0.0f ? std::nearbyint(xb[j] / sc) * sc : 0.0f;
    }
}

void mx_cpu_rows(const uint8_t* w, size_t rb, int k, int r0, int r1, const float* const* x, int n, float* const* y) {
#if defined(MX_X86)
    static const bool avx2 = strata::dsv41k::cpu::exl3_cpu_tier() >= 1;
    if (avx2) return rows_avx2(w, rb, k, r0, r1, x, n, y);
#endif
    rows_scalar(w, rb, k, r0, r1, x, n, y);
}

// ---- the int8 path
bool mx_tier_ok(int t) {
    switch (t) {
        case kMxScalar: return true;
        case kMxAvx2: return cpu().avx2;
#if defined(MX_AVXVNNI)
        case kMxAvxVnni: return cpu().vnni256;
#endif
        case kMxAvx512: return cpu().avx512;
        case kMxAvx512Vnni: return cpu().vnni512;
        default: return false;
    }
}
const char* mx_tier_name(int t) {
    switch (t) {
        case kMxScalar: return "scalar";
        case kMxAvx2: return "avx2";
        case kMxAvxVnni: return "avxvnni";
        case kMxAvx512: return "avx512";
        case kMxAvx512Vnni: return "avx512vnni";
        default: return "?";
    }
}
int mx_tier() {
    static const int t = pick_tier();
    return t;
}
const char* mx_tier_report() {
    (void) mx_tier();
    return g_tier_report.c_str();
}

void mx_quant_blocks(const float* x, int b0, int b1, void* act, int k) {
#if defined(MX_X86)
    if (cpu().avx2 && k % 256 == 0) return mx_avx2::quant(x, b0, b1, (uint8_t*) act, k);
#endif
    quant_scalar(x, b0, b1, (uint8_t*) act, k);
}
void mx_quant_blocks_scalar(const float* x, int b0, int b1, void* act, int k) {
    quant_scalar(x, b0, b1, (uint8_t*) act, k);
}
int mx_act_value(const void* act, int b, int j) { return act_q((const uint8_t*) act, b, j); }
float mx_act_scale(const void* act, int k, int b) { return act_d((const uint8_t*) act, k, b); }

void mx_rows_tier(int t, const uint8_t* w, size_t rb, int k, int r0, int r1, const void* const* act, int n,
                  float* const* y, int pf) {
    if (k % 256 != 0 || !mx_tier_ok(t)) t = kMxScalar;   // (the vector tiers take a group of 8 blocks a step)
    const float* tb = e8().v;
#if defined(MX_X86)
    switch (t) {
        case kMxAvx2: return mx_avx2::rows(w, rb, k, r0, r1, act, n, y, tb, pf);
#if defined(MX_AVXVNNI)
        case kMxAvxVnni: return mx_avxvnni::rows(w, rb, k, r0, r1, act, n, y, tb, pf);
#endif
        case kMxAvx512: return mx_avx512::rows(w, rb, k, r0, r1, act, n, y, tb, pf);
        case kMxAvx512Vnni: return mx_avx512vnni::rows(w, rb, k, r0, r1, act, n, y, tb, pf);
        default: break;
    }
#endif
    (void) tb, (void) pf;
    for (int i0 = 0; i0 < n; i0 += kMxCpuMaxN)
        rows_q_scalar(w, rb, k, r0, r1, act + i0, std::min(kMxCpuMaxN, n - i0), y + i0);
}

void mx_rows(const uint8_t* w, size_t rb, int k, int r0, int r1, const void* const* act, int n, float* const* y) {
    static const int pf = prefetch_bytes();
    mx_rows_tier(mx_tier(), w, rb, k, r0, r1, act, n, y, pf);
}

}  // namespace strata::ds4::gguf
