                ok = fin ? m.feed_mark(r.ids.data() + done, (int) n, 1, 1, err)
                         : m.feed(r.ids.data() + done, (int) n, 0, err);
            done += n;
            if (ok && pin_at != 0 && done == pin_at) m.checkpoint(3);
            if (ok && (done >= next_pp || done == total)) {
                const double ms = now_ms() - t0;
                std::printf("PP %zu %zu %.1f %.1f %zu\n", done, r.ids.size(), ms,
                            ms > 0 ? 1000.0 * (double) (done - from) / ms : 0.0, from);
                std::fflush(stdout);
                next_pp = done + 64;
            }
        }
        m.set_cancel(nullptr);
        m.set_images({});
        if (stopped || (!ok && m.cancelled())) {
            const bool back = from > 0 && m.restore((int64_t) from) && (size_t) m.pos() == from;
            if (!back) {
                m.reset();
                held.clear();
            }
            std::fprintf(stderr, "ds4 serve: stopped while reading the prompt of %zu tokens, after %.0f ms%s\n",
                         total, now_ms() - t0, back ? "; the conversation before it is kept" : "");
            std::printf("DONE 0 %zu %.1f 0.0 cancel 0 0 %zu 0 0\n", r.ids.size(), now_ms() - t0, back ? from : (size_t) 0);
            std::fflush(stdout);
            continue;
        }
        if (!ok) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "ds4: %s\n", err.c_str());
            std::printf("ERR %s\n", err.c_str());
            std::printf("DONE 0 %zu 0.0 0.0 cancel 0 0 0 0 0\n", r.ids.size());
            std::fflush(stdout);
            m.reset();
            held.clear();
            continue;
        }
        held = std::move(pics);
        m.checkpoint(0);
        if (!continued && slot_max > 0) m.pin();   // (a new run of prompts: where it may be rendered again from)
        const double t1 = now_ms();
        long long produced = 0;
        const char* finish = "length";
        const long long limit = r.max_new > 0 ? r.max_new : m.max_context() - (long long) r.ids.size();
        long long d_off = 0, d_acc = 0;
        bool cool = false;
        int tok = m.sample(r.temperature, r.top_p, r.top_k, r.min_p, r.seed, counter++);
        std::vector<int> got;
        // STAT for the Monitor every 8 tokens and at the end, over this answer so far: the GLM engine's keys (speed, the
        // VRAM hit, promotions a token) and DeepSeek's own - experts a token on the CPU lane, MB a token the storage
        // read (Linux), the n-gram memory's (Engram) read time a token, the drafts' acceptance
        const strata::ds4::Stats s_dec = m.stats();
        const long long io_dec = io_read_bytes();
        auto stat_line = [&]() {
            const strata::ds4::Stats& s = m.stats();
            const double ms = now_ms() - t1;
            const double fed = (double) std::max<int64_t>(1, s.tokens - s_dec.tokens);
            const double ex = (double) (s.experts - s_dec.experts), cx = (double) (s.cpu_experts - s_dec.cpu_experts);
            std::string out = "STAT";
            char b[160];
            std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, " tok_s=%.2f ms_tok=%.2f vram_hit=%.4f cpu=%.3f ram=%.3f promo=%.3f engram_ms=%.3f",
                          ms > 0 ? 1000.0 * (double) produced / ms : 0.0, produced > 0 ? ms / (double) produced : 0.0,
                          ex > 0 ? 1.0 - cx / ex : 1.0, cx / fed, (double) (s.ram_experts - s_dec.ram_experts) / fed,
                          (double) (s.swaps - s_dec.swaps) / fed, (s.engram_ms - s_dec.engram_ms) / fed);
            out += b;
            const long long io = io_read_bytes();
            if (io >= 0 && io_dec >= 0) {
                std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, " disk_mb=%.3f", (double) (io - io_dec) / 1e6 / fed);
                out += b;
            }
            if (d_off > 0) {
                std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, " drafts=%.3f", (double) d_acc / (double) d_off);
                out += b;
            }
            if (s.skipped > s_dec.skipped) {   // (STRATA_DS4_DISK_SKIP_W: experts left out a token)
                std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, " skipped=%.3f", (double) (s.skipped - s_dec.skipped) / fed);
                out += b;
            }
            std::printf("%s\n", out.c_str());
        };
        for (;;) {
            if (in.stop.load()) {
                finish = "cancel";
                break;
            }
            std::printf("T %d\n", tok);
            ++produced;
            if (produced % 8 == 0) stat_line();
            std::fflush(stdout);
            bool end = false;
            for (int e : eos) end = end || tok == e;
            if (end) {
                finish = "stop";
                break;
            }
            if (produced >= limit || m.pos() >= m.max_context()) break;
            if (got.empty()) {   // the next round: the drafts (if any) and the token after them
                const int room = (int) std::min<long long>(limit - produced, m.max_context() - m.pos());
                int off = 0, acc = 0;
                // a round whose drafts were all below the confidence floor: the next one does without the drafter
                // (a request's spec / dspark_conf keys over the engine's: the speed calibration measures both ways)
                const bool try_spec = (r.spec < 0 ? spec : r.spec != 0) && !cool;
                if (!round(m, tok, room, try_spec, r.conf >= 0 ? r.conf : conf_min, r.temperature, r.top_p, r.top_k,
                           r.min_p, r.seed, counter, got,
                           off, acc, err, r.cum)) {
                    std::fprintf(stderr, "ds4: %s\n", err.c_str());
                    finish = "cancel";
                    break;
                }
                d_off += off;
                d_acc += acc;
                cool = try_spec && off == 0;
                std::reverse(got.begin(), got.end());
            }
            tok = got.back();
            got.pop_back();
        }
        // (a stop within accepted drafts leaves the state past it: the next prompt shares less with it, and goes back to
        //  the checkpoint at this prompt's end)
        stat_line();
        const double t2 = now_ms();
        std::printf("DONE %lld %zu %.1f %.1f %s %lld %lld %zu 0 0\n", produced, r.ids.size(), t1 - t0, t2 - t1, finish,
                    d_acc, d_off, from);
        std::fflush(stdout);
        const auto& s = m.stats();
        std::fprintf(stderr,
                     "maya ds4 serve: prompt %zu tokens = %zu reused + %zu read in %.0f ms (%.1f tok/s), %lld generated "
                     "in %.0f ms (%.2f tok/s); CPU lane %.1f%% of the experts\n",
                     r.ids.size(), from, r.ids.size() - from, t1 - t0,
                     t1 > t0 ? 1000.0 * (double) (r.ids.size() - from) / (t1 - t0) : 0.0, produced, t2 - t1,
                     t2 > t1 ? 1000.0 * (double) produced / (t2 - t1) : 0.0,
                     s.experts ? 100.0 * (double) s.cpu_experts / (double) s.experts : 0.0);
        if (d_off > 0) std::fprintf(stderr, "maya ds4 serve: drafts %lld of %lld kept; %s\n", d_acc, d_off,
                                    per_position(s_dec, s).c_str());
        m.save_profile();
    }
    // the engine ends (QUIT or the end of its input): the conversation in the model is set aside, and every one in
    // RAM is written to the folder, so the next run reads on from them
    if (slot_max > 0) {
        if (held.empty()) slot_put(" as the engine ended");
        size_t written = 0;
        while (true) {   // (a write can take the folder's least recently used conversation away: the list is asked again)
            size_t i = SIZE_MAX;
            for (size_t k = 0; k < slots.size(); ++k)
                if (slots[k].data) {
                    i = k;
                    break;
                }
            if (i == SIZE_MAX) break;
            if (slot_write_file(slots[i])) ++written;
            else slot_drop(i);   // (its state could not be written: there is nothing more to do at the engine's end)
        }
        if (written > 0) {
            int ram = 0, disk = 0;
            slot_count(ram, disk);
            char msg[256];
            std::snprintf(msg, sizeof msg, "wrote %zu conversation(s) to %s; %d there in all", written,
                          slot_dir.string().c_str(), disk);
            note(msg);
        }
    }
    m.save_profile();
    return 0;
}


// ---- Strata addition: teacher-forced scoring (the quality gate) -------------------------------------------------
// --score IDS.json --score-out RUN.tsv: every segment of a tools/quant_quality.py ids file (name + ids) is read through
// the model from a fresh state; per position the log-probability of the text's next token and the 64 most likely
// tokens go out in the STRATA_LOGPOS row format that `quant_quality.py compare` reads (natural logs, full-vocabulary
// log-softmax in double).  RUN.tsv.seg.json lists each segment's first line and size.
struct ScoreSeg {
    std::string name;
    std::vector<int> ids;
};

bool read_score_ids(const std::string& path, std::vector<ScoreSeg>& segs, std::string& err) {
    std::FILE* f = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "rb");
    if (f == nullptr) {
        err = path + ": cannot open";
        return false;
    }
    std::string s;
    char buf[1 << 16];
    size_t k;
    while ((k = std::fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf, f)) > 0) s.append(buf, k);
    std::fclose(f);
    size_t p = 0;
    for (;;) {
        const size_t n0 = s.find("\"name\"", p);
        if (n0 == std::string::npos) break;
        const size_t q0 = s.find('"', s.find(':', n0) + 1);
        const size_t q1 = s.find('"', q0 + 1);
        const size_t i0 = s.find("\"ids\"", q1);
        if (q0 == std::string::npos || q1 == std::string::npos || i0 == std::string::npos) break;
        const size_t b0 = s.find('[', i0), b1 = s.find(']', b0);
        if (b0 == std::string::npos || b1 == std::string::npos) break;
        ScoreSeg g;
        g.name = s.substr(q0 + 1, q1 - q0 - 1);
        g.ids = parse_ids(s.substr(b0 + 1, b1 - b0 - 1));
        segs.push_back(std::move(g));
        p = b1;
    }
    if (segs.empty()) {
        err = path + ": no segments (expected quant_quality.py's ids file)";
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

int score(strata::ds4::Model& m, const std::string& ids_path, const std::string& out_path, int window, int eos) {
    std::vector<ScoreSeg> segs;
    std::string err;
    if (!read_score_ids(ids_path, segs, err)) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "strata-dsv41: %s\n", err.c_str());
        return 1;
    }
    // DS4_SCORE_PREFIX=N (a test of the long-prompt layer skip): the segments are joined into one stream, its first N
    // tokens are read as one prompt (logits of the last row only: the path a long prompt takes, where the skip applies)
    // and only the positions after them are scored, in windows
    const long long prefix_n = std::getenv("DS4_SCORE_PREFIX") ? std::atoll(std::getenv("DS4_SCORE_PREFIX")) : 0;
    if (prefix_n > 0 && segs.size() > 1) {
        ScoreSeg all;
        all.name = "concat";
        for (const ScoreSeg& sg : segs) all.ids.insert(all.ids.end(), sg.ids.begin(), sg.ids.end());
        segs.assign(1, all);
    }
    std::FILE* out = std::fopen(out_path.c_str(), "wb");
    std::FILE* sj = std::fopen((out_path + ".seg.json").c_str(), "wb");
    if (out == nullptr || sj == nullptr) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "strata-dsv41: cannot write %s\n", out_path.c_str());
        return 1;
    }
    std::fprintf(sj, "{\"segments\": [");
    const int V = m.vocab();
    long long line = 0;
    std::vector<float> lg;
    std::vector<int> order;
    const double t0 = now_ms();
    for (size_t si = 0; si < segs.size(); ++si) {
        const std::vector<int>& ids = segs[si].ids;
        m.reset();
        const long long first = line;
        double sum_nll = 0.0;
        long long top1 = 0, cnt = 0;
        size_t a0 = 0;
        if (prefix_n > 0 && (size_t) prefix_n + 1 < ids.size()) {
            a0 = (size_t) prefix_n;
            if (!m.feed(ids.data(), (int) a0, 1, err)) {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "strata-dsv41: %s\n", err.c_str());
                return 1;
            }
        }
        for (size_t a = a0; a + 1 < ids.size();) {
            const int T = (int) std::min<size_t>((size_t) window, ids.size() - 1 - a);   // (positions a .. a+T-1 are scored)
            if (!m.feed(ids.data() + a, T, T, err) || !m.logits(lg) || lg.size() < (size_t) T * (size_t) V) {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "strata-dsv41: %s\n", err.empty() ? "no logits" : err.c_str());
                return 1;
            }
            for (int t = 0; t < T; ++t) {
                const float* r = lg.data() + (size_t) t * (size_t) V;
                float mx = r[0];
                for (int v = 1; v < V; ++v) mx = std::max(mx, r[v]);
                double z = 0.0;
                for (int v = 0; v < V; ++v) z += std::exp((double) (r[v] - mx));
                const double lz = std::log(z) + (double) mx;
                order.resize((size_t) V);
                std::iota(order.begin(), order.end(), 0);
                std::partial_sort(order.begin(), order.begin() + 64, order.end(), [&](int x, int y) {
                    return r[x] > r[y] || (r[x] == r[y] && x < y);
                });
                const int tgt = ids[a + (size_t) t + 1];
                const double lt = (double) r[tgt] - lz;
                const double la = (double) r[order[0]] - lz;
                const double le = eos >= 0 && eos < V ? (double) r[eos] - lz : -1e30;
                // logp(target) with the end token left out of the distribution, as the engine's row has it
                const double lt_ne = tgt == eos ? lt : std::log(std::max(1e-300, std::exp(lt) / std::max(1e-300, 1.0 - std::exp(le))));
                std::fprintf(out, "%zu\t%d\t%.6f\t%d\t%.6f\t%d\t%.6f\t%.6f", a + (size_t) t, tgt, lt, order[0], la,
                             order[0] == tgt ? 1 : 0, le, lt_ne);
                for (int j = 0; j < 64; ++j) std::fprintf(out, "\t%d:%.6f", order[(size_t) j], (double) r[order[(size_t) j]] - lz);
                std::fprintf(out, "\n");
                ++line;
                ++cnt;
                top1 += order[0] == tgt;
                sum_nll -= lt;
            }
            a += (size_t) T;
        }
        std::fprintf(sj, "%s{\"name\": \"%s\", \"first_line\": %lld, \"end_line\": %lld, \"n\": %lld, \"ppl\": %.6f, \"top1\": %.6f}", si ? ", " : "",
                     segs[si].name.c_str(), first, first + cnt, cnt, std::exp(sum_nll / (double) std::max(1LL, cnt)),
                     (double) top1 / (double) std::max(1LL, cnt));
        std::fprintf(stderr, "score %s: %lld positions, ppl %.4f, top-1 %.4f (%.0f s)\n", segs[si].name.c_str(), cnt,
                     std::exp(sum_nll / (double) std::max(1LL, cnt)), (double) top1 / (double) std::max(1LL, cnt),
                     (now_ms() - t0) / 1000.0);
        std::fflush(out);
    }
    std::fprintf(sj, "]}\n");
    std::fclose(sj);
    std::fclose(out);
    return 0;
}
// ---- Strata H100 addition: profile run -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// --profile-run IDS.json: every segment is fed through the model from a fresh state (no logits); the engine's expert
// profile (--expert-profile FILE, counts a layer and expert) and DS4_TRACE collect the routing.  The profile is saved
// every 10 segments.  --window sets the chunk (a chunked prompt path above 16).
int profile_run(strata::ds4::Model& m, const std::string& ids_path, int window) {
    std::vector<ScoreSeg> segs;
    std::string err;
    if (!read_score_ids(ids_path, segs, err)) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "strata-dsv41: %s\n", err.c_str());
        return 1;
    }
    const double t0 = now_ms();
    long long tot = 0;
    for (size_t si = 0; si < segs.size(); ++si) {
        const std::vector<int>& ids = segs[si].ids;
        m.reset();
        for (size_t a = 0; a < ids.size();) {
            const int T = (int) std::min<size_t>((size_t) window, ids.size() - a);
            if (!m.feed(ids.data() + a, T, 0, err)) {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "strata-dsv41: %s\n", err.c_str());
                return 1;
            }
            a += (size_t) T;
        }
        tot += (long long) ids.size();
        std::fprintf(stderr, "profile-run %zu/%zu %s: %zu tokens, %lld in all, %.0f s, %.1f tok/s\n", si + 1, segs.size(),
                     segs[si].name.c_str(), ids.size(), tot, (now_ms() - t0) / 1000.0, 1000.0 * (double) tot / (now_ms() - t0));
        if ((si + 1) % 10 == 0) m.save_profile();
    }
    m.save_profile();
    return 0;
}
// ---- Strata H100 addition: DSpark acceptance log ---------------------------------------------------------------
// --spec-eval IDS.json --n N: each segment is a prompt: fed from reset, then N greedy tokens decoded with the drafter, every
// draft verified (--dspark-conf 0); DS4_ROUND_LOG=file gets a line a round (segment name, drafts, accepted, confidences).
int spec_eval(strata::ds4::Model& m, const std::string& ids_path, int n, int window, float conf_min, bool spec) {
    std::vector<ScoreSeg> segs;
    std::string err;
    if (!read_score_ids(ids_path, segs, err)) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "strata-dsv41: %s\n", err.c_str());
        return 1;
    }
    if (const char* f = std::getenv("DS4_ROUND_LOG")) g_round_log = std::fopen(f, "wb");
    const double t0 = now_ms();
    for (size_t si = 0; si < segs.size(); ++si) {
        const std::vector<int>& ids = segs[si].ids;
        g_round_tag = segs[si].name;
        m.reset();
        for (size_t a = 0; a < ids.size();) {
            const int T = (int) std::min<size_t>((size_t) window, ids.size() - a);
            const bool last = a + (size_t) T == ids.size();
            if (!m.feed(ids.data() + a, T, last ? 1 : 0, err)) {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "strata-dsv41: %s\n", err.c_str());
                return 1;
            }
            a += (size_t) T;
        }
        unsigned long long counter = 0;
        int tok = m.sample(0.0f, 1.0f, 1, 0.0f, 1, counter++);
        std::vector<int> got;
        int emitted = 1;
        long long rounds = 0, acc_all = 0;
        bool stop = false;
        while (emitted < n && !stop) {
            int off = 0, acc = 0;
            if (!round(m, tok, n - emitted, spec, conf_min, 0.0f, 1.0f, 1, 0.0f, 1, counter, got, off, acc, err)) {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "strata-dsv41: %s\n", err.c_str());
                return 1;
            }
            ++rounds;
            acc_all += acc;
            for (int t : got) {
                ++emitted;
                if (t == 1) stop = true;
            }
            tok = got.back();
        }
        std::fprintf(stderr, "spec-eval %zu/%zu %s: prompt %zu, %d tokens, %lld rounds, %.2f tokens a round, accepted %lld (%.0f s)\n", si + 1,
                     segs.size(), segs[si].name.c_str(), ids.size(), emitted, rounds, (double) (emitted - 1) / (double) std::max(1LL, rounds),
                     acc_all, (now_ms() - t0) / 1000.0);
        if (g_round_log != nullptr) std::fflush(g_round_log);
    }
    return 0;
}
}  // namespace

#ifndef DS4_BUILD_ID
#define DS4_BUILD_ID "unknown"
#endif

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    strata::ds4::os::fine_timer();
    strata::ds4::Options o;
    std::string ids_s, dump, eos = "1";
    int n = 0, window = 0;   // (0: the model's feed unit - a whole prompt on the chunked path; 16 for the scoring runs)
    bool spec = true;
    float temp = 0.0f;   // the CLI's sampling (0: greedy)
    unsigned long long cli_seed = 1;
    bool serve_mode = false;
    bool pack_info_mode = false;
    std::string images, enc_rgb, enc_out;
    std::string score_ids, score_out, prof_ids, spec_ids;
    int enc_w = 0, enc_h = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        const std::string a = argv[i];
        auto val = [&](const char* what) -> std::string {
            if (i + 1 >= argc) {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "%s needs a value\n", what);
                std::exit(2);
            }
            return argv[++i];
        };
        if (a == "--pack") o.pack = val("--pack");
        else if (a == "--gpus") {
            for (int g : parse_ids(val("--gpus"))) o.gpus.push_back(g);
        } else if (a == "--max-context") o.max_context = std::atoll(val("--max-context").c_str());
        else if (a == "--reserve-mib") o.reserve_mib = std::atoll(val("--reserve-mib").c_str());
        else if (a == "--vram-experts") o.vram_experts = std::atof(val("--vram-experts").c_str());
        else if (a == "--cpu-threads") o.cpu_threads = std::atoi(val("--cpu-threads").c_str());
        else if (a == "--expert-profile") o.profile = val("--expert-profile");
        else if (a == "--ssd-cache") o.ssd_cache_gb = std::atof(val("--ssd-cache").c_str());
        else if (a == "--ssd-policy") {
            const std::string v = val("--ssd-policy");
            o.ssd_policy = v == "lfu" ? 1 : v == "lfulru" ? 2 : 0;
        }
        else if (a == "--eos") eos = val("--eos");
        else if (a == "--no-expert-cache") o.expert_cache = false;
        else if (a == "--dspark") {
            const std::string v = val("--dspark");
            spec = v != "off";
            o.dspark = v != "none";   // none: not even loaded
            o.dspark_auto = v == "auto";
        } else if (a == "--dspark-conf") o.dspark_conf = (float) std::atof(val("--dspark-conf").c_str());
        else if (a == "--dspark-block") o.dspark_block = std::max(0, std::atoi(val("--dspark-block").c_str()));
        else if (a == "--tp") o.tp = std::max(1, std::atoi(val("--tp").c_str()));
        else if (a == "--prefill-chunk") o.prefill_chunk = std::max(0, std::atoi(val("--prefill-chunk").c_str()));
        else if (a == "--threads") o.threads = val("--threads") != "off";
        else if (a == "--vision") o.vision = val("--vision") != "off";
        else if (a == "--mmap-experts") {
            const std::string v = val("--mmap-experts");
            o.mmap_experts = v == "on" ? 1 : v == "off" ? 0 : -1;
        } else if (a == "--images") images = val("--images");
        else if (a == "--encode-image") enc_rgb = val("--encode-image");
        else if (a == "--dump-image") enc_out = val("--dump-image");
        else if (a == "--size") {
            const std::string v = val("--size");
            enc_w = std::atoi(v.c_str());
            enc_h = v.find('x') != std::string::npos ? std::atoi(v.c_str() + v.find('x') + 1) : 0;
        }
        else if (a == "--temperature") temp = (float) std::atof(val("--temperature").c_str());
        else if (a == "--seed") cli_seed = std::strtoull(val("--seed").c_str(), nullptr, 10);
        else if (a == "--verbose" || a == "-v") {
            o.verbose = true;
            std::fprintf(stderr, "ds4: build %s (%s)\n", DS4_BUILD_ID, STRATA_VERSION);
        } else if (a == "--version") {
            std::printf("strata-dsv41 %s build %s\n", STRATA_VERSION, DS4_BUILD_ID);
            return 0;
        }
        else if (a == "--ids") ids_s = val("--ids");
        else if (a == "--n") n = std::atoi(val("--n").c_str());
        else if (a == "--window") window = std::max(1, std::atoi(val("--window").c_str()));   // (> 16: the chunked prompt path)
        else if (a == "--dump-logits") dump = val("--dump-logits");
        else if (a == "--score") score_ids = val("--score");
        else if (a == "--score-out") score_out = val("--score-out");
        else if (a == "--profile-run") prof_ids = val("--profile-run");
        else if (a == "--spec-eval") spec_ids = val("--spec-eval");
        else if (a == "--serve") serve_mode = true;
        else if (a == "--pack-info") pack_info_mode = true;
        else if (a == "--layer-split") (void) val("--layer-split");   // the server's (this engine balances its own split)
        else if (a == "--help" || a == "-h") {
            usage();
            return 0;
        } else {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "unknown option %s\n", a.c_str());
            usage();
            return 2;
        }
    }
    if (pack_info_mode) {   // the pack's description only: no device, no weights, no lock
        if (o.pack.empty()) {
            usage();
            return 2;
        }
        return strata::ds4::pack_info(o.pack, stdout);
    }
    if (o.pack.empty() || (!serve_mode && ids_s.empty() && enc_rgb.empty() && score_ids.empty() && prof_ids.empty() && spec_ids.empty())) {
        usage();
        return 2;
    }
    if (o.profile.empty()) o.profile = o.pack + "/expert-profile.bin";   // "none": no profile
    if (o.profile == "none") o.profile.clear();
    o.vision_only = !enc_rgb.empty();
    strata::ds4::Model m;
    std::string err;
    if (!m.load(o, err)) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "maya-ds4: %s\n", err.c_str());
        return 1;
    }
    if (!o.vision_only) std::fprintf(stderr, "%s", m.describe().c_str());
    if (serve_mode) return serve(m, eos, spec, o.dspark_conf, o.pack);
    const int window_given = window;
    if (window == 0) window = 16;   // (the scoring / profiling runs; the plain run below takes the model's feed unit)
    if (!prof_ids.empty()) return profile_run(m, prof_ids, window);
    if (!spec_ids.empty()) return spec_eval(m, spec_ids, n, window, o.dspark_conf, spec);
    if (!score_ids.empty()) return score(m, score_ids, score_out.empty() ? score_ids + ".tsv" : score_out, window, std::atoi(eos.c_str()));

    if (!enc_rgb.empty()) {   // the vision tower alone: a picture's span rows (BF16 [rows][dim]) into --dump-image
        std::vector<uint8_t> px((size_t) std::max(0, enc_w) * std::max(0, enc_h) * 3);
        std::FILE* f = std::fopen(enc_rgb.c_str(), "rb");
        const bool got = f != nullptr && !px.empty() && std::fread(px.data(), 1, px.size(), f) == px.size();
        if (f != nullptr) std::fclose(f);
        if (!got) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "maya-ds4: %s: expected %d x %d RGB bytes (--size WxH)\n", enc_rgb.c_str(), enc_w, enc_h);
            return 1;
        }
        std::vector<uint16_t> span;
        for (int k = 0; k < 2; ++k) {   // (the second: warm)
            const double te = now_ms();
            if (!m.encode_image(px.data(), enc_w, enc_h, span, err)) {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "maya-ds4: %s\n", err.c_str());
                return 1;
            }
            std::fprintf(stderr, "vision: %d x %d pixels -> a span of %zu rows in %.0f ms\n", enc_w, enc_h,
                         span.size() / (size_t) m.dim(), now_ms() - te);
        }
        std::FILE* o2 = enc_out.empty() ? nullptr : std::fopen(enc_out.c_str(), "wb");
        if (o2 != nullptr) {
            std::fwrite(span.data(), 2, span.size(), o2);
            std::fclose(o2);
        }
        return 0;
    }
    if (!ids_s.empty() && ids_s[0] == '@') {   // --ids @file: the ids in a file (a command line is 32 KB on Windows)
        std::ifstream idf(ids_s.substr(1));
        std::stringstream ss;
        ss << idf.rdbuf();
        ids_s = ss.str();
    }
    const std::vector<int> ids = parse_ids(ids_s);
    if (!images.empty()) {   // --images: a GENI file's pictures, for the prompt's spans
        std::vector<Pic> pics;
        if (!read_pics(images, pics, err)) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "maya-ds4: %s\n", err.c_str());
            return 1;
        }
        std::vector<strata::ds4::Image> imgs;
        for (const Pic& q : pics) {
            auto rows = std::make_shared<std::vector<uint16_t>>();
            const double te = now_ms();
            if (!m.encode_image(q.rgb.data(), q.width, q.height, *rows, err)) {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "maya-ds4: %s\n", err.c_str());
                return 1;
            }
            std::fprintf(stderr, "picture at %lld: %d x %d pixels, %zu tokens, %.0f ms\n", (long long) q.start, q.width,
                         q.height, rows->size() / (size_t) m.dim(), now_ms() - te);
            imgs.push_back({q.start, rows});
        }
        m.set_images(std::move(imgs));
    }
    std::FILE* df = dump.empty() ? nullptr : std::fopen(dump.c_str(), "wb");
    std::vector<float> lg;
    if (window_given == 0) window = df != nullptr ? 16 : std::max(16, std::min(m.feed_unit(), 1 << 30));
    const double t0 = now_ms();
    for (size_t a = 0; a < ids.size();) {
        const int T = (int) std::min<size_t>((size_t) window, ids.size() - a);
        const bool last = a + (size_t) T == ids.size();
        if (!m.feed(ids.data() + a, T, df != nullptr ? T : (last ? 1 : 0), err)) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "maya-ds4: %s\n", err.c_str());
            return 1;
        }
        if (df != nullptr && m.logits(lg)) std::fwrite(lg.data(), 4, lg.size(), df);
        a += (size_t) T;
    }
    m.set_images({});
    const double t1 = now_ms();
    std::fprintf(stderr, "prompt: %zu tokens in %.0f ms (%.2f tok/s, windows of %d)\n", ids.size(), t1 - t0,
                 1000.0 * (double) ids.size() / (t1 - t0), window);
    const strata::ds4::Stats s0 = m.stats();
    if (s0.eg_rows > 0)
        std::fprintf(stderr, "prompt's Engram rows: %lld, %.1f%% without a read (repeats and the row cache), %lld read\n",
                     (long long) s0.eg_rows, 100.0 * (double) s0.eg_hits / (double) s0.eg_rows, (long long) s0.eg_reads);
    const long long io0 = io_read_bytes();
    std::vector<int> out;
    std::vector<double> tok_ms;   // (DS4_TOKLOG: each token's time since the one before - the latency ledger)
    double t_prev = t1;
    unsigned long long counter = 0;
    long long d_off = 0, d_acc = 0, rounds = 0;
    bool cool = false;
    if (n > 0) {
        int tok = m.sample(temp, 1.0f, temp > 0 ? 64 : 1, 0.0f, cli_seed, counter++);
        std::vector<int> got;
        for (;;) {
            out.push_back(tok);
            {
                const double tn = now_ms();
                tok_ms.push_back(tn - t_prev);
                t_prev = tn;
            }
            std::printf("%d,", tok);
            std::fflush(stdout);
            if ((tok == 1 && std::getenv("DS4_NO_EOS") == nullptr) || (int) out.size() >= n) break;   // (DS4_NO_EOS: decode n tokens whatever)
            if (got.empty()) {
                int off = 0, acc = 0;
                const bool try_spec = spec && !cool;
                if (!round(m, tok, n - (int) out.size(), try_spec, o.dspark_conf, temp, 1.0f, temp > 0 ? 64 : 1, 0.0f,
                           cli_seed, counter, got, off, acc, err)) {
                    std::fprintf(stderr, "maya-ds4: %s\n", err.c_str());
                    return 1;
                }
                d_off += off;
                d_acc += acc;
                ++rounds;
                cool = try_spec && off == 0;
                std::reverse(got.begin(), got.end());
            }
            tok = got.back();
            got.pop_back();
        }
        std::printf("\n");
        if (df != nullptr && m.logits(lg)) std::fwrite(lg.data(), 4, lg.size(), df);
    }
    if (spec && rounds > 0) {
        const auto& s1 = m.stats();
        const double nv = (double) std::max<int64_t>(1, s1.drafts_rounds - s0.drafts_rounds);
        std::fprintf(stderr, "dspark: %lld rounds, %lld drafts offered, %lld accepted (%.2f tokens a round); drafting "
                             "%.2f ms a round, verifying %.1f ms in all (%lld windows)\n",
                     rounds, d_off, d_acc, (double) out.size() / (double) rounds, (s1.draft_ms - s0.draft_ms) / nv,
                     s1.verify_ms - s0.verify_ms, (long long) (s1.drafts_offered > 0 ? 0 : 0));
        std::fprintf(stderr, "dspark %s\n", per_position(s0, s1).c_str());
    }
    if (std::getenv("DS4_TOKLOG") != nullptr && tok_ms.size() > 8) {   // the decode's tokens after the first (which carries the prompt's tail)
        std::vector<double> v(tok_ms.begin() + 1, tok_ms.end());
        std::sort(v.begin(), v.end());
        std::fprintf(stderr, "token latency ms: p50 %.0f p95 %.0f p99 %.0f max %.0f mean %.0f (%zu tokens)\n", v[v.size() / 2],
                     v[(size_t) ((double) v.size() * 0.95)], v[(size_t) ((double) v.size() * 0.99)], v.back(),
                     std::accumulate(v.begin(), v.end(), 0.0) / (double) v.size(), v.size());
    }
    const double t2 = now_ms();
    const auto& s = m.stats();
    const double nt = std::max<double>(1.0, (double) (s.tokens - s0.tokens));
    std::fprintf(stderr, "decode: %zu tokens in %.0f ms (%.2f tok/s); CPU lane: %lld of %lld experts; the cache moved %lld "
                         "(%lld in all)\n", out.size(), t2 - t1,
                 out.size() > 1 ? 1000.0 * (double) (out.size() - 1) / (t2 - t1) : 0.0,
                 (long long) (s.cpu_experts - s0.cpu_experts), (long long) (s.experts - s0.experts),
                 (long long) (s.swaps - s0.swaps), (long long) s.swaps);
    std::fprintf(stderr, "decode per token: layers %.2f ms (of it: routing waits %.2f, CPU lane %.2f, the rest host launches), "
                         "head wait %.2f, Engram reads %.2f\n",
                 (s.layer_ms - s0.layer_ms) / nt, (s.gpu_wait_ms - s0.gpu_wait_ms) / nt, (s.cpu_ms - s0.cpu_ms) / nt,
                 (s.head_ms - s0.head_ms) / nt, (s.engram_ms - s0.engram_ms) / nt);
    if (s.eg_rows > s0.eg_rows) {   // the Engram rows: how many the row cache served, the reads' time behind the layers
        const double rows = (double) (s.eg_rows - s0.eg_rows);
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Engram per token: %.0f rows, %.1f%% without a read (the row cache holds %lld of %lld), "
                             "%.1f read, the reads %.2f ms from asking to the last one (left to wait: %.2f)\n",
                     rows / nt, 100.0 * (double) (s.eg_hits - s0.eg_hits) / rows, (long long) s.eg_cached,
                     (long long) s.eg_cache_cap, (double) (s.eg_reads - s0.eg_reads) / nt, (s.eg_io_ms - s0.eg_io_ms) / nt,
                     (s.engram_ms - s0.engram_ms) / nt);
    }
    const long long io1 = io_read_bytes();
    if (io0 >= 0 && io1 >= 0)
        std::fprintf(stderr, "decode reads from the disk: %.1f MB a token\n", (double) (io1 - io0) / 1e6 / nt);
    if (s.skipped > s0.skipped)   // STRATA_DS4_DISK_SKIP_W
        std::fprintf(stderr, "decode left out %.1f experts a token not in RAM (%.1f%% of the routed)\n",
                     (double) (s.skipped - s0.skipped) / nt,
                     100.0 * (double) (s.skipped - s0.skipped) / std::max<double>(1.0, (double) (s.experts - s0.experts)));
    if (s.store_slots_max > 0) {   // --ssd-cache
        const double h = (double) (s.store_hits - s0.store_hits), m = (double) (s.store_misses - s0.store_misses);
        std::fprintf(stderr,
                     "store: %.1f%% of the CPU lane's experts were in RAM (%.1f hits, %.1f misses a token); read %.1f MB a token "
                     "(demand and guesses), the CPU lane waited %.1f ms a token for them; %lld prefetched, %lld used, %lld given up "
                     "unused; slots %lld of %lld, %lld evictions, %lld failed reads; the GPU computed %.1f experts a token from the store "
                     "(%lld slots visible)\n",
                     100.0 * h / std::max(1.0, h + m), h / nt, m / nt, (double) (s.store_bytes - s0.store_bytes) / 1e6 / nt,
                     (s.store_wait_ms - s0.store_wait_ms) / nt, (long long) (s.store_prefetched - s0.store_prefetched),
                     (long long) (s.store_pf_used - s0.store_pf_used), (long long) (s.store_pf_wasted - s0.store_pf_wasted),
                     (long long) s.store_slots, (long long) s.store_slots_max, (long long) (s.store_evictions - s0.store_evictions),
                     (long long) (s.store_fails - s0.store_fails), (double) (s.store_zc - s0.store_zc) / nt,
                     (long long) s.store_zc_visible);
    }
    if (s.ahead_picks > s0.ahead_picks) {   // lookahead
        const double p = (double) (s.ahead_picks - s0.ahead_picks), c = (double) (s.ahead_cold - s0.ahead_cold);
        std::fprintf(stderr, "lookahead: the guesses a layer before held %.1f%% of the picks (their top k %.1f%%, two layers "
                             "before %.1f%%); file-read picks asked for early %.1f%% (%lld of %lld); %.1f experts asked "
                             "for early a token\n",
                     100.0 * (double) (s.ahead_hit - s0.ahead_hit) / p, 100.0 * (double) (s.ahead_hit_k - s0.ahead_hit_k) / p,
                     100.0 * (double) (s.ahead_hit2 - s0.ahead_hit2) / p,
                     c > 0 ? 100.0 * (double) (s.ahead_cold_hit - s0.ahead_cold_hit) / c : 0.0,
                     (long long) (s.ahead_cold_hit - s0.ahead_cold_hit), (long long) (s.ahead_cold - s0.ahead_cold),
                     (double) (s.ahead_pf - s0.ahead_pf) / nt);
        std::string rk = "lookahead: picked by the guess's rank (1 ..):";
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
            const long long n = (long long) (s.ahead_rank_n[i] - s0.ahead_rank_n[i]);
            if (n <= 0) break;
            char b[24];
            std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, " %.0f%%", 100.0 * (double) (s.ahead_rank_hit[i] - s0.ahead_rank_hit[i]) / (double) n);
            rk += b;
        }
        std::fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", rk.c_str());
    }
    if (s.prof_tokens > s0.prof_tokens) {   // DS4_PROF
        const double pt = (double) (s.prof_tokens - s0.prof_tokens);
        double sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) sum += (s.prof_ms[i] - s0.prof_ms[i]) / pt;
        std::fprintf(stderr, "GPU per token (DS4_PROF): %.2f ms - between layers %.2f, attention %.2f, routing + shared "
                             "expert %.2f, experts gate/up %.2f, waiting for the CPU lane %.2f, down + post %.2f\n", sum,
                     (s.prof_ms[0] - s0.prof_ms[0]) / pt, (s.prof_ms[1] - s0.prof_ms[1]) / pt,
                     (s.prof_ms[2] - s0.prof_ms[2]) / pt, (s.prof_ms[3] - s0.prof_ms[3]) / pt,
                     (s.prof_ms[4] - s0.prof_ms[4]) / pt, (s.prof_ms[5] - s0.prof_ms[5]) / pt);
    }
    if (df != nullptr) std::fclose(df);
    m.save_profile();
    return 0;
}


## src/dsv41/ds4_packinfo.cpp

// Strata. `strata-dsv41 --pack-info`: the pack as a description, before anything is loaded onto a GPU - the type map
// (layer x role), the bytes an expert and a token, the tier sizes, and the tensors whose type has no device kernel (they
// would go to the CPU lane, or stop the load).  Host only, no device, no weights read: tensors.txt and ds4.txt are the
// pack's whole description (tools/dsv41/pack_gguf.py).  The same report is the first line of every benchmark log.
#include "ds4_packinfo.hpp"
#include "ds4_iq.cuh"      // iq::supported / iq::name: the device-type list below is derived from the kernels, not copied

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#if defined(_MSC_VER)
#include <cstring>
#define strtok_r strtok_s
#endif
namespace strata::ds4 {
namespace {

// The ggml block types the device kernels take (ds4_iq.cu's Ty<> / DS4_IQ_SWITCH + ds4_gguf.cu's MXFP4).  A name here
// and not in the pack's tensor list is fine; a tensor whose type is not here is the CPU lane's (ggml-cpu's row dots).
// It was a copy of the supported() switch and fell behind when IQ1_S, IQ1_M and IQ4_NL got kernels (2026-10-23), so it is
// now the switch itself, by type name.

bool device_type(const std::string& t) {
    static const std::set<std::string> ok = [] {
        std::set<std::string> s = {"MXFP4", "TQK6", "TQK7", "TQK5X", "TQK4X", "TQK5T", "TQK4T"};   // ds4_gguf.cu / trellis
        for (int ty = 0; ty < 64; ++ty) {
            const char* n = gguf::iq::name(ty);
            if (n && std::strcmp(n, "?") != 0 && gguf::iq::supported(ty)) s.insert(n);
        }
        return s;
    }();
    return ok.count(t) != 0;
}
// The types the dense path reads as they are (ds4_gguf.cu: BF16 / F32 / MXFP8 rows, Q8_0 rows; ds4_iq's GEMV for the
// K-quants is the same device support as the experts').
bool dense_type(const std::string& t) {
    return t == "BF16" || t == "F32" || t == "F16" || t == "MXFP8" || t == "Q8_0" || device_type(t);
}

struct Tensor {
    std::string dtype;
    double bytes = 0;
    std::vector<long long> shape;
};

double gb(double b) { return b / 1e9; }

}  // namespace

int pack_info(const std::string& dir, std::FILE* out) {
    std::map<std::string, std::string> kv;
    {
        std::ifstream f(dir + "/ds4.txt");
        if (!f) {
            std::fprintf(out, "pack-info: %s/ds4.txt: not found\n", dir.c_str());
            return 1;
        }
        std::string line;
        while (std::getline(f, line)) {
            const size_t sp = line.find(' ');
            if (sp != std::string::npos) kv[line.substr(0, sp)] = line.substr(sp + 1);
        }
    }
    auto num = [&](const char* k, long long d) {
        auto it = kv.find(k);
        return it == kv.end() ? d : std::atoll(it->second.c_str());
    };
    const long long nl = num("num_hidden_layers", 0), ne = num("n_routed_experts", 0), topk = num("num_experts_per_tok", 0);
    const long long dim = num("hidden_size", 0), ff = num("moe_intermediate_size", 0), vocab = num("vocab_size", 0);
    std::map<std::string, Tensor> t;
    std::vector<std::string> files;
    std::map<int, double> need;   // bytes the pack needs from each file (its largest tensor end)
    {
        std::FILE* f = std::fopen((dir + "/tensors.txt").c_str(), "r");
        if (f == nullptr) {
            std::fprintf(out, "pack-info: %s/tensors.txt: not found\n", dir.c_str());
            return 1;
        }
        std::vector<char> buf(1 << 16);
        while (std::fgets(buf.data(), (int) buf.size(), f) != nullptr) {
            char* s = buf.data();
            if (s[0] == 'f') {   // file <i> <name>
                char name[4096];
                int i = 0;
                if (std::sscanf(s, "file %d %4095s", &i, name) == 2) {
                    if ((int) files.size() <= i) files.resize((size_t) i + 1);
                    files[(size_t) i] = name;
                }
                continue;
            }
            if (s[0] != 't') continue;
            char* save = nullptr;
            ::strtok_r(s, " \n", &save);
            const char* name = ::strtok_r(nullptr, " \n", &save);
            const char* dt = ::strtok_r(nullptr, " \n", &save);
            const char* fi = ::strtok_r(nullptr, " \n", &save);
            const char* off = ::strtok_r(nullptr, " \n", &save);
            const char* nb = ::strtok_r(nullptr, " \n", &save);
            if (name == nullptr || dt == nullptr || fi == nullptr || off == nullptr || nb == nullptr) continue;
            Tensor x;
            x.dtype = dt;
            x.bytes = (double) std::strtoull(nb, nullptr, 10);
            const int idx = std::atoi(fi);
            need[idx] = std::max(need[idx], (double) std::strtoull(off, nullptr, 10) + x.bytes);
            while (const char* d = ::strtok_r(nullptr, " \n", &save)) x.shape.push_back(std::atoll(d));
            t[name] = std::move(x);
        }
        std::fclose(f);
    }
    if (t.empty()) {
        std::fprintf(out, "pack-info: %s/tensors.txt: no tensors\n", dir.c_str());
        return 1;
    }
    // the files the pack points at: they must be there, and at least as long as the largest tensor end says (the weights
    // live elsewhere; a pack whose model_dir was cleaned up still describes itself perfectly - this is the check)
    const std::string md = kv.count("model_dir") ? kv["model_dir"] : "";
    int missing = 0;
    for (const auto& [i, n] : need) {
        const std::string name = (size_t) i < files.size() ? files[(size_t) i] : "";
        if (name.empty()) {
            std::fprintf(out, "  file %d: no name in tensors.txt\n", i);
            ++missing;
            continue;
        }
        const std::string path = md + "/" + name;
        std::FILE* f = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "rb");
        if (f == nullptr) {
            std::fprintf(out, "  MISSING %s (%.2f GB wanted)\n", path.c_str(), n / 1e9);
            ++missing;
            continue;
        }
#if defined(_WIN32)
        _fseeki64(f, 0, SEEK_END);   // (long is 32 bits there: the weights are far past 2 GB)
        const long long sz = _ftelli64(f);
#else
        std::fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
        const long long sz = std::ftell(f);
#endif
        std::fclose(f);
        if ((double) sz + 0.5 < n) {
            std::fprintf(out, "  SHORT %s: %.2f GB there, %.2f GB wanted\n", path.c_str(), (double) sz / 1e9, n / 1e9);
            ++missing;
        }
    }

    // ---- the expert map: layer -> role types and bytes an expert
    struct Role {
        std::string type[3];
        double bytes[3] = {0, 0, 0};
        bool mixed = false;
        int n = 0;
    };
    std::vector<Role> lay((size_t) nl);
    std::map<std::string, long long> type_count;   // tensor count a type (the experts' 3 roles)
    double experts_bytes = 0;
    std::set<std::string> no_kernel;
    for (long long il = 0; il < nl; ++il) {
        Role& r = lay[(size_t) il];
        const std::string pre = "layers." + std::to_string(il) + ".ffn.experts.";
        for (long long e = 0; e < ne; ++e) {
            const char* role[3] = {"w1", "w3", "w2"};
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) {
                auto it = t.find(pre + std::to_string(e) + "." + role[k] + ".weight");
                if (it == t.end()) {
                    std::fprintf(out, "pack-info: %s%s%lld.%s.weight: missing\n", pre.c_str(), "", e, role[k]);
                    return 1;
                }
                if (e == 0) {
                    r.type[k] = it->second.dtype;
                    r.bytes[k] = it->second.bytes;
                } else if (it->second.dtype != r.type[k] || it->second.bytes != r.bytes[k]) {
                    r.mixed = true;
                }
                if (e == 0) {
                    ++type_count[it->second.dtype];
                    if (!device_type(it->second.dtype)) no_kernel.insert("layer " + std::to_string(il) + " " + role[k] + " " + it->second.dtype);
                }
            }
        }
        r.n = (int) ne;
        experts_bytes += (double) ne * (r.bytes[0] + r.bytes[1] + r.bytes[2]);
    }
    const double per_expert = nl > 0 ? experts_bytes / ((double) nl * (double) ne) : 0;
    // (a token picks `topk` experts a layer: sum over the layers of topk x one expert of that layer)
    double token_bytes = 0;
    for (long long il = 0; il < nl; ++il) token_bytes += (double) topk * (lay[(size_t) il].bytes[0] + lay[(size_t) il].bytes[1] + lay[(size_t) il].bytes[2]);
    const double expert_params = (double) nl * (double) ne * 3.0 * (double) ff * (double) dim;

    // ---- the dense side: everything that is not an expert tensor
    double dense = 0, dense_embed = 0, dense_head = 0, dense_mtp = 0, dense_vision = 0, dense_engram = 0;
    std::set<std::string> dense_types;
    for (const auto& [name, x] : t) {
        if (name.find(".ffn.experts.") != std::string::npos && name.rfind("layers.", 0) == 0) continue;
        dense += x.bytes;
        dense_types.insert(x.dtype);
        if (name == "embed.weight") dense_embed += x.bytes;
        else if (name == "head.weight") dense_head += x.bytes;
        else if (name.rfind("mtp.", 0) == 0) dense_mtp += x.bytes;
        else if (name.find(".engram.") != std::string::npos) dense_engram += x.bytes;
        else if (name.rfind("vision.", 0) == 0 || name.rfind("aligner.", 0) == 0) dense_vision += x.bytes;
        if (!dense_type(x.dtype)) no_kernel.insert("dense " + name + " " + x.dtype);
    }

    // ---- report
    std::fprintf(out, "pack-info %s\n", dir.c_str());
    std::fprintf(out, "  model_dir %s   format %s   %lld layers x %lld experts, %lld used; dim %lld, ff %lld, vocab %lld\n",
                 kv.count("model_dir") ? kv["model_dir"].c_str() : "?", kv.count("format") ? kv["format"].c_str() : "?", nl, ne, topk,
                 dim, ff, vocab);
    std::fprintf(out, "  layer  gate+up   down      bytes/expert   MB/token\n");
    for (long long il = 0; il < nl; ++il) {
        const Role& r = lay[(size_t) il];
        const double eb = r.bytes[0] + r.bytes[1] + r.bytes[2];
        std::fprintf(out, "  %5lld  %-9s %-9s %13.0f %10.2f%s\n", il, r.type[0].c_str(), r.type[2].c_str(), eb,
                     (double) topk * eb / 1e6, r.mixed ? "  (mixed)" : "");
    }
    std::fprintf(out, "  expert tensors by type:");
    for (const auto& [ty, n] : type_count) std::fprintf(out, " %s %lld", ty.c_str(), n);
    std::fprintf(out, "\n");
    std::fprintf(out, "  an expert %.2f MB, %lld picks a token: %.3f GB a token\n", per_expert / 1e6, topk, token_bytes / 1e9);
    std::fprintf(out, "  all experts %.1f GB at %.2f bpw (%.0f G parameters), dense %.2f GB (embed %.2f, head %.2f, mtp %.2f, vision %.2f, engram %.2f)\n",
                 gb(experts_bytes), expert_params > 0 ? experts_bytes * 8.0 / expert_params : 0.0, expert_params / 1e9, gb(dense),
                 gb(dense_embed), gb(dense_head), gb(dense_mtp), gb(dense_vision), gb(dense_engram));
    std::fprintf(out, "  dense types:");
    for (const auto& d : dense_types) std::fprintf(out, " %s", d.c_str());
    std::fprintf(out, "\n");
    // the geometry the engine needs at run time but that is easy to lose in a pack built by another tool: DSpark's block
    // size / noise token / markov rank (0 there means it drafts one token a run, i.e. it is off) and the Engram's layers
    {
        auto kvn = [&](const char* k) {
            auto it = kv.find(k);
            return it == kv.end() ? 0 : std::atoll(it->second.c_str());
        };
        const int n_mtp = (int) std::count_if(t.begin(), t.end(), [](const auto& p) { return p.first.rfind("mtp.", 0) == 0; });
        const long long nl_eg = num("engram_layer_ids", -1);
        std::fprintf(out, "  dspark: block_size %lld, noise_token_id %lld, markov_rank %lld, routed experts %lld of %lld%s\n",
                     num("dspark_block_size", 0), num("dspark_noise_token_id", 0), num("dspark_markov_rank", 0),
                     num("dspark_n_routed_experts", 0), num("dspark_num_experts_per_tok", 0),
                     num("dspark_block_size", 0) == 0 ? "  <- DSpark cannot draft (block size 0)" : "");
        std::fprintf(out, "  mtp tensors: %d%s\n", n_mtp, n_mtp == 0 ? "  <- no DSpark drafter in the pack" : "");
        auto it = kv.find("engram_layer_ids");
        std::fprintf(out, "  engram layers: %s%s\n", it == kv.end() ? "(none)" : it->second.c_str(),
                     it == kv.end() ? "  <- the Engram tables are not used" : "");
    }
    if (no_kernel.empty()) {
        std::fprintf(out, "  no GPU kernel: none (every tensor is a device type)\n");
    } else {
        std::fprintf(out, "  no GPU kernel (%zu): the CPU lane takes them, they cannot go in the VRAM tier\n", no_kernel.size());
        int shown = 0;
        for (const std::string& s : no_kernel) {
            std::fprintf(out, "    %s\n", s.c_str());
            if (++shown >= 40) {
                std::fprintf(out, "    ... %zu more\n", no_kernel.size() - (size_t) shown);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    if (missing > 0) {
        std::fprintf(out, "  %d of %zu files missing or short: this pack cannot load (build it again, or point model_dir at "
                          "the weights)\n", missing, need.size());
        return 2;
    }
    std::fprintf(out, "  files: %zu, all present and long enough\n", need.size());
    return 0;
}

}  // namespace strata::ds4


## src/dsv41/ds4_tq_cpu.cpp

// Strata. The trellis routed experts (ds4_iq.cuh's is_tq types) on the CPU lane of the DeepSeek-V4.1 engine path: Strata's
// own decode-and-dot kernels (include/strata/kernels/cpu/tq_cpu.hpp: AVX-512 / AVX2 / scalar, one result whatever the ISA)
// over the file's rows read in place.  The activations are the device's (ds4_gguf.cu's q8_quant: int8 with an F32 scale a 32
// values), so an expert gives the same sums on either lane up to the order of the blocks' float sums.
#include "ds4_gguf_cpu.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#if defined(STRATA_DSV41_TQ_CPU)
#include "strata/kernels/cpu/tq_cpu.hpp"
#endif

namespace strata::ds4::gguf {

#if defined(STRATA_DSV41_TQ_CPU)
namespace kc = strata::kernels::cpu;
namespace {

int kbits_of(int type) {
    switch (type) {
        case 145: return 6;
        case 146: return 7;
        case 224: case 226: return 5;
        case 225: case 227: return 4;
        default: return 0;
    }
}
constexpr int kActTq = 100;   // IqCpu::gu_act / d_act of these types: the layout below

// an activation of k values: k / 32 F32 scales, then k int8
size_t act_bytes_of(int k) { return (size_t) k / 32 * 4 + (size_t) k; }

void unpack(const void* act, int k, kc::tq_detail::TqAct& a) {
    const uint8_t* p = (const uint8_t*) act;
    std::memcpy(a.d, p, (size_t) k / 32 * 4);
    const int8_t* q = (const int8_t*) (p + (size_t) k / 32 * 4);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) a.q[i] = q[i];
}

// dots of rows [r0, r1) of one matrix against nt activations: out[t][r]
void dots(int type, const uint8_t* w, size_t rb, int n, const void* const* act, int nt, float* const* out, int r0, int r1) {
    static thread_local std::vector<kc::tq_detail::TqAct> unp(kc::kTqMaxTokens);
    const kc::tq_detail::TqAct* ap[kc::kTqMaxTokens];
    for (int t = 0; t < nt; ++t) {
        unpack(act[t], n, unp[(size_t) t]);
        ap[t] = &unp[(size_t) t];
    }
    const int kb = kc::tq_kbits(type);
    const int16_t* tab = kc::tq_state_table_for(type);
    switch (kc::tq_isa()) {
        case kc::TqIsa::avx512: kc::tq_detail::tq_rows_avx512(kb, tab, w, rb, n, ap, nt, out, r0, r1); break;
        case kc::TqIsa::avx2: kc::tq_detail::tq_rows_avx2(kb, tab, w, rb, n, ap, nt, out, r0, r1); break;
        default: kc::tq_detail::tq_rows_scalar(kb, tab, w, rb, n, ap, nt, out, r0, r1); break;
    }
}
}  // namespace

bool tq_cpu_fmt(int tg, int td, int n_embd, int n_ff, IqCpu& f, std::string& err) {
    if (kbits_of(tg) == 0 || kbits_of(td) == 0) {
        err = "not trellis types";
        return false;
    }
    if (n_embd % 128 != 0 || n_ff % 128 != 0 || n_embd > kc::kTqMaxN || n_ff > kc::kTqMaxN) {
        err = "the trellis CPU kernels take widths of 128 blocks up to " + std::to_string(kc::kTqMaxN);
        return false;
    }
    f.tg = tg;
    f.td = td;
    f.n_embd = n_embd;
    f.n_ff = n_ff;
    f.gu_act = f.d_act = kActTq;
    f.gu_row = (size_t) (n_embd / 128) * (2 + 4 * kbits_of(tg));
    f.d_row = (size_t) (n_ff / 128) * (2 + 4 * kbits_of(td));
    f.act_bytes = act_bytes_of(n_embd);
    f.h_bytes = act_bytes_of(n_ff);
    return true;
}

// x (k values) -> the layout above (the device's q8_quant: sc = max|x| / 127, q = round-half-even(x / sc))
void tq_cpu_quant(const float* x, int k, void* dst) {
    float* d = (float*) dst;
    int8_t* q = (int8_t*) ((uint8_t*) dst + (size_t) k / 32 * 4);
    for (int b = 0; b < k / 32; ++b) {
        const float* xb = x + b * 32;
        float am = 0.0f;
        for (int j = 0; j < 32; ++j) am = std::max(am, std::fabs(xb[j]));
        const float sc = am / 127.0f;
        d[b] = sc;
        for (int j = 0; j < 32; ++j) q[b * 32 + j] = (int8_t) (am > 0.0f ? (int) std::nearbyint(xb[j] / sc) : 0);
    }
}

void tq_cpu_gate_up(const IqCpu& f, const uint8_t* gate, const uint8_t* up, const void* const* act, int nt, float* const* ff,
                    int r0, int r1, float limit) {
    static thread_local std::vector<float> tmp[kc::kTqMaxTokens];
    float* up_out[kc::kTqMaxTokens];
    for (int t = 0; t < nt; ++t) {
        tmp[t].resize((size_t) r1);
        up_out[t] = tmp[t].data();
    }
    dots(f.tg, gate, f.gu_row, f.n_embd, act, nt, ff, r0, r1);
    dots(f.tg, up, f.gu_row, f.n_embd, act, nt, up_out, r0, r1);
    for (int t = 0; t < nt; ++t)
        for (int r = r0; r < r1; ++r) {
            float g = ff[t][r], u = up_out[t][r];
            if (limit > 0.0f) {
                g = std::min(g, limit);
                u = std::min(std::max(u, -limit), limit);
            }
            ff[t][r] = g / (1.0f + std::exp(-g)) * u;
        }
}

void tq_cpu_down(const IqCpu& f, const uint8_t* down, const void* const* hq, int nt, float* const* out, int r0, int r1) {
    dots(f.td, down, f.d_row, f.n_ff, hq, nt, out, r0, r1);
}
bool tq_cpu_type(int type) { return kbits_of(type) > 0; }
int tq_cpu_act() { return kActTq; }
#else
bool tq_cpu_fmt(int, int, int, int, IqCpu&, std::string& err) {
    err = "this build has no CPU trellis kernels (STRATA_NATIVE_EXPERTS=OFF)";
    return false;
}
void tq_cpu_quant(const float*, int, void*) {}
void tq_cpu_gate_up(const IqCpu&, const uint8_t*, const uint8_t*, const void* const*, int, float* const*, int, int, float) {}
void tq_cpu_down(const IqCpu&, const uint8_t*, const void* const*, int, float* const*, int, int) {}
bool tq_cpu_type(int) { return false; }
int tq_cpu_act() { return 100; }
#endif

}  // namespace strata::ds4::gguf


## src/dsv41/vendor/exl3_cpu.cpp

// Copyright (c) 2026 Peasant Smith and the Project Maya contributors (MIT; https://github.com/mw00/project-maya, v1.1.17).
// Ported into Strata (third_party/project-maya/NOTICE.md, LICENSE); changes are in the git history of this file.
// src/kernels/cpu/exl3_cpu.cpp - EXL3 routed experts on the CPU (see include/strata/kernels/cpu/exl3_cpu.hpp).
//
// The vector kernels follow exllamav3's CPU expert kernel (MIT, turboderp - exllamav3_ext/cpu/moe_mul1.cpp, its
// AVX-512 BW and AVX2 tiers): a tile row's 16 states come out of the tile's words with cross-lane permutes and a
// per-lane funnel shift from compile-time tables, the codebook product's bytes are added with vpmaddubsw against ones
// and vpmaddwd against ones.  Unlike there, the activations stay F32 (no int8 rows) and the affine offset is the
// device's FP16 constant, so the CPU lane computes what the device kernels compute up to the FP16 rounding of each
// weight.  The AVX-512 and AVX2 tiers do the same FMAs in the same order: they give the same bits (the bands,
// the split-K pieces, the GEMM's sums and the vectorised transforms alike).
#include "strata/dsv41/exl3_cpu.hpp"

#include "strata/kernels/f16_bits.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(_M_X64)
#define EXL3_X86 1
#include <immintrin.h>
#if defined(_MSC_VER)
#include <intrin.h>
#else
#include <cpuid.h>
#endif
#endif

#if defined(EXL3_X86) && (defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__))
#define EXL3_AVX512 __attribute__((target("avx512f,avx512bw,fma")))
#define EXL3_AVX2 __attribute__((target("avx2,fma,f16c")))
#define EXL3_AVX2_INLINE __attribute__((target("avx2,fma,f16c"), always_inline)) inline
#elif defined(_MSC_VER)
#define EXL3_AVX512
#define EXL3_AVX2
#define EXL3_AVX2_INLINE __forceinline
#else
#define EXL3_AVX512
#define EXL3_AVX2
#define EXL3_AVX2_INLINE inline
#endif

namespace strata::dsv41k::cpu {
// Strata's cpu_avx2_ok lives in strata_kernels_cpu, which this path does not link: AVX2 + FMA here
static bool cpu_avx2_ok() {
#if defined(__x86_64__) && (defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__))
    __builtin_cpu_init();
    return __builtin_cpu_supports("avx2") && __builtin_cpu_supports("fma");
#else
    return false;
#endif
}
using strata::kernels::f32_from_f16;
using strata::kernels::f16_from_f32;
namespace {

constexpr uint32_t kMul1 = 0x83DCD12Du;

float k_inv() { return f32_from_f16(0x1eee); }
float k_zero() { return 1024.0f * f32_from_f16(0x1eee) + f32_from_f16(0xc931); }   // w = s * k_inv + k_zero

// the 128-point Sylvester transform over sqrt(128), in place
void had128(float* v) {
    for (int h = 1; h < 128; h <<= 1)
        for (int i = 0; i < 128; i += 2 * h)
            for (int j = i; j < i + h; ++j) {
                const float a = v[j], b = v[j + h];
                v[j] = a + b;
                v[j + h] = a - b;
            }
    const float s = 0.088388347648f;
    for (int i = 0; i < 128; ++i) v[i] *= s;
}

// step p of a tile: row (p/8 % 4) * 2 + (p & 1) + 8 (p/2 & 1), column p/32 + 8 (p/4 & 1); inv[row * 16 + col] = p
constexpr std::array<uint16_t, 256> make_inv() {
    std::array<uint16_t, 256> inv{};
    for (int p = 0; p < 256; ++p) {
        const int lane = p >> 3, j = p & 7;
        const int r = (lane & 3) * 2 + (j & 1) + 8 * ((j >> 1) & 1);
        const int c = (lane >> 2) + 8 * (j >> 2);
        inv[(size_t) (r * 16 + c)] = (uint16_t) p;
    }
    return inv;
}

// a tile row's 16 states: column c's 16-bit window ends at bit b1 = (p + 1 + 256) K of the tile's MSB-first stream;
// its words i0 (the window's first bit) and i1 (its last), and the right shift of (w[i0] : w[i1]) that aligns it
template <int K>
struct RowTab {
    int32_t i0[16][16] = {}, i1[16][16] = {}, sr[16][16] = {}, sl[16][16] = {};
    uint16_t hi0[16] = {}, hi1[16] = {};   // columns whose word is in the second register pair (>= 32)
};
template <int K>
constexpr RowTab<K> make_rowtab() {
    RowTab<K> t{};
    constexpr int W = 8 * K;
    const auto inv = make_inv();
    for (int r = 0; r < 16; ++r)
        for (int c = 0; c < 16; ++c) {
            const int p = inv[(size_t) (r * 16 + c)];
            const int b1 = (p + 1 + 256) * K;
            const int w1 = ((b1 - 1) >> 5) % W, w0 = ((b1 - 16) >> 5) % W;
            const int sh = (((b1 - 1) >> 5) + 1) * 32 - b1;
            t.i0[r][c] = w0;
            t.i1[r][c] = w1;
            t.sr[r][c] = sh;
            t.sl[r][c] = 32 - sh;   // a shift by 32 clears the lane: a window inside one word
            if (w0 >= 32) t.hi0[r] = (uint16_t) (t.hi0[r] | (1u << c));
            if (w1 >= 32) t.hi1[r] = (uint16_t) (t.hi1[r] | (1u << c));
        }
    return t;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- scalar
template <int K>
void band_scalar(const Exl3Part& m, const float* xh, int tc0, int ks0, int ks1, float* acc /* 128 */) {
    constexpr int W = 8 * K;
    static constexpr RowTab<K> T = make_rowtab<K>();
    const int ld = m.n / 16;
    for (int i = 0; i < 128; ++i) acc[i] = 0.0f;
    for (int ks = ks0; ks < ks1; ++ks)
        for (int t = 0; t < 8; ++t) {
            const uint32_t* w = m.trellis + ((size_t) ks * ld + tc0 + t) * W;
            for (int r = 0; r < 16; ++r) {
                const float xv = xh[ks * 16 + r];
                for (int c = 0; c < 16; ++c) {
                    const uint64_t a = w[T.i0[r][c]], b = w[T.i1[r][c]];
                    const uint32_t st = (uint32_t) (((a << 32) | b) >> T.sr[r][c]) & 0xffffu;
                    const uint32_t x = st * kMul1;
                    const int s = (int) ((x & 0xffu) + ((x >> 8) & 0xffu) + ((x >> 16) & 0xffu) + (x >> 24));
                    acc[t * 16 + c] += (float) s * xv;
                }
            }
        }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- AVX-512
#if defined(EXL3_X86)
template <int K>
EXL3_AVX512 inline __m512i gather_words(const RowTab<K>& T, const int32_t (&idx)[16][16], const uint16_t* hi, int r,
                                        __m512i p0, __m512i p1, __m512i p2, __m512i p3) {
    const __m512i ix = _mm512_loadu_si512((const void*) idx[r]);
    __m512i v = _mm512_permutex2var_epi32(p0, ix, p1);
    if constexpr (8 * K > 32) {
        if (hi[r] != 0) v = _mm512_mask_blend_epi32((__mmask16) hi[r], v, _mm512_permutex2var_epi32(p2, ix, p3));
    }
    (void) T;
    return v;
}

template <int K>
EXL3_AVX512 void band_avx512(const Exl3Part& m, const float* xh, int tc0, int ks0, int ks1, float* out /* 128 */) {
    constexpr int W = 8 * K;
    static constexpr RowTab<K> T = make_rowtab<K>();
    constexpr auto ld_mask = [](int n) -> __mmask16 {
        return n >= 16 ? (__mmask16) 0xffffu : n <= 0 ? (__mmask16) 0 : (__mmask16) ((1u << n) - 1u);
    };
    constexpr __mmask16 m0 = ld_mask(W), m1 = ld_mask(W - 16), m2 = ld_mask(W - 32), m3 = ld_mask(W - 48);
    const int ld = m.n / 16;
    const size_t row_words = (size_t) ld * W;
    const __m512i mult = _mm512_set1_epi32((int) kMul1);
    const __m512i ones8 = _mm512_set1_epi8(1), ones16 = _mm512_set1_epi16(1);
    const __m512i low16 = _mm512_set1_epi32(0xffff);
    __m512 acc[8];
    for (int t = 0; t < 8; ++t) acc[t] = _mm512_setzero_ps();
    const uint32_t* row = m.trellis + (size_t) ks0 * row_words + (size_t) tc0 * W;
    for (int ks = ks0; ks < ks1; ++ks, row += row_words) {
        // the band's 8 tiles of this slice are contiguous; the next slices' are one row of tiles on
        const char* pf = (const char*) (row + 4 * row_words);
        for (int l = 0; l < 8 * W * 4; l += 64) _mm_prefetch(pf + l, _MM_HINT_T0);
        const float* xk = xh + ks * 16;
        for (int t = 0; t < 8; ++t) {
            const uint32_t* w = row + t * W;
            const __m512i p0 = _mm512_maskz_loadu_epi32(m0, w);
            const __m512i p1 = m1 ? _mm512_maskz_loadu_epi32(m1, w + 16) : _mm512_setzero_si512();
            const __m512i p2 = m2 ? _mm512_maskz_loadu_epi32(m2, w + 32) : _mm512_setzero_si512();
            const __m512i p3 = m3 ? _mm512_maskz_loadu_epi32(m3, w + 48) : _mm512_setzero_si512();
            __m512 a = acc[t];
#pragma GCC unroll 16
            for (int r = 0; r < 16; ++r) {
                const __m512i wa = gather_words<K>(T, T.i0, T.hi0, r, p0, p1, p2, p3);
                const __m512i wb = gather_words<K>(T, T.i1, T.hi1, r, p0, p1, p2, p3);
                const __m512i st = _mm512_and_si512(
                    _mm512_or_si512(_mm512_srlv_epi32(wb, _mm512_loadu_si512((const void*) T.sr[r])),
                                    _mm512_sllv_epi32(wa, _mm512_loadu_si512((const void*) T.sl[r]))),
                    low16);
                const __m512i bs = _mm512_madd_epi16(_mm512_maddubs_epi16(_mm512_mullo_epi32(st, mult), ones8), ones16);
                a = _mm512_fmadd_ps(_mm512_cvtepi32_ps(bs), _mm512_set1_ps(xk[r]), a);
            }
            acc[t] = a;
        }
    }
    for (int t = 0; t < 8; ++t) _mm512_storeu_ps(out + t * 16, acc[t]);
}

// band_avx512 for N activations at once (xh[i] -> out[i]), as exllamav3's CPU kernel takes up to 4 token rows: each
// tile row's 16 states are pulled out and byte-summed once, then one FMA per activation - activation i's FMAs are
// band_avx512's for it alone, in its order, so out[i] is the same bit for bit.  An extra activation costs one FMA of
// the row's ~12 instructions.  (The tiles' accumulators live in memory, loaded once a tile and slice as there: only
// the N of the tile in hand take registers.)
template <int K, int N>
EXL3_AVX512 void band_avx512_n(const Exl3Part& m, const float* const* xh, int tc0, int ks0, int ks1,
                               float* const* out /* N x 128 */) {
    constexpr int W = 8 * K;
    static constexpr RowTab<K> T = make_rowtab<K>();
    constexpr auto ld_mask = [](int n) -> __mmask16 {
        return n >= 16 ? (__mmask16) 0xffffu : n <= 0 ? (__mmask16) 0 : (__mmask16) ((1u << n) - 1u);
    };
    constexpr __mmask16 m0 = ld_mask(W), m1 = ld_mask(W - 16), m2 = ld_mask(W - 32), m3 = ld_mask(W - 48);
    const int ld = m.n / 16;
    const size_t row_words = (size_t) ld * W;
    const __m512i mult = _mm512_set1_epi32((int) kMul1);
    const __m512i ones8 = _mm512_set1_epi8(1), ones16 = _mm512_set1_epi16(1);
    const __m512i low16 = _mm512_set1_epi32(0xffff);
    __m512 acc[8][N];
    for (int t = 0; t < 8; ++t)
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) acc[t][i] = _mm512_setzero_ps();
    const uint32_t* row = m.trellis + (size_t) ks0 * row_words + (size_t) tc0 * W;
    for (int ks = ks0; ks < ks1; ++ks, row += row_words) {
        const char* pf = (const char*) (row + 4 * row_words);
        for (int l = 0; l < 8 * W * 4; l += 64) _mm_prefetch(pf + l, _MM_HINT_T0);
        const float* xk[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) xk[i] = xh[i] + ks * 16;
        for (int t = 0; t < 8; ++t) {
            const uint32_t* w = row + t * W;
            const __m512i p0 = _mm512_maskz_loadu_epi32(m0, w);
            const __m512i p1 = m1 ? _mm512_maskz_loadu_epi32(m1, w + 16) : _mm512_setzero_si512();
            const __m512i p2 = m2 ? _mm512_maskz_loadu_epi32(m2, w + 32) : _mm512_setzero_si512();
            const __m512i p3 = m3 ? _mm512_maskz_loadu_epi32(m3, w + 48) : _mm512_setzero_si512();
            __m512 a[N];
#pragma GCC unroll 8
            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) a[i] = acc[t][i];
#pragma GCC unroll 16
            for (int r = 0; r < 16; ++r) {
                const __m512i wa = gather_words<K>(T, T.i0, T.hi0, r, p0, p1, p2, p3);
                const __m512i wb = gather_words<K>(T, T.i1, T.hi1, r, p0, p1, p2, p3);
                const __m512i st = _mm512_and_si512(
                    _mm512_or_si512(_mm512_srlv_epi32(wb, _mm512_loadu_si512((const void*) T.sr[r])),
                                    _mm512_sllv_epi32(wa, _mm512_loadu_si512((const void*) T.sl[r]))),
                    low16);
                const __m512 f = _mm512_cvtepi32_ps(
                    _mm512_madd_epi16(_mm512_maddubs_epi16(_mm512_mullo_epi32(st, mult), ones8), ones16));
#pragma GCC unroll 8
                for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) a[i] = _mm512_fmadd_ps(f, _mm512_set1_ps(xk[i][r]), a[i]);
            }
#pragma GCC unroll 8
            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) acc[t][i] = a[i];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
        for (int t = 0; t < 8; ++t) _mm512_storeu_ps(out[i] + t * 16, acc[t][i]);
}

// rows_avx512_n: slices [ks0, ks1) of the tile columns [t0, t1) - a split-K piece, or a run of its columns - for N
// activations (xh[i] -> acc[i], indexed by column; columns 16 t0 .. 16 t1 overwritten).  The tile rows are read in
// memory order, where a band's tiles are 1 KB runs a whole tile row apart: 40 threads of a 2-socket Xeon 6152 read a K4
// expert from DRAM in 0.14 ms in pieces, 0.21 in bands (~90 vs ~60 GB/s), the kernel the same.  A tile's 16 sums per
// activation live in acc between slices; each row's decode and FMAs are band_avx512's, so acc[i] is the N = 1 call's
// for xh[i] alone, bit for bit, whatever the columns' run.  The prefetch runs 16 tiles ahead in the job's own order
// (into the next slice past the run's end, not the next job's columns)
template <int K, int N>
EXL3_AVX512 void rows_avx512_n(const Exl3Part& m, const float* const* xh, int ks0, int ks1, int t0, int t1,
                               float* const* acc) {
    constexpr int W = 8 * K;
    static constexpr RowTab<K> T = make_rowtab<K>();
    constexpr auto ld_mask = [](int n) -> __mmask16 {
        return n >= 16 ? (__mmask16) 0xffffu : n <= 0 ? (__mmask16) 0 : (__mmask16) ((1u << n) - 1u);
    };
    constexpr __mmask16 m0 = ld_mask(W), m1 = ld_mask(W - 16), m2 = ld_mask(W - 32), m3 = ld_mask(W - 48);
    const int ld = m.n / 16;
    const size_t row_words = (size_t) ld * W;
    const __m512i mult = _mm512_set1_epi32((int) kMul1);
    const __m512i ones8 = _mm512_set1_epi8(1), ones16 = _mm512_set1_epi16(1);
    const __m512i low16 = _mm512_set1_epi32(0xffff);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
        for (int c = 16 * t0; c < 16 * t1; c += 16) _mm512_storeu_ps(acc[i] + c, _mm512_setzero_ps());
    const int span = t1 - t0;
    const uint32_t* row = m.trellis + (size_t) ks0 * row_words;
    for (int ks = ks0; ks < ks1; ++ks, row += row_words) {
        float xk[N][16];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
            for (int r = 0; r < 16; ++r) xk[i][r] = xh[i][ks * 16 + r];
        for (int t = t0; t < t1; ++t) {
            const uint32_t* w = row + (size_t) t * W;
            const uint32_t* pf = t + 16 < t1 || span == ld ? w + 16 * W : row + row_words + (size_t) (t + 16 - span) * W;
            for (int l = 0; l < W * 4; l += 64) _mm_prefetch((const char*) pf + l, _MM_HINT_T0);
            const __m512i p0 = _mm512_maskz_loadu_epi32(m0, w);
            const __m512i p1 = m1 ? _mm512_maskz_loadu_epi32(m1, w + 16) : _mm512_setzero_si512();
            const __m512i p2 = m2 ? _mm512_maskz_loadu_epi32(m2, w + 32) : _mm512_setzero_si512();
            const __m512i p3 = m3 ? _mm512_maskz_loadu_epi32(m3, w + 48) : _mm512_setzero_si512();
            __m512 a[N];
#pragma GCC unroll 8
            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) a[i] = _mm512_loadu_ps(acc[i] + t * 16);
#pragma GCC unroll 16
            for (int r = 0; r < 16; ++r) {
                const __m512i wa = gather_words<K>(T, T.i0, T.hi0, r, p0, p1, p2, p3);
                const __m512i wb = gather_words<K>(T, T.i1, T.hi1, r, p0, p1, p2, p3);
                const __m512i st = _mm512_and_si512(
                    _mm512_or_si512(_mm512_srlv_epi32(wb, _mm512_loadu_si512((const void*) T.sr[r])),
                                    _mm512_sllv_epi32(wa, _mm512_loadu_si512((const void*) T.sl[r]))),
                    low16);
                const __m512 f = _mm512_cvtepi32_ps(
                    _mm512_madd_epi16(_mm512_maddubs_epi16(_mm512_mullo_epi32(st, mult), ones8), ones16));
#pragma GCC unroll 8
                for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) a[i] = _mm512_fmadd_ps(f, _mm512_set1_ps(xk[i][r]), a[i]);
            }
#pragma GCC unroll 8
            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) _mm512_storeu_ps(acc[i] + t * 16, a[i]);
        }
    }
}

// band_gemm: a band's byte-sum products for many activations - each chunk of kGemmK inputs decoded ONCE into F32
// (wc, in L2), then multiplied as a GEMM: tiles of TB activations x 64 columns, the sums in registers, two FMAs a
// load.  The prompt path's CPU rows, where an expert serves tens to hundreds of tokens: one decode (~6 instructions a
// 16-weight row) for all of them instead of one per kExl3CpuMaxN.
constexpr int kGemmK = 256;

template <int K>
EXL3_AVX512 void decode_chunk(const Exl3Part& m, int tc0, int ks0, int ks1, float* wc /* (ks1 - ks0) 16 x 128 */) {
    constexpr int W = 8 * K;
    static constexpr RowTab<K> T = make_rowtab<K>();
    constexpr auto ld_mask = [](int n) -> __mmask16 {
        return n >= 16 ? (__mmask16) 0xffffu : n <= 0 ? (__mmask16) 0 : (__mmask16) ((1u << n) - 1u);
    };
    constexpr __mmask16 m0 = ld_mask(W), m1 = ld_mask(W - 16), m2 = ld_mask(W - 32), m3 = ld_mask(W - 48);
    const size_t row_words = (size_t) (m.n / 16) * W;
    const __m512i mult = _mm512_set1_epi32((int) kMul1);
    const __m512i ones8 = _mm512_set1_epi8(1), ones16 = _mm512_set1_epi16(1);
    const __m512i low16 = _mm512_set1_epi32(0xffff);
    const uint32_t* row = m.trellis + (size_t) ks0 * row_words + (size_t) tc0 * W;
    for (int ks = ks0; ks < ks1; ++ks, row += row_words) {
        const char* pf = (const char*) (row + 4 * row_words);
        for (int l = 0; l < 8 * W * 4; l += 64) _mm_prefetch(pf + l, _MM_HINT_T0);
        float* wr = wc + (size_t) (ks - ks0) * 16 * 128;
        for (int t = 0; t < 8; ++t) {
            const uint32_t* w = row + t * W;
            const __m512i p0 = _mm512_maskz_loadu_epi32(m0, w);
            const __m512i p1 = m1 ? _mm512_maskz_loadu_epi32(m1, w + 16) : _mm512_setzero_si512();
            const __m512i p2 = m2 ? _mm512_maskz_loadu_epi32(m2, w + 32) : _mm512_setzero_si512();
            const __m512i p3 = m3 ? _mm512_maskz_loadu_epi32(m3, w + 48) : _mm512_setzero_si512();
#pragma GCC unroll 16
            for (int r = 0; r < 16; ++r) {
                const __m512i wa = gather_words<K>(T, T.i0, T.hi0, r, p0, p1, p2, p3);
                const __m512i wb = gather_words<K>(T, T.i1, T.hi1, r, p0, p1, p2, p3);
                const __m512i st = _mm512_and_si512(
                    _mm512_or_si512(_mm512_srlv_epi32(wb, _mm512_loadu_si512((const void*) T.sr[r])),
                                    _mm512_sllv_epi32(wa, _mm512_loadu_si512((const void*) T.sl[r]))),
                    low16);
                const __m512i bs =
                    _mm512_madd_epi16(_mm512_maddubs_epi16(_mm512_mullo_epi32(st, mult), ones8), ones16);
                _mm512_store_ps(wr + r * 128 + t * 16, _mm512_cvtepi32_ps(bs));
            }
        }
    }
}

// acc[t][0..128) += sum_{k < kr} x[t][k] wc[k][..] for TB activations
template <int TB>
EXL3_AVX512 void gemm_tile(const float* wc, int kr, const float* const* x, float* const* acc) {
    for (int cb = 0; cb < 128; cb += 64) {
        __m512 a[TB][4];
        for (int t = 0; t < TB; ++t)
            for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) a[t][j] = _mm512_loadu_ps(acc[t] + cb + j * 16);
        const float* w = wc + cb;
        for (int k = 0; k < kr; ++k, w += 128) {
            const __m512 w0 = _mm512_load_ps(w), w1 = _mm512_load_ps(w + 16), w2 = _mm512_load_ps(w + 32),
                         w3 = _mm512_load_ps(w + 48);
#pragma GCC unroll 8
            for (int t = 0; t < TB; ++t) {
                const __m512 xv = _mm512_set1_ps(x[t][k]);
                a[t][0] = _mm512_fmadd_ps(xv, w0, a[t][0]);
                a[t][1] = _mm512_fmadd_ps(xv, w1, a[t][1]);
                a[t][2] = _mm512_fmadd_ps(xv, w2, a[t][2]);
                a[t][3] = _mm512_fmadd_ps(xv, w3, a[t][3]);
            }
        }
        for (int t = 0; t < TB; ++t)
            for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) _mm512_storeu_ps(acc[t] + cb + j * 16, a[t][j]);
    }
}

// nb bands from tile column tc0 (acc[t]: the activation's 128 nb outputs from there): each chunk of the inputs is
// taken for every band in turn, so the activations' chunk (n x kGemmK floats) comes from L2 for the nb bands - an
// expert's rows are its own tokens, and with a job a band they came from DRAM again for every band (~16x the
// expert's weights in bytes)
template <int K>
EXL3_AVX512 void band_gemm_avx512(const Exl3Part& m, const float* const* xh, int n, int tc0, int nb,
                                  float* const* acc, float* wc) {
    constexpr int KS = kGemmK / 16;
    constexpr int TB = 6;   // 24 sums + 4 weights + the activation: 29 of the 32 registers
    for (int t = 0; t < n; ++t) std::memset(acc[t], 0, (size_t) nb * 128 * sizeof(float));
    std::vector<float*> ab((size_t) n);
    for (int ks0 = 0; ks0 < m.k / 16; ks0 += KS) {
        const int ks1 = std::min(m.k / 16, ks0 + KS), kr = (ks1 - ks0) * 16;
        for (int bb = 0; bb < nb; ++bb) {
            decode_chunk<K>(m, tc0 + 8 * bb, ks0, ks1, wc);
            for (int t = 0; t < n; ++t) ab[(size_t) t] = acc[t] + bb * 128;
            float* const* ap = ab.data();
            int t = 0;
            for (; t + TB <= n; t += TB) {
                const float* xp[TB];
                for (int i = 0; i < TB; ++i) xp[i] = xh[t + i] + ks0 * 16;
                gemm_tile<TB>(wc, kr, xp, ap + t);
            }
            if (t < n) {   // the last 1..TB-1 activations in one pass too
                const float* xp[TB];
                for (int i = 0; i < n - t; ++i) xp[i] = xh[t + i] + ks0 * 16;
                switch (n - t) {
                    case 1: gemm_tile<1>(wc, kr, xp, ap + t); break;
                    case 2: gemm_tile<2>(wc, kr, xp, ap + t); break;
                    case 3: gemm_tile<3>(wc, kr, xp, ap + t); break;
                    case 4: gemm_tile<4>(wc, kr, xp, ap + t); break;
                    default: gemm_tile<5>(wc, kr, xp, ap + t); break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// had128 in 8 registers: every butterfly takes the operands the scalar loop takes (a lane's partner by a permute; the
// lower lane a + b, the upper b's lane t - r = a - b), so the result is had128's bit for bit
EXL3_AVX512 inline __m512 bfly(__m512 r, __m512 t, __mmask16 upper) {
    return _mm512_mask_sub_ps(_mm512_add_ps(r, t), upper, t, r);
}
EXL3_AVX512 void had128_avx512(float* v) {
    __m512 r[8];
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) r[i] = _mm512_loadu_ps(v + 16 * i);
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
        r[i] = bfly(r[i], _mm512_permute_ps(r[i], 0b10110001), (__mmask16) 0xAAAA);              // h = 1
        r[i] = bfly(r[i], _mm512_permute_ps(r[i], 0b01001110), (__mmask16) 0xCCCC);              // h = 2
