            self.assertEqual(self.tpl.render(messages, tools=tools, **kw), case["text"], case["id"] + " " + case["mode"])

    def test_thinking_is_the_default(self):
        text = self.tpl.render([{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}])
        self.assertTrue(text.endswith("<｜Assistant｜><think>"))
        text = self.tpl.render([{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], enable_thinking=False)
        self.assertTrue(text.endswith("<｜Assistant｜></think>"))

    def test_a_tool_call_and_its_result_render_in_dsml(self):
        msgs = [{"role": "user", "content": "weather?"},
                {"role": "assistant", "content": "", "reasoning_content": "call it",
                 "tool_calls": [{"function": {"name": "get_weather", "arguments": {"city": "Zagreb", "days": 3}}}]},
                {"role": "tool", "content": "sunny"}]
        text = self.tpl.render(msgs, tools=[WEATHER["function"]], enable_thinking=False)
        self.assertIn('<｜DSML｜ invoke name="get_weather">', text)
        self.assertIn('<｜DSML｜ parameter name="city" string="true">Zagreb</｜DSML｜ parameter>', text)
        self.assertIn('<｜DSML｜ parameter name="days" string="false">3</｜DSML｜ parameter>', text)
        self.assertIn("<tool_result>sunny</tool_result>", text)


class Translator(unittest.TestCase):
    RAW = call(("get_weather", [("city", "Zagreb", True), ("days", "3", False)]), ("ping", []))

    def all_at_once(self, text):
        t = DsmlTranslator()
        return t.feed(text) + t.flush()

    def test_a_call_becomes_the_qwen_form(self):
        got = self.all_at_once("Sure." + self.RAW)
        self.assertEqual(got, "Sure.\n\n<tool_call>\n<function=get_weather>\n<parameter=city>\nZagreb\n</parameter>\n"
                              "<parameter=days>\n3\n</parameter>\n</function>\n</tool_call>\n"
                              "<tool_call>\n<function=ping>\n</function>\n</tool_call>\n")

    def test_the_split_of_the_stream_changes_nothing(self):
        want = self.all_at_once("a < b and 1<2" + self.RAW + "tail")
        for step in (1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13):
            t = DsmlTranslator()
            text = "a < b and 1<2" + self.RAW + "tail"
            got = "".join(t.feed(text[i:i + step]) for i in range(0, len(text), step)) + t.flush()
            self.assertEqual(got, want, step)

    def test_text_with_angle_brackets_passes(self):
        text = "x <div> y </｜DSML｜ nope> <｜User｜> <｜DSML｜ unknown>"
        self.assertEqual(self.all_at_once(text), text)

    def test_the_end_of_the_output_inside_a_tag_is_text(self):
        t = DsmlTranslator()
        got = t.feed("ok <｜DSML｜ inv") + t.flush()
        self.assertEqual(got, "ok <｜DSML｜ inv")

    def test_a_value_that_looks_like_a_tag(self):
        raw = call(("write", [("text", "<b>bold</b> and < 3", True)]))
        self.assertIn("<parameter=text>\n<b>bold</b> and < 3\n</parameter>", self.all_at_once(raw))

    def test_a_missing_closing_tag_is_closed(self):
        raw = '<｜DSML｜ calls>\n<｜DSML｜ invoke name="f">\n<｜DSML｜ parameter name="a" string="true">x</｜DSML｜ invoke>'
        self.assertEqual(self.all_at_once(raw),
                         "<tool_call>\n<function=f>\n<parameter=a>\nx\n</parameter>\n</function>\n</tool_call>\n")


class Parser(unittest.TestCase):
    TOOLS = [WEATHER["function"], {"name": "lookup", "description": "", "parameters": {
        "type": "object", "properties": {"id": {}}}}]

    def run_parser(self, text, thinking=True, step=7, cls=DsmlOutputParser):
        p = cls(thinking=thinking, tools=self.TOOLS, stream_tools=True)
        evs = []
        for i in range(0, len(text), step):
            evs += p.feed(text[i:i + step])
        evs += p.finish("stop")
        return evs

    def test_reasoning_then_two_calls(self):
        raw = call(("get_weather", [("city", "Zagreb", True), ("days", "3", False)]), ("lookup", [("id", "123", True)]))
        for step in (1, 4, 1000):
            evs = self.run_parser("Think < ok.</think>" + raw, step=step)
            self.assertEqual("".join(e.text for e in evs if e.kind == "reasoning"), "Think < ok.")
            calls = [e.call for e in evs if e.kind == "tool_call"]
            self.assertEqual([(c.name, c.arguments) for c in calls],
                             [("get_weather", {"city": "Zagreb", "days": 3}), ("lookup", {"id": "123"})])
            self.assertEqual("".join(e.text for e in evs if e.kind == "tool_args"),
                             '{"city":"Zagreb","days":3}{"id":"123"}')

    def test_a_string_value_stays_a_string_even_when_the_schema_says_nothing(self):
        evs = self.run_parser(call(("lookup", [("id", "007", True)])), thinking=False)
        self.assertEqual([e.call.arguments for e in evs if e.kind == "tool_call"], [{"id": "007"}])
        evs = self.run_parser(call(("lookup", [("id", "7", False)])), thinking=False)
        self.assertEqual([e.call.arguments for e in evs if e.kind == "tool_call"], [{"id": 7}])

    def test_a_non_string_value_is_json(self):
        evs = self.run_parser(call(("lookup", [("id", '{"a": [1, 2]}', False)])), thinking=False)
        self.assertEqual([e.call.arguments for e in evs if e.kind == "tool_call"], [{"id": {"a": [1, 2]}}])

    def test_content_before_the_call_and_none_after(self):
        evs = self.run_parser("Checking.\n\n" + call(("lookup", [("id", "x", True)]))[2:], thinking=False)
        self.assertEqual("".join(e.text for e in evs if e.kind == "content").strip(), "Checking.")
        self.assertEqual(sum(e.kind == "tool_call" for e in evs), 1)

    def test_a_call_cut_off_by_the_length_limit_is_not_a_call(self):
        raw = call(("get_weather", [("city", "Zagr", True)]))
        raw = raw[:raw.index("Zagr") + 4]
        p = DsmlOutputParser(thinking=False, tools=self.TOOLS, stream_tools=True)
        evs = p.feed(raw) + p.finish("length")
        self.assertEqual(sum(e.kind == "tool_call" for e in evs), 0)

    def test_the_plain_parser_is_unchanged(self):
        p = OutputParser(thinking=False, tools=self.TOOLS)
        evs = p.feed("<tool_call>\n<function=lookup>\n<parameter=id>\n5\n</parameter>\n</function>\n</tool_call>")
        self.assertEqual([e.call.arguments for e in evs if e.kind == "tool_call"], [{"id": 5}])
        self.assertTrue(p.clean)

    def test_clean_counts_a_held_tag(self):
        p = DsmlOutputParser(thinking=False, tools=self.TOOLS)
        p.feed("hello <｜DS")
        self.assertFalse(p.clean)
        p.feed("ML｜ calls>")
        self.assertTrue(p.clean)

    def test_forced_opening(self):
        self.assertEqual(to_dsml_force("<tool_call>\n<function=get_weather>\n"),
                         '<｜DSML｜ calls>\n<｜DSML｜ invoke name="get_weather">\n')
        self.assertEqual(to_dsml_force("<tool_call>\n<function="), '<｜DSML｜ calls>\n<｜DSML｜ invoke name="')
        self.assertIsNone(to_dsml_force(None))
        # the opening and the model's continuation are one call
        p = DsmlOutputParser(thinking=False, tools=self.TOOLS, stream_tools=True)
        evs = p.feed(to_dsml_force("<tool_call>\n<function=get_weather>\n"))
        evs += p.feed('<｜DSML｜ parameter name="city" string="true">Rome</｜DSML｜ parameter>\n</｜DSML｜ invoke>\n</｜DSML｜ calls>')
        evs += p.finish("stop")
        self.assertEqual([(e.call.name, e.call.arguments) for e in evs if e.kind == "tool_call"],
                         [("get_weather", {"city": "Rome"})])


class ReadyTimeout(unittest.TestCase):
    """A 300+ GB model read from a slow disk needs more than the default 900 s before READY: the config's "engine_ready_s"."""

    def test_the_config_sets_it_and_a_bad_value_is_said(self):
        from serve import server
        before = server.ENGINE_READY_S
        self.addCleanup(setattr, server, "ENGINE_READY_S", before)
        server.apply_ready_timeout({})
        self.assertEqual(server.ENGINE_READY_S, before)
        server.apply_ready_timeout({"engine_ready_s": 3600})
        self.assertEqual(server.ENGINE_READY_S, 3600.0)
        for bad in (0, -5, "soon", True):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                server.apply_ready_timeout({"engine_ready_s": bad})


class ApiBase(unittest.TestCase):
    """Both APIs against a fake engine that replays scripted DeepSeek text (the helpers; Api has the tests)."""

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.tok = mini_tokenizer()

    def start(self, script):
        tok = self.tok
        engine = DsEngine(tok, script)
        svc = Service(engine, tok, ChatTemplate(TEMPLATE), model_name=default_model_name({"arch": "deepseek41"}))
        svc.model_arch = "deepseek41"
        svc.set_family("deepseek41")
        httpd = serve(svc, port=0)
        self.addCleanup(httpd.server_close)
        self.addCleanup(httpd.shutdown)
        self.addCleanup(frontend.use_family, None)
        self.engine, self.svc = engine, svc
        self.base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{httpd.server_address[1]}"
        return engine

    def post(self, path, body, raw=False):
        req = urllib.request.Request(self.base + path, data=json.dumps(body).encode(),
                                     headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
                data = r.read().decode()
                return r.status, (data if raw else json.loads(data))
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            return e.code, json.loads(e.read().decode())

    def prompt(self):
        return self.tok.decode(self.engine.last_prompt)

    def chat(self, **extra):
        body = {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], "max_tokens": 400, **extra}
        return self.post("/v1/chat/completions", body)


class Api(ApiBase):
    # -- thinking --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def test_thinking_by_default(self):
        self.start("The user greets me.</think>\n\nHello!")
        status, r = self.chat()
        self.assertEqual(status, 200, r)
        self.assertTrue(self.prompt().endswith("<｜User｜>hi<｜Assistant｜><think>"))
        msg = r["choices"][0]["message"]
        self.assertEqual(msg["reasoning_content"], "The user greets me.")
        self.assertEqual(msg["content"].strip(), "Hello!")
        self.assertEqual(r["choices"][0]["finish_reason"], "stop")

    ANSWER = "17 x 23 = 391. The answer is 391."

    def test_no_closing_think_tag_makes_the_text_the_answer(self):
        """The 2-bit sets write the answer after <think> and stop without </think>: it must not arrive as reasoning only (P2003)."""
        for effort in (None, "low", "medium", "high"):
            with self.subTest(effort=effort, api="openai"):
                self.start(self.ANSWER)
                status, r = self.chat(**({"reasoning_effort": effort} if effort else {}))
                self.assertEqual(status, 200, r)
                msg = r["choices"][0]["message"]
                self.assertEqual(msg["content"].strip(), self.ANSWER)
                self.assertFalse(msg.get("reasoning_content"))
                self.assertEqual(r["choices"][0]["finish_reason"], "stop")
            with self.subTest(effort=effort, api="anthropic"):
                self.start(self.ANSWER)
                status, r = self.post("/v1/messages", {"model": "x", "max_tokens": 400,
                                                       "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}],
                                                       **({"output_config": {"effort": effort}} if effort else {})})
                self.assertEqual(status, 200, r)
                self.assertEqual([b["type"] for b in r["content"]], ["text"])
                self.assertEqual(r["content"][0]["text"].strip(), self.ANSWER)

    def test_no_closing_think_tag_streaming_ends_with_the_answer_as_content(self):
        self.start(self.ANSWER)
        status, raw = self.post("/v1/chat/completions", {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], "max_tokens": 400,
                                                         "stream": True}, raw=True)
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        chunks = [json.loads(l[6:]) for l in raw.splitlines() if l.startswith("data: ") and l != "data: [DONE]"]
        content = "".join(c["choices"][0]["delta"].get("content") or "" for c in chunks if c["choices"])
        self.assertEqual(content.strip(), self.ANSWER)
        status, raw = self.post("/v1/messages", {"model": "x", "max_tokens": 400, "stream": True,
                                                 "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}]}, raw=True)
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertIn('"text_delta"', raw)
        self.assertIn("391", raw)

    def test_a_turn_cut_by_max_tokens_is_not_turned_into_an_answer(self):
        self.start(self.ANSWER * 30)
        status, r = self.chat(max_tokens=8)
        msg = r["choices"][0]["message"]
        self.assertEqual(r["choices"][0]["finish_reason"], "length")
        self.assertFalse(msg.get("content"))
        self.assertTrue(msg.get("reasoning_content"))

    def test_a_normal_closed_think_is_unchanged(self):
        self.start("Reasoning here.</think>The answer.")
        status, r = self.chat()
        msg = r["choices"][0]["message"]
        self.assertEqual((msg["reasoning_content"], msg["content"].strip()), ("Reasoning here.", "The answer."))

    def test_thinking_off(self):
        self.start("Hello!")
        for extra in ({"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": False}}, {"reasoning_effort": "none"}):
            status, r = self.chat(**extra)
            self.assertEqual(status, 200, r)
            self.assertTrue(self.prompt().endswith("<｜User｜>hi<｜Assistant｜></think>"), extra)
            msg = r["choices"][0]["message"]
            self.assertEqual(msg["content"].strip(), "Hello!")
            self.assertFalse(msg.get("reasoning_content"))

    def test_the_end_token_is_deepseeks_not_qwens(self):
        self.start("one<|im_end|>two")                # (not a token here: just text, like any other)
        status, r = self.chat(chat_template_kwargs={"enable_thinking": False})
        self.assertEqual(r["choices"][0]["message"]["content"], "one<|im_end|>two")

    def test_model_name_and_card_sampling(self):
        self.start("ok")
        self.assertEqual(FAMILY_MODEL_NAMES["deepseek41"], "deepseek-v4.1-flash")
        self.assertEqual(default_model_name({"arch": "deepseek41"}), "deepseek-v4.1-flash")
        self.assertEqual(model_card_sampling("deepseek41", True), {"temperature": 1.0, "top_p": 1.0})
        self.chat()
        self.assertEqual(self.engine.last_sampling.get("temperature"), 1.0)

    # -- effort ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def test_effort_words(self):
        self.start("ok")
        for given, line in (("low", "Reasoning Effort: 50 "), ("medium", "Reasoning Effort: 62 "),
                            ("high", "Reasoning Effort: 75 "), ("max", "Reasoning Effort: 100 "),
                            ("xhigh", "Reasoning Effort: 100 "), (40, "Reasoning Effort: 40 ")):
            status, r = self.chat(reasoning_effort=given)
            self.assertEqual(status, 200, (given, r))
            self.assertIn(line, self.prompt(), given)
        status, r = self.chat()
        self.assertIn("Reasoning Effort: 75 ", self.prompt())
        status, r = self.chat(reasoning_effort="extreme")
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)

    def test_anthropic_budget_picks_the_effort(self):
        self.start("ok")

                                               "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}]})

        self.assertIn("Reasoning Effort: 50 ", self.prompt())

    # -- tool calls -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def test_openai_tool_call(self):
        self.start("Need the weather.</think>" + call(("get_weather", [("city", "Zagreb", True), ("days", "2", False)])))
        status, r = self.chat(tools=[WEATHER])
        self.assertEqual(status, 200, r)
        self.assertIn('"name": "get_weather"', self.prompt())
        ch = r["choices"][0]
        self.assertEqual(ch["finish_reason"], "tool_calls")
        tc = ch["message"]["tool_calls"][0]
        self.assertEqual(tc["function"]["name"], "get_weather")
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(tc["function"]["arguments"]), {"city": "Zagreb", "days": 2})
        self.assertEqual(ch["message"]["reasoning_content"], "Need the weather.")

    def test_two_calls_in_one_turn(self):
        self.start("</think>" + call(("get_weather", [("city", "A", True)]), ("get_weather", [("city", "B", True)])))
        status, r = self.chat(tools=[WEATHER])
        names = [json.loads(c["function"]["arguments"])["city"] for c in r["choices"][0]["message"]["tool_calls"]]
        self.assertEqual(names, ["A", "B"])

    def test_streamed_tool_call(self):
        self.start("</think>" + call(("get_weather", [("city", "Zagreb", True)])))
        status, text = self.post("/v1/chat/completions", {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "w?"}], "tools": [WEATHER],
                                                          "stream": True, "max_tokens": 300}, raw=True)
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        chunks = [json.loads(x[6:]) for x in text.split("\n\n") if x.startswith("data: ") and x != "data: [DONE]"]
        calls = [tc for c in chunks for tc in c["choices"][0]["delta"].get("tool_calls", [])]
        self.assertEqual(calls[0]["function"]["name"], "get_weather")
        self.assertEqual(json.loads("".join(tc["function"].get("arguments", "") for tc in calls)), {"city": "Zagreb"})
        self.assertEqual([c["choices"][0]["finish_reason"] for c in chunks if c["choices"][0].get("finish_reason")],
                         ["tool_calls"])

    def test_a_tool_result_turn_renders_for_the_model(self):
        self.start("The weather is sunny.")

                {"role": "assistant", "content": None, "tool_calls": [{"id": "c1", "type": "function", "function": {

    # -- metrics -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def test_metrics_use_the_one_answer_speed(self):
        self.start("</think>Hello, how are you today?")
        self.chat()
        status = urllib.request.urlopen(self.base + "/metrics", timeout=10)
        m = json.loads(status.read().decode())
        last = m["requests"][-1]
        # produced tokens over the engine's decode time (10 ms a token in the fake), never over the prompt's time
        self.assertEqual(last["decode_tok_s"], 100.0)


    # -- the shared start of an agent's and its sub-agents' prompts (the engine keeps its state there) ------------
    def test_the_system_prompt_and_tools_are_the_shared_start(self):
        self.start("ok")
        self.auto_pin("1")
        sysmsg = {"role": "system", "content": "You are an agent. " * 20}
        body = {"messages": [sysmsg, {"role": "user", "content": "task one"}], "tools": [WEATHER], "max_tokens": 40}
        self.assertEqual(self.post("/v1/chat/completions", body)[0], 200)
        n = self.engine.last_sampling["strata_prefix"]["tokens"]
        ids = self.engine.last_prompt
        self.assertTrue(0 < n < len(ids) - 1)
        self.assertIn("get_weather", self.tok.decode(ids[:n]))            # the tools are in the shared start
        self.assertNotIn("task one", self.tok.decode(ids[:n]))            # the first user message is not
        # another agent behind the same system prompt and tools, another task: the same boundary, the same start
        body["messages"] = [sysmsg, {"role": "user", "content": "a different task for the sub-agent"}]
        self.assertEqual(self.post("/v1/chat/completions", body)[0], 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.engine.last_sampling["strata_prefix"]["tokens"], n)
        self.assertEqual(self.engine.last_prompt[:n], ids[:n])

    def auto_pin(self, value):
        old = os.environ.get("STRATA_DS4_AUTO_PIN")
        if value is None:
            os.environ.pop("STRATA_DS4_AUTO_PIN", None)
        else:
            os.environ["STRATA_DS4_AUTO_PIN"] = value
        self.addCleanup(lambda: os.environ.pop("STRATA_DS4_AUTO_PIN", None) if old is None
                        else os.environ.__setitem__("STRATA_DS4_AUTO_PIN", old))

    def test_no_shared_start_without_a_system_prompt_or_when_switched_off(self):
        self.start("ok")
        self.auto_pin("1")
        self.chat()
        self.assertNotIn("strata_prefix", self.engine.last_sampling)     # no system message
        body = {"messages": [{"role": "system", "content": "s"}, {"role": "user", "content": "u"}], "max_tokens": 40}
        for off in (None, "0"):                                           # off by default, and when switched off
            self.auto_pin(off)
            self.post("/v1/chat/completions", body)
            self.assertNotIn("strata_prefix", self.engine.last_sampling)

    def test_a_clients_own_prefix_wins(self):
        self.start("ok")
        self.auto_pin("1")
        body = {"messages": [{"role": "system", "content": "s " * 30}, {"role": "user", "content": "u"}],
                "max_tokens": 40, "strata_prefix": {"tokens": 7}}
        self.post("/v1/chat/completions", body)
        self.assertEqual(self.engine.last_sampling["strata_prefix"], {"tokens": 7})

    def test_the_qwen_path_asks_for_no_prefix(self):
        # the same request on a server that is not DeepSeek's: nothing is added (Qwen keeps its own cache logic)
        svc = Service(MockEngine(self.tok, "ok"), self.tok, ChatTemplate(ROOT / "serve" / "chat_template.jinja"))
        req = {}
        svc.prepare([{"role": "system", "content": "s"}, {"role": "user", "content": "u"}], None, {}, 16, req=req)
        self.assertEqual(req, {})


class SlotEnv(unittest.TestCase):
    """The engine's kept conversations: the folder and the switch reach the DeepSeek engine only."""

    KEYS = ("STRATA_DS4_SLOT_KEEP", "STRATA_DS4_SLOT_DIR")

    def env(self, cfg):
        saved = {k: os.environ.pop(k, None) for k in self.KEYS}
        try:
            return server.child_env(cfg)
        finally:
            for k, v in saved.items():
                if v is not None:
                    os.environ[k] = v

    def test_deepseek_gets_a_folder_in_the_data_folder_and_the_default_switch(self):
        env = self.env({"arch": "deepseek41", "log": str(Path("data") / "strata-deepseek.log"), "args": []})
        self.assertEqual(Path(env["STRATA_DS4_SLOT_DIR"]), Path("data") / "ds4-slots")
        self.assertEqual(env["STRATA_DS4_SLOT_KEEP"], "0")
        self.assertEqual(env["STRATA_DS4_SLOT_GB"], "2")

    def test_the_configs_own_settings_win(self):
        env = self.env({"arch": "deepseek41", "log": "x/y.log",
                        "env": {"STRATA_DS4_SLOT_KEEP": "1", "STRATA_DS4_SLOT_DIR": "elsewhere"}})
        self.assertEqual((env["STRATA_DS4_SLOT_KEEP"], env["STRATA_DS4_SLOT_DIR"]), ("1", "elsewhere"))

    def test_other_families_get_nothing(self):
        for arch in ("qwen4exp", None, "gyro"):
            env = self.env({"arch": arch, "log": "x/y.log"} if arch else {"log": "x/y.log"})
            self.assertFalse([k for k in env if k.startswith("STRATA_DS4_")], arch)

class ThinkForever(DsEngine):
    """Thinks without end (random letters) until the thinking is closed in the prompt, then answers."""

    ANSWER = "Four."

    def __init__(self, tok):
        super().__init__(tok, "")
        self.prompts = []

    def generate(self, ids, max_new, sampling, cancel, embeddings=None):
        self.prompts.append(list(ids))
        self.last_prompt = list(ids)
        got = 0
        try:
            if self.tok.decode(list(ids[-14:])).endswith("</think>\n\n"):
                out = self.tok.encode(self.ANSWER) + [EOS]
            else:
                import random
                rng = random.Random(len(ids))          # (no repeated token: the server's loop guard would end it)
                out = self.tok.encode("".join(chr(97 + rng.randrange(26)) for _ in range(max_new)))
            for t in out[:max_new]:
                if cancel.is_set():
                    return
                got += 1
                yield t
        finally:
            self.last = {"generated": got, "prompt_tokens": len(ids), "prompt_ms": 50.0, "decode_ms": got * 10.0,
                         "finish": "stop"}


class SmallCap(ApiBase):
    """A short max_tokens (200-600) with the thinking on: it was all spent on the thinking and no text block came.
    With no budget of the client's own the thinking is capped at half of max_tokens (this family only)."""

    def start_forever(self):
        self.start("")
        engine = ThinkForever(self.tok)
        self.svc.engine = engine
        self.engine = engine
        return engine

    def text_of(self, r):
        return "".join(c.get("text", "") for c in r["content"] if c["type"] == "text")

    def test_every_short_cap_gets_an_answer_on_both_apis(self):
        for cap in (200, 400, 600):
            for api in ("anthropic", "openai"):
                with self.subTest(cap=cap, api=api):
                    self.start_forever()
                    if api == "anthropic":
                        status, r = self.post("/v1/messages", {"model": "x", "max_tokens": cap, "thinking": {"type": "enabled"},
                                                               "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "2+2?"}]})
                        self.assertEqual(status, 200, r)
                        self.assertEqual(self.text_of(r), ThinkForever.ANSWER)
                        self.assertLessEqual(r["usage"]["output_tokens"], cap)
                    else:
                        status, r = self.chat(max_tokens=cap)
                        self.assertEqual(status, 200, r)
                        self.assertEqual(r["choices"][0]["message"]["content"], ThinkForever.ANSWER)
                        self.assertLessEqual(r["usage"]["completion_tokens"], cap)
                    first = self.engine.prompts[0]
                    self.assertEqual(len(self.engine.prompts), 2)          # the thinking was wrapped up, then answered
                    self.assertEqual(len(self.engine.prompts[1]) - len(first), cap // 2 - 0 + len(self.tok.encode(
                        REASONING_WRAP_UP, parse_special=True)))

    def test_thinking_off_is_untouched(self):
        for cap in (200, 400, 600):
            with self.subTest(cap=cap):
                self.start("Plain answer.")
                status, r = self.chat(max_tokens=cap, reasoning_effort="none")
                self.assertEqual(status, 200, r)
                self.assertEqual(r["choices"][0]["message"]["content"], "Plain answer.")
                status, r = self.post("/v1/messages", {"model": "x", "max_tokens": cap, "thinking": {"type": "disabled"},
                                                       "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}]})
                self.assertEqual(self.text_of(r), "Plain answer.")

    def test_a_client_budget_wins(self):
        self.start_forever()
        status, r = self.chat(max_tokens=600, reasoning_budget_tokens=20)
        self.assertEqual(status, 200, r)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.engine.prompts[1]) - len(self.engine.prompts[0]), 20 + len(self.tok.encode(
            REASONING_WRAP_UP, parse_special=True)))

    def test_a_tool_call_under_a_short_cap_still_parses(self):
        for cap in (200, 400, 600):
            with self.subTest(cap=cap):
                self.start("Need it.</think>" + call(("f", [("a", "1", True)])))
                status, r = self.chat(max_tokens=cap, tools=[{"type": "function", "function": {
                    "name": "f", "description": "f", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"a": {"type": "string"}}}}}])
                self.assertEqual(status, 200, r)
                calls = r["choices"][0]["message"]["tool_calls"]
                self.assertEqual(calls[0]["function"]["name"], "f")
                self.assertEqual(json.loads(calls[0]["function"]["arguments"]), {"a": "1"})
                self.assertEqual(len(self.engine.last_prompt) > 0, True)

    def test_the_family_default_thinking_budget(self):
        """DeepSeek-V4.1 only, as Maya ships it: 32768 thinking tokens when neither the request nor the config names a budget."""
        self.start("ok")
        self.assertEqual(self.svc.reasoning_budget({}), 32768)
        self.assertIsNone(self.svc.reasoning_budget({"reasoning_budget_tokens": 0}))        # a request turns it off
        self.assertEqual(self.svc.reasoning_budget({"reasoning_budget_tokens": 50}), 50)    # and its own wins
        self.assertEqual(self.svc.reasoning_budget({"thinking_budget_tokens": 70}), 70)
        self.svc.reasoning_budget_tokens, self.svc.reasoning_budget_configured = 90, True
        self.assertEqual(self.svc.reasoning_budget({}), 90)                                 # the config's wins
        self.svc.reasoning_budget_tokens = 0                                                # the config says none
        self.assertIsNone(self.svc.reasoning_budget({}))
        self.svc.reasoning_budget_configured = False
        self.svc.set_family(None)
        self.assertIsNone(self.svc.reasoning_budget({}))                                    # other families: none

    def test_the_default_budget_closes_a_long_thinking(self):
        self.start_forever()
        status, r = self.chat(max_tokens=5000)
        self.assertEqual(status, 200, r)
        self.assertEqual(r["choices"][0]["message"]["content"], ThinkForever.ANSWER)
        status, r = self.chat(max_tokens=300, reasoning_effort="none")                      # thinking off: no budget, no wrap-up
        self.assertEqual(len(self.engine.prompts), 3)

    def test_other_families_keep_the_old_behaviour(self):
        self.start_forever()
        self.svc.set_family(None)
        status, r = self.chat(max_tokens=300)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.engine.prompts), 1)                       # no wrap-up: Qwen's serving is as it was


class PickTemplateTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """A pack made from another GGUF can ship the V4-Flash template (`tool_calls`, no space): the V4.1 model then
    writes malformed calls (P2003 install test).  The server swaps in the V4.1 template for such a pack."""

    def test_v4flash_pack_template_is_replaced(self):
        import tempfile
        from serve import dsml
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            old = Path(d) / "old.jinja"
            old.write_text("{%- set dsml_token = '｜DSML｜' -%}{{ '<' + dsml_token + 'tool_calls>' }}", encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertEqual(dsml.pick_template(old), (dsml.FIXTURE_TEMPLATE, True))
            same = Path(d) / "same.jinja"
            same.write_text(dsml.FIXTURE_TEMPLATE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertEqual(dsml.pick_template(same), (same, False))
            self.assertEqual(dsml.pick_template(Path(d) / "none.jinja"), (dsml.FIXTURE_TEMPLATE, False))

    def test_fixture_is_accepted(self):
        from serve import dsml
        self.assertTrue(dsml.v41_template_ok(dsml.FIXTURE_TEMPLATE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## serve/test_effort_paths.py

"""serve/test_effort_paths.py - every way a client sets the thinking level reaches the model's prompt (mock engine, no GPU).

The level is nothing but a sentence in the rendered prompt (the template: xhigh / low sentences, none = the empty think
block, medium = no sentence), so "the effort does not work" is always a request form whose level never reached the template.
This pins the prompt each form produces, over the three APIs, the Chat settings shared with apps and the config's
"reasoning_effort" (#1641).  0.1.44.1: the Responses API (/v1/responses, Codex) ignored the config's level.

    python -m unittest serve.test_effort_paths -v
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
import unittest
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from serve.frontend import ChatTemplate  # noqa: E402
from serve.server import ByteTokenizer, MockEngine, Service, serve  # noqa: E402

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
MSG = [{"role": "user", "content": "hello"}]


def level_of(prompt: str) -> str:
    """What the template made of the level: xhigh and low have their sentence, none ends in the empty think block, and
    medium is the prompt with no sentence at all (the model's own wording)."""
    if prompt.rstrip().endswith("</think>"):
        return "none"
    if "Reasoning effort is set to low." in prompt:
        return "low"
    if "Reasoning effort is set to xhigh." in prompt:
        return "xhigh"
    return "medium"


class EffortPaths(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.tok = ByteTokenizer()
        cls.engine = MockEngine(cls.tok, "<think>\nhm\n</think>\n\nok", max_context=8192)
        cls.svc = Service(cls.engine, cls.tok, ChatTemplate(ROOT / "serve/chat_template.jinja"))
        cls.httpd = serve(cls.svc, port=0)
        cls.base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{cls.httpd.server_address[1]}"

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls.httpd.shutdown()
        cls.httpd.server_close()

    def setUp(self):
        self.svc.config_effort = None
        self.svc.shared = {}

    def post(self, path, body):
        req = urllib.request.Request(self.base + path, data=json.dumps(body).encode(),
                                     headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
        self.engine.last_prompt = []
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
                status = r.status
                r.read()
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            with e:
                status = e.code
        return status

    def level(self, path, body):
        status = self.post(path, body)
        self.assertEqual(status, 200, (path, body))
        return level_of(self.tok.decode(self.engine.last_prompt))

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- the request's own level, every spelling
    def test_openai_reasoning_effort(self):
        for given, want in ((None, "xhigh"), ("none", "none"), ("off", "none"), ("minimal", "none"), ("low", "low"),
                            ("medium", "medium"), ("high", "xhigh"), ("xhigh", "xhigh"), ("max", "xhigh"),
                            ("LOW", "low"), (False, "none")):
            body = {"messages": MSG, **({} if given is None else {"reasoning_effort": given})}
            with self.subTest(given=given):
                self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/chat/completions", body), want)

    def test_openai_reasoning_object_and_template_kwargs(self):
        for given, want in (("low", "low"), ("medium", "medium"), ("high", "xhigh"), ("none", "none")):
            with self.subTest(given=given):
                self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/chat/completions", {"messages": MSG, "reasoning": {"effort": given}}), want)
                self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/chat/completions",
                                            {"messages": MSG, "chat_template_kwargs": {"reasoning_effort": given}}), want)
        self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/chat/completions",
                                    {"messages": MSG, "chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": False}}), "none")

    def test_an_unknown_level_is_a_400_not_the_default(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.post("/v1/chat/completions", {"messages": MSG, "reasoning_effort": "huge"}), 400)

    def test_anthropic_output_config_and_thinking(self):
        for given, want in (("low", "low"), ("medium", "medium"), ("high", "xhigh")):
            with self.subTest(effort=given):
                self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/messages", {"messages": MSG, "max_tokens": 50,
                                                             "output_config": {"effort": given}}), want)
        for budget, want in ((500, "low"), (2047, "low"), (2048, "medium"), (8191, "medium"), (8192, "xhigh"), (31999, "xhigh")):
            with self.subTest(budget=budget):
                self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/messages", {"messages": MSG, "max_tokens": 50,
                                                             "thinking": {"type": "enabled", "budget_tokens": budget}}), want)
        self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/messages", {"messages": MSG, "max_tokens": 50, "thinking": {"type": "disabled"}}),
                         "none")
        self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/messages", {"messages": MSG, "max_tokens": 50}), "xhigh")   # nothing asked: it thinks

    def test_responses_reasoning_effort(self):
        for given, want in (("low", "low"), ("medium", "medium"), ("high", "xhigh"), ("none", "none"), ("minimal", "none")):
            with self.subTest(given=given):
                self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/responses", {"input": "hello", "reasoning": {"effort": given}}), want)
        self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/responses", {"input": "hello"}), "xhigh")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- the level of a request that names none
    def test_config_level_reaches_every_api(self):
        for cfg, want in (("low", "low"), ("medium", "medium"), ("high", "xhigh"), ("none", "none")):
            self.svc.config_effort = cfg
            with self.subTest(config=cfg):
                self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/chat/completions", {"messages": MSG}), want)
                self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/messages", {"messages": MSG, "max_tokens": 50}), want)
                self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/responses", {"input": "hello"}), want)      # 0.1.44.1: it ignored the config

    def test_the_requests_own_level_beats_the_config(self):
        self.svc.config_effort = "low"
        self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/chat/completions", {"messages": MSG, "reasoning_effort": "high"}), "xhigh")
        self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/messages", {"messages": MSG, "max_tokens": 50, "output_config": {"effort": "high"}}),
                         "xhigh")
        self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/messages", {"messages": MSG, "max_tokens": 50,
                                                     "thinking": {"type": "enabled", "budget_tokens": 20000}}), "xhigh")
        self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/responses", {"input": "hello", "reasoning": {"effort": "high"}}), "xhigh")
        self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/chat/completions", {"messages": MSG, "reasoning_effort": "none"}), "none")
        self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/chat/completions", {"messages": MSG, "reasoning_effort": False}), "none")

    def test_the_chat_settings_shared_with_apps_beat_the_config(self):
        self.svc.config_effort = "low"
        self.svc.shared = {"reasoning_effort": "high"}
        for path, body in (("/v1/chat/completions", {"messages": MSG}), ("/v1/messages", {"messages": MSG, "max_tokens": 50}),
                           ("/v1/responses", {"input": "hello"})):
            with self.subTest(path=path):
                self.assertEqual(self.level(path, body), "xhigh")
        self.svc.shared = {"reasoning_effort": "none"}
        for path, body in (("/v1/chat/completions", {"messages": MSG}), ("/v1/messages", {"messages": MSG, "max_tokens": 50}),
                           ("/v1/responses", {"input": "hello"})):
            with self.subTest(path=path, shared="none"):
                self.assertEqual(self.level(path, body), "none")

    def test_the_web_apps_request_shape(self):
        # serve/web/app.js: {model, messages, stream, reasoning_effort: settings.thinking} with none / low / medium / high
        for given, want in (("none", "none"), ("low", "low"), ("medium", "medium"), ("high", "xhigh")):
            with self.subTest(given=given):
                self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/chat/completions", {"model": "m", "messages": MSG, "stream": True,
                                                                     "temperature": 0.6, "top_p": 0.95, "top_k": 20,
                                                                     "reasoning_effort": given}), want)

    def test_tools_and_a_system_message_keep_the_level(self):
        tools = [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "f", "description": "d",
                                                    "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {}}}}]
        body = {"messages": [{"role": "system", "content": "be brief"}] + MSG, "tools": tools}
        self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/chat/completions", {**body, "reasoning_effort": "low"}), "low")
        self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/chat/completions", {**body, "reasoning_effort": "high"}), "xhigh")
        self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/chat/completions", {**body, "reasoning_effort": "none"}), "none")

    def test_the_level_follows_a_conversation(self):
        history = MSG + [{"role": "assistant", "content": "hi", "reasoning_content": "greet"},
                         {"role": "user", "content": "and now?"}]
        for given, want in (("low", "low"), ("medium", "medium"), ("none", "none")):
            with self.subTest(given=given):
                self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/chat/completions", {"messages": history, "reasoning_effort": given}), want)


    def test_the_agents_request_shape_with_thinking_off(self):
        """The app's agent (Harness) sends no reasoning_effort when Thinking is Off, only chat_template_kwargs {enable_thinking: false}, with tools, a
        system message, earlier reasoning and a token cap. That one flag must reach the template as the empty think block, whatever else is in the
        request or configured (a thinking model that went on reasoning with the menu on Off was this request form).  The same body with
        enable_thinking true / an effort keeps thinking."""
        tools = [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "pwsh", "description": "d", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {}}}}]
        history = [{"role": "developer", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."}, {"role": "user", "content": "first"},
                   {"role": "assistant", "content": "ok", "reasoning_content": "earlier thoughts"}, {"role": "user", "content": "now?"}]
        agent = {"model": "m", "messages": history, "tools": tools, "stream": True, "stream_options": {"include_usage": True},
                 "max_completion_tokens": 4096}
        for config in (None, "high", "low"):
            self.svc.config_effort = config
            with self.subTest(config=config):
                self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/chat/completions", {**agent, "chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": False}}), "none")
        self.svc.config_effort = None
        self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/chat/completions", {**agent, "chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": True, "reasoning_effort": "low"}}), "low")
        self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/chat/completions", {**agent, "chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": True, "reasoning_effort": "high"}}), "xhigh")
        # the same flag in the plain (no tools) body the direct chat sends alongside a budget
        self.assertEqual(self.level("/v1/chat/completions", {"messages": MSG, "chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": False}, "reasoning_effort": "none"}), "none")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## serve/test_env_to_user.py

"""Config "env_to_user": opencode's <env> block (working directory, date) leaves the system message for the first user
message, so the system turn is the same in every session and the prefix cache keeps it.  Off (the default), nothing moves."""
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

import serve.frontend as fe  # noqa: E402

SYS = ("You are opencode.\n"
       "Here is some useful information about the environment you are running in:\n"
       "<env>\n"
       "  Working directory: C:/a\n"
       "  Today's date: Mon Oct 12 2026\n"
       "</env>\n"
       "Instructions that never change.")


class EnvBlockToUser(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.addCleanup(setattr, fe, "ENV_TO_USER", fe.ENV_TO_USER)

    def convert(self, on, system=SYS, user="hi"):
        fe.ENV_TO_USER = on
        msgs, _, _ = fe.openai_to_messages({"messages": [{"role": "system", "content": system},
                                                         {"role": "user", "content": user}]})
        return msgs

    def test_moved_to_the_first_user_message(self):
        msgs = self.convert(True)
        self.assertEqual(msgs[0]["content"], "You are opencode.\nInstructions that never change.")
        self.assertTrue(msgs[1]["content"].startswith(
            "Here is some useful information about the environment you are running in:\n<env>\n  Working directory: C:/a"))
        self.assertTrue(msgs[1]["content"].endswith("</env>\n\nhi"))

    def test_two_folders_share_the_system_turn(self):
        a = self.convert(True)[0]["content"]
        b = self.convert(True, system=SYS.replace("C:/a", "D:/b"))[0]["content"]
        self.assertEqual(a, b)

    def test_content_parts_get_a_leading_text_part(self):
        fe.ENV_TO_USER = True
        out = fe._env_to_user([{"role": "system", "content": SYS},
                               {"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "image", "image": "x.png"}, {"type": "text", "text": "hi"}]}])
        self.assertEqual(out[1]["content"][0]["type"], "text")
        self.assertIn("<env>", out[1]["content"][0]["text"])
        self.assertEqual(out[1]["content"][1:], [{"type": "image", "image": "x.png"}, {"type": "text", "text": "hi"}])

    def test_text_parts_are_read_as_one_text(self):
        msgs = self.convert(True, user=[{"type": "text", "text": "hi"}])
        self.assertIn("<env>", msgs[1]["content"] if isinstance(msgs[1]["content"], str) else msgs[1]["content"][0]["text"])

    def test_anthropic_requests_too(self):
        fe.ENV_TO_USER = True
        msgs, _, _ = fe.anthropic_to_messages({"system": SYS, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}]})
        self.assertNotIn("<env>", msgs[0]["content"])
        self.assertIn("<env>", msgs[1]["content"])

    def test_off_and_no_block_change_nothing(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.convert(False)[0]["content"], SYS)
        self.assertEqual(self.convert(True, system="Plain system prompt.")[0]["content"], "Plain system prompt.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## serve/test_exif_orientation.py

"""#1229: a phone JPEG stored turned (EXIF Orientation 6 or 8) is turned upright before the vision encoder reads it."""
import io
import unittest

from serve.server import Vision

try:
    from PIL import Image
except ImportError:                 # Pillow is optional: the image then goes through as it was
    Image = None


def jpeg(size, orientation=None) -> bytes:
    im = Image.new("RGB", size, (200, 30, 30))
    exif = Image.Exif()
    if orientation is not None:
        exif[0x0112] = orientation
    out = io.BytesIO()
    im.save(out, format="JPEG", exif=exif)
    return out.getvalue()


@unittest.skipIf(Image is None, "Pillow is not installed")
class ExifOrientation(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_turned_jpeg_comes_out_upright_as_a_png(self):
        for tag in (6, 8):
            out = Vision.normalize(jpeg((40, 20), tag))
            self.assertEqual(out[:8], b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n")
            self.assertEqual(Image.open(io.BytesIO(out)).size, (20, 40))

    def test_a_jpeg_without_the_tag_or_with_tag_1_passes_through_unchanged(self):
        for tag in (None, 1):
            data = jpeg((40, 20), tag)
            self.assertIs(Vision.normalize(data), data)

    def test_png_passes_through(self):
        out = io.BytesIO()
        Image.new("RGB", (4, 4)).save(out, format="PNG")
        self.assertEqual(Vision.normalize(out.getvalue()), out.getvalue())

    def test_a_broken_jpeg_is_left_as_it_was_sent(self):
        data = b"\xff\xd8\xff" + b"not a jpeg"
        self.assertEqual(Vision.normalize(data), data)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## serve/test_family_name.py

"""serve/test_family_name.py - the API's model name per model family (NEW-MODELS-PLAN.md T0): the config's
"model_name" wins; without one, the family's ("arch": qwen4exp -> qwen3.8-flash-next, qwen35moe -> qwen3.6-35b-a3b),
and Flash-Next's for a config that names neither (every config setup wrote before).

    python -m unittest serve.test_family_name
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import unittest

from serve.server import FAMILY_MODEL_NAMES, default_model_name


class FamilyName(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_config_name_wins(self):
        self.assertEqual(default_model_name({"model_name": "qwen3.8-flash-next-q2_0", "arch": "qwen35moe"}),
                         "qwen3.8-flash-next-q2_0")

    def test_per_family(self):
        self.assertEqual(default_model_name({"arch": "qwen35moe"}), "qwen3.6-35b-a3b")
        self.assertEqual(default_model_name({"arch": "qwen4exp"}), "qwen3.8-flash-next")
        self.assertEqual(default_model_name({"arch": "deepseek41"}), "deepseek-v4.1-flash")

    def test_old_configs(self):
        self.assertEqual(default_model_name({}), "qwen3.8-flash-next")
        self.assertEqual(default_model_name({"arch": "something-else"}), "qwen3.8-flash-next")
        self.assertEqual(set(FAMILY_MODEL_NAMES), {"qwen4exp", "qwen35moe", "deepseek41"})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## serve/test_fatal_recovery.py

"""Real pipe/process protocol regression for a native ERR that leaves its process alive."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import time
import unittest
import json
import urllib.request
from serve.server import StrataEngine, Service, ChatTemplate, EngineDied, serve
from serve.test_server import ByteTokenizer

FAKE=r'''
import sys
from pathlib import Path
state=Path(sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--state')+1])
mode=sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--mode')+1]
print('READY 4096 stop',flush=True)
for line in sys.stdin:
 if line.startswith('QUIT'):break
 if line.startswith(('GEN','BGEN')):
  if not state.exists():
   state.write_text('first request was attempted')
   if mode=='invalid':print('ERR prompt exceeds context',flush=True)
   else:
    kind='verify batch' if mode=='batch' else 'verify'
    print(f'ERR {kind}: timed out at layer 18; its GPU waits were released and the GPU finished (#267)',flush=True)
    print('DONE 0 1 0 1 error',flush=True)
   continue
  print('T 90\nDONE 1 1 0 1 stop',flush=True)
'''

class FatalRecovery(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory();self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.root=Path(self.tmp.name);py=self.root/'native.py'
        if os.name=='nt':   # no shebangs on Windows: a .cmd runs the same fake engine
            py.write_text(FAKE);self.script=self.root/'native.cmd'
            self.script.write_text(f'@"{sys.executable}" "{py}" %*\r\n')
        else:
            self.script=py;py.write_text('#!'+sys.executable+'\n'+FAKE);py.chmod(0o700)
    def engine(self,mode='fatal'):
        e=StrataEngine(str(self.script),['--state',str(self.root/'state'),'--mode',mode])
        self.addCleanup(e.close);return e
    def service(self,e):
        return Service(e,ByteTokenizer(),ChatTemplate(Path(__file__).parent/'chat_template.jinja'))
    def wait_dead(self,e):
        end=time.monotonic()+2
        while e.alive() and time.monotonic()<end:time.sleep(.01)
        self.assertFalse(e.alive(),'unrecoverable native ERR must invalidate health before a new request')
    def run_request(self,svc):
        return list(svc.run([1],False,[],8,{},threading.Event()))
    def test_fatal_error_is_not_a_success_and_next_request_reloads(self):
        e=self.engine();svc=self.service(e)
        with self.assertRaises(EngineDied):self.run_request(svc)
        self.wait_dead(e)
        self.assertIs(svc.engine,e,'the failed request must not be retried automatically')
        self.assertEqual(svc.history[-1]['finish'],'error')
        result=self.run_request(svc);self.addCleanup(svc.engine.close)
        self.assertTrue(svc.engine.alive())
        self.assertTrue(svc.loaded());self.assertEqual(result[-1][1]['completion_tokens'],1)
    def test_http_health_and_next_request_recovery(self):
        old=self.engine();svc=self.service(old);http=serve(svc,port=0)
        base=f'http://127.0.0.1:{http.server_address[1]}'
        body={'messages':[{'role':'user','content':'hi'}],'max_tokens':8,
              'chat_template_kwargs':{'enable_thinking':False},'stream':True}
        try:
            def post():
                req=urllib.request.Request(base+'/v1/chat/completions',data=json.dumps(body).encode(),headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
                with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=5) as r:return r.read().decode()
            text=post()
            self.assertIn('"error"',text);self.assertTrue(text.rstrip().endswith('data: [DONE]'))
            with urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/health',timeout=5) as r:self.assertFalse(json.load(r)['loaded'])
            body['stream']=False
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(post())['usage']['completion_tokens'],1)
            with urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/health',timeout=5) as r:self.assertTrue(json.load(r)['loaded'])
        finally:
            http.shutdown();http.server_close();svc.engine.close()
    def test_batch_timeout_signature_also_invalidates_engine(self):
        e=self.engine('batch')
        with self.assertRaises(EngineDied):list(e.generate([1],8,{},threading.Event()))
        self.wait_dead(e)

    def feed(self,e,lines,slots):
        import queue
        class P:
            stdout=iter(lines)
            terminated=False
            def terminate(self):self.terminated=True
        old=e.proc;e.proc=P();e.lines=queue.Queue();e.slot_q=[queue.Queue() for _ in range(slots)];e.ended=False
        e._pump()
        self.assertTrue(e.ended);self.assertTrue(e.proc.terminated)
        self.assertIsNone(e.lines.get_nowait());self.assertTrue(e.lines.empty())   # EOF, never the trailing DONE
        e.proc=old
    def test_fatal_lines_are_checked_before_batch_routing(self):
        e=self.engine('fatal')
        self.feed(e,['ERR verify batch: timed out at layer 3\n','BDONE 0 1 0 1 error\n'],2)
        self.assertTrue(all(q.get_nowait() is None and q.empty() for q in e.slot_q))   # only the EOF reached a slot, not the BDONE
    def test_an_earlier_window_never_finished_is_fatal(self):
        e=self.engine('fatal')
        self.feed(e,['ERR verify: an earlier window never finished on the GPU (#267); restart the engine\n','DONE 0 1 0 1 error\n'],0)
        self.feed(e,['ERR verify batch: an earlier window never finished on the GPU (#267)\n'],2)
    def test_generate_batched_refuses_a_dead_engine(self):
        e=self.engine('fatal');e.close()
        with self.assertRaises(EngineDied):list(e.generate_batched([1],8,{},threading.Event()))

    def test_validation_error_does_not_kill_engine(self):
        e=self.engine('invalid')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):list(e.generate([1],8,{},threading.Event()))
        self.assertTrue(e.alive())
        self.assertEqual(list(e.generate([1],8,{},threading.Event())),[90])
    def test_closed_serial_engine_rejects_without_accessing_closed_pipe(self):
        e=self.engine();e.close()
        with self.assertRaises(EngineDied):list(e.generate([1],8,{},threading.Event()))
if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()


## serve/test_frontend.py

"""Chat history normalization before rendering the model's prompt."""
import copy
from pathlib import Path
import unittest

from serve.frontend import ChatTemplate, anthropic_to_messages, openai_to_messages
from serve.server import ByteTokenizer, MockEngine, Service


class EmptyAssistantHistory(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.template = ChatTemplate(Path(__file__).with_name("chat_template.jinja"))
        tok = ByteTokenizer()
        self.service = Service(MockEngine(tok, "ok"), tok, self.template)

    def test_openai_empty_replies_are_not_rendered(self):
        for content in (None, "", " \n\t", [], [{"type": "text", "text": ""}]):
            for preserve in (True, False):
                with self.subTest(content=content, preserve_thinking=preserve):
                    history = []
                    for _ in range(3):
                        history.extend([{"role": "user", "content": "haz un ls"},
                                        {"role": "assistant", "content": content,
                                         "reasoning_content": "Let me run ls."}])
                    history.append({"role": "user", "content": "haz un ls"})
                    messages, tools, kwargs = openai_to_messages({"messages": history})
                    kwargs["preserve_thinking"] = preserve
                    clean = [m for m in messages if m["role"] == "user"]
                    self.assertEqual(self.service.encode_prompt(messages, tools, kwargs),
                                     self.service.encode_prompt(clean, tools, kwargs))

    def test_anthropic_thinking_only_replies_are_not_rendered(self):
        messages, tools, kwargs = anthropic_to_messages({"messages": [
            {"role": "user", "content": "haz un ls"},
            {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "thinking", "thinking": "Let me run ls."}]},
            {"role": "user", "content": "haz un ls"},
        ]})
        self.assertEqual(self.service.encode_prompt(messages, tools, kwargs),
                         self.service.encode_prompt([messages[0], messages[2]], tools, kwargs))

    def test_text_and_tool_calls_are_kept(self):
        messages, tools, kwargs = openai_to_messages({"messages": [
            {"role": "user", "content": "haz un ls"},
            {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Running ls."}]},
            {"role": "assistant", "content": None, "tool_calls": [
                {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "run", "arguments": '{"command":"ls"}'}},
            ]},
            {"role": "tool", "content": "file.txt"},
            {"role": "user", "content": "thanks"},
        ]})
        before = copy.deepcopy(messages)
        prompt = self.template.render(messages, tools=tools, **kwargs)
        self.assertIn("Running ls.", prompt)
        self.assertIn("<function=run>", prompt)
        self.assertIn("file.txt", prompt)
        self.assertEqual(messages, before)

    def test_image_only_assistant_turn_is_kept(self):
        messages, tools, kwargs = openai_to_messages({"messages": [
            {"role": "user", "content": "describe the image"},
            {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": "image.png"}]},
            {"role": "user", "content": "thanks"},
        ]})
        self.assertIn("<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>",
                      self.template.render(messages, tools=tools, **kwargs))

    def test_final_empty_assistant_turn_is_kept(self):
        prompt = self.template.render([{"role": "user", "content": "hi"},
                                       {"role": "assistant", "content": ""}], add_generation_prompt=False)
        self.assertIn("<|im_start|>assistant\n", prompt)

    def test_empty_user_and_tool_turns_are_kept(self):
        prompt = self.template.render([{"role": "user", "content": ""},
                                       {"role": "tool", "content": ""},
                                       {"role": "user", "content": "hi"}])
        self.assertEqual(prompt.count("<|im_start|>user\n"), 3)
        self.assertIn("<tool_response>\n\n</tool_response>", prompt)


class UnreadContentParts(unittest.TestCase):
    """A content part the server does not read is refused naming it and where it sits, as /v1/responses does; chat
    and messages used to drop it without a word, and the model answered about a file it had never seen."""

    def setUp(self):
        self.template = ChatTemplate(Path(__file__).with_name("chat_template.jinja"))
        tok = ByteTokenizer()
        self.service = Service(MockEngine(tok, "ok"), tok, self.template)

    def test_chat_file_and_audio_parts_are_left_out(self):
        parts = ({"type": "file", "file": {"filename": "a.pdf", "file_data": "data:application/pdf;base64,AA"}},
                 {"type": "input_audio", "input_audio": {"data": "AA", "format": "wav"}})
        plain = [{"role": "user", "content": "summarize"}, {"role": "user", "content": "this one"}]
        for part in parts:
            with self.subTest(kind=part["type"]):
                got = openai_to_messages({"messages": [
                    {"role": "user", "content": "summarize"},
                    {"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "this one"}, part]}]})
                want = openai_to_messages({"messages": [
                    {"role": "user", "content": "summarize"},
                    {"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "this one"}]}]})
                self.assertEqual(got, want)

    def test_messages_blocks_real_clients_send_are_left_out(self):
        # tool_reference (Claude Code's tool search), documents, search results, server tool blocks, signed thinking
        extra = [{"type": "document", "source": {"type": "base64", "media_type": "application/pdf", "data": "AA"}},
                 {"type": "search_result", "source": "s", "title": "t", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "x"}]},
                 {"type": "server_tool_use", "id": "s1", "name": "web_search", "input": {}},
                 {"type": "web_search_tool_result", "tool_use_id": "s1", "content": []},
                 {"type": "container_upload", "file_id": "f"}]
        for block in extra:
            with self.subTest(kind=block["type"]):
                got = anthropic_to_messages({"messages": [
                    {"role": "user", "content": "hi"},
                    {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "ok"}, block]},
                    {"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "go"}, block]}]})
                want = anthropic_to_messages({"messages": [
                    {"role": "user", "content": "hi"},
                    {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "ok"}]},
                    {"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "go"}]}]})
                self.assertEqual(got, want)

    def test_messages_tool_reference_in_a_tool_result_is_left_out(self):
        def run(extra):
            return anthropic_to_messages({"messages": [
                {"role": "user", "content": "find a tool"},
                {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "tool_use", "id": "t1", "name": "ToolSearch", "input": {}}]},
                {"role": "user", "content": [
                    {"type": "tool_result", "tool_use_id": "t1", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "found"}] + extra}]}]})
        self.assertEqual(run([{"type": "tool_reference", "tool_name": "mcp__x"}]), run([]))

    def test_a_system_prompt_with_an_image_part_is_read_as_text_as_before(self):
        got = openai_to_messages({"messages": [
            {"role": "system", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "be brief"},
                                           {"type": "image_url", "image_url": "image.png"}]},
            {"role": "user", "content": "hi"}]})
        self.assertEqual(got[0][0]["content"], "be brief")

    def test_messages_redacted_thinking_is_dropped(self):
        msgs = {"messages": [
            {"role": "user", "content": "haz un ls"},
            {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "redacted_thinking", "data": "ZW50cnk="},
                                              {"type": "text", "text": "Running ls."}]},
            {"role": "user", "content": "thanks"}]}
        without = copy.deepcopy(msgs)
        del without["messages"][1]["content"][0]
        with_block = anthropic_to_messages(msgs)
        without_block = anthropic_to_messages(without)
        self.assertEqual(with_block[0], without_block[0])
        self.assertEqual(self.service.encode_prompt(with_block[0], with_block[1], with_block[2]),
                         self.service.encode_prompt(without_block[0], without_block[1], without_block[2]))

    def test_chat_refusal_part_is_read_as_its_text(self):
        messages, tools, kwargs = openai_to_messages({"messages": [
            {"role": "user", "content": "do a thing"},
            {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "refusal", "refusal": "I cannot do that."}]},
            {"role": "user", "content": "ok"}]})
        self.assertEqual(messages[1]["content"], "I cannot do that.")
        self.assertIn("I cannot do that.", self.template.render(messages, tools=tools, **kwargs))

    def test_text_and_image_requests_render_as_before(self):
        parts = [{"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "haz un ls"}]},
                 {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "file.txt"}]}]
        plain = [{"role": "user", "content": "haz un ls"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "file.txt"}]
        for convert in (openai_to_messages, anthropic_to_messages):
            with self.subTest(convert=convert.__name__):
                self.assertEqual(self.service.encode_prompt(*convert({"messages": parts})),
                                 self.service.encode_prompt(*convert({"messages": plain})))
        chat = openai_to_messages({"messages": [
            {"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "describe"},
                                         {"type": "image_url", "image_url": "image.png"}]}]})
        self.assertIn("<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>",
                      self.template.render(chat[0], tools=chat[1], **chat[2]))
        msgs = anthropic_to_messages({"messages": [
            {"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "describe"},
                                         {"type": "image", "source": {"type": "url", "url": "image.png"}}]}]})
        self.assertIn("<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>",
                      self.template.render(msgs[0], tools=msgs[1], **msgs[2]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

class QuotedToolCallCloser(unittest.TestCase):
    """#2026: a `</tool_call>` a user quotes is text, not the end-of-call token (type 4: matched even without
    parse_special); an assistant message replaying raw call text keeps the model's own tokens."""

    def setUp(self):
        import sys
        sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "tools"))
        import strata_tokenizer as ST
        b2u = ST.bytes_to_unicode()
        self.tool_tags = ["</tool_call>", "<tool_call>", "<tool_response>", "</tool_response>"]
        self.tok = ST.Tokenizer([b2u[b] for b in range(256)] + self.tool_tags + ["<|im_end|>"], [],
                                [1] * 256 + [4] * len(self.tool_tags) + [3])
        self.tags = __import__("serve.frontend", fromlist=["literal_tags"]).literal_tags(self.tok.control_tokens)

    def encode(self, role, text):
        from serve.frontend import mark_think_literals, unmark_think_literals
        marked, _, changed = mark_think_literals([{"role": role, "content": text}], None, self.tags)
        content = marked[0]["content"]
        if isinstance(content, list):
            content = "".join(x["text"] for x in content)
        prompt, plain = unmark_think_literals(content, self.tags)
        return self.tok.encode(prompt, parse_special=True, plain=plain), changed

    def special(self, tag):
        return self.tok.encode(tag, parse_special=True)

    def test_every_tool_tag_a_user_quotes_stays_text(self):
        # 0.1.44: <tool_call>, <tool_response> and </tool_response> are type 4 like </tool_call> (47Hunter47, #2026)
        for role in ("user", "system", "tool"):
            for tag in self.tool_tags:
                with self.subTest(role=role, tag=tag):
                    text = f"output verbatim: {tag}."
                    self.assertEqual(len(self.special(tag)), 1)
                    ids, changed = self.encode(role, text)
                    self.assertTrue(changed)
                    self.assertEqual(ids, [*text.encode()])

    def test_assistant_replay_keeps_every_tool_tag(self):
        text = "<tool_call>x</tool_call> then <tool_response>y</tool_response>"
        ids, _ = self.encode("assistant", text)
        self.assertEqual(ids, self.tok.encode(text, parse_special=True))

    def test_user_tool_result_keeps_its_outer_markers(self):
        # the template tells a tool result sent as a user turn from a question by this outer pair (last_query_index)
        inner = "\nthe log says </tool_call> and <tool_response>\n"
        for content in (f"<tool_response>{inner}</tool_response>", f"  <tool_response>{inner}</tool_response>\n",
                        [{"type": "text", "text": f"<tool_response>{inner}</tool_response>"}],
                        [{"type": "text", "text": "<tool_response>\nthe log"},
                         {"type": "text", "text": " says </tool_call> and <tool_response>\n</tool_response>"}]):
            with self.subTest(content=content):
                ids, _ = self.encode("user", content)
                text = content if isinstance(content, str) else "".join(x["text"] for x in content)
                o, c = self.special("<tool_response>"), self.special("</tool_response>")
                lead = len(text) - len(text.lstrip())
                tail = len(text) - len(text.rstrip())
                self.assertEqual(ids[lead:lead + 1], o)
                self.assertEqual(ids[len(ids) - tail - 1:len(ids) - tail], c)
                middle = ids[lead + 1:len(ids) - tail - 1]
                self.assertEqual(middle, [*inner.encode()])       # the quoted tags inside are text

    def test_a_user_asking_for_a_closer_verbatim_gets_text(self):
        # #2026 (47Hunter47): "</tool_response>" asked verbatim came back 0/15 while it reached the model as the real
        # closer.  The outer-pair exception must not swallow such a request: only a message wholly wrapped in the pair is
        # a tool result.
        for text in ("Please output the following string verbatim: </tool_response>.",
                     "</tool_response>",
                     "Repeat exactly: <tool_response>x</tool_response>",
                     "<tool_response> is how a result opens; what closes it?",
                     "the closer is </tool_response>, then </tool_call>"):
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                ids, changed = self.encode("user", text)
                self.assertTrue(changed)
                self.assertEqual(ids, [*text.encode()])

    def test_template_keeps_seeing_a_tool_result_turn(self):
        from serve.frontend import mark_think_literals
        msgs = [{"role": "user", "content": "q"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "a"},
                {"role": "user", "content": "<tool_response>\nok\n</tool_response>"}]
        marked, _, changed = mark_think_literals(msgs, None, self.tags)
        self.assertTrue(changed)
        self.assertTrue(marked[2]["content"].startswith("<tool_response>"))
        self.assertTrue(marked[2]["content"].endswith("</tool_response>"))
        # a question that only mentions the pair is still marked through
        marked, _, _ = mark_think_literals([{"role": "user", "content": "what is <tool_response>?"}], None, self.tags)
        self.assertNotIn("<tool_response>", marked[0]["content"])

    def test_user_text_stays_text(self):
        text = "output verbatim: </tool_call>."
        ids, changed = self.encode("user", text)
        self.assertTrue(changed)
        self.assertEqual(ids, [*text.encode()])
        self.assertNotEqual(self.tok.encode(text, parse_special=True), ids)     # unmarked, it was the special token

    def test_assistant_replay_keeps_its_token(self):
        text = "<tool_call>x</tool_call>"
        ids, _ = self.encode("assistant", text)
        self.assertEqual(ids, self.tok.encode(text, parse_special=True))


class FencedJsonCallInWrapper(unittest.TestCase):
    """#2037: with recovery on, a declared tool's JSON call in a Markdown fence inside <tool_call> is the call."""
    TOOLS = [{"name": "write_file", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"content": {"type": "string"}}}}]
    PAYLOAD = '{"name": "write_file", "arguments": {"content": "hello `world`"}}'

    def run_parser(self, raw, chunk, stream_tools, recover=True, tools=None):
        from serve.frontend import OutputParser
        p = OutputParser(thinking=False, tools=self.TOOLS if tools is None else tools, recover=recover,
                         stream_tools=stream_tools)
        events = []
        for i in range(0, len(raw), chunk):
            events += p.feed(raw[i:i + chunk])
        events += p.finish()
        return ([e.call.arguments for e in events if e.kind == "tool_call"],
                "".join(e.text for e in events if e.kind == "content"))

    def test_fenced_and_bare_agree(self):
        for fence in ("```json\n", "```\n", "```JSON\r\n"):
            raw = f"<tool_call>\n{fence}{self.PAYLOAD}\n```\n</tool_call>"
            for chunk in (len(raw), 1, 7):
                for st in (False, True):
                    with self.subTest(fence=fence, chunk=chunk, stream_tools=st):
                        self.assertEqual(self.run_parser(raw, chunk, st), ([{"content": "hello `world`"}], ""))

    def test_other_fences_and_prose_stay_text(self):
        raw = "<tool_call>\n```python\nx = 1\n```\n</tool_call>"
        for chunk in (len(raw), 1):
            self.assertEqual(self.run_parser(raw, chunk, False), ([], raw))
        raw = f"Here:\n```json\n{self.PAYLOAD}\n```\n"                 # no wrapper: just text
        self.assertEqual(self.run_parser(raw, len(raw), False), ([], raw))

    def test_off_without_recovery_or_for_an_undeclared_tool(self):
        raw = f"<tool_call>\n```json\n{self.PAYLOAD}\n```\n</tool_call>"
        calls, text = self.run_parser(raw, len(raw), False, recover=False)
        self.assertEqual((calls, text), ([], raw))
        other = [{"name": "other", "parameters": {}}]
        calls, text = self.run_parser(raw, len(raw), False, tools=other)
        self.assertEqual((calls, text), ([], raw))


## serve/test_gpu_roles_server.py

"""serve/server.py: the run settings' "gpu_roles" (Main / Helper / Off) become the engine's card list, Main LAST, Off left out."""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from serve.server import card_roles_lines, child_env, gpu_list, ordered_gpus  # noqa: E402


class Roles(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_roles_alone_give_the_order_main_last_and_off_left_out(self):
        cfg = {"gpu_roles": {"0": "helper", "1": "main", "2": "off"}, "args": []}
        self.assertEqual(gpu_list(cfg), [0, 1])
        self.assertEqual(gpu_list({"gpu_roles": {"0": "main", "1": "helper"}, "args": []}), [1, 0])
        env = child_env({"gpu_roles": {"0": "main", "1": "helper", "2": "off"}, "args": []})
        self.assertEqual(env["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"], "1,0")

    def test_the_mirror_is_used_and_never_re_sorted_by_speed(self):
        cfg = {"gpu_roles": {"0": "main", "1": "helper"}, "gpu": [1, 0], "gpu_order": "as_given", "args": []}
        self.assertEqual(ordered_gpus(cfg, {0: 1.0, 1: 9.0}), [1, 0])             # the faster card is Helper on purpose
        cfg2 = {"gpu_roles": {"0": "main", "1": "helper"}, "gpu": [1, 0], "args": []}      # even without gpu_order
        self.assertEqual(ordered_gpus(cfg2, {0: 1.0, 1: 9.0}), [1, 0])

    def test_one_card_on(self):
        cfg = {"gpu_roles": {"0": "off", "1": "main"}, "gpu": 1, "gpu_order": "as_given", "args": []}
        self.assertEqual(gpu_list(cfg), [1])
        self.assertEqual(child_env(cfg)["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"], "1")

    def test_a_hand_edited_gpu_wins(self):
        cfg = {"gpu_roles": {"0": "helper", "1": "main"}, "gpu": [1, 0], "gpu_order": "as_given", "args": []}
        self.assertEqual(gpu_list(cfg), [1, 0])
        self.assertTrue(any("edited by hand" in l for l in card_roles_lines(cfg)))
        self.assertEqual(ordered_gpus({**cfg, "gpu_order": None}, {0: 1.0, 1: 9.0}), [0, 1])       # the legacy rule again

    def test_bad_roles_are_ignored(self):
        for bad in ({"0": "boss"}, {"0": "main", "1": "main"}, "x", {}):
            self.assertEqual(gpu_list({"gpu_roles": bad, "gpu": 1, "args": []}), [1])

    def test_legacy_settings_are_untouched(self):
        self.assertEqual(gpu_list({"gpu": "0,2", "args": []}), [0, 2])
        self.assertEqual(gpu_list({"args": []}), [])
        self.assertEqual(card_roles_lines({"gpu": [1, 0], "args": []}), [])

    def test_the_log_line_names_every_role(self):
        lines = card_roles_lines({"gpu_roles": {"0": "helper", "1": "main", "2": "off"}, "gpu": [0, 1], "args": []})
        self.assertEqual(lines, ["[strata] card roles: Main GPU 1, Helper GPU 0, Off GPU 2 (numbers as nvidia-smi gives them)"])

    def test_every_card_off(self):
        cfg = {"gpu_roles": {"0": "off", "1": "off"}, "gpu": [], "gpu_none": True, "args": []}
        self.assertEqual(gpu_list(cfg), [])
        env = child_env(cfg)
        self.assertEqual((env["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"], env["HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES"]), ("", ""))
        with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as e:
            card_roles_lines(cfg)                                                   # a CUDA engine cannot start without a card: said plainly
        self.assertIn("Turn a card on", str(e.exception))
        cpu = card_roles_lines({**cfg, "backend": "cpu"})
        self.assertIn("Performance is degraded on CPU only.", cpu[0])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
