    inside = [t for t in ts if lo <= t <= hi]
    gaps = [b - a for a, b in zip(ts, ts[1:]) if b >= lo and a <= hi]
    return {"tokens": len(inside), "max_gap_s": round(max(gaps or [0]), 3), "p99_gap_s": round(pct(gaps, 99), 3),
            "stalled_s": round(sum(g for g in gaps if g > 0.5), 3)}


def scenario(port, model, name, n, joins, max_tokens, tag):
    """`n` streams decode; each join (delay s, size in K tokens) then sends a cold prompt of this repository's text."""
    events, joined = {}, {}

    def decode(i):
        content = "Stream %s-%s-%d. %s" % (tag, name, i, CODING[i % len(CODING)])
        events[i] = stream(port, request(content, max_tokens, model))[0]

    def join(k, delay, size):
        time.sleep(delay)
        text = corpus(int(size * 1024 * 3.3), 7 * size + k + 131 * len(name))
        content = "Join %s-%s-%d.\n%s\nName the file that defines the class above in one line." % (tag, name, k, text)
        ts, _, usage, t0 = stream(port, request(content, 64, model))
        joined[k] = {"sent": t0, "first": ts[0] if ts else None, "usage": usage}

    t0 = time.monotonic()
    threads = [threading.Thread(target=decode, args=(i,)) for i in range(n)]
    threads += [threading.Thread(target=join, args=(k, d, size)) for k, (d, size) in enumerate(joins)]
    for t in threads:
        t.start()
    for t in threads:
        t.join()
    lo = min(v["sent"] for v in joined.values())
    hi = max(v["first"] for v in joined.values()) + 1.0
    per = [smooth(ts, lo, hi) for _, ts in sorted(events.items())]
    ends = [ts[-1] for ts in events.values() if ts]
    joins_in_order = [v for _, v in sorted(joined.items())]
    return {"joiner_ttft_s": [round(v["first"] - v["sent"], 3) for v in joins_in_order],
            "joiner_prompt_tokens": [v["usage"].get("prompt_tokens") for v in joins_in_order],
            "joiner_cached_tokens": [(v["usage"].get("prompt_tokens_details") or {}).get("cached_tokens")
                                     for v in joins_in_order],
            "worst_max_gap_s": max(p["max_gap_s"] for p in per),
            "mean_stalled_s": round(statistics.mean(p["stalled_s"] for p in per), 3),
            "stream_tokens_during_join": sum(p["tokens"] for p in per),
            "aggregate_tok_s": round(sum(len(t) for t in events.values()) / (max(ends) - t0), 1),
            "streams": per}


def alone(port, model, name, size, follow, tag):
    """A cold prompt of `size` K tokens with nothing decoding; with `follow`, a short prompt `follow` s after it."""
    got = {}

    def long_read():
        text = corpus(int(size * 1024 * 3.3), 11 * size + 131 * len(name))
        content = "Read %s-%s.\n%s\nName the file that defines the class above in one line." % (tag, name, text)
        ts, _, usage, t0 = stream(port, request(content, 64, model))
        got["long"] = (t0, ts[0] if ts else None, usage)

    def short():
        time.sleep(follow)
        content = "Follow-up %s-%s: what is 17 x 23? Reply with the number only." % (tag, name)
        ts, _, usage, t0 = stream(port, request(content, 16, model))
        got["short"] = (t0, ts[0] if ts else None, usage)

    threads = [threading.Thread(target=long_read)] + ([threading.Thread(target=short)] if follow else [])
    for t in threads:
        t.start()
    for t in threads:
        t.join()
    out = {"long_ttft_s": round(got["long"][1] - got["long"][0], 3),
           "long_prompt_tokens": got["long"][2].get("prompt_tokens")}
    if follow:
        out["followup_ttft_s"] = round(got["short"][1] - got["short"][0], 3)
        out["followup_prompt_tokens"] = got["short"][2].get("prompt_tokens")
    return out


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8080)
    ap.add_argument("--model", default=None, help="default: the server's own model id")
    ap.add_argument("--streams", type=int, default=4)
    ap.add_argument("--max-tokens", type=int, default=2048)
    ap.add_argument("--scenarios", default="cold32k,cold64k,two_joiners",
                    help="comma-separated: " + ", ".join(SCENARIOS))
    ap.add_argument("--repeat", type=int, default=1, help="runs of each scenario (each with its own cold prompts)")
    ap.add_argument("--out")
    ap.add_argument("--determinism", action="store_true")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    tag = time.strftime("%H%M%S")
    if a.model is None:
        c = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", a.port, timeout=30)
        c.request("GET", "/v1/models")
        a.model = json.loads(c.getresponse().read())["data"][0]["id"]
        c.close()
    if a.determinism:
        rows = []
        for p in DETERMINISM:
            _, text, usage, _ = stream(a.port, request(p, 128, a.model))
            rows.append({"prompt_sha256": hashlib.sha256(p.encode()).hexdigest()[:12],
                         "answer_sha256": hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),
                         "tokens": usage.get("completion_tokens")})
        print(json.dumps(rows, indent=1))
        return
    out = {}
    for rep in range(a.repeat):
        for name in a.scenarios.split(","):
            spec, run_tag = SCENARIOS[name], "%s.%d" % (tag, rep)
            key = name if a.repeat == 1 else "%s#%d" % (name, rep + 1)
            if isinstance(spec, tuple):
                out[key] = alone(a.port, a.model, name, spec[0], spec[1], run_tag)
            else:
                out[key] = scenario(a.port, a.model, name, a.streams, spec, a.max_tokens, run_tag)
            print(json.dumps({"scenario": key, **{k: v for k, v in out[key].items() if k != "streams"}}), flush=True)
            time.sleep(3)
    if a.out:
        Path(a.out).write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


## tools/ple_fp8_pack.py

"""tools/ple_fp8_pack.py - the PLE n-gram table exactly as Qwen shipped it (FP8 E4M3), as a GGUF the engine reads.

    python tools/ple_fp8_pack.py --model <checkpoint dir> --out <ple-fp8.gguf>

Qwen3.8-Flash-Next's checkpoint stores the table as 128 shards `...ngram_embedding.shard_{k}.weight` of
[2500012, 160] F8_E4M3 with one BF16 `weight_scale`: 320,001,536 rows of 160 values, 51.2 GB. The engine used to take
it from ISTA-DASLab's GGUF as IQ4_NL (90 B/row), which is 8% off these values per row; this keeps them bit for bit.

The output is a one-tensor GGUF: `per_layer_token_embd.weight`, ne = [160, 320001536], type I8 holding the FP8 bytes
(GGUF has no FP8 type), with `strata.ple.format` = "f8_e4m3" and `strata.ple.scale` (F32). The bytes are copied
straight out of the safetensors files in shard order - nothing is decoded or rounded - so memory stays flat.
"""
import argparse
import json
import pathlib
import struct
import sys

GGUF_TYPE_STRING, GGUF_TYPE_F32 = 8, 6
GGML_TYPE_I8 = 24
ALIGN = 32
CHUNK = 64 << 20


def safetensors_header(path):
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        n = struct.unpack("<Q", f.read(8))[0]
        return json.loads(f.read(n)), 8 + n


def gguf_string(s):
    b = s.encode("utf-8")
    return struct.pack("<Q", len(b)) + b


def kv_string(key, val):
    return gguf_string(key) + struct.pack("<I", GGUF_TYPE_STRING) + gguf_string(val)


def kv_f32(key, val):
    return gguf_string(key) + struct.pack("<I", GGUF_TYPE_F32) + struct.pack("<f", val)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0])
    ap.add_argument("--model", required=True, help="the checkpoint directory (model.safetensors.index.json)")
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    model, out = pathlib.Path(a.model), pathlib.Path(a.out)
    wmap = json.loads((model / "model.safetensors.index.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["weight_map"]

    shards = {}
    scale_name = None
    for name in wmap:
        if ".ngram_embedding.shard_" in name and name.endswith(".weight"):
            shards[int(name.rsplit(".shard_", 1)[1].split(".")[0])] = name
        elif name.endswith(".ngram_embedding.weight_scale"):
            scale_name = name
    if not shards or scale_name is None:
        sys.exit("no ngram_embedding shards / weight_scale in " + str(model))
    if sorted(shards) != list(range(len(shards))):
        sys.exit("the n-gram shards are not numbered 0..%d without gaps" % (len(shards) - 1))

    hdr, base = safetensors_header(model / wmap[scale_name])
    t = hdr[scale_name]
    if t["dtype"] != "BF16" or t["shape"] not in ([1], []):
        sys.exit("unexpected weight_scale: %s %s" % (t["dtype"], t["shape"]))
    with open(model / wmap[scale_name], "rb") as f:
        f.seek(base + t["data_offsets"][0])
        (bits,) = struct.unpack("<H", f.read(2))
    scale = struct.unpack("<f", struct.pack("<I", bits << 16))[0]

    parts, rows, dim = [], 0, None
    for k in range(len(shards)):
        name = shards[k]
        hdr, base = safetensors_header(model / wmap[name])
        t = hdr[name]
        if t["dtype"] != "F8_E4M3" or len(t["shape"]) != 2:
            sys.exit("%s is %s %s, not a 2-D F8_E4M3 tensor" % (name, t["dtype"], t["shape"]))
        if dim is None:
            dim = t["shape"][1]
        if t["shape"][1] != dim or t["data_offsets"][1] - t["data_offsets"][0] != t["shape"][0] * dim:
            sys.exit("%s: inconsistent shape %s" % (name, t["shape"]))
        parts.append((model / wmap[name], base + t["data_offsets"][0], t["shape"][0] * dim))
        rows += t["shape"][0]
    print("%d shards, %d rows x %d, scale %.9g, %.2f GB" % (len(parts), rows, dim, scale, rows * dim / 1e9), flush=True)

    kvs = [kv_string("general.architecture", "strata-ple"),
           kv_string("general.name", "PLE n-gram table, FP8 E4M3 as shipped"),
           kv_string("strata.ple.format", "f8_e4m3"),
           kv_f32("strata.ple.scale", scale),
           kv_string("strata.ple.source", model.name)]
    head = b"GGUF" + struct.pack("<IQQ", 3, 1, len(kvs)) + b"".join(kvs)
    head += gguf_string("per_layer_token_embd.weight") + struct.pack("<I", 2) + struct.pack("<QQ", dim, rows)
    head += struct.pack("<I", GGML_TYPE_I8) + struct.pack("<Q", 0)
    head += b"\0" * ((-len(head)) % ALIGN)

    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tmp = out.with_suffix(out.suffix + ".part")
    written = 0
    with open(tmp, "wb") as w:
        w.write(head)
        for i, (path, off, n) in enumerate(parts):
            with open(path, "rb") as f:
                f.seek(off)
                left = n
                while left:
                    b = f.read(min(CHUNK, left))
                    if not b:
                        sys.exit("short read in " + str(path))
                    w.write(b)
                    left -= len(b)
            written += n
            if i % 16 == 15 or i == len(parts) - 1:
                print("  %3d/%d shards, %.1f GB" % (i + 1, len(parts), written / 1e9), flush=True)
    if tmp.stat().st_size != len(head) + rows * dim:
        sys.exit("size check failed: %d != %d" % (tmp.stat().st_size, len(head) + rows * dim))
    tmp.replace(out)
    print("wrote %s (%d rows x %d FP8, header %d B)" % (out, rows, dim, len(head)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


## tools/portable_monitor_pty_smoke.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check packaged Monitor detach and terminal restoration on a POSIX PTY.

Run with the Python environment that has the optional Textual dependency.
This exercises an actual terminal session against loopback fake telemetry; it
does not qualify a physical terminal, Windows console or inference engine.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import platform
import pty
import select
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import termios
import threading
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

from portable_monitor_smoke import _server


def _case(bundle: Path, url: str, paths: list[str], key: bytes) -> dict:
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    process = None
    before_count = len(paths)
    try:
        fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack("HHHH", 30, 110, 0, 0))
        before = termios.tcgetattr(slave)
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env["TERM"] = "xterm-256color"
        process = subprocess.Popen(
            [sys.executable, "-I", str(bundle), "monitor", "--url", url,
             "--interval", "0.5", "--glyphs", "ascii"],
            stdin=slave, stdout=slave, stderr=slave, close_fds=True, env=env)
        output = bytearray()
        bytes_read = 0
        sent = False
        active_raw = False
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 12
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            ready, _, _ = select.select([master], [], [], 0.1)
            if ready:
                try:
                    chunk = os.read(master, 65536)
                except OSError:
                    chunk = b""
                bytes_read += len(chunk)
                output.extend(chunk)
                if len(output) > 65536:
                    del output[:-65536]
            if not sent and len(paths) > before_count and b"STRATA" in output:
                active = termios.tcgetattr(slave)
                active_raw = not bool(active[3] & termios.ICANON) and not bool(active[3] & termios.ECHO)
                if active_raw:
                    os.write(master, key)
                    sent = True
            if process.poll() is not None:
                break
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
        exit_code = process.wait(timeout=3)
        restored = termios.tcgetattr(slave) == before
        if exit_code != 0 or not sent or not active_raw or not restored:
            raise RuntimeError(f"PTY detach failed: key={key!r}, exit={exit_code}, "
                               f"sent={sent}, raw={active_raw}, restored={restored}")
        return {"key": "ctrl-c" if key == b"\x03" else "q", "exit_code": exit_code,
                "terminal_went_raw": active_raw, "terminal_restored": restored,
                "telemetry_gets": len(paths) - before_count, "terminal_output_bytes": bytes_read}
    finally:
        if process is not None and process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait(timeout=3)
        os.close(master)
        os.close(slave)


def smoke(bundle: Path) -> dict:
    bundle = bundle.resolve(strict=True)
    server, paths, _ = _server()
    worker = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    worker.start()
    try:
        url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}"
        cases = [_case(bundle, url, paths, key) for key in (b"q", b"\x03")]
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url + "/v1/telemetry", timeout=3) as response:
            server_alive = response.status == 200
    finally:
        server.shutdown()
        server.server_close()
        worker.join(timeout=3)
    if not server_alive or any(path not in ("GET /v1/telemetry", "GET /metrics") for path in paths):
        raise RuntimeError("Monitor detach changed or stopped the telemetry server")
    return {"schema_version": 1, "scope": "portable_monitor_posix_pty_smoke",
            "bundle_sha256": hashlib.sha256(bundle.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            "python": platform.python_version(), "platform": platform.platform(),
            "cases": cases, "server_alive_after_detach": True,
            "http_gets": len(paths), "other_http_methods": 0, "passed": True}


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--bundle", type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--report", type=Path, required=True, help="new absolute JSON report file")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    if os.name != "posix":
        ap.error("this pseudo-terminal check requires a POSIX host")
    if not args.report.is_absolute() or args.report.exists():
        ap.error("--report must be a new absolute file path")
    report = smoke(args.bundle)
    with args.report.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(report, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        stream.write("\n")
    print(json.dumps({"report": str(args.report), "passed": True}))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())


## tools/portable_monitor_smoke.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exercise one portable Monitor bundle with a local fake server.

Run this on each target OS/Python before release. It checks the client and the
local bundle lifecycle. --interactive also checks packaged Textual rendering.
Neither mode exercises the engine or GPU drivers.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import platform
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import time
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path


BUILDER = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "packaging" / "monitor_bundle.py"
INTERACTIVE_CODE = r'''
import asyncio
import io
import json
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
from rich.console import Console
from textual.widgets import Static
from strata_cli.client import Endpoint
from strata_cli.monitor import MonitorApp
from strata_cli.dashboard import render_dashboard
from strata_cli.detail_dashboard import render_detail_dashboard
import strata_cli.monitor as monitor_module

async def main():
    source = str(monitor_module.__file__).replace("\\", "/")
    bundle_path = sys.argv[1].replace("\\", "/")
    if not source.startswith(bundle_path + "/"):
        raise RuntimeError("interactive Monitor was not imported from the bundle")
    app = MonitorApp(Endpoint(sys.argv[2]), None, interval=0.5,
                     theme="dark", color="never", glyphs="ascii")
    async with app.run_test(size=(110, 30)) as pilot:
        for _ in range(30):
            if app.connection_state == "connected":
                break
            await pilot.pause(0.1)
        if app.connection_state != "connected":
            raise RuntimeError("interactive Monitor did not connect")
        output = io.StringIO()
        Console(file=output, width=110, color_system=None).print(
            app.query_one("#content", Static).content)
        shown = output.getvalue()
        if not all(title in shown for title in
                   ("SERVING", "PERFORMANCE", "BATCHING / PARALLEL",
                    "HARDWARE", "REQUESTS", "ACTIVITY")):
            raise RuntimeError("packaged one-screen Overview is incomplete")
        if (app.latest.get("model") or {}).get("id") != "portable-smoke-model":
            raise RuntimeError("interactive Monitor showed the wrong model")
        wide = io.StringIO()
        Console(file=wide, width=140, color_system=None).print(render_dashboard(
            app.latest, width=138, height=42, history=app.history,
            glyphs="ascii", color=False))
        if not all(title in wide.getvalue() for title in
                   ("THROUGHPUT", "GPUS", "CONTEXT / BATCHING", "PARALLEL SLOTS", "REQUESTS")):
            raise RuntimeError("packaged wide visual Overview is incomplete")
        for view, title in (("serving", "REQUEST FLOW"), ("requests", "IN FLIGHT"),
                            ("engine", "STAGES / HOST SPAN"), ("hardware", "GPU CARDS"),
                            ("logs", "RECENT EVENT TIMELINE")):
            detail = io.StringIO()
            Console(file=detail, width=140, color_system=None).print(render_detail_dashboard(
                app.latest, view, width=138, height=42, history=app.history,
                glyphs="ascii", color=False))
            if title not in detail.getvalue():
                raise RuntimeError("packaged visual " + view + " page is incomplete")
        await pilot.press("q")
    print(json.dumps({"connected": True, "overview_panels": 6,
                      "wide_visual": True, "visual_details": 5,
                      "imported_from_bundle": True, "detached": True}))

asyncio.run(main())
'''


def _run(*argv: str) -> dict:
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-S", *argv],
                            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20, check=False)
    if result.returncode or result.stderr.strip():
        raise RuntimeError(f"isolated command failed ({result.returncode}): {result.stderr.strip()}")
    try:
        return json.loads(result.stdout)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise RuntimeError("isolated command did not return one JSON record") from exc


def _server() -> tuple[ThreadingHTTPServer, list[str], threading.Event]:
    paths: list[str] = []
    malformed = threading.Event()

    class TelemetryHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def do_GET(self) -> None:
            paths.append("GET " + self.path)
            if self.path != "/v1/telemetry":
                self.send_error(404)
                return
            body = json.dumps({
                "schema_version": 1, "sampled_at": time.time(),
                "instance": {"id": "portable-smoke", "state": "ready"},
                "model": {"id": "portable-smoke-model", "loaded": True},
                "work": {"active": 0, "queued": 0, "waiting": 0,
                         "slots_requested": 1, "slots_effective": 1, "groups": 1,
                         "slots": [{"slot": 0, "state": "idle", "group": 0}]},
                "topology": {"mode": "single", "selected_devices": []},
                "rates": {"output_tokens_server_counter": 0},
                "devices": [], "quality": {"telemetry": "available"},
            }).encode() if not malformed.is_set() else b"[" * 100000 + b"0" + b"]" * 100000
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)

        def _reject(self) -> None:
            paths.append(self.command + " " + self.path)
            self.send_error(405)

        do_POST = do_PUT = do_PATCH = do_DELETE = do_HEAD = do_OPTIONS = do_TRACE = _reject

        def log_message(self, *args: object) -> None:
            pass

    return ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), TelemetryHandler), paths, malformed


def _malformed_response(bundle: Path, url: str) -> None:
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-S", str(bundle),
                             "status", "--url", url, "--json"],
                            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20, check=False)
    if result.returncode != 3 or result.stderr:
        raise RuntimeError("deeply nested telemetry escaped the client error boundary")
    try:
        response = json.loads(result.stdout)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise RuntimeError("malformed telemetry did not return one JSON error") from exc
    if (response.get("ok") is not False or
            (response.get("error") or {}).get("message") != "server returned malformed JSON telemetry"):
        raise RuntimeError("deeply nested telemetry returned an unexpected error")


def _interactive(bundle: Path, url: str) -> dict:
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-c", INTERACTIVE_CODE, str(bundle), url],
                            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20, check=False)
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(f"packaged interactive Monitor failed ({result.returncode}): "
                           f"{result.stderr.strip()[-2000:]}")
    try:
        report = json.loads(result.stdout)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise RuntimeError("interactive Monitor did not return one JSON record") from exc
    if report != {"connected": True, "overview_panels": 6, "wide_visual": True,
                  "visual_details": 5,
                  "imported_from_bundle": True, "detached": True}:
        raise RuntimeError("packaged interactive Monitor smoke was incomplete")
    return report


def smoke(bundle: Path, *, interactive: bool = False) -> dict:
    bundle = bundle.resolve(strict=True)
    manifest = _run(str(BUILDER), "verify", str(bundle))
    expected_sha = hashlib.sha256(bundle.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if manifest.get("sha256") != expected_sha:
        raise RuntimeError("bundle digest changed after verification")

    server, paths, malformed = _server()
    worker = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    worker.start()
    try:
        url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}"
        one_shot = _run(str(bundle), "monitor", "--url", url, "--once", "--json")
        if (one_shot.get("ok") is not True or
                (one_shot.get("snapshot") or {}).get("model", {}).get("id") != "portable-smoke-model"):
            raise RuntimeError("one-shot monitor returned the wrong model or failed")

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="strata-portable-smoke-") as scratch:
            target = Path(scratch) / "monitor"
            preview = _run(str(BUILDER), "install", str(bundle), "--target", str(target), "--plan")
            if preview.get("sha256") != expected_sha or preview.get("would_install") is not True:
                raise RuntimeError("bundle install preview did not bind the candidate digest")
            installed = _run(str(BUILDER), "install", str(bundle), "--target", str(target),
                             "--if-candidate-sha256", expected_sha)
            if installed.get("installed") is not True:
                raise RuntimeError("bundle install did not complete")
            installed_bundle = target / bundle.name
            _run(str(BUILDER), "verify", str(installed_bundle))
            status = _run(str(installed_bundle), "status", "--url", url, "--json")
            if (status.get("ok") is not True or
                    (status.get("snapshot") or {}).get("instance", {}).get("id") != "portable-smoke"):
                raise RuntimeError("installed client did not reach the fake server")
            removal = _run(str(BUILDER), "uninstall", "--target", str(target), "--plan")
            if removal.get("sha256") != expected_sha or removal.get("would_remove") is not True:
                raise RuntimeError("bundle removal preview did not bind the installed digest")
            removed = _run(str(BUILDER), "uninstall", "--target", str(target),
                           "--if-active-sha256", expected_sha)
            if removed.get("removed") is not True or target.exists():
                raise RuntimeError("bundle uninstall left an installed directory")
        malformed.set()
        _malformed_response(bundle, url)
        malformed.clear()
        interactive_report = _interactive(bundle, url) if interactive else None
    finally:
        server.shutdown()
        server.server_close()
        worker.join(timeout=5)

    if (paths[:2] != ["GET /v1/telemetry", "GET /v1/telemetry"] or
            any(path not in ("GET /v1/telemetry", "GET /metrics") for path in paths) or     # the interactive Overview also reads /metrics (404 here: it keeps the earlier Overview)
            (interactive and len(paths) < 4) or (not interactive and len(paths) != 3)):
        raise RuntimeError(f"unexpected client HTTP operations: {paths}")
    report = {"schema_version": 1, "scope": "portable_monitor_stdlib_smoke",
            "bundle_sha256": expected_sha, "python": platform.python_version(),
            "platform": platform.platform(), "isolated_no_site_packages": True,
            "one_shot_monitor": True, "installed_status": True,
            "digest_pinned_install_uninstall": True,
            "deep_json_error": True,
            "http_gets": len(paths),
            "other_http_methods": 0, "passed": True}
    if interactive_report is not None:
        report["interactive"] = interactive_report
    return report


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--bundle", type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--report", type=Path, required=True,
                    help="new absolute JSON report file")
    ap.add_argument("--interactive", action="store_true",
                    help="also load the packaged Textual Overview in a headless terminal")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    if not args.report.is_absolute() or args.report.exists():
        ap.error("--report must be a new absolute file path")
    report = smoke(args.bundle, interactive=args.interactive)
    with args.report.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(report, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        stream.write("\n")
    print(json.dumps({"report": str(args.report), "passed": True}))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())


## tools/q8_dense_gguf.py

"""tools/q8_dense_gguf.py - a copy of a model whose natively served dense projections and head are Q8_0, for the
Pascal GP100 decode kernel (STRATA_Q8_SM60=1, docs/OLDER_GPUS.md).

The GSQ-RCO packs keep those matrices in K- and i-quants (Q6_K, IQ4_XS, Q4_K, IQ3_S, Q5_K, Q2_0, IQ4_NL), whose
decode is what a GP100 die is slowest at; STRATA_Q8_SM60 only runs Q8_0 matrices. Every shard of the model is
handled, because a model may keep dense matrices in more than one (Swift 1.5 IQ3_XXS: 78 in shard 1, 223 in
shard 2). A shard that holds any of them is written as:

  * the tensor-info block with the SAME byte length: names and dims are unchanged, only the u32 type and the u64
    offset of each converted tensor change, so the data section starts where it did and every other tensor - the
    routed experts above all - keeps its absolute offset. An existing native pack (its native_experts.txt) stays
    valid; nothing is repacked.
  * the original data section, then each converted tensor's Q8_0 blocks appended (the old bytes stay, unused).
    Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_XXS: 301 tensors, +3.5 GiB, the worst requantization error 0.41% of a tensor's |w|max
    (Q8_0 is finer than every source format).

A shard that holds none is hard-linked into the output folder (--copy copies it): the engine finds the shards beside
--native, so --native and --ple-gguf must both name files in the new folder (it refuses two shard 2s).

    python tools/q8_dense_gguf.py <folder>/<model>-00001-of-00002.gguf <new folder> [--copy]

Any shard of the model may be named. Then point the config's --native and --ple-gguf at the new folder and run the
engine with STRATA_Q8_SM60=1.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
import re
import shutil
import struct
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import _paths  # noqa: E402

_paths.add_gguf_py()
from gguf import GGUFReader, GGMLQuantizationType as QT  # noqa: E402
from gguf.quants import dequantize, quantize  # noqa: E402
from gguf_writer import dequantize_q2_0  # noqa: E402

# what src/core/native_dense.cpp serves natively (eligible()), and the head
SUFFIXES = (".attn_qkv.weight", ".attn_gate.weight", ".ssm_out.weight", ".attn_q.weight", ".attn_k.weight",
            ".attn_v.weight", ".attn_output.weight", ".ffn_gate_shexp.weight", ".ffn_up_shexp.weight",
            ".ffn_down_shexp.weight")
Q2_0 = 42   # GSQ's 2-bit type: gguf-py has no member for it


def is_target(name: str) -> bool:
    return name == "output.weight" or (name.startswith("blk.") and name.endswith(SUFFIXES))


def to_f32(t) -> np.ndarray:
    ne0, ne1 = int(t.shape[0]), int(t.shape[1])
    raw = np.asarray(t.data)
    if int(t.tensor_type) == Q2_0:
        return np.asarray(dequantize_q2_0(raw.tobytes()), dtype=np.float32).reshape(ne1, ne0)
    return np.asarray(dequantize(raw, t.tensor_type), dtype=np.float32).reshape(ne1, ne0)


def shards_of(path: Path) -> list[Path]:
    """Every shard of the model `path` belongs to (just `path` for an unsplit file)."""
    m = re.match(r"(.*-)(\d{5})-of-(\d{5})(\.gguf)$", path.name)
    if not m:
        return [path]
    return [path.parent / f"{m[1]}{k:05d}-of-{m[3]}{m[4]}" for k in range(1, int(m[3]) + 1)]


def jobs_of(r) -> list:
    """The shard's convertible tensors and where each one's type/offset fields sit in its tensor-info block."""
    data_start, mm, jobs = r.data_offset, r.data, []
    for t in r.tensors:
        if not is_target(t.name) or int(t.tensor_type) == int(QT.Q8_0):
            continue
        p = t.field.offset                                   # the tensor-info entry: name, n_dims, dims, type, offset
        nlen = struct.unpack_from("<Q", mm, p)[0]; p += 8
        assert bytes(mm[p:p + nlen]).decode() == t.name; p += nlen
        ndim = struct.unpack_from("<I", mm, p)[0]; p += 4 + 8 * ndim
        ttype, toff = struct.unpack_from("<IQ", mm, p)
        assert ttype == int(t.tensor_type) and data_start + toff == t.data_offset, t.name
        if int(t.shape[0]) % 32:
            print(f"  {t.name}: rows of {int(t.shape[0])} are not whole Q8_0 blocks, kept")
            continue
        jobs.append((t, p))
    return jobs


def convert(src: Path, dst: Path, r, jobs) -> int:
    t0 = time.time()
    align, data_start, src_size = r.alignment, r.data_offset, os.path.getsize(src)
    blobs, worst = [], 0.0
    for t, p in jobs:
        f = to_f32(t)
        q = np.ascontiguousarray(quantize(f, QT.Q8_0)).view(np.uint8).reshape(-1)
        assert q.nbytes == int(t.shape[0]) // 32 * 34 * int(t.shape[1]), t.name
        back = dequantize(q, QT.Q8_0).reshape(f.shape)
        worst = max(worst, float(np.abs(back - f).max() / max(float(np.abs(f).max()), 1e-30)))
        blobs.append((t, p, q))
    print(f"  converted in {time.time() - t0:.0f} s; worst requantization error {worst:.2e} of a tensor's |w|max; "
          f"{sum(b[2].nbytes for b in blobs) / 2**30:.2f} GiB to append", flush=True)

    tmp = dst.with_name(dst.name + ".part")
    shutil.copyfile(src, tmp)
    with open(tmp, "r+b") as fh:
        end = src_size
        for t, p, blob in blobs:
            at = (end + align - 1) // align * align
            fh.seek(end); fh.write(b"\0" * (at - end))
            fh.seek(at); fh.write(blob.tobytes())
            end = at + blob.nbytes
            fh.seek(p); fh.write(struct.pack("<IQ", int(QT.Q8_0), at - data_start))
        fh.flush(); os.fsync(fh.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp, dst)

    v = GGUFReader(dst)                                      # every other tensor where it was, every new one as written
    conv = {t.name: blob for t, _, blob in blobs}
    orig = {t.name: t for t in r.tensors}
    assert len(v.tensors) == len(r.tensors) and v.data_offset == data_start
    for t in v.tensors:
        if t.name in conv:
            assert t.tensor_type == QT.Q8_0 and np.array_equal(np.asarray(t.data).view(np.uint8).reshape(-1), conv[t.name]), t.name
        else:
            assert t.tensor_type == orig[t.name].tensor_type and t.data_offset == orig[t.name].data_offset, t.name
    print(f"  wrote {dst} ({os.path.getsize(dst) / 2**30:.2f} GiB): {len(conv)} converted, {len(v.tensors) - len(conv)} "
          "untouched, offsets checked", flush=True)
    return len(conv)


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0])
    ap.add_argument("shard", type=Path, help="any GGUF shard of the model (or the model's only file)")
    ap.add_argument("out_dir", type=Path, help="folder for the converted shards and the others' links")
    ap.add_argument("--copy", action="store_true", help="copy the shards with nothing to convert instead of linking them")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    out = a.out_dir.resolve()
    shards = shards_of(a.shard.resolve())
    if out == shards[0].parent:
        sys.exit("the output folder must not be the model's own folder")
    missing = [s for s in shards if not s.is_file()]
    if missing:
        sys.exit(f"missing shard(s): {', '.join(str(s) for s in missing)}")
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    total = 0
    for src in shards:
        dst = out / src.name
        r = GGUFReader(src)
        jobs = jobs_of(r)
        print(f"{src.name}: {len(r.tensors)} tensors, {len(jobs)} to convert to Q8_0", flush=True)
        if jobs:
            total += convert(src, dst, r, jobs)
            continue
        if dst.exists():
            dst.unlink()                                     # a link or copy from an earlier run
        if a.copy:
            shutil.copyfile(src, dst)
        else:
            os.link(src, dst)
        print(f"  {'copied' if a.copy else 'linked'} (nothing to convert)", flush=True)
    print(f"{total} tensors converted over {len(shards)} shard(s) in {out}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())


## tools/quant_bound.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Decode bounds of a quant from its real per-layer formats (tools/quant_formats.py --json output).

    python tools/quant_bound.py FMT.json [...] --ram-gbs 120 [--vram-gbs 640] [--hit 0.3] [--tokens-per-pass 1]

Per token: the routed experts (10 of 512 per layer: each layer's gate + up + down bytes / 512 x 10), the shared expert
and the dense side (attention, SSM, hyper-connections, router, head: read once per pass on the GPU).  The bound for a
pass of P tokens (a verify window) with a VRAM hit fraction h of the routed experts:
    t_cpu = (1 - h) x routed bytes x U(P) / RAM bandwidth      (the CPU pool reads every missed expert once per pass)
    t_gpu = (h x routed x U(P) + dense) / VRAM bandwidth
    tok/s <= P / max(t_cpu, t_gpu)
U(P) is the distinct experts a pass of P tokens reads per expert a single token reads (1 for P = 1; measured from
the engine's window logs where known, else --union).  The CPU line alone (h = 0) is the floor of the all-on-CPU case.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import pathlib

TOPK, N_EXPERT = 10, 512


def bytes_of(js: dict) -> dict:
    roles = js["roles"]
    tot = lambda role: sum(v["bytes"] for v in roles.get(role, {}).values())
    routed_all = tot("routed gate") + tot("routed up") + tot("routed down")
    per_token = routed_all / N_EXPERT * TOPK
    dense = sum(tot(r) for r in ("shared expert", "router", "attention", "SSM", "hyper-connections", "indexer",
                                 "PLE key/value", "output head"))
    return {"routed_all": routed_all, "routed_per_token": per_token, "dense_per_pass": dense,
            "expert_bytes": routed_all / 48 / N_EXPERT}


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("fmt", nargs="+")
    ap.add_argument("--ram-gbs", type=float, required=True, help="measured RAM read bandwidth, GB/s")
    ap.add_argument("--vram-gbs", type=float, default=0, help="GPU memory bandwidth, GB/s (0: no GPU line)")
    ap.add_argument("--hit", type=float, default=0.0, help="VRAM hit fraction of the routed experts")
    ap.add_argument("--tokens-per-pass", type=float, default=1.0)
    ap.add_argument("--union", type=float, default=1.0, help="distinct experts per pass / experts per token")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    print(f"{'quant':12s} {'expert MB':>9s} {'routed MB/tok':>13s} {'dense MB':>9s} {'CPU-only tok/s':>15s} "
          f"{'bound tok/s':>11s}")
    for f in a.fmt:
        b = bytes_of(json.loads(pathlib.Path(f).read_text()))
        r = b["routed_per_token"] * a.union
        t_cpu = (1 - a.hit) * r / (a.ram_gbs * 1e9)
        t_gpu = (a.hit * r + b["dense_per_pass"]) / (a.vram_gbs * 1e9) if a.vram_gbs else 0.0
        cpu_only = 1 / (b["routed_per_token"] / (a.ram_gbs * 1e9))
        bound = a.tokens_per_pass / max(t_cpu, t_gpu) if max(t_cpu, t_gpu) > 0 else float("inf")
        print(f"{pathlib.Path(f).stem:12s} {b['expert_bytes'] / 1e6:9.2f} {b['routed_per_token'] / 1e6:13.1f} "
              f"{b['dense_per_pass'] / 1e6:9.1f} {cpu_only:15.1f} {bound:11.1f}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())


## tools/quant_formats.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Per-layer tensor formats of a (sharded) GGUF, read from the headers only (docs/QUANTS.md).

    python tools/quant_formats.py PATH-OR-GLOB [...]           local shards (any shard; all are read)
    python tools/quant_formats.py --hf REPO REV DIR [--json OUT] Hugging Face: HTTP range requests on each shard's
                                                                header, nothing else is downloaded

Prints, per role (routed gate / up / down, shared expert, attention, SSM, hyper-connections, indexer, PLE, embedding,
head): the formats and the layers each one covers, and the bytes; then the routed experts layer by layer.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import glob
import io
import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys
import urllib.request

sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import gguf_reader as G  # noqa: E402

ROLES = [
    ("routed gate", r"ffn_gate_exps"), ("routed up", r"ffn_up_exps"), ("routed down", r"ffn_down_exps"),
    ("shared expert", r"ffn_(gate|up|down)_shexp\.weight"), ("router", r"ffn_gate_inp"),
    ("attention", r"attn_(q|k|v|qkv|gate|output)\.weight"), ("SSM", r"ssm_(alpha|beta|out)\.weight"),
    ("hyper-connections", r"hc_(attn|ffn)_(up|down|inject)\.weight"), ("indexer", r"indexer\.(q|k)_proj"),
    ("PLE key/value", r"ple_(key|value)\.weight"), ("PLE table", r"^per_layer_token_embd"),
    ("token embedding", r"^token_embd"), ("output head", r"^output(_hc_(up|down))?\.weight"),
]


class RangeFile(io.RawIOBase):
    """A read-only, forward-reading file over HTTP range requests (4 MiB at a time)."""

    CHUNK = 4 << 20

    def __init__(self, url: str):
        self.url, self.pos, self.buf, self.buf_at = url, 0, b"", 0

    def _fill(self, need_to: int) -> None:
        while self.buf_at + len(self.buf) < need_to:
            start = self.buf_at + len(self.buf)
            req = urllib.request.Request(self.url, headers={"Range": f"bytes={start}-{start + self.CHUNK - 1}"})
            data = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120).read()
            if not data:
                raise EOFError(self.url)
            self.buf += data

    def read(self, n: int = -1) -> bytes:
        self._fill(self.pos + n)
        off = self.pos - self.buf_at
        out = self.buf[off:off + n]
        self.pos += len(out)
        return out

    def tell(self) -> int:
        return self.pos


class Header(G.GGUFFile):
    def __init__(self, name: str, fh):  # noqa: D107 (reuses GGUFFile's parser on any file-like)
        self.path = pathlib.Path(name)
        self.metadata, self.tensors, self.version, self.alignment = {}, [], 0, 32
        self._parse(fh)


def hf_headers(repo: str, rev: str, d: str) -> list[Header]:
    tree = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(f"https://huggingface.co/api/models/{repo}/tree/{rev}/{d}", timeout=60))
    out = []
    for e in sorted(tree, key=lambda e: e["path"]):
        if e["type"] == "file" and e["path"].endswith(".gguf"):
            url = f"https://huggingface.co/{repo}/resolve/{rev}/{e['path']}"
            out.append(Header(e["path"], RangeFile(url)))
    return out


def ranges(layers: list[int]) -> str:
    layers = sorted(layers)
    out, i = [], 0
    while i < len(layers):
        j = i
        while j + 1 < len(layers) and layers[j + 1] == layers[j] + 1:
            j += 1
        out.append(str(layers[i]) if i == j else f"{layers[i]}-{layers[j]}")
        i = j + 1
    return ", ".join(out)


def summarize(heads: list[Header]) -> dict:
    roles: dict[str, dict[str, dict]] = {}
    per_layer: dict[int, dict[str, str]] = {}
    for h in heads:
        for t in h.tensors:
            m = re.match(r"blk\.(\d+)\.", t.name)
            layer = int(m.group(1)) if m else -1
            for role, pat in ROLES:
                if re.search(pat, t.name):
                    r = roles.setdefault(role, {}).setdefault(t.type_name, {"layers": set(), "bytes": 0, "n": 0})
                    r["layers"].add(layer)
                    r["bytes"] += t.expected_bytes() or 0
                    r["n"] += 1
                    if role.startswith("routed"):
                        per_layer.setdefault(layer, {})[role.split()[1]] = t.type_name
                    break
    return {"roles": roles, "per_layer": per_layer}


def render(name: str, s: dict) -> str:
    lines = [f"### {name}", "", "| Role | Format | Layers | Tensors | GiB |", "|---|---|---|---:|---:|"]
    for role, _ in ROLES:
        for ty, r in sorted(s["roles"].get(role, {}).items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]["bytes"]):
            lay = "-" if r["layers"] == {-1} else ranges([x for x in r["layers"] if x >= 0])
            lines.append(f"| {role} | {ty} | {lay} | {r['n']} | {r['bytes'] / 2**30:.2f} |")
    exp = sum(r["bytes"] for role in ("routed gate", "routed up", "routed down")
              for r in s["roles"].get(role, {}).values())
    lines += ["", f"Routed experts: {exp / 2**30:.1f} GiB.", ""]
    combos: dict[tuple, list[int]] = {}
    for layer, d in s["per_layer"].items():
        combos.setdefault((d.get("gate"), d.get("up"), d.get("down")), []).append(layer)
    lines += ["| Routed gate / up / down | Layers |", "|---|---|"]
    for (g, u, dn), lay in sorted(combos.items(), key=lambda kv: -len(kv[1])):
        lines.append(f"| {g} / {u} / {dn} | {ranges(lay)} |")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("paths", nargs="*")
    ap.add_argument("--hf", nargs=3, metavar=("REPO", "REV", "DIR"))
    ap.add_argument("--name")
    ap.add_argument("--json")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    if a.hf:
        heads = hf_headers(*a.hf)
        name = a.name or a.hf[2]
    else:
        files = sorted({p for g in a.paths for p in glob.glob(g)})
        heads = [G.GGUFFile(pathlib.Path(p)) for p in files]
        name = a.name or (pathlib.Path(files[0]).parent.name if files else "?")
    s = summarize(heads)
    sys.stdout.write(render(name, s))
    if a.json:
        js = {"roles": {r: {t: {"layers": sorted(v["layers"]), "bytes": v["bytes"], "n": v["n"]}
                            for t, v in d.items()} for r, d in s["roles"].items()},
              "per_layer": {str(k): v for k, v in sorted(s["per_layer"].items())}}
        pathlib.Path(a.json).write_text(json.dumps(js, indent=1))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())


## tools/quant_quality.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The quant quality yardstick (MODEL-UPDATE.md, Phase 0): teacher-forced top-1 agreement and KL of a quant against
Q8_0, on one fixed text set (data/quant_quality/v1: code, docs, English, other languages, an agent transcript).

    python tools/quant_quality.py ids --tokenizer DIR [--set data/quant_quality/v1] [--out set.ids.json]
        tokenizes the set (each segment cut to --seg-tokens, default 1000) - the ids file is committed with the set
        (data/quant_quality/v1/set.ids.json), so a box without the tokenizer scores the same positions
    python tools/quant_quality.py run --config CFG.json --out RUN.tsv [--ids set.ids.json] [--env K=V ...] [--gpu-experts]
        one `strata --serve` engine (the config's exe and args), every segment one request whose tokens are all read
        through the decode windows (--short-read), where STRATA_LOGPOS / STRATA_LOGPOS_TOPK=64 write, per position,
        the log-probability of the text's next token and the 64 most likely tokens.  Fixed: the experts on the CPU
        (one VRAM slot, --expert-cache 1: the verify windows need a profile-filled tier, so the config must have
        --expert-profile; --gpu-experts: 1500 slots), no expert adaptation, no PCIe share, no suffix drafts, no prompt
        cache, FP16 K/V, STRATA_ROUTE_TAIL_SKIP=0, STRATA_PREFILL_CPU_SHARE=0.  RUN.tsv + RUN.tsv.seg.json (line ranges).
    python tools/quant_quality.py compare REF.tsv RUN.tsv [...]   (REF = the Q8_0 run)
        per segment and overall: top-1 agreement (same argmax), mean / p99 KL(REF || RUN) over REF's 64 most likely
        tokens (both renormalized to that set; a token RUN does not list gets RUN's 64th log-probability), and the
        perplexity of the text under each.

The RUN.tsv rows are the engine's STRATA_LOGPOS format: pos, target id, logp(target), argmax id, logp(argmax),
argmax==target, logp(<|im_end|>), logp(target without <|im_end|>), then 64 `id:logp` fields (natural log).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import os
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import time

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SET_DIR = HERE.parent / "data" / "quant_quality" / "v1"
SEGMENTS = ["code", "docs", "english", "multilingual", "agent"]
TOPK = 64
FIXED = ["--expert-cache", "1", "--adapt-every", "100000", "--pcie-frac", "0", "--suffix-draft", "0",
         "--prompt-cache", "0", "--kv", "fp16"]
FIXED_ENV = {"STRATA_ROUTE_TAIL_SKIP": "0", "STRATA_PREFILL_CPU_SHARE": "0", "STRATA_PCIE_FRAC_DEFAULT": "old"}
# config args the yardstick replaces (value-taking) or drops (flags)
DROP_VALUE = {"--expert-cache", "--adapt-every", "--pcie-frac", "--suffix-draft", "--prompt-cache", "--max-context",
              "--prefill", "--prompt-cache-every", "--short-read", "--conversation-cache-mib", "--eos-ids",
              "--kv", "--kv-resident"}   # (--resident-budget-gib stays: a PC whose RAM does not hold the experts)
DROP_FLAG = {"--serve", "--vision", "--resident-experts", "--resident-cpu-experts"}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ids
def cmd_ids(a) -> int:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
    import strata_tokenizer as ST  # noqa: E402
    tp = pathlib.Path(a.tokenizer)
    vocab = json.loads((tp / "vocab.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    toks = [None] * len(vocab)
    for t, i in vocab.items():
        toks[i] = t
    tok = ST.Tokenizer(toks, (tp / "merges.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").split("\n"),
                       json.loads((tp / "token_type.json").read_text()))
    segs = []
    for name in SEGMENTS:
        text = (pathlib.Path(a.set) / f"{name}.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        ids = tok.encode(text, parse_special=(name == "agent"))
        if len(ids) < a.seg_tokens:
            raise SystemExit(f"{name}: only {len(ids)} tokens (< {a.seg_tokens})")
        segs.append({"name": name, "ids": ids[:a.seg_tokens]})
        print(f"{name}: {len(ids)} tokens, kept {a.seg_tokens}")
    out = pathlib.Path(a.out or (pathlib.Path(a.set) / "set.ids.json"))
    out.write_text(json.dumps({"version": pathlib.Path(a.set).name, "seg_tokens": a.seg_tokens, "segments": segs}))
    print(f"wrote {out}")
    return 0


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ run
def mem_available_gb() -> float:
    try:
        for line in open("/proc/meminfo"):
            if line.startswith("MemAvailable:"):
                return int(line.split()[1]) / 1048576
    except OSError:
        pass
    return float("inf")


def engine_args(cfg: dict, gpu_experts, seg_tokens: int) -> list[str]:
    base, out, i = list(cfg["args"]), [], 0
    while i < len(base):
        x = base[i]
        if x in DROP_FLAG:
            i += 1
            continue
        if x in DROP_VALUE:
            i += 2
            continue
        out.append(x)
        i += 1
    fixed = list(FIXED)
    if gpu_experts:
        fixed[1] = gpu_experts if isinstance(gpu_experts, str) else "1500"
    return [cfg["exe"], "--serve", *out, *fixed, "--max-context", str(seg_tokens + 512),
            "--short-read", str(seg_tokens + 64), "--prefill", "512"]


def cmd_run(a) -> int:
    cfg = json.load(open(a.config, encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    st = json.load(open(a.ids))
    out = pathlib.Path(a.out).resolve()
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if out.exists():
        out.unlink()
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env.update(cfg.get("env", {}))
    if cfg.get("lib_dirs"):
        env["LD_LIBRARY_PATH"] = ":".join(cfg["lib_dirs"] + [env.get("LD_LIBRARY_PATH", "")])
    env.update(FIXED_ENV)
    for kv in a.env or []:
        k, _, v = kv.partition("=")
        env[k] = v
    env["STRATA_LOGPOS"] = str(out)
    env["STRATA_LOGPOS_TOPK"] = str(TOPK)
    if mem_available_gb() < a.min_free_gb:
        raise SystemExit(f"only {mem_available_gb():.0f} GB available (< {a.min_free_gb}): not starting an engine")
    args = engine_args(cfg, a.gpu_experts, st["seg_tokens"])
    if a.wrap:
        args = a.wrap.split() + args
    errf = open(str(out) + ".stderr.txt", "w")
    print("engine:", " ".join(args), flush=True)
    p = subprocess.Popen(args, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=errf, text=True,
                         cwd=cfg.get("cwd"), env=env, bufsize=1)
    for line in p.stdout:
        if line.startswith("READY"):
            break
    else:
        raise SystemExit(f"the engine ended before READY (exit {p.wait()}); see {out}.stderr.txt")
    segs, info = [], []

    def lines() -> int:
        return sum(1 for _ in open(out)) if out.exists() else 0

    for s in st["segments"]:
        n0, t0 = lines(), time.time()
        p.stdin.write("GEN 1 " + ",".join(map(str, s["ids"])) + "\n")
        p.stdin.flush()
        done = None
        for line in p.stdout:
            if line.startswith(("DONE", "ERR")):
                done = line.strip()
                break
        if done is None or not done.startswith("DONE") or "nonfinite" in done:
            p.kill()
            raise SystemExit(f"{s['name']}: the engine answered {done!r}; see {out}.stderr.txt")
        n1 = lines()
        segs.append({"name": s["name"], "first_line": n0, "end_line": n1})
        info.append(f"{s['name']}: {n1 - n0} positions, {time.time() - t0:.1f} s")
        print(info[-1], flush=True)
        if n1 - n0 < len(s["ids"]) // 2:
            p.kill()
            raise SystemExit(f"{s['name']}: only {n1 - n0} positions were scored (the prompt took the batched path?)")
    p.stdin.write("QUIT\n")
    p.stdin.flush()
    try:
        p.wait(timeout=600)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        p.kill()
    errf.close()
    err = pathlib.Path(str(out) + ".stderr.txt").read_text(errors="replace")
    cache = [l for l in err.splitlines() if "expert cache" in l][:3]
    pathlib.Path(str(out) + ".seg.json").write_text(json.dumps({"segments": segs, "config": a.config,
                                                                 "args": args, "env": a.env or [],
                                                                 "expert_cache_lines": cache}, indent=1))
    return 0


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ prompt path
PROMPT_LENS = (256, 512, 768, 1000)


def cmd_prompt(a) -> int:
    """The batched prompt path's answer: every segment's first 256 / 512 / 768 / 1000 tokens as a prompt (one request
    each, no prompt cache), and the logits after it (STRATA_DUMP_FIRST_LOGITS: float32, the whole vocabulary)."""
    cfg = json.load(open(a.config, encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    st = json.load(open(a.ids))
    out = pathlib.Path(a.out).resolve()
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for f in out.glob("first.*"):
        f.unlink()
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env.update(cfg.get("env", {}))
    if cfg.get("lib_dirs"):
        env["LD_LIBRARY_PATH"] = ":".join(cfg["lib_dirs"] + [env.get("LD_LIBRARY_PATH", "")])
    env.update(FIXED_ENV)
    for kv in a.env or []:
        k, _, v = kv.partition("=")
        env[k] = v
    env["STRATA_DUMP_FIRST_LOGITS"] = str(out / "first")
    if mem_available_gb() < a.min_free_gb:
        raise SystemExit(f"only {mem_available_gb():.0f} GB available (< {a.min_free_gb}): not starting an engine")
    args = engine_args(cfg, a.gpu_experts, max(PROMPT_LENS))
    k = args.index("--short-read")
    del args[k:k + 2]                      # the default (64): these prompts take the batched prompt path
    k = args.index("--prefill")
    args[k + 1] = "auto"
    if a.wrap:
        args = a.wrap.split() + args
    errf = open(out / "stderr.txt", "w")
    print("engine:", " ".join(args), flush=True)
    p = subprocess.Popen(args, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=errf, text=True,
                         cwd=cfg.get("cwd"), env=env, bufsize=1)
    for line in p.stdout:
        if line.startswith("READY"):
            break
    else:
        raise SystemExit(f"the engine ended before READY (exit {p.wait()}); see {out}/stderr.txt")
    index = []
    for s in st["segments"]:
        for n in PROMPT_LENS:
            p.stdin.write("GEN 1 " + ",".join(map(str, s["ids"][:n])) + "\n")
            p.stdin.flush()
            done = None
            for line in p.stdout:
                if line.startswith(("DONE", "ERR")):
                    done = line.strip()
                    break
            if done is None or not done.startswith("DONE") or "nonfinite" in done:
                p.kill()
                raise SystemExit(f"{s['name']} {n}: the engine answered {done!r}")
            index.append({"segment": s["name"], "tokens": n})
    p.stdin.write("QUIT\n")
    p.stdin.flush()
    try:
        p.wait(timeout=600)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        p.kill()
    errf.close()
    (out / "index.json").write_text(json.dumps({"requests": index, "args": args, "env": a.env or []}, indent=1))
    print(f"{len(index)} prompts")
    return 0


def cmd_pcompare(a) -> int:
    import numpy as np
    ref = pathlib.Path(a.ref)
    idx = json.loads((ref / "index.json").read_text())["requests"]

    def logp(d, i):
        x = np.fromfile(d / f"first.{i}", dtype=np.float32).astype(np.float64)
        x -= x.max()
        return x - np.log(np.exp(x).sum())

    print(f"reference: {ref}")
    for run in a.runs:
        r = pathlib.Path(run)
        kls, agree = [], 0
        for i in range(len(idx)):
            if not (r / f"first.{i}").exists():
                continue
            lr, la = logp(ref, i), logp(r, i)
            pr = np.exp(lr)
            kls.append(float((pr * (lr - la)).sum()))
            agree += int(lr.argmax() == la.argmax())
        kls.sort()
        n = len(kls)
        print(f"{r.name:40s} prompts {n:3d}  top-1 {100 * agree / max(n, 1):6.2f}%  KL mean {sum(kls) / max(n, 1):.5f}  "
              f"median {kls[n // 2] if n else float('nan'):.5f}  max {kls[-1] if n else float('nan'):.5f}")
    return 0


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ compare
def read_run(path: str) -> dict:
    rows = open(path).read().splitlines()
    segs = json.load(open(path + ".seg.json"))["segments"]
    out = {}
    for s in segs:
        d = {}
        for line in rows[s["first_line"]:s["end_line"]]:
            f = line.split("\t")
            if len(f) < 8 + TOPK:
                continue
            d[int(f[0])] = (int(f[1]), float(f[2]), int(f[3]), [(int(x), float(y)) for x, y in
                                                                (z.split(":") for z in f[8:8 + TOPK])])
        out[s["name"]] = d
    return out


def compare(ref: dict, run: dict) -> dict:
    res, allk, tot = {}, [], {"n": 0, "agree": 0, "nll_r": 0.0, "nll_a": 0.0, "kl": 0.0}
    for name, rr in ref.items():
        ra = run.get(name, {})
        pos = sorted(set(rr) & set(ra))
        n = agree = 0
        kls, nll_r, nll_a = [], 0.0, 0.0
        for q in pos:
            tr, lr, topr, kr = rr[q]
            ta, la, topa, ka = ra[q]
            if tr != ta:
                raise SystemExit(f"{name} pos {q}: target {tr} != {ta} (not the same text)")
            n += 1
            agree += topr == topa
            nll_r -= lr
            nll_a -= la
            da = dict(ka)
            floor = min(b for _, b in ka)
            pr = [math.exp(b) for _, b in kr]
            pa = [math.exp(da.get(i, floor)) for i, _ in kr]
            sr, sa = sum(pr), sum(pa)
            kls.append(sum((x / sr) * math.log((x / sr) / (y / sa)) for x, y in zip(pr, pa) if x > 0))
        allk += kls
        if n:
            res[name] = {"positions": n, "top1": agree / n, "kl": sum(kls) / n,
                         "ppl_ref": math.exp(nll_r / n), "ppl": math.exp(nll_a / n)}
        tot["n"] += n
        tot["agree"] += agree
        tot["nll_r"] += nll_r
        tot["nll_a"] += nll_a
        tot["kl"] += sum(kls)
    n = max(tot["n"], 1)
    allk.sort()
    res["all"] = {"positions": tot["n"], "top1": tot["agree"] / n, "kl": tot["kl"] / n,
                  "kl_p99": allk[int(0.99 * (len(allk) - 1))] if allk else float("nan"),
                  "ppl_ref": math.exp(tot["nll_r"] / n), "ppl": math.exp(tot["nll_a"] / n)}
    return res


def cmd_compare(a) -> int:
    ref = read_run(a.ref)
    print(f"reference: {a.ref}")
    print(f"{'run':40s} {'segment':13s} {'pos':>5s} {'top1':>7s} {'KL':>8s} {'KL p99':>8s} {'PPL':>7s} {'PPL ref':>7s}")
    allres = {}
    for path in a.runs:
        r = compare(ref, read_run(path))
        allres[path] = r
        for seg, v in r.items():
            if seg != "all" and not a.segments:
                continue
            print(f"{pathlib.Path(path).name[:40]:40s} {seg:13s} {v['positions']:5d} {100 * v['top1']:6.2f}% "
                  f"{v['kl']:8.5f} {v.get('kl_p99', float('nan')):8.4f} {v['ppl']:7.3f} {v['ppl_ref']:7.3f}")
    if a.json:
        pathlib.Path(a.json).write_text(json.dumps(allres, indent=1))
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    p = sub.add_parser("ids")
    p.add_argument("--tokenizer", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--set", default=str(SET_DIR))
    p.add_argument("--seg-tokens", type=int, default=1000)
    p.add_argument("--out")
    p = sub.add_parser("run")
    p.add_argument("--config", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--ids", default=str(SET_DIR / "set.ids.json"))
    p.add_argument("--env", action="append")
    p.add_argument("--gpu-experts", nargs="?", const=True, default=False,
                   help="--expert-cache 1500 (or the N given, e.g. auto) instead of one slot (the experts on the GPU kernels)")
    p.add_argument("--min-free-gb", type=float, default=16)
    p.add_argument("--wrap", help="a command prefix for the engine, e.g. 'systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=200G'")
    p = sub.add_parser("prompt", help="the batched prompt path's next-token logits after 20 prompts (a directory)")
    p.add_argument("--config", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--ids", default=str(SET_DIR / "set.ids.json"))
    p.add_argument("--env", action="append")
    p.add_argument("--gpu-experts", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--min-free-gb", type=float, default=16)
    p.add_argument("--wrap")
    p = sub.add_parser("compare")
    p.add_argument("ref")
    p.add_argument("runs", nargs="+")
    p.add_argument("--segments", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--json")
    p = sub.add_parser("pcompare", help="full-vocabulary KL and top-1 of `prompt` directories against a reference one")
    p.add_argument("ref")
    p.add_argument("runs", nargs="+")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    return {"ids": cmd_ids, "run": cmd_run, "prompt": cmd_prompt, "compare": cmd_compare,
            "pcompare": cmd_pcompare}[a.cmd](a)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())


## tools/quantscope.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT OR Apache-2.0
# From https://github.com/1872183316/quantscope (commit bfdf205), used by tools/strata_inspect.py and setup's --inspect.
"""quantscope: find the real quantization of a model without downloading it.

Reads only file headers (a few MB per file, via HTTP range requests) of GGUF or safetensors
models on ModelScope, Hugging Face, any URL, or local disk, and reports the actual storage
type and bits per weight of every tensor group (routed experts, attention, embeddings, ...).
File names such as "IQ4_XS" or "Q4_K_XL" are recipe labels; the header is the ground truth.

Examples:
  python quantscope.py ms:unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF              # list variants
  python quantscope.py ms:unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF UD-Q4_K_XL   # one variant
  python quantscope.py ms:unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF --all        # compare all variants
  python quantscope.py hf:Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-GPTQ-Int4
  python quantscope.py models/model-00001-of-00003.gguf
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import fnmatch
import glob
import json
import os
import re
import struct
import sys
import urllib.request
from collections import defaultdict

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- sources --------------------

HUBS = {
    "ms": ("https://modelscope.cn/api/v1/models/{repo}/repo/files?Recursive=true",
           "https://modelscope.cn/models/{repo}/resolve/master/{path}"),
    "hf": ("https://huggingface.co/api/models/{repo}/tree/main?recursive=true",
           "https://huggingface.co/{repo}/resolve/main/{path}"),
}
if os.environ.get("HF_ENDPOINT"):
    base = os.environ["HF_ENDPOINT"].rstrip("/")
    HUBS["hf"] = (base + "/api/models/{repo}/tree/main?recursive=true",
                  base + "/{repo}/resolve/main/{path}")


def http(url: str, start: int | None = None, end: int | None = None) -> bytes:
    headers = {"User-Agent": "quantscope"}
    if start is not None:
        headers["Range"] = f"bytes={start}-{end}"
    for attempt in range(5):
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers),
                                        timeout=60) as r:
                return r.read()
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - network retries
            if attempt == 4:
                raise RuntimeError(f"{url}: {error}") from error
    raise AssertionError


class Source:
    """A file readable by byte ranges (remote or local) with a known size."""

    def __init__(self, name: str, size: int, url: str | None = None, path: str | None = None):
        self.name, self.size, self.url, self.path = name, size, url, path

    def read(self, start: int, length: int) -> bytes:
        length = max(0, min(length, self.size - start))
        if length == 0:
            return b""
        if self.path:
            with open(self.path, "rb") as f:
                f.seek(start)
                return f.read(length)
        return http(self.url, start, start + length - 1)


def list_hub(kind: str, repo: str) -> list[Source]:
    list_url, file_url = HUBS[kind]
    data = json.loads(http(list_url.format(repo=repo)))
    out = []
    if kind == "ms":
        for f in data["Data"]["Files"]:
            if f.get("Type") == "blob":
                out.append(Source(f["Path"], int(f.get("Size") or 0),
                                  url=file_url.format(repo=repo, path=f["Path"])))
    else:
        for f in data:
            if f.get("type") == "file":
                size = int((f.get("lfs") or {}).get("size") or f.get("size") or 0)
                out.append(Source(f["path"], size, url=file_url.format(repo=repo, path=f["path"])))
    return out


def resolve(spec: str) -> list[Source]:
    m = re.match(r"^(ms|hf):([^/]+/[^/:]+)$", spec)
    if m:
        return list_hub(m.group(1), m.group(2))
    if spec.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
        head = urllib.request.Request(spec, method="HEAD", headers={"User-Agent": "quantscope"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(head, timeout=60) as r:
            size = int(r.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        return [Source(spec.rsplit("/", 1)[-1], size, url=spec)]
    paths = [spec] if os.path.isfile(spec) else sorted(
        glob.glob(os.path.join(spec, "**", "*"), recursive=True))
    return [Source(os.path.relpath(p, spec) if os.path.isdir(spec) else os.path.basename(p),
                   os.path.getsize(p), path=p) for p in paths if os.path.isfile(p)]


def variant_of(name: str) -> str:
    """Groups the shards of one model file: strips -00001-of-00004 and the extension."""
    return re.sub(r"(-\d{5}-of-\d{5})?\.(gguf|safetensors|ninfer)$", "", name)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- GGUF -----------------------

GGML_TYPES = {
    0: "F32", 1: "F16", 2: "Q4_0", 3: "Q4_1", 6: "Q5_0", 7: "Q5_1", 8: "Q8_0", 9: "Q8_1",
    10: "Q2_K", 11: "Q3_K", 12: "Q4_K", 13: "Q5_K", 14: "Q6_K", 15: "Q8_K", 16: "IQ2_XXS",
    17: "IQ2_XS", 18: "IQ3_XXS", 19: "IQ1_S", 20: "IQ4_NL", 21: "IQ3_S", 22: "IQ2_S",
    23: "IQ4_XS", 24: "I8", 25: "I16", 26: "I32", 27: "I64", 28: "F64", 29: "IQ1_M",
    30: "BF16", 34: "TQ1_0", 35: "TQ2_0", 39: "MXFP4",
    42: "Q2_0",  # ISTA-DASLab GSQ-RCO 2-bit (Strata, llama.cpp fork type)
    143: "PTQ1_0", 144: "TQ2_T", 145: "TQK6", 146: "TQK7",  # agentionai Gyro (tools/gguf_reader.py has the block sizes)
}


class Buffered:
    """Sequential reader over a remote header that fetches more bytes on demand."""

    def __init__(self, src: Source, first: int = 4 << 20):
        self.src, self.buf, self.pos = src, src.read(0, first), 0

    def take(self, n: int) -> bytes:
        while self.pos + n > len(self.buf):
            if len(self.buf) >= self.src.size:
                raise EOFError(f"{self.src.name}: truncated header")
            self.buf += self.src.read(len(self.buf), max(len(self.buf), 4 << 20))
        out = self.buf[self.pos:self.pos + n]
        self.pos += n
        return out

    def u32(self) -> int: return struct.unpack("<I", self.take(4))[0]
    def u64(self) -> int: return struct.unpack("<Q", self.take(8))[0]
    def string(self) -> str: return self.take(self.u64()).decode("utf-8", "replace")


SCALAR = {0: 1, 1: 1, 2: 2, 3: 2, 4: 4, 5: 4, 6: 4, 7: 1, 10: 8, 11: 8, 12: 8}


def gguf_value(r: Buffered, vtype: int):
    if vtype == 8:
        return r.string()
    if vtype == 9:
        itype, n = r.u32(), r.u64()
        if itype == 8:
            items = [r.string() for _ in range(n)]  # must be consumed either way
            return items if n <= 64 else None
        if itype == 9:
            raise ValueError("nested GGUF arrays are not supported")
        size = SCALAR[itype]
        r.take(size * n)
        return None
    raw = r.take(SCALAR[vtype])
    fmt = {0: "<B", 1: "<b", 2: "<H", 3: "<h", 4: "<I", 5: "<i", 6: "<f", 7: "<?",
           10: "<Q", 11: "<q", 12: "<d"}[vtype]
    return struct.unpack(fmt, raw)[0]


def read_gguf(src: Source) -> tuple[dict, list[dict]]:
    r = Buffered(src)
    if r.take(4) != b"GGUF":
        raise ValueError(f"{src.name}: not a GGUF file")
    r.u32()  # version
    n_tensors, n_kv = r.u64(), r.u64()
    meta = {}
    for _ in range(n_kv):
        key = r.string()
        meta[key] = gguf_value(r, r.u32())
    tensors = []
    for _ in range(n_tensors):
        name = r.string()
        dims = [r.u64() for _ in range(r.u32())]
        ttype, offset = r.u32(), r.u64()
        count = 1
        for d in dims:
            count *= d
        tensors.append({"name": name, "type": GGML_TYPES.get(ttype, f"type#{ttype}"),
                        "elements": count, "offset": offset})
    align = int(meta.get("general.alignment") or 32)
    data_start = (r.pos + align - 1) // align * align
    # Actual stored bytes from the offsets: exact for every type, including unknown ones.
    order = sorted(tensors, key=lambda t: t["offset"])
    for a, b in zip(order, order[1:] + [None]):
        end = b["offset"] if b else src.size - data_start
        a["bytes"] = end - a["offset"]
    return meta, tensors


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- safetensors ----------------

ST_BYTES = {"F64": 8, "F32": 4, "F16": 2, "BF16": 2, "F8_E4M3": 1, "F8_E5M2": 1, "I64": 8,
            "I32": 4, "I16": 2, "I8": 1, "U8": 1, "BOOL": 1, "F8_E8M0": 1, "U32": 4}
PACKED = re.compile(r"(qweight|weight_packed|\.blocks$|_blocks$)")


def read_safetensors(src: Source, bits: int | None) -> list[dict]:
    n = struct.unpack("<Q", src.read(0, 8))[0]
    header = json.loads(src.read(8, n))
    out = []
    for name, t in header.items():
        if name == "__metadata__":
            continue
        count = 1
        for d in t["shape"]:
            count *= d
        nbytes = count * ST_BYTES.get(t["dtype"], 1)
        elements = count
        if PACKED.search(name):
            # Packed integer codes: logical weights = stored bits / code bits.
            elements = nbytes * 8 // (bits or 4)
        elif re.search(r"(scales|zeros|qzeros|g_idx|scale$|_scale|zero_point)", name):
            elements = 0  # metadata of a quantized weight: counts as bytes only
        out.append({"name": name, "type": t["dtype"], "elements": elements, "bytes": nbytes})
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- NInfer v3 ------------------

NINFER_MAGIC = b"NINFER" + bytes([0, 3])


def read_ninfer(src: Source) -> list[dict]:
    """Logical parameters of a NInfer v3 .ninfer entry, from its directory JSON only.

    A stored object may hold several logical parameters (for example an expert bank); each
    binding's share of the object's stored bytes is proportional to its element range.
    """
    head = src.read(0, 32)
    magic, json_bytes, _artifact_id = struct.unpack("<8sQ16s", head)
    if magic != NINFER_MAGIC:
        raise ValueError(f"{src.name}: not a NInfer v3 entry")
    directory = json.loads(src.read(32, json_bytes))
    objects = {o["id"]: o for o in directory["objects"] if o.get("kind", "tensor") == "tensor"}
    elements = {}
    for oid, o in objects.items():
        count = 1
        for d in o["shape"]:
            count *= d
        elements[oid] = count
    out = []
    for name, binding in directory["bindings"].items():
        parts = ([{"object": binding["object"], "range": [0, elements.get(binding["object"], 0)]}]
                 if "object" in binding else binding.get("parts", []))
        count = nbytes = 0
        fmt = None
        for part in parts:
            o = objects.get(part["object"])
            if o is None:
                continue
            n = part["range"][1] - part["range"][0]
            count += n
            nbytes += o["bytes"] * n / max(elements[part["object"]], 1)
            fmt = o["format"]
        if count:
            out.append({"name": name, "type": (fmt or "?").upper(), "elements": count,
                        "bytes": nbytes})
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- summary --------------------

CATEGORIES = [
    ("norms", r"(norm)"),
    ("hyper-connections", r"(hc_|_hc\.|hyper_connection)"),
    ("routed experts", r"(_exps\b|\.experts\.|experts\.\d+|block_sparse_moe\.experts)"),
    ("shared experts", r"(_shexp|shared_expert|moe\.shared\.)"),
    ("router", r"(ffn_gate_inp|\.gate\.weight$|\.router\b|shared_score)"),
    ("n-gram/per-layer embeddings", r"(ngram|per_layer|ple_|\.ple\.)"),
    ("linear attn/SSM", r"(ssm_|linear_attn|mamba|conv1d|\.gdn\.)"),
    # GGUF also names GatedDeltaNet input projections attn_qkv/attn_gate.
    ("attention (incl. GDN qkv/gate)", r"(attn|attention|self_attn|indexer|\.q_proj|\.k_proj|"
                                       r"\.v_proj|\.o_proj)"),
    ("dense FFN", r"(ffn_|\.mlp\.)"),
    ("token embedding", r"(token_embd|embed_tokens|token_embedding|wte)"),
    ("output head", r"(^output\.|lm_head|output_head)"),
    ("MTP / nextn", r"(nextn|mtp)"),
]


def category(name: str) -> str:
    n = name.lower().replace("/", ".")  # NInfer logical names use slashes
    for label, pattern in CATEGORIES:
        if re.search(pattern, n):
            return label
    return "other"


def q_class(bpw: float) -> str:
    for limit, label in [(1.9, "Q1 class"), (2.8, "Q2 class"), (3.7, "Q3 class"),
                         (4.9, "Q4 class"), (5.9, "Q5 class"), (7.5, "Q6 class"),
                         (10.0, "Q8 class"), (17.0, "16-bit")]:
        if bpw < limit:
            return label
    return "32-bit"


def summarize(title: str, tensors: list[dict]) -> dict:
    groups: dict[str, dict] = defaultdict(lambda: {"elements": 0, "bytes": 0,
                                                  "types": defaultdict(int)})
    for t in tensors:
        g = groups[category(t["name"])]
        g["elements"] += t["elements"]
        g["bytes"] += t["bytes"]
        g["types"][t["type"]] += t["bytes"]
    total_e = sum(g["elements"] for g in groups.values())
    total_b = sum(g["bytes"] for g in groups.values())
    print(f"\n=== {title} ===")
    print(f"total {total_b / 1e9:.2f} GB, {total_e / 1e9:.2f} B weights, "
          f"{8 * total_b / max(total_e, 1):.2f} bits/weight overall")
    print(f"{'group':30s} {'weights':>9s} {'GB':>8s} {'bits/w':>7s}  types (share of bytes)")
    for label, g in sorted(groups.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]["bytes"]):
        bpw = 8 * g["bytes"] / g["elements"] if g["elements"] else float("nan")
        types = ", ".join(f"{k} {100 * v / g['bytes']:.0f}%"
                          for k, v in sorted(g["types"].items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]))
        print(f"{label:30s} {g['elements'] / 1e9:8.2f}B {g['bytes'] / 1e9:8.2f} {bpw:7.2f}  {types}")
    experts = groups.get("routed experts")
    verdict = None
    if experts and experts["elements"]:
        verdict = 8 * experts["bytes"] / experts["elements"]
        print(f"-> routed experts are {verdict:.2f} bits/weight ({q_class(verdict)})")
    return {"title": title, "gb": total_b / 1e9, "bpw": 8 * total_b / max(total_e, 1),
            "experts_bpw": verdict}


def scan(label: str, files: list[Source], meta_config: dict | None) -> dict:
    tensors: list[dict] = []
    for src in files:
        if src.name.endswith(".gguf"):
            _meta, ts = read_gguf(src)
        elif src.name.endswith(".ninfer"):
            ts = read_ninfer(src)
        else:
            bits = None
            if meta_config:
                q = meta_config.get("quantization_config") or {}
                bits = q.get("bits") or q.get("w_bit")
            ts = read_safetensors(src, bits)
        tensors += ts
        print(f"  read header of {src.name}: {len(ts)} tensors", file=sys.stderr)
    return summarize(label, tensors)


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__,
                                     formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("source", help="ms:owner/repo, hf:owner/repo, URL, file or directory")
    parser.add_argument("variant", nargs="?", help="variant name or glob (e.g. UD-Q4_K_XL)")
    parser.add_argument("--all", action="store_true", help="scan and compare every variant")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    files = [f for f in resolve(args.source)
             if f.name.endswith((".gguf", ".safetensors", ".ninfer"))]
    config = None
    for f in resolve(args.source) if args.source.startswith(("ms:", "hf:")) else []:
        if f.name == "config.json":
            config = json.loads(http(f.url))
            if config.get("quantization_config"):
                print("config.json quantization_config:",
                      json.dumps(config["quantization_config"])[:400])
    variants: dict[str, list[Source]] = defaultdict(list)
    for f in files:
        variants[variant_of(f.name)].append(f)
    if not variants:
        sys.exit("no .gguf, .safetensors or .ninfer files found")
    if len(variants) > 1 and not args.variant and not args.all:
        print("variants (pass one as the second argument, or --all):")
        for name, fs in sorted(variants.items()):
            print(f"  {name:70s} {sum(f.size for f in fs) / 1e9:8.2f} GB  {len(fs)} file(s)")
        return
    chosen = {k: v for k, v in variants.items()
              if args.all or not args.variant or args.variant in k
              or fnmatch.fnmatch(k, args.variant)}
    results = [scan(name, sorted(fs, key=lambda f: f.name), config)
               for name, fs in sorted(chosen.items())]
