        print(f"{a_.exe}: no engine - build it first", flush=True)
        return 2
    engine_args = shlex.split(a_.engine_args)
    N, max_new = a_.turns, a_.max_new
    PIN = len(P["sys"])
    ok = True

    def check(what: str, cond: bool) -> None:
        nonlocal ok
        print(("  ok    " if cond else "  FAIL  ") + what, flush=True)
        ok = ok and cond

    # the turns A1 B1 A2 B2 ...; an agent's prompt is its previous prompt + the answer it got + the new message
    # (the answers of `ref` when given, so every arm sends the same prompts byte for byte)
    def build_steps(ref: dict | None, upto: int = N, start: int = 1, agents: str = "AB"):
        out = []
        for i in range(start, upto + 1):
            for x in agents:
                def make(ans, x=x, i=i):
                    src = ref if ref is not None else ans
                    prompt = P["sys"] + P["task" + x]
                    for j in range(1, i):
                        prompt = prompt + src[f"{x}{j}"]["tokens"] + P[f"turn{x}{j}"]
                    return prompt
                out.append((f"{x}{i}", make))
        return out

    def table(ans: dict, upto: int = N) -> tuple[float, float]:
        for i in range(1, upto + 1):
            for x in "AB":
                r = ans[f"{x}{i}"]
                print(f"        {x}{i}: prompt {r['prompt_len']:>6}  first token {r['ttft_ms'] / 1000:6.2f} s  "
                      f"reused {r['reused']:>6}", flush=True)
        wall = sum(ans[f"{x}{i}"]["s"] for i in range(1, upto + 1) for x in "AB")
        tt = sum(ans[f"{x}{i}"]["ttft_ms"] for i in range(1, upto + 1) for x in "AB") / 1000
        print(f"        {2 * upto} turns: wall {wall:.1f} s, time to first token (sum) {tt:.1f} s", flush=True)
        return wall, tt

    def same_tokens(name: str, ans: dict, ref: dict, upto: int = N) -> bool:
        bad = [f"{x}{i}" for i in range(1, upto + 1) for x in "AB" if ans[f"{x}{i}"]["tokens"] != ref[f"{x}{i}"]["tokens"]]
        for k in bad:
            print(f"        {k}: {ans[k]['tokens'][:8]} vs the reference's {ref[k]['tokens'][:8]}", flush=True)
        return not bad

    tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="ds4-slots-") if not a_.keep_dir else a_.keep_dir
    os.makedirs(tmp, exist_ok=True)
    dir_on = os.path.join(tmp, "on")
    ref = None
    sums: dict[str, tuple[float, float]] = {}
    try:
        print(f"prompts: system+tools {len(P['sys'])} tok, task {len(P['taskA'])}, turn {len(P['turnA1'])}; "
              f"{N} turns per agent, {max_new} new tokens each, pin={PIN}", flush=True)
        need_ref = bool(steps & {"ref", "pin", "on", "restart", "cap"})
        if need_ref:
            print("ref: A1 B1 A2 B2 ... every request a fresh read of its whole prompt (STRATA_DS4_REUSE=0), shared "
                  "start marked", flush=True)
            ref, _, load0 = run(a_.exe, a_.pack, engine_args, os.path.join(tmp, "ref"), False,
                                build_steps(None, N + 1), max_new, pin=PIN, reuse=False)
            print(f"        load {load0:.0f} s", flush=True)
            sums["ref"] = table(ref)
            check("ref: nothing is reused", all(ref[f"{x}{i}"]["reused"] == 0 for i in range(1, N + 1) for x in "AB"))

        if "old" in steps:
            print("old: the engine as it was (no shared start, no slots): the other agent takes the model every turn",
                  flush=True)
            old, _, _ = run(a_.exe, a_.pack, engine_args, os.path.join(tmp, "old"), False,
                            build_steps(ref, N) if ref else build_steps(None, N), max_new)
            sums["old"] = table(old)
            if ref is not None:
                print(f"        tokens {'the same as' if same_tokens('old', old, ref) else 'DIFFER from'} the reference's "
                      "(informational: no shared-start split here)", flush=True)

        if "pin" in steps:
            print("pin: the shared start marked, no slots: a sub-agent goes back to the start the other left", flush=True)
            pn, _, _ = run(a_.exe, a_.pack, engine_args, os.path.join(tmp, "pin"), False, build_steps(ref, N), max_new,
                           pin=PIN)
            sums["pin"] = table(pn)
            check(f"pin: the sub-agent's first turn reads only its own task (reused {pn['B1']['reused']} of {PIN})",
                  pn["B1"]["reused"] == PIN)
            check(f"pin: every turn prints the reference's tokens ({2 * N} x {max_new})", same_tokens("pin", pn, ref))

        if "on" in steps:
            print("on: slots on (RAM) and the shared start marked", flush=True)
            on, notes, _ = run(a_.exe, a_.pack, engine_args, dir_on, True, build_steps(ref, N), max_new, pin=PIN)
            sums["on"] = table(on)
            check(f"on: the sub-agent's first turn reads only its own task (reused {on['B1']['reused']} of {PIN})",
                  on["B1"]["reused"] == PIN)
            check(f"on: every turn prints the reference's tokens ({2 * N} x {max_new})", same_tokens("on", on, ref))
            # a turn after the first continues a kept conversation: the whole earlier prompt + answer minus its last
            # token is reused (the state ends one token short of the answer's last one)
            full = True
            for i in range(2, N + 1):
                for x in "AB":
                    want = on[f"{x}{i}"]["prompt_len"] - len(P[f"turn{x}{i - 1}"]) - 1
                    got = on[f"{x}{i}"]["reused"]
                    if got != want:
                        full = False
                        print(f"        {x}{i}: reused {got}, expected {want}", flush=True)
            check("on: every later turn reuses its whole earlier conversation", full)
            if "old" in sums:
                check(f"on: faster to the first token than the old engine ({sums['on'][1]:.1f} s vs {sums['old'][1]:.1f} s)",
                      sums["on"][1] < sums["old"][1])
                print(f"        wall x{sums['old'][0] / max(sums['on'][0], 1e-9):.2f}, first token x"
                      f"{sums['old'][1] / max(sums['on'][1], 1e-9):.2f} against the old engine", flush=True)

        if "restart" in steps:
            bins = [f for f in os.listdir(dir_on) if f.startswith("slot-") and f.endswith(".bin")] if os.path.isdir(dir_on) else []
            check(f"restart: the folder holds both agents' conversations ({len(bins)} .bin)", len(bins) == 2)
            print("restart: each agent's next turn, a new process on the folder", flush=True)
            rs, notes2, _ = run(a_.exe, a_.pack, engine_args, dir_on, True,
                                [(f"{x}{N + 1}", build_steps(ref, N + 1, N + 1, x)[0][1]) for x in "AB"], max_new,
                                pin=PIN)
            for x in "AB":
                r = rs[f"{x}{N + 1}"]
                print(f"        {x}{N + 1}: prompt {r['prompt_len']:>6}  first token {r['ttft_ms'] / 1000:6.2f} s  reused {r['reused']:>6}",
                      flush=True)
                want = r["prompt_len"] - len(P[f"turn{x}{N}"]) - 1
                check(f"restart: {x}{N + 1} reuses its whole conversation ({r['reused']} of {want})", r["reused"] == want)
                check(f"restart: {x}{N + 1} prints the reference's tokens", r["tokens"] == ref[f"{x}{N + 1}"]["tokens"])

        if "cap" in steps:
            # three conversations (A, B and an unrelated C) cannot fit under A+B's bytes: the least recently used goes
            ca = os.path.join(tmp, "cap")
            seen = {}
            if os.path.isdir(dir_on):
                for fn in os.listdir(dir_on):
                    if fn.endswith(".bin"):
                        seen[fn] = os.path.getsize(os.path.join(dir_on, fn))
            if len(seen) == 2:
                cap_gb = sum(seen.values()) / 2**30 * 1.02
                c_prompt = P["taskB"] + P["taskA"] + P["sys"][:2000]
                print(f"cap: A, B, C into a folder capped at {cap_gb:.3f} GB (the bytes of A and B)", flush=True)
                run(a_.exe, a_.pack, engine_args, ca, True,
                    [("A1", build_steps(ref, 1)[0][1]), ("B1", build_steps(ref, 1)[1][1]),
                     ("C1", lambda _: c_prompt)], max_new, pin=PIN, slot_gb=cap_gb)
                total = sum(os.path.getsize(os.path.join(ca, f)) for f in os.listdir(ca) if f.endswith(".bin"))
                held = []
                a_start, b_start = P["sys"] + P["taskA"], P["sys"] + P["taskB"]
                for fn in sorted(os.listdir(ca)):
                    if fn.endswith(".meta"):
                        mt = meta_tokens(os.path.join(ca, fn))
                        if mt:
                            t = mt[0]
                            held.append("C" if t[:len(c_prompt)] == c_prompt else "A" if t[:len(a_start)] == a_start
                                        else "B" if t[:len(b_start)] == b_start else "?")
                print(f"        the folder holds {sorted(held)} ({total / 2**20:.1f} MiB of {cap_gb * 1024:.1f} MiB)", flush=True)
                check("cap: the folder stays under its cap", total <= cap_gb * 2**30)
                check("cap: the newest conversation (C) is kept", "C" in held)
                check("cap: the least recently used (A) is gone", "A" not in held)
            else:
                print("        (no two conversations in the loop's folder: the cap check needs the on step)", flush=True)
    except (RuntimeError, OSError) as e:
        print(f"FAIL: {e}", flush=True)
        ok = False
    finally:
        if not a_.keep_dir:
            shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
    if sums:
        print("summary (wall s, sum of first-token s): " + "  ".join(f"{k} {v[0]:.1f}/{v[1]:.1f}" for k, v in sums.items()),
              flush=True)
    print("PASS: the kept conversations read on from their state" if ok else "FAIL", flush=True)
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())


## tools/dsv41/smoke.py

"""16 tokens of a fixed prompt through strata-dsv41 and a check of the TEXT (setup runs this once after the pack is built).

    python tools/dsv41/smoke.py --exe strata-dsv41 --pack <pack> [--gpus 0] [--tokens 16]

A pack that loads can still give garbage (a wrong pack recipe does exactly that), so the answer is read, not just the exit code:
the model is asked for the capital of France and the reply must be words, with "Paris" in it.  Exit 0 and the text on success; exit 1
and one plain line (and the engine's last lines) when the reply is not sensible; exit 2 when the engine did not run at all.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))

PROMPT = "<｜begin▁of▁sentence｜><｜User｜>What is the capital of France? Answer in one short sentence.<｜Assistant｜></think>"


def tokenizer(pack: Path):
    import strata_tokenizer as ST
    tpath = pack / "tokenizer"
    vocab = json.loads((tpath / "vocab.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    tokens = [None] * len(vocab)
    for t, i in vocab.items():
        tokens[i] = t
    merges = (tpath / "merges.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").split("\n")
    types = json.loads((tpath / "token_type.json").read_text())
    tcfg = {}
    try:
        tcfg = json.loads((tpath / "tokenizer.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        pass
    return ST.Tokenizer(tokens, merges, types, tcfg.get("pre") or "qwen35", tcfg.get("special_ids") or None)


def sensible(text: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """Words, not noise: letters in a normal share, more than two different words, no replacement characters, and Paris in it."""
    t = text.strip()
    words = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z]{2,}", t)
    if not t:
        return False, "the answer is empty"
    if "�" in t:
        return False, "the answer has broken characters"
    if len(set(w.lower() for w in words)) < 3:
        return False, "the answer is not made of words"
    letters = sum(c.isalpha() or c.isspace() or c in ".,'-" for c in t) / len(t)
    if letters < 0.8:
        return False, "the answer is mostly symbols"
    if "paris" not in t.lower():
        return False, "the answer to a question with a known answer (the capital of France) does not contain it"
    return True, "ok"


def main() -> int:
    for st in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr):       # the reply has DeepSeek's special tokens (fullwidth bars): a Windows console code page cannot print them
        try:
            st.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        except (AttributeError, OSError):
            pass
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--exe", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--pack", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--gpus")
    ap.add_argument("--tokens", type=int, default=16)
    ap.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=5400)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    pack = Path(a.pack)
    tok = tokenizer(pack)
    ids = tok.encode(PROMPT, parse_special=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        f = Path(d) / "ids.txt"
        f.write_text(",".join(str(i) for i in ids), encoding="ascii")
        cmd = [a.exe, "--pack", str(pack), "--ids", "@" + str(f), "--n", str(a.tokens), "--max-context", "1024", "--dspark", "auto",
               "--window", "16"]
        if a.gpus:
            cmd += ["--gpus", a.gpus]
        try:
            r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=a.timeout, env=dict(os.environ))
        except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as e:
            print(f"the engine did not finish the test run: {e}")
            return 2
    err = (r.stderr or "").strip().splitlines()
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(f"the engine stopped with an error (exit {r.returncode}): " + " | ".join(err[-3:]))
        return 2
    out = [int(x) for x in re.findall(r"-?\d+", (r.stdout or "").strip().splitlines()[-1] if (r.stdout or "").strip() else "")]
    text = tok.decode(out)
    good, why = sensible(text)
    print(text.strip())
    if not good:
        print(f"test question failed: {why}")
        return 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())


## tools/dsv41/st.py

# Copyright (c) 2026 Peasant Smith and the Project Maya contributors (MIT; https://github.com/mw00/project-maya, v1.1.17).
# Ported into Strata (third_party/project-maya/NOTICE.md, LICENSE); changes are in the git history of this file.
"""tools/ds4/st.py - every tensor of a DeepSeek-V4.1 model directory, read in place.

    st = SafeTensors(Path("~/models/DSV4").expanduser())
    st.t["layers.0.attn.wq_a.trellis"]   -> (file, dtype, shape, absolute offset, bytes)
    st.raw(name), st.f32(name)            -> numpy views / float32 copies

The index's own files come first; any other .safetensors in the directory (the Engram shards 47 / 48 of the base
repo, model-0004[78]-of-00048.safetensors) only adds names the index does not have.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import pathlib
import struct

import numpy as np

DTYPE_BYTES = {"F32": 4, "F16": 2, "BF16": 2, "I32": 4, "I16": 2, "F8_E4M3": 1, "F8_E8M0": 1, "U8": 1, "I8": 1,
               "I64": 8}


class SafeTensors:
    def __init__(self, d: pathlib.Path):
        self.dir = pathlib.Path(d)
        ix = json.loads((self.dir / "model.safetensors.index.json").read_text())["weight_map"]
        primary = sorted(set(ix.values()))
        others = sorted(p.name for p in self.dir.glob("*.safetensors") if p.name not in primary)
        self.files: list[str] = []
        self.t: dict[str, tuple] = {}
        self.mm: dict[str, np.memmap] = {}
        for fn in primary + others:
            p = self.dir / fn
            with p.open("rb") as f:
                n = struct.unpack("<Q", f.read(8))[0]
                h = json.loads(f.read(n))
            base = 8 + n
            self.files.append(fn)
            for k, v in h.items():
                if k == "__metadata__" or k in self.t:
                    continue
                a, b = v["data_offsets"]
                self.t[k] = (fn, v["dtype"], tuple(v["shape"]), base + a, b - a)
            self.mm[fn] = np.memmap(p, dtype=np.uint8, mode="r")

    def has(self, name: str) -> bool:
        return name in self.t

    def raw(self, name: str) -> np.ndarray:
        fn, _, _, off, nb = self.t[name]
        return self.mm[fn][off:off + nb]

    def f32(self, name: str) -> np.ndarray:
        """The tensor as float32 (exact for F32/F16/BF16), shaped as stored."""
        _, dt, shape, _, _ = self.t[name]
        r = self.raw(name)
        if dt == "F32":
            a = r.view("<f4")
        elif dt == "F16":
            a = r.view("<f2").astype(np.float32)
        elif dt == "BF16":
            a = (r.view("<u2").astype(np.uint32) << 16).view(np.float32)
        else:
            raise ValueError("%s is %s, not a float tensor" % (name, dt))
        return a.reshape(shape)


## tools/dsv41/test_prompt_skip.py

"""The long-prompt layer skip (STRATA_DS4_PROMPT_SKIP=1) against the full work: same answers within noise.

Needs a GPU, a DeepSeek-V4.1 pack and the golden ids file, so it runs only when they are named:

    STRATA_DSV41_BIN=.../strata-dsv41 STRATA_DSV41_PACK=/data/pack2.00 STRATA_DSV41_IDS=.../logpos.ids.json \
        python -m unittest tools.dsv41.test_prompt_skip

The golden segments are joined, the first DS4_SCORE_PREFIX tokens (4200) are read as one prompt (the path a long prompt
takes: logits of the last row only, where the skip applies), and the positions after them are scored teacher-forced.
The skip changes only what the layers 20-39 compute for the prompt's early rows, so the scored rows' KL against the
full work must stay at the noise of the experts' summing order.
"""
import os
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
import quant_quality  # noqa: E402

BIN = os.environ.get("STRATA_DSV41_BIN")
PACK = os.environ.get("STRATA_DSV41_PACK")
IDS = os.environ.get("STRATA_DSV41_IDS")


def keep_rows(nl=40, yoco=20, win=128):
    """The rows a long prompt keeps on layers yoco.. (the engine's forward_chunks): each layer looks back one window
    more than the layer before, so the last (nl - yoco) * (win - 1) + win rows."""
    return (nl - yoco) * (win - 1) + win


class PromptSkip(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_keep_rows_is_the_chain_of_windows(self):
        self.assertEqual(keep_rows(), 2668)

    @unittest.skipUnless(BIN and PACK and IDS, "needs STRATA_DSV41_BIN / _PACK / _IDS")
    def test_scored_rows_after_a_skipped_prompt_match_the_full_work(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            outs = {}
            for mode in ("0", "1"):
                out = pathlib.Path(tmp) / f"skip{mode}.tsv"
                env = dict(os.environ, STRATA_DS4_PROMPT_SKIP=mode, DS4_SCORE_PREFIX="4200", DS4_CHUNK="1024")
                subprocess.run([BIN, "--pack", PACK, "--tp", "1", "--threads", "off", "--max-context", "6144", "--vision",
                                "off", "--dspark", "off", "--expert-profile", "none", "--window", "128", "--score", IDS,
                                "--score-out", str(out)], check=True, env=env)
                outs[mode] = quant_quality.read_run(str(out))
            res = quant_quality.compare(outs["0"], outs["1"])["all"]
            self.assertGreater(res["positions"], 500)
            self.assertLess(res["kl"], 0.002)
            self.assertGreaterEqual(res["top1"], 0.99)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tools/dsv41/tok.py

# Copyright (c) 2026 Peasant Smith and the Project Maya contributors (MIT; https://github.com/mw00/project-maya, v1.1.17).

"""tools/ds4/tok.py - token ids for maya-ds4's --ids, and text back from its output (DeepSeek-V4.1's tokenizer).

    python tools/ds4/tok.py --model ~/models/DSV4 --chat "Why is the sky blue?" [--think]   -> 0,128803,...
    python tools/ds4/tok.py --model ~/models/DSV4 --decode 18033,1                          -> text
"""

import argparse
import pathlib
import sys


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--model", default=str(pathlib.Path("~/models/DSV4").expanduser()))
    ap.add_argument("--chat")
    ap.add_argument("--think", action="store_true", help="thinking mode (the prompt ends with <think>)")
    ap.add_argument("--text")
    ap.add_argument("--decode")

        s = a.text or ""
    print(",".join(str(i) for i in tok.encode(s, add_special_tokens=False).ids))
    return 0

    sys.exit(main())


## tools/dsv41/tq_convert.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""tq_convert.py - re-encode the routed experts of some layers of a DeepSeek-V4.1 pack with the trellis encoder
(tools/tqenc.py, HIP) and write them in the format the engine reads (strata-dsv41: ds4_tq.cu / ds4_tq_cpu.cpp):

    HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 TQENC_GPU_LOCK=2 python tools/dsv41/tq_convert.py --pack PACK --out DIR --layers 1,7 --type K5

PACK is the pack pack_gguf.py wrote (its tensors.txt names the source MXFP4 experts in the GGUF shards).  Per layer one file
DIR/tq-L<layer>.bin holds the three roles one after another (gate = w1, up = w3, down = w2), each stacked [n_exp][rows][row
bytes] in the trellis types' file layout (a row = k / 128 blocks of {fp16 d; 4 K stream bytes}, tools/trellis/tqenc.hpp), 4096-aligned;
DIR/tq.json lists them as {"layers.N.ffn.experts.w1": [type name, file, offset, bytes, [n_exp, rows, cols]], ...}.  Then

    python tools/dsv41/pack_gguf.py --model <gguf dir> --out PACK2 --tq-experts DIR

writes a pack whose layers listed there read these experts (the other layers keep their MXFP4).  The weights are encoded as they
are (plain error, no rotation, no activation weights): what the dense override experiments of gate 3 measure.  Types:
K4 = TQK4X, K5 = TQK5X (computed codebook, version 2), K4T / K5T (the table, version 1), K6 = TQK6, K7 = TQK7.
"""
import argparse
import concurrent.futures as cf
import json
import os
import pathlib
import sys
import threading
import time

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))
import tqenc  # noqa: E402

TYPES = {"K4": tqenc.TQK4X, "K5": tqenc.TQK5X, "K4T": tqenc.TQK4T, "K5T": tqenc.TQK5T, "K6": tqenc.TQK6, "K7": tqenc.TQK7}
CFGS = {"fast": dict(iters=0, ncand=1, scale_tries=1), "default": dict(iters=1, ncand=1, scale_tries=1)}
MXFP4_LUT = np.array([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 0, -1, -2, -3, -4, -6, -8, -12], dtype=np.float32)
ROLES = (("w1", "gate"), ("w3", "up"), ("w2", "down"))


def decode_mxfp4(raw, n_in):
    """ggml MXFP4 blocks (32 values in 17 bytes: E8M0 scale, 16 code bytes) -> float32 [rows, n_in]"""
    b = raw.reshape(-1, 17)
    e = b[:, 0].astype(np.int32)
    d = np.where(e == 0, np.float32(2.0 ** -127), np.ldexp(np.float32(1.0), e - 128)).astype(np.float32)
    q = b[:, 1:]
    return (np.concatenate([MXFP4_LUT[q & 15], MXFP4_LUT[q >> 4]], axis=1) * d[:, None]).reshape(-1, n_in)


def read_pack(path):
    files, tensors, cfg = {}, {}, {}
    for line in open(os.path.join(path, "tensors.txt"), encoding="utf-8"):
        f = line.split()
        if f and f[0] == "file":
            files[int(f[1])] = line.split(None, 2)[2].strip()
        elif f and f[0] == "t":
            tensors[f[1]] = (f[2], int(f[3]), int(f[4]), int(f[5]), [int(x) for x in f[6:]])
    for line in open(os.path.join(path, "ds4.txt"), encoding="utf-8"):
        k, _, v = line.strip().partition(" ")
        cfg[k] = v
    return files, tensors, cfg


def align(n, a=4096):
    return (n + a - 1) // a * a


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--pack", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--layers", required=True, help="comma list")
    ap.add_argument("--type", required=True, choices=sorted(TYPES))
    ap.add_argument("--cfg", default="fast", choices=sorted(CFGS))
    ap.add_argument("--experts", type=int, default=0, help="only the first N experts (tests; the others stay zero streams)")
    ap.add_argument("--act", default="", help="calibration dir with L<l>_gu.f64 [n_exp][dim], L<l>_dn.f64 [n_exp][ff] (sums of x^2 of the "
                    "gate/up and down inputs per expert) and L<l>_cnt.u64 [n_exp]: an input-column weighted encode (error = sum h (w - dec)^2)")
    ap.add_argument("--prior", type=float, default=64.0, help="pseudo-count of the layer-mean prior for rarely used experts")
    ap.add_argument("--threads", type=int, default=4)
    ap.add_argument("--cpu", action="store_true", help="the CPU encoder instead of the card")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    t = TYPES[a.type]
    cfg = CFGS[a.cfg]
    files, tensors, pcfg = read_pack(a.pack)
    model_dir = pcfg["model_dir"]
    n_exp = int(pcfg["n_routed_experts"])
    ff, dim = int(pcfg["moe_intermediate_size"]), int(pcfg["hidden_size"])
    n_do = a.experts or n_exp
    os.makedirs(a.out, exist_ok=True)
    idx_path = os.path.join(a.out, "tq.json")
    idx = json.load(open(idx_path)) if os.path.exists(idx_path) else {}
    bb = tqenc.block_bytes(t)
    mm = {}
    gpu_lock = threading.Lock()
    for L in [int(x) for x in a.layers.split(",")]:
        path = os.path.join(a.out, "tq-L%d.bin" % L)
        if all("layers.%d.ffn.experts.%s" % (L, r) in idx for r, _ in ROLES) and os.path.exists(path):
            print("layer %d: already in %s, skipped" % (L, idx_path), flush=True)
            continue
        sizes = {}
        offs = {}
        off = 0
        for role, _ in ROLES:
            rows, cols = (ff, dim) if role != "w2" else (dim, ff)
            sizes[role] = (rows, cols, n_exp * rows * (cols // 128) * bb)
            offs[role] = off
            off += align(sizes[role][2])
        with open(path, "wb") as f:
            f.truncate(off)
        fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDWR)
        act = None
        if a.act:
            gu = np.fromfile("%s/L%d_gu.f64" % (a.act, L), dtype=np.float64).reshape(n_exp, dim)
            dn = np.fromfile("%s/L%d_dn.f64" % (a.act, L), dtype=np.float64).reshape(n_exp, ff)
            cnt = np.fromfile("%s/L%d_cnt.u64" % (a.act, L), dtype=np.uint64).astype(np.float64)
            tot = max(cnt.sum(), 1.0)
            act = (gu, dn, cnt, gu.sum(0) / tot, dn.sum(0) / tot)
        for role, rname in ROLES:
            rows, cols, total = sizes[role]
            t0 = time.time()
            per_out = rows * (cols // 128) * bb
            names = ["layers.%d.ffn.experts.%d.%s.weight" % (L, e, role) for e in range(n_do)]
            err2 = np.zeros(n_do)
            ref2 = np.zeros(n_do)

            def one(e):
                dt, fi, off_, nb, shape = tensors[names[e]]
                if dt != "MXFP4":
                    raise SystemExit("%s is %s, not MXFP4: only MXFP4 sources are re-encoded" % (names[e], dt))
                key = files[fi]
                if key not in mm:
                    mm[key] = np.memmap(os.path.join(model_dir, key), dtype=np.uint8, mode="r")
                w = decode_mxfp4(np.asarray(mm[key][off_:off_ + nb]), cols)
                h = None
                if act is not None:   # the input columns' mean x^2 of this expert, shrunk toward the layer's mean by the prior
                    gu_, dn_, cnt_, mg, md = act
                    sq, m = (dn_[e], md) if role == "w2" else (gu_[e], mg)
                    hc = (sq + a.prior * m) / (cnt_[e] + a.prior)
                    hc = np.maximum(hc / hc.mean(), 1e-3).astype(np.float32)
                    h = np.ascontiguousarray(np.broadcast_to(hc, (rows, cols)))
                with gpu_lock:
                    packed, err, tot, st = tqenc.encode(w, t, h=h, gpu=not a.cpu, **cfg)
                dec = tqenc.decode(packed, t).reshape(rows, cols)
                err2[e] = ((w.astype(np.float64) - dec) ** 2).sum()
                ref2[e] = (w.astype(np.float64) ** 2).sum()
                os.pwrite(fd, packed.tobytes(), offs[role] + e * per_out)
                return st["nonfinite_blocks"]

            with cf.ThreadPoolExecutor(a.threads) as ex:
                nonfin = sum(ex.map(one, range(n_do)))
            print("layer %d %s: %d experts %s %.0f s, rel mse %.4f (sqnr %.2f dB), nonfinite blocks %d" %
                  (L, rname, n_do, a.type, time.time() - t0, err2.sum() / ref2.sum(), 10 * np.log10(ref2.sum() / err2.sum()), nonfin), flush=True)
            idx["layers.%d.ffn.experts.%s" % (L, role)] = [tqenc.TYPE_NAMES[t], os.path.basename(path), offs[role], total, [n_exp, rows, cols]]
        os.fsync(fd)
        os.close(fd)
        json.dump(idx, open(idx_path, "w"), indent=1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


## tools/dsv41/tune.py

"""A short tune for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (strata-dsv41): the few settings the engine has, measured on this computer.

    python tools/dsv41/tune.py --config <launch config .json> [--mode quick|thorough] [--runs N]

What it does (a few short decode runs through the engine's own command line; each loads the model, so about 1-3 minutes each):
  1. the launch's own settings (the baseline);
  2. the same with the DSpark drafter forced on (`--dspark on --dspark-conf 0.65`) against `--dspark auto`, which leaves it unloaded on a
     small card: kept only when it is clearly faster; with it on, a draft block of 3 against the pack's own (5);
  3. the CPU threads: the number of physical cores against every logical thread (SMT), when they differ: kept only when clearly faster.
The RAM store (`--ssd-cache`) sizes itself from the free memory at start, so it is left as the engine's own; the line says so.
A setting is changed only for a gain of more than 5% (run-to-run noise on this engine is about 5%).  Whatever is kept is written into
the config's args; a run that fails or a computer that is too busy leaves the config as it was, with one plain line.  Always exits 0.
The context stays what the person chose.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))

GAIN = 1.05
DECODE = re.compile(r"decode:\s*\d+ tokens in [\d.]+ ms \(([\d.]+) tok/s\)")


def say(msg: str) -> None:
    print(msg, flush=True)


def parse_speed(stderr: str) -> float | None:
    m = DECODE.findall(stderr or "")
    return float(m[-1]) if m else None


def drop(args: list[str], flag: str) -> list[str]:
    """`args` without `flag` and its value."""
    out, i = [], 0
    while i < len(args):
        if args[i] == flag:
            i += 2
            continue
        out.append(args[i])
        i += 1
    return out


def with_flag(args: list[str], flag: str, *values: str) -> list[str]:
    return [*drop(args, flag), flag, *values]


def physical_cores() -> int | None:
    try:
        import psutil
        return psutil.cpu_count(logical=False)
    except Exception:                                    # noqa: BLE001
        return None


def measure(exe: str, args: list[str], ids_file: Path, n: int, timeout: int, env: dict) -> float | None:
    """Decode tokens a second of one CLI run, or None when it did not run to the end."""
    cmd = [exe, *[a for a in args if a not in ("--serve",)], "--ids", "@" + str(ids_file), "--n", str(n)]
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=timeout, env=env)
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
        return None
    if r.returncode != 0:
        return None
    return parse_speed(r.stderr)


def prompt_ids(pack: Path) -> list[int]:
    import smoke
    tok = smoke.tokenizer(pack)
    return tok.encode(smoke.PROMPT, parse_special=True)


def lib_env(cfg: dict) -> dict:
    env = dict(os.environ)
    dirs = [str(d) for d in cfg.get("lib_dirs") or [] if d]
    key = "PATH" if os.name == "nt" else "LD_LIBRARY_PATH"
    if dirs:
        env[key] = os.pathsep.join(dirs + [env.get(key, "")])
    return env


def tune(config: Path, mode: str = "quick", n: int = 48, timeout: int = 1500, measure_fn=measure) -> dict:
    """Returns {"changed": [...], "speeds": {...}, "lines": [plain sentences]}; writes the config when something was kept."""
    cfg = json.loads(config.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    exe, args = cfg.get("exe"), [str(a) for a in cfg.get("args") or []]
    res = {"changed": [], "speeds": {}, "lines": []}
    if not exe or "--pack" not in args:
        res["lines"].append("This launch has no DeepSeek engine settings to tune, so it starts as it is.")
        return res
    pack = Path(args[args.index("--pack") + 1])
    env = lib_env(cfg)
    try:
        ids = prompt_ids(pack)
    except Exception as e:                                # noqa: BLE001
        res["lines"].append(f"The tuner could not prepare its test question ({e}), so the standard settings run.")
        return res
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        f = Path(d) / "ids.txt"
        f.write_text(",".join(str(i) for i in ids), encoding="ascii")
        base_args = [a for a in args if a != "--serve"]
        say("Tuning DeepSeek: measuring the standard settings first ...")
        base = measure_fn(exe, base_args, f, n, timeout, env)
        if base is None:
            res["lines"].append("The standard settings did not finish a test run here, so nothing was tuned and they stay as they are.")
            return res
        res["speeds"]["standard"] = base
        best, best_args = base, base_args
        say(f"  standard settings: {base:.2f} tokens a second")
        trials = [("the drafter on (DSpark)", lambda a: with_flag(with_flag(a, "--dspark", "on"), "--dspark-conf", "0.65"))]
        trials.append(("a shorter draft block (3)", lambda a: with_flag(a, "--dspark-block", "3")))
        cores, logical = physical_cores(), os.cpu_count() or 0
        if cores and logical and logical > cores and "--cpu-threads" not in base_args:
            trials.append((f"{cores} CPU threads (one for each physical core)", lambda a, c=cores: with_flag(a, "--cpu-threads", str(c))))
        if mode == "thorough" and cores:
            trials.append(("every logical CPU thread", lambda a, c=logical: with_flag(a, "--cpu-threads", str(c))))
        queue = list(trials)
        while queue:
            label, make = queue.pop(0)
            if label == "a shorter draft block (3)":
                if "on" != (best_args[best_args.index("--dspark") + 1] if "--dspark" in best_args else ""):
                    continue                                       # only with the drafter on: with `auto` it may not even be loaded
            cand = make(best_args)
            say(f"  trying {label} ...")
            v = measure_fn(exe, cand, f, n, timeout, env)
            if v is None:
                res["lines"].append(f"The test with {label} did not finish; that setting stays as it was.")
                continue
            res["speeds"][label] = v
            say(f"    {v:.2f} tokens a second")
            if v > best * GAIN:
                best, best_args = v, cand
                res["changed"].append(label)
    tried = ", ".join(f"{k} {v:.1f}" for k, v in res["speeds"].items())
    if res["changed"]:
        new = [a for a in best_args]
        cfg["args"] = new
        cfg.setdefault("tuned", {})["dsv41"] = {"speeds": res["speeds"], "changed": res["changed"]}
        config.write_text(json.dumps(cfg, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
        res["lines"].append(f"Done: {', '.join(res['changed'])} - answers about {100 * (best / base - 1):.0f}% faster "
                            f"({base:.1f} -> {best:.1f} tokens a second). The RAM store sizes itself when the model starts.")
    else:
        res["lines"].append(f"Your computer already runs DeepSeek best with the standard settings ({base:.1f} tokens a second); nothing changed.")
    if len(res["speeds"]) > 1:
        res["lines"].append(f"Tried (tokens a second): {tried}.")
    else:
        res["lines"].append("Only the standard settings could be timed here, so there was nothing to compare.")
    return res


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--config", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--mode", default="quick", choices=["quick", "thorough"])
    ap.add_argument("--tokens", type=int, default=48)
    ap.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=1500)
    ap.add_argument("--output", default="human")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    try:
        res = tune(Path(a.config), a.mode, a.tokens, a.timeout)
    except Exception as e:                                # noqa: BLE001 - a tune never stops a launch
        res = {"changed": [], "speeds": {}, "lines": [f"The tuner stopped ({type(e).__name__}), so the standard settings run."]}
    for line in res["lines"]:
        say(line)
    if a.output == "json":
        say(json.dumps({"result": res}))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())


## tools/dsv41/vision_pack.py

# Copyright (c) 2026 Peasant Smith and the Project Maya contributors (MIT; https://github.com/mw00/project-maya, v1.1.17).
# Ported into Strata (third_party/project-maya/NOTICE.md, LICENSE); changes are in the git history of this file.
"""tools/ds4/vision_pack.py - DeepSeek-V4.1's vision tower (the part of the model that reads pictures, which the GGUFs
leave out) for a GGUF install: shard 1 of DeepSeek's own checkpoint (model-00001-of-00048, the tower's vision.* and the
aligner's aligner.* tensors, BF16, nothing else) and config.json (their geometry) from download_gguf.json's "vision"
entry, plus the picture span's three marker rows (image_start, image_newline, image_end: BF16 [5120]), which sit beside
the embedding in shard 2 - only their 30 KB are read from it, with an HTTP range request, never the 1.3 GB file.

    python tools/ds4/vision_pack.py --dir <folder with shard 1 and config.json>     -> vision.bin + vision.json there

vision.bin holds every tensor exactly as the checkpoint has it (copied, 256-byte aligned) and then the three marker
rows; it is read back and compared with the shard bit for bit before it is kept.  vision.json lists every tensor (name,
dtype, offset, bytes, shape) as tensors.txt does, and the geometry the engine reads (vision.<key> from config.json's
vision_config, image_token_id); pack_gguf.py adds both to the pack.

The marker rows: the shard's header (a range request), then the rows (one range request), each row's sha256 checked
against the manifest's.  A server that answers a range request with the whole file (status 200, not 206) is cut off at
once, the request is tried once more, then this stops with the reason - nothing large is ever downloaded here.
--marks-url takes another URL, or a local file (a mirror, the tests).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import struct
import sys
import time
import urllib.request

import numpy as np

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
MANIFEST = HERE / "download_gguf.json"
HF = "https://huggingface.co/{repo}/resolve/{revision}/{path}"
ALIGN = 256
MARKS = ("image_start", "image_newline", "image_end")   # (the order in vision.bin)
TRIES = 2                                               # a range request and one retry


class RangeError(Exception):
    pass


def manifest_entry(path: pathlib.Path = MANIFEST) -> dict:
    v = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("vision") or {}
    if not v.get("files") or not v.get("marks"):
        raise SystemExit(f"{path}: no \"vision\" entry")
    return v


def read_range(url: str, start: int, n: int, total: int | None = None, timeout: int = 60) -> bytes:
    """Bytes start .. start + n - 1 of a file: a URL with a range request (exactly those bytes, status 206 - anything
    else is cut off unread: RangeError), or a local file / file:// URL read at the offset."""
    if not url.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
        p = pathlib.Path(url[7:] if url.startswith("file://") else url)
        with p.open("rb") as f:
            f.seek(start)
            b = f.read(n)
        if len(b) != n:
            raise RangeError(f"{p}: {len(b)} of {n} bytes at {start}")
        return b
    end = start + n - 1
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "maya-setup", "Range": f"bytes={start}-{end}",
                                               "Accept-Encoding": "identity"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
            cr = r.headers.get("Content-Range", "")
            want = f"bytes {start}-{end}/"
            if r.status != 206 or not cr.startswith(want) or (total and cr != f"{want}{total}"):
                # (the whole file, or other bytes: the connection is closed here without reading the body)
                raise RangeError(f"the server answered status {r.status} ({cr or 'no Content-Range'}) to a request for "
                                 f"bytes {start}-{end}, not just those bytes")
            b = r.read(n + 1)
    except OSError as e:
        raise RangeError(str(e)) from e
    if len(b) != n:
        raise RangeError(f"{len(b)} bytes arrived for a range of {n}")
    return b


def fetch_marks(url: str, marks: dict, tries: int = TRIES) -> dict:
    """The marker rows {name: bytes} from shard 2 at `url`: its header (where they are), then the rows, every row's
    sha256 checked.  Each step is tried `tries` times; then SystemExit with the reason."""
    rows = marks["rows"]
    total = marks.get("bytes")
    why = ""
    for attempt in range(tries):
        try:
            n = struct.unpack("<Q", read_range(url, 0, 8, total))[0]
            if not 0 < n < 1 << 24:
                raise RangeError(f"a safetensors header of {n} bytes")
            head = json.loads(read_range(url, 8, n, total))
            base = 8 + n
            at = {}
            for name, (off, nb, _sha) in rows.items():
                e = head.get(name) or {}
                a, b = e.get("data_offsets") or (None, None)
                if e.get("dtype") != "BF16" or a is None or base + a != off or b - a != nb:
                    raise RangeError(f"{name} is not where the manifest says ({e or 'not in the header'})")
                at[name] = (off, nb)
            lo = min(o for o, _ in at.values())
            hi = max(o + nb for o, nb in at.values())
            if hi - lo > 1 << 20:
                raise RangeError(f"the marker rows span {hi - lo} bytes: not read in one piece")
            blob = read_range(url, lo, hi - lo, total)
            out = {}
            for name, (off, nb) in at.items():
                out[name] = blob[off - lo:off - lo + nb]
                if hashlib.sha256(out[name]).hexdigest() != rows[name][2]:
                    raise RangeError(f"{name}: the sha256 does not match the manifest's")
            return out
        except (RangeError, ValueError) as e:
            why = str(e)
            if attempt + 1 < tries:
                print(f"vision: the marker rows: {why}; trying once more ...", file=sys.stderr)
                time.sleep(2)
    raise SystemExit(f"vision: the picture markers (30 KB of {marks['file']}) could not be read: {why}.  Nothing large "
                     "was downloaded.  Check the connection and run the setup again (or --no-vision: text only).")


def shard(path: pathlib.Path):
    raw = np.memmap(path, np.uint8, mode="r")
    n = struct.unpack("<Q", bytes(raw[:8]))[0]
    head = json.loads(bytes(raw[8:8 + n]))
    head.pop("__metadata__", None)
    return raw, head, 8 + n


def geometry(cfg: dict) -> dict:
    """pack.py's vision keys: vision.<key> for config.json's numeric vision_config entries, and image_token_id."""
    out = {}
    for k, v in (cfg.get("vision_config") or {}).items():
        if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool):
            out["vision.%s" % k] = v
    if isinstance(cfg.get("image_token_id"), int):
        out["image_token_id"] = cfg["image_token_id"]
    if not out.get("vision.num_hidden_layers") or "image_token_id" not in out:
        raise SystemExit("config.json: no vision_config / image_token_id")
    return out


def pack(d: pathlib.Path, man: dict, marks_url: str | None = None) -> dict:
    names = [n for n in man["files"] if n.endswith(".safetensors")]
    if len(names) != 1:
        raise SystemExit("the manifest's vision entry: one safetensors shard expected")
    src = d / names[0]
    if not src.is_file() or src.stat().st_size != man["files"][names[0]][0]:
        raise SystemExit(f"{src}: missing or not whole")
    geo = geometry(json.loads((d / "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
    mk = man["marks"]
    url = marks_url or HF.format(repo=man["repo"], revision=man["revision"], path=mk["file"])
    rows = fetch_marks(url, mk)
    raw, head, base = shard(src)
    order = sorted(head, key=lambda t: head[t]["data_offsets"][0])
    for t in order:
        if not t.startswith(("vision.", "aligner.")):
            raise SystemExit(f"{src.name}: {t} is not the vision tower's")
    entries, off = [], 0
    part = d / "vision.bin.part"
    with part.open("wb") as f:
        def put(name, dtype, shape, b):
            nonlocal off
            f.write(b)
            entries.append([name, dtype, off, len(b), list(shape)])
            off += len(b)
            pad = (-off) % ALIGN
            f.write(b"\0" * pad)
            off += pad
        for t in order:
            e = head[t]
            a, b = e["data_offsets"]
            put(t, e["dtype"], e["shape"], raw[base + a:base + b].tobytes())
        for name in MARKS:
            put(name, "BF16", [len(rows[name]) // 2], rows[name])
    # read back: every tensor as the checkpoint has it, bit for bit
    back = np.memmap(part, np.uint8, mode="r")
    for name, _dt, o, nb, _shape in entries:
        if name in rows:
            ok = back[o:o + nb].tobytes() == rows[name]
        else:
            a, b = head[name]["data_offsets"]
            ok = np.array_equal(back[o:o + nb], raw[base + a:base + b])
        if not ok:
            raise SystemExit(f"vision.bin: {name} differs from the checkpoint after the copy")
    del back, raw
    part.replace(d / "vision.bin")
    info = {"from": {"repo": man["repo"], "revision": man["revision"], "files": sorted(man["files"]),
                     "marks": mk["file"]}, "config": geo, "tensors": entries}
    (d / "vision.json").write_text(json.dumps(info))
    return info


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--dir", required=True, help="the folder with shard 1 and config.json")
    ap.add_argument("--manifest", default=str(MANIFEST))
    ap.add_argument("--marks-url", help="shard 2 elsewhere (a URL or a local file; default: Hugging Face, pinned)")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    d = pathlib.Path(a.dir)
    info = pack(d, manifest_entry(pathlib.Path(a.manifest)), a.marks_url)
    nb = sum(e[3] for e in info["tensors"])
    print(f"vision.bin: {len(info['tensors'])} tensors ({nb / 1e9:.2f} GB), every one equal to the checkpoint's; "
          f"{info['config']['vision.num_hidden_layers']} blocks, image token {info['config']['image_token_id']}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())


## tools/dsv41/win/cachesim.py

"""cachesim.py - offline expert-cache policies on routing traces (DS4_TRACE files of strata-dsv41).

A trace is a run of records: u8 layer, u8 T (bit 7: guesses follow), T x k int16 expert ids [, u8 na1, u8 na2, T x (na1 + na2)
int16 guesses for the next layer and the one after].  One decode step (or verify window) is the records of layers 0..nl-1 in order.

Sizes are in bytes (an expert's real size in its layer: sizes.json), capacities in GB.  Policies:
  lru        one global LRU over (layer, expert)
  lfu        frequency with exponential decay (LRFU / CRF), evicts the lowest score
  static     the N hottest by training-trace frequency (a shipped per-set profile), no adaptation
  static+lru half the capacity pinned from the profile, half LRU
  belady     the offline optimum (farthest next use): the ceiling for any predictor of reuse
  lru+ahead  LRU plus a prefetch of the guesses for the next layer (top m): counts the wasted bytes
Reports: hit rate (by accesses and by bytes), SSD bytes per token (misses + wasted prefetch), the share of misses a guess covered.
"""
import argparse
import collections
import heapq
import json
import math
import os
import struct
import sys


WARM = 0   # accesses before this index warm the cache but are not counted


def read_trace(path, k=6):
    """-> list of steps; a step = list of (layer, [rows of expert ids], guesses or None)."""
    data = open(path, 'rb').read()
    pos, n = 0, len(data)
    steps, cur, last_layer = [], [], -1
    while pos + 2 <= n:
        layer, t = data[pos], data[pos + 1]
        pos += 2
        has_ahead = bool(t & 0x80)
        t &= 0x7f
        rows = []
        for _ in range(t):
            rows.append(list(struct.unpack_from('<%dh' % k, data, pos)))
            pos += 2 * k
        guesses = None
        if has_ahead:
            na1, na2 = data[pos], data[pos + 1]
            pos += 2
            guesses = []
            for _ in range(t):
                g1 = list(struct.unpack_from('<%dh' % na1, data, pos)) if na1 else []
                pos += 2 * na1
                g2 = list(struct.unpack_from('<%dh' % na2, data, pos)) if na2 else []
                pos += 2 * na2
                guesses.append((g1, g2))
        if layer <= last_layer and cur:
            steps.append(cur)
            cur = []
        last_layer = layer
        cur.append((layer, rows, guesses))
    if cur:
        steps.append(cur)
    return steps


def accesses(steps):
    """the flat access stream: (step, layer, expert) with the union over a window's rows, in layer order"""
    out = []
    for si, st in enumerate(steps):
        for layer, rows, _ in st:
            seen = []
            for r in rows:
                for e in r:
                    if e not in seen:
                        seen.append(e)
            for e in seen:
                out.append((si, layer, e))
    return out


class Sizes:
    def __init__(self, path):
        d = json.load(open(path))
        el = d['exp_layer']
        self.s = {int(k): float(v) for k, v in el.items()}

    def __call__(self, layer):
        return self.s.get(layer, 8.6e6)


def sim_lru(acc, size, cap):
    od = collections.OrderedDict()
    used = hits = hitb = tot = totb = 0
    for i, (_, l, e) in enumerate(acc):
        k = (l, e)
        sz = size(l)
        cnt = i >= WARM
        tot += cnt
        totb += sz * cnt
        if k in od:
            od.move_to_end(k)
            hits += cnt
            hitb += sz * cnt
            continue
        od[k] = sz
        used += sz
        while used > cap:
            _, s0 = od.popitem(last=False)
            used -= s0
    return hits, hitb, tot, totb


def sim_lfu(acc, size, cap, half_life_acc=20000):
    lam = math.log(2) / half_life_acc
    score, last, res = {}, {}, {}
    heap = []
    used = hits = hitb = tot = totb = 0
    for t, (_, l, e) in enumerate(acc):
        k = (l, e)
        sz = size(l)
        cnt = t >= WARM
        tot += cnt
        totb += sz * cnt
        # CRF: decayed count, kept in log space: v = log(count) + lam * t
        if k in res:
            hits += cnt
            hitb += sz * cnt
        old = score.get(k)
        v = lam * t
        score[k] = v if old is None else v + math.log1p(math.exp(old - v)) if old - v < 50 else old
        if k not in res:
            res[k] = sz
            used += sz
        heapq.heappush(heap, (score[k], k))
        while used > cap and heap:
            sc, kk = heapq.heappop(heap)
            if kk not in res or score[kk] != sc:
                continue
            if kk == k and len(res) == 1:
                break
            used -= res.pop(kk)
    return hits, hitb, tot, totb


def freq_table(acc):
    c = collections.Counter((l, e) for _, l, e in acc)
    return c


def pick_static(freq, size, cap):
    keys = sorted(freq, key=lambda k: -freq[k] / size(k[0]))
    chosen, used = set(), 0
    for k in keys:
        s = size(k[0])
        if used + s > cap:
            continue
        chosen.add(k)
        used += s
    return chosen


def sim_static(acc, size, chosen):
    hits = hitb = tot = totb = 0
    for i, (_, l, e) in enumerate(acc):
        sz = size(l)
        cnt = i >= WARM
        tot += cnt
        totb += sz * cnt
        if (l, e) in chosen:
            hits += cnt
            hitb += sz * cnt
    return hits, hitb, tot, totb


def sim_static_lru(acc, size, cap, chosen, pinned_bytes):
    od = collections.OrderedDict()
    used = hits = hitb = tot = totb = 0
    room = cap - pinned_bytes
    for i, (_, l, e) in enumerate(acc):
        k = (l, e)
        sz = size(l)
        cnt = i >= WARM
        tot += cnt
        totb += sz * cnt
        if k in chosen:
            hits += cnt
            hitb += sz * cnt
            continue
        if k in od:
            od.move_to_end(k)
            hits += cnt
            hitb += sz * cnt
            continue
        od[k] = sz
        used += sz
        while used > room:
            _, s0 = od.popitem(last=False)
            used -= s0
    return hits, hitb, tot, totb


def sim_belady(acc, size, cap):
    n = len(acc)
    nxt = [0] * n
    last = {}
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        k = (acc[i][1], acc[i][2])
        nxt[i] = last.get(k, n + 1)
        last[k] = i
    res = {}   # k -> next use
    heap = []  # (-next use, k)
    used = hits = hitb = tot = totb = 0
    for i, (_, l, e) in enumerate(acc):
        k = (l, e)
        sz = size(l)
        cnt = i >= WARM
        tot += cnt
        totb += sz * cnt
        if k in res:
            hits += cnt
            hitb += sz * cnt
            res[k] = nxt[i]
            heapq.heappush(heap, (-nxt[i], k))
            continue
        if nxt[i] > n:      # never used again: do not keep
            continue
        res[k] = nxt[i]
        used += sz
        heapq.heappush(heap, (-nxt[i], k))
        while used > cap and heap:
            nu, kk = heapq.heappop(heap)
            if kk not in res or res[kk] != -nu:
                continue
            used -= size(kk[0])
            del res[kk]
    return hits, hitb, tot, totb


def sim_lru_ahead(steps, size, cap, m=6, depth=1):
    """LRU + prefetch of the top-m guesses (from the record of layer L-1 for layer L): a miss that a guess covered is a 'hidden'
    miss (its read started a layer early), a guess nobody used is wasted bytes."""
    od = collections.OrderedDict()
    used = 0
    hits = tot = miss = hidden = 0
    ssd = 0.0
    wasted = 0.0
    pend = {}   # (layer, expert) -> bytes prefetched, not yet used this step
    nsteps = len(steps)

    def put(k, sz):
        nonlocal used
        if k in od:
            od.move_to_end(k)
            return
        od[k] = sz
        used += sz
        while used > cap:
            _, s0 = od.popitem(last=False)
            used -= s0

    for st in steps:
        pend.clear()
        for layer, rows, guesses in st:
            sz = size(layer)
            seen = []
            for r in rows:
                for e in r:
                    if e not in seen:
                        seen.append(e)
            for e in seen:
                k = (layer, e)
                tot += 1
                if k in pend:
                    hidden += 1
                    del pend[k]
                    miss += 1
                    put(k, sz)
                elif k in od:
                    hits += 1
                    od.move_to_end(k)
                else:
                    miss += 1
                    ssd += sz
                    put(k, sz)
            for k, b in list(pend.items()):
                if k[0] <= layer:
                    wasted += b
                    del pend[k]
            if guesses:
                nl = layer + 1
                gs = []
                for g1, g2 in guesses:
                    for e in g1[:m]:
                        if e not in gs:
                            gs.append(e)
                for e in gs:
                    k = (nl, e)
                    if k in od or k in pend:
                        continue
                    pend[k] = size(nl)
                    ssd += size(nl)
    for b in pend.values():
        wasted += b
    return dict(hit=hits / max(1, tot), hidden=hidden / max(1, tot), ssd_per_step_MB=ssd / max(1, nsteps) / 1e6,
                wasted_per_step_MB=wasted / max(1, nsteps) / 1e6)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('traces', nargs='+', help='trace files: all are test sets; --train-on names the profile source')
    ap.add_argument('--sizes', default='C:/ds-ista-work/sizes.json')
    ap.add_argument('--caps', default='20,30,40,44', help='cache sizes in GB (VRAM hot set + pinned RAM)')
    ap.add_argument('--train', nargs='*', default=[], help='traces the static profile is built from (others than the test)')
    ap.add_argument('--warm-steps', type=int, default=0, help='steps at the start that fill the cache but are not counted')
    ap.add_argument('--skip', default='', help='policies to skip (comma): lru,lfu,static,static+lru,belady,ahead')
    a = ap.parse_args()
    size = Sizes(a.sizes)
    global WARM
    skip = set(a.skip.split(','))
    train_acc = []
    for t in a.train:
        train_acc += accesses(read_trace(t))
    for path in a.traces:
        steps = read_trace(path)
        acc = accesses(steps)
        nsteps = len(steps)
        WARM = 0
        if a.warm_steps:
            WARM = next((i for i, x in enumerate(acc) if x[0] >= a.warm_steps), len(acc))
            nsteps -= a.warm_steps
        uniq = len({(l, e) for _, l, e in acc})
        print('   unique experts touched: %d of 15360 (%.1f%%), %.1f GB' % (uniq, 100 * uniq / 15360, sum(size(l) for l, e in {(l, e) for _, l, e in acc}) / 1e9))
        print('== %s: %d steps, %d expert accesses (%.1f a step)' % (os.path.basename(path), nsteps, len(acc), len(acc) / max(1, nsteps)))
        tb = sum(size(l) for _, l, _ in acc) / nsteps
        print('   bytes a step (union per layer): %.2f GB' % (tb / 1e9))
        print('   %-14s %6s %9s %9s %12s' % ('policy', 'capGB', 'hit(acc)', 'hit(bytes)', 'SSD MB/step'))
        for cg in [float(x) for x in a.caps.split(',')]:
            cap = cg * 1e9
            rows = []
            if 'lru' not in skip:
                rows.append(('lru', sim_lru(acc, size, cap)))
            if 'lfu' not in skip:
                rows.append(('lfu(decay)', sim_lfu(acc, size, cap)))
            if train_acc and 'static' not in skip:
                ch = pick_static(freq_table(train_acc), size, cap)
                rows.append(('static', sim_static(acc, size, ch)))
                ch2 = pick_static(freq_table(train_acc), size, cap / 2)
                rows.append(('static+lru', sim_static_lru(acc, size, cap, ch2, cap / 2)))
            if 'belady' not in skip:
                rows.append(('belady', sim_belady(acc, size, cap)))
            for name, (h, hb, t, tb_) in rows:
                print('   %-14s %6.0f %8.1f%% %8.1f%% %12.1f' % (name, cg, 100 * h / t, 100 * hb / tb_, (tb_ - hb) / nsteps / 1e6))
            if 'ahead' not in skip and any(g for st in steps for _, _, g in st):
                for m in (6, 8, 12):
                    r = sim_lru_ahead(steps, size, cap, m=m)
                    print('   lru+ahead(top%-2d) %4.0f   hit %.1f%% (+%.1f%% hidden)  SSD %.0f MB/step (wasted %.0f)' % (
                        m, cg, 100 * r['hit'], 100 * r['hidden'], r['ssd_per_step_MB'], r['wasted_per_step_MB']))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()


## tools/dsv41/win/h100sim.py

"""h100sim.py - replay the H100 routing corpus (1.78M tokens, code/agent/chat/multi/math/long, DS4_TRACE format, see
phaseA-tests/h100/trace_tools.py) through an LRU expert cache at this PC's sizes, with and without a profile warm start.

  h100sim.py <trace.bin[.zst]> <profile.bin> [--tokens N] [--skip S] [--caps 30,40,44] [--sizes sizes.json]

Prints the demand hit rate by bytes after a warm-up of `--warm` tokens, for: empty start LRU; LRU started with the profile's
hottest experts in (the engine's preload) and the same cold-start window's hit rate (first 2000 tokens), and a static top-N
(profile only, no adaptation)."""
import argparse
import collections
import io
import json
import struct
import sys

import numpy as np


def decode(path, max_tokens, skip):
    if path.endswith('.zst'):
        import zstandard
        raw = zstandard.ZstdDecompressor().stream_reader(open(path, 'rb')).read()
    else:
        raw = open(path, 'rb').read()
    buf = np.frombuffer(raw, dtype=np.uint8)
    pos, n = 0, len(buf)
    per = {l: [] for l in range(40)}
    got = [0] * 40
    while pos < n:
        b0 = int(buf[pos])
        if b0 & 0x80:
            l = b0 & 0x7F
            T = int(buf[pos + 1]) | (int(buf[pos + 2]) << 8)
            pos += 3
        else:
            l = b0
            T = int(buf[pos + 1]) & 0x7F
            pos += 2
        sz = T * 12
        if pos + sz > n:
            break
        per[l].append(buf[pos:pos + sz].view(np.int16).reshape(T, 6))
        pos += sz
        if min(got) >= skip + max_tokens:
            break
        got[l] += T
    arr = []
    for l in range(40):
        a = np.concatenate(per[l])[skip:skip + max_tokens]
        arr.append(a)
    m = min(len(a) for a in arr)
    return np.stack([a[:m] for a in arr], axis=1)   # [tokens][layer][6]


def lru(acc_iter, size, cap, init=None, warm=0):
    od = collections.OrderedDict()
    used = 0
    if init:
        for k in init:
            od[k] = size[k[0]]
            used += size[k[0]]
    hb = tb = 0.0
    first_hb = first_tb = 0.0
    for i, (t, k) in enumerate(acc_iter):
        sz = size[k[0]]
        cnt = t >= warm
        early = t < 2000
        if k in od:
            od.move_to_end(k)
            if cnt:
                hb += sz
            if early:
                first_hb += sz
        else:
            od[k] = sz
            used += sz
            while used > cap:
                _, s0 = od.popitem(last=False)
                used -= s0
        if cnt:
            tb += sz
        if early:
            first_tb += sz
    return 100 * hb / max(tb, 1), 100 * first_hb / max(first_tb, 1)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('trace')
    ap.add_argument('profile')
    ap.add_argument('--tokens', type=int, default=40000)
    ap.add_argument('--skip', type=int, default=0)
    ap.add_argument('--warm', type=int, default=4000)
    ap.add_argument('--caps', default='30,40')
    ap.add_argument('--sizes', default=r'C:\ds-ista-work\sizes.json')
    a = ap.parse_args()
    d = json.load(open(a.sizes))
    size = {int(k): float(v) for k, v in d['exp_layer'].items()}
    tr = decode(a.trace, a.tokens, a.skip)
    prof = np.fromfile(a.profile, dtype=np.uint32).reshape(-1, 384)[:40]
    print('trace', tr.shape, 'tokens', len(tr))

    def acc():
        for t in range(len(tr)):
            for l in range(40):
                for e in tr[t, l]:
                    yield t, (l, int(e))
    dens = sorted(((prof[l, e] / size[l], l, e) for l in range(40) for e in range(384)), reverse=True)
    for cg in [float(x) for x in a.caps.split(',')]:
        cap = cg * 1e9
        r0, f0 = lru(acc(), size, cap, None, a.warm)
        order, used = [], 0.0
        for _, l, e in dens:
            if used + size[l] > cap:
                break
            order.append((l, e))
            used += size[l]
        r1, f1 = lru(acc(), size, cap, list(reversed(order)), a.warm)   # hottest last = most recent
        # static: top-N of the profile, no adaptation
        sel = set(order)
        hb = tb = 0.0
        for t, k in acc():
            if t >= a.warm:
                tb += size[k[0]]
                if k in sel:
                    hb += size[k[0]]
        print('cap %.0f GB: LRU from empty: steady hit %.1f%% (first 2000 tokens %.1f%%); LRU from the profile\'s hottest: steady %.1f%% (first 2000 tokens %.1f%%); static top-N alone %.1f%%' % (
            cg, r0, f0, r1, f1, 100 * hb / tb))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()


## tools/dsv41/win/predsim.py

"""predsim.py - token-level prediction of a decode step's experts from the token history (n-gram match), as a prefetch into an LRU
cache, on DS4_TRACE decode traces.

  predsim.py <trace> <prompt ids file> <output ids file> [--cap GB] [--warm N] [--budget MB] [--k 2]

Before step i (its token known: the one the last step sampled) the experts of the step after the previous occurrence of the same
k-gram are the guess for every layer.  They are read ahead (up to --budget MB a step, hottest layers first), so a miss at use time
is only the ones the guess missed.  Reports demand hit rate, SSD MB a step (demand + wasted guesses) and the guess's recall /
precision.  The engine's lead time for these reads is a whole step (the SSD is idle while the CPU lane computes)."""
import argparse
import collections
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, r'C:\Users\AI-Server\Desktop\Strata\GitHub\wt-dsv41-win\tools\dsv41\win')
import cachesim as cs


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('trace')
    ap.add_argument('prompt')
    ap.add_argument('out')
    ap.add_argument('--cap', type=float, default=36.0)
    ap.add_argument('--warm', type=int, default=150)
    ap.add_argument('--budget', type=float, default=400.0, help='MB of reads ahead per step')
    ap.add_argument('--k', type=int, default=2)
    ap.add_argument('--sizes', default=r'C:\ds-ista-work\sizes.json')
    a = ap.parse_args()
    size = cs.Sizes(a.sizes)
    st = cs.read_trace(a.trace)
    p = [int(x) for x in open(a.prompt).read().strip().split(',')]
    o = [int(x) for x in open(a.out).read().strip().strip(',').split(',')]
    S = p + o
    cap = a.cap * 1e9
    routes = {}
    for i, s in enumerate(st):
        if i == 0:
            continue
        routes[i] = {layer: list(dict.fromkeys(rows[0])) for layer, rows, _ in s}
    pos = lambda i: len(p) + i - 1  # noqa: E731
    for mode in ('lru', 'lru+hist'):
        od = collections.OrderedDict()
        used = 0
        last = {}
        n = hit = 0
        demand_b = pref_b = wasted_b = 0.0
        rec = tot = prec = ptot = 0
        steps = 0
        for i in range(1, len(st)):
            key = tuple(S[pos(i) - a.k + 1:pos(i) + 1])
            pred = None
            if mode == 'lru+hist' and key in last:
                pred = routes[last[key]]
            last[key] = i
            counted = i >= a.warm
            pend = {}
            if pred is not None:
                budget = a.budget * 1e6
                for l in range(40):
                    for e in pred[l]:
                        kk = (l, e)
                        if kk in od or kk in pend:
                            continue
                        if budget < size(l):
                            continue
                        budget -= size(l)
                        pend[kk] = size(l)
                if counted:
                    pref_b += sum(pend.values())
                    for l in range(40):
                        a_ = set(routes[i][l])
                        b_ = set(pred[l])
                        rec += len(a_ & b_)
                        tot += len(a_)
                        prec += len(a_ & b_)
                        ptot += len(b_)
            steps += counted
            for l in range(40):
                sz = size(l)
                for e in routes[i][l]:
                    kk = (l, e)
                    if counted:
                        n += 1
                    if kk in od:
                        od.move_to_end(kk)
                        if counted:
                            hit += 1
                        continue
                    if kk in pend:   # read ahead: arrived in time
                        del pend[kk]
                        if counted:
                            hit += 1
                    elif counted:
                        demand_b += sz
                    od[kk] = sz
                    used += sz
                    while used > cap:
                        _, s0 = od.popitem(last=False)
                        used -= s0
            if counted:
                wasted_b += sum(pend.values())   # read ahead, not used this step (they stay in the cache only if inserted: not here)
        print('%-9s cap %.0f GB k=%d: demand hit %.1f%%; SSD per step: demand %.0f MB + guesses %.0f MB (wasted %.0f); guess recall %.1f%% precision %.1f%%' % (
            mode, a.cap, a.k, 100 * hit / max(1, n), demand_b / steps / 1e6, pref_b / steps / 1e6, wasted_b / steps / 1e6,
            100 * rec / max(1, tot), 100 * prec / max(1, ptot)))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()


## tools/early_close_test.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""A client that stops reading a streamed answer early must not leave its tokens to the next request.

  STRATA_KEY=... python3 tools/early_close_test.py http://127.0.0.1:8090
"""
import json, os, sys, threading, urllib.request

URL = sys.argv[1].rstrip("/") + "/v1/chat/completions"
KEY = os.environ.get("STRATA_KEY", "")


def req(content, stream, max_tokens=300):
    body = json.dumps({"model": "m", "max_tokens": max_tokens, "temperature": 0, "stream": stream,
                       "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}],
                       "chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": False}}).encode()
    return urllib.request.Request(URL, data=body, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json",
                                                           "Authorization": f"Bearer {KEY}"})


def early_close(content, keep_lines=5):
    r = urllib.request.urlopen(req(content, True), timeout=600)
    for _ in range(keep_lines):
        r.readline()
    r.close()                                   # the client goes away mid-answer


def answer(content):
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req(content, False, 60), timeout=600) as r:
        m = json.load(r)["choices"][0]["message"]
        return (m.get("content") or "") + " " + (m.get("reasoning_content") or m.get("reasoning") or "")


ok = True
# alone (solo path), then the same with a second request running (batch slots)
for label, background in (("solo", False), ("batch", True)):
    bg = None
    if background:
        bg = threading.Thread(target=answer, args=("Count slowly from 1 to 60, one number per line.",))
        bg.start()
    early_close("Describe the weather in Montpellier in great detail, at length.")
    a = answer("Reply with exactly one word: the color of the sky on a clear day.")
    good = "blue" in a.lower() and "montpellier" not in a.lower()
    ok &= good
    print(f"{label}: {'OK' if good else 'STALE'} -> {a[:120]!r}", flush=True)
    if bg:
        bg.join()
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)


## tools/embd_bf16_pack.py

"""tools/embd_bf16_pack.py - the token embedding exactly as the checkpoint ships it (BF16), as a GGUF the engine reads.

    python tools/embd_bf16_pack.py --model <checkpoint dir> --out <token-embd-bf16.gguf>

nvfp4_convert.py stores token_embd as Q8_0 (0.56% off per value). The engine keeps the table in mapped host memory
and reads one row per token, so BF16 costs 0.6 GB of RAM more and no VRAM; `--embd-gguf` takes it from this file.

The output is a one-tensor GGUF: `token_embd.weight`, ne = [n_embd, n_vocab], type BF16, the bytes copied straight
out of the safetensors file - nothing decoded or rounded.

    python tools/embd_bf16_pack.py --gguf <model.gguf> --out <token-embd-bf16.gguf>

instead dequantizes a GGUF's own token_embd.weight to BF16 (round-to-nearest-even, through gguf-py), for a file whose
embedding type has no GPU dequantizer in the engine (Agention's Gyro-S stores it as Q6_K).  That is the GGUF's values
rounded to BF16, not the checkpoint's.
"""
import argparse
import json
import pathlib
import struct
import sys

GGUF_TYPE_STRING = 8
GGML_TYPE_BF16 = 30
ALIGN = 32
CHUNK = 64 << 20


def safetensors_header(path):
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        n = struct.unpack("<Q", f.read(8))[0]
        return json.loads(f.read(n)), 8 + n


def gguf_string(s):
    b = s.encode("utf-8")
    return struct.pack("<Q", len(b)) + b


def kv_string(key, val):
    return gguf_string(key) + struct.pack("<I", GGUF_TYPE_STRING) + gguf_string(val)


def write_header(dim, vocab, source, what):
    kvs = [kv_string("general.architecture", "strata-embd"),
           kv_string("general.name", what),
           kv_string("strata.embd.source", source)]
    head = b"GGUF" + struct.pack("<IQQ", 3, 1, len(kvs)) + b"".join(kvs)
    head += gguf_string("token_embd.weight") + struct.pack("<I", 2) + struct.pack("<QQ", dim, vocab)
    head += struct.pack("<I", GGML_TYPE_BF16) + struct.pack("<Q", 0)
    head += b"\0" * ((-len(head)) % ALIGN)
    return head


def from_gguf(src, out):
    """token_embd.weight of a GGUF, dequantized and rounded to BF16 (nearest-even), in row chunks."""
    import numpy as np
    sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
    import gguf_reader as G
    from _paths import add_gguf_py
    add_gguf_py()
    from gguf import GGMLQuantizationType as Q, quants
    g = G.GGUFFile(src)
    t = next((t for t in g.tensors if t.name == "token_embd.weight"), None)
    if t is None or len(t.shape) != 2 or t.expected_bytes() is None:
        sys.exit("%s: no 2-D token_embd.weight of a known type" % src)
    dim, vocab = int(t.shape[0]), int(t.shape[1])
    row = t.expected_bytes() // vocab
    mm = np.memmap(src, dtype=np.uint8, mode="r")
    base = g.data_start + t.offset
    print("token_embd.weight: %d x %d %s -> BF16, %.2f GB" % (vocab, dim, t.type_name, vocab * dim * 2 / 1e9), flush=True)
    head = write_header(dim, vocab, src.name, "token embedding, %s dequantized to BF16" % t.type_name)
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tmp = out.with_suffix(out.suffix + ".part")
    rows = 8192
    with open(tmp, "wb") as w:
        w.write(head)
        for r0 in range(0, vocab, rows):
            r1 = min(vocab, r0 + rows)
            raw = np.asarray(mm[base + r0 * row: base + r1 * row]).reshape(r1 - r0, row)
            vals = quants.dequantize(raw, Q[t.type_name]).astype(np.float32)
            if not np.isfinite(vals).all():
                sys.exit("token_embd.weight has non-finite values")
            w.write(quants.quantize(vals, Q.BF16).tobytes())
    if tmp.stat().st_size != len(head) + vocab * dim * 2:
        sys.exit("size check failed")
    tmp.replace(out)
    print("wrote %s (header %d B)" % (out, len(head)))


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0])
    src = ap.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    src.add_argument("--model", help="the checkpoint directory (model.safetensors.index.json)")
    src.add_argument("--gguf", help="a model GGUF whose token_embd.weight is dequantized to BF16")
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    if a.gguf:
        from_gguf(pathlib.Path(a.gguf).absolute(), pathlib.Path(a.out))
        return
    model, out = pathlib.Path(a.model), pathlib.Path(a.out)
    wmap = json.loads((model / "model.safetensors.index.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["weight_map"]

    names = [n for n in wmap if n.endswith("embed_tokens.weight") and "visual" not in n and "mtp" not in n]
    if len(names) != 1:
        sys.exit("expected one text embed_tokens.weight in %s, found %s" % (model, names))
    name = names[0]
    hdr, base = safetensors_header(model / wmap[name])
    t = hdr[name]
    if t["dtype"] != "BF16" or len(t["shape"]) != 2:
        sys.exit("%s is %s %s, not a 2-D BF16 tensor" % (name, t["dtype"], t["shape"]))
    vocab, dim = t["shape"]
    n = vocab * dim * 2
    if t["data_offsets"][1] - t["data_offsets"][0] != n:
        sys.exit("%s: data size does not match its shape" % name)
    print("%s: %d x %d BF16, %.2f GB" % (name, vocab, dim, n / 1e9), flush=True)

    head = write_header(dim, vocab, model.name, "token embedding, BF16 as shipped")

    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tmp = out.with_suffix(out.suffix + ".part")
    with open(tmp, "wb") as w, open(model / wmap[name], "rb") as f:
        w.write(head)
        f.seek(base + t["data_offsets"][0])
        left = n
        while left:
            b = f.read(min(CHUNK, left))
            if not b:
                sys.exit("short read in " + str(model / wmap[name]))
            w.write(b)
            left -= len(b)
    if tmp.stat().st_size != len(head) + n:
        sys.exit("size check failed: %d != %d" % (tmp.stat().st_size, len(head) + n))
    tmp.replace(out)
    print("wrote %s (header %d B)" % (out, len(head)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


## tools/gguf_reader.py

"""Minimal GGUF v3 header reader - no ggml, no gguf-py.

Written because the `gguf` PyPI package cannot open this artifact: its `GGMLQuantizationType`
enum has no member for type 42 (`Q2_0`), which is newer than the library. That is itself a P0.S6
finding - the format this engine is specialized for is ahead of the standard tooling.

This is the reference implementation for `src/artifact/` (architecture §15: "GGUF v3 reader (mmap,
no ggml dependency)"). It parses the header only; tensor data is never read.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import dataclasses
import pathlib
import struct
from typing import Any

GGUF_MAGIC = 0x46554747  # "GGUF" little-endian

# ggml_type values. 42 = Q2_0, the GSQ-RCO routed-expert encoding, absent from gguf-py as of 0.19.
GGML_TYPES: dict[int, str] = {
    0: "F32", 1: "F16", 2: "Q4_0", 3: "Q4_1", 4: "Q4_2", 5: "Q4_3", 6: "Q5_0", 7: "Q5_1",
    8: "Q8_0", 9: "Q8_1", 10: "Q2_K", 11: "Q3_K", 12: "Q4_K", 13: "Q5_K", 14: "Q6_K",
    15: "Q8_K", 16: "IQ2_XXS", 17: "IQ2_XS", 18: "IQ3_XXS", 19: "IQ1_S", 20: "IQ4_NL",
    21: "IQ3_S", 22: "IQ2_S", 23: "IQ4_XS", 24: "I8", 25: "I16", 26: "I32", 27: "I64",
    28: "F64", 29: "IQ1_M", 30: "BF16", 31: "Q4_0_4_4", 32: "Q4_0_4_8", 33: "Q4_0_8_8",
    34: "TQ1_0", 35: "TQ2_0", 36: "IQ4_NL_4_4", 37: "IQ4_NL_4_8", 38: "IQ4_NL_8_8",
    39: "MXFP4", 40: "NVFP4", 41: "Q4_0_8_8", 42: "Q2_0",
    # Agention's llama.cpp fork (agentionai/llama.cpp): the APR trellis expert types (128-value blocks)
    143: "PTQ1_0", 144: "TQ2_T", 145: "TQK6", 146: "TQK7",
}

# GGUF metadata value type ids
GGUF_META = {
    0: ("u8", 1), 1: ("i8", 1), 2: ("u16", 2), 3: ("i16", 2), 4: ("u32", 4), 5: ("i32", 4),
    6: ("f32", 4), 7: ("bool", 1), 8: ("string", None), 9: ("array", None),
    10: ("u64", 8), 11: ("i64", 8), 12: ("f64", 8),
}

# ggml block geometry for the encodings this model uses: (block elements, bytes per block)
# This is what makes a per-tensor byte count checkable, and it is the contract the kernels share.
BLOCK_GEOMETRY: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {
    "F32": (1, 4), "F16": (1, 2), "BF16": (1, 2), "F64": (1, 8),
    "Q4_0": (32, 18), "Q4_1": (32, 20), "Q5_0": (32, 22), "Q5_1": (32, 24),
    "Q8_0": (32, 34), "Q8_1": (32, 36),
    "Q2_K": (256, 84), "Q3_K": (256, 110), "Q4_K": (256, 144), "Q5_K": (256, 176),
    "Q6_K": (256, 210), "Q8_K": (256, 292),
    "IQ2_XXS": (256, 66), "IQ2_XS": (256, 74), "IQ3_XXS": (256, 98), "IQ1_S": (256, 50),
    "IQ4_NL": (32, 18), "IQ3_S": (256, 110), "IQ2_S": (256, 82), "IQ4_XS": (256, 136),
    "IQ1_M": (256, 56), "Q2_0": (64, 18), "MXFP4": (32, 17), "NVFP4": (64, 36),
    # fp16 scale + trellis stream (32 steps x 8 / 6 / 7 bits); PTQ1_0: 26 B of trits + fp16 scale
