    pathlib.Path(a.out).write_text("\n".join(out), encoding="utf-8")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())


## tools/trellis/swap_compare.py

"""swap_compare.py - KL / NLL of Gyro-S swap variants against the Q8_0-swap reference, with paired differences.

  python3 tools/trellis/swap_compare.py REF.tsv shipped=RUN.tsv plain=RUN.tsv diag=RUN.tsv [...] [--base shipped]

Per run: mean KL(REF || run) over REF's top-64 (tools/quant_quality.py's definition), top-1 agreement with REF, mean negative
log-likelihood of the text (and its difference to REF's), each with a standard error over segments.  Then the paired
difference of every run against --base (same positions): mean +- standard error over segments, and the share of segments
where the run is better.  Per text kind (english / multilingual / code / docs / agent) too.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import math
import pathlib
import sys

import numpy as np

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE.parent))
import quant_quality as QQ  # noqa: E402


def per_position(ref, run):
    """{segment: (kl[], nll[], agree[])} for positions both runs have."""
    out = {}
    for name, rr in ref.items():
        ra = run.get(name, {})
        kls, nll, ag = [], [], []
        for q in sorted(set(rr) & set(ra)):
            tr, lr, topr, kr = rr[q]
            ta, la, topa, ka = ra[q]
            if tr != ta:
                raise SystemExit("%s pos %d: different text" % (name, q))
            da = dict(ka)
            floor = min(b for _, b in ka)
            pr = np.array([math.exp(b) for _, b in kr])
            pa = np.array([math.exp(da.get(i, floor)) for i, _ in kr])
            pr /= pr.sum()
            pa /= pa.sum()
            kls.append(float(np.sum(pr * np.log(pr / pa))))
            nll.append(-la)
            ag.append(float(topr == topa))
        if kls:
            out[name] = (np.array(kls), np.array(nll), np.array(ag))
    return out


def kind(name):
    return name.rsplit("_", 1)[0]


def se(x):
    return float(np.std(x, ddof=1) / math.sqrt(len(x))) if len(x) > 1 else float("nan")


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("ref")
    ap.add_argument("runs", nargs="+", help="label=file.tsv")
    ap.add_argument("--base", default=None)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    ref = QQ.read_run(a.ref)
    runs = {}
    for r in a.runs:
        lab, _, path = r.partition("=")
        runs[lab] = per_position(ref, QQ.read_run(path))
    runs.setdefault('ref', per_position(ref, ref))
    base = a.base or next(iter(runs))
    segs = sorted(set.intersection(*[set(v) for v in runs.values()]))
    kinds = sorted({kind(s) for s in segs})
    print("segments %d, positions %d (reference %s)\n" % (len(segs), sum(len(runs[base][s][0]) for s in segs), a.ref))

    def seg_mean(lab, idx, ss):
        return np.array([runs[lab][s][idx].mean() for s in ss])

    for title, ss in [("ALL", segs)] + [(k, [s for s in segs if kind(s) == k]) for k in kinds]:
        if not ss:
            continue
        print("== %s (%d segments)" % (title, len(ss)))
        print("  %-10s %-22s %-14s %-20s %s" % ("run", "KL(ref||run)", "top-1 vs ref", "NLL of the text", "paired KL difference vs " + base))
        for lab in runs:
            kl, ag, nl = seg_mean(lab, 0, ss), seg_mean(lab, 2, ss), seg_mean(lab, 1, ss)
            kb = seg_mean(base, 0, ss)
            d = kl - kb
            nb = seg_mean(base, 1, ss)
            print("  %-10s %.5f +- %.5f      %.4f         %.4f +- %.4f   %s" % (
                lab, kl.mean(), se(kl), ag.mean(), nl.mean(), se(nl),
                "(base)" if lab == base else "%+.5f +- %.5f  better in %d/%d segments; NLL %+.4f +- %.4f" % (
                    d.mean(), se(d), int((d < 0).sum()), len(d), (nl - nb).mean(), se(nl - nb))))
        print()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())


## tools/trellis/test_blockldl.py

"""test_blockldl.py - block feedback against plain encoding on a synthetic anisotropic H (an incoherent random basis with a
spread spectrum) and on real expert weights: the proxy loss tr(E H E^T) must drop, the plain loss rises a little.
  python3 tools/trellis/test_blockldl.py [--orig DIR --layer 4]
"""
import argparse
import pathlib
import sys

import numpy as np

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE.parent))
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
import blockldl  # noqa: E402
import tqenc  # noqa: E402

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument("--n", type=int, default=1024)
ap.add_argument("--rows", type=int, default=512)
ap.add_argument("--spread", type=float, default=100.0, help="ratio of the largest to the smallest eigenvalue")
ap.add_argument("--type", default="TQK6")
a = ap.parse_args()
t = tqenc.TYPE_BY_NAME[a.type]
rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
n = a.n
Q, _ = np.linalg.qr(rng.standard_normal((n, n)))
lam = np.logspace(0, -np.log10(a.spread), n)
H = (Q * lam) @ Q.T
W = (rng.standard_normal((a.rows, n)) * 0.02).astype(np.float32)
R = blockldl.hessian_factor(H, 0.01)
fb = blockldl.feedback_matrices(R)
pk, _, _, _ = tqenc.encode(W, t, iters=1, threads=8)
plain = tqenc.decode(pk, t).reshape(W.shape)
_, ldl = blockldl.encode_ldl(W, t, fb, threads=8)


def proxy(Wq):
    E = (W - Wq).astype(np.float64)
    return np.trace(E @ H @ E.T) / np.trace(W.astype(np.float64) @ H @ W.T.astype(np.float64))


for name, Wq in (("plain", plain), ("block LDL", ldl)):
    E = W - Wq
    print("%-10s unweighted %.2f dB   H-weighted %.2f dB" % (name, 10 * np.log10(np.sum(W.astype(np.float64) ** 2) / np.sum(E.astype(np.float64) ** 2)), -10 * np.log10(proxy(Wq))))


## tools/trellis/test_tqenc_py.py

"""Python-level checks of tools/tqenc.py (run on the box with libtqenc.so built): Hadamard orthonormality and the
Q(Ux) == Q_orig x identity through the encoder, signs and .tqx round trips, K5/K4 sizes."""
import os
import sys
import tempfile
import pathlib

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))
import tqenc  # noqa: E402

fails = 0


def check(c, msg):
    global fails
    if not c:
        fails += 1
        print("FAIL", msg)


H = tqenc.hadamard_matrix()
check(np.abs(H @ H.T - np.eye(128)).max() < 1e-6 and np.abs(H - H.T).max() == 0, "H128 orthonormal and symmetric")
rng = np.random.default_rng(3)
for n in (2304, 5120):
    s = tqenc.make_signs(n, 5)
    check(set(np.unique(s)) <= {-1.0, 1.0}, "signs +-1")
    check(np.array_equal(tqenc.unpack_signs(tqenc.pack_signs(s), n), s), "sign pack round trip")
    W = rng.standard_normal((8, n)).astype(np.float32)
    x = rng.standard_normal(n).astype(np.float32)
    Wr = tqenc.rotate(W, s)
    check(np.abs(tqenc.unrotate(Wr, s) - W).max() < 1e-5, "unrotate(rotate(W)) == W")
    Ux = tqenc.rotate(x[None, :], s)[0]
    check(np.abs(Wr @ Ux - W @ x).max() < 1e-3, "Wrot (U x) == W x before quantization")
    for t in (tqenc.TQK4X, tqenc.TQK5X, tqenc.TQK4T, tqenc.TQK5T, tqenc.TQK6, tqenc.TQK7, tqenc.TQ2_T):
        packed, err, tot, st = tqenc.encode(Wr, t, iters=0)
        check(packed.shape == (8 * n // 128, tqenc.block_bytes(t)), "packed shape")
        Q = tqenc.decode(packed, t).reshape(8, n)
        y1 = Q @ Ux
        y2 = tqenc.unrotate(Q, s) @ x
        check(np.abs(y1 - y2).max() < 1e-3 * max(1.0, np.abs(y1).max()), "Q(Ux) == unrotate(Q) x  type %d" % t)
        check(abs(tot - np.sum((Wr.astype(np.float64) - Q) ** 2)) < 1e-4 * tot, "encoder error == decoded error")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            p = os.path.join(d, "m.tqx")
            tqenc.write_tqx(p, t, 8, n, packed, s)
            t2, r2, c2, pk2, s2 = tqenc.read_tqx(p)
            check(t2 == t and r2 == 8 and c2 == n and np.array_equal(pk2, packed) and np.array_equal(s2, s), "tqx round trip")
check(tqenc.block_bytes(tqenc.TQK5X) == 22 and tqenc.block_bytes(tqenc.TQK4X) == 18, "K5 22 bytes, K4 18 bytes")
check(abs(tqenc.bpw(tqenc.TQK5X) - 1.375) < 1e-9 and abs(tqenc.bpw(tqenc.TQK4X) - 1.125) < 1e-9, "bpw")
print("python checks:", "OK" if not fails else "%d FAILED" % fails)
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)


## tests/desktop/test_app_version.py

"""The desktop app's version is written in one place: apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml (Tauri reads it for the installer and file names when
tauri.conf.json has no version; the shell passes it to the host as STRATA_APP_VERSION; the host reads the same file in a checkout)."""
import json
import re
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

DESKTOP = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "apps" / "desktop"


def cargo_version() -> str:
    return re.search(r'^version\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"', (DESKTOP / "src-tauri" / "Cargo.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), re.M).group(1)


class AppVersionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_the_version_is_the_product_version_not_the_placeholder(self):
        self.assertRegex(cargo_version(), r"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(-[0-9A-Za-z.]+)?$")
        self.assertNotEqual(cargo_version(), "0.1.0")

    def test_tauri_conf_does_not_carry_a_second_copy(self):
        conf = json.loads((DESKTOP / "src-tauri" / "tauri.conf.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertNotIn("version", conf)

    def test_the_npm_package_follows_it(self):
        self.assertEqual(json.loads((DESKTOP / "package.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["version"], cargo_version())

    def test_no_script_hard_codes_a_file_name_with_a_version(self):
        text = (DESKTOP / "scripts" / "make-dmg.sh").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertNotRegex(text, r"Strata_\d+\.\d+\.\d+")
        self.assertIn("Cargo.toml", text)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/desktop/test_control_install.py

"""The desktop app's installer: tools/strata_mcp.py and setup.py run on Control's Python in STRATA_CONTROL_INSTALL mode.

What the owner asked for: a user installs the app, picks a model in it and downloads and prepares it, like any normal user.
What must stay true: a start or a serve never acquires anything (tests/terminal/test_no_acquisition.py), and the install
itself downloads model files only - no pip, no git, no compiler, no engine fetch, only the bundled preparation tools.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


def load_setup(home: Path, name: str = "setup_control_mode"):
    """setup.py imported as the app's installer: the mode is read when the module loads."""
    env = {"STRATA_CONTROL_INSTALL": "1", "STRATA_INSTALL_DIR": str(home)}
    with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, env):
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, ROOT / "setup.py")
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


class ControlModeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.home = Path(self.tmp.name) / "install"
        self.home.mkdir()
        self.S = load_setup(self.home)

    def test_the_folder_everything_is_written_to_is_the_install_folder_not_the_bundle(self):
        S = self.S
        self.assertTrue(S.CONTROL)
        self.assertEqual(S.home(), self.home.resolve())
        self.assertEqual(S.ROOT, ROOT)
        # without the mode nothing moves: HOME is the source folder, as it always was
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("setup_plain_mode", ROOT / "setup.py")
        plain = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_CONTROL_INSTALL": "0"}):
            spec.loader.exec_module(plain)
        self.assertFalse(plain.CONTROL)
        self.assertEqual(plain.home(), plain.ROOT)

    def test_only_this_python_running_a_bundled_tool_may_run(self):
        S = self.S
        tool = ROOT / "tools" / "pack_index.py"
        for refused in (
            [sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "numpy"],
            ["pip", "install", "numpy"],
            ["git", "clone", "https://example.invalid/x.git"],
            ["cmake", "--build", "."],
            ["winget", "install", "Nvidia.CUDA"],
            [sys.executable, str(self.home / "evil.py")],                 # a script outside the bundled tools
            [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "setup.py"), "--build"],
            [sys.executable],
        ):
            with self.subTest(refused=refused), mock.patch.object(S.subprocess, "run", side_effect=AssertionError("ran")):
                with self.assertRaises(S.acquisition.AcquisitionRefused):
                    S.run(refused)
        done = subprocess.CompletedProcess([], 0)
        with mock.patch.object(S.subprocess, "run", return_value=done) as runner:
            S.run([sys.executable, str(tool), "--help"], check=False)
        runner.assert_called_once()

    def test_no_package_is_installed(self):
        S = self.S
        with mock.patch.object(S, "run", side_effect=AssertionError("pip")), \
                mock.patch.object(S, "control_missing_packages", return_value=[]):
            S.pip_install(["numpy==1"], "the packages")      # the app ships them; nothing runs
        with mock.patch.object(S, "control_missing_packages", return_value=["numpy"]), \
                self.assertRaises(SystemExit):
            S.pip_install(["numpy==1"], "the packages")

    def test_the_engine_is_the_component_and_a_missing_one_does_not_stop_the_download(self):
        S = self.S
        llama = self.home / "third_party" / "llama.cpp"
        (llama / "ggml").mkdir(parents=True)
        (llama / "ggml" / "CMakeLists.txt").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
        (llama / "gguf-py").mkdir()
        empty = Path(self.tmp.name) / "components"
        empty.mkdir()
        gpu = {"index": 0, "vram_gb": 12.0}
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_COMPONENTS_DIR": str(empty)}), \
                mock.patch.object(S, "download", side_effect=AssertionError("fetched")), \
                mock.patch.object(S, "build_engine", side_effect=AssertionError("built")), \
                mock.patch.object(S, "get_prebuilt", side_effect=AssertionError("fetched an engine")):
            found, eng, meta, libs, chosen, vision = S.engine_step(mock.Mock(build=False, prebuilt=None), gpu, False, [], 13, "gpu")
        self.assertEqual(found.resolve(), llama.resolve())
        self.assertEqual(libs, [])
        self.assertEqual(vision, "none")                                   # images are not in the first app release
        self.assertEqual(meta["source"], "local")
        self.assertEqual(S.engine_exe(eng), "component:strata-engine")

    def test_the_run_config_goes_to_the_install_folder_and_the_data_folder_sits_beside_it(self):
        S = self.S
        self.assertEqual(S.installed_configs(), [])
        (self.home / "strata-q2_0.json").write_text(json.dumps({"exe": "component:strata-engine", "args": ["--native", "x.gguf"],
                                                                "tokenizer": "t"}), encoding="utf-8")
        with mock.patch.object(S, "model_config", return_value=True):
            self.assertEqual([p.name for p in S.installed_configs()], ["strata-q2_0.json"])
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"APPDATA": self.tmp.name, "XDG_CONFIG_HOME": self.tmp.name}):
            data, _ = S.data_folder_in_place()
        self.assertEqual(data, self.home.resolve().parent / "Strata-data")

    @unittest.skipIf(os.name == "nt", "a launcher is a shell script: Linux and macOS bundles")
    def test_the_bundle_keeps_one_real_python_and_launchers_for_the_other_names(self):
        sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "apps" / "desktop" / "scripts"))
        try:
            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("stage_control_for_launchers", ROOT / "apps" / "desktop" / "scripts" / "stage-control.py")
            stage = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
            spec.loader.exec_module(stage)
        finally:
            sys.path.pop(0)
        folder = Path(self.tmp.name) / "bundle"
        bindir = folder / "python" / "bin"
        bindir.mkdir(parents=True)
        real = bindir / "python3.12"
        real.write_text("#!/bin/sh"+chr(10)+"echo real "+chr(34)+"$@"+chr(34)+chr(10))
        real.chmod(0o755)
        os.symlink("python3.12", bindir / "python3")
        os.symlink("python3", bindir / "python")
        self.assertEqual(stage.dedupe_python(folder), ["python", "python3"])
        for name in ("python", "python3"):
            f = bindir / name
            self.assertFalse(f.is_symlink())
            self.assertLess(f.stat().st_size, 400, "a launcher, not a second copy of the interpreter")
            self.assertTrue(os.access(f, os.X_OK))
        out = subprocess.run([str(bindir / "python"), "a b", "c"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
        self.assertEqual(out.strip(), "real a b c")
        self.assertEqual(stage.dedupe_python(folder), [], "run twice: nothing left to change")
        # no external program: with an empty PATH (and, in the AppImage, libraries that make `dirname` fail) the launcher still starts the
        # interpreter, from another folder and through a relative name. Ubuntu 26.04: "dirname: libsystemd.so.0: version LIBSYSTEMD_254 not found".
        for cwd, name in ((str(folder), "python/bin/python3"), (str(bindir), "./python"), (str(bindir.parent), "bin/python")):
            r = subprocess.run(["/bin/sh", name, "x"], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=cwd, env={"PATH": ""})
            self.assertEqual(r.stdout.strip(), "real x", (cwd, name, r.stderr))

    def test_the_bundle_lists_everything_the_install_imports(self):
        sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "apps" / "desktop" / "scripts"))
        try:
            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("stage_control_for_test", ROOT / "apps" / "desktop" / "scripts" / "stage-control.py")
            stage = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
            spec.loader.exec_module(stage)
        finally:
            sys.path.pop(0)
        tools = stage.local_imports(ROOT, stage.INSTALLER_TOOLS)
        for need in ("strata_mcp", "iq_pack", "strata_pack", "canonical_xcheck", "pack_layer", "gguf_reader", "gguf_writer", "_paths"):
            self.assertIn(need, tools)
        out = Path(self.tmp.name) / "control"
        out.mkdir()
        record = stage.add_installer(out)
        for name in ("setup.py", "ref/load.py", "tools/strata_mcp.py", "tools/iq_pack.py", "data/draft_vocab.bin"):
            self.assertTrue((out / name).is_file(), name)
        self.assertIn("tools/strata_pack.py", record["files"])
        # every module setup.py's preparation steps run exists in the bundle
        for tool in ("iq_pack", "strata_pack", "pack_index", "strata_tokenizer", "mtp_fetch", "mtp_pack", "mtp_rt"):
            self.assertTrue((out / "tools" / f"{tool}.py").is_file(), tool)


class InstallerServerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """tools/strata_mcp.py with its source (setup.py, serve/) apart from the install folder, as the app runs it."""

    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.tmp.name) / "install"
        self.root.mkdir()
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("strata_mcp_for_test", ROOT / "tools" / "strata_mcp.py")
        self.mcp = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_CONTROL_INSTALL": "1", "STRATA_INSTALL_DIR": str(self.root)}):
            spec.loader.exec_module(self.mcp)

    def test_the_catalog_comes_from_setup_py_in_the_bundle(self):
        s = self.mcp.Strata(self.root, ROOT)
        self.assertEqual(s.root, self.root.resolve())
        self.assertEqual(s.src, ROOT)
        models, families, contexts, source = s.tables()
        self.assertEqual(source, "setup.py")
        self.assertIn("qwen", families)
        self.assertIn("IQ3_XXS", models)
        self.assertEqual(s.python_override, sys.executable)               # Control's own Python runs the install

    def test_the_install_job_runs_on_control_python_without_a_venv_and_may_fetch_only_for_itself(self):
        s = self.mcp.Strata(self.root, ROOT)
        spec_path = self.root / "job.json"
        spec = {"job": "j1", "root": str(self.root), "src": str(ROOT), "control": True, "python": sys.executable,
                "base_python": sys.executable, "create_venv": False, "args": ["--yes", "--no-start"],
                "result": str(self.root / "result.json")}
        spec_path.write_text(json.dumps(spec), encoding="utf-8")
        seen = {}

        class FakePopen:
            pid = 4242

            def __init__(self, cmd, **kw):
                seen["cmd"], seen["kw"] = cmd, kw

            def wait(self):
                return 0

        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE": "1", "PYTHONPATH": "x", "PYTHONHOME": "y"}), \
                mock.patch.object(self.mcp.subprocess, "Popen", FakePopen), \
                mock.patch.object(self.mcp, "proc_identity", return_value=None):
            self.assertEqual(self.mcp.install_job(str(spec_path)), 0)
            self.assertEqual(os.environ["STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE"], "1", "this process keeps the switch")
        self.assertEqual(seen["cmd"][:2], [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "setup.py")])
        env = seen["kw"]["env"]
        self.assertEqual(env["STRATA_CONTROL_INSTALL"], "1")
        self.assertEqual(env["STRATA_INSTALL_DIR"], str(self.root))
        self.assertNotIn("STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE", env, "the explicit install job may fetch the chosen model's files")
        self.assertNotIn("PYTHONPATH", env)
        self.assertNotIn("PYTHONHOME", env)
        self.assertFalse((self.root / ".venv").exists(), "no virtual environment, no pip")
        self.assertIsNotNone(s)

    def test_a_two_file_model_has_one_combined_progress(self):
        """The bar went 70 GB -> 0 -> up again because each file reported its own total. One total for the whole model now."""
        folder = self.root / "Strata-data" / "models" / "IQ3_S"
        folder.mkdir(parents=True)
        job = {"folder": str(folder), "total_gb": 0.004}
        step5 = {"step": "5/7: downloading Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_S"}
        seen = []
        # file 1 downloading, then complete, then file 2 starts: the combined figure only goes up
        for name, size in (("a.gguf.part", 400_000), ("a.gguf.part", 1_500_000)):
            (folder / name).write_bytes(b"x" * size)
            seen.append(self.mcp.combined_progress(dict(step5), job)["download"])
        (folder / "a.gguf.part").rename(folder / "a.gguf")
        (folder / "b.gguf.part").write_bytes(b"x" * 100_000)
        seen.append(self.mcp.combined_progress(dict(step5), job)["download"])
        (folder / "b.gguf.part").write_bytes(b"x" * 1_000_000)
        seen.append(self.mcp.combined_progress(dict(step5), job)["download"])
        done = [d["done_gb"] for d in seen]
        self.assertEqual(done, sorted(done), done)
        self.assertEqual(seen[-1]["total_gb"], 0.004)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(seen[-1]["remaining_gb"], 0.004 - seen[-1]["done_gb"], places=2)
        self.assertTrue(all(d["file"] == "model files" for d in seen))
        # not a download any more once setup is preparing the files
        self.assertNotIn("download", self.mcp.combined_progress({"step": "6/7: preparing the model for Strata", "download": {"x": 1}}, job))
        # a resumed install counts what is already on disk
        self.assertGreater(self.mcp.combined_progress(dict(step5), job)["download"]["done_gb"], 0)

    def test_a_model_in_parts_counts_every_part_and_the_picture_reader(self):
        """QA 2026-10-18 (6): the bar stopped at 99 % while the picture reader downloaded, and a first whole part looked like a finished
        model. Every part is counted, the picture reader is a part of its own, and 'done' needs all of them."""
        S = self.mcp.Strata(self.root, ROOT).setup_module()
        models = self.root / "Strata-data" / "models"
        files = self.mcp.expected_files(S, "qwen", "IQ3_S", models, True)
        self.assertEqual([f["role"] for f in files], ["model", "model", "vision"])
        self.assertEqual(Path(files[2]["path"]).parent, models, "the picture reader sits beside the model folders")
        folder = Path(files[0]["path"]).parent
        folder.mkdir(parents=True)
        job = {"folder": str(folder), "total_gb": 0.004, "files": files}
        step5 = {"step": "5/7: downloading Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_S"}
        # the first part is whole, the second not started: the model is NOT downloaded
        Path(files[0]["path"]).write_bytes(b"x" * 2_000_000)
        one = self.mcp.combined_progress(dict(step5), job)
        model = next(x for x in one["parts"] if x["kind"] == "model")
        self.assertEqual((model["files_done"], model["files_total"], model["state"]), (1, 2, "downloading"))
        self.assertLess(one["download"]["percent"], 99)
        # both parts whole, the picture reader under way: still counted, and the bar is not at its end
        Path(files[1]["path"]).write_bytes(b"x" * 2_000_000)
        Path(files[2]["path"]).with_name(Path(files[2]["path"]).name + ".part").write_bytes(b"x" * 400_000)
        two = self.mcp.combined_progress(dict(step5), job)
        vision = next(x for x in two["parts"] if x["kind"] == "vision")
        self.assertEqual(vision["state"], "downloading")
        self.assertEqual(two["download"]["file"], "picture reader")
        self.assertGreater(two["download"]["done_gb"], one["download"]["done_gb"])
        self.assertGreater(two["download"]["total_gb"], 0.004, "the picture reader is part of the total")
        self.assertLessEqual(two["download"]["percent"], 99)
        # all whole
        Path(files[2]["path"]).with_name(Path(files[2]["path"]).name + ".part").unlink()
        Path(files[2]["path"]).write_bytes(b"x" * 907_543_008)
        three = self.mcp.combined_progress(dict(step5), job)
        self.assertTrue(all(x["state"] == "done" for x in three["parts"]))
        self.assertEqual(three["download"]["done_gb"], three["download"]["total_gb"])
        # not a download once setup prepares the files
        self.assertNotIn("download", self.mcp.combined_progress({"step": "6/7: preparing the model for Strata", "download": {"x": 1}}, job))

    def test_a_pack_with_many_files_reports_the_whole_pack(self):
        S = self.mcp.Strata(self.root, ROOT).setup_module()
        files = self.mcp.expected_files(S, "nvfp4", "NVFP4", self.root / "models", False)
        self.assertGreater(len(files), 5)
        self.assertTrue(all(f["bytes"] for f in files), "a ready-made pack pins every file's size")
        big = next(f for f in files if f["path"].endswith("experts.bin"))
        Path(big["path"]).parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        Path(big["path"] + ".part").write_bytes(b"x" * 1000)
        prog = self.mcp.combined_progress({"step": "5/7: downloading"}, {"files": files, "total_gb": 128.0})
        model = prog["parts"][0]
        self.assertEqual((model["kind"], model["state"], model["files_done"], model["files_total"]), ("model", "downloading", 0, len(files)))
        self.assertAlmostEqual(model["total_gb"], sum(f["bytes"] for f in files) / 1e9, places=2)

    def test_a_config_with_only_some_parts_is_not_ready(self):
        """The config names the first part only; 'ready' used to mean that part exists."""
        data = self.root / "models" / "x"
        data.mkdir(parents=True)
        first = data / "Model-00001-of-00003.gguf"
        first.write_bytes(b"x")
        self.assertEqual(len(self.mcp.shard_gaps([str(first)])), 2)
        (data / "Model-00002-of-00003.gguf").write_bytes(b"x")
        (data / "Model-00003-of-00003.gguf.part").write_bytes(b"x")
        self.assertEqual([Path(g).name for g in self.mcp.shard_gaps([str(first)])], ["Model-00003-of-00003.gguf"])
        (data / "Model-00003-of-00003.gguf.part").unlink()
        (data / "Model-00003-of-00003.gguf").write_bytes(b"x")
        self.assertEqual(self.mcp.shard_gaps([str(first)]), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.mcp.shard_gaps([str(data / "single.gguf")]), [])

    @unittest.skipUnless(os.name == "nt" or sys.platform.startswith("linux"), "a PC with a GPU probe")
    def test_a_real_install_reaches_the_model_download_with_nothing_else_acquired(self):
        """setup.py in the app's mode, as the install job runs it: steps 1-4 pass (PC check, packages bundled, engine component
        optional, llama.cpp source already present) and step 5 asks for the model file. The model host is a folder that does
        not exist, so nothing is downloaded; pip, git, cmake and winget shims that record any call must stay unused."""
        import setup as plain
        if not plain.gpus():
            self.skipTest("no NVIDIA GPU here: setup stops at step 1")
        import shutil
        if shutil.disk_usage(self.tmp.name).free < 130 * 10**9:
            self.skipTest("less than 130 GB free: setup stops at its disk check before the download step")
        home = Path(self.tmp.name) / "home"
        shims = Path(self.tmp.name) / "shims"
        for p in (home / "third_party" / "llama.cpp" / "ggml", home / "third_party" / "llama.cpp" / "gguf-py", shims):
            p.mkdir(parents=True)
        (home / "third_party" / "llama.cpp" / "ggml" / "CMakeLists.txt").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
        log = Path(self.tmp.name) / "shim.log"
        for tool in ("pip", "pip3", "git", "cmake", "ninja", "winget", "curl", "wget", "cl", "make"):
            if os.name == "nt":
                (shims / f"{tool}.cmd").write_text(f"@echo {tool} %* >> \"{log}\"\r\n", encoding="utf-8")
            else:
                (shims / tool).write_text(f"#!/bin/sh\necho {tool} \"$@\" >> '{log}'\n", encoding="utf-8")
                (shims / tool).chmod(0o755)
        env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k not in ("STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE", "PYTHONPATH", "VIRTUAL_ENV")}
        env.update(STRATA_CONTROL_INSTALL="1", STRATA_INSTALL_DIR=str(home), APPDATA=str(Path(self.tmp.name) / "appdata"),
                   XDG_CONFIG_HOME=str(Path(self.tmp.name) / "xdg"), STRATA_COMPONENTS_DIR=str(Path(self.tmp.name) / "components"),
                   HF_ENDPOINT=(Path(self.tmp.name) / "no-such-hf").as_uri(), PATH=str(shims) + os.pathsep + env.get("PATH", ""),
                   PYTHONIOENCODING="utf-8")
        done = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / "setup.py"), "--yes", "--no-start", "--family", "qwen", "--model", "Q2_0",
                               "--context", "32768", "--vision", "no", "--experimental-speed-projection", "off"],
                              capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, cwd=str(ROOT), stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, timeout=300)
        out = done.stdout + done.stderr
        self.assertNotEqual(done.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn("bundled with the app", out)
        self.assertIn("Step 5: downloading", out)
        self.assertIn("Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-Q2_0-00001-of-00002.gguf", out)
        self.assertFalse(log.exists(), "something ran pip, git, cmake or a package manager: " + (log.read_text() if log.exists() else ""))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


class FailedStartTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_failed_start_carries_the_last_lines_the_server_wrote(self):
        """The app turns `server_exited` into words and keeps the reason under Details: Control reports the log's last lines."""
        from strata_control import runtime
        owner = [c for _, c in vars(runtime).items() if isinstance(c, type) and hasattr(c, "_log_tail")][0]
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            fake = mock.Mock()
            fake.state_path = Path(directory) / "app-1.json"
            fake.name = "app-1"
            self.assertIsNone(owner._log_tail(fake))                       # no log: nothing, no exception
            (Path(directory) / "app-1.server.log").write_text("loading\n\nmemory guard: 5.1 GiB free is under 6 GiB\nthe engine process ended: exit code 3\n", encoding="utf-8")
            tail = owner._log_tail(fake)
            self.assertIn("memory guard: 5.1 GiB free", tail)
            self.assertTrue(tail.endswith("exit code 3"))
            self.assertNotIn("loading", tail.split(" | ")[0] if tail.count(" | ") > 2 else "")


class DeleteModelTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Deleting a downloaded model removes its own files and run config, never what another installed model still uses."""

    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        base = Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.root = base / "install"
        self.root.mkdir()
        self.data = base / "Strata-data"
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("strata_mcp_for_delete", ROOT / "tools" / "strata_mcp.py")
        self.mcp = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_CONTROL_INSTALL": "1", "STRATA_INSTALL_DIR": str(self.root)}):
            spec.loader.exec_module(self.mcp)
        self.s = self.mcp.Strata(self.root, ROOT)
        self.tools = self.mcp.Tools(self.s)

        def make(path: Path, size: int):
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.write_bytes(b"x" * size)
            return path
        self.make = make
        mtp = self.data / "mtp" / "rt"
        make(mtp / "experts.bin", 3000)
        shared_ple = make(self.data / "models" / "Q2_0" / "shard-2.gguf", 2000)     # the same second shard in both models
        for tag, size in (("iq3_s", 10000), ("q2_0", 4000)):
            folder = self.data / "models" / tag
            first = make(folder / "shard-1.gguf", size)
            make(first.with_name(first.name + ".done"), 1)
            pack = self.data / "packs" / tag
            make(pack / "tokenizer" / "vocab.json", 500)
            (self.root / f"strata-{tag}.json").write_text(json.dumps({"exe": "component:strata-engine", "args": [
                "--pack", str(pack), "--native", str(first), "--ple-gguf", str(shared_ple), "--mtp", str(mtp), "--max-context", "32768"]}), encoding="utf-8")
            (self.root / f"strata-{tag}.log").write_text("log", encoding="utf-8")

    def test_the_plan_names_what_goes_and_what_stays(self):
        plan = self.tools.strata_remove(model="iq3_s")["plan"]
        removed = {Path(x["path"]).name for x in plan["remove"]}
        kept = {Path(x["path"]).name for x in plan["keep"]}
        self.assertIn("shard-1.gguf", removed)
        self.assertIn("iq3_s", removed)                                    # its pack folder
        self.assertIn("strata-iq3_s.json", removed)
        self.assertEqual(kept, {"shard-2.gguf", "rt"})                     # the shared PLE shard and the shared MTP draft
        self.assertEqual(plan["bytes"], 10000 + 1 + 500 + 3 + (self.root / "strata-iq3_s.json").stat().st_size)

    def test_confirm_deletes_only_that_model_and_the_other_still_has_everything(self):
        result = self.tools.strata_remove(model="iq3_s", confirm=True)
        self.assertEqual(result["failed"], [])
        self.assertFalse((self.data / "models" / "iq3_s").exists())        # its folder is gone with its file
        self.assertFalse((self.data / "packs" / "iq3_s").exists())
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "strata-iq3_s.json").exists())
        self.assertTrue((self.data / "models" / "Q2_0" / "shard-2.gguf").is_file())
        self.assertTrue((self.data / "mtp" / "rt" / "experts.bin").is_file())
        self.assertTrue((self.data / "models" / "q2_0" / "shard-1.gguf").is_file())
        self.assertTrue((self.data / "packs" / "q2_0" / "tokenizer" / "vocab.json").is_file())
        self.assertTrue((self.root / "strata-q2_0.json").is_file())

    def test_the_last_model_takes_its_shared_files_with_it(self):
        self.tools.strata_remove(model="iq3_s", confirm=True)
        self.tools.strata_remove(model="q2_0", confirm=True)
        self.assertFalse((self.data / "mtp" / "rt").exists())
        self.assertFalse((self.data / "models" / "Q2_0" / "shard-2.gguf").exists())

    def test_nothing_outside_strata_s_folders_is_touched_and_each_model_reports_its_own_disk_use(self):
        outside = Path(self.tmp.name) / "elsewhere" / "mine.gguf"
        self.make(outside, 777)
        cfg = self.root / "strata-q2_0.json"
        data = json.loads(cfg.read_text())
        data["args"] += ["--ple-gguf", str(outside)]
        cfg.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")
        plan = self.tools.strata_remove(model="q2_0")["plan"]
        self.assertIn("mine.gguf", {Path(x["path"]).name for x in plan["keep"]})
        self.tools.strata_remove(model="q2_0", confirm=True)
        self.assertTrue(outside.is_file())
        described = self.s.describe_config(self.root / "strata-iq3_s.json")
        self.assertGreater(described["disk_bytes"], 10000)


class LocalGgufInstallTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_plan_from_a_local_folder_adopts_the_files_and_needs_no_download_space(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:

## tests/desktop/test_fetch_node.py

"""fetch-node.ps1 (Windows) and fetch-node.sh pin the same Node archive digest, and the PowerShell
script refuses a download that does not match it."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "apps" / "desktop" / "scripts"
POWERSHELL = shutil.which("powershell") or shutil.which("pwsh")


class PinTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_both_scripts_pin_the_same_windows_digest_and_version(self):
        sh = (SCRIPTS / "fetch-node.sh").read_text()
        ps = (SCRIPTS / "fetch-node.ps1").read_text()
        sh_digest = re.search(r'win-x64\)\s+echo "([0-9a-f]{64})"', sh).group(1)
        ps_digest = re.search(r"\$Expected = '([0-9a-f]{64})'", ps).group(1)
        self.assertEqual(sh_digest, ps_digest)
        self.assertEqual(re.search(r'STRATA_NODE_VERSION:-([\d.]+)', sh).group(1),
                         re.search(r"else \{ '([\d.]+)' \}", ps).group(1))


@unittest.skipUnless(os.name == "nt" and POWERSHELL, "Windows PowerShell")
class PowerShellTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_script(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run([POWERSHELL, "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File",
                               str(SCRIPTS / "fetch-node.ps1"), *args],
                              capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)

    def test_a_zip_with_the_wrong_digest_is_refused_and_nothing_is_installed(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            archive = Path(directory) / "node.zip"
            with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, "w") as bundle:
                bundle.writestr("node-v24.12.0-win-x64/node.exe", b"not node")
            dest = Path(directory) / "out"
            result = self.run_script("-FromFile", str(archive), "-Dest", str(dest))
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1, result.stdout + result.stderr)
            self.assertIn("REFUSING", result.stderr)
            self.assertFalse((dest / "node.exe").exists())

    def test_check_reports_a_missing_runtime(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            result = self.run_script("-Check", "-Dest", directory)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
            self.assertIn("not installed", result.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/desktop/test_nsis_layout.py

r"""The Windows installer must never touch the user's data. The app lives in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Strata; %LOCALAPPDATA%\Strata
holds engines, model run configs, tuning. A build that installed the app into the data folder is migrated by removing only its app
files. Exercised with makensis on a temp layout (the template's own migration macro, extracted and run); skipped without NSIS."""

import os
import re
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
TEMPLATE = ROOT / "apps" / "desktop" / "src-tauri" / "nsis" / "installer.nsi"
MAKENSIS = Path(os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", "")) / "tauri" / "NSIS" / "makensis.exe"
DATA = ["components/engine/0.1.45/strata.exe", "install/strata-iq3_s.json", "procs/p.json", "runtime/r.json", "time-skip/t.json",
        "presets/p.json"]
APP = ["strata-desktop.exe", "uninstall.exe", "host/server/index.mjs", "node/node.exe", "control/python/python.exe"]
BS = "\\"


def touch(base: Path, names):
    for name in names:
        path = base / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text("x", encoding="utf-8")


class TemplateTests(unittest.TestCase):
    text = TEMPLATE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    def test_the_default_folder_is_programs_strata_and_the_data_folder_is_never_remembered_as_the_app(self):
        self.assertIn(r'StrCpy $INSTDIR "$LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\${PRODUCTNAME}"', self.text)
        self.assertIn(r'StrCmp $4 "$LOCALAPPDATA\${PRODUCTNAME}" restore_done 0', self.text)
        self.assertIn("StrIsUnder", self.text)          # a remembered folder under Temp is ignored too

    def test_the_install_folder_page_is_shown_except_in_an_update(self):
        # #3186 #3190: the person can put the app on another drive; the app's own updater (passive) and silent installs keep the folder
        # the earlier install wrote to the registry, so an update never asks again and never moves the app
        text = self.text.replace("\r\n", "\n")
        match = re.search(r"!define MUI_PAGE_CUSTOMFUNCTION_PRE (\w+)\n!insertmacro MUI_PAGE_DIRECTORY", text)
        self.assertIsNotNone(match)
        self.assertEqual(match.group(1), "SkipIfPassive")
        self.assertIn('WriteRegStr SHCTX "${MANUPRODUCTKEY}" "" $INSTDIR', text)
        self.assertIn("Call RestorePreviousInstallLocation", text)
        conf = (ROOT / "apps" / "desktop" / "src-tauri" / "tauri.conf.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn('"installMode": "currentUser"', conf)

    def test_the_uninstaller_removes_files_one_by_one_and_only_empty_folders(self):
        uninstall = self.text[self.text.index("Section Uninstall"):]
        self.assertNotRegex(uninstall, r'RMDir /r "\$INSTDIR"')
        self.assertNotIn(r'RmDir /r "$LOCALAPPDATA\${PRODUCTNAME}"', self.text)
        self.assertIn(r'RmDir /r "$LOCALAPPDATA\${BUNDLEID}"', self.text)


@unittest.skipUnless(MAKENSIS.is_file(), "NSIS (the Tauri bundler's copy) is not installed here")
class MigrationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_nsis(self, body: str, work: Path):
        block = re.search(r"; STRATA-MIGRATE-BEGIN.*?; STRATA-MIGRATE-END", TEMPLATE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), re.S).group(0)
        script = work / "t.nsi"
        script.write_text('Unicode true\nOutFile "t.exe"\nRequestExecutionLevel user\nSilentInstall silent\n' + block + "\nSection\n" + body + "\nSectionEnd\n", encoding="utf-8")
        done = subprocess.run([str(MAKENSIS), "/V1", str(script)], cwd=work, capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(done.returncode, 0, done.stdout + done.stderr)
        subprocess.run([str(work / "t.exe")], cwd=work, check=True, timeout=60)

    def layout(self, base: Path) -> Path:
        old = base / "Strata"
        touch(old, DATA + APP)
        return old

    def test_migration_removes_only_the_old_app_files_and_keeps_every_bit_of_data(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            base = Path(tmp)
            old = self.layout(base)
            new = base / "Programs" / "Strata"
            self.run_nsis(f'!insertmacro StrataMigrateOldInstall "{old}" "{new}"', base)
            for name in DATA:
                self.assertTrue((old / name).is_file(), f"data kept: {name}")
            for name in APP:
                self.assertFalse((old / name).exists(), f"app file removed: {name}")
            for folder in ("host", "node", "control"):
                self.assertFalse((old / folder).exists())

    def test_migration_does_nothing_when_old_and_new_are_the_same_or_there_is_no_old_app(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            base = Path(tmp)
            old = self.layout(base)
            self.run_nsis(f'!insertmacro StrataMigrateOldInstall "{old}" "{old}"', base)
            for name in DATA + APP:
                self.assertTrue((old / name).is_file(), name)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            base = Path(tmp)
            touch(base / "Strata", DATA)                   # data only: no strata-desktop.exe
            self.run_nsis(f'!insertmacro StrataMigrateOldInstall "{base / "Strata"}" "{base / "Programs" / "Strata"}"', base)
            for name in DATA:
                self.assertTrue((base / "Strata" / name).is_file(), name)

    def test_an_uninstall_of_the_template_kind_leaves_data_in_a_shared_folder(self):
        """The uninstaller deletes named files and uses non-recursive RMDir: in a folder that also holds data (a legacy install) the
        data and so the folder stay."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            base = Path(tmp)
            old = self.layout(base)
            lines = [f'Delete "{old}{BS}{n.replace("/", BS)}"' for n in APP]
            lines += [f'RMDir "{old}{BS}{d}"' for d in ("host" + BS + "server", "host", "node", "control" + BS + "python", "control")]
            lines += [f'RMDir "{old}"']
            self.run_nsis("\n".join(lines), base)
            for name in DATA:
                self.assertTrue((old / name).is_file(), name)
            self.assertFalse((old / "strata-desktop.exe").exists())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/desktop/test_tester_readme.py

"""The tester READMEs get their checksums from the files themselves (apps/desktop/scripts/make-tester-readme.sh)."""
import hashlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SCRIPT = ROOT / "apps" / "desktop" / "scripts" / "make-tester-readme.sh"
TEMPLATES = ROOT / "apps" / "desktop" / "tester"
NOTICE = "Strata opened in your browser because the app window couldn't start on this computer."


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def run(*args, check=True):
    return subprocess.run(["bash", str(SCRIPT), *map(str, args)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=check)


@unittest.skipIf(shutil.which("bash") is None or shutil.which("sha256sum") is None, "needs bash and sha256sum")
class TesterReadmeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="strata-readme-"))
        self.addCleanup(shutil.rmtree, self.tmp, True)
        self.files = self.tmp / "files"
        self.files.mkdir()
        self.out = self.tmp / "README.txt"

    def put(self, name, data):
        (self.files / name).write_bytes(data)
        return self.files / name

    def test_every_hash_and_size_in_the_readme_comes_from_the_file(self):
        app = self.put("Strata-tester-linux.AppImage", b"app image bytes " * 1000)
        run(TEMPLATES / "README-linux.txt.in", self.out, "--appimage", app.name, "--files-dir", self.files)
        text = self.out.read_text()
        self.assertIn(sha(app), text)
        self.assertNotIn("@APPIMAGE@", text)
        for needle in ("libfuse2t64", "Ubuntu 26.04", "--browser", "--quit", "--save-logs", "Strata 0.2.3", NOTICE):
            self.assertIn(needle, text)
        run("--verify", self.out, "--files-dir", self.files)

    def test_amd_readmes_hash_both_files(self):
        for variant in ("rx9070", "rx7900"):
            app, zipname = f"Strata-tester-linux-amd-{variant}.AppImage", f"Strata-Terminal-Linux-tester-amd-{variant}.zip"
            a, z = self.put(app, b"a" * 5000), self.put(zipname, b"z" * 3000)
            run(TEMPLATES / f"README-amd-{variant}.txt.in", self.out, "--appimage", app, "--files-dir", self.files)
            text = self.out.read_text()
            self.assertIn(sha(a), text)
            self.assertIn(sha(z), text)
            self.assertIn(f"./{app} --browser", text)
            run("--verify", self.out, "--files-dir", self.files)

    def test_a_missing_file_stops_the_readme_instead_of_leaving_a_stale_hash(self):
        app = self.put("Strata-tester-linux-amd-rx9070.AppImage", b"a" * 5000)  # the zip is not there
        result = run(TEMPLATES / "README-amd-rx9070.txt.in", self.out, "--appimage", app.name, "--files-dir", self.files, check=False)
        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn("must not carry a hash it did not compute", result.stderr)
        self.assertFalse(self.out.exists())

    def test_verify_catches_a_stale_hash(self):
        app = self.put("Strata-tester-linux.AppImage", b"first build")
        run(TEMPLATES / "README-linux.txt.in", self.out, "--appimage", app.name, "--files-dir", self.files)
        app.write_bytes(b"rebuilt")  # the file changed after the README was written
        result = run("--verify", self.out, "--files-dir", self.files, check=False)
        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn("STALE", result.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/sycl/test_setup_intel_prefill.py

"""sycl/setup_intel.py: the prompt chunk size setup recommends for an Intel card (--prefill).

A Battlemage card (xe driver, not an A-series) with 24 GB or more and a context over 32K (the prompt borrows cache slots) gets
8192; everything else keeps 4096; a chunk size the user put in the config is kept."""
import importlib.util
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("setup_intel", ROOT / "sycl" / "setup_intel.py")
si = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
_spec.loader.exec_module(si)

B70 = dict(vram_gb=32.0, driver="xe", devid="e223")
A770 = dict(vram_gb=16.0, driver="xe", devid="56a0")
A750 = dict(vram_gb=8.0, driver="i915", devid="56a1")


def prefill_of(ctx, card, extra=()):
    cfg = {"args": ["--max-context", str(ctx), "--kv", "int8", "--prefill", "auto", *extra]}
    out = si.to_sycl(cfg, ROOT / "build-sycl-aot" / "strata", 64.0, {}, **card)
    return si.flag(out["args"], "--prefill")


def test_helper_values():
    assert si.recommended_prefill(32.0, 131072, "xe", "e223")[0] == 8192
    assert si.recommended_prefill(32.0, 131072, "xe", "e223")[1]          # a plain line says why
    assert si.recommended_prefill(24.0, 65536, "xe", "e221")[0] == 8192
    assert si.recommended_prefill(32.0, 32768, "xe", "e223") == (4096, "")   # own prompt buffers: a bigger chunk costs cache slots
    assert si.recommended_prefill(16.0, 131072, "xe", "e212")[0] == 4096     # under 24 GB
    assert si.recommended_prefill(16.0, 131072, "xe", "56a0")[0] == 4096     # Alchemist
    assert si.recommended_prefill(8.0, 131072, "i915", "56a1")[0] == 4096


def test_config_battlemage_long_context():
    assert prefill_of(131072, B70) == "8192"


def test_config_battlemage_32k_keeps_4096():
    assert prefill_of(32768, B70) == "4096"


def test_config_other_cards_unchanged():
    assert prefill_of(131072, A770) == "4096"
    assert prefill_of(131072, A750) == "4096"


def test_user_pick_is_kept():
    cfg = {"args": ["--max-context", "131072", "--kv", "int8", "--prefill", "16384"]}
    out = si.to_sycl(cfg, ROOT / "build-sycl-aot" / "strata", 64.0, {}, **B70)
    assert si.flag(out["args"], "--prefill") == "16384"


## tests/terminal/launch_previews.py

"""Writes the text previews of every `strata launch` screen to docs/terminal-previews/launch-*.txt (fake computer: RTX 5070 12 GB, 64 GB RAM).

    python tests/terminal/launch_previews.py

They are what the screens draw at 110 x 34 (the monitor views at 120 x 36), as text, so the design can be read without running anything.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import io
import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from rich.console import Console  # noqa: E402

from strata_cli.launch import access, settings as S, store  # noqa: E402
from strata_cli.launch.app import Ctx, LaunchApp  # noqa: E402
from strata_cli.launch.widgets import Glyphs  # noqa: E402
from tests.terminal import test_overview as ov  # noqa: E402
from tests.terminal.launch_support import HW_12, HW_2X16, Home, catalog, text_of  # noqa: E402

OUT = ROOT / "docs" / "terminal-previews"
SIZE = (110, 34)


def ctx_for(hw):
    cat = catalog(hw)
    comp = cat.computer()
    return Ctx(catalog=cat, computer=comp, rows=cat.rows(comp.raw), settings=S.LaunchSettings(), glyphs=Glyphs(True))


def write(name: str, text: str, note: str) -> None:
    body = f"# strata launch preview: {note}\n# (text of the screen as drawn at the size named in tests/terminal/launch_previews.py)\n\n" + text.rstrip() + "\n"
    (OUT / f"launch-{name}.txt").write_text(body, encoding="utf-8")
    print("wrote", f"launch-{name}.txt")


async def keys(pilot, *ks):
    for k in ks:
        await pilot.press(k)
        await pilot.pause(0.15)


def run() -> None:
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with Home():
        store.save(S.LaunchSettings(name="IQ3_XXS 128K - Full speed", family="qwen", model="IQ3_XXS", context=131072, parallel=1,
                                    tuned_preset="x", tuned_at="2026-10-16", last_used="2026-10-16 09:00:00"))
        store.save(S.LaunchSettings(name="Coder 64K - agents", family="coder", model="IQ1_M", context=65536, parallel=2, last_used="2026-10-14 09:00:00"))
        store.save(S.LaunchSettings(name="Network serving", family="qwen", model="Q2_0", context=32768, parallel=1, tuned_preset="y",
                                    tuned_at="2026-10-15", last_used="2026-10-15 09:00:00"))
        base = {"exe": "component:strata-engine", "args": ["--max-context", "131072", "--kv", "int8", "--prefill", "auto", "--expert-cache", "auto",
                                                          "--spec", "4"]}
        help_text = ("  --max-context N      memory for the conversation (default 4096)\n  --kv fp16|int8       how the conversation memory is stored\n"
                     "  --prefill N          how many prompt tokens are read at once\n  --expert-cache N     experts kept in graphics memory\n"
                     "  --spec N             draft tokens per step (faster replies)\n  --native-rope        experimental pinned rotary arithmetic\n")
        patches = [mock.patch.object(Ctx, "base_config", lambda self: base), mock.patch.object(Ctx, "engine_exe", lambda self: "/engine/strata"),
                   mock.patch("strata_cli.launch.params.engine_help_text", return_value=help_text),
                   mock.patch.object(access, "lan_ips", return_value=["192.168.88.21"]),
                   mock.patch.object(access, "find_cloudflared", return_value="/usr/bin/cloudflared"),
                   mock.patch.object(access, "tailscale_status", return_value={"installed": False, "running": False, "ip": None, "name": None})]
        for p in patches:
            p.start()

        async def tour(hw, prefix, steps_after_start):
            ctx = ctx_for(hw)
            app = LaunchApp(ctx)
            async with app.run_test(size=SIZE) as pilot:
                await pilot.pause(0.3)
                write(f"{prefix}start", text_of(app), "start screen with saved presets")
                for name, ks in steps_after_start:
                    await keys(pilot, *ks)
                    write(f"{prefix}{name}", text_of(app), name)

        asyncio.run(tour(HW_12, "", [
            ("step1-model", ["down", "down", "down", "enter"]),
            ("step2-folder", ["enter"]),
            ("step3-context", ["enter", "down", "down"]),
            ("step4-pictures", ["enter"]),
            ("step5-parallel", ["enter"]),
            ("step6-tuning", ["enter"]),
            ("step7-advanced", ["enter"]),
            ("step8-access", ["n", "down"]),
            ("step9-save", ["enter"]),
        ]))
        asyncio.run(tour(HW_2X16, "twocards-", [("step2-cards", ["down", "down", "down", "enter", "enter"])]))

        class Runner:
            def __init__(self, s, **kw):
                self.s, self.emit = s, kw["emit"]

            def run(self, start=True):
                from strata_cli.launch.runner import Event, Result
                self.emit(Event("engine", "Engine 0.1.45 (cuda) is installed.", 100))
                self.emit(Event("model", "Downloading 41.0 of 75.8 GB", 54.0))
                time.sleep(1.2)
                self.emit(Event("model", "Model is ready.", 100))
                self.emit(Event("config", "Settings are saved.", 100))
                self.emit(Event("tune", "Tuning", 62.0, data={"round": (5, 8), "minutes_left": 7,
                                                              "speeds": [{"label": "Default settings", "decode_tok_s": 83.0},
                                                                         {"label": "Keep more context on GPU", "decode_tok_s": 78.5},
                                                                         {"label": "Longer prompt chunks", "decode_tok_s": 85.1}]}))
                time.sleep(3)
                return Result("launch-x", ["http://127.0.0.1:8080"], None, "faster", [], "/x")

        async def run_screen():
            ctx = ctx_for(HW_12)
            ctx.settings = S.LaunchSettings(name="Demo", family="qwen", model="IQ3_XXS", context=131072, tune="quick")
            with mock.patch("strata_cli.launch.app.Runner", Runner):
                app = LaunchApp(ctx)
                async with app.run_test(size=SIZE) as pilot:
                    await pilot.pause(0.2)
                    app.start_preset("Demo") if False else app.run_launch()
                    await pilot.pause(2.0)
                    write("run-progress", text_of(app), "the progress screen while it downloads and tunes")

        asyncio.run(run_screen())

        # the monitor: Overview, Connect, quit question
        from strata_cli.launch.monitor_ext import LaunchMonitor

        async def monitor():
            src = ov.Source(ov.metrics("reading"))
            info = {"url": "http://127.0.0.1:8080", "urls": ["http://127.0.0.1:8080", "http://192.168.88.21:8080"], "key": "sk-strata-abcdefghijklmn",
                    "model": "qwen3.8-flash-next-iq3_xxs", "context": 32768, "profile": "launch-x", "name": "Demo"}
            app = LaunchMonitor(src, None, info=info, interval=30)
            async with app.run_test(size=(120, 36)) as pilot:
                await pilot.pause(0.6)
                write("monitor-overview", text_of(app), "the monitor's new Overview (view 1)")
                await keys(pilot, "7")
                write("monitor-connect-opencode", text_of(app), "the monitor's Connect view (key 7), OpenCode selected")
                await keys(pilot, "down", "down", "down", "down", "down")
                write("monitor-connect-hermes", text_of(app), "the Connect view, Hermes selected (its limits in plain words)")
                await keys(pilot, "7", "q")
                write("monitor-quit", text_of(app), "q asks: keep serving or stop")

        asyncio.run(monitor())
        for p in patches:
            p.stop()
    Path(OUT / "launch-overview-ascii.txt").write_text(
        "# strata monitor Overview in the classic Windows console mode (--glyphs ascii, or detected): no characters Consolas lacks\n\n"
        + ov.draw(ov.overview.build(ov.metrics("generating")), glyphs="ascii", color=False, connect=True), encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()


## tests/terminal/launch_support.py

"""Shared fixtures for the `strata launch` tests: an isolated home, a fake computer, and a text dump of a Textual screen."""

from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import io
import os
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

HW_12 = {"ram_gb": 64.0, "os": "Test OS", "cpu": {"avx2": True, "name": "test cpu"},
         "gpus": [{"index": 0, "name": "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070", "vram_gb": 12.0, "usable": True, "vendor": "nvidia"}]}
HW_24 = {**HW_12, "gpus": [{"index": 0, "name": "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090", "vram_gb": 24.0, "usable": True, "vendor": "nvidia"}]}
HW_2X16 = {**HW_12, "gpus": [{"index": 0, "name": "NVIDIA RTX A4000", "vram_gb": 16.0, "usable": True, "vendor": "nvidia"},
                             {"index": 1, "name": "NVIDIA RTX A4000", "vram_gb": 16.0, "usable": True, "vendor": "nvidia"}]}
HW_32GB_RAM = {**HW_12, "ram_gb": 32.0}


class Home:
    """A throw-away per-user home: profiles, presets, launch presets, state, components and install folder."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="strata-launch-test-")
        base = Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.base = base
        self.env = {
            "STRATA_PROFILE_DIR": str(base / "config" / "profiles"),
            "STRATA_PRESET_DIR": str(base / "config" / "presets"),
            "STRATA_LAUNCH_PRESET_DIR": str(base / "config" / "launch-presets"),
            "STRATA_COMPONENTS_DIR": str(base / "components"),
            "STRATA_INSTALL_DIR": str(base / "install"),
            "STRATA_RUNTIME_DIR": str(base / "runtime"),
            "XDG_STATE_HOME": str(base / "state"),
            "LOCALAPPDATA": str(base / "local"),
            "HOME": str(base / "home"),
            "USERPROFILE": str(base / "home"),
        }
        (base / "home").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.patch = mock.patch.dict(os.environ, self.env)

    def __enter__(self) -> "Home":
        self.patch.start()
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *exc) -> None:
        self.patch.stop()
        self.tmp.cleanup()


def catalog(hw: dict | None = None, root: Path | None = None):
    from strata_cli.launch.catalog import Catalog
    return Catalog(root=root or Path(os.environ["STRATA_INSTALL_DIR"]), hardware=hw or HW_12)


def text_of(app) -> str:
    """What the current screen shows, one line per terminal row (for assertions and the text previews)."""
    strips = app.screen._compositor.render_strips()
    return "\n".join(s.text.rstrip() for s in strips)


def run_cli(argv: list[str]) -> tuple[int, str, str]:
    from strata_cli.cli import main
    out, err = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out), contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):
        try:
            code = main(argv)
        except SystemExit as e:
            code = int(e.code or 0)
    return code, out.getvalue(), err.getvalue()


## tests/terminal/lifecycle_matrix.py

"""The close-path matrix: every way a Strata server or app can end, and what must be true afterwards.

After each case: no process of the tree that was running is left, the port is free, and the runtime's lease can be
taken again (nothing holds it). With a real engine, `--vram` also checks that the GPU's memory came back.

Run it directly (the pytest wrapper test_lifecycle_matrix.py runs the fake-engine cases on every platform):

    python tests/terminal/lifecycle_matrix.py --scenarios all --report matrix.json
    python tests/terminal/lifecycle_matrix.py --engine real --config /data/run.json --vram --scenarios serve-sigterm

The engine is a small script behind the same manifest-declared entry point a real engine package has, unless
`--engine real` names a run config. It never loads a model.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import signal
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

import psutil  # noqa: E402

from strata_control import components, engine_component as ec, procs, profiles, runtime  # noqa: E402

WINDOWS = os.name == "nt"
LINUX = sys.platform.startswith("linux")
BACKEND = "metal" if sys.platform == "darwin" else "cuda"      # the family the fake package claims on this OS

# Control words (STOP) are taken on a thread of their own, as the real engine does; everything else in order.
FAKE_ENGINE = r'''
import os, sys, threading, time
from pathlib import Path
mark = Path(os.environ["FAKE_ENGINE_MARK"])
(mark / "engine.pid").write_text(str(os.getpid()))
stop = threading.Event()
inbox = []
cv = threading.Condition()
def note(name): (mark / name).write_text(str(time.time()))
def reader():
    for raw in sys.stdin:
        word = raw.split()[0] if raw.split() else ""
        if word == "STOP":
            stop.set(); note("stop"); continue
        with cv:
            inbox.append(raw); cv.notify()
    with cv:
        inbox.append(None); cv.notify()
threading.Thread(target=reader, daemon=True).start()
print("READY 4096 stop", flush=True)
while True:
    with cv:
        while not inbox: cv.wait()
        line = inbox.pop(0)
    if line is None:                       # the server closed our stdin
        note("eof"); sys.exit(0)
    word = line.split()[0] if line.split() else ""
    if word == "QUIT":
        note("quit"); sys.exit(0)
    if word in ("GEN", "BGEN"):
        slow = int(os.environ.get("FAKE_ENGINE_SLOW_STEPS", "0"))
        slot = int(line.split()[1]) if word == "BGEN" else None
        steps = slow if (slow and not os.environ.get("FAKE_ENGINE_FAST_FIRST")) else 1
        stop.clear()
        note("busy")
        for _ in range(steps):
            print("T 97", flush=True)
            if stop.wait(0.2):
                break
        print("DONE 1 1 1.0 1.0 length 0 0 0", flush=True)
        if slot is not None: print(f"BADM {slot} 0", flush=True)
'''


if WINDOWS:   # a parent that ignores Ctrl+C hands that to its children; the matrix must start servers that do not
    import ctypes
    ctypes.windll.kernel32.SetConsoleCtrlHandler(None, False)


def free_port() -> int:
    with socket.socket() as s:
        s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return s.getsockname()[1]


def port_open(port: int) -> bool:
    with socket.socket() as s:
        s.settimeout(0.5)
        return s.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1", port)) == 0


def install_fake_engine(components_dir: Path) -> Path:
    folder = components_dir / "engine" / f"0.1.45-{components.host_platform()}-{BACKEND}"
    folder.mkdir(parents=True)
    (folder / "engine_main.py").write_text(FAKE_ENGINE, encoding="utf-8")
    if WINDOWS:
        entry = "engine.cmd"
        (folder / entry).write_bytes(f'@echo off\r\n"{sys.executable}" "%~dp0engine_main.py" %*\r\n'.encode())
    else:
        entry = "engine"
        (folder / entry).write_text(f'#!/bin/sh\nexec "{sys.executable}" "$(dirname "$0")/engine_main.py" "$@"\n')
        (folder / entry).chmod(0o755)
    files = [{"path": name, "sha256": hashlib.sha256((folder / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              "bytes": (folder / name).stat().st_size} for name in (entry, "engine_main.py")]
    (folder / ec.MANIFEST).write_text(json.dumps({
        "schema_version": 1, "id": "strata-engine", "version": "0.1.45", "platform": components.host_platform(),
        "backend": BACKEND, "entrypoint": entry, "files": files}), encoding="utf-8")
    return folder


def vram_used_mib() -> int | None:
    try:
        out = subprocess.run(["nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=memory.used", "--format=csv,noheader,nounits"],
                             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20).stdout.split()
        return sum(int(v) for v in out)
    except (OSError, ValueError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
        return None


class Rig:
    """A throwaway Strata home: state, runtime, profile and (fake or real) engine config."""

    def __init__(self, root: Path, *, real_config: Path | None = None, real_components: Path | None = None,
                 slow_steps: int = 0):
        self.root = root
        self.real = real_config is not None
        self.port = free_port()
        self.components = root / "components"
        self.components.mkdir()
        self.mark = root / "mark"
        self.mark.mkdir()
        self.state = root / "state"
        self.state.mkdir()
        self.env = {**os.environ, "STRATA_PROFILE_DIR": str(root / "profiles"), "STRATA_RUNTIME_DIR": str(root / "runtime"),
                    "STRATA_COMPONENTS_DIR": str(self.components), "STRATA_ENGINE_BACKEND": BACKEND,
                    "STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE": "1", "FAKE_ENGINE_MARK": str(self.mark), "LOCALAPPDATA": str(self.state),
                    "XDG_STATE_HOME": str(self.state), "PYTHONPATH": str(ROOT), "PYTHONUNBUFFERED": "1",
                    "FAKE_ENGINE_SLOW_STEPS": str(slow_steps)}
        self.env.pop("STRATA_API_KEY", None)
        for key in ("STRATA_PROFILE_DIR", "STRATA_RUNTIME_DIR", "LOCALAPPDATA", "XDG_STATE_HOME", "STRATA_COMPONENTS_DIR",
                    "STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE", "STRATA_ENGINE_BACKEND", "FAKE_ENGINE_MARK", "FAKE_ENGINE_SLOW_STEPS"):
            os.environ[key] = self.env[key]               # this process reads the same folders (profiles, runtime)
        if real_components is not None:
            self.env["STRATA_COMPONENTS_DIR"] = os.environ["STRATA_COMPONENTS_DIR"] = str(real_components)
        if real_config is not None:
            cfg = json.loads(real_config.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            cfg.update({"host": "127.0.0.1", "port": self.port})
            if cfg.get("log"):
                cfg["log"] = str(root / "engine.log")                  # never the real install's log
            self.config = root / "run.json"
            self.config.write_text(json.dumps(cfg), encoding="utf-8")
        else:
            install_fake_engine(self.components)
            from tools.strata_tokenizer import BYTE_TO_UNICODE
            tokenizer = root / "tokenizer"
            tokenizer.mkdir()
            tokens = [BYTE_TO_UNICODE[i] for i in range(256)] + ["ab", "<|im_start|>", "<|im_end|>", "<|endoftext|>"]
            (tokenizer / "vocab.json").write_text(json.dumps({token: i for i, token in enumerate(tokens)}))
            (tokenizer / "merges.txt").write_text("a b")
            (tokenizer / "token_type.json").write_text(json.dumps([0] * 257 + [3, 3, 3]))
            self.config = root / "run.json"
            self.config.write_text(json.dumps({"exe": "component:strata-engine", "backend": BACKEND,
                                               "tokenizer": str(tokenizer), "args": [], "cwd": str(root),
                                               "model_name": "fake", "host": "127.0.0.1", "port": self.port}),
                                   encoding="utf-8")
        profiles.create("app", str(self.config))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- starting
    def serve_argv(self) -> list[str]:
        return [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "strata.py"), "serve", "--profile", "app", "--port", str(self.port),
                "--host", "127.0.0.1", "--shutdown-timeout", "5"]

    def wait_ready(self, proc=None, seconds=None) -> None:
        seconds = seconds or (480 if self.real else 120)
        deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            if proc is not None and proc.poll() is not None:
                raise RuntimeError(f"the server exited with {proc.returncode} before it was ready")
            if port_open(self.port):
                try:
                    urllib.request.urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}/health", timeout=3).read()
                    return
                except OSError:
                    pass
            time.sleep(0.25)
        raise RuntimeError("the server was not ready in time")

    def tree(self, pid: int) -> list[procs.Ident]:
        """The process and everything below it, with the facts that tell them from a later process."""
        found = []
        try:
            family = [psutil.Process(pid), *psutil.Process(pid).children(recursive=True)]
        except psutil.Error:
            return found
        for p in family:
            token = procs.start_token(p.pid)
            if token:
                found.append(procs.Ident(p.pid, token, tuple(procs.command_line(p.pid) or [])))
        return found

    def engine_idents(self) -> list[procs.Ident]:
        """Every live process that is this run's engine (found by its recorded launch, not by a name)."""
        return [procs.Ident(r["pid"], r["token"], tuple(r["cmd"])) for r in procs.records()
                if r.get("role") in ("engine", "server") and procs.start_token(r["pid"]) == r["token"]]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- checking
    def survivors(self, idents) -> list[str]:
        return [f"{i.pid} {' '.join(i.cmd)[:90]}" for i in idents if procs.start_token(i.pid) == i.token]

    def wait_gone(self, idents, seconds=45) -> list[str]:
        deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
        left = self.survivors(idents)
        while left and time.monotonic() < deadline:
            time.sleep(0.25)
            left = self.survivors(idents)
        return left

    def lease_free(self) -> bool:
        try:
            fd = runtime.acquire_activity_lease(shared=False)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            return False
        runtime._unlock_file(fd)
        os.close(fd)
        return True

    def marks(self) -> list[str]:
        return sorted(p.name for p in self.mark.iterdir())

    def clear_marks(self) -> None:
        for p in self.mark.iterdir():
            p.unlink()


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- actions

def _default_signals() -> None:
    for sig in (signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGHUP, signal.SIGTERM):
        signal.signal(sig, signal.SIG_DFL)


def spawn_serve(rig: Rig, *, new_console: bool = False, session: bool = True) -> subprocess.Popen:
    log = open(rig.root / "serve.log", "ab")
    kw: dict = {}
    if WINDOWS:
        kw["creationflags"] = subprocess.CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE if new_console else subprocess.CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP
        if new_console:
            info = subprocess.STARTUPINFO()
            info.dwFlags |= subprocess.STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW
            info.wShowWindow = 7                               # minimized, not activated
            kw["startupinfo"] = info
    elif session:
        kw["start_new_session"] = True                         # its own process group, like a job in a shell
        kw["preexec_fn"] = _default_signals                    # a harness started in the background inherits "ignore"
    proc = subprocess.Popen(rig.serve_argv(), cwd=ROOT, env=rig.env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=log,
                            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, **kw)
    log.close()
    return proc


def windows_console_event(pid: int, kind: str) -> None:
    """Ctrl+C ('ctrl-c') or the window's close box ('close') on the console `pid` is attached to."""
    code = (
        "import ctypes, sys, time\n"
        "k = ctypes.windll.kernel32\n"
        "k.FreeConsole()\n"
        f"assert k.AttachConsole({pid}), 'AttachConsole failed'\n"
        "if sys.argv[1] == 'ctrl-c':\n"
        "    k.SetConsoleCtrlHandler(None, 1)\n"
        "    k.GenerateConsoleCtrlEvent(0, 0)\n"
        "    time.sleep(1.5)\n"
        "else:\n"
        "    hwnd = k.GetConsoleWindow()\n"
        "    assert hwnd, 'no console window'\n"
        "    ctypes.windll.user32.PostMessageW(hwnd, 0x0010, 0, 0)\n"
        "    time.sleep(1.0)\n"
    )
    # for "close" the helper is attached to the console that is closing, so the system ends it too: that exit is expected
    done = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code, kind], creationflags=subprocess.DETACHED_PROCESS, timeout=30)
    if kind == "ctrl-c" and done.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"could not send Ctrl+C (helper exit {done.returncode})")


def kill_hard(pid: int) -> None:
    if WINDOWS:
        subprocess.run(["taskkill", "/F", "/PID", str(pid)], capture_output=True)      # this one process, not its tree
    else:
        os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)


def pty_close(rig: Rig):
    """A terminal: the server runs as the session leader of a pseudo-terminal; closing the master is the window closing."""
    import pty
    pid, master = pty.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.chdir(ROOT)
        _default_signals()
        os.execve(sys.executable, rig.serve_argv(), rig.env)
    return pid, master


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ scenarios

class Result(dict):
    pass


def finish(rig: Rig, name: str, idents, *, expect_graceful: bool | None, note: str = "", vram_before=None,
           vram: bool = False, wait: float = 45, stopped_text: str | None = None, vram_during=None) -> Result:
    left = rig.wait_gone(idents, wait)
    problems = []
    if left:
        problems.append(f"processes left: {left}")
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 10                      # a closing process's sockets go a moment after it
    while port_open(rig.port) and time.monotonic() < deadline:
        time.sleep(0.2)
    if port_open(rig.port):
        problems.append("port still open")
    if not rig.lease_free():
        problems.append("lease still held")
    marks = rig.marks()
    if expect_graceful is True and not rig.real and not ({"quit", "eof"} & set(marks)):
        problems.append(f"engine was not asked to quit (marks {marks})")
    if vram and vram_before is not None:
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
        used = vram_used_mib()
        while used is not None and used > vram_before + 300 and time.monotonic() < deadline:
            time.sleep(1)
            used = vram_used_mib()
        if used is not None and used > vram_before + 300:
            problems.append(f"VRAM not freed: {used} MiB used, {vram_before} before")
        note += f" vram {vram_before}->{vram_during}->{used} MiB"
        if vram_during is not None and vram_during <= vram_before + 500:
            problems.append(f"the engine never held GPU memory ({vram_during} MiB while running), so the check proves nothing")
    return Result(name=name, ok=not problems, problems=problems, graceful=("quit" in marks or "eof" in marks),
                  marks=marks, note=note.strip(), stopped=stopped_text)


def serve_case(rig: Rig, name: str, action, *, graceful: bool | None, vram: bool = False,
               new_console: bool = False, wait: float = 45) -> Result:
    rig.clear_marks()
    before = vram_used_mib() if vram else None
    proc = spawn_serve(rig, new_console=new_console)
    try:
        rig.wait_ready(proc)
        idents = rig.tree(proc.pid)
        idents += [i for i in rig.engine_idents() if i.pid not in {x.pid for x in idents}]
        if not any("engine" in " ".join(i.cmd) or "--serve" in " ".join(i.cmd) for i in idents):
            raise RuntimeError(f"no engine in the tree: {[' '.join(i.cmd)[:60] for i in idents]}")
        during = vram_used_mib() if vram else None
        t0 = time.monotonic()
        action(rig, proc)
        out = finish(rig, name, idents, expect_graceful=graceful, vram_before=before, vram=vram, wait=wait,
                     vram_during=during)
        out["seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - t0, 1)
        text = (rig.root / "serve.log").read_text(errors="replace") if (rig.root / "serve.log").exists() else ""
        out["stopped"] = "[strata] stopped" in text
        if graceful is True and not out["stopped"]:
            out["problems"].append("the server did not print its clean-stop line"); out["ok"] = False
        return out
    finally:
