        if proc.poll() is None:
            proc.kill()
        try:
            proc.wait(timeout=10)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            pass
        for i in rig.tree(proc.pid):
            if procs.start_token(i.pid) == i.token:
                try:
                    psutil.Process(i.pid).kill()
                except psutil.Error:
                    pass
        keep = os.environ.get("STRATA_MATRIX_LOGS")                 # keep the server's and engine's logs as evidence
        if keep:
            Path(keep).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            for log in ("serve.log", "engine.log"):
                if (rig.root / log).exists():
                    (Path(keep) / f"{name}.{log}").write_bytes((rig.root / log).read_bytes())
        (rig.root / "serve.log").write_bytes(b"")


def sigint_group(rig, proc):                      # Ctrl+C in a terminal: SIGINT to the whole foreground group
    os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGINT)


def sigterm(rig, proc):
    os.kill(proc.pid, signal.SIGTERM)


def sighup(rig, proc):                            # what ssh dropping the connection does to the shell's job
    os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGHUP)


def kill9_parent(rig, proc):
    kill_hard(proc.pid)


def win_ctrl_break(rig, proc):
    os.kill(proc.pid, signal.CTRL_BREAK_EVENT)


def win_ctrl_c(rig, proc):
    windows_console_event(proc.pid, "ctrl-c")


def win_console_close(rig, proc):
    windows_console_event(proc.pid, "close")


def busy_sigterm(rig, proc):
    """A request is running when the stop arrives: it must be cancelled, not waited for."""
    import threading
    started = threading.Event()

    def ask():
        try:
            body = json.dumps({"model": "fake", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], "max_tokens": 4000 if rig.real else 200,
                               "stream": True}).encode()
            req = urllib.request.Request(f"http://127.0.0.1:{rig.port}/v1/chat/completions", data=body,
                                         headers={"content-type": "application/json"})
            started.set()
            urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60).read()
        except OSError:
            pass
    threading.Thread(target=ask, daemon=True).start()
    started.wait(5)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 10
    while not rig.real and "busy" not in rig.marks() and time.monotonic() < deadline:
        time.sleep(0.1)
    if rig.real:
        time.sleep(4)                               # the real engine is reading the prompt / generating by now
    (sigterm if not WINDOWS else win_ctrl_break)(rig, proc)


def nohup_case(rig: Rig, name: str = "serve-nohup-keeps-serving", *, vram: bool = False) -> Result:
    """`nohup strata serve &` asks to outlive its terminal: a hangup that was ignored at start is still ignored, and the
    server stops on SIGTERM as usual. (An ordinary server stops on SIGHUP: serve-sighup.)"""
    rig.clear_marks()
    before = vram_used_mib() if vram else None
    log = open(rig.root / "serve.log", "ab")

    def ignore_hangup():
        _default_signals()
        signal.signal(signal.SIGHUP, signal.SIG_IGN)
    proc = subprocess.Popen(rig.serve_argv(), cwd=ROOT, env=rig.env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=log,
                            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True, preexec_fn=ignore_hangup)
    log.close()
    try:
        rig.wait_ready(proc)
        idents = rig.tree(proc.pid)
        idents += [i for i in rig.engine_idents() if i.pid not in {x.pid for x in idents}]
        during = vram_used_mib() if vram else None
        os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGHUP)                  # the terminal closes
        time.sleep(3)
        problems = []
        if proc.poll() is not None or not port_open(rig.port):
            problems.append("the server stopped on a hangup it was told to ignore")
        t0 = time.monotonic()
        os.kill(proc.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        out = finish(rig, name, idents, expect_graceful=True, vram_before=before, vram=vram, vram_during=during)
        out["seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - t0, 1)
        out["problems"] = problems + out["problems"]
        out["ok"] = not out["problems"]
        return out
    finally:
        if proc.poll() is None:
            proc.kill()
        for i in rig.tree(proc.pid):
            if procs.start_token(i.pid) == i.token:
                try:
                    psutil.Process(i.pid).kill()
                except psutil.Error:
                    pass


def pty_close_case(rig: Rig, name: str = "serve-terminal-closed", *, vram: bool = False) -> Result:
    rig.clear_marks()
    before = vram_used_mib() if vram else None
    pid, master = pty_close(rig)
    try:
        class _P:                                   # just enough of Popen for wait_ready
            returncode = None

            def poll(self_inner):
                done, _ = os.waitpid(pid, os.WNOHANG)
                self_inner.returncode = 0 if done else None
                return 0 if done else None
        rig.wait_ready(_P())
        idents = rig.tree(pid)
        idents += [i for i in rig.engine_idents() if i.pid not in {x.pid for x in idents}]
        during = vram_used_mib() if vram else None
        t0 = time.monotonic()
        os.close(master)                            # the window is closed
        out = finish(rig, name, idents, expect_graceful=True, vram_before=before, vram=vram, vram_during=during)
        out["seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - t0, 1)
        return out
    finally:
        try:
            os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        except OSError:
            pass
        try:
            os.waitpid(pid, 0)
        except OSError:
            pass


# --- the detached service (`strata runtime start`) ------------------------------------------------

def runtime_start(rig: Rig, die_with: int | None = None) -> dict:
    argv = [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "strata.py"), "runtime", "start", "--profile", "app", "--wait", "400" if rig.real else "240",
            "--shutdown-timeout", "5", "--output", "json"]
    if die_with:
        argv += ["--die-with-pid", str(die_with)]
    out = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=ROOT, env=rig.env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=500)
    try:
        return json.loads(out.stdout)
    except ValueError:
        raise RuntimeError(f"runtime start gave {out.returncode}: {out.stdout[-300:]} {out.stderr[-300:]}") from None


def runtime_stop(rig: Rig) -> dict:
    out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / "strata.py"), "runtime", "stop", "--profile", "app", "--wait", "60",
                          "--output", "json"], cwd=ROOT, env=rig.env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    try:
        return json.loads(out.stdout)
    except ValueError:
        return {"ok": False, "raw": out.stdout[-300:] + out.stderr[-300:]}


def owner_pid(rig: Rig) -> int:
    return runtime._read_state("app")["host_pid"]


def sleeper_process() -> subprocess.Popen:
    return subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-c", "import time; time.sleep(600)"],
                            creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0))


def runtime_case(rig: Rig, name: str, what: str, *, vram: bool = False) -> Result:
    rig.clear_marks()
    before = vram_used_mib() if vram else None
    holder = sleeper_process() if what == "die-with" else None
    try:
        started = runtime_start(rig, die_with=holder.pid if holder else None)
        if started.get("state") != "ready":
            raise RuntimeError(f"not ready: {started}")
        owner = owner_pid(rig)
        idents = rig.tree(owner)
        during = vram_used_mib() if vram else None
        t0 = time.monotonic()
        graceful = True
        note = ""
        if what == "stop":
            res = runtime_stop(rig)
            note = f"stop -> {res.get('state')}"
        elif what == "terminal-gone":
            # the command that started it is long gone; the service must still be serving
            time.sleep(1.5)
            note = "still serving: " + str(port_open(rig.port))
            if not port_open(rig.port):
                raise RuntimeError("the background service died with its terminal")
            res = runtime_stop(rig)
        elif what == "owner-killed":
            kill_hard(owner)
            graceful = None
        elif what == "server-killed":
            server = next(i for i in idents if "serve.server" in " ".join(i.cmd))
            kill_hard(server.pid)
            graceful = None
            note = "server killed, owner left alive"
            idents = [i for i in idents if "strata_control.runtime" not in " ".join(i.cmd) and "conhost" not in " ".join(i.cmd)]
        elif what == "die-with":
            holder.kill(); holder.wait(timeout=10)
        if what == "server-killed":
            # the server and engine are gone; the owner host stays to report the failure until it is told to stop
            out = finish(rig, name, idents, expect_graceful=graceful, vram_before=before, vram=vram, note=note, wait=60,
                     vram_during=during)
            out["problems"] = [p for p in out["problems"] if p != "lease still held"]
            res = runtime_stop(rig)
            out["stop_after"] = res.get("state")
            left = rig.wait_gone(rig.tree(owner) or [], 30)
            if left or not rig.lease_free():
                out["problems"].append(f"after runtime stop: {left} lease_free={rig.lease_free()}")
            out["ok"] = not out["problems"]
            return out
        out = finish(rig, name, idents, expect_graceful=graceful, vram_before=before, vram=vram, note=note, wait=60,
                     vram_during=during)
        out["seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - t0, 1)
        if what == "owner-killed":
            res = runtime_stop(rig)                       # the next stop clears the private state of a lost owner
            out["stop_after"] = res.get("state")
            if runtime._read_state("app") is not None:
                out["problems"].append("state file left after stop"); out["ok"] = False
        return out
    finally:
        if holder and holder.poll() is None:
            holder.kill()
        try:
            if runtime._read_state("app") is not None:
                runtime_stop(rig)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass
        for i in rig.engine_idents():
            try:
                psutil.Process(i.pid).kill()
            except psutil.Error:
                pass


def windows_press(pid: int, text: str) -> None:
    """Type `text` into the console `pid` is attached to (what a person at the keyboard does)."""
    code = (
        "import ctypes, sys\n"
        "from ctypes import wintypes\n"
        "k = ctypes.windll.kernel32\n"
        "class Key(ctypes.Structure):\n"
        "    _fields_ = [('down', wintypes.BOOL), ('repeat', wintypes.WORD), ('vk', wintypes.WORD), ('scan', wintypes.WORD),\n"
        "                ('char', wintypes.WCHAR), ('state', wintypes.DWORD)]\n"
        "class Rec(ctypes.Structure):\n"
        "    _fields_ = [('kind', wintypes.WORD), ('pad', wintypes.WORD), ('key', Key)]\n"
        "k.FreeConsole()\n"
        f"assert k.AttachConsole({pid}), 'AttachConsole failed'\n"
        "k.CreateFileW.restype = wintypes.HANDLE\n"
        "h = k.CreateFileW('CONIN$', 0xC0000000, 3, None, 3, 0, None)\n"
        "recs = []\n"
        "for ch in sys.argv[1]:\n"
        "    for down in (1, 0):\n"
        "        recs.append(Rec(1, 0, Key(down, 1, ord(ch.upper()), 0, ch, 0)))\n"
        "arr = (Rec * len(recs))(*recs)\n"
        "n = wintypes.DWORD()\n"
        "assert k.WriteConsoleInputW(h, arr, len(recs), ctypes.byref(n)), 'WriteConsoleInput failed'\n"
    )
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code, text], creationflags=subprocess.DETACHED_PROCESS, check=True, timeout=30)


def monitor_case(rig: Rig, how: str) -> Result:
    """The Textual monitor starts no engine. Quitting it (`q`) or killing it ends the monitor and leaves a service
    started elsewhere untouched; nothing of the monitor is left behind."""
    rig.clear_marks()
    started = runtime_start(rig)
    if started.get("state") != "ready":
        raise RuntimeError(f"not ready: {started}")
    owner = owner_pid(rig)
    service = rig.tree(owner)
    argv = [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "strata.py"), "monitor", "--url", f"http://127.0.0.1:{rig.port}"]
    env = {**rig.env, "TERM": "xterm-256color", "COLUMNS": "120", "LINES": "40"}
    master = child = None
    if WINDOWS:
        info = subprocess.STARTUPINFO()
        info.dwFlags |= subprocess.STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW
        info.wShowWindow = 7
        monitor = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=ROOT, env=env, creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE, startupinfo=info)
        pid, alive = monitor.pid, lambda: monitor.poll() is None
    else:
        import fcntl, pty, struct, termios
        child, master = pty.fork()
        if child == 0:
            os.chdir(ROOT)
            _default_signals()
            fcntl.ioctl(0, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack("HHHH", 40, 120, 0, 0))     # a terminal that has a size
            os.execve(sys.executable, argv, env)
        pid = child
        gone = []

        def drain():                                  # a TUI paints without pause; a full pty buffer would freeze it
            while True:
                try:
                    if not os.read(master, 65536):
                        return
                except OSError:
                    return
        import threading
        threading.Thread(target=drain, daemon=True).start()

        def alive():
            if gone:
                return False
            try:
                done, _ = os.waitpid(child, os.WNOHANG)
            except ChildProcessError:
                done = child
            if done:
                gone.append(True)
            return not done
    problems = []
    time.sleep(4)
    if not alive():
        problems.append("the monitor did not stay up (is Textual installed here?)")
    mine = rig.tree(pid)
    if how == "quit":
        if WINDOWS:
            windows_press(pid, "q")
        else:
            os.write(master, b"q")
    else:
        kill_hard(pid)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 15
    while alive() and time.monotonic() < deadline:
        time.sleep(0.2)
    if alive():
        problems.append(f"the monitor did not end on '{how}'")
    if master is not None:
        os.close(master)
    left = rig.wait_gone(mine, 15)
    if left:
        problems.append(f"monitor processes left: {left}")
    if not port_open(rig.port) or rig.survivors(service) != [f"{i.pid} {' '.join(i.cmd)[:90]}" for i in service
                                                           if procs.start_token(i.pid) == i.token]:
        problems.append("the monitor's end disturbed the service")
    runtime_stop(rig)
    left = rig.wait_gone(service, 45)
    if left:
        problems.append(f"service left after stop: {left}")
    return Result(name=f"monitor-{how}-leaves-service-alone", ok=not problems, problems=problems, marks=rig.marks(), note="")


SCENARIOS = {
    # foreground `strata serve`
    "serve-ctrl-c": lambda rig, v: serve_case(rig, "serve-ctrl-c", win_ctrl_c if WINDOWS else sigint_group,
                                              graceful=True, vram=v, new_console=WINDOWS),
    "serve-sigterm": lambda rig, v: serve_case(rig, "serve-sigterm", sigterm, graceful=True, vram=v),
    "serve-sighup": lambda rig, v: serve_case(rig, "serve-sighup", sighup, graceful=True, vram=v),
    "serve-ctrl-break": lambda rig, v: serve_case(rig, "serve-ctrl-break", win_ctrl_break, graceful=True, vram=v),
    "serve-console-close": lambda rig, v: serve_case(rig, "serve-console-close", win_console_close, graceful=None,
                                                     vram=v, new_console=True),
    "serve-kill-parent": lambda rig, v: serve_case(rig, "serve-kill-parent", kill9_parent, graceful=None, vram=v),
    "serve-busy-stop": lambda rig, v: serve_case(rig, "serve-busy-stop", busy_sigterm, graceful=True, vram=v),
    "serve-terminal-closed": lambda rig, v: pty_close_case(rig, vram=v),
    "serve-nohup-keeps-serving": lambda rig, v: nohup_case(rig, vram=v),
    # `strata runtime start` (a background service by design)
    "runtime-stop": lambda rig, v: runtime_case(rig, "runtime-stop", "stop", vram=v),
    "runtime-survives-terminal": lambda rig, v: runtime_case(rig, "runtime-survives-terminal", "terminal-gone", vram=v),
    "runtime-owner-killed": lambda rig, v: runtime_case(rig, "runtime-owner-killed", "owner-killed", vram=v),
    "runtime-server-killed": lambda rig, v: runtime_case(rig, "runtime-server-killed", "server-killed", vram=v),
    "runtime-die-with": lambda rig, v: runtime_case(rig, "runtime-die-with", "die-with", vram=v),
    # the TUI
    "monitor-quit": lambda rig, v: monitor_case(rig, "quit"),
    "monitor-killed": lambda rig, v: monitor_case(rig, "kill"),
}
POSIX_ONLY = {"serve-sigterm", "serve-sighup", "serve-terminal-closed", "serve-nohup-keeps-serving"}
WINDOWS_ONLY = {"serve-ctrl-break", "serve-console-close"}


def applicable(name: str) -> bool:
    if WINDOWS:
        return name not in POSIX_ONLY
    return name not in WINDOWS_ONLY


def run(names: list[str], *, real_config: Path | None = None, real_components: Path | None = None,
        vram: bool = False, slow_steps: int = 600) -> list[Result]:
    results = []
    for name in names:
        saved = dict(os.environ)                      # a Rig points this process at its own folders; give them back
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="strata-matrix-") as tmp:
            rig = Rig(Path(tmp), real_config=real_config, real_components=real_components, slow_steps=slow_steps if name == "serve-busy-stop" else 0)
            try:
                result = SCENARIOS[name](rig, vram)
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                result = Result(name=name, ok=False, problems=[f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"], marks=[])
            results.append(result)
            print(("PASS " if result["ok"] else "FAIL ") + name, result.get("seconds", ""), result.get("problems") or "",
                  result.get("note", ""), flush=True)
            try:
                runtime_stop(rig)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass
            for ident in rig.engine_idents():
                try:
                    psutil.Process(ident.pid).kill()
                except psutil.Error:
                    pass
        os.environ.clear()
        os.environ.update(saved)
    return results


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--scenarios", default="all")
    ap.add_argument("--config", help="a real engine's run config (then no fake engine is used)")
    ap.add_argument("--components", help="the engine component folder for --config (STRATA_COMPONENTS_DIR)")
    ap.add_argument("--vram", action="store_true", help="check nvidia-smi memory returns")
    ap.add_argument("--report")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    names = [n for n in SCENARIOS if applicable(n)] if a.scenarios == "all" else a.scenarios.split(",")
    results = run(names, real_config=Path(a.config) if a.config else None,
                  real_components=Path(a.components) if a.components else None, vram=a.vram)
    if a.report:
        Path(a.report).write_text(json.dumps({"platform": sys.platform, "engine": "real" if a.config else "fake",
                                              "results": results}, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    return 0 if all(r["ok"] for r in results) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())


## tests/terminal/ssh_disconnect.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""A real ssh disconnect ends the server and its engine on a Linux box.

    python tests/terminal/ssh_disconnect.py --host p2003ssh.claryel.space --src /data/split-life/src --python /data/venv/bin/python

Runs from any machine with ssh: it starts `strata serve` on the box in an `ssh -tt` session (a pty, like an interactive
login), kills the LOCAL ssh client (the connection drops, sshd hangs up the pty), and then checks on the box that the
server and the fake engine are gone, the port is free and the lease is free. The engine is the fake package of
lifecycle_matrix.py (no GPU, no model). It prints one line, `PASS ssh-disconnect ...` or `FAIL ...`, and exits 0/1.
"""
import argparse
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time

REMOTE_RIG = r'''
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "%(src)s")
from pathlib import Path
from tests.terminal import lifecycle_matrix as m
root = Path("/data/split-life/sshrig"); import shutil; shutil.rmtree(root, ignore_errors=True); root.mkdir(parents=True)
rig = m.Rig(root)
print(json.dumps({"argv": rig.serve_argv(), "env": {k: v for k, v in rig.env.items() if k.startswith(("STRATA_", "FAKE_", "XDG_", "LOCALAPPDATA", "PYTHONPATH"))}, "port": rig.port}))
'''

REMOTE_STATE = r'''
import json, os, socket, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "%(src)s")
os.environ.update(json.loads(%(env)r))
from strata_control import procs, runtime
port = %(port)d
left = [r for r in procs.records() if procs.start_token(r["pid"]) == r["token"]]
import psutil
fam = [p.pid for p in psutil.process_iter(["cmdline"]) if any("sshrig" in c or "serve.server" in c or "strata.py" in c for c in (p.info["cmdline"] or [])) and p.pid != os.getpid()]
with socket.socket() as s:
    s.settimeout(0.5); open_ = s.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1", port)) == 0
try:
    fd = runtime.acquire_activity_lease(shared=False); runtime._unlock_file(fd); os.close(fd); lease = True
except Exception:
    lease = False
print(json.dumps({"records_alive": [r["pid"] for r in left], "processes": fam, "port_open": open_, "lease_free": lease}))
'''


def ssh(host, *args, stdin=None, timeout=120):
    return subprocess.run(["ssh", "-o", "ConnectTimeout=30", host, *args], input=stdin, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--host", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--src", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--python", default="python3")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    rig = json.loads(ssh(a.host, a.python, "-", stdin=REMOTE_RIG % {"src": a.src}).stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1])
    env = " ".join(f"{k}='{v}'" for k, v in rig["env"].items())
    remote = f"cd {a.src} && env {env} {a.python} " + " ".join(rig["argv"][1:])
    client = subprocess.Popen(["ssh", "-tt", "-o", "ConnectTimeout=30", a.host, remote], stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                              stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    ready = False
    for _ in range(120):
        probe = ssh(a.host, f"curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{{http_code}}' http://127.0.0.1:{rig['port']}/health")
        if probe.stdout.strip() == "200":
            ready = True
            break
        time.sleep(1)
    if not ready:
        client.kill()
        print("FAIL ssh-disconnect: the server did not come up")
        return 1
    client.kill()                                       # the connection drops; sshd hangs up the pty
    client.wait(timeout=10)
    state = {}
    for _ in range(40):
        time.sleep(1)
        state = json.loads(ssh(a.host, a.python, "-", stdin=REMOTE_STATE % {"src": a.src, "env": json.dumps(rig["env"]), "port": rig["port"]}).stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1])
        if not state["records_alive"] and not state["processes"] and not state["port_open"] and state["lease_free"]:
            print("PASS ssh-disconnect", json.dumps(state))
            return 0
    print("FAIL ssh-disconnect", json.dumps(state))
    return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())


## tests/terminal/test_app_isolation.py

"""The desktop app never adopts an older command-line Strata install (tester report 2026-10-17: the app wrote
strata-gyro-gyro-s.log/.json into the tester's old T:\\Strata). The app points Control and the installer at a settings file of its
own (STRATA_SETTINGS_FILE); the shared %APPDATA% / ~/.config file with the old install's folders is not read."""

import json
import os
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from strata_control import models  # noqa: E402
import setup as strata_setup  # noqa: E402


class AppIsolation(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.dir.cleanup)
        base = Path(self.dir.name)
        self.old = base / "T-Strata"
        self.old.mkdir()
        (self.old / "strata-gyro-gyro-s.json").write_text(json.dumps({"exe": "strata.exe", "tokenizer": "t", "args": []}))
        shared = base / "appdata" / "Strata"
        shared.mkdir(parents=True)
        (shared / "settings.json").write_text(json.dumps({"installs": [str(self.old)], "data_dir": str(base / "T-data")}))
        (base / "xdg" / "strata").mkdir(parents=True)
        (base / "xdg" / "strata" / "settings.json").write_text(json.dumps({"installs": [str(self.old)], "data_dir": str(base / "T-data")}))
        self.app_data = base / "app" / "Strata"
        self.app_data.mkdir(parents=True)
        self.env = {"APPDATA": str(base / "appdata"), "XDG_CONFIG_HOME": str(base / "xdg"),
                    "LOCALAPPDATA": str(base / "local"), "XDG_DATA_HOME": str(base / "xdg-data"), "STRATA_COMPONENTS_DIR": ""}
        self.base = base
        self.terminal = base / "terminal"
        self.terminal.mkdir()

    def test_the_terminal_still_remembers_the_old_install(self):
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, self.env), mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=False), mock.patch.object(models, "ROOT", self.terminal):
            os.environ.pop("STRATA_SETTINGS_FILE", None)
            os.environ.pop("STRATA_INSTALL_DIR", None)
            self.assertEqual(models.resolve_install(), (self.old.resolve(), "remembered"))

    def test_the_app_does_not(self):
        env = {**self.env, "STRATA_SETTINGS_FILE": str(self.app_data / "app-settings.json")}
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, env), mock.patch.object(models, "ROOT", self.terminal):
            os.environ.pop("STRATA_INSTALL_DIR", None)
            self.assertEqual(models.settings_path(), self.app_data / "app-settings.json")
            self.assertEqual(models.remembered_installs(), [])
            # no older install is adopted: with nothing of its own yet the app gets its own install folder (beside its components folder)
            found, how = models.resolve_install()
            self.assertEqual(how, "default")
            self.assertNotEqual(found, self.old.resolve())
            self.assertEqual(strata_setup.settings_path(), self.app_data / "app-settings.json")
            self.assertEqual(strata_setup.load_settings(), {})
            # the installer's own list of "other installs" has no sibling scan and no shared settings
            self.assertEqual(strata_setup.other_installs(strata_setup.load_settings()), [])

    def test_saving_settings_goes_to_the_app_file_only(self):
        env = {**self.env, "STRATA_SETTINGS_FILE": str(self.app_data / "app-settings.json")}
        shared = self.base / "appdata" / "Strata" / "settings.json"
        before = shared.read_bytes()
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, env):
            strata_setup.save_settings({"data_dir": str(self.app_data / "data")})
        self.assertEqual(shared.read_bytes(), before)
        self.assertIn("data_dir", json.loads((self.app_data / "app-settings.json").read_text()))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_app_prerelease_version.py

"""The app reports its version as 0.2.0-beta; the update check must compare it, not choke on it."""
import unittest

from strata_control import feed as feedmod


class AppPrereleaseVersionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_pre_release_sorts_below_the_same_number_and_above_the_older_one(self):
        key = feedmod.app_version_key
        self.assertLess(key("0.2.0-beta"), key("0.2.0"))
        self.assertGreater(key("0.2.0-beta"), key("0.1.46"))
        self.assertLess(key("0.2.0-beta"), key("0.2.0.1"))
        self.assertEqual(key("0.2.0"), key("0.2.0"))

    def test_a_feed_whose_app_entry_is_a_pre_release_parses(self):
        """The release feed carries app version 0.2.0-beta (found building the real feed: parse() used the strict key)."""
        import json
        from tests.terminal import update_fixture as fx
        key = fx.make_key()
        doc = {"schema_version": 1, "feed": "strata-updates", "channel": "stable", "sequence": 1, "generated_at": "2026-10-19T00:00:00Z", "expires_at": None,
               "app": {"version": "0.2.0-beta", "notes": "", "pub_date": "2026-10-19T00:00:00Z",
                       "platforms": {"windows-x86_64": {"url": "a.exe", "signature": "s", "sha256": "a" * 64, "size": 1}}}}
        from strata_control import signing
        payload = (json.dumps(doc, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
        loaded = feedmod.verify_and_parse(payload, json.dumps(signing.sign_bytes(key, payload)).encode(), source="x", trusted=fx.trusted_of(key))
        self.assertEqual(loaded.app.version, "0.2.0-beta")

    def test_the_feeds_own_versions_stay_strict(self):
        with self.assertRaises(feedmod.FeedError):
            feedmod.version_key("0.2.0-beta")
        with self.assertRaises(feedmod.FeedError):
            feedmod.app_version_key("0.2.0-be ta")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_archive_gaps.py

"""Things a user of the Terminal archive (no setup.py, no tools/calibrate.py, an engine package) hit on real boxes."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import stat
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from strata_control import calibration, tune_apply, tuning  # noqa: E402
from strata_control.profiles import ProfileError  # noqa: E402


class BooleanFlags(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_boolean_flag_is_on_or_absent_never_given_a_value(self):
        self.assertEqual(tuning.flag_argv("--kv-grow", "1"), ["--kv-grow"])
        self.assertEqual(tuning.flag_argv("--kv-grow", "0"), [])
        self.assertEqual(tuning.flag_argv("--kv-grow", True), ["--kv-grow"])
        self.assertEqual(tuning.flag_argv("--kv-grow", False), [])
        self.assertEqual(tuning.flag_argv("--spec-min-p", "0.5"), ["--spec-min-p", "0.5"])
        self.assertEqual(tuning.flag_argv("--spec", "1"), ["--spec", "1"])      # a numeric flag keeps its 1

    def test_a_candidate_with_kv_grow_off_does_not_become_kv_grow_0(self):
        self.assertEqual(tune_apply.args_to_argv({"--kv-grow": "0", "--kv": "int8"}), ["--kv", "int8"])
        self.assertEqual(tune_apply.args_to_argv({"--kv-grow": "1"}), ["--kv-grow"])

    def test_the_harness_argv_follows_the_same_rule(self):
        from strata_control import tune_engine
        harness = tune_engine.EngineHarness(Path("engine"), {"--kv-grow": "0", "--pool-workers": "0", "--host-core": "first"})
        argv = harness._argv()
        self.assertNotIn("--kv-grow", argv)
        self.assertIn("--pool-workers", argv)
        self.assertEqual(argv[argv.index("--pool-workers") + 1], "0")


class EnginePackageEnv(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_package_folder_goes_first_on_the_library_path(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            folder = Path(d)
            (folder / "engine-component.json").write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
            (folder / "strata").write_text("x", encoding="utf-8")
            with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"LD_LIBRARY_PATH": "/old", "PATH": "/old"}):
                env = tuning.engine_env(folder / "strata")
            var = "PATH" if os.name == "nt" else "LD_LIBRARY_PATH"
            self.assertTrue(env[var].startswith(str(folder.resolve())))
            self.assertTrue(env[var].endswith("/old") or env[var].endswith("old"))

    def test_a_plain_engine_keeps_the_callers_environment(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            (Path(d) / "strata").write_text("x", encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertIsNone(tuning.engine_env(Path(d) / "strata"))


class CalibrateWithoutAFullFolder(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_missing_setup_is_a_refusal_in_words_not_a_traceback(self):
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=False):
            os.environ.pop("STRATA_INSTALL_DIR", None)
            with mock.patch("importlib.import_module", side_effect=ImportError("no module")):
                with self.assertRaises(ProfileError) as ctx:
                    calibration._full_folder("tools.calibrate")
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code if hasattr(ctx.exception, "code") else 5, 5)
        self.assertIn("STRATA_INSTALL_DIR", str(ctx.exception))
        self.assertIn("tune run --mode api", str(ctx.exception))

    def test_tool_availability_is_reported_for_the_plan(self):
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=False):
            os.environ.pop("STRATA_INSTALL_DIR", None)
            with mock.patch("importlib.util.find_spec", return_value=None):
                self.assertFalse(calibration._tools_available())
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
                (Path(d) / "tools").mkdir()
                (Path(d) / "setup.py").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
                (Path(d) / "tools" / "calibrate.py").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
                os.environ["STRATA_INSTALL_DIR"] = d
                with mock.patch("importlib.util.find_spec", return_value=None):
                    self.assertTrue(calibration._tools_available())


class HipPackageForAnotherCard(unittest.TestCase):
    """A HIP package built for gfx1200/gfx1201 must not be chosen for a Phoenix iGPU (gfx1103): P2006 resolved it as usable."""

    def _kfd(self, root: Path, versions):
        for number, value in enumerate(versions):
            node = root / str(number)
            node.mkdir()
            (node / "properties").write_text("cpu_cores_count 1\ngfx_target_version " + value + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    def test_gfx_target_version_becomes_the_gfx_name(self):
        from strata_control import engine_component as ec
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            self._kfd(Path(d), ["0", "110003", "120001", "90010", "100300"])
            self.assertEqual(ec.hip_archs_present(d), ["gfx1103", "gfx1201", "gfx90a", "gfx1030"])
        self.assertEqual(ec.hip_archs_present("/nonexistent/kfd"), [])

    def test_a_package_without_the_cards_arch_is_not_chosen_and_one_with_it_is(self):
        from strata_control import engine_component as ec
        from tests.terminal.test_engine_component import make_package, rewrite
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            root = Path(d)
            folder = make_package(root, backend="hip")
            rewrite(folder, schema_version=2, archs=["gfx1200", "gfx1201"], build_id="test")
            with mock.patch.object(ec, "hip_archs_present", return_value=["gfx1103"]):
                with self.assertRaises(ec.EngineMissing) as ctx:
                    ec.resolve(root, backend="hip")
            self.assertIn("gfx1103", str(ctx.exception))
            self.assertIn("gfx1201", str(ctx.exception))
            with mock.patch.object(ec, "hip_archs_present", return_value=["gfx1201"]):
                self.assertEqual(ec.resolve(root, backend="hip").backend, "hip")
            with mock.patch.object(ec, "hip_archs_present", return_value=[]):      # cannot tell: not a refusal
                self.assertEqual(ec.resolve(root, backend="hip").backend, "hip")


class DeviceAccess(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_render_node_the_user_cannot_open_is_named(self):
        from strata_control import doctor
        if not sys.platform.startswith("linux"):
            self.skipTest("Linux device nodes")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            (Path(d) / "dri").mkdir()
            node = Path(d) / "dri" / "renderD128"
            node.write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
            os.chmod(node, 0)
            if os.access(node, os.R_OK):
                self.skipTest("running as a user that can open anything")
            issue = doctor._device_access_issue("sycl", d)
            self.assertEqual(issue["code"], "GPU_DEVICE_ACCESS")
            self.assertIn("render", issue["message"])
            os.chmod(node, 0o666)
            self.assertIsNone(doctor._device_access_issue("sycl", d))
            self.assertIsNone(doctor._device_access_issue("cuda", d))
            self.assertIsNone(doctor._device_access_issue("hip", tempfile.gettempdir() + "/none"))


class ArchiveContents(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_the_fingerprint_table_models_import_reads_is_in_the_payload(self):
        sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "packaging"))
        import package_terminal
        self.assertIn("data/gguf_fingerprints.json", package_terminal.PAYLOAD)
        self.assertTrue((ROOT / "data" / "gguf_fingerprints.json").is_file())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_bench.py

"""Serving benchmark evidence with a live mock HTTP server, no model weights."""

import io
import json
import os
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import time
import unittest
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from serve.frontend import ChatTemplate
from serve.server import ByteTokenizer, IM_END, MockEngine, Service, serve
from strata_cli import bench
from strata_cli.cli import main
from strata_cli.client import Endpoint
from strata_control import benchmarking, journal, management
from strata_control.private_files import is_unshared
from strata_control.profiles import ProfileError


class _NoGpu:
    note = None

    def ok(self):
        return False

    def name(self):
        return None

    def read(self):
        return {}


class BenchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        # The telemetry sampler reads the machine's real GPU on a timer; a card's first reading lands
        # between two benchmark runs and makes their reported environments differ. Use no GPU.
        patcher = mock.patch("serve.telemetry.gpu_reader", lambda index=0, amd=False: _NoGpu())
        patcher.start()
        self.addCleanup(patcher.stop)
        tok = ByteTokenizer()
        service = Service(MockEngine(tok, "Benchmark mock answer.", max_context=4096), tok,
                          ChatTemplate(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "serve/chat_template.jinja"))
        service.api_key = "inference-test-secret"
        service.telemetry_key = "monitor-test-secret"
        self.service = service
        self.httpd = serve(service, port=0)
        self.addCleanup(self.httpd.server_close)
        self.addCleanup(self.httpd.shutdown)
        self.url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.httpd.server_address[1]}"
        self.inference = Endpoint(self.url, service.api_key)
        self.telemetry = Endpoint(self.url, service.telemetry_key)

    def test_live_benchmark_writes_private_report_without_prompt_or_answer(self):
        out = self.root / "smoke"
        with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            report = bench.run(self.inference, self.telemetry, out, concurrency=2)
        self.assertTrue(report["successful"])
        self.assertEqual([p["kind"] for p in report["phases"]], ["warmup", "serial", "mixed"])
        self.assertEqual(report["phases"][2]["requested"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(report["phases"][2]["client_workers"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(report["instance_id"], report["after"]["instance_id"])
        self.assertTrue(all(r["ttft_s"] is not None and r["completion_tokens"] is not None
                            for p in report["phases"] for r in p["requests"]))
        contents = (out / "results.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        for secret in ("inference-test-secret", "monitor-test-secret", "Benchmark mock answer.",
                       "Answer in one sentence"):
            self.assertNotIn(secret, contents)
        self.assertIn("prompt_sha256", contents)
        if os.name != "nt":
            self.assertEqual(stat.S_IMODE(out.stat().st_mode), 0o700)
            self.assertEqual(stat.S_IMODE((out / "results.json").stat().st_mode), 0o600)
        self.assertEqual(bench.summary(bench.load(out))["successful"], True)
        self.assertEqual(self.telemetry.snapshot()["work"]["client_disconnect_cancels"], 0)

    def test_phase_progress_is_private_and_recovers_from_saved_report(self):
        output = self.root / "progress"
        reached = threading.Event()
        release = threading.Event()
        original = bench._phase

        def held_phase(*args, **kwargs):
            if kwargs["kind"] == "mixed":
                reached.set()
                if not release.wait(10):
                    raise AssertionError("progress test did not release the mixed phase")
            return original(*args, **kwargs)

        with mock.patch.object(bench, "_phase", side_effect=held_phase), \
                ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as pool:
            future = pool.submit(bench.run, self.inference, self.telemetry, output, concurrency=2)
            try:
                self.assertTrue(reached.wait(10))
                active = bench.progress(output)
                self.assertEqual(active["state"], "running")
                self.assertEqual(active["completed_phases"], 2)
                self.assertEqual(active["current_phase"], "mixed")
            finally:
                release.set()
            self.assertTrue(future.result(timeout=10)["successful"])
        saved = bench.progress(output / "results.json")
        self.assertEqual(saved["state"], "report_saved")
        self.assertEqual(saved["completed_phases"], 3)
        self.assertTrue(saved["successful"])
        raw = (output / "progress.json").read_text()
        self.assertNotIn("inference-test-secret", raw)
        self.assertNotIn("Benchmark mock answer", raw)
        if os.name == "posix":
            self.assertEqual(stat.S_IMODE((output / "progress.json").stat().st_mode), 0o600)

    def test_saved_profile_benchmark_lease_refuses_overlap(self):
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_PROFILE_DIR": str(self.root / "profiles")}):
            output = self.root / "leased-run"
            self.assertEqual(benchmarking.benchmark_activity("local", output), "untracked")
            with benchmarking.benchmark_lease("local", output):
                self.assertEqual(benchmarking.benchmark_activity("local", output), "active")
                self.assertEqual(benchmarking.benchmark_activity("local", self.root / "other-run"),
                                 "other_active")
                raw = (self.root / "profiles" / ".bench-local.lock").read_bytes()
                self.assertNotIn(os.fsencode(str(output)), raw)
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProfileError, "another benchmark is running"):
                    with benchmarking.benchmark_lease("local"):
                        self.fail("overlapping benchmark lease was accepted")
            self.assertEqual(benchmarking.benchmark_activity("local", output), "ended")
            self.assertEqual(benchmarking.benchmark_activity("local", self.root / "raw-run"),
                             "untracked")
            with benchmarking.benchmark_lease("local"):
                self.assertEqual(benchmarking.benchmark_activity("local", output), "untracked")

    def test_operator_cancel_stops_live_stream_and_saves_distinct_evidence(self):
        output = self.root / "operator-stopped"
        self.service.engine.delay = 0.15
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_PROFILE_DIR": str(self.root / "profiles")}), \
                ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as pool:
            def execute():
                with benchmarking.benchmark_lease("local", output):
                    return bench.run(self.inference, self.telemetry, output,
                                     concurrency=2, request_timeout=30)
            started = time.monotonic()
            future = pool.submit(execute)
            deadline = started + 10
            while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                if output.exists() and self.telemetry.snapshot()["work"]["active"] > 0:
                    break
                time.sleep(0.05)
            else:
                self.fail("benchmark did not enter an active request")
            wrong = self.root / "another-run"
            wrong.mkdir(mode=0o700)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProfileError, "exact benchmark run is not active"):
                benchmarking.request_cancel("local", wrong)
            linked = self.root / "linked-run"
            linked.symlink_to(output, target_is_directory=True)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProfileError, "owner-only"):
                benchmarking.request_cancel("local", linked)
            with mock.patch("strata_control.profiles.load", return_value=({"id": "local"}, "a" * 16)):
                request = management.dispatch({"schema_version": 1, "action": "bench.cancel",
                                               "profile": "local",
                                               "params": {"path": str(output / "results.json")}})
            self.assertEqual(request["state"], "cancel_requested")
            report = future.result(timeout=10)
            self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - started, 10)
            self.assertTrue(report["cancelled"])
            self.assertFalse(report["successful"])
            self.assertEqual(bench.progress(output)["state"], "cancelled")
            self.assertTrue(benchmarking.cancel_requested(output))
            self.assertTrue(bench.load(output)["cancelled"])
            self.assertIn("| Result | Cancelled |", bench.markdown_report(report))
            self.assertEqual(benchmarking.benchmark_activity("local", output), "ended")
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProfileError, "not active"):
                benchmarking.request_cancel("local", output)

    def test_progress_bridge_reports_exact_run_lease(self):
        output = self.root / "bridge-progress"
        with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            bench.run(self.inference, self.telemetry, output, concurrency=1)
        request = {"schema_version": 1, "action": "bench.progress", "profile": "local",
                   "params": {"path": str(output / "results.json")}}
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_PROFILE_DIR": str(self.root / "profiles")}), \
                mock.patch("strata_control.profiles.load", return_value=({"id": "local"}, "a" * 16)):
            with benchmarking.benchmark_lease("local", output):
                active = management.dispatch(request)
                self.assertEqual(active["activity"], "active")
                self.assertEqual(active["progress"]["state"], "report_saved")
            self.assertEqual(management.dispatch(request)["activity"], "ended")

    def test_durable_benchmark_job_receipt_survives_host_state_loss(self):
        output = self.root / "durable-job"
        instance = self.telemetry.snapshot()["instance"]["id"]
        revision, source = "a" * 16, "b" * 64
        job_id = "c" * 32
        params = {"path": str(output), "suite": "serving-smoke", "concurrency": 2,
                  "repeat": 1, "request_timeout": 30, "condition": "baseline",
                  "if_profile_revision": revision, "if_source_sha256": source,
                  "if_owner_id": "d" * 32, "if_instance_id": instance}
        identity = {"profile": "local", "revision": revision, "source_sha256": source}
        settings = (None, identity, self.inference, self.telemetry, output)
        planned = {"profile_revision": revision, "source_sha256": source,
                   "owner_id": "d" * 32, "instance_id": instance}
        (self.root / "profiles").mkdir(mode=0o700)
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_PROFILE_DIR": str(self.root / "profiles")}), \
                mock.patch("strata_control.profiles.load", return_value=({"id": "local"}, revision)), \
                mock.patch.object(benchmarking, "_settings", return_value=settings), \
                mock.patch.object(benchmarking, "plan", return_value=planned), \
                mock.patch.object(bench, "_managed_match", return_value={"matched": True,
                                                                          "instance_id": instance}):
            created = management.dispatch({"schema_version": 1, "action": "bench.job.create",
                                           "profile": "local", "params": {**params, "job_id": job_id}})
            self.assertEqual(created["job_id"], job_id)
            self.assertEqual(benchmarking.job_status("local", job_id)["job"]["state"],
                             "launching")
            real_run = bench.run

            def report_before_worker_receipt(*args, **kwargs):
                report = real_run(*args, **kwargs)
                self.assertEqual(benchmarking.job_status("local", job_id)["job"]["state"],
                                 "completed")
                return report

            with mock.patch.object(bench, "run", side_effect=report_before_worker_receipt), \
                    redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
                result = management.dispatch({"schema_version": 1, "action": "bench.run",
                                              "profile": "local", "params": {**params, "job_id": job_id}})
            self.assertTrue(result["successful"])
            recovered = management.dispatch({"schema_version": 1, "action": "bench.job",
                                             "profile": "local", "params": {"job_id": job_id}})["job"]
            self.assertEqual(recovered["state"], "completed")
            self.assertTrue(recovered["result"]["successful"])
            self.assertEqual(recovered["result"]["run_id"], bench.load(output)["run_id"])
            self.assertEqual(recovered["progress"]["state"], "report_saved")
            self.assertEqual(journal.load("local", job_id)["state"], "succeeded")
            receipt = self.root / "profiles" / ".ops" / "local" / ".runs" / f"{job_id}.json"
            if os.name == "nt":
                self.assertTrue(is_unshared(receipt))     # NTFS has no mode bits: assert the effective ACL
            else:
                self.assertEqual(stat.S_IMODE(receipt.stat().st_mode), 0o600)

            failed_path = self.root / "failed-job"
            failed_params = {**params, "path": str(failed_path)}
            failed_id = "e" * 32
            management.dispatch({"schema_version": 1, "action": "bench.job.create",
                                 "profile": "local", "params": {**failed_params, "job_id": failed_id}})
            with mock.patch.object(benchmarking, "plan", side_effect=ProfileError("stale benchmark", 6)):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProfileError, "stale benchmark"):
                    management.dispatch({"schema_version": 1, "action": "bench.run",
                                         "profile": "local", "params": {**failed_params, "job_id": failed_id}})
            self.assertEqual(benchmarking.job_status("local", failed_id)["job"]["state"], "failed")

            recovered_path = self.root / "report-before-receipt"
            recovered_params = {**params, "path": str(recovered_path)}
            recovered_id = "f" * 32
            management.dispatch({"schema_version": 1, "action": "bench.job.create",
                                 "profile": "local", "params": {**recovered_params, "job_id": recovered_id}})
            with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
                bench.run(self.inference, self.telemetry, recovered_path, concurrency=2,
                          request_timeout=30, condition="baseline", profile_identity=identity,
                          require_managed_match=True)
            self.assertEqual(journal.load("local", recovered_id)["state"], "running")
            self.assertEqual(benchmarking.job_status("local", recovered_id)["job"]["state"],
                             "completed")
            self.assertEqual(journal.load("local", recovered_id)["state"], "succeeded")

    def test_process_death_releases_exact_run_lease(self):
        output = self.root / "child-run"
        ready = self.root / "child-ready"
        environment = {**os.environ, "STRATA_PROFILE_DIR": str(self.root / "profiles")}
        code = ("from pathlib import Path\n"
                "from strata_control.benchmarking import benchmark_lease\n"
                "from time import sleep\n"
                f"with benchmark_lease('local', Path({str(output)!r})):\n"
                f"    Path({str(ready)!r}).write_text('ready')\n"
                "    sleep(30)\n")
        process = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-c", code],
                                   cwd=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2], env=environment,
                                   stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        try:
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 10
            while not ready.exists() and process.poll() is None and time.monotonic() < deadline:
                time.sleep(0.05)
            if not ready.exists():
                self.fail("benchmark lease child did not become ready: " +
                          (process.stderr.read().decode("utf-8", "replace") if process.poll() is not None else
                           "timed out"))
            with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_PROFILE_DIR": environment["STRATA_PROFILE_DIR"]}):
                self.assertEqual(benchmarking.benchmark_activity("local", output), "active")
                if os.name == "nt":
                    # a venv's python.exe is a launcher that runs the real interpreter as its child
                    subprocess.run(["taskkill", "/F", "/T", "/PID", str(process.pid)], capture_output=True)
                else:
                    process.kill()
                process.wait(timeout=5)
                self.assertEqual(benchmarking.benchmark_activity("local", output), "ended")
        finally:
            if process.poll() is None:
                process.kill()
                process.wait(timeout=5)
            process.stderr.close()

    def test_interrupted_phase_cannot_produce_successful_report(self):
        output = self.root / "interrupted"
        original = bench._phase

        def interrupted_phase(*args, **kwargs):
            if kwargs["kind"] == "serial":
                raise RuntimeError("synthetic benchmark interruption")
            return original(*args, **kwargs)

        with mock.patch.object(bench, "_phase", side_effect=interrupted_phase), \
                redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "synthetic benchmark interruption"):
                bench.run(self.inference, self.telemetry, output, concurrency=2)
        report = bench.load(output)
        self.assertEqual([p["kind"] for p in report["phases"]], ["warmup"])
        self.assertEqual(report["planned_phases"], ["warmup", "serial", "mixed"])
        self.assertFalse(report["successful"])
        self.assertEqual(bench.summary(report)["completed_phase_count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(bench.summary(report)["planned_phase_count"], 3)
        self.assertIn("| Result | Incomplete |", bench.markdown_report(report))
        record = bench.progress(output)
        self.assertEqual(record["state"], "report_saved")
        self.assertEqual(record["completed_phases"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(record["current_phase"], None)
        self.assertFalse(record["successful"])
        report["successful"] = True
        (output / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(report), encoding="utf-8")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProfileError, "unsupported benchmark report"):
            bench.load(output)
        del report["planned_phases"]  # Old reports must not claim success for a partial suite either.
        (output / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(report), encoding="utf-8")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProfileError, "unsupported benchmark report"):
            bench.load(output)

    def test_postflight_telemetry_parse_failure_keeps_failed_evidence(self):
        output = self.root / "postflight"
        original = bench._phase
        postflight = False

        def phase(*args, **kwargs):
            nonlocal postflight
            result = original(*args, **kwargs)
            if kwargs["kind"] == "mixed":
                postflight = True
            return result

        def snapshot():
            if postflight:
                raise ValueError("malformed postflight telemetry")
            return self.telemetry.snapshot()

        telemetry = mock.Mock(timeout=self.telemetry.timeout)
        telemetry.snapshot.side_effect = snapshot
        with mock.patch.object(bench, "_phase", side_effect=phase), redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            report = bench.run(self.inference, telemetry, output, concurrency=2)
        self.assertFalse(report["successful"])
        self.assertEqual(len(report["phases"]), 3)
        self.assertEqual(report["after"]["instance_id"], None)
        self.assertFalse(bench.load(output)["successful"])
        self.assertEqual(bench.progress(output)["state"], "report_saved")

    def test_managed_benchmark_checks_owned_instance_before_and_after(self):
        identity = {"profile": "local", "revision": "a" * 16,
                    "source_sha256": "b" * 64}
        instance = self.telemetry.snapshot()["instance"]["id"]
        owner = {"ok": True, "state": "ready", "launch_attested": True,
                 "api_identity_verified": True, "generation_ready": True,
                 "instance_id": instance, "profile_revision": identity["revision"], "api_url": self.url}
        plan = {"ok": True, "changed": False, "current_instance_id": instance,
                "current_profile_revision": identity["revision"],
                "candidate_profile_revision": identity["revision"]}
        out = self.root / "managed"
        with mock.patch("strata_control.runtime.status", return_value=owner) as status, \
                mock.patch("strata_control.runtime.plan_restart", return_value=plan) as preview, \
                redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            report = bench.run(self.inference, self.telemetry, out, concurrency=1,
                               profile_identity=identity, require_managed_match=True)
        self.assertTrue(report["successful"])
        self.assertEqual(report["profile_running_match"], "managed_launch_checked")
        self.assertTrue(report["profile_running_check"]["before"]["matched"])
        self.assertTrue(report["profile_running_check"]["after"]["matched"])
        self.assertEqual(bench.summary(report)["profile_running_match"], "managed_launch_checked")
        self.assertEqual(status.call_count, 2)
        self.assertEqual(preview.call_count, 2)

        with mock.patch("strata_control.runtime.status", return_value={**owner, "instance_id": "wrong"}), \
                mock.patch("strata_control.runtime.plan_restart", return_value=plan):
            rejected = self.root / "rejected"
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProfileError, "managed benchmark preflight failed: instance_mismatch"):
                bench.run(self.inference, self.telemetry, rejected, concurrency=1,
                          profile_identity=identity, require_managed_match=True)
        self.assertFalse(rejected.exists())

        with mock.patch("strata_control.runtime.status", return_value=owner), \
                mock.patch("strata_control.runtime.plan_restart", return_value={**plan, "changed": True}):
            stale = self.root / "stale"
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProfileError, "managed benchmark preflight failed: profile_or_source_changed"):
                bench.run(self.inference, self.telemetry, stale, concurrency=1,
                          profile_identity=identity, require_managed_match=True)
        self.assertFalse(stale.exists())

        with mock.patch("strata_control.runtime.status", side_effect=[owner, {**owner, "instance_id": "wrong"}]), \
                mock.patch("strata_control.runtime.plan_restart", return_value=plan), \
                redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            changed = bench.run(self.inference, self.telemetry, self.root / "changed", concurrency=1,
                                profile_identity=identity, require_managed_match=True)
        self.assertFalse(changed["successful"])
        self.assertEqual(changed["profile_running_check"]["after"]["reason"], "instance_mismatch")
        self.assertTrue((self.root / "changed" / "results.json").is_file())

    def test_desktop_review_runs_shared_benchmark_and_rejects_changed_owner(self):
        source = self.root / "run.json"
        source.write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
        instance = self.telemetry.snapshot()["instance"]["id"]
        revision = "a" * 16
        owner_id = ["b" * 32]
        owner = {"ok": True, "state": "ready", "launch_attested": True,
                 "api_identity_verified": True, "generation_ready": True,
                 "instance_id": instance, "profile_revision": revision, "api_url": self.url}
        restart = {"ok": True, "changed": False, "current_instance_id": instance,
                   "current_profile_revision": revision, "candidate_profile_revision": revision}
        launch = {"effective": {"host": "127.0.0.1", "port": self.httpd.server_address[1]}}
        settings = {"path": str(self.root / "desktop-run"), "suite": "serving-smoke",
                    "concurrency": 2, "repeat": 1, "request_timeout": 120,
                    "condition": "baseline"}
        def send(action, params):
            return management.dispatch({"schema_version": 1, "action": action,
                                        "profile": "local", "params": params})
        with mock.patch("strata_control.benchmarking._source", return_value=(
                source, {"id": "local"}, revision, {"model_name": "test", "gpu": "cpu"})), \
                mock.patch("strata_control.benchmarking._launch_plan", return_value=(launch, [])), \
                mock.patch("strata_control.runtime.status", side_effect=lambda _: {
                    **owner, "owner_id": owner_id[0]}), \
                mock.patch("strata_control.runtime.plan_restart", return_value=restart), \
                mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_API_KEY": self.service.api_key,
                                             "STRATA_TELEMETRY_KEY": self.service.telemetry_key}):
            reviewed = send("bench.run.plan", settings)["plan"]
            self.assertEqual(reviewed["planned_requests"], 5)
            self.assertEqual(reviewed["instance_id"], instance)
            pinned = {"if_profile_revision": reviewed["profile_revision"],
                      "if_source_sha256": reviewed["source_sha256"],
                      "if_owner_id": reviewed["owner_id"],
                      "if_instance_id": reviewed["instance_id"]}
            owner_id[0] = "c" * 32
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProfileError, "target changed after review"):
                send("bench.run", {**settings, **pinned})
            self.assertFalse(Path(settings["path"]).exists())
            owner_id[0] = "b" * 32
            with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
                result = send("bench.run", {**settings, **pinned})
            self.assertTrue(result["successful"])
            self.assertTrue(Path(result["path"]).is_file())
            self.assertEqual(bench.load(Path(settings["path"]))["profile_running_match"],
                             "managed_launch_checked")

    def test_report_cli_json_and_malformed_report(self):
        out = self.root / "smoke"
        with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            bench.run(self.inference, self.telemetry, out, concurrency=1)
        stdout = io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(stdout):
            self.assertEqual(main(["bench", "report", str(out), "--output", "json"]), 0)
        value = json.loads(stdout.getvalue())
        self.assertTrue(value["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(value["summary"]["suite"], "serving-smoke")
        report_file = out / "results.json"
        data = json.loads(report_file.read_text())
        for phase in data["phases"]:
            phase.pop("passed")  # reports written before the overload suite remain readable
        report_file.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertTrue(all(phase["passed"] for phase in bench.summary(bench.load(out))["phases"]))
        data["phases"] = [{"kind": "mixed"}]
        report_file.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProfileError, "unsupported benchmark report"):
            bench.load(out)

    def test_markdown_export_is_local_private_and_keeps_measurement_limits(self):
        first = self.root / "baseline"
        second = self.root / "candidate"
        with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            report = bench.run(self.inference, self.telemetry, first, concurrency=1)
        report["model_id"] = "model | <untrusted>"
        (first / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(report), encoding="utf-8")
        other = json.loads(json.dumps(report))
        other["run_id"] = "f" * 32
        second.mkdir()
        (second / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(other), encoding="utf-8")
        share = self.root / "share.md"
        with mock.patch.object(Endpoint, "snapshot", side_effect=AssertionError("export must stay offline")):
            with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
                self.assertEqual(main(["bench", "report", str(first), "--output", "markdown",
                                       "--out", str(share)]), 0)
            comparison = io.StringIO()
            with redirect_stdout(comparison):
                self.assertEqual(main(["bench", "compare", str(first), str(second),
                                       "--output", "markdown"]), 0)
        exported = share.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn("model \\| \\<untrusted\\>", exported)
        self.assertIn("Peak slots", exported)
        self.assertIn("Missing readings appear as `unavailable`", exported)
        self.assertNotIn(self.url, exported)
        for secret in ("inference-test-secret", "monitor-test-secret", "Benchmark mock answer.",
                       "Answer in one sentence"):
            self.assertNotIn(secret, exported)
            self.assertNotIn(secret, comparison.getvalue())
        self.assertIn("Provisional comparison", comparison.getvalue())
        self.assertIn("monitor attachment", comparison.getvalue())
        original = share.read_bytes()
        with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            self.assertEqual(main(["bench", "report", str(first), "--output", "markdown",
                                   "--out", str(share)]), 2)
        self.assertEqual(share.read_bytes(), original)
        if os.name != "nt":
            self.assertEqual(stat.S_IMODE(share.stat().st_mode), 0o600)

    def test_saved_run_comparison_is_read_only_and_provisional(self):
        baseline_path, candidate_path = self.root / "baseline", self.root / "monitored"
        with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            baseline = bench.run(self.inference, self.telemetry, baseline_path, concurrency=2, repeat=3,
                                 condition="baseline")
            candidate = bench.run(self.inference, self.telemetry, candidate_path, concurrency=2, repeat=3,
                                  condition="monitor-default")
        self.assertTrue(baseline["successful"] and candidate["successful"])
        before = [(path / "results.json").read_bytes() for path in (baseline_path, candidate_path)]
        with mock.patch.object(Endpoint, "snapshot", side_effect=AssertionError("compare must not contact server")):
            output = io.StringIO()
            with redirect_stdout(output):
                code = main(["bench", "compare", str(baseline_path), str(candidate_path),
                             "--output", "json"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        comparison = json.loads(output.getvalue())["comparison"]
        self.assertEqual(comparison["qualification"], "provisional")
        self.assertTrue(comparison["workload_match"])
        self.assertEqual(comparison["primary_phases"], 3)
        self.assertIsNotNone(comparison["median_primary_metrics"]["p95_ttft_s"]["baseline"])
        self.assertEqual(comparison["baseline"]["condition"], "baseline")
        self.assertEqual(comparison["candidate"]["condition"], "monitor-default")
        self.assertTrue(any("monitor attachment" in note for note in comparison["warnings"]))
        self.assertEqual(before, [(path / "results.json").read_bytes()
                                  for path in (baseline_path, candidate_path)])
        self.assertIn("provisional comparison", bench.format_comparison(comparison))
        missing = json.loads(json.dumps(candidate))
        next(phase for phase in missing["phases"] if phase["kind"] == "mixed")["summary"]["p95_ttft_s"] = None
        self.assertIsNone(bench.compare(baseline, missing)["median_primary_metrics"]["p95_ttft_s"]["candidate"])
        next(phase for phase in missing["phases"] if phase["kind"] == "mixed")["summary"]["p95_ttft_s"] = 10 ** 400
        self.assertIsNone(bench.compare(baseline, missing)["median_primary_metrics"]["p95_ttft_s"]["candidate"])

    def test_comparison_rejects_workload_and_identity_mismatch(self):
        first_path, second_path = self.root / "one", self.root / "two"
        with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            first = bench.run(self.inference, self.telemetry, first_path, concurrency=1)
            second = bench.run(self.inference, self.telemetry, second_path, concurrency=2)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProfileError, "workload or concurrency differs"):
            bench.compare(first, second)
        second["phases"][2]["requested"] = first["phases"][2]["requested"]
        second["phases"][2]["client_workers"] = first["phases"][2]["client_workers"]
        second["phases"][2]["requests"] = first["phases"][2]["requests"]
        second["environment"]["slots_effective"] = 999
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProfileError, "reported environment differs: slots_effective"):
            bench.compare(first, second)
        second["environment"]["slots_effective"] = first["environment"]["slots_effective"]
        first["profile_identity"] = {"source_sha256": "0" * 64}
        second["profile_identity"] = {"source_sha256": "1" * 64}
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProfileError, "source config digests differ"):
            bench.compare(first, second)
