## tests/terminal/test_cloudflared_find.py

"""The Terminal finds a cloudflared that the system installed (PATH, /usr/bin, ~/.local/bin, Homebrew, Program Files), checks its
version, and does not start a second connector next to one that is already running."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import stat
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_cli.launch import access


def fake_cloudflared(directory: Path, version: str = "2026.5.0", name: str = "cloudflared") -> Path:
    path = directory / name
    path.write_text(f'#!/bin/sh\necho "cloudflared version {version} (built 2026-05-12)"\n')
    path.chmod(path.stat().st_mode | stat.S_IXUSR)
    return path


@unittest.skipIf(os.name == "nt", "the fixture is a shell script")
class FindOnPath(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        access._cf_seen.clear()
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.dir = Path(self.tmp.name)

    def tearDown(self):
        self.tmp.cleanup()

    def env(self, **extra):
        return mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"PATH": str(self.dir / "bin"), "HOME": str(self.dir), **extra}, clear=False)

    def test_a_user_local_copy_on_path_is_found_with_its_version(self):
        (self.dir / "bin").mkdir()
        exe = fake_cloudflared(self.dir / "bin")
        with self.env():
            info = access.cloudflared_info()
            self.assertEqual(info, {"path": str(exe), "version": "2026.5.0"})
            self.assertEqual(access.find_cloudflared(), str(exe))

    def test_the_local_bin_folder_is_searched_when_path_misses_it(self):
        (self.dir / ".local" / "bin").mkdir(parents=True)
        exe = fake_cloudflared(self.dir / ".local" / "bin")
        with self.env(PATH=str(self.dir / "empty")), mock.patch.object(Path, "home", return_value=self.dir):
            self.assertEqual(access.find_cloudflared(), str(exe))

    def test_a_too_old_copy_is_passed_over(self):
        (self.dir / "bin").mkdir()
        fake_cloudflared(self.dir / "bin", version="2021.3.0")
        with self.env(), mock.patch.object(Path, "home", return_value=self.dir / "nohome"):
            places = [p for p in access._cloudflared_places() if str(self.dir) in p]
            with mock.patch.object(access, "_cloudflared_places", return_value=places):
                self.assertIsNone(access.find_cloudflared())

    def test_a_file_that_does_not_run_is_passed_over(self):
        (self.dir / "bin").mkdir()
        bad = self.dir / "bin" / "cloudflared"
        bad.write_text("#!/bin/sh\nexit 3\n")
        bad.chmod(0o755)
        with self.env(), mock.patch.object(access, "_cloudflared_places", return_value=[str(bad)]):
            self.assertIsNone(access.find_cloudflared())

    def test_strata_cloudflared_picks_exactly_that_file(self):
        exe = fake_cloudflared(self.dir, version="2025.1.2", name="mine")
        with self.env(STRATA_CLOUDFLARED=str(exe)):
            self.assertEqual(access._cloudflared_places(), [str(exe)])
            self.assertEqual(access.cloudflared_info()["version"], "2025.1.2")


class Places(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_the_usual_places_are_listed(self):
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"PATH": "/opt/x/bin"}, clear=False), mock.patch.object(access, "WINDOWS", False), \
                mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=False):
            os.environ.pop("STRATA_CLOUDFLARED", None)
            places = [p.replace("\\", "/") for p in access._cloudflared_places()]
        for want in ("/opt/x/bin/cloudflared", "/usr/bin/cloudflared", "/usr/local/bin/cloudflared", "/opt/homebrew/bin/cloudflared"):
            self.assertIn(want, places)
        self.assertTrue(any(p.endswith(".local/bin/cloudflared") for p in places))
        self.assertEqual(len(places), len(set(places)))

    def test_windows_places_include_program_files(self):
        env = {"PATH": "", "ProgramFiles": r"C:\Program Files", "ProgramFiles(x86)": r"C:\Program Files (x86)"}
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, env, clear=False), mock.patch.object(access, "WINDOWS", True):
            os.environ.pop("STRATA_CLOUDFLARED", None)
            places = access._cloudflared_places()
        self.assertTrue(any("Program Files" in p and p.endswith("cloudflared.exe") for p in places))

    def test_version_rule(self):
        self.assertTrue(access._cf_new_enough("2026.5.0"))
        self.assertTrue(access._cf_new_enough("2022.1.0"))
        self.assertFalse(access._cf_new_enough("2021.12.2"))
        self.assertTrue(access._cf_new_enough(""))


class OtherTunnels(unittest.TestCase):
    PS = ("  4242 cloudflared /usr/bin/cloudflared --no-autoupdate tunnel run --token SECRETSECRETSECRETSECRET\n"
          "    77 cloudflared cloudflared tunnel --no-autoupdate --url http://127.0.0.1:8080\n"
          "    90 bash bash -c cloudflared\n   100 sshd sshd\n")

    def test_every_cloudflared_is_listed_with_its_pid_and_our_own_pid_is_left_out(self):
        with mock.patch.object(access, "WINDOWS", False), mock.patch.object(access.subprocess, "run", return_value=mock.Mock(stdout=self.PS)):
            self.assertEqual([p for p, _ in access.cloudflared_procs()], [4242, 77])
            self.assertEqual([p for p, _ in access.cloudflared_procs(exclude=(4242,))], [77])

    def test_only_a_tunnel_pointing_at_this_servers_port_is_its_own(self):
        procs = [(4242, "cloudflared tunnel run --token X"), (77, "cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:8080"), (5, "cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:18080")]
        self.assertEqual(access.own_tunnel_pids(procs, 8080), [77])
        self.assertEqual(access.own_tunnel_pids(procs, 9999), [])
        self.assertEqual(access.other_tunnel_note([4242]), "cloudflared is already running for another tunnel (PID 4242).")
        self.assertEqual(access.other_tunnel_note([1, 2]), "cloudflared is already running for other tunnels (PIDs 1, 2).")

    def test_the_servers_own_tunnel_already_running_is_not_doubled(self):
        with mock.patch.object(access, "find_cloudflared", return_value="/usr/bin/cloudflared"), mock.patch.object(access, "tunnel_info", return_value=None), \
                mock.patch.object(access, "cloudflared_procs", return_value=[(31, "cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:8080")]), \
                mock.patch.object(access.subprocess, "Popen") as popen:
            url, message = access.start_tunnel("demo", 8080)
        self.assertIsNone(url)
        popen.assert_not_called()
        self.assertIn("already running (PID 31)", message)
        self.assertIn("did not start a second one", message)

    def test_another_tunnel_running_does_not_stop_a_quick_tunnel(self):
        proc = mock.Mock(pid=55)
        proc.poll.return_value = None
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp, mock.patch.object(access, "find_cloudflared", return_value="/usr/bin/cloudflared"), \
                mock.patch.object(access, "tunnel_info", return_value=None), mock.patch.object(access, "stop_tunnel"), \
                mock.patch.object(access, "_state_dir", return_value=Path(tmp)), \
                mock.patch.object(access, "cloudflared_procs", return_value=[(4242, "cloudflared tunnel run --token X")]), \
                mock.patch.object(access.subprocess, "Popen", side_effect=lambda *a, **k: (k["stdout"].write(b"https://abc-def.trycloudflare.com"), k["stdout"].flush(), proc)[2]) as popen, \
                mock.patch("strata_control.procs.start_token", return_value="t"), mock.patch("strata_control.procs.command_line", return_value=["x"]):
            url, message = access.start_tunnel("demo", 8080, wait=2)
        popen.assert_called_once()
        self.assertEqual(url, "https://abc-def.trycloudflare.com")
        self.assertIn("cloudflared is already running for another tunnel (PID 4242).", message)

    def test_a_missing_ps_is_never_a_block(self):
        with mock.patch.object(access, "WINDOWS", False), mock.patch.object(access.subprocess, "run", side_effect=FileNotFoundError):
            self.assertEqual(access.cloudflared_procs(), [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_component_start.py

"""A start through the owner runtime finds its engine in the component folder, or says clearly that there is none.

The engine here is the fake one the runtime tests use (a script behind a manifest-declared entrypoint), so this proves
the path the installed app takes: run config "component:strata-engine" -> `strata runtime start` -> the server resolves
the package -> the engine runs from the component folder -> stop ends it. It also proves the absence is a notice, not a
fetch: with an empty component folder and the no-acquire switch set, a start fails with the typed message, starts no
engine, and the state ends up stopped."""

import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import unittest
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_cli.cli import main
from strata_control import components, engine_component as ec, profiles, runtime

WINDOWS = os.name == "nt"
FAKE_ENGINE = (
    "import sys, os\nfrom pathlib import Path\n"
    "Path(os.environ['FAKE_ENGINE_MARK']).write_text(os.path.abspath(__file__) + '\\n' + ' '.join(sys.argv[1:]))\n"
    "print('READY 4096 stop', flush=True)\n"
    "for line in sys.stdin:\n"
    "    if line.strip() == 'QUIT': break\n"
    "    if line.startswith(('GEN ', 'BGEN ')):\n"
    "        slot = int(line.split()[1]) if line.startswith('BGEN ') else None\n"
    "        print('T 97', flush=True)\n"
    "        print('DONE 1 1 1.0 1.0 length 0 0 0', flush=True)\n"
    "        if slot is not None: print(f'BADM {slot} 0', flush=True)\n")


def install_fake_engine(components_dir: Path) -> Path:
    folder = components_dir / "engine" / f"0.1.45-{components.host_platform()}-cuda"
    folder.mkdir(parents=True)
    (folder / "engine_main.py").write_text(FAKE_ENGINE, encoding="utf-8")
    if WINDOWS:
        entry = "engine.cmd"
        (folder / entry).write_bytes(f'@echo off\r\n"{sys.executable}" "%~dp0engine_main.py" %*\r\n'.encode())
    else:
        entry = "engine"
        (folder / entry).write_text(f'#!/bin/sh\nexec "{sys.executable}" "$(dirname "$0")/engine_main.py" "$@"\n')
        (folder / entry).chmod(0o755)
    files = [{"path": name, "sha256": hashlib.sha256((folder / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              "bytes": (folder / name).stat().st_size} for name in (entry, "engine_main.py")]
    (folder / ec.MANIFEST).write_text(json.dumps({
        "schema_version": 1, "id": "strata-engine", "version": "0.1.45", "platform": components.host_platform(),
        "backend": "cuda", "entrypoint": entry, "files": files}), encoding="utf-8")
    return folder


@unittest.skipUnless(os.name in ("posix", "nt"), "no qualified owner transport on this platform")
class ComponentStart(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="strata-component-start-")
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.components = self.root / "components"
        self.components.mkdir()
        env = mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {
            "STRATA_PROFILE_DIR": str(self.root / "profiles"), "STRATA_RUNTIME_DIR": str(self.root / "runtime"),
            "STRATA_COMPONENTS_DIR": str(self.components), "STRATA_ENGINE_BACKEND": "cuda",
            "STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE": "1", "FAKE_ENGINE_MARK": str(self.root / "ran.txt")})
        env.start()
        self.addCleanup(env.stop)
        os.environ.pop("STRATA_API_KEY", None)
        from tools.strata_tokenizer import BYTE_TO_UNICODE
        tokenizer = self.root / "tokenizer"
        tokenizer.mkdir()
        tokens = [BYTE_TO_UNICODE[i] for i in range(256)] + ["ab", "<|im_start|>", "<|im_end|>", "<|endoftext|>"]
        (tokenizer / "vocab.json").write_text(json.dumps({token: i for i, token in enumerate(tokens)}))
        (tokenizer / "merges.txt").write_text("a b")
        (tokenizer / "token_type.json").write_text(json.dumps([0] * 257 + [3, 3, 3]))
        self.config = self.root / "run.json"
        self.config.write_text(json.dumps({"exe": "component:strata-engine", "backend": "cuda",
                                            "tokenizer": str(tokenizer), "args": [], "cwd": str(self.root),
                                            "model_name": "fake", "host": "127.0.0.1", "port": 0}), encoding="utf-8")
        profiles.create("app", str(self.config))
        self.addCleanup(self._stop)

    def _stop(self):
        try:
            if runtime._read_state("app") is not None:
                runtime.stop("app", timeout=12)
        except (OSError, profiles.ProfileError):
            pass

    def _cli(self, *args):
        out = io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(out):
            code = main([*args, "--output", "json"])
        return code, json.loads(out.getvalue())

    def test_start_runs_the_engine_from_the_component_folder_and_stop_ends_it(self):
        folder = install_fake_engine(self.components)
        code, started = self._cli("runtime", "start", "--profile", "app", "--wait", "30", "--shutdown-timeout", "2")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, started)
        self.assertEqual(started["state"], "ready")
        self.assertTrue(started["generation_ready"])
        ran = (self.root / "ran.txt").read_text().splitlines()[0]
        self.assertEqual(Path(ran).resolve(), (folder / "engine_main.py").resolve())
        status = self._cli("runtime", "status", "--profile", "app")[1]
        self.assertEqual(status["instance_id"], started["instance_id"])
        code, stopped = self._cli("runtime", "stop", "--profile", "app", "--wait", "20")
        self.assertEqual((code, stopped["state"]), (0, "stopped"))
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
        while runtime._read_state("app") is not None and time.monotonic() < deadline:
            time.sleep(0.05)
        self.assertIsNone(runtime._read_state("app"))

    def test_a_packaged_stub_engine_starts_and_a_changed_library_does_not(self):
        """The package is made by packaging/package_engine.py (schema 2: archs, min_driver, build_id), the start hashes
        every file: one flipped byte in a library the stub never loads still refuses the start, and no engine runs."""
        sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "packaging"))
        import package_engine
        src = self.root / "stub-src"
        src.mkdir()
        (src / "engine_main.py").write_text(FAKE_ENGINE, encoding="utf-8")
        if WINDOWS:
            entry = "strata.cmd"
            (src / entry).write_bytes(f'@echo off\r\n"{sys.executable}" "%~dp0engine_main.py" %*\r\n'.encode())
            library = "cudart64_13.dll"
        else:
            entry = "strata"
            (src / entry).write_text(f'#!/bin/sh\nexec "{sys.executable}" "$(dirname "$0")/engine_main.py" "$@"\n')
            library = "libcudart.so.13"
        (src / library).write_bytes(b"a runtime library the stub never loads " * 200)
        (src / "BUILD.json").write_text(json.dumps({"version": "0.1.45"}))
        out = self.components / "engine"
        out.mkdir()
        folder = package_engine.build(src, "cuda", "0.1.45", components.host_platform(), out, entry=entry,
                                      archs=("sm_86", "compute_89"), min_driver={"nvidia": "580.65"},
                                      build_id="stub-1", variant="cuda13", include=["engine_main.py"])
        patches = (mock.patch.object(ec, "cuda_archs_present", return_value=["sm_86"]),
                   mock.patch.object(ec, "nvidia_driver_version", return_value="610.47"))
        for item in patches:
            item.start()
            self.addCleanup(item.stop)
        code, started = self._cli("runtime", "start", "--profile", "app", "--wait", "30", "--shutdown-timeout", "2")
        log = self.root / "runtime" / "app.server.log"
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, (started, log.read_text(errors="replace")[-1500:] if log.exists() else "no server log"))
        self.assertEqual(started["state"], "ready")
        self.assertEqual(Path((self.root / "ran.txt").read_text().splitlines()[0]).resolve(),
                         (folder / "engine_main.py").resolve())
        self.assertEqual(self._cli("runtime", "stop", "--profile", "app", "--wait", "20")[1]["state"], "stopped")
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
        while runtime._read_state("app") is not None and time.monotonic() < deadline:
            time.sleep(0.05)
        (self.root / "ran.txt").unlink()
        body = bytearray((folder / library).read_bytes())
        body[100] ^= 0xFF                                       # same size; only the full hash sees it
        (folder / library).write_bytes(bytes(body))
        code, result = self._cli("runtime", "start", "--profile", "app", "--wait", "20", "--shutdown-timeout", "2")
        self.assertEqual(code, 5, result)                      # the refusal is the first thing the user sees: no host, no server
        self.assertFalse(result["ok"])
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "ran.txt").exists(), "a package with a changed library must not run")
        self.assertIn("integrity check", json.dumps(result))
        self.assertIn(library, json.dumps(result))
        self.assertIn("not started", json.dumps(result))
        self.assertIsNone(runtime._read_state("app"), "no runtime host may exist after the refusal")

    def test_no_engine_is_a_notice_and_starts_nothing(self):
        code, result = self._cli("runtime", "start", "--profile", "app", "--wait", "20", "--shutdown-timeout", "2")
        self.assertNotEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertFalse(result["ok"])
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "ran.txt").exists(), "no engine may run")
        log = (self.root / "runtime" / "app.server.log")
        text = log.read_text(errors="replace") if log.exists() else ""
        self.assertIn("No engine for this PC", text + json.dumps(result))
        self.assertIn("never downloads", text + json.dumps(result))
        self.assertIn(runtime.status("app")["state"], ("stopped", "failed"))
        self.assertEqual(sorted(p.name for p in self.components.iterdir()), [],
                         "looking for an engine must not create or fetch anything")

    def test_a_tampered_engine_is_not_started(self):
        folder = install_fake_engine(self.components)
        (folder / "engine_main.py").write_text(FAKE_ENGINE + "# changed\n", encoding="utf-8")
        code, result = self._cli("runtime", "start", "--profile", "app", "--wait", "20", "--shutdown-timeout", "2")
        self.assertNotEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "ran.txt").exists(), "a changed package must not run")

    def test_the_package_folder_is_first_on_the_library_path(self):
        from serve import server
        folder = install_fake_engine(self.components)
        cfg = server.with_component_engine({"exe": "component:strata-engine", "backend": "cuda", "lib_dirs": ["/other"]})
        self.assertEqual(Path(cfg["exe"]).parent.resolve(), folder.resolve())
        self.assertEqual(cfg["lib_dirs"][0], str(folder / ("engine.cmd" if WINDOWS else "engine")).rsplit(os.sep, 1)[0])
        self.assertEqual(cfg["lib_dirs"][1:], ["/other"])
        env = server.child_env(cfg)
        var = "PATH" if WINDOWS else "LD_LIBRARY_PATH"
        self.assertTrue(env[var].startswith(str(folder)))
        plain = {"exe": "/some/where/strata", "args": []}
        self.assertIs(server.with_component_engine(plain), plain)
        with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as caught:
            for entry in (folder / "engine.cmd", folder / "engine"):
                entry.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            server.with_component_engine({"exe": "component:strata-engine", "backend": "cuda"})
        self.assertEqual(caught.exception.code, 5)

    def test_a_picture_reader_path_from_an_older_engine_folder_follows_the_installed_package(self):
        """After an engine update the folder name changes; the run config's absolute vision exe must not stop the server."""
        from serve import server
        folder = install_fake_engine(self.components)
        reader = folder / "strata-vision"
        reader.write_text("x", encoding="utf-8")
        gone = str(self.components / "engine" / "0.0.1-old" / "strata-vision")
        cfg = server.with_component_engine({"exe": "component:strata-engine", "backend": "cuda",
                                            "vision": {"exe": gone, "cpu_exe": gone, "mmproj": "/m.gguf"}})
        self.assertEqual(cfg["vision"]["exe"], str(reader))
        self.assertEqual(cfg["vision"]["cpu_exe"], str(reader))
        self.assertEqual(cfg["vision"]["mmproj"], "/m.gguf")
        ok = {"exe": "component:strata-engine", "backend": "cuda", "vision": {"exe": str(reader)}}
        self.assertEqual(server.with_component_engine(ok)["vision"], {"exe": str(reader)})
        none = server.with_component_engine({"exe": "component:strata-engine", "backend": "cuda", "vision": {"exe": gone.replace("strata-vision", "other")}})
        self.assertTrue(none["vision"]["exe"].endswith("other"))        # no such file in the package: left as it is

    def test_the_build_json_lib_dirs_follow_the_package_folder(self):
        """The Windows HIP package keeps the ROCm DLLs in rocm/bin (BUILD.json lib_dirs): strata.exe does not load without them on PATH."""
        from serve import server
        folder = install_fake_engine(self.components)
        (folder / "rocm" / "bin").mkdir(parents=True)
        (folder / "BUILD.json").write_text(json.dumps({"lib_dirs": ["rocm/bin", "../escape", "missing", "/abs"]}), encoding="utf-8")
        cfg = server.with_component_engine({"exe": "component:strata-engine", "backend": "cuda", "lib_dirs": ["/other"]})
        self.assertEqual(cfg["lib_dirs"], [str(folder), str(folder / "rocm" / "bin"), "/other"])
        env = server.child_env(cfg)
        var = "PATH" if WINDOWS else "LD_LIBRARY_PATH"
        self.assertTrue(env[var].startswith(str(folder) + os.pathsep + str(folder / "rocm" / "bin")))

    def test_doctor_names_the_missing_engine(self):
        from strata_control.doctor import inspect
        report = inspect(self.config)
        engine = next(row for row in report["components"] if row["name"] == "engine")
        self.assertEqual(engine["status"], "missing")
        install_fake_engine(self.components)
        report = inspect(self.config)
        engine = next(row for row in report["components"] if row["name"] == "engine")
        self.assertEqual(engine["status"], "ok")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_connections.py

"""Saved read-only connections work in both source and portable terminal clients."""

import io
import json
import os
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_cli.cli import main
from strata_cli import connections
from strata_cli.client import ClientError, Endpoint, server_url
from strata_cli.render import render_view


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


class ConnectionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="strata-connections-")
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.directory = Path(self.temp.name) / "connections"
        env = mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_CONNECTION_DIR": str(self.directory)}, clear=False)
        env.start()
        self.addCleanup(env.stop)

    def _cli(self, *argv):
        output = io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(output):
            code = main(list(argv))
        return code, json.loads(output.getvalue())

    def test_create_edit_precedence_and_private_storage(self):
        code, created = self._cli("connection", "create", "edge", "--url", "https://Example.COM:443",
                                  "--prefix", "/proxy/strata", "--credential-env", "STRATA_READ_KEY",
                                  "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(created["connection"]["url"], "https://example.com:443")
        self.assertEqual(created["connection"]["prefix"], "/proxy/strata")
        saved = self.directory / "edge.json"
        if os.name == "posix":
            self.assertEqual(self.directory.stat().st_mode & 0o077, 0)
            self.assertEqual(saved.stat().st_mode & 0o077, 0)
        self.assertNotIn("test-secret", saved.read_text())
        revision = created["revision"]
        code, plan = self._cli("connection", "set", "edge", "prefix=/new", "--plan",
                                "--if-revision", revision, "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertTrue(plan["would_save"])
        self.assertEqual(connections.load("edge")[1], revision)
        code, changed = self._cli("connection", "set", "edge", "prefix=/new",
                                   "--if-revision", revision, "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertNotEqual(changed["revision"], revision)
        code, stale = self._cli("connection", "set", "edge", "prefix=/other",
                                 "--if-revision", revision, "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual((code, stale["error"]["code"]), (6, 6))
        self.assertEqual(connections.load("edge")[0]["prefix"], "/new")
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_CONNECTION": "edge", "STRATA_URL": "https://ignored.example",
                                       "STRATA_READ_KEY": "test-secret"}):
            code, effective = self._cli("config", "show", "--effective", "--output", "json")
            self.assertEqual(code, 0)
            self.assertEqual(effective["effective"]["url"], "https://example.com:443")
            self.assertEqual(effective["effective"]["prefix"], "/new")
            self.assertEqual(effective["effective"]["base_url"], "https://example.com:443/new")
            self.assertEqual(effective["effective"]["origins"]["url"], "connection")
            self.assertEqual(effective["effective"]["timeout_s"], 3.0)
            self.assertEqual(effective["effective"]["origins"]["timeout_s"], "default")
            self.assertTrue(effective["effective"]["credential_present"])
            self.assertNotIn("test-secret", json.dumps(effective))
            code, override = self._cli("config", "show", "--url", "https://other.example",
                                       "--credential-env", "OTHER_KEY", "--timeout", "4.5",
                                       "--output", "json")
            self.assertEqual(code, 0)
            self.assertEqual(override["effective"]["url"], "https://other.example")
            self.assertEqual(override["effective"]["prefix"], "")
            self.assertEqual(override["effective"]["credential_env"], "OTHER_KEY")
            self.assertEqual(override["effective"]["origins"]["url"], "flag")
            self.assertEqual(override["effective"]["origins"]["timeout_s"], "flag")
            self.assertEqual(override["effective"]["timeout_s"], 4.5)
            code, conflict = self._cli("config", "show", "--url", "https://other.example",
                                       "--connection", "edge", "--output", "json")
            self.assertEqual((code, conflict["error"]["code"]), (2, 2))

    def test_connection_and_config_json_aliases(self):
        code, listed = self._cli("connection", "list", "--json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(listed["connections"], [])
        code, effective = self._cli("config", "show", "--url", "http://127.0.0.1:8095", "--json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertTrue(effective["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(effective["effective"]["url"], "http://127.0.0.1:8095")

    def test_interactive_monitor_rejects_json_output_before_connecting(self):
        for output_flag in (("--output", "json"), ("--json",)):
            with self.subTest(output_flag=output_flag), mock.patch(
                    "strata_cli.monitor_commands.Endpoint") as endpoint:
                code, response = self._cli("monitor", "--url", "http://127.0.0.1:1",
                                           *output_flag)
                self.assertEqual((code, response["error"]["code"]), (2, 2))
                self.assertIn("requires --once", response["error"]["message"])
                endpoint.assert_not_called()
        bundle = Path(self.temp.name) / "strata-monitor.pyz"
        subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / "packaging/monitor_bundle.py"),
                        "build", str(bundle)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        portable = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-S", str(bundle), "monitor", "--url",
                                   "http://127.0.0.1:1", "--output", "json"],
                                  cwd=self.temp.name, capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(portable.returncode, 2)
        self.assertIn("requires --once", json.loads(portable.stdout)["error"]["message"])
        self.assertEqual(portable.stderr, "")

    def test_quiet_connection_and_status_keep_machine_records(self):
        output = io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(output):
            self.assertEqual(main(["connection", "list", "--quiet"]), 0)
        self.assertEqual(output.getvalue(), "")
        code, listed = self._cli("connection", "list", "--quiet", "--json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(listed["connections"], [])
        with mock.patch("strata_cli.monitor_commands.Endpoint") as endpoint:
            endpoint.return_value.snapshot.return_value = {"schema_version": 1}
            output = io.StringIO()
            with redirect_stdout(output):
                self.assertEqual(main(["status", "--url", "http://127.0.0.1:8095", "--quiet"]), 0)
            self.assertEqual(output.getvalue(), "")
            with redirect_stdout(output):
                self.assertEqual(main(["status", "--url", "http://127.0.0.1:8095",
                                       "--quiet", "--json"]), 0)
            self.assertTrue(json.loads(output.getvalue())["ok"])

    def test_invalid_prefix_credentials_and_file_permissions_fail_closed(self):
        for prefix in ("//proxy", "/a/../b", "/a?key=secret", "/a//b", "https://host/path"):
            with self.assertRaises(connections.ConnectionError):
                connections.prefix_path(prefix)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            server_url("http://@127.0.0.1:8095")
        with self.assertRaises(connections.ConnectionError):
            connections.credential_name("BAD-NAME")
        connections.create("local", "http://127.0.0.1:8095")
        with self.assertRaises(connections.ConnectionError):
            connections.create("local", "http://127.0.0.1:8095")
        if os.name == "posix":
            record = self.directory / "local.json"
            record.chmod(0o644)                          # our own file with drifted modes is put back, not refused
            connections.load("local")
            self.assertEqual(stat.S_IMODE(record.stat().st_mode), 0o600)
            with mock.patch("os.getuid", return_value=os.getuid() + 1):      # a file that belongs to another account is refused
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(connections.ConnectionError, "belongs to .*sudo chown"):
                    connections.load("local")
        record = self.directory / "local.json"
        corrupted = json.loads(record.read_text())
        corrupted["url"] = 42
        record.write_text(json.dumps(corrupted))
        code, response = self._cli("config", "show", "--connection", "local", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual((code, response["error"]["code"]), (5, 5))

    def test_proxy_prefix_and_credential_reference_work_in_portable_bundle(self):
        seen = []
        snapshot = {"schema_version": 1, "instance": {"id": "from-proxy"},
                    "model": {"id": "fixture", "loaded": True}, "work": {"active": 3}}

        class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            def do_GET(self):
                seen.append((self.path, self.headers.get("Authorization")))
                if self.path != "/proxy/v1/telemetry":
                    self.send_error(404)
                    return
                body = json.dumps(snapshot).encode()
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(body)

            def log_message(self, *_args):
                pass

        server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        thread.start()
        try:
            root = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}"
            connections.create("proxied", root, prefix="/proxy", credential_env="STRATA_READ_KEY")
            with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_READ_KEY": "test-secret"}):
                code, source = self._cli("status", "--connection", "proxied", "--json")
                self.assertEqual(code, 0)
                self.assertEqual(source["snapshot"]["work"]["active"], 3)
                bundle = Path(self.temp.name) / "strata-monitor.pyz"
                subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / "packaging/monitor_bundle.py"),
                                "build", str(bundle)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
                portable = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-S", str(bundle), "status", "--connection",
                                           "proxied", "--json"], env=os.environ.copy(), cwd=self.temp.name,
                                          capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
                self.assertEqual(json.loads(portable.stdout), source)
                portable_config = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-S", str(bundle), "config", "show",
                                                  "--connection", "proxied", "--output", "json"],
                                                 env=os.environ.copy(), cwd=self.temp.name,
                                                 capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
                self.assertEqual(json.loads(portable_config.stdout)["effective"]["prefix"], "/proxy")
                self.assertNotIn("test-secret", portable_config.stdout)
                subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-S", str(bundle), "connection", "create", "second",
                                "--url", root, "--output", "json"], env=os.environ.copy(),
                               cwd=self.temp.name, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
                self.assertEqual(connections.load("second")[0]["url"], root)
            self.assertEqual(seen, [("/proxy/v1/telemetry", "Bearer test-secret")] * 2)
            self.assertEqual(Endpoint(root, prefix="/proxy").base_url, root + "/proxy")
        finally:
            server.shutdown()
            server.server_close()
            thread.join(timeout=2)

    def test_deeply_nested_telemetry_returns_one_redacted_error(self):
        depth = 20000  # Python 3.13 parses 1100 levels; the recursion limit is reached at a few thousand on every version
        body = b"[" * depth + b"0" + b"]" * depth

        class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            def do_GET(self):
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(body)

            def log_message(self, *_args):
                pass

        server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        thread.start()
        try:
            root = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}"
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ClientError, "malformed JSON telemetry"):
                Endpoint(root).snapshot()
            code, response = self._cli("status", "--url", root, "--json")
            self.assertEqual(code, 3)
            self.assertEqual(response["error"]["message"], "server returned malformed JSON telemetry")
            bundle = Path(self.temp.name) / "deep-json-monitor.pyz"
            subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / "packaging/monitor_bundle.py"),
                            "build", str(bundle)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
            portable = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-S", str(bundle), "status",
                                       "--url", root, "--json"], cwd=self.temp.name,
                                      capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
            self.assertEqual(portable.returncode, 3)
            self.assertFalse(portable.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(portable.stdout)["error"]["message"],
                             "server returned malformed JSON telemetry")
        finally:
            server.shutdown()
            server.server_close()
            thread.join(timeout=2)

    def test_status_only_fallback_labels_missing_telemetry_without_inventing_work(self):
        paths = []
        metrics_status = [404]
        status = {"service": "strata", "model": "loaded-model", "loaded": True,
                  "started": 1_790_000_000, "concurrency": {"serving": 8}}

        class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            def do_GET(self):
                paths.append(self.path)
                if self.path == "/metrics" and metrics_status[0] == 401:
                    self.send_error(401)
                    return
                if self.path != "/v1/status":
                    self.send_error(404)
                    return
                body = json.dumps(status).encode()
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(body)

            def log_message(self, *_args):
                pass

        server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        thread.start()
        try:
            root = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}"
            snapshot = Endpoint(root).snapshot()
            self.assertEqual(paths, ["/v1/telemetry", "/metrics", "/v1/status"])
            self.assertEqual(snapshot["source"], "status-only")
            self.assertEqual(snapshot["quality"]["telemetry"], "unavailable")
            self.assertEqual(snapshot["model"], {"id": "loaded-model", "loaded": True, "context": None})
            self.assertEqual(snapshot["work"]["slots_effective"], 8)
            self.assertIsNone(snapshot["work"]["active"])
            self.assertIsNone(snapshot["rates"]["answer_tok_s"])
            display = render_view(snapshot, "overview", 80, 24)
            self.assertIn("[NO TELEMETRY]", display)
            self.assertIn("Telemetry unavailable; status only", display)
            self.assertIn("Sample age", render_view(snapshot, "overview", 40, 12))
            self.assertIn("In flight --", display)
            code, source = self._cli("status", "--url", root, "--json")
            self.assertEqual(code, 0)
            self.assertEqual(source["snapshot"]["quality"]["telemetry"], "unavailable")
            bundle = Path(self.temp.name) / "status-only.pyz"
            subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / "packaging/monitor_bundle.py"),
                            "build", str(bundle)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
            portable = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-S", str(bundle), "status", "--url", root,
                                       "--json"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
            portable_snapshot = json.loads(portable.stdout)["snapshot"]
            self.assertEqual(portable_snapshot["source"], "status-only")
            self.assertIsNone(portable_snapshot["work"]["active"])
            metrics_status[0] = 401
            paths.clear()
            with self.assertRaises(ClientError) as denied:
                Endpoint(root).snapshot()
            self.assertEqual(denied.exception.exit_code, 4)
            self.assertEqual(paths, ["/v1/telemetry", "/metrics"])
        finally:
            server.shutdown()
            server.server_close()
            thread.join(timeout=2)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_cpu_topology.py

"""serve/telemetry.py `_cpu_topology`: how many CPU sockets and NUMA nodes the computer has (for "2 CPUs · 64 cores" in the monitor)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from serve import telemetry


def fake_sysfs(root: Path, packages: list[int], nodes: int) -> None:
    for i, pkg in enumerate(packages):
        d = root / "cpu" / f"cpu{i}" / "topology"
        d.mkdir(parents=True)
        (d / "physical_package_id").write_text(f"{pkg}\n")
    (root / "cpu" / "cpufreq").mkdir()                       # not a cpuN folder: never counted
    for n in range(nodes):
        (root / "node" / f"node{n}").mkdir(parents=True)


class Topology(unittest.TestCase):
    def read(self, root):
        with mock.patch.object(telemetry.os, "name", "posix"), mock.patch.object(telemetry.sys, "platform", "linux"):
            return telemetry._cpu_topology(str(root))

    def test_two_sockets_two_numa_nodes(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            fake_sysfs(Path(tmp), [0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1], 2)           # 8 logical CPUs on 2 packages
            self.assertEqual(self.read(tmp), (2, 2))

    def test_one_socket(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            fake_sysfs(Path(tmp), [0, 0, 0, 0], 1)
            self.assertEqual(self.read(tmp), (1, 1))

    def test_one_socket_with_several_memory_nodes(self):             # e.g. an EPYC with NPS4: one package, four nodes
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            fake_sysfs(Path(tmp), [0] * 8, 4)
            self.assertEqual(self.read(tmp), (1, 4))

    def test_nothing_readable_is_none_not_a_guess(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            self.assertEqual(self.read(tmp), (None, None))

    def test_this_computer_answers_in_numbers(self):
        sockets, numa = telemetry._cpu_topology()
        self.assertTrue(sockets is None or sockets >= 1)
        self.assertTrue(numa is None or numa >= 1)

    def test_the_hardware_info_carries_them(self):
        src = (Path(telemetry.__file__)).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn('"sockets"', src)
        self.assertIn('"numa_nodes"', src)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_data_dir_choice.py

"""`--data-dir` names a new folder: the model library is never moved without a choice (0.2.1 R).

Everything lives in temporary folders: settings.json (APPDATA / XDG_CONFIG_HOME), the Strata folder (setup.ROOT) and the data folders.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import contextlib
import io
import json
import os
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

import setup
from strata_cli.launch import cmd, library
from strata_cli.launch import settings as S
from strata_cli.launch.runner import Runner

from tests.terminal.test_launch import HW_12, Home, catalog


def put(path: Path, size: int = 64) -> Path:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_bytes(b"x" * size)
    return path


class DataFolderChoice(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.base = Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.root = self.base / "Strata"
        self.root.mkdir()
        self.old = self.base / "old-data"
        self.new = self.base / "new-data"
        env = mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"APPDATA": str(self.base / "appdata"), "XDG_CONFIG_HOME": str(self.base / "appdata"),
                                           "STRATA_SETTINGS_FILE": ""})
        env.start()
        self.addCleanup(env.stop)
        os.environ.pop("STRATA_SETTINGS_FILE", None)
        for patcher in (mock.patch.object(setup, "ROOT", self.root), mock.patch.object(setup, "_CONTROL_HOME", None)):
            patcher.start()
            self.addCleanup(patcher.stop)
        self.assertTrue(str(setup.settings_path()).startswith(str(self.base)), setup.settings_path())
        self.weights = put(self.old / "models" / "Q2_0" / "w-00001-of-00001.gguf", 200)
        self.pack = put(self.old / "packs" / "q2_0" / "tokenizer" / "vocab.json", 20)
        self.mtp = put(self.old / "mtp" / "rt" / "experts.bin", 30)
        setup.settings_path().parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.write_settings({"data_dir": str(self.old), "installs": []})

    def write_settings(self, data: dict) -> None:
        setup.settings_path().write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")

    def saved(self) -> dict:
        return json.loads(setup.settings_path().read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    def call(self, *args, **kw):
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()) as out:
            res = setup.data_folder(*args, **kw)
        return res, out.getvalue()

    def assertLibraryUntouched(self):
        for f in (self.weights, self.pack, self.mtp):
            self.assertTrue(f.is_file(), f)

    def test_a_new_data_dir_with_yes_keeps_the_library_and_the_saved_default(self):
        (dest, elsewhere), _ = self.call(str(self.new), yes=True)
        self.assertEqual(dest.resolve(), self.new.resolve())
        self.assertTrue(dest.is_dir())
        self.assertEqual([Path(e).resolve() for e in elsewhere], [self.old.resolve()])     # still found: the old folder is a root
        self.assertLibraryUntouched()
        self.assertFalse((self.new / "models").exists())
        self.assertEqual(self.saved()["data_dir"], str(self.old))                          # the saved default is not rewritten

    def test_the_default_answer_with_no_keyboard_keeps_everything(self):
        with mock.patch("builtins.input", side_effect=EOFError):
            with self.assertRaises(SystemExit):                                            # ask() ends a setup with nobody to answer
                self.call(str(self.new), yes=False)
        self.assertLibraryUntouched()
        self.assertEqual(self.saved()["data_dir"], str(self.old))

    def test_asked_the_answer_keep_moves_nothing(self):
        with mock.patch("builtins.input", return_value=""):
            (dest, elsewhere), said = self.call(str(self.new), yes=False)
        self.assertIn("keep)", said)
        self.assertLibraryUntouched()
        self.assertEqual(self.saved()["data_dir"], str(self.old))
        self.assertEqual([Path(e).resolve() for e in elsewhere], [self.old.resolve()])

    def test_asked_the_answer_move_moves_and_remembers_the_new_folder(self):
        with mock.patch("builtins.input", return_value="move"):
            (dest, elsewhere), _ = self.call(str(self.new), yes=False)
        self.assertEqual(elsewhere, [])
        self.assertTrue((self.new / "models" / "Q2_0" / "w-00001-of-00001.gguf").is_file())
        self.assertTrue((self.new / "packs" / "q2_0" / "tokenizer" / "vocab.json").is_file())
        self.assertFalse(self.weights.exists())
        self.assertEqual(Path(self.saved()["data_dir"]).resolve(), self.new.resolve())

    def test_move_data_moves_without_asking(self):
        with mock.patch("builtins.input", side_effect=AssertionError("must not ask")):
            (dest, elsewhere), _ = self.call(str(self.new), move=True, yes=True)
        self.assertTrue((self.new / "mtp" / "rt" / "experts.bin").is_file())
        self.assertEqual(Path(self.saved()["data_dir"]).resolve(), self.new.resolve())

    def test_set_default_data_dir_remembers_the_folder_and_moves_nothing(self):
        (dest, elsewhere), _ = self.call(str(self.new), yes=True, set_default=True)
        self.assertLibraryUntouched()
        self.assertEqual(Path(self.saved()["data_dir"]).resolve(), self.new.resolve())
        self.assertEqual([Path(e).resolve() for e in elsewhere], [self.old.resolve()])

    def test_a_pc_with_no_models_anywhere_remembers_the_new_folder(self):
        for d in ("models", "packs", "mtp"):
            shutil.rmtree(self.old / d)
        (dest, elsewhere), _ = self.call(str(self.new), yes=True)
        self.assertEqual(elsewhere, [])
        self.assertEqual(Path(self.saved()["data_dir"]).resolve(), self.new.resolve())

    def test_the_library_in_the_strata_folder_is_asked_about_too(self):
        # no remembered data folder: the models sit next to the checkout (an old install)
        self.write_settings({})
        for d in ("models", "packs", "mtp"):
            shutil.rmtree(self.old / d)
        mine = put(self.root / "Strata-data" / "models" / "Q2_0" / "w-00001-of-00001.gguf")
        (dest, elsewhere), _ = self.call(str(self.new), yes=True)
        self.assertTrue(mine.is_file())
        self.assertEqual([Path(e).resolve() for e in elsewhere], [(self.root / "Strata-data").resolve()])
        self.assertNotIn("data_dir", self.saved())

    def test_no_data_dir_still_gathers_into_the_remembered_folder(self):
        # the data folder's own job (an earlier Strata folder's models) is not part of the --data-dir question
        other = self.base / "Strata-old"
        other.mkdir()
        (other / "setup.py").write_text("# old\n")
        put(other / "models" / "Q2_0" / "extra.gguf")
        self.write_settings({"data_dir": str(self.old), "installs": [str(other)]})
        (dest, _), _ = self.call(None, yes=True)
        self.assertEqual(dest.resolve(), self.old.resolve())
        self.assertTrue((self.old / "models" / "Q2_0" / "extra.gguf").is_file())

    def test_the_same_folder_again_is_not_a_change(self):
        (dest, elsewhere), _ = self.call(str(self.old), yes=False)
        self.assertEqual(elsewhere, [])
        self.assertLibraryUntouched()


class TerminalQuestion(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.base = Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.old = self.base / "old"
        self.new = self.base / "new"
        put(self.old / "models" / "Q2_0" / "w.gguf", 3_000_000)
        self.cat = mock.Mock()
        self.cat.data_dir.return_value = self.old

    def args(self, **kw):
        ns = dict(data_dir=str(self.new), move_data=False, yes=False, plan=False)
        ns.update(kw)
        return argparse.Namespace(**ns)

    def test_no_data_dir_asks_nothing(self):
        self.assertFalse(cmd._move_data_choice(self.args(data_dir=None), S.LaunchSettings(), self.cat, False))

    def test_move_data_says_yes_without_asking(self):
        with mock.patch("builtins.input", side_effect=AssertionError("must not ask")):
            self.assertTrue(cmd._move_data_choice(self.args(move_data=True), S.LaunchSettings(), self.cat, False))

    def test_yes_machine_and_plan_keep_the_library(self):
        with mock.patch("builtins.input", side_effect=AssertionError("must not ask")):
            for kw, machine in (({"yes": True}, False), ({}, True), ({"plan": True}, False)):
                self.assertFalse(cmd._move_data_choice(self.args(**kw), S.LaunchSettings(), self.cat, machine), kw)

    def test_no_keyboard_keeps_the_library(self):
        with mock.patch.object(sys.stdin, "isatty", return_value=False), mock.patch("builtins.input", side_effect=AssertionError):
            self.assertFalse(cmd._move_data_choice(self.args(), S.LaunchSettings(), self.cat, False))

    def test_asked_on_a_terminal(self):
        out = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch.object(sys.stdin, "isatty", return_value=True), contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):
            with mock.patch("builtins.input", return_value="m"):
                self.assertTrue(cmd._move_data_choice(self.args(), S.LaunchSettings(), self.cat, False))
            with mock.patch("builtins.input", return_value=""):
                self.assertFalse(cmd._move_data_choice(self.args(), S.LaunchSettings(), self.cat, False))
        self.assertIn("use the new folder only for new downloads", out.getvalue())

    def test_an_empty_or_same_library_asks_nothing(self):
        self.cat.data_dir.return_value = self.new
        with mock.patch.object(sys.stdin, "isatty", return_value=True), mock.patch("builtins.input", side_effect=AssertionError):
            self.assertFalse(cmd._move_data_choice(self.args(), S.LaunchSettings(), self.cat, False))
        self.assertEqual(library.movable_library(self.base / "nothing", self.new), 0.0)

    def test_setup_gets_move_data_only_when_chosen_and_a_folder_is_named(self):
        with Home():
            cat = catalog(HW_12)
            s = S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="IQ3_XXS", context=32768, vision="off", data_dir="/d")
            self.assertNotIn("--move-data", Runner(s, catalog=cat).setup_args())
            self.assertIn("--move-data", Runner(s, catalog=cat, move_data=True).setup_args())
            s2 = S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="IQ3_XXS", context=32768, vision="off")
            self.assertNotIn("--move-data", Runner(s2, catalog=cat, move_data=True).setup_args())
            with mock.patch.object(sys, "platform", "darwin"):
                mac = Runner(s, catalog=cat, move_data=True).setup_args()
            self.assertIn("--move-data", mac)
            self.assertEqual(mac[mac.index("--data-dir") + 1], "/d")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_discovery.py

"""Tester report 2026-10-18, T03 / T04 / T05: existing models are found the same way by the launch screens, `strata models list`, the
own-files import and `strata launch` (strata_control/discovery.py), with a mock of the desktop app's folders and a Gyro-S file header
(TQK6 / TQK7 experts, the one-file layout)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import io
import json
import os
import shutil
import struct
import tempfile
import unittest
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_cli.launch import modelstate, settings as S
from strata_cli.launch.catalog import Catalog
from strata_cli.launch.runner import Runner
from strata_control import discovery, models
from tests.terminal.launch_support import HW_12

GYRO_S = "Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Gyro-S-TQ1_0.gguf"
GYRO_M = "Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Gyro-M-TQ2_0.gguf"
TQ2_T, TQK6, TQK7 = 144, 145, 146


def string(value: str) -> bytes:
    raw = value.encode()
    return struct.pack("<Q", len(raw)) + raw


def gguf_with(tensors: list[tuple[str, int, int, int]]) -> bytes:
    """A tiny qwen4exp GGUF: (name, ggml type id, elements, payload bytes) per tensor, laid out one after another."""
    pairs = [("general.architecture", 8, string("qwen4exp")), ("tokenizer.ggml.model", 8, string("gpt2")),
             ("tokenizer.ggml.tokens", 9, struct.pack("<IQ", 8, 1) + string("a")),
             ("tokenizer.ggml.merges", 9, struct.pack("<IQ", 8, 1) + string("a b"))]
    header = (b"GGUF" + struct.pack("<IQQ", 3, len(tensors), len(pairs)) +
              b"".join(string(k) + struct.pack("<I", kind) + value for k, kind, value in pairs))
    offset = 0
    for name, type_id, elements, nbytes in tensors:
        header += string(name) + struct.pack("<IQIQ", 1, elements, type_id, offset)
        offset += -(-nbytes // 32) * 32
    header += b"\x00" * (-len(header) % 32)
    return header + b"\x00" * offset


def gyro_s_bytes() -> bytes:
    return gguf_with([("blk.0.ffn_gate_exps.weight", TQK6, 256, 52), ("blk.0.ffn_down_exps.weight", TQK7, 256, 60)])


def gyro_m_bytes() -> bytes:
    return gguf_with([("blk.0.ffn_gate_exps.weight", TQ2_T, 256, 68)])


class GuiLayout(unittest.TestCase):
    """The desktop app's folders, as the Windows (and Linux) app lays them out, plus an empty Terminal folder."""

    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="strata-discovery-")
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        base = Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.base = base
        self.env = {"LOCALAPPDATA": str(base / "local"), "XDG_DATA_HOME": str(base / "local"), "APPDATA": str(base / "roaming"),
                    "XDG_CONFIG_HOME": str(base / "config"), "USERPROFILE": str(base / "home"), "HOME": str(base / "home"),
                    "XDG_STATE_HOME": str(base / "state"), "XDG_DOCUMENTS_DIR": ""}
        patch = mock.patch.dict(os.environ, self.env)
        patch.start()
        self.addCleanup(patch.stop)
        for key in ("STRATA_INSTALL_DIR", "STRATA_SETTINGS_FILE", "STRATA_COMPONENTS_DIR", "STRATA_DOCUMENTS_DIR"):
            patch = mock.patch.dict(os.environ)
            patch.start()
            self.addCleanup(patch.stop)
            os.environ.pop(key, None)
        self.terminal = base / "terminal"
        (self.terminal / "data").mkdir(parents=True)
        shutil.copy(Path(models.__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "data" / "gguf_fingerprints.json", self.terminal / "data")
        p = mock.patch.object(models, "ROOT", self.terminal)
        p.start()
        self.addCleanup(p.stop)
        self.install = discovery.app_install_dir()
        self.docs = base / "home" / "Documents" / "Strata"
        gyro = self.docs / "Models" / "gyro-Gyro-S"
        gyro.mkdir(parents=True)

        self.gguf.write_bytes(gyro_s_bytes())
        (gyro / (GYRO_S + ".done")).write_text("done")
        (self.docs / "packs" / "gyro-gyro-s" / "tokenizer").mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.docs / "packs" / "gyro-gyro-s" / "dense.bin").write_bytes(b"x")
        (self.docs / "mtp" / "rt").mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.docs / "mtp" / "rt" / "experts.bin").write_bytes(b"x")
        self.mmproj = self.docs / "Models" / "mmproj-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-BF16.gguf"
        self.mmproj.write_bytes(b"x")
        self.install.mkdir(parents=True)
        engine = base / "engine.exe"
        engine.write_bytes(b"e")
        tok = self.docs / "packs" / "gyro-gyro-s" / "tokenizer"
        (tok / "vocab.json").write_text("{}")
        self.cfg = {"exe": "component:strata-engine", "tokenizer": str(tok), "model_name": "qwen3.8-flash-next-gyro-gyro-s",
                    "args": ["--pack", str(self.docs / "packs" / "gyro-gyro-s"), "--native", str(self.gguf), "--ple-gguf", str(self.gguf),
                             "--mtp", str(self.docs / "mtp" / "rt"), "--max-context", "131072", "--kv", "int8", "--vision"],

    def catalog(self) -> Catalog:
        return Catalog(hardware=HW_12)

    # ---- T04: one answer for list and the wizard

        self.assertEqual(plan["candidate_selection"]["basis"], "header_size_and_tensors")
        self.assertEqual(plan["candidate_selection"]["model"], "Gyro-S")
        self.assertEqual(payload, 124)
