        self.assertIn("https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases", note)

    def test_the_matching_family_is_not_blocked(self):
        with mock.patch.object(ec, "hip_archs_present", return_value=["gfx1201"]):
            self.assertEqual(ec.resolve(self.root, backend="hip", runtime="1").backend, "hip")


class Rx6000Package(unittest.TestCase):
    """0.2.2: the RX 6000 package (gfx1030 / gfx1031) is the one an RX 6000 card finds, and no other card family finds it."""

    def setUp(self):
        self.dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.root = Path(self.dir.name)
        self.addCleanup(self.dir.cleanup)

    def kfd(self, *versions):
        nodes = Path(self.dir.name) / "kfd"
        for i, ver in enumerate(versions):
            node = nodes / str(i)
            node.mkdir(parents=True)
            (node / "properties").write_text(f"cpu_cores_count 0{chr(10)}simd_count 80{chr(10)}gfx_target_version {ver}{chr(10)}", encoding="utf-8")
        return str(nodes)

    def test_the_kfd_topology_names_rdna2_cards(self):
        self.assertEqual(ec.hip_archs_present(self.kfd(100300, 100301, 110000, 120001)), ["gfx1030", "gfx1031", "gfx1100", "gfx1201"])

    def test_an_rx6000_card_finds_the_rx6000_package_and_an_rx7000_card_does_not(self):
        make_package(self.root, backend="hip", archs=("gfx1030", "gfx1031"))
        with mock.patch.object(ec, "hip_archs_present", return_value=["gfx1030"]):
            self.assertEqual(ec.resolve(self.root, backend="hip", runtime="1").hip_archs, ("gfx1030", "gfx1031"))
            self.assertIsNone(ec.status(self.root, backend="hip")["notice"])
        with mock.patch.object(ec, "hip_archs_present", return_value=["gfx1100"]):
            with self.assertRaises(ec.EngineMissing) as caught:
                ec.resolve(self.root, backend="hip", runtime="1")
        self.assertTrue(str(caught.exception).startswith("This build of Strata is for AMD RX 6000 cards."), str(caught.exception))
        self.assertIn("Ask for the RX 7000 build.", str(caught.exception))

    def test_the_rx9000_package_on_an_rx6000_card_names_a_build_that_exists(self):
        make_package(self.root, backend="hip", archs=("gfx1200", "gfx1201"))
        with mock.patch.object(ec, "hip_archs_present", return_value=["gfx1030"]):
            with self.assertRaises(ec.EngineMissing) as caught:
                ec.resolve(self.root, backend="hip", runtime="1")
        self.assertIn("Ask for the RX 6000 build.", str(caught.exception))


class NeverAcquires(unittest.TestCase):
    """The lookup, the status report and the CLI work with the network and process creation unavailable."""

    def setUp(self):
        self.dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.root = Path(self.dir.name)
        self.addCleanup(self.dir.cleanup)

    def run_cli(self, *argv):
        out, err = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out), contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):
            code = cli.main(list(argv))
        return code, out.getvalue(), err.getvalue()

    def test_status_and_cli_with_the_network_down(self):
        make_package(self.root)
        with NoNetwork(), mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE": "1"}):
            report = ec.status(self.root, backend="cuda")
            code, out, _ = self.run_cli("components", "engine", "--components-dir", str(self.root),
                                        "--backend", "cuda", "--output", "json")
        self.assertTrue(report["usable"])
        self.assertFalse(report["acquires"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        data = json.loads(out)
        self.assertTrue(data["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(Path(data["engine"]["exe"]).name, EXE)

    def test_cli_missing_engine_is_exit_5_with_the_notice(self):
        with NoNetwork():
            code, out, _ = self.run_cli("components", "engine", "--components-dir", str(self.root),
                                        "--backend", "cuda", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        data = json.loads(out)
        self.assertFalse(data["ok"])
        self.assertIn("never downloads an engine", data["notice"])

    def test_a_driver_too_old_for_every_engine_gets_one_plain_line_naming_the_version(self):
        a = make_package(self.root, version="0.1.45", backend="cuda")
        rewrite(a, min_driver={"nvidia": "580.65"})
        with mock.patch.object(ec, "nvidia_driver_version", return_value="550.120"):
            with self.assertRaises(ec.EngineMissing) as caught:
                ec.resolve(self.root, backend="cuda", runtime="1")
            note = ec.status(self.root, backend="cuda")["notice"]
        self.assertIn("580.65", str(caught.exception), "the technical reason stays for the log")
        self.assertIn("(550.120)", note)
        self.assertIn("driver 580 or newer", note)
        self.assertNotIn("component", note)
        # two builds: the line names the lower requirement; a driver that runs one of them is no problem
        folder = self.root / "engine" / "0.1.45-twelve"
        folder.mkdir(parents=True)
        for item in a.iterdir():
            (folder / item.name).write_bytes(item.read_bytes())
        (folder / "strata").chmod(0o755) if not WINDOWS else None
        rewrite(folder, min_driver={"nvidia": "575.51"})
        with mock.patch.object(ec, "nvidia_driver_version", return_value="550.120"):
            self.assertIn("driver 575 or newer", ec.status(self.root, backend="cuda")["notice"])
        with mock.patch.object(ec, "nvidia_driver_version", return_value="576.02"):
            self.assertEqual(ec.resolve(self.root, backend="cuda", runtime="1").root.name, "0.1.45-twelve")
        with mock.patch.object(ec, "nvidia_driver_version", return_value="580.178.04"):
            self.assertEqual(ec.resolve(self.root, backend="cuda", runtime="1").root.name, a.name, "the newer-driver build wins")

    def test_the_driver_version_comes_from_the_kernel_module_when_there_is_no_nvidia_smi(self):
        text = "NVRM version: NVIDIA UNIX x86_64 Kernel Module  580.95.05  Thu Sep 11 2026 GCC version: gcc 15"
        with mock.patch.object(ec, "_smi_query", return_value=[]), mock.patch.object(Path, "read_text", return_value=text):
            self.assertEqual(ec.nvidia_driver_version(), "580.95.05")
        with mock.patch.object(ec, "_smi_query", return_value=["575.57.08", "580.95.05"]):
            self.assertEqual(ec.nvidia_driver_version(), "575.57.08", "the oldest when cards disagree")
        with mock.patch.object(ec, "_smi_query", return_value=[]), mock.patch.object(Path, "read_text", side_effect=OSError):
            self.assertIsNone(ec.nvidia_driver_version())

    def test_the_component_fetcher_refuses_where_acquiring_is_forbidden(self):
        store = components.ComponentStore(self.root / "store")
        artifact = components.Artifact(name="engine.tar.gz", url="https://example.invalid/e.tgz",
                                       sha256="0" * 64, bytes=10)
        with NoNetwork(), mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE": "1"}):
            with self.assertRaises(acquisition.AcquisitionRefused):
                store._fetch(artifact)

    def test_main_guard_turns_the_notice_into_exit_5(self):
        def start():
            ec.resolve(self.root, backend="cuda")
        err = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):
            code = acquisition.main_guard(start)
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        self.assertIn("No engine for this PC", err.getvalue())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_engine_deps.py

"""An engine package must carry every library its binaries import, except the OS's and the GPU driver's.

Tester report 2026-10-17: a clean Windows 11 PC failed with 0xC0000135 because strata.exe imports cublas64_13.dll and the package
did not hold it (the build PC had the CUDA Toolkit on PATH, which hid the problem). These tests build tiny real PE files, so they
run anywhere and need no GPU or toolkit."""

import os
import struct
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "packaging"))
import binary_deps  # noqa: E402
import package_engine  # noqa: E402


def make_pe(imports, delay=()):
    """A minimal PE32+ file with a .idata section that imports the named DLLs (and delay-loads `delay`)."""
    va, raw = 0x1000, 0x400
    body = bytearray()
    descriptors = (len(imports) + 1) * 20
    delays = (len(delay) + 1) * 32
    names_at = descriptors + delays
    name_rvas = []
    blob = bytearray()
    for n in list(imports) + list(delay):
        name_rvas.append(va + names_at + len(blob))
        blob += n.encode("ascii") + b"\0"
    for i, _ in enumerate(imports):
        body += struct.pack("<IIIII", 0, 0, 0, name_rvas[i], 0)
    body += b"\0" * 20
    for j, _ in enumerate(delay):
        body += struct.pack("<II", 1, name_rvas[len(imports) + j]) + b"\0" * 24
    body += b"\0" * 32
    body += blob
    size = len(body)
    dos = bytearray(0x40)
    dos[:2] = b"MZ"
    struct.pack_into("<I", dos, 0x3C, 0x40)
    coff = b"PE\0\0" + struct.pack("<HHIIIHH", 0x8664, 1, 0, 0, 0, 240, 0x22)
    opt = bytearray(240)
    struct.pack_into("<H", opt, 0, 0x20B)
    struct.pack_into("<II", opt, 112 + 8, va if imports else 0, descriptors if imports else 0)
    struct.pack_into("<II", opt, 112 + 13 * 8, va + descriptors if delay else 0, delays if delay else 0)
    section = b".idata\0\0" + struct.pack("<IIIIIIHHI", size, va, size, raw, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x40000040)
    head = bytes(dos) + coff + bytes(opt) + section
    return head + b"\0" * (raw - len(head)) + bytes(body)


class Imports(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_pe_reader_lists_load_time_and_delay_load_imports(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            p = Path(d) / "a.exe"
            p.write_bytes(make_pe(["cublas64_13.dll", "KERNEL32.dll"], delay=["cudart64_13.dll"]))
            self.assertEqual(binary_deps.pe_imports(p), ["cublas64_13.dll", "KERNEL32.dll", "cudart64_13.dll"])

    @unittest.skipUnless(sys.platform.startswith("linux"), "needs a real ELF")
    def test_elf_reader_on_a_system_binary(self):
        names = binary_deps.elf_needed(Path("/bin/ls") if Path("/bin/ls").exists() else Path(sys.executable))
        self.assertTrue(any(n.startswith("libc.so") for n in names), names)


class Rule(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.dir.cleanup)
        self.pkg = Path(self.dir.name) / "pkg"
        self.pkg.mkdir()

    def test_a_missing_cuda_dll_is_reported_and_the_driver_and_os_are_not(self):
        (self.pkg / "strata.exe").write_bytes(make_pe(["cublas64_13.dll", "KERNEL32.dll", "ADVAPI32.dll", "nvcuda.dll", "api-ms-win-crt-heap-l1-1-0.dll"]))
        self.assertEqual(binary_deps.uncovered(self.pkg), [("strata.exe", "cublas64_13.dll")])

    def test_the_visual_cpp_runtime_is_not_an_os_library(self):
        (self.pkg / "strata.exe").write_bytes(make_pe(["VCRUNTIME140.dll", "MSVCP140.dll"]))
        self.assertEqual({n for _, n in binary_deps.uncovered(self.pkg)}, {"VCRUNTIME140.dll", "MSVCP140.dll"})

    def test_bundled_libraries_count_and_their_own_imports_are_checked(self):
        (self.pkg / "strata.exe").write_bytes(make_pe(["cublas64_13.dll"]))
        (self.pkg / "cublas64_13.dll").write_bytes(make_pe(["cublasLt64_13.dll", "KERNEL32.dll"]))
        self.assertEqual(binary_deps.uncovered(self.pkg), [("cublas64_13.dll", "cublasLt64_13.dll")])
        (self.pkg / "CUBLASLT64_13.DLL").write_bytes(make_pe(["KERNEL32.dll"]))
        self.assertEqual(binary_deps.uncovered(self.pkg), [])


@unittest.skipUnless(os.name == "nt", "the packager only copies DLLs for Windows targets")
class Packager(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.dir.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.dir.name)
        self.src = self.root / "src"
        self.src.mkdir()
        (self.src / "strata.exe").write_bytes(make_pe(["cublas64_13.dll", "KERNEL32.dll"]))
        self.toolkit = self.root / "toolkit"
        self.toolkit.mkdir()
        (self.toolkit / "cublas64_13.dll").write_bytes(make_pe(["cublasLt64_13.dll", "KERNEL32.dll"]))
        (self.toolkit / "cublasLt64_13.dll").write_bytes(make_pe(["KERNEL32.dll"]))
        self.out = self.root / "out"
        self.out.mkdir()

    def build(self, search):
        return package_engine.build(self.src, "cuda", "0.1.45.1", "windows-x86_64", self.out, archs=("sm_86",), build_id="t", search=search)

    def test_it_bundles_the_imported_dlls_and_what_they_import(self):
        folder = self.build([self.toolkit])
        self.assertTrue((folder / "cublas64_13.dll").is_file() and (folder / "cublasLt64_13.dll").is_file())
        self.assertEqual(binary_deps.uncovered(folder), [])
        self.assertEqual(package_engine.main(["--verify", str(folder)]), 0)

    def test_it_refuses_when_a_dll_cannot_be_found(self):
        empty = self.root / "empty"
        empty.mkdir()
        with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as raised:
            self.build([empty])
        self.assertIn("cublas64_13.dll", str(raised.exception))
        self.assertFalse(any(self.out.iterdir()) and any(p.name.startswith("0.1.45.1") for p in self.out.iterdir()))




class SubfolderDlls(unittest.TestCase):
    """A DLL only in a sub-folder is found only when BUILD.json lists the folder (Control puts those on PATH)."""

    def make(self, d, lib_dirs):
        import json
        d = Path(d)
        (d / "strata.exe").write_bytes(make_pe(["rocblas.dll", "KERNEL32.dll"]))
        (d / "rocm" / "bin").mkdir(parents=True)
        (d / "rocm" / "bin" / "rocblas.dll").write_bytes(make_pe(["KERNEL32.dll"]))
        (d / "BUILD.json").write_text(json.dumps({"lib_dirs": lib_dirs}))

    def test_subfolder_dll_not_on_the_path_is_flagged(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            self.make(d, [])
            self.assertEqual(binary_deps.uncovered(Path(d)), [("strata.exe", "rocblas.dll")])

    def test_subfolder_dll_listed_in_lib_dirs_passes(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            self.make(d, ["rocm/bin"])
            self.assertEqual(binary_deps.uncovered(Path(d)), [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_engine_manifest.py

"""The engine component manifest (schema 2): its fields, the checks a start makes, the signature hook S6 fills, and
packaging/package_engine.py round trips. Every folder is a throwaway; no GPU tool is run."""

import contextlib
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_control import components, engine_component as ec, signing

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "packaging"))
import collect_libs  # noqa: E402
import package_engine  # noqa: E402

WINDOWS = os.name == "nt"
HERE = components.host_platform()
EXE = "strata.exe" if WINDOWS else "strata"
LIB = "cudart64_13.dll" if WINDOWS else "libcudart.so.13"


def make_source(folder: Path) -> Path:
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (folder / EXE).write_bytes(b"engine-binary-" * 40)
    (folder / LIB).write_bytes(b"runtime-library-" * 60)
    (folder / "BUILD.json").write_text(json.dumps({"version": "0.1.45"}))
    (folder / "LICENSE.txt").write_text("MIT")
    (folder / "notes.txt").write_text("not packaged by default")
    (folder / "rocm" / "bin").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (folder / "rocm" / "bin" / "kernel.co").write_bytes(b"kernel" * 100)
    return folder


class Manifest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.dir.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.dir.name)
        self.src = make_source(self.root / "src")
        self.out = self.root / "components" / "engine"
        self.out.mkdir(parents=True)

    def package(self, **kw):
        args = dict(archs=("sm_86", "compute_89"), min_driver={"nvidia": "580.65"}, build_id="abc123-cuda13.0")
        args.update(kw)
        return package_engine.build(self.src, "cuda", "0.1.45", HERE, self.out, **args)

    def test_the_packager_writes_every_field_the_plan_asks_for(self):
        folder = self.package()
        data = json.loads((folder / ec.MANIFEST).read_text())
        self.assertEqual(data["schema_version"], 2)
        self.assertEqual((data["id"], data["name"], data["version"]), ("strata-engine", "strata-engine", "0.1.45"))
        self.assertEqual((data["platform"], data["backend"]), (HERE, "cuda"))
        self.assertEqual(data["archs"], ["sm_86", "compute_89"])
        self.assertEqual(data["min_driver"], {"nvidia": "580.65"})
        self.assertEqual(data["build_id"], "abc123-cuda13.0")
        self.assertIn("signature", data)
        self.assertIsNone(data["signature"])
        names = {item["path"] for item in data["files"]}
        self.assertEqual(names, {EXE, LIB, "BUILD.json", "LICENSE.txt"})        # notes.txt and rocm/ need --include / --tree
        for item in data["files"]:
            body = (folder / item["path"]).read_bytes()
            self.assertEqual((item["sha256"], item["bytes"]), (hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(), len(body)))
        self.assertEqual(data["entrypoint"], EXE)
        component = ec.read_manifest(folder)
        self.assertEqual((component.build_id, component.archs, component.min_driver),
                         ("abc123-cuda13.0", ("sm_86", "compute_89"), {"nvidia": "580.65"}))
        ec.verify(component, full=True)

    def test_include_and_tree_take_nested_files(self):
        with_include = self.package(include=["rocm/**"])
        self.assertIn("rocm/bin/kernel.co", {f[0] for f in ec.read_manifest(with_include).files})
        self.assertNotIn("notes.txt", {f[0] for f in ec.read_manifest(with_include).files})
        every = self.out / "tree"
        every.mkdir()
        folder = package_engine.build(self.src, "cuda", "9.9", HERE, every, archs=("sm_86",), tree=True, build_id="x")
        self.assertIn("notes.txt", {f[0] for f in ec.read_manifest(folder).files})
        self.assertEqual(ec.read_manifest(folder).files[0][0], EXE)

    def test_symlinks_are_never_packaged(self):
        if WINDOWS:
            self.skipTest("POSIX symlinks")
        os.symlink("/etc/passwd", self.src / "link.so")
        folder = self.package()
        self.assertNotIn("link.so", {f[0] for f in ec.read_manifest(folder).files})

    def test_linux_programs_are_executable_in_the_tar_even_from_a_windows_packer(self):
        import feed_tool
        folder = self.package()
        elf = bytes([0x7f]) + b"ELF" + bytes(60)
        for name in ("strata-dsv41", "strata-vision"):                    # ELF programs without execute bits (copied over from Windows)
            (folder / name).write_bytes(elf)
            os.chmod(folder / name, 0o644)
        (folder / "libx.so").write_bytes(elf)
        if WINDOWS:                                                       # a Linux package packed on Windows: the ELF header decides
            self.assertEqual(feed_tool._mode(folder / "strata-dsv41", "strata-dsv41", "strata"), 0o755)
            self.assertEqual(feed_tool._mode(folder / "strata-vision", "strata-vision", "strata"), 0o755)

    def test_strata_dsv41_travels_beside_the_engine_and_can_be_required(self):
        dsv = "strata-dsv41.exe" if WINDOWS else "strata-dsv41"
        with self.assertRaises(SystemExit):
            self.package(require_dsv41=True)                                  # a package without it is refused when it is required
        self.assertNotIn(dsv, {f[0] for f in ec.read_manifest(self.package()).files})   # optional by default (Intel, Mac, Pascal ...)
        (self.src / dsv).write_bytes(b"dsv41-binary-" * 50)
        other = self.root / "again"
        other.mkdir()
        folder = package_engine.build(self.src, "cuda", "0.1.46", HERE, other, archs=("sm_86",), build_id="x", require_dsv41=True)
        self.assertIn(dsv, {f[0] for f in ec.read_manifest(folder).files})
        self.assertEqual(package_engine.main(["--verify", str(folder), "--require-dsv41"]), 0)
        (self.src / dsv).unlink()
        plain = self.root / "plain"
        plain.mkdir()
        bare = package_engine.build(self.src, "cuda", "0.1.47", HERE, plain, archs=("sm_86",), build_id="x")
        self.assertEqual(package_engine.main(["--verify", str(bare), "--require-dsv41"]), 1)

    def test_a_gpu_package_without_archs_is_refused_by_the_packager(self):
        with self.assertRaises(SystemExit):
            self.package(archs=())

    def test_schema_2_needs_build_id_and_archs(self):
        folder = self.package()
        path = folder / ec.MANIFEST
        original = json.loads(path.read_text())
        for key, why in (("build_id", "no build_id"), ("archs", "no archs")):
            data = dict(original)
            data.pop(key)
            path.write_text(json.dumps(data))
            with self.assertRaises(ec.ComponentProblem) as caught:
                ec.read_manifest(folder)
            self.assertIn(why, str(caught.exception))
        data = dict(original, min_driver={"nvidia": 580})
        path.write_text(json.dumps(data))
        with self.assertRaises(ec.ComponentProblem):
            ec.read_manifest(folder)
        data = dict(original, signature="trust me")
        path.write_text(json.dumps(data))
        with self.assertRaises(ec.ComponentProblem):
            ec.read_manifest(folder)

    def test_a_schema_1_package_from_s3_still_loads(self):
        folder = self.package()
        path = folder / ec.MANIFEST
        data = json.loads(path.read_text())
        for key in ("name", "build_id", "min_driver", "signature", "archs"):
            data.pop(key)
        data["schema_version"] = 1
        data["cuda_archs"] = ["sm_86"]
        path.write_text(json.dumps(data))
        component = ec.read_manifest(folder)
        self.assertEqual((component.archs, component.build_id), (("sm_86",), ""))

    def test_duplicate_file_entries_are_refused(self):
        folder = self.package()
        path = folder / ec.MANIFEST
        data = json.loads(path.read_text())
        data["files"].append(dict(data["files"][1]))
        path.write_text(json.dumps(data))
        with self.assertRaises(ec.ComponentProblem):
            ec.read_manifest(folder)

    def test_verify_cli_and_package_digest(self):
        folder = self.package()
        out = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):
            self.assertEqual(package_engine.main(["--verify", str(folder)]), 0)
        self.assertIn(package_engine.package_sha256(folder), out.getvalue())
        (folder / LIB).write_bytes(b"x" * (folder / LIB).stat().st_size)
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):
            self.assertEqual(package_engine.main(["--verify", str(folder)]), 1)


class CollectLibs(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_kernel_data_is_filtered_by_arch_and_shared_tables_stay(self):
        want = "gfx1200,gfx1201"
        self.assertTrue(collect_libs.arch_wanted("Kernels.so-000-gfx1201.hsaco", want))
        self.assertTrue(collect_libs.arch_wanted("hipblasltTransform.hsaco", want))
        self.assertFalse(collect_libs.arch_wanted("TensileLibrary_x_gfx1100.co", want))
        self.assertTrue(collect_libs.arch_wanted("anything_gfx1100.co", ""))

    def test_elf_check_and_system_split(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            lib, text = Path(d) / "libx.so", Path(d) / "gdb.py"
            lib.write_bytes(collect_libs.ELF_MAGIC + b"rest")
            text.write_text("print(1)")
            self.assertTrue(collect_libs.is_elf(lib))
            self.assertFalse(collect_libs.is_elf(text))
        self.assertTrue(collect_libs.is_system("/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6"))
        self.assertFalse(collect_libs.is_system("/usr/local/cuda/lib64/libcudart.so.13"))
        self.assertTrue(collect_libs.is_driver("libcuda.so.1"))
        self.assertFalse(collect_libs.is_driver("libcublas.so.13"))


class Arch(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_machine_code_and_ptx(self):
        self.assertTrue(ec.arch_covers(["sm_86"], ["sm_86"]))
        self.assertFalse(ec.arch_covers(["sm_86"], ["sm_120"]))
        self.assertTrue(ec.arch_covers(["sm_75", "compute_89"], ["sm_120"]), "PTX of an older generation runs on a newer card")
        self.assertFalse(ec.arch_covers(["sm_75", "compute_89"], ["sm_86"]), "PTX never runs on an older card")
        self.assertTrue(ec.arch_covers(["sm_86"], []), "cannot tell: not a refusal")


class Start(unittest.TestCase):
    """What a start checks: every file's hash (not only the entrypoint), the driver, the signature policy."""

    def setUp(self):
        self.dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.dir.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.dir.name)
        self.out = self.root / "engine"
        self.out.mkdir()
        self.folder = package_engine.build(make_source(self.root / "src"), "cuda", "0.1.45", HERE, self.out,
                                           archs=("sm_86",), min_driver={"nvidia": "580.65"}, build_id="b1")
        self.addCleanup(ec.register_signature_verifier, None)
        patch = mock.patch.object(signing, "BUILTIN_KEYS", self.root / "no-shipped-keys.json")   # a build with no shipped key; the real file: test_release_keys
        patch.start()
        self.addCleanup(patch.stop)

    def start(self, **kw):
        with mock.patch.object(ec, "cuda_archs_present", return_value=kw.pop("cards", ["sm_86"])), \
                mock.patch.object(ec, "nvidia_driver_version", return_value=kw.pop("driver", "590.00")):
            return ec.expand("component:strata-engine", {"backend": "cuda"}, root=self.root, **kw)

    def test_a_good_package_starts(self):
        self.assertEqual(Path(self.start()).resolve(), (self.folder / EXE).resolve())

    def test_a_same_size_change_in_a_library_refuses_the_start_with_the_file_named(self):
        lib = self.folder / LIB
        body = bytearray(lib.read_bytes())
        body[7] ^= 0xFF                                           # same size, same entrypoint: only the full hash sees it
        lib.write_bytes(bytes(body))
        with mock.patch.object(ec, "cuda_archs_present", return_value=["sm_86"]),                 mock.patch.object(ec, "nvidia_driver_version", return_value=None):
            self.assertEqual(ec.resolve(self.root, backend="cuda", runtime="1").version, "0.1.45", "the quick check passes")
        with self.assertRaises(ec.EngineIntegrityError) as caught:
            self.start()
        self.assertIn(LIB, str(caught.exception))
        self.assertIn("SHA-256", str(caught.exception))
        self.assertIn("not started", str(caught.exception))
        self.assertEqual(caught.exception.exit_code, 5)
        self.assertIsInstance(caught.exception, ec.EngineMissing)

    def test_a_changed_manifest_hash_is_refused(self):
        path = self.folder / ec.MANIFEST
        data = json.loads(path.read_text())
        data["files"][0]["sha256"] = "0" * 64
        path.write_text(json.dumps(data))
        with self.assertRaises(ec.EngineIntegrityError):
            self.start()

    def test_two_builds_of_one_version_prefer_the_newer_driver_when_both_fit(self):
        other = make_source(self.root / "src3")
        old = package_engine.build(other, "cuda", "0.1.45", HERE, self.out, archs=("sm_60", "sm_86"),
                                   min_driver={"nvidia": "575.51"}, build_id="b-12", variant="cuda12")
        self.assertEqual(old.name, f"0.1.45-{HERE}-cuda-cuda12")
        self.assertEqual(ec.read_manifest(old).variant, "cuda12")
        self.assertEqual(Path(self.start(driver="610.0")).parent.resolve(), self.folder.resolve())    # 580.65 build wins
        self.assertEqual(Path(self.start(driver="576.0")).parent.resolve(), old.resolve())            # only the CUDA 12 one fits

    def test_a_cuda12_package_without_pascal_or_volta_code_is_refused(self):
        """#3503: the Linux cuda12 package shipped with 0.2.1 had sm_75/86/89 only; P100 containers restarted in a loop."""
        other = make_source(self.root / "src4")
        with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as caught:
            package_engine.build(other, "cuda", "0.1.45", HERE, self.out, archs=("sm_75", "sm_86", "sm_89", "compute_89"),
                                 min_driver={"nvidia": "575.51"}, build_id="b-12", variant="cuda12")
        self.assertIn("sm_60", str(caught.exception))
        package_engine.build(other, "cuda", "0.1.45", HERE, self.out, archs=("sm_70", "sm_86"), build_id="b-13", variant="cuda12")

    def test_a_good_package_does_not_hide_a_tampered_one(self):
        newer = package_engine.build(make_source(self.root / "src2"), "cuda", "0.1.46", HERE, self.out,
                                     archs=("sm_86",), build_id="b2")
        (newer / LIB).write_bytes(b"y" * (newer / LIB).stat().st_size)
        self.assertEqual(ec.read_manifest(Path(self.start()).parent).version, "0.1.45")

    def test_other_pc_reasons_are_not_integrity_errors(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ec.EngineMissing) as caught:
            self.start(cards=["sm_120"])
        self.assertNotIsInstance(caught.exception, ec.EngineIntegrityError)
        self.assertIn("sm_86", str(caught.exception))

    def test_an_old_driver_is_refused_with_both_versions(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ec.EngineMissing) as caught:
            self.start(driver="535.10")
        self.assertIn("580.65", str(caught.exception))
        self.assertIn("535.10", str(caught.exception))
        self.assertTrue(self.start(driver=None), "an unreadable driver is not a refusal")

    def test_signature_policy_and_hook(self):
        self.assertEqual(ec.verify_signature(ec.read_manifest(self.folder), {}), "unsigned")
        with self.assertRaises(ec.IntegrityProblem):
            ec.verify_signature(ec.read_manifest(self.folder), {ec.ENV_REQUIRE_SIGNED: "1"})
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {ec.ENV_REQUIRE_SIGNED: "1"}):
            with self.assertRaises(ec.EngineIntegrityError):
                self.start()
        # sign it: a stand-in "signature" over the canonical payload
        path = self.folder / ec.MANIFEST
        data = json.loads(path.read_text())
        key = b"test-key"
        data["signature"] = {"alg": "test-hmac", "key_id": "k1",
                             "value": hashlib.sha256(key + ec.signing_payload(data)).hexdigest()}
        path.write_text(json.dumps(data))
        component = ec.read_manifest(self.folder)
        self.assertEqual(ec.verify_signature(component, {}), "unverified", "signed but nobody can check it")
        with self.assertRaises(ec.IntegrityProblem):
            ec.verify_signature(component, {ec.ENV_REQUIRE_SIGNED: "1"})

        def verifier(payload, signature, comp):
            if signature["value"] != hashlib.sha256(key + payload).hexdigest():
                raise ValueError("wrong")
        ec.register_signature_verifier(verifier)
        self.assertEqual(ec.verify_signature(component, {ec.ENV_REQUIRE_SIGNED: "1"}), "verified")
        self.assertTrue(self.start())
        data["version"] = "0.1.46-evil"                      # any manifest change breaks the signature
        path.write_text(json.dumps(data))
        with self.assertRaises(ec.EngineIntegrityError) as caught:
            self.start()
        self.assertIn("signature", str(caught.exception))

    def test_the_payload_is_canonical_and_excludes_the_signature(self):
        a = ec.signing_payload({"b": 1, "a": [1, 2], "signature": {"alg": "x", "value": "y"}})
        b = ec.signing_payload({"a": [1, 2], "b": 1, "signature": None})
        self.assertEqual(a, b)
        self.assertEqual(a, b'{"a":[1,2],"b":1}')


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_engine_smoke.py

"""The engine test start with no model installed: an engine without a --version flag (it prints its options and exits 2) still counts as running."""

import os
import stat
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

from strata_control import updater


def make_engine(folder: Path, body_posix: str, body_nt: str) -> Path:
    if os.name == "nt":
        path = folder / "strata.cmd"
        path.write_text("@echo off\r\n" + body_nt, encoding="utf-8")
    else:
        path = folder / "strata"
        path.write_text("#!/bin/sh\n" + body_posix, encoding="utf-8")
        path.chmod(path.stat().st_mode | stat.S_IXUSR)
    return path


USAGE_POSIX = "echo 'strata generate [options]' >&2\nfor f in a b c d e f; do echo \"  --opt-$f N   something\" >&2; done\nexit 2\n"
USAGE_NT = "echo strata generate [options] 1>&2\r\n" + "".join(f"echo   --opt-{c} N   something 1>&2\r\n" for c in "abcdef") + "exit /b 2\r\n"


class BinarySmoke(unittest.TestCase):
    def component(self, folder: Path, exe: Path):
        return SimpleNamespace(exe=exe, root=folder, version="0.1.45")

    def test_an_engine_that_lists_its_options_instead_of_answering_version_passes(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            folder = Path(tmp)
            res = updater.binary_smoke(self.component(folder, make_engine(folder, USAGE_POSIX, USAGE_NT)))
            self.assertEqual(res["mode"], "binary-only")
            self.assertIn("does not answer --version", res["detail"])
            self.assertIn("listed its options", res["detail"])

    def test_an_engine_that_answers_version_passes_as_before(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            folder = Path(tmp)
            res = updater.binary_smoke(self.component(folder, make_engine(folder, "echo strata 0.1.45\nexit 0\n", "echo strata 0.1.45\r\nexit /b 0\r\n")))
            self.assertIn("--version only", res["detail"])

    def test_a_real_failure_still_fails(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            folder = Path(tmp)
            exe = make_engine(folder, "echo 'No device of requested type available' >&2\nexit 250\n", "echo No device of requested type available 1>&2\r\nexit /b 250\r\n")
            with self.assertRaises(updater.TestStartFailed) as e:
                updater.binary_smoke(self.component(folder, exe))
            self.assertIn("No device of requested type", e.exception.reason)

    def test_exit_2_without_a_list_of_options_still_fails(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            folder = Path(tmp)
            exe = make_engine(folder, "echo 'bad usage' >&2\nexit 2\n", "echo bad usage 1>&2\r\nexit /b 2\r\n")
            with self.assertRaises(updater.TestStartFailed):
                updater.binary_smoke(self.component(folder, exe))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_file_in_use.py

"""Windows 'file in use': every swap of a state file waits and retries (atomic.replace), and the message does not blame permissions."""

import re
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_control import atomic, private_files

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SITES = ["strata_control/calibration.py", "strata_control/components.py", "strata_control/presets.py",
         "strata_control/preset_marks.py", "strata_control/procs.py", "strata_control/profiles.py",
         "strata_control/tune_apply.py", "strata_control/updater.py", "strata_cli/bench.py", "strata_cli/connections.py",
         "strata_cli/launch/runner.py", "strata_cli/launch/store.py", "strata_cli/tune_commands.py", "serve/runconfig.py"]


class Sites(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_no_bare_os_replace_is_left_in_the_state_file_writers(self):
        for rel in SITES:
            text = (ROOT / rel).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            bare = [l for l in text.splitlines() if re.search(r"(?<![_\w.])os\.replace\(", l) or re.search(r"[^_]os\.replace\(", l)]
            # updater._move_dir keeps its own longer retry loop
            bare = [l for l in bare if not (rel.endswith("updater.py") and "source, destination" in l)]
            self.assertEqual(bare, [], rel)
            self.assertIn("_atomic_mod.replace(", text, rel)


class Retry(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_held_file_is_waited_for_on_windows(self):
        calls = []

        def flaky(src, dst):
            calls.append(1)
            if len(calls) < 3:
                raise PermissionError(13, "in use")
        with mock.patch.object(atomic.os, "replace", flaky), mock.patch.object(atomic.os, "name", "nt"):
            atomic.replace("a", "b", sleep=lambda s: None)
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 3)


class Message(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sharing_violation_is_told_from_a_refusal(self):
        in_use = PermissionError(13, "The process cannot access the file because it is being used by another process")
        in_use.winerror = 32
        denied = PermissionError(13, "Access is denied")
        denied.winerror = 5
        self.assertTrue(private_files.is_sharing_violation(in_use))
        self.assertFalse(private_files.is_sharing_violation(denied))
        self.assertNotIn("as yourself", private_files.ACCESS_MESSAGE)
        self.assertIn("another program", private_files.IN_USE_MESSAGE)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_flow2_022.py

"""0.2.2 flow walk, second round (phaseA-tests/flow-findings-022.md): what `strata launch` says and does with your own model files, the
plan, the download figure, the long silent step and a tuning result that already exists."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_cli.launch import settings as S
from strata_cli.launch.catalog import Catalog
from strata_cli.launch.runner import LaunchError, Runner
from tests.terminal.launch_support import HW_12, Home, run_cli
from tests.terminal.test_own_files import IQ3XXS, Q2, gguf_bytes


class Base(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.home = Home().__enter__()
        self.addCleanup(self.home.__exit__, None, None, None)
        p = mock.patch.object(Catalog, "hardware", lambda self, fresh=False: dict(HW_12, disk_free_gb=500.0))
        p.start()
        self.addCleanup(p.stop)
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="strata-flow2-")
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.base = Path(self.tmp.name)

    def files(self, folder: Path, names: list[str], kind: str) -> Path:
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for n in names:
            (folder / n).write_bytes(gguf_bytes([kind]))
        return folder

    def runner(self, **kw) -> Runner:
        return Runner(S.LaunchSettings(**kw), catalog=Catalog(hardware=HW_12))


class MissingOwnFiles(Base):
    """Finding 2: a --model-path that is not there, or holds no model, is said in plain words before anything starts."""

    def test_a_folder_that_does_not_exist_is_named_and_nothing_is_promised(self):
        missing = self.base / "models"
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", "--model-path", str(missing)])
        self.assertEqual(code, 2)
        self.assertIn(f"This folder does not exist: {missing}", err)
        self.assertNotIn("Qwen", err)
        self.assertNotIn("continues where it stopped", err)
        self.assertNotIn("could not be installed", err)

    def test_a_missing_file_says_file(self):
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", "--model-path", str(self.base / "x-00001-of-00002.gguf")])
        self.assertEqual(code, 2)
        self.assertIn("This file does not exist", err)

    def test_an_empty_folder_says_there_are_no_gguf_files(self):
        empty = self.base / "empty"
        empty.mkdir()
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", "--model", "q2_0", "--model-path", str(empty)])
        self.assertEqual(code, 2)
        self.assertIn("no .gguf model files", err)
        self.assertIn("...-00001-of-00002.gguf", err)

    def test_machine_output_carries_the_same_words(self):
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", "--output", "json", "--model-path", str(self.base / "gone")])
        self.assertEqual(code, 2)
        self.assertIn("This folder does not exist", json.loads(out)["error"]["message"])

    def test_the_engine_is_not_touched_for_a_wrong_path(self):
        r = self.runner(model_path=str(self.base / "gone"))
        with mock.patch.object(Runner, "ensure_engine", side_effect=AssertionError("engine step must not start")):
            with self.assertRaises(LaunchError) as ctx:
                r.run()
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, 2)
        self.assertIn("does not exist", ctx.exception.text)

    def test_the_failure_hint_of_own_files_promises_no_download(self):
        r = self.runner(model_path=str(self.files(self.base / "m", Q2, "Q2_0")), family="qwen", model="Q2_0")
        proc = mock.Mock()
        proc.stdout = iter(["=== Step 5: Getting the model files ===", "[X] missing /m/x.gguf"])
        proc.wait.return_value = 1
        with mock.patch.object(Runner, "_spawn", return_value=proc), mock.patch.object(Runner, "adopt_prepared_files", return_value=None):
            with self.assertRaises(LaunchError) as ctx:
                r.ensure_model()
        self.assertNotIn("download", ctx.exception.next)
        self.assertIn("finished steps are skipped", ctx.exception.next)

    def test_the_screens_say_the_same(self):
        from strata_control import models
        text, nxt = models.own_path_problem(str(self.base / "nope"))
        self.assertIn("This folder does not exist", text)
        self.assertIn("Nothing was downloaded", nxt)
        self.assertIsNone(models.own_path_problem(str(self.files(self.base / "ok", IQ3XXS, "IQ3_XXS"))))

    def test_a_folder_one_level_above_the_files_is_not_called_empty(self):
        self.files(self.base / "repo" / "IQ3_XXS", IQ3XXS, "IQ3_XXS")
        from strata_control import models
        self.assertIsNone(models.own_path_problem(str(self.base / "repo")))


class LinkedShards(Base):
    """Finding 3: shards that are links are accepted with no --model, as with --model, and a problem is said once."""

    def links(self, names: list[str], real: bool = True) -> Path:
        blobs = self.base / "blobs"
        snap = self.base / "snap"
        blobs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        snap.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        for i, n in enumerate(names):
            target = blobs / f"sha{i}"
            if real:
                target.write_bytes(gguf_bytes(["Q2_0"]))
            try:
                os.symlink(target, snap / n)
            except (OSError, NotImplementedError):
                self.skipTest("this account cannot create symbolic links")
        return snap

    def test_linked_shards_without_a_model_name_are_used(self):
        snap = self.links(Q2)
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", "--output", "json", "--model-path", str(snap)])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err or out)
        s = json.loads(out)["plan"]["settings"]
        self.assertEqual((s["family"], s["model"]), ("qwen", "Q2_0"))
        self.assertEqual(Path(s["model_path"]), snap)                       # the link names stay (the shard names are what setup reads)

    def test_linked_shards_with_the_model_named_give_the_same_folder(self):
        snap = self.links(Q2)
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", "--output", "json", "--model", "q2_0", "--model-path", str(snap)])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err or out)
        self.assertEqual(Path(json.loads(out)["plan"]["settings"]["model_path"]), snap)

    def test_links_to_nothing_are_one_sentence_not_one_per_file(self):
        snap = self.links(Q2, real=False)
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", "--model-path", str(snap)])
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        self.assertEqual(err.count("shortcut"), 1, err)
        self.assertIn(Q2[0], err)
        self.assertIn(Q2[1], err)

    def test_the_same_problem_for_many_files_is_said_once(self):
        from strata_control import models
        issues = [f"m-0000{i}-of-00005.gguf: GGUF metadata is truncated" for i in range(1, 6)] + ["incomplete_or_invalid_shard_set"]
        words = models.problem_words(issues)
        self.assertEqual(words.count("the file is cut short"), 1)
        self.assertIn("m-00001-of-00005.gguf, m-00002-of-00005.gguf and 3 more files", words)
        self.assertEqual(models.problem_words(["a.gguf: GGUF metadata is truncated", "b.gguf: GGUF metadata is truncated"]),
                         "a.gguf and b.gguf: the file is cut short (a download or copy that did not finish)")
        self.assertEqual(models.problem_words(["multiple_model_groups", "unrecognized_or_unsupported_model_variant"]),
                         "the folder holds more than one model")
        many = [f"unsupported_or_missing_architecture", "incomplete_or_invalid_shard_set", "multiple_model_groups",
                "unsupported_or_incomplete_tokenizer_metadata", "missing_or_unexpected_expert_quantization"]
        self.assertTrue(models.problem_words(many).endswith("and 2 more problems"))



class PlanWords(Base):
    """Findings 1 and 7: --plan shows the real model, the picture setting, a copyable line, and what would be downloaded."""

    def plan_text(self, *args):
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", *args])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err or out)
        return out

    def test_own_files_show_the_model_they_are(self):
        folder = self.files(self.base / "IQ3_XXS", IQ3XXS, "IQ3_XXS")
        out = self.plan_text("--model-path", str(folder))
        self.assertIn("Plan for 'IQ3_XXS", out)
        self.assertNotIn("model default", out)
        self.assertNotIn("None", out)
        self.assertIn("Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_XXS", out)
        self.assertIn(f"your files in {folder}", out)
        self.assertRegex(out, r"pictures (on|off)")
        self.assertIn("--model iq3_xxs", out.split("same as")[1])         # the copyable line names the model too
        self.assertIn(f'--model-path "{folder}"', out.split("same as")[1])

    def test_a_named_catalog_model_shows_its_size_and_the_download(self):
        out = self.plan_text("--model", "q2_0")
        self.assertIn("Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Q2_0, 66 GB", out)
        self.assertRegex(out, r"download\s+About 7\d\.\d GB to download: the model \(66\.4 GB\), the draft layer \(5\.2 GB\)")
        self.assertIn("The engine for your graphics card is downloaded first", out)

    def test_nothing_is_downloaded_when_everything_is_here(self):
        folder = self.files(self.base / "IQ3_XXS", IQ3XXS, "IQ3_XXS")
        data = self.base / "Strata" 
        (data / "models" / "x").mkdir(parents=True)
        (data / "mtp" / "rt").mkdir(parents=True)
        (data / "mtp" / "rt" / "experts.bin").write_bytes(b"x")
        (data / "models" / "mmproj-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-BF16.gguf").write_bytes(b"x")
        # the files sit under <data>/models/<tag>: the draft layer and the picture reader are found beside them
        moved = data / "models" / "iq3_xxs"
        folder.rename(moved)
        out = self.plan_text("--model-path", str(moved))
        self.assertIn("download  Nothing to download: your model files are used where they are.", out)

    def test_own_files_with_no_draft_layer_say_what_is_fetched(self):
        folder = self.files(self.base / "IQ3_XXS", IQ3XXS, "IQ3_XXS")
        with mock.patch.object(Runner, "existing_data_dir", return_value=None),                 mock.patch.object(Catalog, "data_dir", return_value=self.base / "emptydata"):
            out = self.plan_text("--model-path", str(folder), "--vision", "off")
        self.assertIn("About 5.2 GB to download: the draft layer (5.2 GB). Your model files are used where they are.", out)

    def test_a_model_whose_files_are_all_on_disk_does_not_list_a_zero_download(self):
        from strata_cli.launch.modelstate import ModelState, Part
        data = self.base / "d"
        (data / "mtp" / "rt").mkdir(parents=True)
        (data / "mtp" / "rt" / "experts.bin").write_bytes(b"x")
        whole = ModelState(installed=False, parts=[Part("weights", "the model", 0.0)], on_disk_gb=66.4, total_gb=66.4)
        with mock.patch.object(Runner, "model_state", return_value=whole):
            out = self.plan_text("--model", "q2_0", "--data-dir", str(data), "--vision", "off")
            self.assertIn("download  Nothing to download: the model is already on this computer.", out)
            out = self.plan_text("--model", "q2_0", "--data-dir", str(self.base / "other"), "--vision", "off")
        self.assertIn("About 5.2 GB to download: the draft layer (5.2 GB). 66 GB of the model is already in its folder.", out)
        self.assertNotIn("0.0 GB", out)

    def test_json_plan_carries_the_numbers(self):
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", "--output", "json", "--model", "q2_0", "--mtp", "off", "--vision", "off"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err)
        plan = json.loads(out)["plan"]
        self.assertEqual(plan["model"]["title"], "Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Q2_0")
        self.assertEqual(plan["model"]["model_gb"], 66.4)
        self.assertEqual(plan["download"]["gb"], 66.4)
        self.assertEqual([p["kind"] for p in plan["download"]["parts"]], ["weights"])



class DownloadTotal(Base):
    """Finding 4: the figure counts every shard (and the picture reader), in the folder the setup is really given."""

    def run_lines(self, runner: Runner, lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        seen: list[str] = []
        runner.emit_cb = lambda ev: seen.append(ev.text)
        proc = mock.Mock()
        proc.stdout = iter(lines)
        proc.wait.return_value = 1                               # stop after the lines: the failure path is not what is looked at
        with mock.patch.object(Runner, "_spawn", return_value=proc), mock.patch.object(Runner, "adopt_prepared_files", return_value=None):
            with self.assertRaises(LaunchError):
                runner.ensure_model()
        return seen

    def test_the_total_is_the_whole_model_in_the_chosen_data_folder(self):
        data = self.base / "mydata"
        folder = data / "models" / "Q2_0"
        folder.mkdir(parents=True)
        first = folder / (Q2[0] + ".part")
        first.write_bytes(bytes(100_000_000))
        r = self.runner(family="qwen", model="Q2_0", data_dir=str(data), vision="on", context=32768)
        job = r.progress_job()
        self.assertEqual(Path(job["folder"]), folder)
        self.assertEqual(len(job["files"]), 3)                                   # two shards and the picture reader
        seen = self.run_lines(r, ["=== Step 5: Getting the model files ===", f"{Q2[0]}: 0.10 / 37.60 GB (0%)"])
        text = [x for x in seen if "GB" in x]
        self.assertTrue(text, seen)
        self.assertIn("of 67.3 GB", text[-1])                                     # 66.4 GB of shards + 0.9 GB picture reader
        self.assertNotIn("37.6", " ".join(text))

    def test_the_default_data_folder_is_used_when_none_was_chosen(self):
        r = self.runner(family="qwen", model="Q2_0", vision="off", context=32768)
        self.assertEqual(Path(r.progress_job()["folder"]).parts[-2:], ("models", "Q2_0"))
        self.assertEqual(len(r.progress_job()["files"]), 2)



class QuietStep(Base):
    """Finding 5: setup step 6 (packing) prints nothing for minutes: the person sees the plain sentence and a 'still working' line."""

    def slow(self, steps):
        import time
        for delay, line in steps:
            time.sleep(delay)
            yield line + "\n"

    def run_steps(self, steps, heartbeat=0.3):
        r = self.runner(family="qwen", model="Q2_0", vision="off", context=32768)
        r.HEARTBEAT_S = heartbeat
        seen = []
        r.emit_cb = lambda ev: seen.append(ev.text)
        proc = mock.Mock()
        proc.stdout = self.slow(steps)
        proc.wait.return_value = 1
        with mock.patch.object(Runner, "_spawn", return_value=proc), mock.patch.object(Runner, "adopt_prepared_files", return_value=None):
            with self.assertRaises(LaunchError):
                r.ensure_model()
        return seen

    def test_a_silent_pack_step_says_what_it_does_and_that_it_is_still_going(self):
        seen = self.run_steps([(0, "=== Step 5: Getting the model files ==="), (0, "all model files present"),
                               (0, "=== Step 6: Preparing the model for Strata ==="),
                               (0, "> python tools/iq_pack.py --gguf x --out y --experts-bin"), (1.6, "[X] stopped for the test")])
        pack = [x for x in seen if x.startswith("Packing the experts into one file")]
        self.assertTrue(pack, seen)
        self.assertEqual(pack[0], "Packing the experts into one file for low-memory mode (one time)")
        beats = [x for x in pack if "still working" in x]
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(beats), 2, seen)                    # a line every interval of silence
        self.assertNotIn("Setup step 6", " ".join(seen))

    def test_no_heartbeat_while_lines_keep_coming(self):
        seen = self.run_steps([(0, "=== Step 6: Preparing the model for Strata ==="), (0, "> python tools/iq_pack.py --gguf x --out y --experts-bin")] +
                              [(0.1, f"  layer {i}") for i in range(5)] + [(0, "[X] stopped")], heartbeat=2.0)
        self.assertFalse([x for x in seen if "still working" in x])

    def test_the_plain_printer_shows_each_heartbeat(self):
        import io
        from strata_cli.launch import cmd
        from strata_cli.launch.runner import Event
        buf = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch.object(cmd.sys, "stdout", buf):
            emit = cmd._printer()
            emit(Event("model", "Packing (still working, 30 s so far)"))
            emit(Event("model", "Packing (still working, 60 s so far)"))
            emit(Event("model", "Packing (still working, 60 s so far)"))
        self.assertEqual(buf.getvalue().count("still working"), 2)



class StoredTuning(Base):
    """Finding 6: a run by flags (no saved preset) reuses the tuning result stored for the same model, choices and computer."""

    IDENT = {"hardware": {"hard": {"gpus": ["RTX 5070"], "cpu": "test", "logical": 16, "ram_gib": 64}, "soft": {}},
             "engine": {"backend": "cuda"}, "model": {"sha256_shard1": "abc"}}

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        from strata_control import presets
        self.presets = presets
        self.cfg_path = self.base / "launch.json"
        self.cfg = {"args": ["--native", "x/model-00001-of-00002.gguf", "--max-context", "32768", "--kv", "int8"], "model_name": "qwen"}
        self.cfg_path.write_text(json.dumps(self.cfg), encoding="utf-8")
        self.ident = json.loads(json.dumps(self.IDENT))
        p = mock.patch.object(presets, "current_identity", lambda cfg, **kw: self.ident)
        p.start()
        self.addCleanup(p.stop)

    def store(self):
        return self.presets.create({"settings": {"args": {}, "env": {}, "per_request": {}}, "outcome": "improved"},
                                   choices=self.presets.choices_from_config(self.cfg), identity=self.ident, name="Q2 32K - Full speed")

    def runner_for_tune(self, retune=False):
        r = self.runner(family="qwen", model="Q2_0", tune="quick")
        r.retune = retune
        r.config_path = self.cfg_path
        return r

    def run_tune(self, r):
        seen = []
        r.emit_cb = lambda ev: seen.append(ev.text)
        with mock.patch.object(Runner, "_spawn", side_effect=RuntimeError("the tuner started")) as spawn:
            try:
                r.tune()
                started = False
            except RuntimeError:
                started = True
        return seen, started

    def test_nothing_stored_means_it_is_measured(self):
        seen, started = self.run_tune(self.runner_for_tune())
        self.assertTrue(started)

    def test_a_stored_result_is_used_and_said(self):
        saved = self.store()
        r = self.runner_for_tune()
        seen, started = self.run_tune(r)
        self.assertFalse(started)
        text = seen[-1]
        self.assertIn("already tuned for this computer", text)
        self.assertIn("Q2 32K - Full speed", text)
        self.assertIn("--retune", text)
        self.assertEqual(r.s.tuned_preset, saved["id"])
        self.assertTrue(r.s.is_tuned)

    def test_retune_measures_again(self):
        self.store()
        seen, started = self.run_tune(self.runner_for_tune(retune=True))
        self.assertTrue(started)

    def test_another_context_is_another_result(self):
        self.store()
        self.cfg["args"][3] = "65536"
        self.cfg_path.write_text(json.dumps(self.cfg), encoding="utf-8")
        seen, started = self.run_tune(self.runner_for_tune())
        self.assertTrue(started)

    def test_a_changed_graphics_card_is_measured_again(self):
        self.store()
        self.ident["hardware"]["hard"]["gpus"] = ["RTX 4090"]
        seen, started = self.run_tune(self.runner_for_tune())
        self.assertTrue(started)

    def test_the_flag_asks_for_a_new_measurement_and_implies_quick(self):
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", "--output", "json", "--model", "q2_0", "--retune"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(out)["plan"]["settings"]["tune"], "quick")
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--help"])
        self.assertIn("--retune", out)



if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_folders_home.py

"""strata_control/folders.problem: a system folder is refused, except inside the running user's own home (root's /root included)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_control import folders


class OwnHome(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_system_folder_is_still_refused(self):
        root = folders._system_roots()[0]
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"HOME": tempfile.gettempdir(), "USERPROFILE": tempfile.gettempdir()}):
            p = folders.problem(str(Path(root) / "strata-models"))
        self.assertIsNotNone(p)
        self.assertIn("system folder", p[0])

    def test_the_users_own_home_is_allowed_even_when_it_is_under_a_system_root(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            home = Path(d) / "rootlike"
            home.mkdir()
            with mock.patch.object(folders, "_system_roots", lambda: [d]), \
                    mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"HOME": str(home), "USERPROFILE": str(home)}):
                self.assertIsNone(folders.problem(str(home / "models")))
                other = Path(d) / "elsewhere"
                other.mkdir()
                self.assertIn("system folder", folders.problem(str(other / "models"))[0])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_gfx_selection.py

"""#3456 / #3486: an RX 9070 on Windows has no hipInfo, so the gfx list is empty and every HIP build "fits". The newest version (the rdna3
build, 0.1.46.1) then won over the rx9070 one (0.1.46). Selection must follow the GPU name or the installed variant, never the version."""
from __future__ import annotations

import unittest
from unittest import mock

from strata_control import engine_component as ec, feed as feedmod, updater

WIN = "windows-x86_64"


def pkg(version, variant, archs):
    return feedmod._engine_package({
        "version": version, "platform": WIN, "backend": "hip", "variant": variant, "archs": list(archs), "min_driver": {},
        "min_runtime": None, "build_id": f"b-{version}-{variant}", "format": "zip", "url": f"e-{version}-{variant}.zip", "size": 10,
        "sha256": "a" * 64, "manifest_sha256": "b" * 64, "installed_bytes": 20, "notes": ""})


FEED = [pkg("0.1.46", "rx9070", ("gfx1200", "gfx1201")), pkg("0.1.46.1", "rdna3", ("gfx1100", "gfx1101", "gfx1102", "gfx1151"))]


def hw(names=(), gfx=(), installed="", wanted=""):
    return {"platform": WIN, "backend": "hip", "runtime": "0.2.1.3", "nvidia_driver": None, "cuda_archs": [], "gfx": list(gfx),
            "gpu_names": list(names), "installed_variant": installed, "variant_wanted": wanted}


class Selection(unittest.TestCase):
    def pick(self, hardware):
        best, reasons = feedmod.select_engine(FEED, hardware)
        return (best.variant if best else None), reasons

    def test_rx9070_with_empty_gfx_gets_rx9070(self):
        for name in ("AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT", "AMD Radeon RX 9070", "AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT", "AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700"):
            self.assertEqual(self.pick(hw([name]))[0], "rx9070", name)

    def test_strix_halo_and_rx7900_with_empty_gfx_get_rdna3(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.pick(hw(["AMD Radeon(TM) 8060S Graphics"]))[0], "rdna3")
        self.assertEqual(self.pick(hw(["AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX"]))[0], "rdna3")
        self.assertEqual(self.pick(hw(["AMD Radeon RX 7600"]))[0], "rdna3")

    def test_unknown_amd_keeps_the_installed_variant(self):
        got, why = self.pick(hw(["AMD Radeon Mystery"], installed="rx9070"))
        self.assertEqual(got, "rx9070")
        self.assertTrue(any("kept" in r for r in why))
        self.assertEqual(self.pick(hw([], installed="rdna3"))[0], "rdna3")

    def test_unknown_amd_and_nothing_installed_chooses_nothing_instead_of_the_newest(self):
        got, why = self.pick(hw([]))
        self.assertIsNone(got)
        self.assertTrue(any("cannot tell" in r for r in why))

    def test_the_name_beats_a_stale_installed_variant_when_the_card_changed(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.pick(hw(["AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT"], installed="rdna3"))[0], "rx9070")

    def test_a_known_gfx_is_unchanged(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.pick(hw(gfx=["gfx1201"]))[0], "rx9070")
        self.assertEqual(self.pick(hw(gfx=["gfx1151"]))[0], "rdna3")

    def test_the_variant_can_be_asked_for(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.pick(hw([], wanted="rx9070"))[0], "rx9070")


class Names(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_names(self):
        table = {"AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT": "gfx1201", "AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT": "gfx1200", "AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700": "gfx1201",
                 "AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX": "gfx1100", "AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT": "gfx1101", "AMD Radeon RX 7700 XT": "gfx1101",
                 "AMD Radeon RX 7600 XT": "gfx1102", "AMD Radeon(TM) 8060S Graphics": "gfx1151", "AMD Radeon 780M Graphics": "gfx1103",
                 "AMD Radeon 890M Graphics": "gfx1150", "AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT": "gfx1030", "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090": "", "": ""}
        for name, gfx in table.items():
            self.assertEqual(ec.gfx_from_name(name), gfx, name)

    def test_a_card_with_an_unlisted_pci_id_is_identified_by_its_name(self):
        cards = ec.windows_amd_cards([{"vendor": "1002", "device": 0x7551 + 0x100, "name": "AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT", "vram_gb": 0.0}])
        self.assertEqual([c["arch"] for c in cards], ["gfx1201"])
        self.assertEqual(ec.windows_amd_cards([{"vendor": "1002", "device": 0x9999, "name": "AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics", "vram_gb": 0.5}]), [])
        self.assertEqual(ec.windows_amd_cards([{"vendor": "1002", "device": 0x9999, "name": "AMD Radeon 890M Graphics", "vram_gb": 4.0}]), [])


class Detection(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_windows_without_hipinfo_reads_the_gfx_from_the_adapters(self):
        adapters = [{"vendor": "1002", "device": 0x7550, "name": "AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT", "vram_gb": 16.0}]
        with mock.patch.object(updater.os, "name", "nt"), mock.patch.object(updater.shutil, "which", return_value=None), \
                mock.patch.object(ec, "windows_display_adapters", return_value=adapters):
            self.assertEqual(updater._gfx_names(), ["gfx1201"])
            self.assertEqual(updater._amd_card_names(), ["AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT"])

    def test_the_feed_style_backend_name_is_accepted(self):
        with mock.patch.object(updater, "_gfx_names", return_value=[]), mock.patch.object(updater, "_amd_card_names", return_value=[]):
            got = updater.detect_hardware({ec.ENV_BACKEND: "hip-rx9070"})
        self.assertEqual((got["backend"], got["variant_wanted"]), ("hip", "rx9070"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_gpu_fit.py

"""strata_control/gpu_fit.py: the one rule for which graphics cards a model uses (app, strata launch and setup share it)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from strata_control import gpu_fit as G

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


def card(index, name, vram, **kw):
    return {"index": index, "name": name, "vram_gb": vram, "usable": True, **kw}


class GpuFitRule(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_one_card_is_the_only_option(self):
        r = G.options(44.0, 62.0, [card(0, "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti", 8)])
        self.assertEqual([o["key"] for o in r["options"]], ["single"])
        self.assertEqual(r["recommended"], "single")
        self.assertEqual(r["options"][0]["verdict"], "fits")
        self.assertIn("RTX 3070 Ti + RAM", r["options"][0]["label"])

    def test_two_unequal_cards_and_the_model_fits_one_defaults_to_single_and_offers_the_split(self):
        r = G.options(44.0, 62.0, [card(1, "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti", 8), card(0, "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti", 16)])
        keys = [o["key"] for o in r["options"]]
        self.assertEqual(keys[:2], ["single", "split"])             # the largest card first, then the split
        self.assertEqual(r["recommended"], "single")
        self.assertEqual(r["options"][0]["cards"], [0])             # the largest card is the 16 GB one
        split = r["options"][1]
        self.assertEqual(split["cards"], [0, 1])
        self.assertIn("layer split", split["label"])
        self.assertTrue(any("20% faster" in n for n in split["notes"]))
        self.assertEqual(sum(1 for o in r["options"] if o["recommended"]), 1)

    def test_two_small_cards_and_the_model_does_not_fit_one_defaults_to_the_split(self):
        r = G.options(44.0, 32.0, [card(0, "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060", 10), card(1, "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060", 10)])
        single, split = r["options"][0], r["options"][1]
        self.assertEqual(single["verdict"], "spills")
        self.assertLess(split["spill_gb"], single["spill_gb"])      # the second card takes part of the SSD reading away
        self.assertEqual(r["recommended"], "split")
        self.assertEqual(split["cards"], [0, 1])

    def test_a_tight_single_card_moves_the_default_to_the_split_when_that_fits_with_room(self):
        # 44 GB model, 46 GB of RAM: one 12 GB card + RAM holds it but leaves no RAM spare (tight); two cards leave room
        r = G.options(44.0, 46.0, [card(0, "RTX 4070", 12), card(1, "RTX 4070", 12)])
        self.assertEqual(r["options"][0]["verdict"], "tight")
        self.assertEqual(r["options"][1]["verdict"], "fits")
        self.assertEqual(r["recommended"], "split")

    def test_an_integrated_chip_and_a_tiny_card_are_ignored(self):
        cards = [card(0, "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti", 8), card(1, "AMD Radeon Graphics", 16, integrated=True), card(2, "Old display card", 2)]
        r = G.options(44.0, 62.0, cards)
        self.assertEqual([o["key"] for o in r["options"]], ["single"])
        self.assertEqual({c["index"] for c in r["ignored"]}, {1, 2})
        self.assertTrue(all(c["why_ignored"] for c in r["ignored"]))
        self.assertEqual(G.recommended_cards(44.0, 62.0, cards), [0])

    def test_a_unified_memory_chip_counts_when_it_is_the_only_device(self):
        mac = {"index": 0, "name": "Apple M4", "vendor": "apple", "vram_gb": 0.0, "unified_gb": 32.0, "usable": True}
        keep, ignored = G.usable_cards([mac])
        self.assertEqual((len(keep), ignored), (1, []))
        igpu = {"index": 0, "name": "AMD Radeon 8060S", "vram_gb": 64.0, "uma": True, "usable": True}
        self.assertEqual(len(G.usable_cards([igpu])[0]), 1)                 # a Strix Halo PC: the integrated chip IS the device
        keep, ignored = G.usable_cards([card(0, "RTX 3070 Ti", 8), igpu])   # beside a real card it adds nothing
        self.assertEqual([c["index"] for c in keep], [0] if keep[0]["name"] == "RTX 3070 Ti" else [])
        self.assertEqual(len(ignored), 1)

    def test_a_strix_halo_counts_its_memory_once(self):
        """The 'shared' pool of an APU is the RAM: a 70 GB model on a 128 GB Strix Halo with a 2 GB carve-out is RAM-resident, not 'VRAM + RAM'."""
        igpu = {"index": 0, "name": "AMD Radeon 8060S", "vram_gb": 66.0, "dedicated_gb": 2.0, "uma": True, "usable": True}
        self.assertEqual(G.own_memory_gb(igpu), 2.0)
        self.assertEqual(G.own_memory_gb({"index": 1, "vram_gb": 32.0}), 32.0)
        self.assertEqual(G.own_memory_gb({"index": 0, "vram_gb": 66.0, "uma": True}), 0.0)          # no carve-out figure: none counted
        # 64 GB PC, a 90 GB model: counted twice (66 GB 'VRAM' + 54 GB RAM) it looked like it fit; once, 36 GB come from the SSD
        r = G.options(90.0, 64.0, [dict(igpu, vram_gb=34.0)])
        self.assertEqual(r["options"][0]["verdict"], "spills")
        self.assertGreater(r["options"][0]["spill_gb"], 30.0)
        # 128 GB, 90 GB model: fits in RAM
        self.assertEqual(G.options(90.0, 128.0, [dict(igpu, vram_gb=66.0)])["options"][0]["verdict"], "fits")

    def test_an_unusable_card_is_ignored_with_its_own_reason(self):
        r = G.options(44.0, 62.0, [card(0, "RTX 3070 Ti", 8), card(1, "GTX 1060", 6, usable=False, problem="older than the RTX 20 series")])
        self.assertEqual([o["key"] for o in r["options"]], ["single"])
        self.assertIn("older than the RTX 20 series", r["ignored"][0]["why_ignored"])

    def test_a_card_under_the_split_minimum_is_offered_alone_but_not_in_the_split(self):
        r = G.options(44.0, 32.0, [card(0, "RTX 3060", 12), card(1, "GTX 1660", 6)])
        keys = [o["key"] for o in r["options"]]
        self.assertNotIn("split", keys)
        self.assertEqual(r["recommended"], "single")

    def test_three_cards_offer_the_pair_and_all_of_them(self):
        r = G.options(70.0, 32.0, [card(i, "RTX 3060", 12) for i in range(3)])
        keys = [o["key"] for o in r["options"]]
        self.assertEqual(keys[:3], ["single", "split", "split-all"])

    def test_no_card_gives_no_options(self):
        r = G.options(44.0, 62.0, [])
        self.assertEqual((r["options"], r["recommended"]), ([], None))

    def test_unknown_ram_is_unknown_not_a_guess(self):
        r = G.options(44.0, None, [card(0, "RTX 3070 Ti", 8), card(1, "RTX 3060 Ti", 8)])
        self.assertEqual(r["options"][0]["verdict"], "unknown")
        self.assertEqual(r["recommended"], "single")

    def test_plain_numbers_are_in_the_words(self):
        r = G.options(44.0, 62.0, [card(0, "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti", 8)])
        self.assertIn("needs 44 GB", r["options"][0]["words"])
        self.assertIn("RTX 3070 Ti + RAM", r["options"][0]["summary"])
        r2 = G.options(44.0, 32.0, [card(0, "RTX 3060", 10)])
        self.assertIn("read from the SSD", r2["options"][0]["words"])

    def test_the_constants_equal_the_apps(self):
        text = (ROOT / "apps" / "host" / "src" / "lib" / "native-fit.ts").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        m = re.search(r"const DENSE_GB = (\d+), SYSTEM_ROOM_GB = (\d+), DENSE_EXTRA_GB = (\d+)", text)
        self.assertIsNotNone(m)
        self.assertEqual((G.DENSE_GB, G.SYSTEM_ROOM_GB, G.DENSE_EXTRA_GB), tuple(float(x) for x in m.groups()))

    def test_fit_matches_the_launch_catalog_port_of_native_fit(self):
        from strata_cli.launch.catalog import fit_on
        for ram, vram in ((62, 16), (32, 10), (16, 0), (128, 24)):
            a = fit_on({"memory_gb": 44.0}, ram, vram)
            b = G.fit(44.0, ram, vram)
            self.assertAlmostEqual(a["spillGb"], b["spill_gb"])
            self.assertAlmostEqual(a["vramUseGb"], b["vram_use_gb"])
            self.assertAlmostEqual(a["ramUseGb"], b["ram_use_gb"])


class GpuFitInTheModelList(unittest.TestCase):
    """The app reads the options from the model list (tools/strata_mcp.py model_table): the same rule, nothing duplicated in the UI."""

    def setUp(self):

        self.home = Home().__enter__()
        self.addCleanup(self.home.__exit__, None, None, None)

    def sizes(self, hw):
        from tests.terminal.launch_support import catalog
