    def test_run_without_screens_prints_the_address_and_saves_the_preset(self):
        fake = Result(profile="launch-office", urls=["http://127.0.0.1:8080", "http://192.168.1.5:8080"], key="sk-strata-abcdefghijkl",
                      tune_word=None, notices=[], config="/x")
        with mock.patch.object(Runner, "run", return_value=fake):
            code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--no-tui", "--model", "q2_0", "--access", "lan", "--save-preset", "Office"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err)
        self.assertIn("Strata is serving.", out)
        self.assertIn("http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1", out)
        self.assertIn("http://192.168.1.5:8080/v1", out)
        self.assertNotIn("sk-strata-abcdefghijkl", out)                      # the key is masked
        self.assertIn("strata connect", out)
        self.assertEqual([p.name for p in store.list_presets()], ["Office"])
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--list-presets"])
        self.assertIn("Office", out)
        code, out, _ = run_cli(["launch", "--show-key", "--preset", "Office"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)                                              # the preset's own key
        self.assertTrue(out.strip().startswith("sk-strata-"))

    def test_a_reason_joined_after_a_sentence_starts_with_a_capital(self):
        from strata_cli.launch.runner import capital
        self.assertEqual(capital("the update feed could not be read: no route"), "The update feed could not be read: no route")
        self.assertEqual(capital("Already fine."), "Already fine.")
        self.assertEqual(capital(""), "")

    def test_launch_error_is_one_plain_sentence(self):
        from strata_cli.launch.runner import LaunchError
        with mock.patch.object(Runner, "run", side_effect=LaunchError("The engine could not be installed.", "Check your internet.", 6)):
            code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--no-tui", "--model", "q2_0"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 6)
        self.assertIn("The engine could not be installed. Check your internet.", err)
        self.assertNotIn("Traceback", err)

    def test_list_delete_status_stop_without_anything_running(self):
        store.save(S.LaunchSettings(name="A", family="qwen", model="Q2_0", context=32768))
        code, out, _ = run_cli(["launch", "--list-presets"])
        self.assertIn("A", out)
        code, out, _ = run_cli(["launch", "--delete-preset", "A"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertIn("Models and tuning results were not touched", out)
        code, out, _ = run_cli(["launch", "--list-presets"])
        self.assertIn("No saved presets", out)
        code, out, _ = run_cli(["launch", "--status"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertIn("Nothing from `strata launch` is running.", out)
        code, out, _ = run_cli(["launch", "--stop"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertIn("Nothing", out)
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--delete-preset", "gone"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 2)
        self.assertIn("no saved preset", err)

    def test_feed_flag_reaches_the_runner(self):
        seen = {}

        def fake(self, *a, **k):
            seen["feed"] = self.feed
            return Result("launch-x", ["http://127.0.0.1:8080"], None, None, [], "/x")

        with mock.patch.object(Runner, "run", fake):
            code, _, err = run_cli(["launch", "--no-tui", "--model", "q2_0", "--feed", "http://127.0.0.1:9/feed"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err)
        self.assertEqual(seen["feed"], "http://127.0.0.1:9/feed")

    def test_output_json_for_scripts(self):
        fake = Result("launch-x", ["http://127.0.0.1:8080"], "sk-k", "faster", ["a note"], "/x")
        with mock.patch.object(Runner, "run", return_value=fake):
            code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--no-tui", "--output", "json", "--model", "q2_0"])
        data = json.loads(out)
        self.assertTrue(data["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(data["urls"], ["http://127.0.0.1:8080"])
        self.assertEqual(data["api_key"], "set")                                # never the key itself
        self.assertEqual(data["tuned"], "faster")


class ConnectCommand(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.home = Home().__enter__()
        self.addCleanup(self.home.__exit__, None, None, None)

    def test_list_and_unknown_names(self):
        code, out, _ = run_cli(["connect"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        for h in ("opencode", "codex", "claude-code", "omp", "pi", "hermes", "openclaw", "deepseek-harness"):
            self.assertIn(h, out)
        code, out, err = run_cli(["connect", "opncode"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 2)
        self.assertIn("Did you mean 'opencode'", err)
        code, out, _ = run_cli(["connect", "--output", "json"])
        self.assertEqual(len(json.loads(out)["harnesses"]), 8)

    def test_prints_the_config_with_a_masked_key(self):
        code, out, err = run_cli(["connect", "opencode", "--url", "http://127.0.0.1:8123", "--key", "sk-strata-abcdefghij1234", "--model", "m1"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err)
        self.assertIn("http://127.0.0.1:8123/v1", out)
        self.assertIn("opencode.json", out)
        self.assertIn("limit", out)
        self.assertNotIn("abcdefghij1234", out)
        code, out, _ = run_cli(["connect", "opencode", "--url", "http://127.0.0.1:8123", "--key", "sk-strata-abcdefghij1234", "--show-key"])
        self.assertIn("sk-strata-abcdefghij1234", out)

    def test_claude_code_uses_the_anthropic_variables_without_a_login(self):
        code, out, _ = run_cli(["connect", "claude-code", "--url", "http://127.0.0.1:8080", "--key", "sk-x1234567890abc", "--show-key"])
        self.assertIn("ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL", out)
        self.assertIn("ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN", out)
        self.assertNotIn("/v1", out.split("ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL")[1].splitlines()[0])      # the Anthropic client adds /v1 itself

    def test_a_pasted_v1_address_is_cut_back_to_the_server_root(self):
        """The Anthropic client adds /v1/messages itself, so ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL must never end in /v1 (that gave /v1/v1/messages, a 404);
        the OpenAI-style apps get exactly one /v1."""
        code, out, _ = run_cli(["connect", "claude-code", "--url", "http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/", "--key", "sk-x1234567890abc", "--show-key", "--output", "json"])
        data = json.loads(out)
        self.assertEqual(data["env"]["ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL"], "http://127.0.0.1:8080")
        self.assertIn('"ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL": "http://127.0.0.1:8080"', data["files"][0]["text"])
        code, out, _ = run_cli(["connect", "opencode", "--url", "http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1", "--output", "json"])
        text = json.loads(out)["files"][0]["text"]
        self.assertIn("http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1", text)
        self.assertNotIn("/v1/v1", text)
        code, out, _ = run_cli(["connect", "claude-code", "--url", "http://127.0.0.1:8080"])
        self.assertIn("without /v1", out)

    def test_write_keeps_a_backup_and_merges(self):
        target = Path(os.environ["HOME"]) / ".config" / "opencode" / "opencode.json"
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        target.write_text(json.dumps({"theme": "dark", "provider": {"other": {"a": 1}}}))
        code, out, err = run_cli(["connect", "opencode", "--url", "http://127.0.0.1:8080", "--key", "sk-x1234567890abc", "--write", "--yes"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err)
        data = json.loads(target.read_text())
        self.assertEqual(data["theme"], "dark")
        self.assertIn("other", data["provider"])
        self.assertIn("strata", data["provider"])
        backups = list(target.parent.glob("opencode.json.strata-bak-*"))
        self.assertEqual(len(backups), 1)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(backups[0].read_text())["theme"], "dark")
        self.assertIn("backup", out)

    def test_write_asks_first_without_yes(self):
        # no keyboard: stdin is a pipe whatever the shell that runs the tests is; input() must never be reached
        pipe = io.StringIO("")
        with mock.patch.object(sys, "stdin", pipe), mock.patch("builtins.input", side_effect=AssertionError("asked on a pipe")):
            code, out, err = run_cli(["connect", "opencode", "--write"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 2)
        self.assertIn("asks first", err)

    def test_write_answered_by_nobody_writes_nothing(self):
        # a terminal whose input ends (Ctrl-D, a closed console) is "no", not a traceback
        with mock.patch.object(sys.stdin, "isatty", return_value=True), mock.patch("builtins.input", side_effect=EOFError):
            code, out, err = run_cli(["connect", "opencode", "--write"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertIn("Nothing was written", out)

    def test_built_in_harness_has_nothing_to_write(self):
        code, out, _ = run_cli(["connect", "deepseek-harness", "--write", "--yes"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertIn("Nothing to write", out)

    def render(self, name, **kw):
        h = harness.find(name)
        t = harness.target(kw.get("url", "http://127.0.0.1:18900"), kw.get("key"), "qwen3.8-flash-next-q2_0", kw.get("context", 32768))
        return harness.render(h, t)

    def test_all_eight_are_tested_configs(self):
        self.assertEqual([h.id for h in harness.HARNESSES],
                         ["opencode", "codex", "claude-code", "omp", "pi", "hermes", "openclaw", "deepseek-harness"])
        for h in harness.HARNESSES:
            self.assertTrue(h.tested, h.id)
            self.assertIn("tested", h.status)

    def test_opencode_has_limit_input_and_the_15k_compaction_buffer(self):
        cfg = json.loads(self.render("opencode")["files"][0]["text"])
        m = cfg["provider"]["strata"]["models"]["qwen3.8-flash-next-q2_0"]
        self.assertEqual(m["limit"], {"context": 32768, "input": 28672, "output": 4096})
        self.assertEqual(cfg["compaction"]["buffer"], 13672)                  # 28672 - 15000
        self.assertEqual(cfg["provider"]["strata"]["options"]["baseURL"], "http://127.0.0.1:18900/v1")
        self.assertEqual(cfg["provider"]["strata"]["options"]["apiKey"], "strata-local")

    def test_codex_uses_responses_and_the_key_variable(self):
        out = self.render("codex", key="sk-real")
        text = out["files"][0]["text"]
        self.assertIn('wire_api = "responses"', text)
        self.assertIn("model_auto_compact_token_limit = 15000", text)
        self.assertIn('base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:18900/v1"', text)
        self.assertEqual(out["env"], {"STRATA_API_KEY": "sk-real"})

    def test_claude_code_sets_window_and_output_cap_and_has_no_login(self):
        out = self.render("claude-code")
        env = out["env"]
        self.assertEqual(env["ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL"], "http://127.0.0.1:18900")
        self.assertEqual(env["CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS"], "32768")
        self.assertEqual(env["CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS"], "4096")
        self.assertEqual(env["CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE"], "1")                      # the full prompt is 15.6K tokens
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(out["files"][0]["text"])["env"], env)
        big = self.render("claude-code", context=131072)["env"]
        self.assertEqual(big["CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS"], "131072")
        self.assertNotIn("CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE", big)
        self.assertTrue(any("CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS" in n for n in out["limits"]))

    def test_pi_omp_hermes_openclaw_numbers(self):
        pi = self.render("pi")["files"]
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(pi[1]["text"])["compaction"]["reserveTokens"], 17768)       # 32768 - 15000
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(pi[0]["text"])["providers"]["strata"]["models"][0]["contextWindow"], 32768)
        omp = self.render("omp")["files"]
        self.assertIn("thresholdTokens: 15000", omp[1]["text"])
        self.assertIn("contextWindow: 32768", omp[0]["text"])
        hermes = self.render("hermes")
        self.assertIn("provider: lmstudio", hermes["files"][0]["text"])
        self.assertIn("context_length: 65536", hermes["files"][0]["text"])
        self.assertTrue(any("WARNING" in n and "64K" in n for n in hermes["limits"]))
        self.assertFalse(any("WARNING" in n for n in self.render("hermes", context=131072)["limits"]))
        oc = json.loads(self.render("openclaw")["files"][0]["text"])
        self.assertEqual(oc["models"]["providers"]["strata"]["models"][0]["contextTokens"], 23192)
        self.assertTrue(any("Node 24.16" in n for n in self.render("openclaw")["limits"]))

    def test_limits_are_in_plain_words_for_every_app(self):
        for h in harness.HARNESSES:
            self.assertTrue(self.render(h.id)["limits"], h.id)

    def test_deepseek_harness_is_the_app(self):
        out = self.render("deepseek-harness")
        self.assertEqual(out["files"], [])
        self.assertIn("Strata app", " ".join(out["limits"]))

    def test_check_sends_the_apps_own_wire_format_and_reports_pass_or_fail(self):
        from strata_cli.launch import check
        seen = []

        def good(url, key, body, headers=None, timeout=0):
            seen.append(url)
            if url.endswith("/v1/responses"):
                if "tools" in body:
                    return {"output": [{"type": "function_call", "name": "get_weather", "arguments": json.dumps({"city": "Paris"})}]}
                return {"output_text": "pong"}
            if url.endswith("/v1/messages"):
                if "tools" in body:
                    return {"content": [{"type": "tool_use", "name": "get_weather", "input": {"city": "Paris"}}]}
                return {"content": [{"type": "text", "text": "pong"}]}
            if "tools" in body:
                return {"choices": [{"message": {"content": None, "tool_calls": [{"function": {"name": "get_weather", "arguments": "{\"city\": \"Paris\"}"}}]}}]}
            return {"choices": [{"message": {"content": "Pong."}}]}

        for h, ending in (("opencode", "/v1/chat/completions"), ("codex", "/v1/responses"), ("claude-code", "/v1/messages")):
            seen.clear()
            res = check.run_checks(h, "http://127.0.0.1:1", "k", "m", poster=good)
            self.assertEqual([r.ok for r in res], [True, True], h)
            self.assertTrue(all(u.endswith(ending) for u in seen), (h, seen))

        def wrong(url, key, body, headers=None, timeout=0):
            if "tools" in body:
                return {"choices": [{"message": {"content": "It is sunny.", "tool_calls": None}}]}
            return {"choices": [{"message": {"content": "hello there"}}]}

        res = check.run_checks("pi", "http://127.0.0.1:1", "k", "m", poster=wrong)
        self.assertEqual([r.ok for r in res], [False, False])
        self.assertIn("not the word asked for", res[0].detail)
        self.assertIn("did not call the tool", res[1].detail)

        import urllib.error

        def refused(url, key, body, headers=None, timeout=0):
            raise urllib.error.HTTPError(url, 401, "no", None, None)
        res = check.run_checks("pi", "http://127.0.0.1:1", "", "m", poster=refused)
        self.assertIn("refused the key", res[0].detail)

    def test_connect_check_flag_prints_pass_lines(self):
        from strata_cli.launch import check
        ok = [check.Check("prompt", True, "It answered: 'pong'.", 1.0), check.Check("tool call", True, "It called get_weather with {}.", 2.0)]
        with mock.patch.object(check, "run_checks", return_value=ok):
            code, out, err = run_cli(["connect", "opencode", "--url", "http://127.0.0.1:1", "--check"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err)
        self.assertIn("PASS prompt", out)
        self.assertIn("PASS tool call", out)
        bad = [check.Check("prompt", False, "x", 1.0), ok[1]]
        with mock.patch.object(check, "run_checks", return_value=bad):
            code, out, err = run_cli(["connect", "opencode", "--url", "http://127.0.0.1:1", "--check"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        self.assertIn("FAIL prompt", out)

    def test_context_flag_reaches_the_config(self):
        code, out, _ = run_cli(["connect", "pi", "--url", "http://127.0.0.1:8080", "--context", "64k", "--show-key"])
        self.assertIn('"contextWindow": 65536', out)
        self.assertIn('"reserveTokens": 50536', out)


class GpuRolesFlag(unittest.TestCase):
    """--gpu-roles: a role for each card (strata_control/gpu_roles.py); unnamed cards are Off."""

    def setUp(self):
        self.home = Home().__enter__()
        self.addCleanup(self.home.__exit__, None, None, None)
        p = mock.patch.object(Catalog, "hardware", lambda self, fresh=False: dict(HW_2X16, disk_free_gb=500.0))
        p.start()
        self.addCleanup(p.stop)

    def test_roles_reach_the_settings_and_the_plan_says_who_does_what(self):
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", "--output", "json", "--model", "iq3_xxs", "--gpu-roles", "1=main,0=helper"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err or out)
        s = json.loads(out)["plan"]["settings"]
        self.assertEqual(s["gpu_roles"], {"1": "main", "0": "helper"})
        self.assertIsNone(s["gpus"])
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", "--model", "iq3_xxs", "--gpu-roles", "1=main,0=helper"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err or out)
        self.assertIn("cards     Main: GPU 2 RTX A4000. Helper: GPU 1 RTX A4000.", out)
        self.assertIn("--gpu-roles 0=helper,1=main", out)                 # the copyable line says the same

    def test_one_card_named_leaves_the_other_off(self):
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", "--model", "iq3_xxs", "--gpu-roles", "1=main"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err or out)
        self.assertIn("Main: GPU 2 RTX A4000. Off: GPU 1 RTX A4000.", out)

    def test_bad_roles_are_plain_sentences(self):
        for argv, word in ((["--gpu-roles", "1=boss"], "main, helper, off"), (["--gpu-roles", "0=main,1=main"], "only one card can be Main"),
                           (["--gpu-roles", "1"], "number=role"), (["--gpu", "0", "--gpu-roles", "1=main"], "not both")):
            code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", *argv])
            self.assertEqual(code, 2, argv)
            self.assertIn(word, err, argv)
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", "--model", "iq3_xxs", "--gpu-roles", "7=main"])
        self.assertIn("There is no card 7", out + err)

    def test_the_launch_config_gets_the_roles_and_the_mirror_with_main_last(self):
        from strata_cli.launch.runner import cards_for_launch
        two = catalog(HW_2X16)
        mirror = cards_for_launch(S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="IQ3_XXS", gpu_roles={"1": "main", "0": "helper"}), two)
        self.assertEqual((mirror["gpu"], mirror["gpu_order"]), ([0, 1], "as_given"))
        self.assertEqual(mirror["gpu_roles"], {"0": "helper", "1": "main"})
        base = {"exe": "x", "args": [], "gpu": 1, "gpus_asked": True, "hip_ordinal": 0, "gpu_roles": {"0": "off", "1": "main"}}
        cfg = derive_config(base, S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="IQ3_XXS"), bool_flags=frozenset(), gpus=mirror)
        self.assertEqual((cfg["gpu"], cfg["layer_split"], cfg["gpu_order"]), ([0, 1], "auto", "as_given"))
        self.assertNotIn("hip_ordinal", cfg)
        one = cards_for_launch(S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="IQ3_XXS", gpu_roles={"0": "main"}), two)
        cfg = derive_config(base, S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="IQ3_XXS"), bool_flags=frozenset(), gpus=one)
        self.assertEqual((cfg["gpu"], cfg["gpu_roles"], "layer_split" in cfg), (0, {"0": "main", "1": "off"}, False))
        none = cards_for_launch(S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="IQ3_XXS", gpu_roles={"0": "off", "1": "off"}), two)
        self.assertEqual((none["gpu"], none["gpu_none"]), ([], True))

    def test_a_plain_card_list_replaces_an_earlier_roles_choice_and_the_installed_roles_are_kept(self):
        from strata_cli.launch.runner import apply_cards, cards_for_launch, installed_cards
        cfg = {"gpu": 1, "gpu_roles": {"0": "off", "1": "main"}, "gpu_cards": {}, "gpus_asked": True}
        apply_cards(cfg, [0, 1])
        self.assertEqual((cfg["gpu"], "gpu_roles" in cfg), ([0, 1], False))
        saved = {"gpu": [0, 1], "gpu_order": "as_given", "gpu_roles": {"0": "helper", "1": "main"}}
        self.assertEqual(installed_cards(saved), [0, 1])
        self.assertIsNone(cards_for_launch(S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="IQ3_XXS"), catalog(HW_2X16), base=saved))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_launch_dsv41.py

"""`strata launch` for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: the model is in the list, `--plan` says where it goes on this computer's cards (the real
numbers of strata_control/dsv41_fit.py), `--model-path` takes the nine shards where they are, and the settings that cannot apply
(parallel requests, pictures, tuning) are said instead of passed to an engine that would refuse them.  Nothing is downloaded or started."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_cli.launch import settings as S
from strata_cli.launch.catalog import Catalog
from strata_cli.launch.runner import LaunchError, Runner
from tests.terminal.launch_support import HW_12, Home, catalog, run_cli

R9700 = {"name": "AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700", "vram_gb": 32.0, "usable": True, "vendor": "amd"}
HW_4X32 = {**HW_12, "ram_gb": 251.0, "disk_free_gb": 900.0, "engine_vendor": "amd",
           "gpus": [{**R9700, "index": i} for i in range(4)]}


class LaunchDeepSeek(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.home = Home().__enter__()
        self.addCleanup(self.home.__exit__, None, None, None)
        self.hw = dict(HW_4X32)
        p = mock.patch.object(Catalog, "hardware", lambda s, fresh=False: dict(self.hw))
        p.start()
        self.addCleanup(p.stop)

    def plan(self, *args):
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", "--output", "json", *args])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err + out)
        return json.loads(out)["plan"]

    def test_the_model_is_in_the_list(self):
        rows = [r for r in catalog(self.hw).rows() if r.family == "deepseek41"]
        self.assertEqual([r.model for r in rows], ["IST-DAS-2.00bpw", "IST-DAS-2.25bpw", "IST-DAS-1.75bpw", "UD-Q8_K_XL"])
        self.assertEqual([r.download_gb for r in rows[:3]], [256.8, 273.8, 239.3])
        self.assertEqual(catalog(self.hw).resolve("ist-das-2.25bpw"), ("deepseek41", "IST-DAS-2.25bpw"))
        r = rows[3]
        self.assertEqual((r.id, r.download_gb, r.verdict, r.images), ("deepseek-v4.1-flash-ud-q8_k_xl", 508.4, "fits", False))
        self.assertEqual(catalog(self.hw).resolve("ud-q8_k_xl"), ("deepseek41", "UD-Q8_K_XL"))
        self.assertEqual(catalog(self.hw).max_context("deepseek41", "UD-Q8_K_XL"), 8192)

    def test_the_plan_places_the_model_on_the_four_cards(self):
        p = self.plan("--model", "ud-q8_k_xl", "--no-tui")
        pl = p["placement"]
        self.assertEqual(p["settings"]["family"], "deepseek41")
        self.assertEqual(p["settings"]["context"], 8192)
        self.assertEqual(p["settings"]["tune"], "skip")
        self.assertEqual(p["settings"]["vision"], "off")
        self.assertEqual(pl["verdict"], "fits")
        self.assertEqual([c["layers"] for c in pl["cards"]], [[0, 9], [10, 19], [20, 29], [30, 39]])
        self.assertEqual(pl["args"], ["--tp", "2"])
        # measured on this very computer: 6,197 experts (116.5 GB) in graphics memory, 9,163 (172.3 GB) on the CPU
        self.assertAlmostEqual(pl["experts_in_vram"], 6197, delta=100)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(pl["cpu_experts_gb"], 172.3, delta=2.5)
        text = " ".join(pl["lines"])
        self.assertIn("n-gram table", text)
        self.assertIn("stays on the SSD", text)
        self.assertIn("508 GB", text)

    def test_the_human_plan_shows_the_placement(self):
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", "--model", "ud-q8_k_xl", "--no-tui"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err)
        self.assertIn("placement", out)
        self.assertIn("4 cards, one block of layers on each", out)
        self.assertIn("n-gram table", out)
        self.assertIn("Nothing was changed.", out)

    def test_named_cards_are_the_ones_planned(self):
        p = self.plan("--model", "ud-q8_k_xl", "--gpu", "0,1")
        self.assertEqual([c["index"] for c in p["placement"]["cards"]], [0, 1])
        self.assertLess(p["placement"]["experts_in_vram"], 3000)

    def test_a_small_computer_gets_the_warnings_not_a_refusal(self):
        self.hw = {**HW_12, "ram_gb": 64.0, "disk_free_gb": 100.0, "engine_vendor": "nvidia"}
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", "--model", "ud-q8_k_xl", "--no-tui"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err)
        self.assertIn("read from the SSD", out)
        self.assertIn("free disk space", out)
        self.assertIn("It is still allowed", out)
        row = next(r for r in catalog(self.hw).rows() if r.family == "deepseek41" and r.model == "UD-Q8_K_XL")
        self.assertEqual(row.verdict, "no")                         # "too big (can still try)": the plan above is printed and nothing is refused

    def test_the_plan_names_dspark_not_mtp(self):
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", "--model", "ud-q8_k_xl", "--no-tui"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err)
        self.assertIn("drafting  DSpark", out)
        self.assertNotIn("MTP", out)

    def test_no_card_is_said(self):
        self.hw = {**HW_12, "gpus": []}
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", "--model", "ud-q8_k_xl", "--no-tui"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err)
        self.assertIn("No graphics card", out)

    def test_parallel_pictures_and_tuning_are_not_passed_on(self):
        p = self.plan("--model", "ud-q8_k_xl", "--parallel", "4", "--vision", "on", "--tune", "quick")
        s = p["settings"]
        self.assertFalse(s.get("parallel"))
        self.assertEqual((s["vision"], s["tune"]), ("off", "quick"))          # the DeepSeek tune is real now: the choice stays
        text = " ".join(p["warnings"])
        self.assertIn("one request at a time", text)
        self.assertIn("cannot read pictures", text)
        self.assertNotIn("Tuning is not offered", text)

    def test_setup_is_asked_for_the_family_and_the_files(self):
        s = S.LaunchSettings(family="deepseek41", model="UD-Q8_K_XL", context=8192, vision="off", tune="skip",
                             model_path="/data/ds")
        args = Runner(s, catalog=catalog(self.hw)).setup_args()
        self.assertEqual(args[:6], ["--yes", "--no-start", "--family", "deepseek41", "--model", "UD-Q8_K_XL"])
        self.assertIn("--gguf-dir", args)
        self.assertNotIn("--parallel", args)
        self.assertIsNone(Runner(s, catalog=catalog(self.hw)).catalog_parallel())


class OwnShards(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.home = Home().__enter__()
        self.addCleanup(self.home.__exit__, None, None, None)
        self.hw = dict(HW_4X32)
        p = mock.patch.object(Catalog, "hardware", lambda s, fresh=False: dict(self.hw))
        p.start()
        self.addCleanup(p.stop)

    def folder(self, shards=range(1, 10), nested=False):
        base = Path(os.environ["STRATA_INSTALL_DIR"]) / "ds"
        folder = base / "UD-Q8_K_XL" if nested else base
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for i in shards:
            (folder / f"DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-UD-Q8_K_XL-{i:05d}-of-00009.gguf").write_bytes(b"GGUF")
        return base, folder

    def runner(self, path):
        return Runner(S.LaunchSettings(model_path=str(path)), catalog=catalog(self.hw))

    def test_a_folder_of_the_nine_shards_is_the_model(self):
        _base, folder = self.folder()
        r = self.runner(folder)
        r.check_own_files()
        self.assertEqual((r.s.family, r.s.model, r.s.model_path), ("deepseek41", "UD-Q8_K_XL", str(folder)))

    def test_the_repository_folder_with_the_size_inside(self):
        base, folder = self.folder(nested=True)
        r = self.runner(base)
        r.check_own_files()
        self.assertEqual((r.s.family, r.s.model, r.s.model_path), ("deepseek41", "UD-Q8_K_XL", str(folder)))

    def test_one_shard_names_its_folder(self):
        _base, folder = self.folder()
        r = self.runner(folder / "DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-UD-Q8_K_XL-00003-of-00009.gguf")
        r.check_own_files()
        self.assertEqual(r.s.model_path, str(folder))

    def test_a_missing_shard_is_said_before_anything_is_downloaded(self):
        _base, folder = self.folder(shards=[1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9])
        with self.assertRaises(LaunchError) as cm:
            self.runner(folder).check_own_files()
        self.assertIn("nine parts", cm.exception.text)
        self.assertIn("00004-of-00009", cm.exception.text)

    def test_the_plan_with_own_files_downloads_nothing(self):
        _base, folder = self.folder()
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", "--model-path", str(folder), "--no-tui"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err + out)
        self.assertIn("DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash", out)
        self.assertIn("Nothing to download", out)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_launch_engine_first.py

"""`strata launch` settles the engine before it touches the model. With no usable engine and none to get it does NOT refuse (owner decision,
2026-10-18): it warns in plain words (the reason from `strata update`, and the next step), asks whether to download the model anyway (the
answer is yes unless the person says no; --yes skips the question), downloads, and ends with a message that names the engine problem and the
next step, exit code 0. Nothing is started without an engine."""

from __future__ import annotations

import io
import json
import os
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_cli.launch import settings as S
from strata_cli.launch.runner import LaunchError, NO_ENGINE_STEP, Runner, no_engine_final, no_engine_warning
from strata_control import engine_component as ec

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

WRONG_FAMILY = ec.arch_notice(("gfx1100", "gfx1101", "gfx1102"), ["gfx1201"])
USABLE = {"usable": True, "engine": {"version": "0.1.45", "backend": "hip"}, "notice": None}
UNUSABLE = {"usable": False, "engine": None, "notice": "No engine for this PC was found in /x: the component folder holds no engine package. "
                                                       "The app never downloads an engine while it starts or serves."}


class FakeProc:
    def __init__(self, events: list[dict], code: int = 0):
        self.stdout = iter(json.dumps(e) + "\n" for e in events)
        self._code = code

    def wait(self) -> int:
        return self._code


def update_events(status: str, note: str = "", code: int = 0) -> list[dict]:
    res = {"component": "engine", "status": status, "changed": status == "updated", "installed_before": None}
    if note:
        res["note"] = note
    return [{"event": "phase", "phase": "feed", "message": "Reading the signed update feed"},
            {"event": "result", "results": [res], "exit_code": code}]


def runner(spawned: list) -> Runner:
    r = Runner(S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="Q2_0", context=32768), catalog=mock.Mock(), emit=lambda e: None)
    r.check_cancel = lambda: None
    return r


class EngineBeforeModel(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_ensure(self, statuses: list[dict], events: list[dict], code: int = 0):
        """ensure_engine() with a fake `strata update` and a sequence of engine reports. Returns (spawn count, the error or None)."""
        spawns, err, _r = self.run_ensure_runner(statuses, events, code)
        return spawns, err

    def run_ensure_runner(self, statuses: list[dict], events: list[dict], code: int = 0, confirm=None, gb: float = 0.0,
                          assume_yes: bool = False):
        """ensure_engine() like run_ensure, returning (spawns, error or None, the runner with .events)."""
        spawns: list = []
        seen: list = []
        r = Runner(S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="Q2_0", context=32768), catalog=mock.Mock(), emit=seen.append,
                   confirm=confirm, assume_yes=assume_yes)
        r.events = seen
        r.check_cancel = lambda: None
        err = None
        with mock.patch.object(ec, "status", side_effect=statuses), \
                mock.patch.object(Runner, "_spawn", side_effect=lambda argv, **kw: spawns.append(argv) or FakeProc(events, code)), \
                mock.patch.object(Runner, "download_gb", return_value=gb):
            try:
                r.ensure_engine()
            except LaunchError as e:
                err = e
        return spawns, err, r

    def test_engine_present_runs_nothing(self):
        spawns, err = self.run_ensure([USABLE], [])
        self.assertIsNone(err)
        self.assertEqual(spawns, [])

    def test_no_engine_and_the_feed_has_one(self):
        spawns, err = self.run_ensure([UNUSABLE, USABLE], update_events("updated"))
        self.assertIsNone(err)
        self.assertEqual(len(spawns), 1)
        self.assertIn("update", spawns[0])

    def test_no_engine_and_the_feed_has_none_is_a_warning_not_a_refusal(self):
        note = "The feed has no engine package for this PC."
        spawns, err, r = self.run_ensure_runner([UNUSABLE, UNUSABLE], update_events("none-for-this-pc", note))
        self.assertIsNone(err)
        self.assertEqual(r.engine_problem, note)
        warning = no_engine_warning(note)
        self.assertEqual(r.events[-1].text, warning)
        self.assertEqual(r.events[-1].level, "warn")
        self.assertIn("Strata couldn't find an engine for this computer (The feed has no engine package for this PC)", warning)
        self.assertIn("The model will download, but it may not run until you install the right engine (next step:", warning)
        self.assertIn(NO_ENGINE_STEP, warning)
        self.assertNotIn("The app never downloads", warning)          # not the generic line

    def test_no_graphics_card_is_said_plainly_with_no_feed_address(self):
        report = dict(UNUSABLE, backend=None)
        spawns, err, r = self.run_ensure_runner([report, report], update_events("none-for-this-pc"))
        self.assertIsNone(err)
        self.assertTrue(r.engine_problem.startswith("no graphics card that Strata can use was found"))
        text = r.events[-1].text
        self.assertIn("Strata needs an NVIDIA or AMD graphics card", text)
        self.assertNotIn("--feed", text)
        self.assertNotIn("<address>", text)
        self.assertNotIn("--feed", no_engine_final(r.engine_problem))

    def test_the_other_no_engine_texts_do_not_ask_for_a_feed_address_either(self):
        self.assertNotIn("<address>", NO_ENGINE_STEP)
        self.assertNotIn("--feed", no_engine_warning("The feed has no engine package for this PC."))

    def test_wrong_family_names_the_plain_reason_in_the_warning(self):
        spawns, err, r = self.run_ensure_runner([UNUSABLE, UNUSABLE], update_events("none-for-this-pc", WRONG_FAMILY))
        self.assertIsNone(err)
        self.assertEqual(r.engine_problem, WRONG_FAMILY)
        text = r.events[-1].text
        self.assertIn("This build of Strata is for AMD RX 7000 cards. This computer has an AMD RX 9000 card (gfx1201).", text)
        self.assertIn("Ask for the RX 9000 build)", text)

    def test_installed_wrong_family_package_uses_its_plain_notice(self):
        report = {"usable": False, "engine": None, "notice": WRONG_FAMILY}
        spawns, err, r = self.run_ensure_runner([report, report], update_events("none-for-this-pc"))
        self.assertEqual(r.engine_problem, WRONG_FAMILY)

    def test_the_question_is_asked_with_the_warning_and_no_stops_before_the_download(self):
        asked = []
        spawns, err, r = self.run_ensure_runner([UNUSABLE, UNUSABLE], update_events("none-for-this-pc", "No engine here."),
                                                confirm=lambda title, text: asked.append((title, text)) or False, gb=66.0)
        self.assertEqual(len(asked), 1)
        self.assertIn("Strata couldn't find an engine for this computer (No engine here)", asked[0][1])
        self.assertIn("Download the model now (about 66 GB)?", asked[0][1])
        self.assertIsInstance(err, LaunchError)
        self.assertEqual(err.code, 130)
        self.assertIn("Nothing was downloaded", err.text)

    def test_yes_goes_on_and_the_yes_flag_asks_nothing(self):
        asked = []
        spawns, err, r = self.run_ensure_runner([UNUSABLE, UNUSABLE], update_events("none-for-this-pc", "No engine here."),
                                                confirm=lambda t, x: asked.append(1) or True, gb=66.0)
        self.assertIsNone(err)
        self.assertEqual(len(asked), 1)
        asked.clear()
        spawns, err, r = self.run_ensure_runner([UNUSABLE, UNUSABLE], update_events("none-for-this-pc", "No engine here."),
                                                confirm=lambda t, x: asked.append(1) or False, gb=66.0, assume_yes=True)
        self.assertIsNone(err)
        self.assertEqual(asked, [])
        self.assertEqual(r.engine_problem, "No engine here.")

    def test_nothing_to_download_asks_nothing(self):
        asked = []
        spawns, err, r = self.run_ensure_runner([UNUSABLE, UNUSABLE], update_events("none-for-this-pc", "No engine here."),
                                                confirm=lambda t, x: asked.append(1) or False, gb=0.0)
        self.assertIsNone(err)
        self.assertEqual(asked, [])

    def test_the_model_is_downloaded_and_nothing_is_started_without_an_engine(self):
        r = runner([])
        started = []
        with mock.patch.object(ec, "status", return_value=UNUSABLE), \
                mock.patch.object(Runner, "_spawn", return_value=FakeProc(update_events("none-for-this-pc", WRONG_FAMILY))), \
                mock.patch.object(Runner, "ensure_model", return_value=Path("/x/strata-q.json")) as model, \
                mock.patch.object(Runner, "build_config", return_value=Path("/x/launch.json")), \
                mock.patch.object(Runner, "ensure_profile"), mock.patch.object(Runner, "tune") as tune, \
                mock.patch.object(Runner, "start", side_effect=lambda: started.append(1)):
            result = r.run()
        model.assert_called_once()
        tune.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual(started, [])
        self.assertFalse(result.serving)
        self.assertEqual(result.urls, [])
        self.assertEqual(result.engine_problem, WRONG_FAMILY)
        self.assertEqual(result.final_text, no_engine_final(WRONG_FAMILY))
        self.assertIn("The model is ready, but Strata can't start it yet", result.final_text)
        self.assertIn("Ask for the RX 9000 build)", result.final_text)
        self.assertIn(NO_ENGINE_STEP, result.final_text)

    def test_the_setup_child_is_told_to_go_on_without_an_engine(self):
        r = runner([])
        r.engine_problem = "No engine here."
        seen = {}

        class Boom(Exception):
            pass

        def spawn(self, argv, env=None, cwd=None):
            seen["env"] = env
            raise Boom()

        cat = mock.MagicMock()
        cat.src = ROOT
        r._catalog = cat
        r.s = S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="Q2_0", context=32768)
        with mock.patch.object(Runner, "installed_state", return_value=(None, None)), mock.patch.object(Runner, "_spawn", spawn):
            with self.assertRaises(Boom):
                r.ensure_model()
        self.assertEqual(seen["env"].get("STRATA_ALLOW_NO_ENGINE"), "1")
        self.assertNotIn("STRATA_NEED_ENGINE", seen["env"])

    def test_a_failed_update_still_reports_the_old_message(self):
        spawns, err = self.run_ensure([UNUSABLE], [{"event": "error", "error": {"message": "cannot reach the feed"}}], code=6)
        self.assertEqual(err.code, 6)
        self.assertIn("Cannot reach the feed", err.text)      # (the reason is capitalised where it joins the sentence)


class SetupControlStep(unittest.TestCase):
    """setup.py in the app's mode (and under `strata launch`): the engine step comes before the download step."""

    def load_setup(self):
        """A private copy of setup.py read in the app's mode; the shared `setup` module (other tests) is left as it is."""
        import importlib.util
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("setup_control_copy", ROOT / "setup.py")
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_CONTROL_INSTALL": "1"}):
            spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        return module

    def step(self, exc: Exception, env: dict) -> tuple[object, str]:
        setup = self.load_setup()
        out = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, env), mock.patch.object(ec, "resolve", side_effect=exc), \
                mock.patch.object(setup, "get_llama_cpp", return_value=Path("llama")), \
                mock.patch.object(setup, "say", lambda *a, **k: out.write(" ".join(map(str, a)) + "\n")), \
                mock.patch.object(setup, "warn", lambda *a, **k: out.write("WARN " + " ".join(map(str, a)) + "\n")), \
                mock.patch.object(setup, "ok", lambda *a, **k: None):
            try:
                return setup.control_engine_step({}, "none"), out.getvalue()
            except SystemExit as e:
                return e, out.getvalue()

    def test_wrong_family_stops_before_the_download_for_launch(self):
        exc = ec.EngineMissing("nothing matched", Path("/c"), notice=WRONG_FAMILY)
        res, out = self.step(exc, {"STRATA_NEED_ENGINE": "1"})
        self.assertIsInstance(res, SystemExit)
        self.assertIn("Ask for the RX 9000 build.", out)
        self.assertIn("nothing was downloaded", out)

    def test_wrong_family_goes_on_with_a_warning_when_launch_said_go_on(self):
        exc = ec.EngineMissing("nothing matched", Path("/c"), notice=WRONG_FAMILY)
        res, out = self.step(exc, {"STRATA_ALLOW_NO_ENGINE": "1"})
        self.assertNotIsInstance(res, SystemExit)
        self.assertIn("no engine is installed for this PC yet", out)
        self.assertIn("The model is downloaded and prepared now", out)

    def test_no_engine_for_launch_still_stops_setup_when_run_on_its_own(self):
        res, out = self.step(ec.EngineMissing("the component folder holds no engine package", Path("/c")), {"STRATA_NEED_ENGINE": "1"})
        self.assertIsInstance(res, SystemExit)

    def test_the_app_with_a_wrong_family_engine_warns_and_still_downloads(self):
        """Owner decision 2026-10-18: the app downloads the model anyway and warns (its card says so)."""
        env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k != "STRATA_NEED_ENGINE"}
        exc = ec.EngineMissing("nothing matched", Path("/c"), notice=WRONG_FAMILY)
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, env, clear=True):
            res, out = self.step(exc, {})
        self.assertNotIsInstance(res, SystemExit)
        self.assertIn("Ask for the RX 9000 build.", out)
        self.assertIn("The model is downloaded and prepared now", out)

    def test_no_engine_stops_before_the_download_for_launch(self):
        res, out = self.step(ec.EngineMissing("the component folder holds no engine package", Path("/c")), {"STRATA_NEED_ENGINE": "1"})
        self.assertIsInstance(res, SystemExit)

    def test_the_app_without_an_engine_keeps_its_order(self):
        env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k != "STRATA_NEED_ENGINE"}
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, env, clear=True):
            res, out = self.step(ec.EngineMissing("the component folder holds no engine package", Path("/c")), {})
        self.assertNotIsInstance(res, SystemExit)
        self.assertIn("The model is downloaded and prepared now", out)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_launch_identity.py

"""An owned server attests the bytes and arguments it actually received."""

import json
import unittest
from unittest import mock

from serve.launch_identity import attestation
from strata_control import readiness


class LaunchIdentityTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_attestation_changes_with_source_args_and_key(self):
        key = bytes(range(32))
        cfg = b'{"api_key":"a private setting","model_name":"fake"}'
        args = ["--config", "/tmp/run.json", "--parallel", "4"]
        value = attestation(key, cfg, args)
        self.assertEqual(len(value), 64)
        self.assertEqual(value, attestation(key, cfg, args))
        self.assertNotEqual(value, attestation(key, cfg + b" ", args))
        self.assertNotEqual(value, attestation(key, cfg, [*args, "--batch-telemetry"]))
        self.assertNotEqual(value, attestation(bytes(reversed(key)), cfg, args))
        self.assertNotIn("private", value)

    def test_wrong_or_absent_server_attestation_rejects_readiness_before_generation(self):
        ready = {"bound_host": "127.0.0.1", "bound_port": 1234,
                 "model_id": "fake", "model_state": "ready"}
        cfg = json.dumps({"model_name": "fake"}).encode()
        for reported in (None, "0" * 64):
            with self.subTest(reported=reported), mock.patch.object(readiness, "_request") as request:
                request.return_value = {"instance": {"id": "one", "launch_attestation": reported},
                                        "model": {"id": "fake", "loaded": True}}
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(readiness.ReadinessError,
                                            "probe_launch_attestation_mismatch"):
                    readiness.verify(ready, cfg, expected_host="127.0.0.1",
                                     expected_instance="one", expected_attestation="f" * 64,
                                     timeout=1)
                self.assertEqual(request.call_count, 1)

    def test_attested_lazy_model_reports_unloaded_without_generation(self):
        ready = {"bound_host": "127.0.0.1", "bound_port": 1234,
                 "model_id": "fake", "model_state": "unloaded"}
        with mock.patch.object(readiness, "_request", return_value={
                "instance": {"id": "one", "launch_attestation": "f" * 64},
                "model": {"id": "fake", "loaded": False}}) as request:
            result = readiness.verify(ready, b'{"model_name":"fake"}',
                                      expected_host="127.0.0.1", expected_instance="one",
                                      expected_attestation="f" * 64, timeout=1)
        self.assertTrue(result["launch_attested"])
        self.assertFalse(result["generation_ready"])
        self.assertEqual(request.call_count, 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_launch_install.py

"""The one-line installers and the local test feed: syntax, the placeholder guard, the feed builder, and (POSIX) a real install.sh run against a feed."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from functools import partial
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "packaging"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
import make_local_feed as mlf  # noqa: E402


class Scripts(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_install_sh_syntax_and_guard(self):
        sh = shutil.which("sh") or shutil.which("bash")
        if not sh:
            self.skipTest("no sh")
        r = subprocess.run([sh, "-n", str(ROOT / "packaging" / "install.sh")], capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)
        text = (ROOT / "packaging" / "install.sh").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertNotIn("__FEED__", text)                                # no placeholder: the GitHub Releases address is the built-in default
        self.assertIn(":-" + mlf.RELEASE_FEED + "}", text)                # the default a local feed bakes its own address over
        self.assertIn("Installed. Run: ", text)
        self.assertNotIn("\r", text)

    def test_install_ps1_parses_and_guard(self):
        text = (ROOT / "packaging" / "install.ps1").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertNotIn("__FEED__", text)
        self.assertIn("else { '" + mlf.RELEASE_FEED + "' }", text)
        self.assertIn("Installed. Run: strata launch", text)
        ps = shutil.which("powershell") or shutil.which("pwsh")
        if not ps:
            self.skipTest("no PowerShell")
        cmd = ("$e=$null; $t=$null; [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile('%s',[ref]$t,[ref]$e) | Out-Null; "
               "if ($e.Count) { $e | ForEach-Object { $_.Message }; exit 1 } else { 'ok' }" % str(ROOT / "packaging" / "install.ps1").replace("'", "''"))
        r = subprocess.run([ps, "-NoProfile", "-Command", cmd], capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stdout + r.stderr)

    def test_the_built_in_address_is_the_default_feed(self):
        """install.sh / install.ps1 and `strata update` use the same GitHub Releases folder; STRATA_FEED stays an override."""
        from strata_cli import update_cmd
        self.assertEqual(update_cmd.DEFAULT_FEED, mlf.RELEASE_FEED + "/strata-feed.json")
        self.assertIn(":-" + mlf.RELEASE_FEED + "}", (ROOT / "packaging" / "install.sh").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertIn("$env:STRATA_FEED", (ROOT / "packaging" / "install.ps1").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


class Feed(unittest.TestCase):
    def make_bundle(self, work: Path) -> Path:
        """A tiny terminal archive that is a working `strata` (the repo's own source with the system Python)."""
        top = work / "bundle" / "strata-terminal-9.9.9-linux-x86_64"
        top.mkdir(parents=True)
        for name in ("strata.py", "strata_cli", "strata_control", "serve"):
            src = ROOT / name
            (shutil.copytree(src, top / name, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc")) if src.is_dir() else shutil.copy2(src, top / name))
        (top / "bin").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(ROOT / "bin" / "strata", top / "bin" / "strata")
        (top / "bin" / "strata").chmod(0o755)
        (top / "VERSION").write_text("9.9.9\n", encoding="utf-8")
        archive = work / "strata-terminal-9.9.9-linux-x86_64.tar.gz"
        with tarfile.open(archive, "w:gz") as tf:
            tf.add(top, arcname=top.name)
        return archive

    def test_make_local_feed_and_a_real_install(self):
        import make_local_feed
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            work = Path(tmp)
            archive = self.make_bundle(work)
            feed = work / "feed"
            rc = make_local_feed.main(["--out", str(feed), "--terminal", str(archive), "--keys", str(work / "keys"), "--url", "http://127.0.0.1:1"])
            self.assertEqual(rc, 0)
            for name in ("strata-feed.json", "strata-feed.json.sig", "install-manifest.txt", "install.sh", "install.ps1", "test-trust.json"):
                self.assertTrue((feed / name).is_file(), name)
            line = (feed / "install-manifest.txt").read_text().split()
            self.assertEqual(line[0], "linux-x86_64")
            self.assertEqual(line[1], "9.9.9")
            control = feed / line[2]
            self.assertEqual(hashlib.sha256(control.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), line[3])
            self.assertEqual(control.stat().st_size, int(line[4]))
            sh_text = (feed / "install.sh").read_text()
            self.assertIn("http://127.0.0.1:1", sh_text)
            self.assertNotIn(mlf.RELEASE_FEED, sh_text)                  # the GitHub address was replaced everywhere by the local one
            self.assertIn("Installed. Run:", (feed / "install.ps1").read_text())
            doc = json.loads((feed / "strata-feed.json").read_text())
            self.assertEqual(doc["control"]["packages"][0]["sha256"], line[3])
            self.assertNotIn("seed", (feed / "test-trust.json").read_text())      # only the public key is published
            if os.name == "nt" or not (shutil.which("sh") and shutil.which("curl") and shutil.which("tar")):
                self.skipTest("the real install.sh run needs POSIX sh, curl and tar")
            handler = partial(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, directory=str(feed))
            handler.log_message = lambda *a, **k: None                                   # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), handler)
            threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
            try:
                url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_address[1]}"
                home = work / "home"
                home.mkdir()
                env = {**os.environ, "HOME": str(home), "STRATA_FEED": url, "STRATA_INSTALL_TEST_TRUST": "1", "STRATA_PYTHON": sys.executable,
                       "PATH": os.environ["PATH"], "STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE": ""}
                for k in ("XDG_DATA_HOME", "STRATA_UPDATE_TRUSTED_KEYS"):
                    env.pop(k, None)
                r = subprocess.run(["sh", str(feed / "install.sh")], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=240)
                self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stdout + r.stderr)
                self.assertIn("Checksum ok", r.stdout)
                self.assertIn("Signature ok", r.stdout)
                self.assertIn("Installed. Run:", r.stdout)
                self.assertTrue((home / ".local" / "bin" / "strata").exists())
                v = subprocess.run([str(home / ".local" / "bin" / "strata"), "--version"], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=60)
                self.assertEqual(v.returncode, 0, v.stderr)
                # an archive with one top folder (a terminal archive, not the feed's control package) installs too
                data = archive.read_bytes()
                (feed / "top.tar.gz").write_bytes(data)
                (feed / "install-manifest.txt").write_text(f"linux-x86_64 9.9.9 top.tar.gz {hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()} {len(data)}" + chr(10))
                home3 = work / "home3"
                home3.mkdir()
                r = subprocess.run(["sh", str(feed / "install.sh")], capture_output=True, text=True, env={**env, "HOME": str(home3)}, timeout=240)
                self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stdout + r.stderr)
                self.assertTrue((home3 / ".local" / "share" / "strata" / "terminal" / "9.9.9" / "bin" / "strata").exists())
                (feed / "install-manifest.txt").write_text(" ".join(line) + chr(10))
                # a damaged download is refused and nothing is installed
                data = (feed / line[2]).read_bytes()
                (feed / line[2]).write_bytes(data[:-10] + b"x" * 10)
                home2 = work / "home2"
                home2.mkdir()
                r = subprocess.run(["sh", str(feed / "install.sh")], capture_output=True, text=True, env={**env, "HOME": str(home2)}, timeout=240)
                self.assertNotEqual(r.returncode, 0)
                self.assertIn("does not match the release's checksum", r.stderr)
                self.assertFalse((home2 / ".local" / "share" / "strata" / "terminal" / "9.9.9").exists())
            finally:
                server.shutdown()

    def test_the_release_path_writes_install_manifest_and_the_unchanged_install_sh_installs_from_it(self):
        """pack-control (flat names, as for GitHub assets) + build-feed, the files a release uploads; not make_local_feed."""
        import feed_tool
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            work = Path(tmp)
            archive = self.make_bundle(work)
            unpacked = work / "unpacked"
            unpacked.mkdir()
            folder = mlf.extract_terminal(archive, unpacked)
            release = work / "release"
            feed_tool.keygen(work / "keys")
            key = feed_tool._load_key(work / "keys" / "feed-key.json")
            entry = feed_tool.pack_control(folder, release / "control", version="9.9.9", platform="linux-x86_64", url_prefix="")
            shutil.move(str(release / "control" / entry["url"]), str(release / entry["url"]))        # GitHub assets are flat
            feed_tool.build_feed(release, key=key, sequence=1, control_dir=release / "control")
            line = (release / "install-manifest.txt").read_text().split()
            self.assertEqual(line, ["linux-x86_64", "9.9.9", entry["url"], entry["sha256"], str(entry["size"])])
            self.assertEqual(json.loads((release / "strata-feed.json").read_text())["control"]["packages"][0]["sha256"], entry["sha256"])
            bad = work / "bad"                           # a Windows pack that is not a zip cannot be installed by install.ps1: left out of the manifest
            feed_tool.build_feed(bad, key=key, sequence=1, control_dir=self._windows_tar_pack(folder, work))
            self.assertFalse((bad / "install-manifest.txt").exists())
            shutil.copy2(ROOT / "packaging" / "install.sh", release / "install.sh")                   # uploaded unchanged
            shutil.copy2(work / "keys" / "feed-key.pub.json", release / "test-trust.json")
            if os.name == "nt" or not (shutil.which("sh") and shutil.which("curl") and shutil.which("tar")):
                self.skipTest("the real install.sh run needs POSIX sh, curl and tar")
            handler = partial(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, directory=str(release))
            handler.log_message = lambda *a, **k: None                                   # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), handler)
            threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
            try:
                home = work / "home"
                home.mkdir()
                env = {**os.environ, "HOME": str(home), "STRATA_FEED": f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_address[1]}",
                       "STRATA_INSTALL_TEST_TRUST": "1", "STRATA_PYTHON": sys.executable, "STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE": ""}
                for k in ("XDG_DATA_HOME", "STRATA_UPDATE_TRUSTED_KEYS"):
                    env.pop(k, None)
                r = subprocess.run(["sh", str(release / "install.sh")], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=240)
                self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stdout + r.stderr)
                self.assertIn("Checksum ok", r.stdout)
                self.assertIn("Signature ok", r.stdout)
                self.assertTrue((home / ".local" / "bin" / "strata").exists())
            finally:
                server.shutdown()

    def _windows_tar_pack(self, folder: Path, work: Path) -> Path:
        import feed_tool
        out = work / "badcontrol"
        feed_tool.pack_control(folder, out, version="9.9.9", platform="windows-x86_64", fmt="tar.gz", url_prefix="")
        return out


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_launch_monitor.py

"""The monitor as `strata launch` opens it: the Connect view (key 7), its keys, the check, and the quit question."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import os
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_cli.launch import check
from strata_cli.launch.monitor_ext import LaunchMonitor
from tests.terminal.launch_support import Home, text_of
from tests.terminal.test_overview import Source, metrics

INFO = {"url": "http://127.0.0.1:8080", "urls": ["http://127.0.0.1:8080", "http://192.168.1.5:8080"], "key": "sk-strata-abcdefghijklmnop",
        "model": "qwen3.8-flash-next-iq3_xxs", "context": 32768, "profile": "launch-x", "name": "Demo"}


def flat(app) -> str:
    return " ".join(text_of(app).split())


class Connect(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_app(self, coro, info=None):
        async def go():
            app = LaunchMonitor(Source(metrics("idle")), None, info=info or dict(INFO), interval=30)
            async with app.run_test(size=(120, 40)) as pilot:
                await pilot.pause(0.5)
                return await coro(app, pilot)
        return asyncio.run(go())

    def test_overview_first_and_connect_on_7(self):
        async def case(app, pilot):
            t = text_of(app)
            self.assertIn("Model state", t)
            self.assertIn("7 Connect", t)
            self.assertIn("q asks: keep serving or stop", t)
            await pilot.press("7")
            await pilot.pause(0.2)
            t = text_of(app)
            self.assertIn("Connect an app", t)
            self.assertIn("URL http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1", t)
            self.assertIn("also reachable at http://192.168.1.5:8080/v1", t)
            self.assertIn("key sk-strata-", t)
            self.assertNotIn("abcdefghijklmnop", t)                      # masked until k
            for name in ("OpenCode", "Codex CLI", "Claude Code", "oh-my-pi", "pi (pi.dev)", "Hermes Agent", "OpenClaw", "DeepSeek Harness"):
                self.assertIn(name, t)
            self.assertIn("Vendor tested", t)
            self.assertIn("This server", t)
            self.assertIn("Not checked", t)
            self.assertIn("opencode 1.19.3", t)
            self.assertIn("OpenCode setup", t)
            self.assertIn("~/.config/opencode/opencode.json", t)
            await pilot.press("k")
            await pilot.pause(0.2)
            self.assertIn("abcdefghijklmnop", flat(app).replace("▒", ""))
            await pilot.press("7")
            await pilot.pause(0.2)
            self.assertIn("Connect an app", text_of(app))                 # 7 is a view like the others: pressing it again stays
            await pilot.press("escape")
            await pilot.pause(0.2)
            self.assertIn("Model state", text_of(app))                    # Esc goes back to the view you came from
        self.run_app(case)

    def test_views_one_to_six_leave_connect(self):
        async def case(app, pilot):
            await pilot.press("7")
            await pilot.press("2")
            await pilot.pause(0.2)
            self.assertNotIn("Connect an app", text_of(app))
        self.run_app(case)

    def test_choosing_an_app_shows_its_limits_in_words(self):
        async def case(app, pilot):
            await pilot.press("7")
            for _ in range(5):
                await pilot.press("down")
            await pilot.pause(0.2)
            t = flat(app)
            self.assertIn("Hermes Agent setup", t)
            self.assertIn("provider: lmstudio", t)
            self.assertIn("WARNING: Hermes is built for 64K or more", t)
            await pilot.press("down")
            await pilot.pause(0.2)
            self.assertIn("Node 24.16", flat(app))
            await pilot.press("down")
            await pilot.pause(0.2)
            self.assertIn("built into the Strata app", flat(app))
            await pilot.press("up", "up", "up", "up", "up", "up", "up")
            await pilot.pause(0.2)
            self.assertIn("OpenCode setup", flat(app))
        self.run_app(case)

    def test_check_reports_each_step_and_the_row(self):
        results = [check.Check("prompt", True, "It answered: 'pong'.", 1.0), check.Check("tool call", False, "The model answered in words and did not call the tool.", 2.0)]
        with mock.patch.object(check, "run_checks", return_value=results):
            async def case(app, pilot):
                await pilot.press("7", "h")
                for _ in range(30):
                    await pilot.pause(0.1)
                    if "Failed (1/2)" in text_of(app):
                        break
                t = flat(app)
                self.assertIn("Failed (1/2)", t)
                self.assertIn("prompt: It answered: 'pong'.", t)
                self.assertIn("did not call the tool", t)
            self.run_app(case)

    def test_write_asks_then_writes_with_a_backup(self):
        with Home() as home:
            target = Path(os.environ["HOME"]) / ".config" / "opencode" / "opencode.json"
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
            target.write_text(json.dumps({"theme": "dark"}))

            async def case(app, pilot):
                await pilot.press("7", "w")
                await pilot.pause(0.2)
                self.assertIn("Write OpenCode's settings?", flat(app))
                self.assertIn("copied to a backup first", flat(app))
                await pilot.press("enter")
                await pilot.pause(0.3)
            self.run_app(case)
            data = json.loads(target.read_text())
            self.assertEqual(data["theme"], "dark")
            self.assertIn("strata", data["provider"])
            self.assertEqual(len(list(target.parent.glob("opencode.json.strata-bak-*"))), 1)

    def test_write_can_be_declined(self):
        with Home():

            async def case(app, pilot):
                await pilot.press("7", "w", "down", "enter")
                await pilot.pause(0.2)
            self.run_app(case)
            self.assertFalse(target.exists())

    def test_copy_does_not_crash(self):
        async def case(app, pilot):
            await pilot.press("7", "c")
            await pilot.pause(0.2)
            self.assertTrue("Copied" in flat(app) or "does not allow copying" in flat(app))
        self.run_app(case)


class Quit(unittest.TestCase):
    def go(self, keys):
        holder = {}

        async def go():
            app = LaunchMonitor(Source(metrics("idle")), None, info=dict(INFO), interval=30)
            async with app.run_test(size=(120, 40)) as pilot:
                await pilot.pause(0.4)
                for k in keys:
                    await pilot.press(k)
                    await pilot.pause(0.2)
                holder["app"] = app
                holder["running"] = app.is_running
                holder["stop"] = app.stop_requested
        asyncio.run(go())
        return holder

    def test_q_asks_with_three_choices(self):
        async def go():
            app = LaunchMonitor(Source(metrics("idle")), None, info=dict(INFO), interval=30)
            async with app.run_test(size=(120, 40)) as pilot:
                await pilot.pause(0.4)
                await pilot.press("q")
                await pilot.pause(0.2)
                t = flat(app)
                self.assertIn("Leave the monitor?", t)
                self.assertIn("Keep serving in the background", t)
                self.assertIn("Stop serving and free the memory", t)
                self.assertIn("Stay in the monitor", t)
                await pilot.press("down", "down", "enter")                # Stay
                await pilot.pause(0.2)
                self.assertTrue(app.is_running)
                self.assertFalse(app.stop_requested)
        asyncio.run(go())

    def test_keep_serving_leaves_without_stopping(self):
        h = self.go(["q", "enter"])
        self.assertFalse(h["stop"])

    def test_stop_asks_the_caller_to_stop(self):
        h = self.go(["q", "down", "enter"])
        self.assertTrue(h["stop"])

    def test_escape_cancels_the_question(self):
        async def go():
            app = LaunchMonitor(Source(metrics("idle")), None, info=dict(INFO), interval=30)
            async with app.run_test(size=(120, 40)) as pilot:
                await pilot.pause(0.4)
                await pilot.press("q", "escape")
                await pilot.pause(0.2)
                self.assertTrue(app.is_running)
        asyncio.run(go())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_launch_old_gpus.py

"""`strata launch` on a computer whose only NVIDIA cards are Pascal / Volta (P100, V100): setup.py admits them (the experimental CUDA 12 engine);
the screens must not say "no usable graphics card found", and several of them must offer the Cards step."""

from __future__ import annotations

import unittest
from unittest import mock

from strata_cli.launch.catalog import Catalog
from tests.terminal.launch_support import HW_12, Home, catalog


def v100(index: int, vram: float = 16.0) -> dict:
    return {"index": index, "name": "Tesla V100-SXM2-16GB", "arch": "70", "vram_gb": vram, "vendor": "nvidia", "usable": False,
            "problem": "not supported - older than the RTX 20 series (compute capability 7.0)"}


RTX = {"index": 0, "name": "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060", "arch": "86", "vram_gb": 12.0, "vendor": "nvidia", "usable": True, "problem": None}


class OldNvidiaCards(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_only_volta_cards_are_admitted(self):
        got = Catalog._admit_old_nvidia([v100(0), v100(1)])
        self.assertEqual([g["usable"] for g in got], [True, True])
        self.assertTrue(all(g["problem"] is None for g in got))

    def test_a_newer_card_keeps_the_old_one_out(self):
        got = Catalog._admit_old_nvidia([{**RTX}, v100(1)])
        self.assertEqual([g["usable"] for g in got], [True, False])

    def test_an_amd_card_keeps_the_old_one_out(self):
        amd = {"index": 0, "name": "AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT", "vendor": "amd", "usable": True, "vram_gb": 16.0}
        got = Catalog._admit_old_nvidia([amd, v100(0)])
        self.assertEqual([g["usable"] for g in got], [True, False])

    def test_other_cards_are_not_touched(self):
        gtx = {"index": 0, "name": "GeForce GT 1030", "arch": "61", "vram_gb": 2.0, "vendor": "nvidia", "usable": False}
        self.assertEqual(Catalog._admit_old_nvidia([gtx])[0]["usable"], True)    # Pascal is admitted too (setup does the same)
        kepler = {"index": 0, "name": "Tesla K80", "arch": "37", "vram_gb": 12.0, "vendor": "nvidia", "usable": False}
        self.assertEqual(Catalog._admit_old_nvidia([kepler])[0]["usable"], False)
        self.assertEqual(Catalog._admit_old_nvidia([]), [])

    def test_hardware_and_computer_show_the_cards(self):
        with Home():
            cat = catalog()
            cat._hardware_override = None
            hw = {**HW_12, "gpus": [v100(0), v100(1)]}
            with mock.patch.object(type(cat.strata), "hardware", return_value=hw):
                comp = cat.computer(fresh=True)
            self.assertEqual(len(comp.usable_gpus), 2)
            self.assertIn("x2", comp.line())
            self.assertNotIn("no usable graphics card", comp.line())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_launch_tui.py

"""The `strata launch` screens, driven with Textual's pilot: every screen, its keys and what it writes into the settings."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import os
import threading
import time
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_cli.launch import access, settings as S, store
from strata_cli.launch.app import Ctx, LaunchApp, run_monitor
from strata_cli.launch.runner import Cancelled, Event, LaunchError, Result
from strata_cli.launch.widgets import Glyphs
from tests.terminal.launch_support import HW_12, HW_24, HW_2X16, Home, catalog, text_of

SIZE = (110, 34)


def flat(app) -> str:
    return " ".join(text_of(app).split())


def make_ctx(hw=None, settings=None):
    cat = catalog(hw or HW_12)
    comp = cat.computer()
    return Ctx(catalog=cat, computer=comp, rows=cat.rows(comp.raw), settings=settings or S.LaunchSettings(), glyphs=Glyphs(True))


class FakeRunner:
    """Stands in for the real Runner: emits the same events, installs nothing, starts nothing."""

    instances: list = []
    behaviour = "ok"
    hold = 0
    download = 0.0

    def __init__(self, s, *, catalog=None, emit=None, cancel=None, feed=None, **kw):
        self.s, self.emit_cb, self.cancel, self.feed = s, emit, cancel, feed
        FakeRunner.instances.append(self)

    def download_gb(self):
        return FakeRunner.download

    def run(self, start=True):
        e = self.emit_cb
        e(Event("engine", "Engine 0.1.45 (cuda) is installed.", 100))
        e(Event("model", "Downloading 12.0 of 75.8 GB", 15.8))
        if FakeRunner.behaviour == "wait":
            while not self.cancel.is_set():
                time.sleep(0.02)
            raise Cancelled()
        if FakeRunner.behaviour == "fail":
            raise LaunchError("The model could not be installed. Not enough disk space.", "Free some space and run it again.", 6)
        if getattr(FakeRunner, "hold", 0):
            time.sleep(FakeRunner.hold)
        e(Event("model", "Model is ready.", 100))
        e(Event("config", "Settings are saved.", 100))
        if self.s.tune != "skip":
            e(Event("tune", "Tuning", 40.0, data={"round": (2, 5), "minutes_left": 12,
                                                  "speeds": [{"label": "Default settings", "decode_tok_s": 83.0},
                                                             {"label": "Longer prompt chunks", "decode_tok_s": 85.1}]}))
            if getattr(FakeRunner, "hold", 0):
                time.sleep(FakeRunner.hold)
            e(Event("tune", "Done: answers are about 3% faster with the tuned settings.", 100))
        e(Event("start", "The model is loaded and answering.", 100))
        urls = [f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.s.port}"]
        return Result("launch-x", urls, self.s.api_key, "faster", [], "/nonexistent.json")


async def press(pilot, *keys, pause=0.12):
    for k in keys:
        await pilot.press(k)
        await pilot.pause(pause)


async def typed(pilot, text):
    for ch in text:
        await pilot.press(ch)
    await pilot.pause(0.1)


class Base(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.home = Home().__enter__()
        self.addCleanup(self.home.__exit__, None, None, None)
        FakeRunner.instances.clear()
        FakeRunner.behaviour = "ok"
        FakeRunner.download = 0.0
        p = mock.patch("strata_cli.launch.app.Runner", FakeRunner)
        p.start()
        self.addCleanup(p.stop)
        p = mock.patch.object(access, "lan_ips", return_value=["192.168.1.5"])
        p.start()
        self.addCleanup(p.stop)

    def run_app(self, coro, ctx=None, auto_run=False):
        ctx = ctx or make_ctx()
        app = LaunchApp(ctx, auto_run=auto_run)

        async def go():
            async with app.run_test(size=SIZE) as pilot:
                await pilot.pause(0.2)
                return await coro(app, pilot, ctx)

        return asyncio.run(go())

        FakeRunner.download = 75.8

            await press(pilot, "enter")

            self.assertIn("Download about 76 GB?", t)
            self.assertIn("not on this computer yet", t)
            self.assertIn("Download and start", t)

            self.assertIsNone(app.result)

class ModelStep(Base):

            self.assertIn("(recommended)", line)

            self.assertIn("too big (can still try)", t)          # NVFP4: a warning, not a block
            big = next(l for l in t.splitlines() if "UD-Q5_K_XL" in l)

class FolderStep(Base):

        async def case(app, pilot, ctx):
            old = self.home.base / "old-data"
            (old / "models" / "Q2_0").mkdir(parents=True)

            with mock.patch.object(type(ctx.catalog), "data_dir", return_value=old):

            self.assertIn("stay there and keep working", t)
            self.assertNotIn("are moved into this folder", t)
        self.run_app(case)

    def test_keeping_the_default_stores_nothing(self):

            self.assertIsNone(ctx.settings.data_dir)
        self.run_app(case)

    def test_not_enough_space_is_a_warning_you_can_go_past(self):
