                                           "LOCALAPPDATA": str(base / "local"), "XDG_DATA_HOME": str(base / "localshare"),
                                           "STRATA_COMPONENTS_DIR": ""})
        env.start()
        self.addCleanup(env.stop)
        os.environ.pop("STRATA_INSTALL_DIR", None)

        exe_name = "strata.exe" if os.name == "nt" else "strata"
        (self.old / "engine").mkdir()
        (self.old / "engine" / exe_name).write_bytes(b"engine")
        (self.old / "engine" / exe_name).chmod(0o700)
        (self.old / "engine" / "BUILD.json").write_text(json.dumps({"version": "0.1.45", "source": "prebuilt"}))
        (self.old / "setup.py").write_text("# the installer of the old folder\n")
        (self.old / ".venv").mkdir()
        (self.old / ".venv" / "pyvenv.cfg").write_text("home = elsewhere\n")
        tok = self.data / "packs" / "tokenizer"
        tok.mkdir(parents=True)
        for name in ("vocab.json", "merges.txt", "token_type.json"):
            (tok / name).write_bytes(b"placeholder")
        self.models = []
        for tag, ctx in (("q2_0", 32768), ("iq3_xxs", 65536)):
            folder = self.data / "models" / tag.upper()
            folder.mkdir(parents=True)
            gguf = folder / f"Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-{tag}-00001-of-00001.gguf"
            gguf.write_bytes(gguf_fixture())
            pack = self.data / "packs" / tag
            pack.mkdir()
            (pack / "experts.bin").write_bytes(b"experts")
            mtp = self.data / "mtp" / tag
            mtp.mkdir(parents=True)
            cfg = self.old / f"strata-{tag}.json"
            cfg.write_text(json.dumps({
                "exe": str(self.old / "engine" / exe_name), "tokenizer": str(tok), "cwd": str(self.old),
                "args": ["--native", str(gguf), "--pack", str(pack), "--mtp", str(mtp), "--max-context", str(ctx)],
                "backend": "cuda", "model_name": tag.upper(), "port": 8080, "log": str(self.old / f"{tag}.log")}),
                encoding="utf-8")
            (self.old / f"strata-{tag}.shared-settings.json").write_text("{}")
            (self.old / (f"run-{tag}.bat" if os.name == "nt" else f"run-{tag}.sh")).write_text("run\n")
            self.models.append(cfg)
        (self.terminal / "VERSION").write_text("0.1.45\n")
        # never the real settings file or model folders: everything below lives in the temporary directory
        self.assertTrue(str(setup.settings_path()).startswith(str(base)), setup.settings_path())
        setup.settings_path().parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        setup.settings_path().write_text(json.dumps({"data_dir": str(self.data), "installs": [str(self.old)]}))
        self.before = snapshot(base)
        self.base = base
        root = mock.patch.object(models, "ROOT", self.terminal)
        root.start()
        self.addCleanup(root.stop)

    def cli(self, *args):
        out = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):
            code = main([*args, "--output", "json"])
        return code, json.loads(out.getvalue())

    def assertNothingChanged(self):
        after = snapshot(self.base)
        created = sorted(set(after) - set(self.before))
        self.assertEqual([c for c in created if not c.startswith("profiles")], [])
        for rel, was in self.before.items():
            self.assertEqual(after.get(rel), was, rel)

    def test_the_terminal_finds_the_old_install_through_settings_json(self):
        self.assertEqual(models.resolve_install(), (self.old.resolve(), "remembered"))
        code, listed = self.cli("models", "list", "--installed")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(listed["install_dir"], str(self.old.resolve()))
        self.assertEqual(listed["install_dir_source"], "remembered")
        self.assertEqual([m["id"] for m in listed["models"]], ["iq3_xxs", "q2_0"])
        self.assertEqual({m["component_status"] for m in listed["models"]}, {"present"})
        self.assertEqual({m["context_tokens"] for m in listed["models"]}, {32768, 65536})
        code, inspected = self.cli("models", "inspect", "q2_0")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertTrue(inspected["components"]["ok"])
        self.assertNothingChanged()

    def test_a_profile_and_serve_plan_use_the_old_engine_and_models_where_they_are(self):
        found = models.install_dir()
        config = found / "strata-q2_0.json"
        profiles.create("migrated", str(config))
        code, planned = self.cli("serve", "--profile", "migrated", "--plan")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        plan = planned["plan"]
        self.assertEqual(Path(plan["source_config"]), config.resolve())
        self.assertEqual(Path(plan["engine_exe"]).parent, self.old / "engine")
        argv = plan["engine_argv"]
        native = argv[argv.index("--native") + 1]
        self.assertEqual(Path(native).parent.parent.parent, self.data)           # Strata-data/models/Q2_0/<gguf>
        self.assertNothingChanged()

    def test_a_folder_with_its_own_configs_and_an_explicit_dir_win_over_the_remembered_install(self):
        (self.terminal / "strata-local.json").write_bytes((self.old / "strata-q2_0.json").read_bytes())
        self.assertEqual(models.resolve_install(), (self.terminal, "here"))
        (self.terminal / "strata-local.json").unlink()
        self.assertEqual(models.resolve_install(str(self.old)), (self.old.resolve(), "explicit"))
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_INSTALL_DIR": str(self.old)}):
            self.assertEqual(models.resolve_install()[1], "explicit")

    def test_nothing_remembered_means_this_folder_and_no_error(self):
        # nothing found anywhere: the folder a new model would be installed into (the desktop app's, which the Terminal shares), no error
        from strata_control import discovery
        default = (discovery.app_install_dir(), "default")
        setup.settings_path().unlink()
        self.assertEqual(models.resolve_install(), default)
        setup.settings_path().write_text("not json")
        self.assertEqual(models.resolve_install(), default)
        setup.settings_path().write_text(json.dumps({"installs": ["relative/path", 7, str(self.base / "gone")]}))
        self.assertEqual(models.resolve_install(), default)
        self.assertEqual(models.list_installed()["models"], [])

    def test_the_settings_path_is_the_one_setup_writes(self):
        self.assertEqual(models.settings_path(), setup.settings_path())

    def test_a_plain_start_from_the_old_folder_uses_the_remembered_data_folder_and_moves_nothing(self):
        started = []
        out = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch.object(setup, "ROOT", self.old), mock.patch.object(sys, "argv", ["setup.py", "--yes"]), \
                mock.patch.object(setup, "gpus", lambda: []), \
                mock.patch.object(setup.subprocess, "call", lambda cmd, *a, **k: started.append(cmd) or 0), \
                contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):
            self.assertEqual(setup.main(), 0, out.getvalue())
        self.assertEqual(len(started), 1)
        self.assertIn("server.py", " ".join(map(str, started[0])))
        self.assertEqual(setup.data_folder_in_place(), (self.data, []))
        # starting touches the most recently used config (its mtime) and nothing else
        after = snapshot(self.base)
        changed = [rel for rel in self.before if after.get(rel) != self.before[rel]]
        self.assertEqual([c for c in changed if not c.startswith("Strata/strata-")], [])
        self.assertEqual(sorted(set(after) - set(self.before)), [])

    def test_setup_from_a_new_copy_reuses_the_data_folder_and_moves_no_model_file(self):
        """The explicit setup path (which does gather files) finds the model files already in the data folder."""
        new_copy = self.base / "Strata-new"
        new_copy.mkdir()
        (new_copy / "setup.py").write_text("# a new copy\n")
        models_before = {k: v for k, v in self.before.items() if k.startswith("Strata-data/")}
        with mock.patch.object(setup, "ROOT", new_copy), contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            data, elsewhere = setup.data_folder(None)
        self.assertTrue(data.samefile(self.data))
        self.assertEqual(elsewhere, [])
        after = snapshot(self.base)
        self.assertEqual({k: v for k, v in after.items() if k.startswith("Strata-data/")}, models_before)
        self.assertEqual({k: v for k, v in after.items() if k.startswith("Strata/")},
                         {k: v for k, v in self.before.items() if k.startswith("Strata/")})
        saved = json.loads(setup.settings_path().read_text())
        self.assertTrue(Path(saved["data_dir"]).samefile(self.data))
        self.assertIn(str(self.old), saved["installs"])                    # the old install stays remembered


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_mixed_vendors.py

"""Owner question 2026-10-18: a PC with an RTX 5060 Ti (16 GB) and an AMD R9700 (32 GB). Every Strata engine drives the cards of ONE make
(CUDA: NVIDIA, HIP: AMD), so one model is never split across makes, only the cards the engine can drive are offered, a bigger card of the
other make is mentioned in one plain line, and two models at once (one per make) is said to be unsupported."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_cli.launch import cmd, settings as S
from strata_cli.launch.runner import cards_for_launch
from strata_cli.launch.screens import flow_for
from strata_control import gpu_fit as G
from tests.terminal.launch_support import HW_12, Home, catalog

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

NV_5060TI = {"index": 0, "name": "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti", "vram_gb": 16.0, "usable": True, "vendor": "nvidia", "arch": "120"}
AMD_R9700 = {"index": 0, "name": "AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700", "vram_gb": 32.0, "usable": True, "vendor": "amd", "arch": "gfx1201"}
NV_2080TI = {"index": 0, "name": "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 Ti", "vram_gb": 11.0, "usable": True, "vendor": "nvidia", "arch": "75"}
NV_5070 = {"index": 1, "name": "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070", "vram_gb": 12.0, "usable": True, "vendor": "nvidia", "arch": "120"}
NV_5070_ALONE = {**NV_5070, "index": 0}

NOTE_AMD = "This computer also has an AMD AI PRO R9700 (32 GB). The AMD build of Strata can use it — it fits bigger models."


class GpuFitMixes(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_nvidia_engine_offers_only_the_nvidia_card_and_says_the_amd_one_is_bigger(self):
        r = G.options(44.0, 62.0, [NV_5060TI, AMD_R9700], "nvidia")
        self.assertEqual([o["key"] for o in r["options"]], ["single"])
        self.assertEqual(r["options"][0]["label"], "RTX 5060 Ti + RAM")
        self.assertNotIn("R9700", r["options"][0]["label"])
        self.assertEqual(r["other_vendor_note"], NOTE_AMD)
        self.assertEqual(r["vendor"], "nvidia")
        self.assertEqual(len(r["ignored"]), 1)
        self.assertIn("AMD build of Strata", r["ignored"][0]["why_ignored"] + "AMD build of Strata")
        self.assertIn("needs the AMD build", r["ignored"][0]["why_ignored"])

    def test_amd_engine_offers_only_the_r9700_and_has_no_note_because_the_nvidia_card_is_smaller(self):
        r = G.options(44.0, 62.0, [NV_5060TI, AMD_R9700], "amd")
        self.assertEqual([o["key"] for o in r["options"]], ["single"])
        self.assertIn("R9700", r["options"][0]["label"])
        self.assertIsNone(r["other_vendor_note"])

    def test_never_a_cross_vendor_split_even_with_two_cards_that_could_share(self):
        cards = [NV_5060TI, {**AMD_R9700, "index": 1}, {**NV_5060TI, "index": 2}]
        for vendor in ("nvidia", "amd"):
            for o in G.options(70.0, 32.0, cards, vendor)["options"]:
                makes = {next(c["vendor"] for c in cards if c["index"] == i and c["vendor"] == vendor) for i in o["cards"]}
                self.assertEqual(makes, {vendor}, o["key"])

    def test_without_an_engine_named_the_default_is_nvidia_first(self):
        self.assertEqual(G.pick_vendor([NV_5060TI, AMD_R9700]), "nvidia")
        self.assertEqual(G.pick_vendor([AMD_R9700]), "amd")
        self.assertEqual(G.pick_vendor([NV_5060TI, AMD_R9700], "hip"), "amd")          # the installed engine decides
        self.assertEqual(G.pick_vendor([NV_5060TI, AMD_R9700], "cuda"), "nvidia")

    def test_a_card_that_names_no_make_is_left_alone(self):
        r = G.options(44.0, 62.0, [{"index": 0, "name": "A", "vram_gb": 16, "usable": True}, {"index": 1, "name": "B", "vram_gb": 16, "usable": True}])
        self.assertEqual([o["key"] for o in r["options"]][:2], ["single", "split"])
        self.assertIsNone(r["other_vendor_note"])

    def test_2080ti_and_5070_are_one_make_so_the_split_is_offered_with_the_newer_card_leading_by_memory(self):
        r = G.options(44.0, 32.0, [NV_2080TI, NV_5070])
        self.assertEqual([o["key"] for o in r["options"]][:2], ["single", "split"])
        self.assertEqual(r["options"][0]["cards"], [1])               # the 12 GB RTX 5070 is the larger card
        self.assertEqual(r["options"][1]["cards"], [1, 0])
        self.assertIn("RTX 5070 + RTX 2080 Ti + RAM (layer split)", r["options"][1]["label"])
        self.assertIsNone(r["other_vendor_note"])
        self.assertEqual(r["ignored"], [])

    def test_2080ti_5070_with_an_amd_card_beside_still_never_mixes(self):
        r = G.options(44.0, 32.0, [NV_2080TI, NV_5070, {**AMD_R9700, "index": 2}], "nvidia")
        for o in r["options"]:
            self.assertNotIn(2, o["cards"])
        self.assertEqual(r["other_vendor_note"], NOTE_AMD)

    def test_the_two_models_sentence_is_plain(self):
        self.assertIn("not supported yet", G.SECOND_MODEL_SENTENCE)
        self.assertIn("one model at a time", G.SECOND_MODEL_SENTENCE)


class LaunchMix(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.home = Home().__enter__()
        self.addCleanup(self.home.__exit__, None, None, None)
        self.hw = {**HW_12, "gpus": [NV_5060TI, AMD_R9700]}
        p = mock.patch("strata_cli.launch.catalog.Catalog.installed_backend", return_value=None)
        p.start()
        self.addCleanup(p.stop)

    def test_the_computer_counts_only_the_cards_the_engine_drives(self):
        comp = catalog(self.hw).computer()
        self.assertEqual(comp.engine_vendor, "nvidia")
        self.assertEqual([g["name"] for g in comp.usable_gpus], ["NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti"])
        self.assertEqual(comp.main_vram_gb, 16.0)                      # not the R9700's 32
        self.assertEqual(comp.other_vendor_note, NOTE_AMD)
        self.assertEqual(len(flow_for(type("C", (), {"computer": comp}))), 9)       # no Cards step: one card the engine can drive

    def test_with_the_amd_engine_installed_the_r9700_counts_and_the_note_goes(self):
        with mock.patch("strata_cli.launch.catalog.Catalog.installed_backend", return_value="hip"):
            comp = catalog(self.hw).computer()
        self.assertEqual(comp.engine_vendor, "amd")
        self.assertEqual(comp.main_vram_gb, 32.0)
        self.assertIsNone(comp.other_vendor_note)

    def test_the_wizard_says_it_in_one_line(self):
        s, notes = cmd.apply_defaults(S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="IQ3_XXS"), catalog(self.hw))
        self.assertIn(NOTE_AMD, [n.line() for n in notes] + [n.text for n in notes])

    def test_naming_the_amd_card_for_the_nvidia_engine_is_refused_in_plain_words(self):
        # NVIDIA has cards 0 and 1 here; AMD's card is number 2 in this mock
        hw = {**HW_12, "gpus": [NV_5060TI, {**NV_5060TI, "index": 1}, {**AMD_R9700, "index": 2}]}
        s, notes = cmd.apply_defaults(S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="IQ3_XXS", gpus=[0, 2]), catalog(hw))
        errors = [n for n in notes if n.level == "error"]
        self.assertEqual(len(errors), 1)
        text = errors[0].text
        self.assertIn("Card 2 is an AMD card", text)
        self.assertIn("cannot be split across NVIDIA and AMD cards", text)
        self.assertIn("one model at a time", text)
        self.assertIn("install the AMD build of Strata", errors[0].next)

    def test_cards_for_launch_never_returns_the_other_make(self):
        hw = {**HW_12, "ram_gb": 32.0, "gpus": [NV_5060TI, {**NV_5060TI, "index": 1}, {**AMD_R9700, "index": 2}]}
        cat = catalog(hw)
        got = cards_for_launch(S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="IQ3_XXS"), cat)
        self.assertTrue(all(i in (0, 1) for i in (got or [])))

    def test_the_app_catalog_uses_the_engine_make(self):
        cat = catalog(self.hw)
        mcp = cat.mcp
        hw = dict(self.hw)
        mcp.Strata._engine_vendor(hw)
        self.assertEqual(hw["engine_vendor"], "nvidia")
        self.assertEqual(hw["gpu_note"], NOTE_AMD)
        usable = cat.strata.engine_gpus(hw)
        self.assertEqual([g["name"] for g in usable], ["NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti"])
        self.assertEqual(cat.strata.gpu_options({"ram_gb": 20, "arena_gb": 30, "download_gb": 30}, 62.0, hw),
                         {"options": [], "recommended": None, "other_vendor_note": NOTE_AMD})
        two = {**hw, "gpus": [NV_5060TI, {**NV_5060TI, "index": 1}, AMD_R9700]}
        res = cat.strata.gpu_options({"ram_gb": 20, "arena_gb": 30, "download_gb": 30}, 62.0, two)
        self.assertEqual({tuple(o["cards"]) for o in res["options"]}, {(0,), (0, 1), (1,)})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_models.py

"""Read-only local inventory of setup-written model run configs."""

import io
import json
import os
import struct
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_cli.cli import main


def gguf_fixture(*, architecture="qwen4exp", tokenizer=True, expert_type=42,
                 overlapping_tensors=False) -> bytes:
    def string(value):
        raw = value.encode()
        return struct.pack("<Q", len(raw)) + raw

    pairs = [("general.architecture", 8, string(architecture))]
    if tokenizer:
        pairs += [("tokenizer.ggml.model", 8, string("gpt2")),
                  ("tokenizer.ggml.tokens", 9, struct.pack("<IQ", 8, 1) + string("a")),
                  ("tokenizer.ggml.merges", 9, struct.pack("<IQ", 8, 1) + string("a b"))]
    header = (b"GGUF" + struct.pack("<IQQ", 3, 2 if overlapping_tensors else 1, len(pairs)) +
              b"".join(string(key) + struct.pack("<I", kind) + value for key, kind, value in pairs))
    elements, payload_bytes = (64, 18) if expert_type == 42 else (256, 144)
    header += string("blk.0.ffn_gate_exps.weight") + struct.pack(
        "<IQIQ", 1, elements, expert_type, 0)
    if overlapping_tensors:
        header += string("blk.1.ffn_gate_exps.weight") + struct.pack(
            "<IQIQ", 1, elements, expert_type, 0)
    return header + b"\x00" * (-len(header) % 32) + b"\x00" * payload_bytes


class ModelInventoryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        engine = self.root / "engine"
        engine.write_bytes(b"fake engine")
        engine.chmod(0o700)
        tokenizer = self.root / "tokenizer"
        tokenizer.mkdir()
        for name in ("vocab.json", "merges.txt", "token_type.json"):
            (tokenizer / name).write_bytes(b"placeholder")
        pack = self.root / "pack"
        pack.mkdir()
        self.config = self.root / "strata-demo.json"
        self.config.write_text(json.dumps({
            "exe": str(engine), "tokenizer": str(tokenizer),
            "args": ["--pack", str(pack), "--max-context", "32768"],
            "backend": "cuda", "model_name": "Demo model", "api_key": "do-not-disclose",
        }), encoding="utf-8")

    def command(self, *args):
        output = io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(output):
            code = main(["models", *args, "--install-dir", str(self.root), "--output", "json"])
        raw = output.getvalue()
        self.assertNotIn("do-not-disclose", raw)
        return code, json.loads(raw)

    def test_list_and_inspect_are_read_only_and_do_not_claim_compatibility(self):
        (self.root / "strata-demo.shared-settings.json").write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
        before = {path.name: (path.read_bytes(), path.stat().st_mtime_ns)
                  for path in self.root.iterdir() if path.is_file()}
        code, listed = self.command("list", "--installed")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(listed["model_count"], 1)
        item = listed["models"][0]
        self.assertEqual(item["id"], "demo")
        self.assertEqual(item["component_status"], "present")
        self.assertEqual(item["context_tokens"], 32768)
        self.assertEqual(item["execution_compatibility"], "unverified")
        self.assertNotIn("args", item)
        code, inspected = self.command("inspect", "demo")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(inspected["model"]["source_sha256"], item["source_sha256"])
        self.assertTrue(inspected["components"]["ok"])
        after = {path.name: (path.read_bytes(), path.stat().st_mtime_ns)
                 for path in self.root.iterdir() if path.is_file()}
        self.assertEqual(after, before)

    def test_missing_and_malformed_components_are_distinguished(self):
        (self.root / "tokenizer" / "vocab.json").unlink()
        code, listed = self.command("list", "--installed")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(listed["models"][0]["component_status"], "missing_or_invalid")
        self.assertIn("COMPONENT_MISSING", listed["models"][0]["issue_codes"])
        # #3478: the list names what is missing, so the app can say which files instead of only "some files are missing"
        self.assertEqual([(m["part"], m["file"], m["status"]) for m in listed["models"][0]["missing"]],
                         [("tokenizer/vocab.json", "vocab.json", "missing")])
        (self.root / "strata-broken.json").write_text("{broken", encoding="utf-8")
        code, listed = self.command("list", "--installed")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(listed["model_count"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(listed["models"][0]["component_status"], "invalid")
        code, error = self.command("inspect", "broken")
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        self.assertFalse(error["ok"])

    def test_invalid_ids_and_symlink_configs_are_rejected(self):
        code, error = self.command("inspect", "../demo")
        self.assertEqual(code, 2)
        self.assertFalse(error["ok"])
        if os.name == "posix":
            (self.root / "strata-link.json").symlink_to(self.config)
            code, listed = self.command("list", "--installed")
            self.assertEqual(code, 0)
            self.assertEqual(next(row for row in listed["models"] if row["id"] == "link")
                             ["component_status"], "invalid")
            code, error = self.command("inspect", "link")
            self.assertEqual(code, 5)
            self.assertFalse(error["ok"])

    def test_install_dir_must_be_absolute(self):
        output = io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(output):
            code = main(["models", "list", "--installed", "--install-dir", "relative", "--output", "json"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        self.assertFalse(json.loads(output.getvalue())["ok"])

    def test_served_inventory_uses_read_only_telemetry_connection(self):
        snapshot = {"model": {"id": "served-demo", "loaded": True},
                    "instance": {"id": "instance-123"}}
        output = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch("strata_cli.client.Endpoint.snapshot", return_value=snapshot) as fetch, \
                redirect_stdout(output):
            code = main(["models", "list", "--served", "--url", "http://127.0.0.1:8095",
                         "--output", "json"])
        result = json.loads(output.getvalue())
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(result["scope"], "served_current_instance")
        self.assertEqual(result["models"], [{"id": "served-demo", "loaded": True,
                                              "instance_id": "instance-123",
                                              "execution_compatibility": "unverified"}])
        fetch.assert_called_once_with()
        output = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch("strata_cli.client.Endpoint.snapshot", return_value={
                "model": {"id": None, "loaded": None}, "instance": {"id": "i"}}), \
                redirect_stdout(output):
            code = main(["models", "list", "--served", "--url", "http://127.0.0.1:8095",
                         "--output", "json"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(output.getvalue())["models"], [])

    def test_served_inventory_reaches_telemetry_with_read_only_key(self):
        seen = []

        class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            def do_GET(self):
                seen.append((self.path, self.headers.get("Authorization")))
                if self.path != "/v1/telemetry" or self.headers.get("Authorization") != "Bearer read-only":
                    self.send_error(403)
                    return
                body = json.dumps({"schema_version": 1,
                                   "instance": {"id": "mock-1", "state": "ready"},
                                   "model": {"id": "example", "loaded": False}}).encode()
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(body)

            def log_message(self, *args):
                pass

        server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        thread.start()
        try:
            output = io.StringIO()
            with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_TELEMETRY_KEY": "read-only"}), \
                    redirect_stdout(output):
                code = main(["models", "list", "--served", "--url",
                             f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}",
                             "--credential-env", "STRATA_TELEMETRY_KEY", "--output", "json"])
            self.assertEqual(code, 0)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(output.getvalue())["models"][0]["loaded"], False)
            self.assertEqual(seen, [("/v1/telemetry", "Bearer read-only")])
            self.assertNotIn("read-only", output.getvalue())
        finally:
            server.shutdown()
            server.server_close()
            thread.join(timeout=2)

    def test_connection_flags_require_served_scope(self):
        output = io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(output):
            code = main(["models", "list", "--installed", "--url", "https://example.invalid",
                         "--output", "json"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 2)
        self.assertFalse(json.loads(output.getvalue())["ok"])

    def test_import_plan_inspects_shards_without_adopting_or_copying(self):
        source = self.root / "source"
        source.mkdir()
        first = source / "Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-Q2_0-00001-of-00002.gguf"
        second = source / "Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-Q2_0-00002-of-00002.gguf"
        for path in (first, second):
            path.write_bytes(gguf_fixture(tokenizer=path == first))
        (source / "mmproj-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-BF16.gguf").write_bytes(b"auxiliary")
        before = {path.name: (path.read_bytes(), path.stat().st_mtime_ns)
                  for path in source.iterdir()}
        output = io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(output):
            code = main(["models", "import", str(source), "--plan", "--output", "json"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        plan = json.loads(output.getvalue())["plan"]
        self.assertEqual(plan["file_count"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(plan["file_set_status"], "plausible")
        self.assertFalse(plan["would_write"])
        self.assertEqual(plan["execution_compatibility"], "unverified")
        self.assertEqual(plan["metadata"]["architecture"], "qwen4exp")
        self.assertEqual(plan["metadata"]["tokenizer_model"], "gpt2")
        self.assertTrue(plan["metadata"]["payload_extent_valid"])
        self.assertEqual(plan["metadata"]["tensor_types"], {"Q2_0": 1})
        self.assertEqual(plan["observed_expert_types"], ["Q2_0"])
        self.assertEqual(plan["candidate_selection"]["family"], "qwen")
        self.assertEqual(plan["candidate_selection"]["model"], "Q2_0")
        self.assertEqual(len(plan["ignored_auxiliary_files"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual({path.name: (path.read_bytes(), path.stat().st_mtime_ns)
                          for path in source.iterdir()}, before)
        second.unlink()
        output = io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(output):
            code = main(["models", "import", str(first), "--plan", "--output", "json"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        self.assertFalse(json.loads(output.getvalue())["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(output.getvalue())["plan"]["file_set_status"],
                         "invalid_or_incomplete")

    def test_import_plan_rejects_symlink_and_wrong_magic(self):
        wrong = self.root / "bad.gguf"
        wrong.write_bytes(b"NOTG\x03\x00\x00\x00")
        output = io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(output):
            code = main(["models", "import", str(wrong), "--plan", "--output", "json"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        self.assertFalse(json.loads(output.getvalue())["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(output.getvalue())["plan"]["file_set_status"],
                         "invalid_or_incomplete")
        if os.name == "posix":
            link = self.root / "link.gguf"
            link.symlink_to(wrong)
            output = io.StringIO()
            with redirect_stdout(output):
                code = main(["models", "import", str(link), "--plan", "--output", "json"])
            self.assertEqual(code, 5)
            self.assertFalse(json.loads(output.getvalue())["ok"])

    def test_import_plan_rejects_other_architecture_and_bounded_metadata(self):
        candidate = self.root / "other.gguf"
        candidate.write_bytes(gguf_fixture(architecture="llama"))
        output = io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(output):
            code = main(["models", "import", str(candidate), "--plan", "--output", "json"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        self.assertIn("unsupported_or_missing_architecture", json.loads(output.getvalue())["plan"]["issues"])
        # A malicious metadata count must fail before allocating or reading tensor data.
        candidate.write_bytes(b"GGUF" + struct.pack("<IQQ", 3, 1, 1_000_000_000))
        output = io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(output):
            code = main(["models", "import", str(candidate), "--plan", "--output", "json"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(output.getvalue())["plan"]["file_set_status"], "invalid_or_incomplete")
        key = b"tokenizer.ggml.tokens"
        candidate.write_bytes(b"GGUF" + struct.pack("<IQQ", 3, 1, 1) +
                              struct.pack("<Q", len(key)) + key +
                              struct.pack("<IIQ", 9, 8, 500_001))
        output = io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(output):
            code = main(["models", "import", str(candidate), "--plan", "--output", "json"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        self.assertIn("inspection limit", json.dumps(json.loads(output.getvalue())["plan"]["issues"]))

    def test_import_plan_rejects_truncated_tensor_payload(self):
        candidate = self.root / "Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-Q2_0-00001-of-00002.gguf"
        candidate.write_bytes(gguf_fixture()[:-4])
        other = self.root / "Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-Q2_0-00002-of-00002.gguf"
        other.write_bytes(gguf_fixture(tokenizer=False))
        output = io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(output):
            code = main(["models", "import", str(candidate), "--plan", "--output", "json"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        self.assertIn("payload is shorter", json.dumps(json.loads(output.getvalue())["plan"]["issues"]))

    def test_import_plan_rejects_unexpected_expert_quantization(self):
        source = self.root / "quant"
        source.mkdir()
        names = [source / f"Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-Q2_0-{i:05d}-of-00002.gguf" for i in (1, 2)]
        names[0].write_bytes(gguf_fixture(expert_type=12))  # Q4_K under a Q2_0 filename
        names[1].write_bytes(gguf_fixture(tokenizer=False))
        output = io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(output):
            code = main(["models", "import", str(source), "--plan", "--output", "json"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        self.assertIn("missing_or_unexpected_expert_quantization",
                      json.loads(output.getvalue())["plan"]["issues"])

    def test_import_plan_rejects_overlapping_tensor_ranges(self):
        source = self.root / "overlap"
        source.mkdir()
        first = source / "Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-Q2_0-00001-of-00002.gguf"
        second = source / "Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-Q2_0-00002-of-00002.gguf"
        first.write_bytes(gguf_fixture(overlapping_tensors=True))
        second.write_bytes(gguf_fixture(tokenizer=False))
        output = io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(output):
            code = main(["models", "import", str(source), "--plan", "--output", "json"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        self.assertIn("byte ranges overlap", json.dumps(json.loads(output.getvalue())["plan"]["issues"]))

    def test_import_plan_does_not_advertise_setup_unsupported_variant(self):
        source = self.root / "unsupported"
        source.mkdir()
        for index in (1, 2):
            (source / f"Swift-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-Q2_0-{index:05d}-of-00002.gguf").write_bytes(
                gguf_fixture(tokenizer=index == 1))
        output = io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(output):
            code = main(["models", "import", str(source), "--plan", "--output", "json"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        plan = json.loads(output.getvalue())["plan"]
        self.assertIsNone(plan["candidate_selection"])
        self.assertIn("unrecognized_or_unsupported_model_variant", plan["issues"])


## tests/terminal/test_models_move.py

"""Moving the models to another folder (strata models move): same drive, another drive, stop, a failed check, disk full, resume."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_control import models_move as mm


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


class MoveCase(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="strata-move-")
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.base = Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.old = self.base / "old"
        self.new = self.base / "new"
        self.files = {
            "models/gyro-s/a.gguf": b"A" * 300_000,
            "models/gyro-s/b.gguf": b"B" * 200_000,
            "packs/gyro-s/dense.bin": b"D" * 100_000,
            "models/coder/c.gguf": b"C" * 150_000,
            "mtp/rt/experts.bin": b"M" * 50_000,
        }
        for rel, data in self.files.items():
            f = self.old / rel
            f.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            f.write_bytes(data)
        # a finished download carries the pinned checksum in its mark
        (self.old / "models/gyro-s/a.gguf.done").write_text(f"done sha256 {sha(self.files['models/gyro-s/a.gguf'])}\n")
        (self.old / "notes.txt").write_text("not a model file")        # Strata moves its own folders only
        self.install = self.base / "install"
        self.install.mkdir()
        self.config = self.install / "strata-gyro-s.json"
        self.config.write_text(json.dumps({"args": ["--native", str(self.old / "models/gyro-s/a.gguf"), "--pack", str(self.old / "packs/gyro-s")],
                                           "mtp": str(self.old / "mtp/rt")}))
        self.total = sum(len(v) for v in self.files.values())

    def tree(self, root: Path) -> set[str]:
        return {p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and p.name != mm.STATE_FILE}

    def copy_mode(self):
        """Another drive: the files are copied, whatever this machine's volumes are."""
        return mock.patch.object(mm, "same_drive", return_value=False)

    def break_after(self, n):
        """A copy that works n times, then fails: a move cut off part way."""
        real, calls = mm._copy_verified, [0]

        def flaky(*args, **kw):
            calls[0] += 1
            if calls[0] > n:
                raise mm.MoveError("io", "cut off")
            return real(*args, **kw)
        return mock.patch.object(mm, "_copy_verified", side_effect=flaky)

    def cut_off(self, n=1):
        with self.copy_mode(), self.break_after(n):
            with self.assertRaises(mm.MoveError):
                self.run_move()

    def run_move(self, **kw):
        events = []
        summary = mm.move(self.old, self.new, on_progress=events.append, configs=[self.config], **kw)
        return summary, events


class PlanTests(MoveCase):
    def test_plan_numbers_and_choices(self):
        with self.copy_mode():
            p = mm.plan(self.old, self.new, free=lambda _p: 10**9)
        self.assertTrue(p["ok"])
        self.assertGreaterEqual(p["models_bytes"], self.total)
        self.assertGreater(p["needed_bytes"], p["models_bytes"])                    # the 5 % margin
        self.assertTrue(p["choices"]["move"]["possible"])
        self.assertEqual({m["name"] for m in p["models"]}, {"gyro-s", "coder", "mtp"})

    def test_not_enough_room_switches_move_off(self):
        with self.copy_mode():
            p = mm.plan(self.old, self.new, free=lambda _p: 1000)
        self.assertTrue(p["ok"])
        self.assertFalse(p["choices"]["move"]["possible"])
        self.assertIn("free", p["choices"]["move"]["reason"])
        self.assertTrue(p["choices"]["keep"]["possible"] and p["choices"]["empty"]["possible"])

    def test_same_drive_needs_no_room(self):
        p = mm.plan(self.old, self.new, free=lambda _p: 0)
        self.assertTrue(p["same_drive"])
        self.assertTrue(p["choices"]["move"]["possible"])

    def test_inside_and_same_are_refused(self):
        self.assertEqual(mm.plan(self.old, self.old / "sub")["issue"]["code"], "inside")
        self.assertEqual(mm.plan(self.old / "sub", self.old)["issue"]["code"], "inside")
        self.assertEqual(mm.plan(self.old, self.old)["issue"]["code"], "same")

    def test_a_folder_that_cannot_be_written_is_refused(self):
        with mock.patch.object(mm, "_write_test", return_value="EPERM: operation not permitted, mkdir 'x'"):
            p = mm.plan(self.old, self.new)
        self.assertEqual(p["issue"]["code"], "not_writable")
        self.assertIn("EPERM", p["issue"]["details"])

    def test_nothing_is_changed_by_a_plan(self):
        before = self.tree(self.old)
        mm.plan(self.old, self.new)
        self.assertEqual(self.tree(self.old), before)


class MoveTests(MoveCase):
    def check_whole(self):
        self.assertEqual({k for k in self.tree(self.new) if not k.endswith(".done")}, set(self.files))
        for rel, data in self.files.items():
            self.assertEqual((self.new / rel).read_bytes(), data)
        self.assertEqual(self.tree(self.old), {"notes.txt"})                       # only what is not Strata's own is left
        cfg = json.loads(self.config.read_text())
        self.assertEqual(Path(cfg["args"][1]), self.new / "models/gyro-s/a.gguf")
        self.assertEqual(Path(cfg["mtp"]), self.new / "mtp/rt")
        self.assertFalse((self.new / mm.STATE_FILE).exists())

    def test_same_drive_is_a_rename(self):
        with mock.patch.object(shutil, "copyfileobj", side_effect=AssertionError("copied")), mock.patch.object(mm, "_copy_verified", side_effect=AssertionError("copied")):
            summary, _events = self.run_move()
        self.assertTrue(summary["done"] and summary["same_drive"])
        self.check_whole()

    def test_another_drive_copies_checks_and_removes(self):
        with self.copy_mode():
            summary, events = self.run_move()
        self.assertTrue(summary["done"] and not summary["same_drive"])
        self.assertEqual(summary["files_moved"], len(self.files) + 1)               # + the .done mark
        self.check_whole()
        self.assertTrue(events and events[-1]["done"] <= self.total + 100)
        self.assertEqual(events[0]["event"], "progress")

    def test_stop_keeps_what_moved_and_removes_the_partial_copy(self):
        calls = {"n": 0}

        def stop():
            calls["n"] += 1
            return calls["n"] > 6                                                   # a few chunks into the second file or so
        with self.copy_mode():
            summary, _events = self.run_move(cancelled=stop)
        self.assertTrue(summary["stopped"] and not summary["done"])
        self.assertEqual([p for p in self.new.rglob("*.part")], [])
        # every file is in exactly one place, nothing is lost
        for rel, data in self.files.items():
            places = [r for r in (self.old, self.new) if (r / rel).exists()]
            self.assertEqual(len(places), 1, rel)
            self.assertEqual((places[0] / rel).read_bytes(), data)
        self.assertTrue(summary["remaining"])
        # a model that moved whole now points at the new folder; one that did not stays where it is
        cfg = json.loads(self.config.read_text())
        for value in (cfg["args"][1], cfg["args"][3], cfg["mtp"]):
            self.assertTrue(Path(value).exists(), value)

    def test_stop_before_anything_leaves_the_old_folder_as_it_was(self):
        with self.copy_mode():
            summary, _ = self.run_move(cancelled=lambda: True)
        self.assertTrue(summary["stopped"])
        self.assertEqual(summary["files_moved"], 0)
        self.assertEqual({k for k in self.tree(self.old) if not k.endswith(".done")}, set(self.files) | {"notes.txt"})
        self.assertFalse((self.new / mm.STATE_FILE).exists())

    def test_a_copy_that_does_not_match_is_never_trusted(self):
        real = mm._sha256_of
        calls = {"n": 0}

        def lies(path, stop, tick=None):
            calls["n"] += 1
            return "0" * 64 if str(path).endswith(".part") and calls["n"] == 1 else real(path, stop, tick)
        with self.copy_mode(), mock.patch.object(mm, "_sha256_of", side_effect=lies):
            with self.assertRaises(mm.MoveError) as caught:
                self.run_move()
        self.assertEqual(caught.exception.code, "verify")
        self.assertEqual(list(self.new.rglob("*.part")), [])
        self.assertEqual({k for k in self.tree(self.old) if not k.endswith(".done")}, set(self.files) | {"notes.txt"})   # the original is untouched

    def test_a_file_that_differs_from_its_pinned_checksum_is_not_moved(self):
        (self.old / "models/gyro-s/a.gguf.done").write_text("done sha256 " + "1" * 64)
        with self.copy_mode():
            with self.assertRaises(mm.MoveError) as caught:
                self.run_move()
        self.assertEqual(caught.exception.code, "verify")
        self.assertTrue((self.old / "models/gyro-s/a.gguf").exists())
        self.assertFalse((self.new / "models/gyro-s/a.gguf").exists())

    def test_disk_full_stops_at_once_and_loses_nothing(self):
        real = mm._copy_verified
        seen = {"n": 0}

        def full(src, dst, size, stop, tick):
            seen["n"] += 1
            if seen["n"] == 3:
                part = dst.with_name(dst.name + ".part")
                part.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                part.write_bytes(b"half")
                try:
                    raise OSError(28, "No space left on device", str(dst))
                except OSError as e:
                    mm._quiet_remove(part)
                    raise mm.MoveError("disk_full", "The drive ran out of space.", str(e)) from e
            return real(src, dst, size, stop, tick)
        with self.copy_mode(), mock.patch.object(mm, "_copy_verified", side_effect=full):
            with self.assertRaises(mm.MoveError) as caught:
                self.run_move()
        self.assertEqual(caught.exception.code, "disk_full")
        self.assertEqual(list(self.new.rglob("*.part")), [])
        for rel, data in self.files.items():
            places = [r for r in (self.old, self.new) if (r / rel).exists()]
            self.assertEqual(len(places), 1, rel)
        self.assertIn("remaining", caught.exception.summary)

    def test_a_real_disk_full_error_is_named(self):
        with mock.patch("builtins.open", side_effect=OSError(28, "No space left on device", "x")):
            with self.assertRaises(mm.MoveError) as caught:
                mm._copy_verified(self.old / "models/coder/c.gguf", self.new / "x.gguf", 1, lambda: False, lambda n: None)
        self.assertEqual(caught.exception.code, "disk_full")

    def test_a_crash_leaves_a_part_and_the_next_run_finishes(self):
        stale = self.new / "models/gyro-s/a.gguf.part"
        stale.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        stale.write_bytes(b"cut off")
        # a file that was copied and renamed, but whose original was not removed yet
        done = self.new / "models/coder/c.gguf"
        done.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        done.write_bytes(self.files["models/coder/c.gguf"])
        with self.copy_mode():
            summary, _ = self.run_move()
        self.assertTrue(summary["done"])
        self.check_whole()

    def test_an_interrupted_move_is_remembered(self):
        self.cut_off(1)
        st = mm.interrupted(self.old)                                               # the old folder is still the data folder: it holds the pointer
        self.assertEqual(st["to"], str(self.new))
        self.assertEqual(st["state"], "failed")
        self.assertEqual(mm.interrupted(self.base / "elsewhere"), None)
        mm._write_state(self.old, state="running", pid=os.getpid() + 7, token=None, **{"from": str(self.old), "to": str(self.new)})
        self.assertEqual(mm.interrupted(self.old)["state"], "running")

    def test_a_move_that_is_running_now_is_not_interrupted(self):
        from strata_control import procs
        mm._write_state(self.old, state="running", pid=os.getpid() + 7, token="t", **{"from": str(self.old), "to": str(self.new)})
        with mock.patch.object(procs, "start_token", return_value="t"):
            self.assertIsNone(mm.interrupted(self.old))
        with mock.patch.object(procs, "start_token", return_value=None):
            self.assertIsNotNone(mm.interrupted(self.old))

    def test_nothing_moved_leaves_nothing_to_ask_about(self):
        self.cut_off(0)
        self.assertIsNone(mm.interrupted(self.old))
        self.assertFalse((self.new / mm.STATE_FILE).exists())

    def test_finish_resumes_the_move(self):
        self.cut_off(1)
        st = mm.interrupted(self.old)
        with self.copy_mode():
            summary = mm.move(Path(st["from"]), Path(st["to"]), configs=[self.config])
        self.assertTrue(summary["done"])
        self.check_whole()
        self.assertIsNone(mm.interrupted(self.old))
        self.assertFalse((self.old / mm.STATE_FILE).exists() or (self.new / mm.STATE_FILE).exists())

    def test_leave_keeps_the_old_folder_complete(self):
        self.cut_off(1)
        (self.new / "models/stray.gguf.part").write_bytes(b"x")                      # not listed by the move, but a .part of ours is
        (self.new / "models/gyro-s").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (self.new / "models/gyro-s/a.gguf.part").write_bytes(b"cut")
        theirs = self.new / "models/own/mine.gguf"                                    # a file of the person's, not part of the move
        theirs.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        theirs.write_bytes(b"mine")
        st = mm.interrupted(self.old)
        with self.copy_mode():
            result = mm.leave(Path(st["from"]), Path(st["to"]), configs=[self.config])
        self.assertGreaterEqual(result["restored"] + result["removed"], 1)
        for rel, data in self.files.items():
            self.assertEqual((self.old / rel).read_bytes(), data, rel)
            self.assertFalse((self.new / rel).exists(), rel)
        self.assertEqual(list(self.new.rglob("*.part")), [(self.new / "models/stray.gguf.part")])
        self.assertTrue(theirs.exists())
        self.assertIsNone(mm.interrupted(self.old))
        self.assertFalse((self.new / mm.STATE_FILE).exists())
        cfg = json.loads(self.config.read_text())
        self.assertTrue(all(str(self.new) not in str(v) for v in cfg.values()))
        self.assertIn(str(self.old / "models/gyro-s/a.gguf"), cfg["args"])

    def test_leave_after_a_crash_removes_the_duplicate(self):
        self.cut_off(1)
        dup = self.new / "models/coder/c.gguf"                                       # copied and renamed, original not yet removed
        dup.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        dup.write_bytes(self.files["models/coder/c.gguf"])
        mm.leave(self.old, self.new)
        self.assertFalse(dup.exists())
        self.assertTrue((self.old / "models/coder/c.gguf").exists())

    def test_configs_are_rewritten_only_for_files_that_are_there(self):
        self.config.write_text(json.dumps({"args": ["--native", str(self.old / "models/gone.gguf")]}))
        with self.copy_mode():
            self.run_move()
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(self.config.read_text())["args"][1], str(self.old / "models/gone.gguf"))

    @unittest.skipUnless(os.environ.get("STRATA_TEST_OTHER_VOLUME"), "set STRATA_TEST_OTHER_VOLUME to a folder on another volume (e.g. a subst or USB drive)")
    def test_a_real_second_volume(self):
        other = Path(os.environ["STRATA_TEST_OTHER_VOLUME"]) / f"strata-move-{os.getpid()}"
        self.addCleanup(shutil.rmtree, other, True)
        self.new = other
        summary, _ = self.run_move()
        self.assertTrue(summary["done"])
        self.check_whole()


class CommandLineTests(MoveCase):
    def test_json_plan_and_run(self):
        from strata_cli import cli
        import contextlib
        import io
        out = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out), self.copy_mode():
            code = cli.main(["models", "move", str(self.new), "--from", str(self.old), "--plan", "--output", "json"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertTrue(json.loads(out.getvalue())["plan"]["choices"]["move"]["possible"])
        out = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out), self.copy_mode():
            code = cli.main(["models", "move", str(self.new), "--from", str(self.old), "--install-dir", str(self.install), "--output", "jsonl"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, out.getvalue())
        lines = [json.loads(line) for line in out.getvalue().splitlines() if line.startswith("{")]
        self.assertEqual(lines[-1]["event"], "result")
        self.assertTrue(lines[-1]["done"])
        self.assertTrue((self.new / "models/coder/c.gguf").exists())

    def run_cli(self, *argv):
        from strata_cli import cli
        from strata_control import discovery
        import contextlib
        import io
        out = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out), self.copy_mode(), mock.patch.object(discovery, "data_dir", return_value=(self.old, "settings")):
            code = cli.main(["models", "move", *argv])
        return code, out.getvalue()

    def test_status_resume_and_leave(self):
        code, text = self.run_cli("--status", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual((code, json.loads(text)["interrupted"]), (0, None))
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli("--resume", "--output", "json")[0], 5)
        self.cut_off(1)
        code, text = self.run_cli("--status", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(text)["interrupted"]["to"], str(self.new))
        self.assertIn("--resume", self.run_cli("--status")[1])
        code, text = self.run_cli("--leave", "--install-dir", str(self.install), "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, text)
        self.assertTrue((self.old / "models/coder/c.gguf").exists())
        self.cut_off(1)
        code, text = self.run_cli("--resume", "--install-dir", str(self.install), "--output", "jsonl")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, text)
        self.assertTrue([json.loads(l) for l in text.splitlines() if l.startswith("{")][-1]["done"])
        self.assertTrue((self.new / "models/coder/c.gguf").exists())
        self.assertFalse((self.old / "models/coder/c.gguf").exists())

    def test_launch_says_it_in_one_line(self):
        from strata_cli.launch import cmd
        from strata_control import discovery
        import contextlib
        import io
        self.cut_off(1)
        with mock.patch.object(discovery, "data_dir", return_value=(self.old, "settings")):
            out = io.StringIO()
            with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):
                cmd._interrupted_move_notice()
            self.assertEqual(len(out.getvalue().strip().splitlines()), 1)
            self.assertIn("models move --resume", out.getvalue())
            mm.leave(self.old, self.new)
            out = io.StringIO()
            with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):
                cmd._interrupted_move_notice()
            self.assertEqual(out.getvalue(), "")

    def test_the_cancel_file_stops_the_run(self):
        from strata_cli import cli
        import contextlib
        import io
        cancel = self.base / "cancel"
        cancel.write_text("x")
        out = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out), self.copy_mode():
            code = cli.main(["models", "move", str(self.new), "--from", str(self.old), "--cancel-file", str(cancel), "--output", "json"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 6)
        self.assertTrue(json.loads(out.getvalue().splitlines()[-1])["stopped"])
        self.assertTrue((self.old / "models/coder/c.gguf").exists())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_monitor_bundle.py

"""Packaged client smoke test without site packages, engine files or model weights."""

import io
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
import zipfile
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_cli.cli import main as source_main


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
BUILDER = ROOT / "packaging/monitor_bundle.py"
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("strata_monitor_bundle_builder", BUILDER)
assert SPEC is not None and SPEC.loader is not None
BUILDER_MODULE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
SPEC.loader.exec_module(BUILDER_MODULE)
build = BUILDER_MODULE.build
install = BUILDER_MODULE.install
uninstall = BUILDER_MODULE.uninstall
update = BUILDER_MODULE.update
rollback = BUILDER_MODULE.rollback
commit = BUILDER_MODULE.commit
verify = BUILDER_MODULE.verify


class MonitorBundleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @staticmethod
    def _candidate(source: Path, destination: Path) -> Path:
        destination.parent.mkdir()
        destination.write_bytes(source.read_bytes())
        with zipfile.ZipFile(destination, "a") as archive:
            archive.comment = b"candidate client revision"
        report = json.loads(source.with_name(source.name + ".manifest.json").read_text())
        report["bundle"] = destination.name
        report["sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(destination.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        destination.with_name(destination.name + ".manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(report))
        verify(destination)
        return destination

    def test_crlf_license_checkout_still_verifies(self):
        """A Windows checkout (autocrlf) ships LICENSE with CRLF; the bundle must still verify."""
        real_copy = BUILDER_MODULE.shutil.copyfile

        def crlf_license(src, dst, *args, **kwargs):
            if Path(src).name != "LICENSE":
                return real_copy(src, dst, *args, **kwargs)
            text = Path(src).read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n").replace(b"\n", b"\r\n")
            Path(dst).write_bytes(text)
            return dst

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            bundle = Path(directory) / "monitor.pyz"
            with mock.patch.object(BUILDER_MODULE.shutil, "copyfile", crlf_license):
                build(bundle)
            with zipfile.ZipFile(bundle) as archive:
                self.assertIn(b"MIT License\r\n", archive.read("LICENSE"))
            self.assertEqual(verify(bundle)["schema_version"], 6)

    def test_update_rollback_and_commit_keep_one_verified_previous_copy(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            first = root / "first" / "monitor.pyz"
            first.parent.mkdir()
            old = build(first)
            candidate = self._candidate(first, root / "second" / "next-monitor.pyz")
            next_sha = verify(candidate)["sha256"]
            target = root / "optional-monitor"
            install(first, target, if_candidate_sha256=old["sha256"])
            preview_run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(BUILDER), "update", str(candidate),
                                          "--target", str(target), "--plan"],
                                         capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
            preview = json.loads(preview_run.stdout)
            self.assertEqual((preview["current_sha256"], preview["candidate_sha256"]),
                             (old["sha256"], next_sha))
            self.assertTrue(preview["would_update"])
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "preview again"):
                update(candidate, target, if_current_sha256=old["sha256"],
                       if_candidate_sha256="0" * 64)
            self.assertFalse((root / "optional-monitor.previous").exists())
            changed = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(BUILDER), "update", str(candidate),
                                      "--target", str(target), "--if-current-sha256", old["sha256"],
                                      "--if-candidate-sha256", next_sha],
                                     capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
            result = json.loads(changed.stdout)
            self.assertTrue(result["updated"])
            previous = root / "optional-monitor.previous"
            self.assertEqual(verify(target / "next-monitor.pyz")["sha256"], next_sha)
            self.assertEqual(verify(previous / "monitor.pyz")["sha256"], old["sha256"])
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(FileExistsError, "previous"):
                update(candidate, target, plan=True)
            preview_run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(BUILDER), "rollback", "--target",
                                          str(target), "--plan"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
            preview = json.loads(preview_run.stdout)
            self.assertTrue(preview["would_rollback"])
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "preview again"):
                rollback(target, if_active_sha256=old["sha256"], if_rollback_sha256=old["sha256"])
            original = os.rename
            calls = 0

            def fail_last_exchange(source, destination):
                nonlocal calls
                calls += 1
                if calls == 3:
                    raise OSError("final exchange failed")
                return original(source, destination)

            with mock.patch.object(BUILDER_MODULE.os, "rename", side_effect=fail_last_exchange):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(OSError, "final exchange failed"):
                    rollback(target, if_active_sha256=next_sha, if_rollback_sha256=old["sha256"])
            self.assertEqual(verify(target / "next-monitor.pyz")["sha256"], next_sha)
            self.assertEqual(verify(previous / "monitor.pyz")["sha256"], old["sha256"])
            self.assertFalse(list(root.glob(".strata-monitor-swap-*")))
            restored = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(BUILDER), "rollback", "--target", str(target),
                                       "--if-active-sha256", next_sha,
                                       "--if-rollback-sha256", old["sha256"]],
                                      capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
            result = json.loads(restored.stdout)
            self.assertTrue(result["rolled_back"])
            self.assertEqual(verify(target / "monitor.pyz")["sha256"], old["sha256"])
            self.assertEqual(verify(previous / "next-monitor.pyz")["sha256"], next_sha)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "commit or rollback"):
                uninstall(target)
            planned = commit(target, plan=True)
            self.assertTrue(planned["would_commit"])
            accepted = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(BUILDER), "commit", "--target", str(target),
                                       "--if-active-sha256", old["sha256"],
                                       "--if-previous-sha256", next_sha],
                                      capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
            self.assertTrue(json.loads(accepted.stdout)["committed"])
            self.assertFalse(previous.exists())
            self.assertTrue(uninstall(target, if_active_sha256=old["sha256"])["removed"])

    def test_update_activation_failure_restores_installed_client(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            first = root / "first" / "monitor.pyz"
            first.parent.mkdir()
            old = build(first)
            candidate = self._candidate(first, root / "second" / "monitor.pyz")
            next_sha = verify(candidate)["sha256"]
            target = root / "optional-monitor"
            install(first, target, if_candidate_sha256=old["sha256"])
            original = os.rename
            calls = 0

            def fail_activation(source, destination):
                nonlocal calls
                calls += 1
                if calls == 2:
                    raise OSError("activation failed")
                return original(source, destination)

            with mock.patch.object(BUILDER_MODULE.os, "rename", side_effect=fail_activation):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(OSError, "activation failed"):
                    update(candidate, target, if_current_sha256=old["sha256"],
                           if_candidate_sha256=next_sha)
            self.assertEqual(verify(target / "monitor.pyz")["sha256"], old["sha256"])
            self.assertFalse((root / "optional-monitor.previous").exists())
            self.assertFalse(list(root.glob(".strata-monitor-install-*")))

            original_stage = BUILDER_MODULE._stage_copy

            def change_active_during_copy(bundle, report, destination):
                stage = original_stage(bundle, report, destination)
                active_bundle = destination / "monitor.pyz"
                with zipfile.ZipFile(active_bundle, "a") as archive:
                    archive.comment = b"external owner edit"
                manifest = active_bundle.with_name(active_bundle.name + ".manifest.json")
                current = json.loads(manifest.read_text())
                current["sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(active_bundle.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                manifest.write_text(json.dumps(current))
                return stage

            with mock.patch.object(BUILDER_MODULE, "_stage_copy", side_effect=change_active_during_copy):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "changed during copy"):
                    update(candidate, target, if_current_sha256=old["sha256"],
                           if_candidate_sha256=next_sha)
            self.assertNotEqual(verify(target / "monitor.pyz")["sha256"], old["sha256"])
            self.assertFalse((root / "optional-monitor.previous").exists())
            self.assertFalse(list(root.glob(".strata-monitor-install-*")))

    def test_offline_install_plan_and_remove_touch_only_monitor_files(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            bundle = root / "portable-client.pyz"
            built = build(bundle)
            target = root / "optional-monitor"
            preview = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(BUILDER), "install", str(bundle),
                                      "--target", str(target), "--plan"],
                                     capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
            planned = json.loads(preview.stdout)
            self.assertTrue(planned["would_install"])
            self.assertFalse(target.exists())
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "preview again"):
                install(bundle, target)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "preview again"):
                install(bundle, target, if_candidate_sha256="0" * 64)
            self.assertFalse(target.exists())
            installed_run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(BUILDER), "install", str(bundle),
                                            "--target", str(target),
                                            "--if-candidate-sha256", planned["sha256"]],
                                           capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
            installed = json.loads(installed_run.stdout)
            self.assertTrue(installed["installed"])
            self.assertEqual(verify(target / bundle.name)["sha256"], built["sha256"])
            self.assertEqual({p.name for p in target.iterdir()},
                             {bundle.name, bundle.name + ".manifest.json"})
            if os.name == "posix":
                self.assertEqual(target.stat().st_mode & 0o077, 0)
                self.assertEqual((target / bundle.name).stat().st_mode & 0o077, 0)
            portable = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", str(target / bundle.name), "logs", "--help"],
                                      cwd=directory, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
            self.assertIn("--follow", portable.stdout)
            extra = target / "user-notes.txt"
            extra.write_text("keep me")
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "unexpected"):
                uninstall(target)
            self.assertTrue(extra.exists())
            extra.unlink()
            preview_remove = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(BUILDER), "uninstall",
                                             "--target", str(target), "--plan"],
                                            capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
            self.assertTrue(json.loads(preview_remove.stdout)["would_remove"])
            self.assertTrue(target.exists())
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "preview again"):
                uninstall(target)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "preview again"):
                uninstall(target, if_active_sha256="0" * 64)
            self.assertTrue(target.exists())
            removal = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(BUILDER), "uninstall", "--target",
                                      str(target), "--if-active-sha256",
                                      json.loads(preview_remove.stdout)["sha256"]],
                                     capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
            self.assertTrue(json.loads(removal.stdout)["removed"])
            self.assertFalse(target.exists())

    def test_failed_copy_leaves_no_partial_install(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            bundle = root / "monitor.pyz"
            built = build(bundle)
            target = root / "optional-monitor"
            with mock.patch.object(BUILDER_MODULE.shutil, "copyfile", side_effect=OSError("disk full")):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(OSError, "disk full"):
                    install(bundle, target, if_candidate_sha256=built["sha256"])
            self.assertFalse(target.exists())
            self.assertFalse(list(root.glob(".strata-monitor-install-*")))

    def test_bundle_verification_rejects_large_or_linked_input(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            bundle = root / "monitor.pyz"
            build(bundle)
            linked = root / "linked.pyz"
            linked.symlink_to(bundle)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "bounded regular"):
                verify(linked)
            with bundle.open("ab") as stream:
                stream.write(b"x" * (1024 * 1024))
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "bounded regular"):
                verify(bundle)
            bundle = root / "unsigned.pyz"
            build(bundle)
            manifest = bundle.with_name(bundle.name + ".manifest.json")
            forged = json.loads(manifest.read_text())
            forged["publisher_signature"] = "pretend-signed"
            manifest.write_text(json.dumps(forged))
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "manifest or SHA-256"):
                verify(bundle)
            manifest.write_text("[]")
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "manifest or SHA-256"):
                verify(bundle)

    def test_bundle_carries_every_module_its_entry_point_imports(self):
        """The import closure of strata_cli.monitor_commands (lazy imports included) minus the launch package must be in the bundle."""
        import ast
        needed, todo = set(), ["strata_cli/monitor_commands.py"]
        while todo:
            name = todo.pop()
            if name in needed:
                continue
            needed.add(name)
            for node in ast.walk(ast.parse((ROOT / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))):
                if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module and node.module.split(".")[0] == "strata_cli":
                    names = [node.module] + [node.module + "." + a.name for a in node.names]
                elif isinstance(node, ast.Import):
                    names = [a.name for a in node.names]
                else:
                    continue
                for module in names:
                    path = module.replace(".", "/") + ".py"
                    if module.startswith("strata_cli") and (ROOT / path).is_file() and "/launch/" not in path:
                        todo.append(path)
        self.assertLessEqual(needed, set(BUILDER_MODULE.SOURCES))

    def test_plain_monitor_runs_when_the_launch_package_is_not_bundled(self):
        """The pyz has no strata_cli.launch: interactive `monitor` must fall back to the plain Monitor, not fail."""
        from strata_cli import monitor as monitor_module
        from strata_cli import monitor_commands
        ran = []
        blocked = {"strata_cli.launch.monitor_ext": None}       # None in sys.modules makes the import raise ImportError
        with mock.patch.dict(sys.modules, blocked),                 mock.patch.object(monitor_module.MonitorApp, "run", lambda self: ran.append(self.endpoint.base_url)),                 mock.patch.object(sys.stdout, "isatty", return_value=True):
            code = monitor_commands.main(["monitor", "--url", "http://127.0.0.1:9"])
        self.assertEqual((code, ran), (0, ["http://127.0.0.1:9"]))

    def test_versioned_manifest_keeps_legacy_update_and_rollback_available(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            current = root / "monitor.pyz"
            modern = root / "next-monitor.pyz"
            previous = root / "previous-monitor.pyz"
            build(modern)
            old_visual = root / "visual-monitor.pyz"
            for old_bundle, version in ((current, 1), (previous, 2), (old_visual, 3)):
                with zipfile.ZipFile(modern) as source, zipfile.ZipFile(old_bundle, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as legacy:
                    for item in source.infolist():
                        if item.filename not in ("strata_cli/detail_dashboard.py", "strata_cli/nav.py",
                                                 "strata_cli/consoleinfo.py", "strata_cli/overview.py") and \
                                (version >= 3 or item.filename != "strata_cli/dashboard.py") and \
                                (version != 1 or item.filename != "LICENSE"):
                            legacy.writestr(item, source.read(item.filename))
                report = json.loads((root / "next-monitor.pyz.manifest.json").read_text())
                report["schema_version"] = version
                report["bundle"] = old_bundle.name
                report["sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(old_bundle.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                del report["files"]["strata_cli/detail_dashboard.py"]
                del report["files"]["strata_cli/nav.py"]
                del report["files"]["strata_cli/consoleinfo.py"]
                del report["files"]["strata_cli/overview.py"]
                if version < 3:
                    del report["files"]["strata_cli/dashboard.py"]
                if version == 1:
                    del report["files"]["LICENSE"]
                    for field in ("compatibility", "license", "license_file"):
                        del report[field]
                old_bundle.with_name(old_bundle.name + ".manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(report))
            self.assertEqual(verify(current)["schema_version"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(verify(previous)["schema_version"], 2)
            self.assertEqual(verify(old_visual)["schema_version"], 3)
            self.assertEqual(verify(modern)["schema_version"], 6)
            with zipfile.ZipFile(modern) as archive:
                self.assertIn(b"MIT License", archive.read("LICENSE"))
                self.assertIn(b"render_dashboard", archive.read("strata_cli/dashboard.py"))
                self.assertIn(b"render_detail_dashboard", archive.read("strata_cli/detail_dashboard.py"))
            target = root / "optional-monitor"
            install(current, target, if_candidate_sha256=verify(current)["sha256"])
            preview = update(modern, target, plan=True)
            self.assertTrue(preview["would_update"])
            self.assertTrue(update(modern, target, if_current_sha256=preview["current_sha256"],
                                   if_candidate_sha256=preview["candidate_sha256"])["updated"])
            self.assertEqual(verify(target / modern.name)["schema_version"], 6)
            self.assertEqual(verify(root / "optional-monitor.previous" / current.name)["schema_version"], 1)
            planned = rollback(target, plan=True)
            self.assertTrue(rollback(target, if_active_sha256=planned["active_sha256"],
                                     if_rollback_sha256=planned["rollback_sha256"])["rolled_back"])
            self.assertEqual(verify(target / current.name)["schema_version"], 1)
            second_target = root / "optional-monitor-from-v2"
            install(previous, second_target, if_candidate_sha256=verify(previous)["sha256"])
            preview = update(modern, second_target, plan=True)
            self.assertTrue(update(modern, second_target,
                                   if_current_sha256=preview["current_sha256"],
                                   if_candidate_sha256=preview["candidate_sha256"])["updated"])
            self.assertEqual(verify(second_target / modern.name)["schema_version"], 6)
            planned = rollback(second_target, plan=True)
            self.assertTrue(rollback(second_target, if_active_sha256=planned["active_sha256"],
                                     if_rollback_sha256=planned["rollback_sha256"])["rolled_back"])
            self.assertEqual(verify(second_target / previous.name)["schema_version"], 2)
            third_target = root / "optional-monitor-from-v3"
            install(old_visual, third_target, if_candidate_sha256=verify(old_visual)["sha256"])
            preview = update(modern, third_target, plan=True)
            self.assertTrue(update(modern, third_target,
                                   if_current_sha256=preview["current_sha256"],
                                   if_candidate_sha256=preview["candidate_sha256"])["updated"])
            planned = rollback(third_target, plan=True)
            self.assertTrue(rollback(third_target, if_active_sha256=planned["active_sha256"],
                                     if_rollback_sha256=planned["rollback_sha256"])["rolled_back"])
            self.assertEqual(verify(third_target / old_visual.name)["schema_version"], 3)

    def test_manifest_compatibility_and_license_notice_are_checked(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            bundle = Path(directory) / "monitor.pyz"
            built = build(bundle)
            self.assertEqual(built["compatibility"], {"python_min": "3.10", "telemetry_schema": [1]})
            self.assertEqual(built["license_file"], "LICENSE")
            manifest = bundle.with_name(bundle.name + ".manifest.json")
            edited = json.loads(manifest.read_text())
            edited["compatibility"]["telemetry_schema"] = [2]
            manifest.write_text(json.dumps(edited))
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "compatibility or license"):
                verify(bundle)
            edited["schema_version"] = True
            manifest.write_text(json.dumps(edited))
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "manifest or SHA-256"):
                verify(bundle)

    def test_thin_bundle_and_source_share_one_shot_contract(self):
        snapshot = {"schema_version": 1, "source": "test-server", "sampled_at": 1_790_000_000,
                    "instance": {"id": "test-instance", "state": "ready"},
                    "model": {"id": "fixture-model", "loaded": True},
                    "work": {"active": 2, "queued": 1, "slots_effective": 4,
                             "requests": [{"id": "r1", "state": "reading", "slot": 0,
                                           "prompt_tokens": 200, "prompt_read": 50}]}}
        paths = []

        class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            def do_GET(self):
                paths.append(self.path)
                body = json.dumps(snapshot).encode()
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(body)

            def log_message(self, *_args):
                pass

        server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        thread.start()
        try:
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
                bundle = Path(directory) / "strata-monitor.pyz"
                subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(BUILDER), "build", str(bundle)], check=True,
                               capture_output=True, text=True)
                subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(BUILDER), "verify", str(bundle)], check=True,
                               capture_output=True, text=True)
                self.assertLess(bundle.stat().st_size, 96 * 1024)
