CUDA12 = ("sm_60", "sm_61", "sm_70", "sm_75", "sm_80", "sm_86", "sm_89", "compute_89")
CUDA13 = ("sm_75", "sm_86", "sm_89", "sm_120", "compute_120")


class ReaderCheck(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.src = Path(self.tmp.name)
        (self.src / "strata").write_text("x")

    def reader(self, vision_archs=None):
        (self.src / "strata-vision").write_text("x")
        data = {"version": "0.2.3"}
        if vision_archs is not None:
            data["vision_archs"] = vision_archs
        (self.src / "BUILD.json").write_text(json.dumps(data))

    def check(self, backend, target, archs, **kw):
        return package_engine.check_picture_reader(self.src, backend, target, archs, **kw)

    def test_a_reader_with_no_recorded_archs_is_refused_for_cuda12(self):
        self.reader()
        with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as cm:
            self.check("cuda", "windows-x86_64", CUDA12, variant="cuda12")
        self.assertIn("vision_archs", str(cm.exception))
        self.assertIn("3669", str(cm.exception))

    def test_a_cuda13_reader_does_not_pass_for_the_pascal_package(self):
        self.reader("75;86;89;120")
        with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as cm:
            self.check("cuda", "windows-x86_64", CUDA12, variant="cuda12")
        for n in ("sm_60", "sm_61", "sm_70"):
            self.assertIn(n, str(cm.exception))

    def test_a_reader_built_for_the_packages_archs_passes(self):
        self.reader("60;61;70;75;80;86;89")
        self.assertEqual(self.check("cuda", "linux-x86_64", CUDA12, variant="cuda12"), [])
        self.reader(["75", "sm_86", "89-real", 120])
        self.assertEqual(self.check("cuda", "windows-x86_64", CUDA13, variant="cuda13"), [])

    def test_allow_stale_vision_packages_it_and_says_what_is_missing(self):
        self.reader("75;86;89;120")
        notes = self.check("cuda", "windows-x86_64", CUDA12, variant="cuda12", allow_stale=True)
        self.assertIn("sm_60", notes[0])

    def test_a_cuda_package_without_a_reader_is_text_only_not_an_error(self):
        notes = self.check("cuda", "linux-x86_64", CUDA13, variant="cuda13")
        self.assertIn("text only", notes[0])

    def test_a_macos_package_without_a_reader_is_refused(self):
        with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as cm:
            self.check("metal", "macos-arm64", ())
        self.assertIn("build_vision_mac.sh", str(cm.exception))
        self.assertIn("pictures are off", self.check("metal", "macos-arm64", (), allow_none=True)[0])

    def test_a_macos_package_with_a_reader_passes(self):
        self.reader()
        self.assertEqual(self.check("metal", "macos-arm64", ()), [])

    def test_build_runs_the_check_only_when_asked(self):
        self.reader("75;86;89;120")
        out = Path(self.tmp.name) / "out"
        out.mkdir()
        with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as cm:
            package_engine.build(self.src, "cuda", "0.2.3", "linux-x86_64", out, archs=CUDA12, variant="cuda12", build_id="t",
                                 check_reader=True)
        self.assertIn("picture reader", str(cm.exception))

    def test_stamp_vision_writes_the_record(self):
        (self.src / "BUILD.json").write_text(json.dumps({"version": "0.2.3", "archs": "60;61"}))
        self.assertEqual(package_engine.main(["--stamp-vision", str(self.src), "--vision-archs", "60;61;70"]), 0)
        data = json.loads((self.src / "BUILD.json").read_text())
        self.assertEqual(data["vision_archs"], "60;61;70")
        self.assertEqual(data["archs"], "60;61")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_posix_owner.py

"""POSIX owner-only checks: our own folders with drifted modes are repaired; another account's folders get a message with the exact fix."""

import os
import stat
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_control import posix_owner

posix_only = unittest.skipUnless(os.name == "posix", "POSIX modes")


@posix_only
class Repair(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.root = Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)

    def test_our_folder_with_open_modes_is_put_back_to_0700(self):
        d = self.root / "recipes"
        d.mkdir()
        os.chmod(d, 0o755)
        self.assertFalse(posix_owner.owner_only_wrong(d, d.lstat()))
        self.assertEqual(stat.S_IMODE(d.lstat().st_mode), 0o700)

    def test_our_file_with_open_modes_is_put_back_to_0600(self):
        f = self.root / "x.json"
        f.write_text("{}")
        os.chmod(f, 0o666)
        self.assertFalse(posix_owner.owner_only_wrong(f, f.lstat()))
        self.assertEqual(stat.S_IMODE(f.lstat().st_mode), 0o600)

    def test_a_private_one_is_left_alone(self):
        d = self.root / "ok"
        d.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        self.assertFalse(posix_owner.owner_only_wrong(d, d.lstat()))

    def test_a_link_is_never_followed_or_repaired(self):
        target = self.root / "t"
        target.mkdir()
        os.chmod(target, 0o755)
        link = self.root / "l"
        os.symlink(target, link)
        self.assertTrue(posix_owner.owner_only_wrong(link, link.lstat()))
        self.assertEqual(stat.S_IMODE(target.lstat().st_mode), 0o755)

    def test_a_folder_owned_by_someone_else_is_refused_and_not_touched(self):
        d = self.root / "root-made"
        d.mkdir()
        os.chmod(d, 0o755)
        with mock.patch.object(posix_owner.os, "getuid", return_value=os.getuid() + 1):
            self.assertTrue(posix_owner.owner_only_wrong(d, d.lstat()))
            text = posix_owner.owner_only_text("recipe directory must be owner-only (mode 0700)", d)
        self.assertEqual(stat.S_IMODE(d.lstat().st_mode), 0o755)
        self.assertIn("recipe directory belongs to", text)
        self.assertIn("sudo", text)
        self.assertIn("sudo chown -R \"$USER\"", text)
        self.assertNotIn("0700", text)

    def test_a_filesystem_that_keeps_no_modes_warns_once_and_goes_on(self):
        d = self.root / "drvfs"
        d.mkdir()
        os.chmod(d, 0o777)
        posix_owner._NOTED.discard(str(d))
        with mock.patch.object(posix_owner.os, "chmod"), mock.patch("sys.stderr") as err:
            self.assertFalse(posix_owner.owner_only_wrong(d, d.lstat()))
            self.assertFalse(posix_owner.owner_only_wrong(d, d.lstat()))
        printed = "".join(str(c.args[0]) for c in err.write.call_args_list)
        self.assertEqual(printed.count("cannot keep files private"), 1)

    def test_the_text_of_our_own_folder_is_unchanged(self):
        d = self.root / "mine"
        d.mkdir()
        self.assertEqual(posix_owner.owner_only_text("x must be owner-only", d), "x must be owner-only")


class Windows(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_nothing_changes_off_posix(self):
        with mock.patch.object(posix_owner, "POSIX", False):
            self.assertFalse(posix_owner.owner_only_wrong(".", os.stat(".")))
            self.assertEqual(posix_owner.owner_only_text("x", "."), "x")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_private_files.py

"""Owner-only files: 0600/0700 on POSIX, a one-entry protected ACL for the current user on NTFS."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import stat
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))

from strata_control import private_files as pf  # noqa: E402


class PrivateFileTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.tmp.name)

    def test_a_file_becomes_private_and_stays_readable_by_us(self):
        path = self.root / "key.json"
        path.write_text('{"apiKey": "x"}')
        pf.restrict_to_current_user(path)
        self.assertTrue(pf.is_private(path))
        self.assertEqual(path.read_text(), '{"apiKey": "x"}')
        path.write_text("{}")  # the owner can still replace it

    def test_a_directory_becomes_private_and_its_children_inherit(self):
        folder = self.root / "app-data"
        folder.mkdir()
        pf.restrict_to_current_user(folder)
        self.assertTrue(pf.is_private(folder))
        child = folder / "child.json"
        child.write_text("{}")
        if pf.WINDOWS:
            # the child inherits the directory's single entry rather than the profile's
            sddl = pf.dacl_sddl(child)
            self.assertIn(pf.current_user_sid(), sddl)
            self.assertNotIn("S-1-1-0", sddl)
            self.assertNotIn(";;;SY)", sddl)
            self.assertNotIn(";;;BA)", sddl)
        else:
            self.assertEqual(stat.S_IMODE(folder.stat().st_mode), 0o700)

    @unittest.skipIf(pf.WINDOWS, "POSIX mode bits")
    def test_posix_modes_are_exact(self):
        path = self.root / "key.json"
        path.write_text("{}")
        os.chmod(path, 0o666)
        pf.restrict_to_current_user(path)
        self.assertEqual(stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode), 0o600)
        os.chmod(path, 0o644)
        self.assertFalse(pf.is_private(path))

    @unittest.skipUnless(pf.WINDOWS, "NTFS ACLs")
    def test_the_effective_acl_is_one_protected_entry_for_the_current_user(self):
        path = self.root / "key.json"
        path.write_text("{}")
        self.assertFalse(pf.is_private(path), "a fresh file inherits SYSTEM/Administrators entries")
        pf.restrict_to_current_user(path)
        sddl = pf.dacl_sddl(path)
        self.assertEqual(sddl, f"D:PAI(A;;FA;;;{pf.current_user_sid()})")
        # nobody else: no Everyone, Users, Authenticated Users, SYSTEM or Administrators
        for sid in ("WD", "BU", "AU", "SY", "BA", "S-1-1-0", "S-1-5-32-545"):
            self.assertNotIn(f";;;{sid})", sddl)

    def test_a_file_made_in_the_profile_is_unshared_but_not_strictly_private(self):
        path = self.root / "inherited.json"
        path.write_text("{}")
        self.assertTrue(pf.is_unshared(path))
        if pf.WINDOWS:
            self.assertFalse(pf.is_private(path))   # SYSTEM and Administrators still inherit

    @unittest.skipUnless(pf.WINDOWS, "NTFS ACLs")
    def test_everyone_is_noticed_by_the_relaxed_check_too(self):
        import subprocess
        path = self.root / "shared.json"
        path.write_text("{}")
        subprocess.run(["icacls", str(path), "/grant", "*S-1-1-0:R"], check=True, capture_output=True)
        self.assertFalse(pf.is_unshared(path))

    @unittest.skipUnless(pf.WINDOWS, "NTFS ACLs")
    def test_widening_the_acl_is_noticed(self):
        path = self.root / "key.json"
        path.write_text("{}")
        pf.restrict_to_current_user(path)
        import subprocess
        subprocess.run(["icacls", str(path), "/grant", "*S-1-1-0:R"], check=True, capture_output=True)
        self.assertFalse(pf.is_private(path))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


@unittest.skipUnless(pf.WINDOWS, "NTFS ACLs")
class ElevatedRunLockoutTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """A file or folder an elevated run made names only SYSTEM and Administrators: the user's normal session cannot open it."""

    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.tmp.name)

    @staticmethod
    def lock_out(path):
        """Replace the rule with SYSTEM only: this session may be elevated itself, so Administrators is left out to make the lock-out real."""
        import ctypes
        from ctypes import wintypes
        descriptor = ctypes.c_void_p()
        assert pf._advapi.ConvertStringSecurityDescriptorToSecurityDescriptorW(
            "D:P(A;OICI;FA;;;SY)", 1, ctypes.byref(descriptor), None)
        present, defaulted, dacl = wintypes.BOOL(), wintypes.BOOL(), ctypes.c_void_p()
        pf._advapi.GetSecurityDescriptorDacl(descriptor, ctypes.byref(present), ctypes.byref(dacl), ctypes.byref(defaulted))
        code = pf._advapi.SetNamedSecurityInfoW(str(path), 1, 0x4 | 0x80000000, None, None, dacl, None)
        assert code == 0, code

    def test_a_locked_file_is_read_again_after_the_repair(self):
        path = self.root / "profile.json"
        path.write_text('{"name": "x"}')
        self.lock_out(path)
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):
            path.read_bytes()
        self.assertEqual(pf.read_bytes_repairing(path), b'{"name": "x"}')
        self.assertIn(pf.current_user_sid(), pf.dacl_sddl(path))
        self.assertEqual(path.read_bytes(), b'{"name": "x"}')

    def test_a_locked_folder_and_what_is_inside_are_repaired_as_a_tree(self):
        folder = self.root / "profiles"
        folder.mkdir()
        (folder / "a.json").write_text("{}")
        (folder / "sub").mkdir()
        (folder / "sub" / "b.json").write_text("{}")
        for item in (folder / "sub" / "b.json", folder / "sub", folder / "a.json", folder):
            self.lock_out(item)
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):
            (folder / "a.json").read_bytes()
        os.environ["STRATA_HOME"] = str(self.root)
        self.addCleanup(os.environ.pop, "STRATA_HOME", None)
        report = pf.repair_known_roots()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(report["repaired"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(report["failed"], 0)
        self.assertEqual((folder / "a.json").read_bytes(), b"{}")
        self.assertEqual((folder / "sub" / "b.json").read_bytes(), b"{}")
        self.assertIn(pf.current_user_sid(), pf.dacl_sddl(folder / "sub" / "b.json"))

    def test_a_folder_made_with_private_mkdir_names_the_user_explicitly(self):
        made = pf.private_mkdir(self.root / "x" / "y", parents=True)
        self.assertIn(pf.current_user_sid(), pf.dacl_sddl(made))
        self.assertIn(pf.current_user_sid(), pf.dacl_sddl(made.parent))
        (made / "file.json").write_text("{}")
        self.assertIn(pf.current_user_sid(), pf.dacl_sddl(made / "file.json"))
        self.assertEqual((made / "file.json").read_text(), "{}")

    def test_the_process_defaults_can_be_set_for_the_user(self):
        self.assertTrue(pf.adopt_user_defaults())
        self.assertTrue(pf.adopt_user_defaults())       # again: nothing breaks
        path = self.root / "new.json"
        path.write_text("{}")
        self.assertEqual(path.read_text(), "{}")

    def test_only_the_users_own_folders_are_ever_repaired(self):
        self.assertFalse(pf.repair_access(os.environ.get("SystemRoot", "C:\Windows") + "\System32\drivers"))

    def test_a_profile_that_was_locked_loads(self):
        from strata_control import profiles
        os.environ["STRATA_PROFILE_DIR"] = str(self.root / "profiles")
        self.addCleanup(os.environ.pop, "STRATA_PROFILE_DIR", None)
        directory = self.root / "profiles"
        directory.mkdir()
        run_config = self.root / "strata-x.json"
        run_config.write_text("{}")
        (directory / "app-1.json").write_text(json.dumps({"schema": 1, "name": "app-1", "source_config": str(run_config)}))
        self.lock_out(directory / "app-1.json")
        try:
            profiles.load("app-1")
        except profiles.ProfileError as exc:
            self.assertNotIn("PermissionError", str(exc))     # any other complaint is the sample's shape, not access


## tests/terminal/test_procs.py

"""Leftover detection: a process is ended only when it is exactly what Strata recorded and its starter is gone."""

import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_control import procs

SLEEP = [sys.executable, "-c", "import time; time.sleep(120)"]
NO_WINDOW = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0)


class Procs(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="strata-procs-")
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        patcher = mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"LOCALAPPDATA": self.temp.name, "XDG_STATE_HOME": self.temp.name})
        patcher.start()
        self.addCleanup(patcher.stop)
        self.started = []
        self.addCleanup(self._kill_all)

    def _kill_all(self):
        for proc in self.started:
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.kill()
            proc.wait(timeout=10)

    def sleeper(self):
        proc = subprocess.Popen(SLEEP, creationflags=NO_WINDOW)
        self.started.append(proc)
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 10
        while procs.identify(proc.pid) is None and time.monotonic() < deadline:
            time.sleep(0.05)
        return proc

    def recorded_pair(self):
        """(starter, child, record): a recorded child of a starter that is then ended."""
        starter, child = self.sleeper(), self.sleeper()
        self.assertIsNotNone(procs.write_record(child.pid, "engine", profile="app-1", parent_pid=starter.pid))
        return starter, child

    def gone(self, proc, seconds=15):
        try:
            proc.wait(timeout=seconds)
            return True
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            return False

    def test_a_child_whose_starter_is_gone_is_a_leftover_and_is_ended(self):
        starter, child = self.recorded_pair()
        self.assertEqual(procs.leftovers()[0], [], "its starter is alive: not a leftover")
        starter.kill(); starter.wait(timeout=10)
        found, unverifiable = procs.leftovers()
        self.assertEqual([r["pid"] for r in found], [child.pid])
        self.assertEqual(unverifiable, [])
        result = procs.end_leftovers(grace=2)
        self.assertEqual([r["pid"] for r in result["ended"]], [child.pid])
        self.assertTrue(self.gone(child))
        self.assertEqual(procs.records(), [], "the record goes with the process")

    def test_a_child_with_a_live_starter_is_never_touched(self):
        starter, child = self.recorded_pair()
        result = procs.end_leftovers(grace=1)
        self.assertEqual((result["ended"], result["stuck"]), ([], []))
        self.assertIsNone(child.poll())

    def test_a_reused_pid_is_not_the_recorded_process(self):
        starter, child = self.recorded_pair()
        path = procs.procs_dir() / f"{child.pid}.json"
        record = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        record["token"] = "x:not-this-process"                  # what a later process with the same number looks like
        path.write_text(json.dumps(record), encoding="utf-8")
        starter.kill(); starter.wait(timeout=10)
        result = procs.end_leftovers(grace=1)
        self.assertEqual((result["ended"], result["stuck"]), ([], []))
        self.assertIsNone(child.poll(), "a stranger with the recorded PID must be left alone")
        self.assertEqual(procs.records(), [], "the stale record is dropped")

    def test_the_same_start_time_with_another_command_line_is_not_ended(self):
        starter, child = self.recorded_pair()
        path = procs.procs_dir() / f"{child.pid}.json"
        record = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        record["cmd"] = [sys.executable, "-c", "something else"]
        path.write_text(json.dumps(record), encoding="utf-8")
        starter.kill(); starter.wait(timeout=10)
        result = procs.end_leftovers(grace=1)
        self.assertEqual((result["ended"], result["stuck"]), ([], []))
        self.assertIsNone(child.poll())

    def test_a_profile_filter_only_ends_that_profiles_leftovers(self):
        starter, child = self.recorded_pair()
        other_starter, other = self.sleeper(), self.sleeper()
        procs.write_record(other.pid, "engine", profile="app-2", parent_pid=other_starter.pid)
        starter.kill(); other_starter.kill()
        starter.wait(timeout=10); other_starter.wait(timeout=10)
        result = procs.end_leftovers(profile="app-1", grace=2)
        self.assertEqual([r["pid"] for r in result["ended"]], [child.pid])
        self.assertIsNone(other.poll(), "another profile's leftover is not part of this stop")

    def test_garbage_in_the_records_folder_is_ignored(self):
        base = procs.procs_dir()
        (base / "1.json").write_text("{not json", encoding="utf-8")
        (base / "2.json").write_text(json.dumps({"schema": 1, "pid": "no"}), encoding="utf-8")
        (base / "3.json").write_text("x" * 40000, encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertEqual(procs.records(), [])
        self.assertEqual(procs.end_leftovers()["ended"], [])

    def test_an_engine_orphan_of_this_executable_is_found_and_a_live_one_is_not(self):
        # an "engine": this interpreter running --serve; its starter is gone after the middle process exits
        code = ("import subprocess,sys; p=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-c','import time; time.sleep(120)','--serve'],"
                "stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,"
                "creationflags=%d); print(p.pid, flush=True)" % NO_WINDOW)
        middle = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        orphan_pid = int(middle.stdout.split()[0])
        self.addCleanup(lambda: procs.start_token(orphan_pid) and os.kill(orphan_pid, 9))
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 10
        while procs.identify(orphan_pid) is None and time.monotonic() < deadline:
            time.sleep(0.05)
        live = subprocess.Popen([*SLEEP, "--serve"], creationflags=NO_WINDOW)
        self.started.append(live)
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 10
        while procs.identify(live.pid) is None and time.monotonic() < deadline:
            time.sleep(0.05)
        found = [i.pid for i in procs.orphans_of(sys.executable)]
        self.assertIn(orphan_pid, found)
        self.assertNotIn(live.pid, found, "this test process started it: a live parent")
        self.assertEqual(procs.orphans_of(str(Path(sys.executable).with_name("not-the-engine"))), [])
        ended = procs.end_orphans(sys.executable, grace=2)
        self.assertIn(orphan_pid, [e["pid"] for e in ended])
        self.assertIsNone(live.poll())
        self.assertIsNone(procs.start_token(orphan_pid))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_profiles.py

"""Local profile and component workflows without a GPU or network service."""

import io
import json
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from contextlib import redirect_stderr, redirect_stdout
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_cli.cli import main
from strata_control import doctor, profiles, runtime


class OperatorProfileTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.env = mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_PROFILE_DIR": str(self.root / "profiles"),
                                             "STRATA_RUNTIME_DIR": str(self.root / "runtime"),
                                             "STRATA_API_KEY": ""})
        self.env.start()
        self.addCleanup(self.env.stop)
        engine = self.root / "engine"
        engine.write_text("engine placeholder", encoding="utf-8")
        engine.chmod(0o700)
        tokenizer = self.root / "tokenizer"
        tokenizer.mkdir()
        for name in ("vocab.json", "merges.txt", "token_type.json"):
            (tokenizer / name).write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
        pack = self.root / "pack"
        pack.mkdir()
        shard = self.root / "model.gguf"
        shard.write_bytes(b"model placeholder")
        self.shard = shard
        self.config = self.root / "run.json"
        self.config.write_text(json.dumps({"exe": str(engine), "args": ["--pack", str(pack), "--native", str(shard)],
                                           "cwd": str(self.root), "tokenizer": str(tokenizer),
                                           "model_name": "test-model", "port": 8095}), encoding="utf-8")

    def command(self, *args):
        output = io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(output):
            code = main(list(args))
        return code, json.loads(output.getvalue())

    def test_saved_overrides_drive_serve_plan_without_rewriting_run_config_or_starting(self):
        before = self.config.read_bytes()
        code, created = self.command("profile", "create", "four-gpu", "--from-config", str(self.config),
                                     "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(created["profile"]["overrides"], {})
        code, changed = self.command("profile", "set", "four-gpu", "parallel=8", "batch_groups=2",
                                     "max_queue=32", "queue_timeout=12.5", "batch_telemetry=true",
                                     "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertNotEqual(changed["revision"], created["revision"])
        with mock.patch("serve.server.main", side_effect=AssertionError("server started")):
            code, planned = self.command("serve", "--profile", "four-gpu", "--plan", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        plan = planned["plan"]
        self.assertEqual(plan["effective"]["parallel"], 8)
        self.assertEqual(plan["effective"]["batch_groups"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(plan["effective"]["max_queue"], 32)
        self.assertEqual(plan["effective"]["queue_timeout"], 12.5)
        self.assertTrue(plan["effective"]["batch_telemetry"])
        self.assertEqual(plan["origin"]["parallel"], "saved_profile")
        self.assertEqual(plan["engine_argv"][-4:], ["--batch-groups", "2", "--batch", "8"])
        self.assertIn("--max-queue", plan["server_argv"])
        self.assertIn("--batch-telemetry", plan["server_argv"])
        self.assertEqual(plan["server_argv"][plan["server_argv"].index("--queue-timeout") + 1], "12.5")
        self.assertEqual(self.config.read_bytes(), before)
        self.assertEqual(len(list((self.root / "profiles" / ".history" / "four-gpu").glob("*.json"))), 1)

    def test_saved_profile_is_used_by_actual_foreground_serve_call(self):
        profiles.create("local", str(self.config))
        profiles.set_values("local", ["parallel=4", "max_queue=7"])
        with mock.patch("serve.server.main", return_value=0) as server:
            self.assertEqual(main(["serve", "--profile", "local"]), 0)
        argv = server.call_args.args[0]
        self.assertEqual(server.call_args.kwargs["interrupt_exit_code"], 130)
        self.assertIn(str(self.config.resolve()), argv)
        self.assertEqual(argv[argv.index("--parallel") + 1], "4")
        self.assertEqual(argv[argv.index("--max-queue") + 1], "7")

    def test_json_alias_is_one_shot_and_keeps_machine_errors(self):
        code, listed = self.command("profile", "list", "--json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertTrue(listed["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(listed["profiles"], [])
        with mock.patch("serve.server.main", side_effect=AssertionError("server started")):
            code, planned = self.command("serve", "--profile", str(self.config), "--plan", "--json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertTrue(planned["ok"])
        self.assertIn("plan", planned)
        code, no_plan = self.command("serve", "--profile", str(self.config), "--json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 2)
        self.assertEqual(no_plan["error"]["code"], 2)
        code, stream = self.command("serve", "--profile", str(self.config), "--json",
                                    "--output", "jsonl")
        self.assertEqual(code, 2)
        self.assertEqual(stream["event"], "failed")
        code, harness = self.command("code", "sessions", "list", "--json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        self.assertEqual(harness["error"]["code"], 5)

    def test_quiet_suppresses_human_success_but_preserves_errors_and_json(self):
        output, diagnostics = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(output), redirect_stderr(diagnostics):
            self.assertEqual(main(["profile", "list", "--quiet"]), 0)
            self.assertEqual(main(["serve", "--profile", str(self.config), "--plan", "--quiet"]), 0)
        self.assertEqual((output.getvalue(), diagnostics.getvalue()), ("", ""))
        with redirect_stdout(output), redirect_stderr(diagnostics):
            self.assertEqual(main(["profile", "list", "--quiet", "--json"]), 0)
        self.assertTrue(json.loads(output.getvalue())["ok"])
        output, diagnostics = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(output), redirect_stderr(diagnostics):
            self.assertNotEqual(main(["profile", "show", "missing", "--quiet"]), 0)
        self.assertEqual(output.getvalue(), "")
        self.assertIn("strata:", diagnostics.getvalue())
        output, diagnostics = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
        def failed_operation(_a):
            print("x" * 70_000)
            print("failure detail")
            return 5
        with mock.patch("strata_cli.cli._profile_command", side_effect=failed_operation):
            with redirect_stdout(output), redirect_stderr(diagnostics):
                self.assertEqual(main(["profile", "list", "--quiet"]), 5)
        self.assertEqual(output.getvalue(), "")
        self.assertLess(len(diagnostics.getvalue()), 66_000)
        self.assertIn("earlier human output omitted", diagnostics.getvalue())
        self.assertIn("failure detail", diagnostics.getvalue())

    def test_quiet_foreground_serve_hides_human_banner(self):
        output = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch("serve.server.main", side_effect=lambda *_args, **_kwargs: print("ready banner") or 0):
            with redirect_stdout(output):
                self.assertEqual(main(["serve", "--profile", str(self.config), "--quiet"]), 0)
        self.assertEqual(output.getvalue(), "")
        output, diagnostics = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch("serve.server.main", return_value=8):
            with redirect_stdout(output), redirect_stderr(diagnostics):
                self.assertEqual(main(["serve", "--profile", str(self.config), "--quiet"]), 8)
        self.assertEqual(output.getvalue(), "")
        self.assertIn("drain deadline expired", diagnostics.getvalue())

    def test_foreground_jsonl_rejects_plan_and_bad_profile_as_events(self):
        code, invalid = self.command("serve", "--profile", str(self.config), "--plan",
                                     "--output", "jsonl")
        self.assertEqual(code, 2)
        self.assertEqual(invalid["event"], "failed")
        self.assertEqual(invalid["exit_code"], 2)
        code, missing = self.command("serve", "--profile", "missing-profile",
                                     "--output", "jsonl")
        self.assertNotEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(missing["event"], "failed")
        self.assertEqual(missing["exit_code"], code)

    def test_foreground_jsonl_reports_startup_failure_without_human_stdout(self):
        output, diagnostics = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch("serve.server.main", side_effect=SystemExit("engine refused to start")):
            with redirect_stdout(output), redirect_stderr(diagnostics):
                code = main(["serve", "--profile", str(self.config), "--output", "jsonl"])
        rows = [json.loads(line) for line in output.getvalue().splitlines()]
        self.assertEqual(code, 6)
        self.assertEqual([row["event"] for row in rows], ["starting", "failed"])
        self.assertEqual(rows[-1]["phase"], "startup")
        self.assertNotIn("engine refused to start", output.getvalue())
        self.assertIn("startup failed", diagnostics.getvalue())

    @unittest.skipUnless(os.name == "posix", "managed activity lease is POSIX-only")
    def test_foreground_serve_holds_shared_lease_until_server_returns(self):
        profiles.create("local", str(self.config))

        def running_server(argv, **_kwargs):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(profiles.ProfileError, "engine lease"):
                runtime.acquire_activity_lease(shared=False)
            return 0

        with mock.patch("serve.server.main", side_effect=running_server):
            self.assertEqual(main(["serve", "--profile", "local"]), 0)
        exclusive = runtime.acquire_activity_lease(shared=False)
        os.close(exclusive)

    def test_batch_telemetry_precedence_can_disable_a_run_config(self):
        cfg = json.loads(self.config.read_text())
        cfg["batch_telemetry"] = True
        self.config.write_text(json.dumps(cfg))
        profiles.create("local", str(self.config))
        code, inherited = self.command("serve", "--profile", "local", "--plan", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertTrue(inherited["plan"]["effective"]["batch_telemetry"])
        self.assertEqual(inherited["plan"]["origin"]["batch_telemetry"], "run_config")
        profiles.set_values("local", ["batch_telemetry=false"])
        code, disabled = self.command("serve", "--profile", "local", "--plan", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertFalse(disabled["plan"]["effective"]["batch_telemetry"])
        self.assertIn("--no-batch-telemetry", disabled["plan"]["server_argv"])
        code, enabled = self.command("serve", "--profile", "local", "--batch-telemetry",
                                     "--plan", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(enabled["plan"]["origin"]["batch_telemetry"], "command")
        self.assertIn("--batch-telemetry", enabled["plan"]["server_argv"])

    def test_serve_plan_validates_ready_file_without_writing_it(self):
        profiles.create("local", str(self.config))
        ready = self.root / "ready.json"
        code, result = self.command("serve", "--profile", "local", "--ready-file", str(ready),
                                    "--plan", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(result["plan"]["ready_file"], str(ready))
        self.assertFalse(ready.exists())
        ready.write_text("stale", encoding="utf-8")
        code, result = self.command("serve", "--profile", "local", "--ready-file", str(ready),
                                    "--plan", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 2)
        self.assertFalse(result["ok"])

    def test_stale_edit_rejected_and_bad_editor_content_keeps_saved_revision(self):
        profiles.create("local", str(self.config))
        current, old_revision = profiles.load("local")
        profiles.set_values("local", ["parallel=4"])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(profiles.ProfileError, "changed during edit"):
            profiles.save("local", current, expected_revision=old_revision)
        _, current_revision = profiles.load("local")

        def corrupt(command, check):
            Path(command[-1]).write_text("{invalid", encoding="utf-8")
            return mock.Mock(returncode=0)

        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"EDITOR": "fake-editor", "VISUAL": ""}), \
                mock.patch("strata_control.profiles.subprocess.run", side_effect=corrupt):
            code, result = self.command("profile", "edit", "local", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 2)
        self.assertFalse(result["ok"])
        draft_path = Path(result["error"]["message"].split("draft kept at ", 1)[1])
        self.assertTrue(draft_path.is_file())
        self.assertEqual(draft_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), "{invalid")
        self.assertEqual(profiles.load("local")[1], current_revision)

    def test_plan_then_history_and_rollback_restore_saved_settings_only(self):
        before = self.config.read_bytes()
        profiles.create("local", str(self.config))
        _, first = profiles.load("local")
        code, planned = self.command("profile", "set", "local", "parallel=8", "--plan", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertTrue(planned["would_save"])
        self.assertEqual(planned["changes"]["parallel"], {"before": None, "after": 8})
        self.assertEqual(profiles.load("local")[1], first)
        code, changed = self.command("profile", "set", "local", "parallel=8", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        code, listing = self.command("profile", "history", "local", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(listing["history"][0]["revision"], changed["revision"])
        self.assertIn(first, [item["revision"] for item in listing["history"]])
        code, restored = self.command("profile", "rollback", "local", "--to", first, "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(restored["revision"], first)
        self.assertEqual(restored["profile"]["overrides"], {})
        self.assertEqual(self.config.read_bytes(), before)

    def test_use_config_previews_and_saves_a_new_model_source_without_editing_either_config(self):
        profiles.create("local", str(self.config))
        old_profile, old_revision = profiles.load("local")
        next_config = self.root / "next.json"
        next_value = json.loads(self.config.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        next_value["model_name"] = "next-model"
        next_config.write_text(json.dumps(next_value), encoding="utf-8")
        before = (self.config.read_bytes(), next_config.read_bytes())
        code, preview = self.command("profile", "use-config", "local", "--from-config",
                                     str(next_config), "--plan", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertTrue(preview["would_save"])
        self.assertEqual(preview["revision"], old_revision)
        self.assertEqual(preview["model_name"], "next-model")
        self.assertEqual(profiles.load("local"), (old_profile, old_revision))
        code, unavailable = self.command("profile", "use-config", "local", "--from-config",
                                         str(self.root / "missing.json"), "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        self.assertFalse(unavailable["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(profiles.load("local"), (old_profile, old_revision))
        code, stale = self.command("profile", "use-config", "local", "--from-config",
                                   str(next_config), "--if-revision", "0" * 16, "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 6)
        self.assertFalse(stale["ok"])
        code, saved = self.command("profile", "use-config", "local", "--from-config",
                                   str(next_config), "--if-revision", old_revision, "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(saved["profile"]["source_config"], str(next_config.resolve()))
        self.assertNotEqual(saved["revision"], old_revision)
        self.assertEqual((self.config.read_bytes(), next_config.read_bytes()), before)
        self.assertIn(old_revision, [row["revision"] for row in profiles.history("local")])

    def test_doctor_distinguishes_required_missing_from_unverified_optional(self):
        profiles.create("local", str(self.config))
        code, result = self.command("doctor", "--profile", "local", "--components", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertTrue(result["report"]["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(result["report"]["integrity"], "unverified_no_manifest_hashes")
        self.shard.unlink()
        code, result = self.command("components", "verify", "--profile", "local", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        self.assertFalse(result["report"]["ok"])
        self.assertTrue(any(i["component"] == "native" for i in result["report"]["issues"]))

    def test_monitor_inventory_checks_the_optional_pinned_version(self):
        pinned = (Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "requirements-monitor.txt").read_text()
        self.assertIn(f"textual=={doctor.MONITOR_TEXTUAL_VERSION}", pinned)
        with mock.patch.object(doctor.util, "find_spec", return_value=None):
            missing = doctor._monitor_component()
        self.assertEqual(missing["status"], "optional_missing")
        with mock.patch.object(doctor.util, "find_spec", return_value=object()), \
                mock.patch.object(doctor.metadata, "version", return_value="8.2.8"):
            present = doctor._monitor_component()
        self.assertEqual(present["status"], "ok")
        self.assertEqual(present["check"], "package_version_only")
        with mock.patch.object(doctor.util, "find_spec", return_value=object()), \
                mock.patch.object(doctor.metadata, "version", return_value="9.0.0"):
            changed = doctor._monitor_component()
        self.assertEqual(changed["status"], "unverified")
        self.assertEqual(changed["version"], "9.0.0")
        with mock.patch.object(doctor.util, "find_spec", return_value=object()), \
                mock.patch.object(doctor.metadata, "version",
                                  side_effect=doctor.metadata.PackageNotFoundError("textual")):
            unknown = doctor._monitor_component()
        self.assertEqual(unknown["status"], "unverified")

        output = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch.object(doctor, "_monitor_component", return_value=changed), redirect_stdout(output):
            code = main(["doctor"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)  # an optional version does not stop serving
        self.assertIn("interactive monitor was qualified with Textual 8.2.8", output.getvalue())

    def test_live_doctor_checks_four_selected_nvidia_cards_without_starting_engine(self):
        config = json.loads(self.config.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        config["gpu"] = [0, 1, 2, 3]
        config["backend"] = "cuda"
        self.config.write_text(json.dumps(config), encoding="utf-8")
        profiles.create("four-gpu", str(self.config))
        cards = "\n".join(f"{i}, RTX 6000 test {i}, GPU-test-{i}, 49140, 580.95" for i in range(4))
        with mock.patch("strata_control.doctor.shutil.which", return_value="/fake/nvidia-smi"), \
                mock.patch("strata_control.doctor.subprocess.run",
                           return_value=mock.Mock(returncode=0, stdout=cards)) as probe:
            code, result = self.command("doctor", "--profile", "four-gpu", "--live", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(result["report"]["live_gpu_probe"]["status"], "ok")
        self.assertEqual(result["report"]["live_gpu_probe"]["selected_indices"], [0, 1, 2, 3])
        self.assertEqual(len(result["report"]["live_gpu_probe"]["cards"]), 4)
        self.assertEqual(probe.call_args.kwargs["timeout"], 5)
        self.assertFalse(probe.call_args.kwargs.get("shell", False))

        with mock.patch("strata_control.doctor.shutil.which", return_value="/fake/nvidia-smi"), \
                mock.patch("strata_control.doctor.subprocess.run",
                           return_value=mock.Mock(returncode=0, stdout=cards.rsplit("\n", 1)[0])):
            code, result = self.command("components", "verify", "--profile", "four-gpu", "--live",
                                        "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        self.assertEqual(result["report"]["live_gpu_probe"]["status"], "missing_selected")
        self.assertTrue(any(i["code"] == "GPU_NOT_VISIBLE" for i in result["report"]["issues"]))

    def test_live_probe_failure_and_unsupported_hip_are_explicit(self):
        config = json.loads(self.config.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        config["gpu"] = [0, 1]
        config["backend"] = "cuda"
        self.config.write_text(json.dumps(config), encoding="utf-8")
        profiles.create("local", str(self.config))
        with mock.patch("strata_control.doctor.shutil.which", return_value=None):
            code, result = self.command("doctor", "--profile", "local", "--live", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        self.assertEqual(result["report"]["live_gpu_probe"]["status"], "unavailable")
        self.assertTrue(any(i["code"] == "LIVE_GPU_PROBE_UNAVAILABLE" for i in result["report"]["issues"]))

        config["backend"] = "hip"
        self.config.write_text(json.dumps(config), encoding="utf-8")
        with mock.patch("strata_control.doctor.subprocess.run",
                        side_effect=AssertionError("NVIDIA probe must not run for HIP")):
            code, result = self.command("doctor", "--profile", "local", "--live", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        self.assertEqual(result["report"]["live_gpu_probe"]["status"], "unverified")

    def test_doctor_default_does_not_run_host_probe(self):
        profiles.create("local", str(self.config))
        with mock.patch("strata_control.doctor.subprocess.run",
                        side_effect=AssertionError("default doctor must be offline")):
            code, result = self.command("doctor", "--profile", "local", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertIsNone(result["report"]["live_gpu_probe"])
        with mock.patch("strata_control.doctor.subprocess.run",
                        side_effect=AssertionError("a profile is required for live probes")):
            code, missing = self.command("doctor", "--live", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        self.assertTrue(any(i["code"] == "PROFILE_NOT_SELECTED_FOR_LIVE_PROBE"
                            for i in missing["report"]["issues"]))

    def test_live_probe_rejects_untrusted_card_output_and_timeouts(self):
        config = json.loads(self.config.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        config["gpu"] = 0
        config["backend"] = "cuda"
        self.config.write_text(json.dumps(config), encoding="utf-8")
        profiles.create("local", str(self.config))
        for output in ("0, GPU\x1b[31m, GPU-0, 1000, 580.95",
                       "0, GPU, GPU-0, 1000, 580.95\n0, GPU, GPU-0, 1000, 580.95",
                       "0, GPU, GPU-0, not-a-number, 580.95"):
            with self.subTest(output=output), \
                    mock.patch("strata_control.doctor.shutil.which", return_value="/fake/nvidia-smi"), \
                    mock.patch("strata_control.doctor.subprocess.run",
                               return_value=mock.Mock(returncode=0, stdout=output)):
                code, result = self.command("doctor", "--profile", "local", "--live", "--output", "json")
            self.assertEqual(code, 5)
            self.assertEqual(result["report"]["live_gpu_probe"]["status"], "unavailable")
        with mock.patch("strata_control.doctor.shutil.which", return_value="/fake/nvidia-smi"), \
                mock.patch("strata_control.doctor.subprocess.run",
                           side_effect=subprocess.TimeoutExpired("nvidia-smi", 5)):
            code, result = self.command("doctor", "--profile", "local", "--live", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 5)
        self.assertEqual(result["report"]["live_gpu_probe"]["status"], "unavailable")

    def test_calibration_preview_has_no_engine_or_config_side_effects(self):
        profiles.create("local", str(self.config))
        before = self.config.read_bytes()
        with mock.patch("serve.server.StrataEngine", side_effect=AssertionError("engine started")), \
                mock.patch("tools.calibrate.run", side_effect=AssertionError("measurement started")):
            code, result = self.command("engine", "calibrate", "--profile", "local", "--plan", "--output", "json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertFalse(result["plan"]["would_start_engine"])
        self.assertFalse(result["plan"]["would_write_config"])
        self.assertEqual(self.config.read_bytes(), before)

    def test_invalid_profile_names_and_types_do_not_escape_store(self):
        for name in ("../outside", "UPPER", "a/b", ".hidden"):
            with self.assertRaises(profiles.ProfileError):
                profiles.create(name, str(self.config))
        profiles.create("local", str(self.config))
        for assignment in ("parallel=0", "max_queue=99999", "queue_timeout=nan",
                           "queue_timeout=0", "offline=yes", "batch_telemetry=yes", "host=bad host"):
            with self.assertRaises(profiles.ProfileError):
                profiles.set_values("local", [assignment])
        profiles.set_values("local", ["queue_timeout=5"])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(profiles.ProfileError, "requires max_queue"):
            from strata_cli.cli import _launch_plan
            _launch_plan("local")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_progress_words.py

"""0.2.2: the words for a model download and its preparation are plain and true (strata_control/progress_words.py), and the app's
and the Terminal's progress read the same lines the same way (tools/strata_mcp.py install_progress / combined_progress).

The excerpts are from real setup logs (Gyro-S on the RTX 5070 PC, 2026-10-19) and from the steps a Q2_0 install adds."""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))

import strata_mcp  # noqa: E402
from strata_control import progress_words as W  # noqa: E402

HEAD = ["Strata - Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on a normal PC", "=== Step 1: checking your PC ===", "  [ok] GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070",
        "=== Step 2: your choices ===", "  [ok] size: Gyro-S", "=== Step 3: Python packages ===", "  [ok] numpy ...",
        "=== Step 4: the Strata engine ==="]
STEP5 = ["=== Step 5: downloading Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Gyro) Gyro-S ===",
         "  The model files go in C:\\Users\\x\\Documents\\Strata\\models\\gyro-Gyro-S"]
MODEL_PROGRESS = "  Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Gyro-S-TQ1_0.gguf:  30.53 / 58.49 GB (52%)   "
CHECK = "  checking Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Gyro-S-TQ1_0.gguf (SHA-256, 58.5 GB) ..."
STEP6 = ["=== Step 6: preparing the model for Strata ==="]


def prog(lines):
    p = strata_mcp.install_progress(lines)
    return p, p.get("label"), p.get("phase")


class StepWords(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_checking_the_pc(self):
        self.assertEqual(prog(HEAD[:3])[1:], ("Checking your computer", "check"))

    def test_the_engine_and_the_helper_download_have_their_own_words(self):
        self.assertEqual(prog(HEAD + ["  llama.cpp source:   0.01 / 0.04 GB (21%)   "])[2], "helpers")
        self.assertIn("small tools", prog(HEAD + ["  llama.cpp source:   0.01 / 0.04 GB (21%)   "])[1])
        self.assertEqual(prog(HEAD + ["  Strata engine:   0.20 / 0.90 GB (22%)   "])[1], "Downloading the engine for this PC")
        self.assertEqual(prog(HEAD)[2], "engine")

    def test_the_model_download(self):
        _p, label, phase = prog(HEAD + STEP5 + [MODEL_PROGRESS])
        self.assertEqual((label, phase), ("Downloading the model files", "download"))

    def test_a_figure_from_an_earlier_step_does_not_leak_into_the_next(self):
        """Step 4's 'llama.cpp source' line must not make step 5 'Downloading ...' before any model line is printed."""
        p, label, phase = prog(HEAD + ["  llama.cpp source:   0.04 / 0.04 GB (100%)   "] + STEP5)
        self.assertNotIn("download", p)
        self.assertEqual(phase, "download")
        self.assertEqual(label, "Getting the model files")

    def test_the_hash_check_is_checking_not_downloading(self):
        lines = HEAD + STEP5 + [MODEL_PROGRESS, "  [ok] downloaded", CHECK]
        p, label, phase = prog(lines)
        self.assertEqual(phase, "verify")
        self.assertIn("Checking that the model files are complete", label)
        self.assertNotIn("Downloading", label)
        # with its own figure
        p, label, phase = prog(lines + ["  checking Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Gyro-S-TQ1_0.gguf:  12.00 / 58.49 GB (20%)   "])
        self.assertEqual(phase, "verify")
        self.assertEqual(p["download"]["percent"], 20)

    def test_a_damaged_file_is_repaired_in_plain_words_and_the_second_check_is_checking(self):
        damaged = "  Some parts of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Gyro-S-TQ1_0.gguf were damaged; downloading only those parts again."
        lines = HEAD + STEP5 + [MODEL_PROGRESS, CHECK, damaged, "  Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Gyro-S-TQ1_0.gguf:  12.00 / 58.49 GB (20%)   "]
        _p, label, phase = prog(lines)
        self.assertEqual(phase, "repair")
        self.assertEqual(label, "Some parts of a model file were damaged; downloading only those parts again")
        done = lines + ["  2 of 1186 parts were different and have been written again; checking the whole file again ..."]
        self.assertEqual(prog(done)[2], "download")

    def test_the_picture_reader(self):
        lines = HEAD + STEP5 + ["  [ok] model files present", "  vision encoder:   0.30 / 0.91 GB (33%)   "]
        self.assertEqual(prog(lines)[1:], ("Downloading the picture reader", "pictures"))

    def test_files_already_there(self):
        lines = HEAD + STEP5 + ["  [ok] Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Q2_0-00001-of-00002.gguf already downloaded"]
        self.assertEqual(prog(lines)[2], "verify")

    def test_step_six_packing_the_experts(self):
        lines = HEAD + STEP5 + STEP6 + ["  Converting the Q2_0 experts for the AVX-512 kernel (one time, ~40 GB written, 2-5 min) ...",
                                        "  > python tools/strata_pack.py build --gguf x --out y --skip-hash --force"]
        self.assertEqual(prog(lines)[1:], ("Packing the model's experts for your processor (one time, a few minutes)", "pack"))
        self.assertEqual(prog(lines + ["  > python tools/pack_index.py --pack y"])[1], "Indexing the packed experts")
        self.assertEqual(prog(lines + ["  > python tools/strata_tokenizer.py --gguf x --out y"])[1], "Preparing the tokenizer")

    def test_step_six_the_draft_layer_download_then_its_preparation(self):
        fetch = ["  [ok] model prepared: y", "  The MTP draft layer (speculative decoding, ~2x faster output) comes from the original Qwen checkpoint:",
                 "  only its ~5 GB of MTP tensors are downloaded.", "  > python tools/mtp_fetch.py fetch --out z",
                 "  MTP draft layer:   1.65 / 5.21 GB (31%)"]
        p, label, phase = prog(HEAD + STEP5 + STEP6 + fetch)
        self.assertEqual(phase, "draft_download")
        self.assertIn("Downloading the draft layer", label)
        # the download is over: the numbers it printed are stale, the next tool is running
        p, label, phase = prog(HEAD + STEP5 + STEP6 + fetch + ["  MTP draft layer:   5.21 / 5.21 GB (100%)", "  > python tools/mtp_pack.py --src z"])
        self.assertEqual((label, phase), ("Preparing the draft layer", "draft"))
        p, label, phase = prog(HEAD + STEP5 + STEP6 + fetch + ["  > python tools/mtp_rt.py --gguf g --out rt"])
        self.assertEqual(phase, "draft")

    def test_step_six_with_everything_already_there(self):
        lines = HEAD + STEP5 + STEP6 + ["  [ok] model prepared: y", "  [ok] MTP draft layer: z"]
        self.assertEqual(prog(lines)[2], "draft")

    def test_low_memory_mode_packing(self):
        lines = HEAD + STEP5 + STEP6 + ["  Writing the experts into one file for the low-memory mode (one time, 80 GB) ...",
                                        "  > python tools/iq_pack.py --gguf x --out y --experts-bin"]
        self.assertEqual(prog(lines)[1], "Packing the experts into one file for low-memory mode (one time)")

    def test_the_last_step(self):
        lines = HEAD + STEP5 + STEP6 + ["=== Step 7: writing the start script ===", "  [ok] KV streaming on"]
        self.assertEqual(prog(lines)[1:], ("Saving the model's settings", "settings"))

    def test_the_heading_is_found_even_after_hundreds_of_tool_lines(self):
        lines = HEAD + STEP5 + STEP6 + ["  > python tools/iq_pack.py --gguf x --out y"] + [f"  layer {i}/40" for i in range(900)]
        self.assertEqual(prog(lines)[2], "pack")

    def test_no_step_yet(self):
        self.assertEqual(prog(["Strata - Qwen3.8-Flash-Next"])[1:], ("Getting your model ready", "working"))

    def test_with_numbers(self):
        w = W.describe(5, STEP5, {"file": "x.gguf", "done_gb": 12.34, "total_gb": 58.49, "percent": 21})
        self.assertEqual(W.with_numbers(w, {"done_gb": 12.34, "total_gb": 58.49}), "Downloading the model files: 12.3 of 58.5 GB")
        self.assertEqual(W.with_numbers(w, None), "Downloading the model files")


class CombinedFigure(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_part_file_the_pieces_filled_ahead_is_not_a_finished_download(self):
        """The parallel download writes the last pieces early, so the .part is full length while the pieces done are 50%: the log's
        figure is the truth (the bar used to jump to 99%)."""
        import tempfile
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            folder = Path(tmp)
            part = folder / "m-00001-of-00002.gguf.part"
            part.write_bytes(b"\0" * 1000)
            files = [{"path": str(folder / "m-00001-of-00002.gguf"), "bytes": 1_000_000_000, "role": "model"}]
            prog_ = {"step": "5/7: downloading X", "download": {"file": "m-00001-of-00002.gguf", "done_gb": 0.5, "total_gb": 1.0, "percent": 50}}
            # the .part says 1000 bytes here; make it say 1 GB without writing it
            import os
            with open(part, "r+b") as f:
                f.truncate(1_000_000_000)
            out = strata_mcp.files_progress(prog_, {"total_gb": 1.0}, files)
            self.assertAlmostEqual(out["download"]["done_gb"], 0.5, places=2)
            self.assertEqual(out["download"]["percent"], 50)

    def test_the_hash_check_has_its_own_figure(self):
        lines = HEAD + STEP5 + [CHECK, "  checking Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Gyro-S-TQ1_0.gguf:  12.00 / 58.49 GB (20%)   "]
        p = strata_mcp.install_progress(lines)
        out = strata_mcp.combined_progress(p, {"folder": None, "total_gb": 58.5})
        self.assertEqual(out["download"]["file"], "checking files")
        self.assertEqual(out["download"]["percent"], 20)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_ready.py

"""Ready-file lifecycle checked against a live mock Strata API process."""

import json
import os
import signal
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from serve.ready import preflight, publish, remove_if_owned


class ReadyFileTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_owner_only_file_is_never_removed_for_another_instance(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "ready.json"
            self.assertEqual(preflight(str(path)), path)
            publish(path, {"schema_version": 1, "instance_id": "one", "pid": os.getpid()})
            if os.name != "nt":
                self.assertEqual(stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode), 0o600)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "already exists"):
                preflight(str(path))
            remove_if_owned(path, "other")
            self.assertTrue(path.exists())
            remove_if_owned(path, "one")
            self.assertFalse(path.exists())

    @unittest.skipIf(os.name == "nt", "Windows console stop needs a platform-specific integration runner")
    def test_mock_server_publishes_bound_port_and_cleans_on_sigterm(self):
        root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "ready.json"
            env = os.environ.copy()
            env.pop("STRATA_API_KEY", None)
            env.pop("STRATA_TELEMETRY_KEY", None)
            process = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-m", "serve.server", "--engine", "mock", "--port", "0",
                                        "--ready-file", str(path)], cwd=root, env=env,
                                       stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
            try:
                deadline = time.monotonic() + 10
                record = None
                while time.monotonic() < deadline and process.poll() is None:
                    try:
                        record = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                        break
                    except (FileNotFoundError, json.JSONDecodeError):
                        time.sleep(0.05)
                self.assertIsNotNone(record, process.stderr.read().decode("utf-8", "replace") if process.poll() is not None else "")
                self.assertEqual(record["pid"], process.pid)
                self.assertEqual(record["api_state"], "ready")
                self.assertEqual(record["model_state"], "ready")
                self.assertGreater(record["bound_port"], 0)
                self.assertNotIn("key", json.dumps(record).lower())
                process.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
                self.assertEqual(process.wait(timeout=10), 0)
                self.assertFalse(path.exists())
            finally:
                if process.poll() is None:
                    process.kill()
                    process.wait(timeout=5)
                process.stderr.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

    def test_history_rollback_and_stale_edit(self):

    def test_journal_prunes_old_terminal_records_but_not_running_work(self):
        recipes.initialize("local")
        with mock.patch.object(journal, "MAX_RECORDS", 2):
            ids = []
            for _ in range(3):
                code, executed = self._cli("run", "check")
                self.assertEqual(code, 0)
                ids.append(executed["operation"]["operation_id"])
            self.assertEqual(len(journal.list_runs("local")), 2)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(profiles.ProfileError, "not found"):
                journal.load("local", ids[0])
            # Two unfinished records exhaust the cap; neither may be discarded.
            directory = profiles.profile_dir() / ".ops" / "local" / ".runs"
            for path in directory.glob("*.json"):
                path.unlink()
            first = journal.begin("local", "check", "components.verify", "0" * 16, "0" * 16)
            second = journal.begin("local", "check", "components.verify", "0" * 16, "0" * 16)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(profiles.ProfileError, "journal is full"):
                journal.begin("local", "check", "components.verify", "0" * 16, "0" * 16)
            self.assertEqual(journal.load("local", first["operation_id"])["state"], "running")
            self.assertTrue(journal.load("local", first["operation_id"])["completion_unverified"])
            self.assertEqual(journal.load("local", second["operation_id"])["state"], "running")

    def test_invalid_journal_event_is_reported_without_rendering_record_content(self):
        recipes.initialize("local")
        operation_id = self._cli("run", "check")[1]["operation"]["operation_id"]
        path = profiles.profile_dir() / ".ops" / "local" / ".runs" / f"{operation_id}.json"
        record = json.loads(path.read_text())
        record["events"][-1]["state"] = "\x1b[31mforged\x1b[0m"
        path.write_text(json.dumps(record))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(profiles.ProfileError, "invalid events"):
            journal.load("local", operation_id)
        code, listed = self._cli("runs")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertIn("error", listed["runs"][0])
        self.assertNotIn("forged", json.dumps(listed))

    def test_direct_journal_is_typed_compact_and_keeps_uncertain_interruptions(self):
        revision = profiles.load("local")[1]
        operation_id, result = journal.run_direct("local", "runtime.restart", revision,
            {"wait_s": 20, "startup_wait_s": 10, "expected_profile_revision": revision},
            lambda: {"ok": False, "state": "ready", "error": "activation_failed", "exit_code": 6,
                     "private_trace": "TOPSECRET"})
        self.assertFalse(result["ok"])
        record = journal.load("local", operation_id)
        self.assertEqual(record["schema_version"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(record["origin"], "direct")
        self.assertEqual(record["state"], "failed")
        self.assertNotIn("TOPSECRET", json.dumps(record))
        deadline_id, _ = journal.run_direct("local", "runtime.stop", revision, {"wait_s": 12},
                                            lambda: {"ok": False, "state": "stopping", "exit_code": 8})
        self.assertEqual(journal.load("local", deadline_id)["state"], "completion_unknown")
        with self.assertRaises(KeyboardInterrupt):
            journal.run_direct("local", "runtime.stop", revision, {"wait_s": 12},
                               lambda: (_ for _ in ()).throw(KeyboardInterrupt()))
        latest = journal.list_runs("local")[0]
        uncertain = journal.load("local", latest["operation_id"])
        self.assertEqual(uncertain["state"], "completion_unknown")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(profiles.ProfileError, "unsupported fields"):
            journal.begin_direct("local", "runtime.stop", revision,
                                 {"wait_s": 12, "shell": "rm -rf /"})
        self.assertEqual(len(journal.list_runs("local")), 3)

    def test_direct_journal_rejects_tampered_origin(self):
        revision = profiles.load("local")[1]
        record = journal.begin_direct("local", "runtime.stop", revision, {"wait_s": 12})
        path = profiles.profile_dir() / ".ops" / "local" / ".runs" / f"{record['operation_id']}.json"
        forged = json.loads(path.read_text())
        forged["origin"] = "remote"
        path.write_text(json.dumps(forged))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(profiles.ProfileError, "unsupported intent"):
            journal.load("local", record["operation_id"])
