## tests/terminal/test_release_config.py

"""The release app configuration: the engine travels inside every installer, the updater signs, the Mac minimum matches the Metal engine."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

TAURI = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "apps" / "desktop" / "src-tauri"


def load(name: str) -> dict:
    return json.loads((TAURI / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))


def merge_patch(base, patch):
    """RFC 7396, the way `tauri build --config <file>` layers an overlay: a null removes the key."""
    if not isinstance(patch, dict):
        return patch
    out = dict(base) if isinstance(base, dict) else {}
    for key, value in patch.items():
        if value is None:
            out.pop(key, None)
        else:
            out[key] = merge_patch(out.get(key), value)
    return out


class ReleaseConfig(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_every_installer_bundles_the_engine(self):
        self.assertEqual(load("tauri.conf.json")["bundle"]["resources"]["resources/engine-bundle"], "engine-bundle")
        self.assertEqual(load("tauri.tester.conf.json")["bundle"]["resources"]["resources/engine-bundle"], "engine-bundle")   # the same place

    def test_the_release_overlay_makes_signed_updater_artifacts(self):
        self.assertIs(load("tauri.release.conf.json")["bundle"]["createUpdaterArtifacts"], True)
        self.assertIs(load("tauri.conf.json")["bundle"]["createUpdaterArtifacts"], False)       # a development build needs no private key

    def test_the_mac_app_needs_the_macos_the_metal_engine_needs(self):
        self.assertEqual(load("tauri.conf.json")["bundle"]["macOS"]["minimumSystemVersion"], "15.0")

    def test_the_updater_points_at_github_releases(self):
        up = load("tauri.conf.json")["plugins"]["updater"]
        self.assertEqual(up["endpoints"], ["https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/latest.json"])
        self.assertNotIn("REPLACE", up["pubkey"])

    def test_the_update_overlay_drops_only_the_engine(self):
        """The app update (latest.json) is built with tauri.update.conf.json: the same app without engine-bundle, so one update
        fits every installer variant (CUDA 13, CUDA 12, AMD) and downloads 0 engine bytes. Engines come per card from the feed."""
        full = load("tauri.conf.json")
        update = merge_patch(full, load("tauri.update.conf.json"))
        self.assertNotIn("resources/engine-bundle", update["bundle"]["resources"])
        self.assertEqual({k: v for k, v in full["bundle"]["resources"].items() if k != "resources/engine-bundle"}, update["bundle"]["resources"])
        self.assertEqual({k: v for k, v in full["bundle"].items() if k != "resources"}, {k: v for k, v in update["bundle"].items() if k != "resources"})
        self.assertEqual(full["plugins"], update["plugins"])        # same key, same endpoint: it is the same app
        self.assertNotIn("endpoints", load("tauri.update.conf.json").get("plugins", {}))

    def test_one_endpoint_and_no_variant_specific_updater_config(self):
        """Three platform keys in one latest.json is the whole design; a variant-specific endpoint would give an AMD or CUDA 12 PC another variant's installer."""
        for name in ("tauri.conf.json", "tauri.release.conf.json", "tauri.tester.conf.json", "tauri.update.conf.json"):
            self.assertNotIn("{{", json.dumps(load(name).get("plugins", {})), name)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_release_keys.py

"""The keys shipped with a release build (strata_control/update_keys.json): the release feed key and the Tauri app key are there,
the tester / local-test keys are not (they come with STRATA_UPDATE_TRUSTED_KEYS), and a feed is verified against them."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_control import feed as feedmod, signing
from tests.terminal import update_fixture as fx

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
RELEASE_KEY_ID = "5d1bc23abbeffd0d"
TAURI_CONF = ROOT / "apps" / "desktop" / "src-tauri" / "tauri.conf.json"


class ShippedKeys(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_the_release_feed_key_is_shipped_and_valid(self):
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {signing.ENV_EXTRA_KEYS: ""}):
            keys = signing.load_trusted_keys()
        self.assertEqual(list(keys), [RELEASE_KEY_ID])           # only the release key: no tester or local-test key in a release build
        self.assertEqual(signing.key_id_of(keys[RELEASE_KEY_ID]), RELEASE_KEY_ID)

    def test_the_app_key_is_the_one_in_the_tauri_config(self):
        shipped = json.loads((ROOT / "strata_control" / "update_keys.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))["app_minisign_public"]
        conf = json.loads(TAURI_CONF.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))["plugins"]["updater"]["pubkey"]
        self.assertEqual(shipped, conf)
        key_id, public = signing.minisign_public(shipped)         # parses as a real Ed25519 minisign key, not the placeholder
        self.assertEqual(len(public), 32)
        self.assertEqual(signing.app_public_key if False else shipped, conf)

    def test_a_feed_signed_by_another_key_is_refused_and_a_tester_key_works_through_the_override(self):
        other = fx.make_key()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
            extra = Path(t) / "tester-keys.json"
            extra.write_text(json.dumps({"keys": [signing.public_part(other)]}))
            with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {signing.ENV_EXTRA_KEYS: ""}):
                self.assertNotIn(other["key_id"], signing.load_trusted_keys())          # a tester key is not part of a release build
            with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {signing.ENV_EXTRA_KEYS: str(extra)}):
                keys = signing.load_trusted_keys()
            self.assertIn(other["key_id"], keys)                                         # private tester builds: their key via the override
            self.assertIn(RELEASE_KEY_ID, keys)                                          # ... beside the release key


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_release_matrix.py

"""The 0.2.0-beta release set as a signed feed offers it: one engine package per platform/backend/variant (values copied from the
packages' engine-component.json), and what `feed.select_engine` hands each kind of PC. This is the evidence that engine updates
reach every installer variant by card, so the app update can stay engine-less (tauri.update.conf.json)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from strata_control import feed as feedmod

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "packaging"))
import feed_tool  # noqa: E402

V = "0.1.45.3"
SM_NEW = ("sm_75", "sm_86", "sm_89", "sm_120", "compute_120")                       # the CUDA 13 packages
SM_OLD = ("sm_60", "sm_61", "sm_70", "sm_75", "sm_80", "sm_86", "sm_89", "compute_89")   # the CUDA 12 packages (Pascal and Volta)


def pkg(platform, backend, variant, archs, driver=None):
    return {"version": V, "platform": platform, "backend": backend, "variant": variant, "archs": list(archs),
            "min_driver": {"nvidia": driver} if driver else {}, "min_runtime": None,
            "build_id": f"rel-{platform}-{backend}-{variant}", "format": "tar.gz", "url": f"strata-engine-{platform}-{variant}.tar.gz",
            "size": 1000, "sha256": "a" * 64, "manifest_sha256": "b" * 64, "installed_bytes": 2000, "notes": ""}


RELEASE = [
    pkg("windows-x86_64", "cuda", "cuda13", SM_NEW, "580.65"),
    pkg("windows-x86_64", "cuda", "cuda12", SM_OLD, "576.02"),
    pkg("windows-x86_64", "hip", "rx9070", ("gfx1200", "gfx1201")),
    pkg("windows-x86_64", "hip", "rdna3", ("gfx1100", "gfx1101", "gfx1102", "gfx1151")),
    pkg("windows-x86_64", "hip", "rdna2", ("gfx1030", "gfx1031")),
    pkg("linux-x86_64", "cuda", "cuda13", SM_NEW, "580.65"),
    pkg("linux-x86_64", "cuda", "cuda12", SM_OLD, "575.51"),
    pkg("linux-x86_64", "hip", "rx9070", ("gfx1200", "gfx1201")),
    pkg("linux-x86_64", "hip", "rx7900", ("gfx1100", "gfx1101", "gfx1102")),
    pkg("linux-x86_64", "hip", "halo", ("gfx1151",)),
    pkg("linux-x86_64", "hip", "rx6000", ("gfx1030", "gfx1031")),
    pkg("linux-x86_64", "sycl", "", ("intel-arc",)),                 # the Intel Arc (A and B series) engine, GPU code JIT-compiled
    pkg("macos-arm64", "metal", "", ("apple-gpu",)),
]


def pc(platform, backend, driver=None, sm=(), gfx=()):
    return {"platform": platform, "backend": backend, "runtime": "0.2.0", "nvidia_driver": driver, "cuda_archs": list(sm), "gfx": list(gfx)}


class ReleaseSelection(unittest.TestCase):
    def pick(self, hardware):
        best, reasons = feedmod.select_engine([feedmod._engine_package(p) for p in RELEASE], hardware)
        return (best.platform, best.backend, best.variant) if best else None, reasons

    def test_every_release_variant_is_chosen_by_some_pc(self):
        chosen = {
            self.pick(pc("windows-x86_64", "cuda", "590.10", ["sm_120"]))[0],     # RTX 5070
            self.pick(pc("windows-x86_64", "cuda", "576.02", ["sm_61"]))[0],      # GTX 1080 on an older driver
            self.pick(pc("windows-x86_64", "hip", gfx=["gfx1201"]))[0],           # RX 9070
            self.pick(pc("windows-x86_64", "hip", gfx=["gfx1100"]))[0],           # RX 7900 XTX
            self.pick(pc("windows-x86_64", "hip", gfx=["gfx1030"]))[0],           # RX 6800 XT
            self.pick(pc("linux-x86_64", "cuda", "615.71", ["sm_86"]))[0],        # RTX 3060
            self.pick(pc("linux-x86_64", "cuda", "575.51", ["sm_60"]))[0],        # Tesla P100
            self.pick(pc("linux-x86_64", "hip", gfx=["gfx1201"]))[0],             # Radeon AI PRO R9700
            self.pick(pc("linux-x86_64", "hip", gfx=["gfx1100"]))[0],             # RX 7900 XTX
            self.pick(pc("linux-x86_64", "hip", gfx=["gfx1151"]))[0],             # Ryzen AI Max (Strix Halo)
            self.pick(pc("linux-x86_64", "hip", gfx=["gfx1031"]))[0],             # RX 6700 XT
            self.pick(pc("linux-x86_64", "sycl"))[0],                             # Arc A750 / B580 / Pro B70
            self.pick(pc("macos-arm64", "metal"))[0],
        }
        self.assertEqual(chosen, {(p["platform"], p["backend"], p["variant"]) for p in RELEASE})

    def test_cuda_13_or_12_follows_the_driver_and_the_card(self):
        win = "windows-x86_64"
        self.assertEqual(self.pick(pc(win, "cuda", "580.65", ["sm_86"]))[0][2], "cuda13")
        self.assertEqual(self.pick(pc(win, "cuda", "590.10", ["sm_120"]))[0][2], "cuda13")
        got, why = self.pick(pc(win, "cuda", "576.02", ["sm_120"]))                 # a new card on an older driver: CUDA 12 reaches it by PTX
        self.assertEqual(got[2], "cuda12")
        self.assertTrue(any("580.65" in r for r in why))
        self.assertEqual(self.pick(pc(win, "cuda", "615.71", ["sm_70"]))[0][2], "cuda12", "Volta is only in the CUDA 12 build")
        self.assertEqual(self.pick(pc("linux-x86_64", "cuda", "575.51", ["sm_75"]))[0][2], "cuda12")
        self.assertEqual(self.pick(pc("linux-x86_64", "cuda", "580.65", ["sm_75"]))[0][2], "cuda13")

    def test_a_driver_that_is_too_old_gets_no_engine_and_a_reason(self):
        got, why = self.pick(pc("windows-x86_64", "cuda", "551.00", ["sm_86"]))
        self.assertIsNone(got)
        self.assertTrue(any("576.02" in r for r in why) and any("580.65" in r for r in why))

    def test_amd_gets_its_own_build_and_never_a_cuda_one(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.pick(pc("linux-x86_64", "hip", gfx=["gfx1200"]))[0][2], "rx9070")
        self.assertEqual(self.pick(pc("linux-x86_64", "hip", gfx=["gfx1102"]))[0][2], "rx7900")
        for hw in (pc("windows-x86_64", "hip", gfx=["gfx1201"]), pc("linux-x86_64", "hip", gfx=["gfx1201"])):
            self.assertEqual(self.pick(hw)[0][1], "hip")

    def test_rx7000_and_strix_halo_on_windows_get_the_rdna3_build(self):
        for gfx in ("gfx1100", "gfx1101", "gfx1102", "gfx1151"):
            self.assertEqual(self.pick(pc("windows-x86_64", "hip", gfx=[gfx]))[0], ("windows-x86_64", "hip", "rdna3"), gfx)
        self.assertEqual(self.pick(pc("windows-x86_64", "hip", gfx=["gfx1201"]))[0][2], "rx9070")
        self.assertEqual(self.pick(pc("windows-x86_64", "hip", gfx=["gfx1200"]))[0][2], "rx9070")

    def test_strix_halo_on_linux_gets_the_halo_build_and_rx7000_keeps_rx7900(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.pick(pc("linux-x86_64", "hip", gfx=["gfx1151"]))[0], ("linux-x86_64", "hip", "halo"))
        for gfx in ("gfx1100", "gfx1101", "gfx1102"):
            self.assertEqual(self.pick(pc("linux-x86_64", "hip", gfx=[gfx]))[0][2], "rx7900", gfx)

    def test_no_amd_card_matches_two_hip_builds_of_one_platform(self):
        """A tie between two builds of the same version would be settled by list order: no arch may be in two hip builds of a platform."""
        for platform in ("windows-x86_64", "linux-x86_64"):
            seen = {}
            for p in RELEASE:
                if p["platform"] == platform and p["backend"] == "hip":
                    for arch in p["archs"]:
                        self.assertNotIn(arch, seen, f"{arch} is in {seen.get(arch)} and {p['variant']} on {platform}")
                        seen[arch] = p["variant"]

    def test_other_unified_memory_radeons_get_no_engine_and_the_plain_family_line(self):
        from strata_control import engine_component as ec
        for platform in ("windows-x86_64", "linux-x86_64"):
            for gfx in ("gfx1103", "gfx1150", "gfx1152", "gfx1032"):
                got, why = self.pick(pc(platform, "hip", gfx=[gfx]))
                self.assertIsNone(got, f"{gfx} on {platform}")
                self.assertTrue(any(gfx in r for r in why))
        self.assertEqual(ec.arch_notice(("gfx1100", "gfx1151"), ["gfx1201"]),
                         "This build of Strata is for AMD RX 7000 and Ryzen AI Max cards. This computer has an AMD RX 9000 card (gfx1201). Ask for the RX 9000 build.")
        self.assertEqual(ec.arch_notice(("gfx1151",), ["gfx1201"]),
                         "This build of Strata is for AMD Ryzen AI Max cards. This computer has an AMD RX 9000 card (gfx1201). Ask for the RX 9000 build.")

    def test_rx6000_has_its_own_package_and_only_gfx103x_cards_get_it(self):
        """0.2.2: gfx1030 / gfx1031 are in the RX 6000 package (Linux rx6000, Windows rdna2) and in no other; no RX 7000 / 9000 card gets it."""
        from strata_control import engine_component as ec
        want = {"windows-x86_64": "rdna2", "linux-x86_64": "rx6000"}
        for platform, variant in want.items():
            for gfx in ("gfx1030", "gfx1031"):
                self.assertEqual(self.pick(pc(platform, "hip", gfx=[gfx]))[0], (platform, "hip", variant), (platform, gfx))
            for gfx in ("gfx1100", "gfx1101", "gfx1102", "gfx1151", "gfx1200", "gfx1201"):
                got = self.pick(pc(platform, "hip", gfx=[gfx]))[0]
                self.assertNotEqual(got[2] if got else None, variant, (platform, gfx))
        self.assertEqual(ec.NO_PACKAGE_HIP, {}, "every card family setup supports has a package; the table is for the next family without one")
        covered = {a for p in RELEASE if p["backend"] == "hip" for a in p["archs"]}
        self.assertTrue({"gfx1030", "gfx1031"} <= covered)
        # the plain family line now names a build that exists
        self.assertIn("Ask for the RX 6000 build.", ec.arch_notice(("gfx1200", "gfx1201"), ["gfx1030"]))
        self.assertIsNone(ec.no_package_note(["gfx1030", "gfx1031"]))

    def test_a_pc_with_an_rx7000_beside_an_rx6000_keeps_the_package_it_always_got(self):
        """Before the RX 6000 package a PC with both cards got the RX 7000 one: the new package must not win that tie, in any feed order."""
        for platform, old, new in (("windows-x86_64", "rdna3", "rdna2"), ("linux-x86_64", "rx7900", "rx6000")):
            hardware = pc(platform, "hip", gfx=["gfx1030", "gfx1100"])
            for order in (RELEASE, list(reversed(RELEASE))):
                best, _ = feedmod.select_engine([feedmod._engine_package(p) for p in order], hardware)
                self.assertEqual(best.variant, old, (platform, new))
        # a Radeon AI PRO (gfx1201) beside an RX 6800 keeps rx9070 too
        for platform in ("windows-x86_64", "linux-x86_64"):
            for order in (RELEASE, list(reversed(RELEASE))):
                best, _ = feedmod.select_engine([feedmod._engine_package(p) for p in order], pc(platform, "hip", gfx=["gfx1201", "gfx1030"]))
                self.assertEqual(best.variant, "rx9070")

    def test_installed_packages_are_chosen_the_same_way(self):
        from strata_control import engine_component as ec
        self.assertEqual(ec.hip_preference(("gfx1030", "gfx1031")), 0)
        self.assertEqual(ec.hip_preference(("gfx1100", "gfx1101", "gfx1102")), 1)
        self.assertEqual(ec.hip_preference(("gfx1030", "gfx1100")), 1)
        self.assertEqual(ec.hip_preference(()), 1)

    def test_the_platform_decides_first(self):
        self.assertIsNone(self.pick(pc("macos-arm64", "cuda", "590.10", ["sm_86"]))[0])
        self.assertEqual(self.pick(pc("macos-arm64", "metal"))[0], ("macos-arm64", "metal", ""))


class PackedOnWindows(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_programs_are_recognised_by_their_header_so_a_linux_package_packed_on_windows_keeps_them_executable(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
            root = Path(t)
            (root / "strata-vision").write_bytes(b"\x7fELF\x02\x01" + bytes(20))
            (root / "libx.dylib").write_bytes(b"\xcf\xfa\xed\xfe" + bytes(20))
            (root / "run.sh").write_bytes(b"#!/bin/sh\n")
            (root / "BUILD.json").write_text("{}")
            (root / "kernel.hsaco").write_bytes(b"\x00\x01\x02\x03")
            names = ("strata-vision", "libx.dylib", "run.sh", "BUILD.json", "kernel.hsaco")
            self.assertEqual([feed_tool._is_native_executable(root / n) for n in names], [True, True, True, False, False])
            if os.name == "nt":                     # the owner's release PC: the archive is what matters
                archive = root / "a.tar.gz"
                feed_tool._write_archive([(n, root / n) for n in ("strata-vision", "BUILD.json")], archive, "tar.gz", None)
                with tarfile.open(archive) as tar:
                    modes = {m.name: m.mode for m in tar.getmembers()}
                self.assertEqual(modes, {"strata-vision": 0o755, "BUILD.json": 0o644})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_round8_fixes.py

"""Owner test round 8 (7 machines), the Control / TUI / setup fixes: F5, F3, N2 to N9, N11."""

import argparse
import io
import json
import os
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_cli.launch import adopt, library, runner as R
from strata_cli.launch import settings as S
from strata_cli.launch.runner import Runner
from tests.terminal.launch_support import HW_12, Home, catalog


def runner_for(**kw) -> Runner:
    return Runner(S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="IQ3_XXS", context=32768, vision="off", **kw), catalog=catalog(HW_12))


class EngineExitIsExplained(unittest.TestCase):
    """F5 (L3): an Arc engine died with 'No device of requested type available' and the person saw only 'server_exited'."""

    def config_with_log(self, lines):
        folder = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(folder.cleanup)
        log = Path(folder.name) / "engine.log"
        log.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        cfg = Path(folder.name) / "run.json"
        cfg.write_text(json.dumps({"log": str(log)}), encoding="utf-8")
        return cfg, log

    def test_arc_without_the_render_group_names_the_cause_the_next_step_and_the_log(self):
        cfg, log = self.config_with_log(["strata generate: memory guard: limit 61.6 GiB", "strata generate: SYCL init",
                                         "terminate called after throwing an instance of 'sycl::exception'",
                                         "  what():  No device of requested type available. -1 (PI_ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_FOUND)"])
        text, nxt = R.explain_engine_exit({"state": "failed", "error": "server_exited", "engine_exit_code": 134}, cfg)
        self.assertIn("stopped while it was loading the model", text)
        self.assertIn("No device of requested type available", text)
        self.assertNotIn("server_exited", text + nxt)
        self.assertIn("render group", nxt)
        self.assertIn(str(log), nxt)

    def test_a_gpu_runtime_start_failure_gets_a_plain_sentence_and_keeps_the_runtime_text_out_of_it(self):
        cfg, log = self.config_with_log(["strata generate: loading", "terminate called after throwing an instance of 'rocr::AMD::hsa_exception'",
                                         "  what():  "])
        text, nxt = R.explain_engine_exit({"state": "failed", "error": "server_exited", "engine_exit_code": 134}, cfg)
        self.assertIn("stopped while it was loading the model (exit code 134)", text)
        self.assertNotIn("hsa_exception", text + nxt)
        self.assertNotIn("terminate called", text + nxt)
        self.assertIn("graphics card was not ready yet", nxt)
        self.assertIn("wait a few seconds", nxt)
        self.assertIn("restart the PC", nxt)
        self.assertIn(str(log), nxt)
        text, nxt = R.explain_engine_exit({"error": "server_exited", "engine_exit_code": 134,
                                           "log_tail": "terminate called after throwing an instance of 'rocr::AMD::hsa_exception' | what():"}, None)
        self.assertNotIn("hsa_exception", text)
        self.assertIn("graphics card was not ready yet", nxt)

    def test_a_real_cause_in_the_same_log_wins_over_the_gpu_runtime_start_failure(self):
        cfg, log = self.config_with_log(["strata generate: CUDA error: out of memory",
                                         "terminate called after throwing an instance of 'rocr::AMD::hsa_exception'", "  what():  "])
        text, nxt = R.explain_engine_exit({"state": "failed", "error": "server_exited", "engine_exit_code": 134}, cfg)
        self.assertIn("out of memory", text)
        self.assertIn("--context 16k", nxt)
        self.assertNotIn("graphics card was not ready", nxt)
        cfg, _ = self.config_with_log(["Permission denied: /dev/dri/renderD128", "terminate called after throwing an instance of 'rocr::AMD::hsa_exception'"])
        self.assertIn("render group", R.explain_engine_exit({"error": "server_exited", "engine_exit_code": 134}, cfg)[1])
        cfg, _ = self.config_with_log(["hsaKmtOpenKFD ok", "strata generate: CUDA error: out of memory"])
        self.assertNotIn("graphics card was not ready", R.explain_engine_exit({"error": "server_exited"}, cfg)[1])

    def test_out_of_memory_and_old_engine_get_their_own_next_step(self):
        cfg, _ = self.config_with_log(["strata generate: CUDA error: out of memory"])
        self.assertIn("--context 16k", R.explain_engine_exit({"error": "server_exited"}, cfg)[1])
        cfg, _ = self.config_with_log(["strata generate: no kernel for TQK6 on this engine"])
        self.assertIn("strata update", R.explain_engine_exit({"error": "server_exited"}, cfg)[1])

    def test_an_unreadable_log_still_says_the_stage_and_where_to_look(self):
        text, nxt = R.explain_engine_exit({"state": "failed", "error": "server_exited", "log_tail": "boom | Error: cannot map the pack"}, None)
        self.assertIn("cannot map the pack", text)
        self.assertIn("strata logs", nxt)
        text, _ = R.explain_engine_exit({"state": "starting", "error": "startup_wait_expired"}, None)
        self.assertIn("did not finish loading in time", text)


class NoTuiNeverAsks(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_no_tui_keeps_the_models_and_says_so_without_input(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as old, tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as new:
            (Path(old) / "models").mkdir()
            (Path(old) / "models" / "a.gguf").write_bytes(b"x" * 2048)
            from strata_cli.launch import cmd
            a = argparse.Namespace(data_dir=new, move_data=False, yes=False, plan=False, no_tui=True)
            cat = mock.Mock()
            cat.data_dir.return_value = Path(old)
            out = io.StringIO()
            with mock.patch.object(library, "movable_library", return_value=40.0), mock.patch("builtins.input", side_effect=AssertionError("asked")), \
                    mock.patch.object(sys, "stdin") as stdin, redirect_stdout(out):
                stdin.isatty.return_value = True
                self.assertFalse(cmd._move_data_choice(a, S.LaunchSettings(), cat, False))
            self.assertIn("Keeping your 40 GB of models where they are", out.getvalue())
            self.assertIn("--move-data", out.getvalue())

    def test_a_run_without_a_keyboard_says_the_same(self):
        from strata_cli.launch import cmd
        a = argparse.Namespace(data_dir="/new", move_data=False, yes=False, plan=False, no_tui=False)
        out = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch.object(library, "movable_library", return_value=3.0), mock.patch("builtins.input", side_effect=AssertionError("asked")), \
                mock.patch.object(sys, "stdin") as stdin, redirect_stdout(out):
            stdin.isatty.return_value = False
            self.assertFalse(cmd._move_data_choice(a, S.LaunchSettings(), mock.Mock(), False))
        self.assertIn("Keeping your 3.0 GB", out.getvalue())


class SetupArguments(unittest.TestCase):
    def installed(self, h: Home, **cfg):
        path = h.base / "install" / "strata-iq3_xxs.json"
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(json.dumps({"exe": "x", "args": [], **cfg}), encoding="utf-8")
        return path

    def test_a_context_change_forwards_the_installed_roles(self):
        # F3: 0=main,1=helper came back from a 32k to 16k change as 0=helper,1=main
        with Home() as h:
            path = self.installed(h, gpu=[1, 0], gpus_asked=True, gpu_roles={"0": "main", "1": "helper"})
            r = runner_for()
            with mock.patch.object(Runner, "installed_state", return_value=(path, None)):
                a = r.setup_args()
            self.assertEqual(a[a.index("--gpu-roles") + 1], "0=main,1=helper")

    def test_installed_cards_are_forwarded_and_the_automatic_pick_is_not(self):
        with Home() as h:
            path = self.installed(h, gpu=[1, 0], gpus_asked=True)
            with mock.patch.object(Runner, "installed_state", return_value=(path, None)):
                a = runner_for().setup_args()
            self.assertEqual(a[a.index("--gpus") + 1], "1,0")
            path = self.installed(h, gpu=0)                               # never asked: setup picks again
            with mock.patch.object(Runner, "installed_state", return_value=(path, None)):
                a = runner_for().setup_args()
            self.assertNotIn("--gpus", a)
            self.assertNotIn("--gpu", a)

    def test_cards_named_on_the_command_line_win_over_the_installed_ones(self):
        with Home() as h:
            path = self.installed(h, gpu=[1, 0], gpus_asked=True, gpu_roles={"0": "main", "1": "helper"})
            with mock.patch.object(Runner, "installed_state", return_value=(path, None)):
                a = runner_for(gpus=[0]).setup_args()
            self.assertEqual(a[a.index("--gpu") + 1], "0")
            self.assertNotIn("--gpu-roles", a)

    def test_mtp_off_reaches_setup(self):
        with Home():
            a = runner_for(mtp="off").setup_args()
            self.assertEqual(a[a.index("--mtp") + 1], "off")
            self.assertNotIn("--mtp", runner_for().setup_args())

    def test_setup_skips_the_draft_layer_download_for_mtp_off(self):
        # setup.py is a script; its two fetch sites must be guarded by the explicit --mtp off (N3: a 5.2 GB download happened anyway)
        text = (Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "setup.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn('if a.mtp == "off" and not (rt / "experts.bin").exists():', text)
        self.assertIn('if use_mtp and a.mtp == "off" and not (mtp / "mtp-q2_0.gguf").exists():', text)
        self.assertIn('"use --data-dir on a bigger drive (strata launch --data-dir)" if CONTROL', text)       # N2: a launch option, not --models-dir


class PlanPredictsEveryDownload(unittest.TestCase):
    def plan_text(self, h: Home, own: Path, **kw) -> dict:
        s = S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="IQ3_XXS", context=32768, vision="on", model_path=str(own), data_dir=str(h.base / "data"), **kw)
        r = Runner(s, catalog=catalog(HW_12))
        with mock.patch.object(Runner, "check_own_files"), mock.patch.object(Runner, "ready_pack_gap", return_value=None):
            return r.download_plan()

    def test_a_local_gguf_without_a_reader_shows_the_picture_reader_and_the_switch(self):
        with Home() as h:
            own = h.base / "own"
            own.mkdir()
            (own / "m-00001-of-00002.gguf").write_bytes(b"x")
            plan = self.plan_text(h, own)
            self.assertIn("picture reader", plan["text"])
            self.assertIn("--vision off", plan["text"])
            self.assertIn("draft layer", plan["text"])
            self.assertIn("--mtp off", plan["text"])

    def test_a_reader_beside_the_files_is_used_and_not_counted(self):
        with Home() as h:
            own = h.base / "own"
            own.mkdir()
            (own / "m-00001-of-00002.gguf").write_bytes(b"x")
            (own / "mmproj-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-BF16.gguf").write_bytes(b"x")
            plan = self.plan_text(h, own)
            self.assertNotIn("picture reader", plan["text"])

    def test_mtp_off_is_not_counted(self):
        with Home() as h:
            own = h.base / "own"
            own.mkdir()
            (own / "m-00001-of-00002.gguf").write_bytes(b"x")
            self.assertNotIn("draft layer", self.plan_text(h, own, mtp="off")["text"])


class ReadyPackPlan(unittest.TestCase):

class EngineIsFreshEnough(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_versions_compare_by_numbers(self):
        self.assertEqual(R.version_tuple("0.1.45.3"), (0, 1, 45, 3))
        self.assertEqual(R.version_tuple("junk"), ())

    def test_an_old_engine_is_named_in_plain_words_and_a_current_one_is_not(self):
        with Home():
            r = runner_for()
            r.catalog.strata.setup_module()           # loads setup.py's tables (MIN_ENGINE)
            words = r.stale_engine("0.1.45.3")
            self.assertIn("older than this model needs", words)
            self.assertIn("0.1.45.3", words)
            self.assertIsNone(r.stale_engine("0.1.47"))
            self.assertIsNone(r.stale_engine("source"))

    def test_gyro_on_a_mac_needs_engine_0_1_47(self):
        with Home():
            r = Runner(S.LaunchSettings(family="gyro", model="Gyro-S", context=32768, vision="off"), catalog=catalog(HW_12))
            with mock.patch.object(sys, "platform", "darwin"):
                self.assertEqual(r.needed_engine(), (0, 1, 47))
                self.assertIn("older than this model needs (0.1.47", r.stale_engine("0.1.45.3"))
                self.assertIsNone(r.stale_engine("0.1.47"))
            with mock.patch.object(sys, "platform", "linux"):
                self.assertLess(r.needed_engine(), (0, 1, 47))               # CUDA, HIP and SYCL had the kernels earlier
                self.assertIsNone(r.stale_engine("0.1.46"))
            with mock.patch.object(sys, "platform", "darwin"):
                q = Runner(S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="IQ3_XXS", context=32768, vision="off"), catalog=catalog(HW_12))
                self.assertLess(q.needed_engine(), (0, 1, 47))              # only Gyro is held to it

    def test_a_stale_engine_is_updated_or_said_never_ignored(self):
        with Home():
            r = runner_for()
            events = []
            r.emit = lambda stage, text, pct=None, level="info", **kw: events.append((level, text))
            before = {"usable": True, "engine": {"version": "0.1.45.3", "backend": "cuda"}}
            proc = mock.Mock()
            proc.stdout = iter([])
            proc.wait.return_value = 0
            from strata_control import engine_component as ec
            with mock.patch.object(ec, "status", return_value=before), mock.patch.object(Runner, "_spawn", return_value=proc):
                r.ensure_engine()
            self.assertTrue(any(level == "warn" and "older than this model needs" in text for level, text in events), events)
            self.assertTrue(any("strata update" in n for n in r.notices), r.notices)


class InstallIsNotHijacked(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_an_earlier_install_outside_the_chosen_data_folder_is_named(self):
        with Home() as h:
            cat = mock.Mock()
            cat.places = [mock.Mock(path=h.base / "old" / "Strata", source="app", configs=2)]
            words = R.install_isolation_words(cat, str(h.base / "scratch"))
            self.assertEqual(len(words), 1)
            self.assertIn("earlier install", words[0])
            self.assertIn(str(h.base / "old" / "Strata"), words[0])
            cat.places = [mock.Mock(path=h.base / "scratch" / "install", source="app", configs=1)]
            self.assertEqual(R.install_isolation_words(cat, str(h.base / "scratch")), [])
            cat.places = [mock.Mock(path=h.base / "old", source="explicit", configs=1)]
            self.assertEqual(R.install_isolation_words(cat, str(h.base / "scratch")), [])
            self.assertEqual(R.install_isolation_words(cat, None), [])

    def test_an_install_inside_strata_data_dir_comes_first(self):
        from strata_control import discovery
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as data, tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as other:
            for folder in (Path(data) / "install", Path(other) / "install"):
                folder.mkdir()
                (folder / "strata-q.json").write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
            env = {"STRATA_DATA_DIR": data}
            found = discovery.places(environ=env, here=Path(other) / "install", home=Path(other))
            self.assertEqual(Path(found[0].path).resolve(), (Path(data) / "install").resolve())


class IdentityAndAdoption(unittest.TestCase):

            plan = {"candidate_selection": {"family": "qwen", "model": "IQ3_XXS"}, "folder_holds": [], "issues": []}
            from strata_control import models
            with mock.patch.object(models, "own_path_problem", return_value=None), mock.patch.object(models, "plan_import", return_value=plan), \
                    mock.patch.object(models, "import_target", return_value=str(h.base)):
                r.resolve_own_files()
            self.assertEqual(len(r.identity_notes), 1)
            self.assertIn("look like qwen IQ3_XXS", r.identity_notes[0])
            self.assertIn("not swift IQ2_XS", r.identity_notes[0])
            self.assertEqual((r.s.family, r.s.model), ("swift", "IQ2_XS"))        # warned, never forced

    def test_gyro_is_adopted_like_the_others_and_the_text_has_no_double_period(self):
        with Home() as h:
            data = h.base / "data"
            model_dir = data / "models" / "gyro-Gyro-S"
            model_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
            (model_dir / "Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Gyro-S-TQ1_0.gguf").write_bytes(b"x")
            pack = data / "packs" / "gyro-gyro-s"
            (pack / "tokenizer").mkdir(parents=True)
            (pack / "index.txt").write_text("x", encoding="utf-8")
            cfg, problems = adopt.plan(family="gyro", model="Gyro-S", model_dir=model_dir, data_dir=data, src=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2],
                                       context=8192, kv=None, model_name="gyro", family_def={}, log=h.base / "x.log", backend="sycl",
                                       pack_name="gyro-gyro-s")
            self.assertEqual(problems, [], problems)
            self.assertEqual(cfg["args"][cfg["args"].index("--ple-gguf") + 1], cfg["args"][cfg["args"].index("--native") + 1])
            _, refused = adopt.plan(family="nvfp4", model="NVFP4", model_dir=model_dir, data_dir=data, src=Path("."), context=8192, kv=None,
                                    model_name="x", family_def={}, log=h.base / "x.log", backend=None)
            self.assertTrue(refused[0].endswith("not for nvfp4"))                 # the caller adds the one full stop


class UpdateCheckNamesTheChoice(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_the_selected_package_is_printed_before_the_rejected_ones(self):
        from strata_cli import update_cmd
        report = {"feed": {"sequence": 107, "channel": "stable", "key_id": "k", "trusted_by": "built-in keys"},
                  "engine": {"status": "install", "installed": None, "download_bytes": 5 << 20,
                             "offered": {"version": "0.1.47", "platform": "linux-x86_64", "backend": "cuda", "variant": "cuda12"},
                             "reasons": ["0.1.47 linux-x86_64-cuda-cuda13 needs driver 580"], "note": None},
                  "control": {"status": "current", "installed": "0.1.47", "offered": None}, "app": {"status": "not-in-feed"}}

            update_cmd._print_check(report)

        self.assertLess(text.index("selected for this PC"), text.index("not used for this PC"))
