        self.assertIn("No active requests", idle_output.getvalue())

    def test_initial_attach_keeps_status_when_telemetry_is_unavailable(self):
        status_only = sanitize_telemetry(normalize_status_only(
            {"service": "strata", "model": "fixture", "loaded": False,
             "concurrency": {"serving": 4}}))

        class Source:
            root = "http://127.0.0.1:8095"

            def snapshot(self):
                return status_only

        async def exercise():
            app = MonitorApp(Source(), None, interval=30)
            async with app.run_test(size=(80, 24)) as pilot:
                await pilot.pause(0.1)
                self.assertEqual(app.connection_state, "telemetry_unavailable")
                self.assertTrue(app.has_snapshot)
                self.assertEqual(app.displayed["model"]["id"], "fixture")
                from rich.console import Console
                output = io.StringIO()
                console = Console(file=output, width=80, color_system=None)
                console.print(app.query_one("#content").content)
                self.assertIn("Telemetry unavailable; status only", output.getvalue())
                self.assertIn("NO MODEL LOADED", output.getvalue())
                await pilot.press("q")
        asyncio.run(exercise())

    def test_failed_poll_marks_stale_immediately_then_recovers(self):
        initial = four_gpu_snapshot()
        initial["sampled_at"] = time.time()
        initial["rates"]["answer_tok_s"] = 12
        initial["rates"]["output_tokens_server_counter"] = 100
        initial["instance"]["id"] = "same-instance"
        sample_time = initial["sampled_at"]

        class Source:
            root = "http://127.0.0.1:8095"
            calls = 0

            def snapshot(self):
                self.calls += 1
                if self.calls <= 3:
                    raise ClientError("temporarily unavailable", 3)
                result = four_gpu_snapshot()
                result["instance"]["id"] = "same-instance"
                result["sampled_at"] = sample_time + self.calls - 4
                result["rates"]["output_tokens_server_counter"] = 160 + 30 * (self.calls - 4)
                return result

        async def exercise():
            from rich.console import Console

            source = Source()
            app = MonitorApp(source, initial, interval=30)
            async with app.run_test(size=(80, 24)) as pilot:
                for expected in ("stale", "stale", "disconnected", "connected"):
                    app._schedule_poll(force=True)
                    await pilot.pause(0.1)
                    self.assertEqual(app.connection_state, expected)
                    output = io.StringIO()
                    Console(file=output, width=80, color_system=None).print(app.query_one("#content").content)
                    if expected == "disconnected":
                        self.assertIn("CONNECTION LOST", output.getvalue())
                        self.assertNotIn("GPU 0", output.getvalue())
                    if expected in ("stale", "disconnected"):
                        self.assertIsNone(app.history.batch_rows[-1])
                        self.assertIsNone(app.history.pre_admit[-1])
                        self.assertIsNone(app.history.device_util[0][-1])
                    if expected == "connected":
                        self.assertIn("GPU 0", output.getvalue())
                        self.assertNotIn("CONNECTION LOST", output.getvalue())
                self.assertEqual(source.calls, 4)
                self.assertEqual(app.failures, 0)
                self.assertIsNone(app.latest["rates"]["aggregate_output_tok_s"])
                app._schedule_poll(force=True)
                await pilot.pause(0.1)

    def test_initial_attach_shows_connecting_and_requires_manual_retry_after_auth(self):
        class Source:
            root = "http://127.0.0.1:8095"
            calls = 0

            def snapshot(self):
                self.calls += 1
                if self.calls == 1:
                    raise ClientError("credential required", 4)
                if self.calls == 2:
                    raise ClientError("unsupported telemetry schema", 5)
                result = four_gpu_snapshot()
                result["sampled_at"] = time.time()
                return result

        async def exercise():
            source = Source()
            app = MonitorApp(source, None, interval=30)

                app._schedule_poll()
                await pilot.pause(0.1)
                self.assertEqual(source.calls, 1)
                app._schedule_poll(force=True)
                await pilot.pause(0.1)
                self.assertEqual(app.connection_state, "incompatible")
                self.assertEqual(app.next_poll_at, float("inf"))
                app._schedule_poll(force=True)
                await pilot.pause(0.1)

        asyncio.run(exercise())

    def test_polling_has_one_in_flight_cycle_and_freeze_keeps_display(self):

    def test_aggregate_rate_uses_one_window_and_resets_on_restart(self):
        old = {"instance": {"id": "one"}, "sampled_at": 10.0,
               "rates": {"output_tokens_server_counter": 100}}
        fresh = {"instance": {"id": "one"}, "sampled_at": 12.0,
                 "rates": {"output_tokens_server_counter": 160}}
        self.assertEqual(with_aggregate_rate(old, fresh)["rates"]["aggregate_output_tok_s"], 30)
        restarted = {"instance": {"id": "two"}, "sampled_at": 14.0,
                     "rates": {"output_tokens_server_counter": 3}}
        self.assertIsNone(with_aggregate_rate(fresh, restarted)["rates"]["aggregate_output_tok_s"])
        invalid = {"instance": {"id": "one"}, "sampled_at": float("inf"),
                   "rates": {"output_tokens_server_counter": 190}}
        self.assertIsNone(with_aggregate_rate(fresh, invalid)["rates"]["aggregate_output_tok_s"])
        stale = {"instance": {"id": "one"}, "sampled_at": time.time() - 10,
                 "rates": {"output_tokens_server_counter": 100}}
        self.assertIsNone(MonitorApp(Endpoint("http://127.0.0.1:8080"), stale).rate_previous)

    def test_resize_keeps_selected_request_visible_in_tiny_serving_view(self):

                        self.assertNotIn("More: strata status --json", content)

    def test_filter_paste_is_bounded_clean_and_keeps_keyboard_focus(self):
        from textual.events import Paste
        from textual.widgets import Input

        async def exercise():
            snapshot = four_gpu_snapshot()
            snapshot["work"]["requests"] = [{"id": "r01", "state": "reading"},
                                               {"id": "r02", "state": "queued"}]

                self.assertIsNone(app.focused)
                shown = str(app.query_one("#content").render())
                self.assertIn("r01", shown)
                self.assertNotIn("r02", shown)
                await pilot.press("q")
                self.assertTrue(app.closing)
        asyncio.run(exercise())

## tests/terminal/test_terminal_commit.py

"""package_terminal.py must work where there is no git (the Docker build stage copies the sources without .git and the image has no git):
the commit comes from STRATA_BUILD_COMMIT, falls back to git when it exists, and is simply left out when neither answers."""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "packaging"))
import package_terminal  # noqa: E402

SHA = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567"


class SourceCommit(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_env_wins_and_is_lower_cased(self):
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_BUILD_COMMIT": " " + SHA.upper() + " "}), \
             mock.patch.object(package_terminal.subprocess, "run", side_effect=AssertionError("git must not run")):
            self.assertEqual(package_terminal.source_commit(), SHA)

    def test_no_git_installed_gives_empty_not_a_crash(self):
        env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k != "STRATA_BUILD_COMMIT"}
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, env, clear=True), \
             mock.patch.object(package_terminal.subprocess, "run", side_effect=FileNotFoundError("git")):
            self.assertEqual(package_terminal.source_commit(), "")

    def test_bad_env_value_falls_back_to_git(self):
        done = subprocess.CompletedProcess([], 0, stdout=SHA + "\n", stderr="")
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"STRATA_BUILD_COMMIT": "not-a-sha"}), \
             mock.patch.object(package_terminal.subprocess, "run", return_value=done):
            self.assertEqual(package_terminal.source_commit(), SHA)

    def test_not_a_checkout_gives_no_commit_file_value(self):
        done = subprocess.CompletedProcess([], 128, stdout="", stderr="fatal: not a git repository")
        env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k != "STRATA_BUILD_COMMIT"}
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, env, clear=True), \
             mock.patch.object(package_terminal.subprocess, "run", return_value=done):
            self.assertEqual(package_terminal.source_commit(), "")


class DockerPassesTheCommit(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_dockerfile_turns_the_build_arg_into_the_env_the_packager_reads(self):
        text = (ROOT / "docker" / "Dockerfile").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertRegex(text, r"ARG STRATA_COMMIT")
        self.assertRegex(text, r"ENV STRATA_BUILD_COMMIT=\$\{STRATA_COMMIT\}")
        self.assertLess(text.index("ENV STRATA_BUILD_COMMIT"), text.index("RUN python3 /src/packaging/package_terminal.py"))

    def test_build_sh_passes_the_commit(self):
        text = (ROOT / "docker" / "build.sh").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn('--build-arg "STRATA_COMMIT=$commit"', text)

    def test_the_packager_reads_the_same_name(self):
        self.assertIn("STRATA_BUILD_COMMIT", (ROOT / "packaging" / "package_terminal.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertTrue(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", SHA))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_terminal_polish.py

"""Terminal polish (0.2.1): "already downloaded" instead of a fake download, and `strata monitor` finding a running launch."""

import io
import json
import os
import unittest
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from unittest import mock

from strata_cli.cli import main
from strata_cli.launch.runner import download_text


class AlreadyDownloaded(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_model_on_disk_is_not_called_a_download(self):
        dl = {"done_gb": 58.5, "total_gb": 58.5, "percent": 100.0}
        self.assertEqual(download_text(dl, True), "The model files are already on this computer (58.5 GB); checking them")

    def test_a_real_download_keeps_its_numbers(self):
        dl = {"done_gb": 12.0, "total_gb": 58.5, "percent": 20.5}
        self.assertEqual(download_text(dl, False), "Downloading 12.0 of 58.5 GB")
        self.assertEqual(download_text(dl, False, "Downloading the draft layer"), "Downloading the draft layer: 12.0 of 58.5 GB")


class MonitorFindsLaunch(unittest.TestCase):
    def _run(self, argv, info, env=None):
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, env or {}, clear=False), \
                mock.patch("strata_cli.launch.cmd.launch_info", return_value=info), \
                mock.patch("strata_cli.monitor_commands.Endpoint") as endpoint:
            os.environ.pop("STRATA_URL", None) if not env else None
            endpoint.return_value.snapshot.return_value = {"schema_version": 1}
            out = io.StringIO()
            with redirect_stdout(out):
                main(argv)
        return endpoint

    def test_no_url_uses_the_running_launch_and_its_key(self):
        info = {"running": True, "url": "http://127.0.0.1:8080", "key": "launch-key"}
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=False):
            os.environ.pop("STRATA_API_KEY", None)
            endpoint = self._run(["monitor", "--once", "--quiet"], info)
        args = endpoint.call_args[0]
        self.assertEqual(args[0], "http://127.0.0.1:8080")
        self.assertEqual(args[1], "launch-key")

    def test_an_explicit_url_wins(self):
        info = {"running": True, "url": "http://127.0.0.1:8080", "key": "k"}
        endpoint = self._run(["monitor", "--once", "--quiet", "--url", "http://127.0.0.1:9999"], info)
        self.assertEqual(endpoint.call_args[0][0], "http://127.0.0.1:9999")

    def test_nothing_running_keeps_the_default_address(self):
        endpoint = self._run(["monitor", "--once", "--quiet"], None)
        self.assertEqual(endpoint.call_args[0][0], "http://127.0.0.1:8095")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_tls_trust.py

"""#3722: HTTPS downloads check the server against the operating system's certificates (truststore), fall back to certifi, and a
certificate that still fails gives a plain explanation, never the raw urlopen text and never a way to skip the check."""

import ssl
import sys
import types
import unittest
import urllib.error
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from strata_control import tls  # noqa: E402

RAW = ("<urlopen error [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate "
       "(_ssl.c:1010)>")


def cert_error():
    inner = ssl.SSLCertVerificationError(1, "[SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate")
    return urllib.error.URLError(inner)


class Install(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.mode = tls.mode
        self.context = ssl._create_default_https_context
        tls.mode = None
        self.addCleanup(self.restore)

    def restore(self):
        tls.mode = self.mode
        ssl._create_default_https_context = self.context

    def test_truststore_is_used_when_present(self):
        fake = types.SimpleNamespace(calls=0)
        fake.inject_into_ssl = lambda: setattr(fake, "calls", fake.calls + 1)
        with mock.patch.dict(sys.modules, {"truststore": fake}):
            self.assertEqual(tls.install(), "truststore")
            self.assertEqual(tls.install(), "truststore")          # again: nothing more happens
        self.assertEqual(fake.calls, 1)

    def test_certifi_is_the_fallback_when_truststore_is_missing(self):
        seen = {}
        fake_certifi = types.SimpleNamespace(where=lambda: "bundle.pem")
        with mock.patch.dict(sys.modules, {"truststore": None, "certifi": fake_certifi}), \
                mock.patch.object(ssl, "create_default_context", lambda cafile=None, **k: seen.setdefault("cafile", cafile)):
            self.assertEqual(tls.install(), "certifi")
            ssl._create_default_https_context()
        self.assertEqual(seen["cafile"], "bundle.pem")

    def test_python_default_stays_when_neither_exists(self):
        with mock.patch.dict(sys.modules, {"truststore": None, "certifi": None}):
            self.assertEqual(tls.install(), "default")
        self.assertIs(ssl._create_default_https_context, self.context)

    def test_the_pins_name_truststore_in_requirements_and_every_lock(self):
        self.assertIn("truststore==", (ROOT / "requirements.txt").read_text())
        for lock in (ROOT / "packaging" / "locks").glob("runtime-*-cp312.txt"):
            text = lock.read_text()
            self.assertRegex(text, r"truststore==\S+ \\r?\n\s+--hash=sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}", lock.name)
            self.assertIn("certifi==", text)                       # the fallback stays


class Plain(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_failed_certificate_is_recognised_however_it_is_wrapped(self):
        self.assertTrue(tls.is_certificate_error(cert_error()))
        self.assertTrue(tls.is_certificate_error(OSError(RAW)))
        wrapped = RuntimeError("x")
        wrapped.__cause__ = cert_error()
        self.assertTrue(tls.is_certificate_error(wrapped))
        self.assertFalse(tls.is_certificate_error(urllib.error.URLError(ConnectionRefusedError())))
        self.assertFalse(tls.is_certificate_error(None))

    def test_the_message_is_plain_and_never_offers_to_skip_the_check(self):
        text = tls.explain("github.com")
        for word in ("github.com", "antivirus", "proxy", "date and time", "Windows Update"):
            self.assertIn(word, text)
        for raw in ("urlopen", "CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED", "_ssl.c", "issuer"):
            self.assertNotIn(raw, text)
        self.assertRegex(text, r"will not skip the check")
        self.assertNotRegex(text.lower(), r"verify\s*=\s*false|insecure|disable (the )?verification|turn off (the )?(certificate|verification)")

    def test_setup_urlopen_raises_the_plain_problem(self):
        import setup
        request = types.SimpleNamespace(full_url="https://github.com/x/y")
        with mock.patch.object(setup.acquisition, "require", lambda *a, **k: None), \
                mock.patch.object(setup.urllib.request, "urlopen", side_effect=cert_error()):
            with self.assertRaises(tls.CertificateProblem) as cm:
                setup._urlopen(request)
        self.assertIn("github.com", str(cm.exception))
        self.assertNotIn("CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED", str(cm.exception))

    def test_setup_urlopen_leaves_other_errors_alone(self):
        import setup
        refused = urllib.error.URLError(ConnectionRefusedError())
        with mock.patch.object(setup.acquisition, "require", lambda *a, **k: None), \
                mock.patch.object(setup.urllib.request, "urlopen", side_effect=refused):
            with self.assertRaises(urllib.error.URLError):
                setup._urlopen(types.SimpleNamespace(full_url="https://github.com/x"))

    def test_the_update_reader_gives_the_plain_message(self):
        from strata_control import transfer
        with mock.patch.object(transfer, "check_url_policy", lambda url: None), \
                mock.patch.object(transfer._opener, "open", side_effect=cert_error()):
            with self.assertRaises(transfer.TransferError) as cm:
                transfer.read_small("https://updates.example.org/feed.json")
        self.assertIn("antivirus", str(cm.exception))
        self.assertNotIn("urlopen", str(cm.exception))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_tui2_023_install.py

"""0.2.3 RC stress test: #11 (A01b/A05) an install from an older feed shows the real reason with both sequence numbers, the folder that holds the
old state and one next step, and the installer prints the whole cause; #12 (A04) the Windows installer unpacks into a folder whose name has
accented letters."""

import hashlib
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

from strata_control import feed as feedmod, updater
from tests.terminal import test_updater

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
INSTALL_PS1 = ROOT / "packaging" / "install.ps1"
POWERSHELL = shutil.which("powershell") if os.name == "nt" else None


class ReplayedFeedWords(test_updater.UpdaterCase):
    def test_the_refusal_gives_both_numbers_the_folder_and_one_next_step(self):
        self.publish(("0.1.46", test_updater.fx.GOOD_ENGINE), sequence=108)
        updater.check(self.ctx())                                      # accepts sequence 108 and remembers it
        self.publish(("0.1.46", test_updater.fx.GOOD_ENGINE), sequence=107)
        with self.assertRaises(feedmod.FeedDowngrade) as caught:
            updater.check(self.ctx())
        text = str(caught.exception)
        self.assertIn("older than the one already accepted", text)
        self.assertIn("its sequence is 107", text)
        self.assertIn("the accepted one is 108", text)
        self.assertIn(str(self.components / ".updates"), text)
        self.assertIn("state.json", text)
        self.assertEqual(text.count("Use the newest release folder"), 1)


def stub_release(folder: Path, body: str) -> str:
    folder.mkdir(parents=True)
    archive = folder / "terminal.zip"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        z.writestr("strata-terminal-0.1.48-windows-x86_64/bin/strata.cmd", body)
        z.writestr("strata-terminal-0.1.48-windows-x86_64/strata.py", "# stub\n")
    (folder / "install-manifest.txt").write_text(
        f"windows-x86_64 0.1.48 terminal.zip {hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} {archive.stat().st_size}\n")
    return "file:///" + folder.as_posix()


@unittest.skipUnless(POWERSHELL, "the Windows installer runs only on Windows")
class WindowsInstaller(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="strata-inst-")
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)

    def run_installer(self, feed: str, data: Path):
        runner = self.root / "run.ps1"
        runner.write_text("$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'\n"
                          f"$env:STRATA_FEED = '{feed}'; $env:STRATA_DATA_DIR = '{data}'; $env:STRATA_NO_PATH = '1'\n"
                          f"try {{ Invoke-Expression (Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath '{INSTALL_PS1}') }} catch {{ Write-Host \"STOPPED\" }}\n",
                          encoding="utf-8-sig")
        done = subprocess.run([POWERSHELL, "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File", str(runner)], capture_output=True, text=True,
                              encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=300)
        return done.stdout + done.stderr

    def test_a_folder_with_accented_letters_is_unpacked(self):
        feed = stub_release(self.root / "feed", "@echo off\r\nexit /b 0\r\n")
        data = self.root / "Ünï test"
        out = self.run_installer(feed, data)
        self.assertIn("Installed. Run: strata launch", out, out)
        self.assertTrue((data / "terminal" / "0.1.48" / "bin" / "strata.cmd").is_file())
        self.assertEqual([p.name for p in (data / "terminal").iterdir() if p.name.startswith("u") and p.suffix in ("", ".zip")], [])

    def test_the_whole_cause_is_printed_not_the_first_six_lines(self):
        lines = ["echo strata update: this update source is older than the one already accepted (its sequence is 107, the accepted one is 108)."]
        lines += [f"echo detail {i}" for i in range(2, 9)] + ["echo the last line of the cause"]
        feed = stub_release(self.root / "feed2", "@echo off\r\n" + "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\nexit /b 5\r\n")
        out = self.run_installer(feed, self.root / "data")
        self.assertIn("the last line of the cause", out)
        self.assertIn("its sequence is 107", out)
        self.assertIn("The reason is printed above", out)
        self.assertIn("STOPPED", out)
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "data" / "terminal" / "0.1.48").exists(), "nothing is installed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_tui2_023_messages.py

"""0.2.3 RC stress test: X01 (a failed engine test start gives a plain cause and one next step, not the engine's words) and #18 (the rollback text
never says "0.1.45.3 -> 0.1.45.3")."""

import json
import unittest

from strata_control import updater
from tests.terminal import test_updater
from tests.terminal import update_fixture as fx


class TestStartText(unittest.TestCase):
    RAW = "it did not answer a one-token probe (server_exited) | CUDA error: out of memory at gr.cu:123 | stack"

    def test_the_engines_words_stay_out_of_the_sentence(self):
        err = updater.TestStartFailed("0.1.48", "it did not answer a one-token probe (server_exited)")
        text = str(err)
        self.assertIn("did not start correctly on this computer", text)
        self.assertIn("so it was not installed", text)
        self.assertIn("Your current engine is unchanged", text)
        self.assertIn("The engine started but stopped before it answered a test question.", text)
        self.assertIn("`strata update --force`", text)
        self.assertNotIn("server_exited", text)
        self.assertNotIn("probe", text)
        self.assertEqual(err.reason, "it did not answer a one-token probe (server_exited)")      # kept for the state file and the JSON
        self.assertEqual(err.exit_code, 6)

    def test_a_busy_card_says_so_and_asks_for_a_plain_retry(self):
        err = updater.TestStartFailed("0.1.48", "CUDA error: out of memory")
        self.assertTrue(err.busy)
        self.assertIn("graphics card or memory looks busy", str(err))
        self.assertNotIn("CUDA", str(err))
        self.assertNotIn("--force", str(err))

    def test_an_engine_that_would_not_run_and_a_missing_model(self):
        self.assertIn("The engine program did not run on this computer.", str(updater.TestStartFailed("0.1.48", "--version exited 3: dll missing")))
        self.assertNotIn("dll missing", str(updater.TestStartFailed("0.1.48", "--version exited 3: dll missing")))
        self.assertIn("no installed model", str(updater.TestStartFailed("0.1.48", "no installed model to test with")).lower())

    def test_control_is_called_control(self):
        text = str(updater.TestStartFailed("Control 0.1.48", "--version said 'oops' (exit 7)"))
        self.assertTrue(text.startswith("The new Control 0.1.48 did not start correctly"), text)
        self.assertIn("Your current Control is unchanged.", text)
        self.assertNotIn("engine", text)


class RollbackText(test_updater.UpdaterCase):
    def test_from_names_the_version_that_is_left(self):
        self.install_current()
        self.publish(("0.1.46", fx.GOOD_ENGINE))
        updater.run_update(self.ctx(), control=False)
        out = updater.rollback_engine(self.ctx())
        self.assertEqual((out["from"], out["to"]), ("0.1.46", "0.1.45"))
        self.assertNotEqual(out["from"], out["to"])

    def test_a_second_rollback_says_there_is_nothing_older_instead_of_the_same_version_twice(self):
        self.install_current()
        self.publish(("0.1.46", fx.GOOD_ENGINE))
        updater.run_update(self.ctx(), control=False)
        updater.rollback_engine(self.ctx())
        state = self.components / ".updates" / "state.json"
        data = json.loads(state.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        data["engine"]["previous"] = data["engine"]["pinned"]          # the stale state a second run can meet
        state.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(updater.UpdateError, "already the previous one .0.1.45.*strata update --force"):
            updater.rollback_engine(self.ctx())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_tui2_023_old_launcher.py

"""0.2.3 RC stress test, #4 (H03): a Terminal that cannot hand over to a newer Control is told so instead of being told "updated"."""

import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from strata_cli import handover

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


class OldLauncherIsToldTheTruth(unittest.TestCase):
    """The Terminals before 0.2.1.3 have no hand-over. Their updater test-starts the staged Control with `--version`, with
    STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE=1 and without STRATA_HANDOVER: this Control refuses that start in one plain sentence."""

    def staged_tree(self, parent=".s"):
        base = Path(self.enterContext(tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="strata-stage-"))) / parent / "ab12"
        base.mkdir(parents=True)
        shutil.copy2(ROOT / "strata.py", base / "strata.py")
        for package in ("strata_cli", "strata_control"):
            shutil.copytree(ROOT / package, base / package, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__"))
        return base

    def run_version(self, tree, **env):
        base = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("STRATA_")}
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(tree / "strata.py"), "--version"], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=str(tree),
                              env={**base, "PYTHONNOUSERSITE": "1", **env})

    def test_an_old_updaters_test_start_is_refused_with_one_plain_sentence(self):
        done = self.run_version(self.staged_tree(), STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE="1")
        self.assertEqual(done.returncode, handover.OLD_LAUNCHER_EXIT)
        self.assertEqual(done.stdout.strip(), handover.OLD_LAUNCHER_TEXT)
        self.assertLessEqual(len(handover.OLD_LAUNCHER_TEXT), 120, "the old updater shows only the first 120 characters")
        self.assertNotIn("'", handover.OLD_LAUNCHER_TEXT)

    def test_the_current_updaters_test_start_and_a_normal_start_are_not_touched(self):
        tree = self.staged_tree()
        for env in ({"STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE": "1", "STRATA_HANDOVER": "1"}, {}):
            done = self.run_version(tree, **env)
            self.assertEqual(done.returncode, 0, done.stderr)
            self.assertTrue(done.stdout.startswith("strata 0.2.4.1 (build "), done.stdout)
        elsewhere = self.staged_tree(parent="terminal")                       # not the updater's staging folder
        self.assertEqual(self.run_version(elsewhere, STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE="1").returncode, 0)

    def test_only_a_bare_version_start_is_refused(self):
        tree = self.staged_tree()
        self.assertIsNone(handover.refuse_old_updater(["status"], {"STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE": "1"}, tree))
        self.assertEqual(handover.refuse_old_updater(["--version"], {"STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE": "1"}, tree), handover.OLD_LAUNCHER_EXIT)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_tui2_023_plan.py

"""0.2.3 RC stress test: #6 (A07/B03) the download size counts the draft layer and the picture reader, B03 `--plan` does not call an installed
engine missing, B10/E04 `--drafting off` leaves `--mtp <path>` out of the written config."""

import unittest
from unittest import mock

from strata_cli.launch import modelstate, settings as S
from strata_cli.launch.runner import Runner, derive_config
from strata_control import engine_component
from tests.terminal.launch_support import HW_12, Home, catalog


class DownloadSize(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.home = Home().__enter__()
        self.addCleanup(self.home.__exit__, None, None, None)

    def runner(self, **kw):
        values = dict(family="gyro", model="Gyro-S", context=32768, vision="cpu")
        values.update(kw)
        return Runner(S.LaunchSettings(**values), catalog=catalog(HW_12))

    def test_gyro_s_counts_the_model_the_draft_layer_and_the_picture_reader(self):
        runner = self.runner()
        state = runner.model_state()
        self.assertEqual([p.kind for p in state.parts], ["weights", "mtp", "mmproj"])
        self.assertAlmostEqual(state.remaining_gb, 58.5 + 5.2 + 0.9, places=1)
        title, text = runner.download_question()
        self.assertEqual(title, "Download about 65 GB?")
        plan = runner.download_plan()
        self.assertEqual([p["kind"] for p in plan["parts"]], ["weights", "mtp", "mmproj"])
        self.assertAlmostEqual(plan["gb"], 64.6, places=1)
        self.assertIn("the draft layer (5.2 GB)", plan["text"])

    def test_what_the_person_turns_off_is_not_counted(self):
        self.assertEqual([p.kind for p in self.runner(vision="off").model_state().parts], ["weights", "mtp"])
        self.assertEqual([p.kind for p in self.runner(mtp="off").model_state().parts], ["weights", "mmproj"])
        self.assertEqual([p.kind for p in self.runner(drafting="off").model_state().parts], ["weights", "mmproj"])
        self.assertAlmostEqual(self.runner(vision="off", mtp="off").model_state().remaining_gb, 58.5, places=1)

    def test_the_other_families_that_get_helpers_count_the_same(self):
        for family, model in (("qwen", "Q2_0"), ("swift", "IQ2_XS"), ("coder", "IQ3_XXS")):
            kinds = [p.kind for p in self.runner(family=family, model=model).model_state().parts]
            self.assertEqual(kinds, ["weights", "mtp", "mmproj"], family)

    def test_setup_is_told_the_draft_layer_is_off_for_drafting_off(self):
        args = self.runner(drafting="off").setup_args()
        self.assertEqual(args[args.index("--mtp") + 1], "off")
        self.assertTrue(modelstate.HELPER_FAMILIES.count("gyro"))


class PlanEngine(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.home = Home().__enter__()
        self.addCleanup(self.home.__exit__, None, None, None)

    def plan(self, report):
        runner = Runner(S.LaunchSettings(family="gyro", model="Gyro-S", context=32768, vision="off"), catalog=catalog(HW_12))
        with mock.patch.object(engine_component, "status", return_value=report):
            return runner.download_plan()

    def test_an_engine_that_is_installed_but_unusable_is_not_called_missing(self):
        out = self.plan({"usable": False, "installed": [{"version": "0.1.48"}], "notice": "x"})
        self.assertIs(out["engine_missing"], False)
        self.assertIs(out["engine_usable"], False)
        self.assertIn("An engine (0.1.48) is installed", out["text"])
        self.assertNotIn("downloaded first", out["text"])

    def test_no_engine_at_all_is_missing_and_a_usable_one_is_neither(self):
        out = self.plan({"usable": False, "installed": []})
        self.assertIs(out["engine_missing"], True)
        self.assertIn("downloaded first", out["text"])
        ok = self.plan({"usable": True, "installed": [{"version": "0.1.48"}]})
        self.assertEqual((ok["engine_missing"], ok["engine_usable"]), (False, True))


class DraftingOffConfig(unittest.TestCase):
    BASE = {"exe": "component:strata-engine", "port": 8080, "model_name": "m", "env": {},
            "args": ["--native", "x.gguf", "--spec", "4", "--spec-min-p", "0.5", "--mtp", "/m/rt"]}

    def test_drafting_off_writes_no_mtp_path(self):
        cfg = derive_config(self.BASE, S.LaunchSettings(drafting="off"), bool_flags=frozenset())
        self.assertIs(cfg["mtp"], False)
        self.assertEqual(cfg["drafting"], "off")
        for flag in ("--mtp", "--spec-min-p"):
            self.assertNotIn(flag, cfg["args"])
        self.assertIn("--mtp", self.BASE["args"])

    def test_auto_and_mtp_keep_the_draft_layer(self):
        for mode in ("auto", "mtp", None):
            cfg = derive_config(self.BASE, S.LaunchSettings(drafting=mode), bool_flags=frozenset())
            self.assertIn("--mtp", cfg["args"], mode)

    def test_an_installed_config_that_already_says_off_stays_off(self):
        cfg = derive_config({**self.BASE, "drafting": "off"}, S.LaunchSettings(), bool_flags=frozenset())
        self.assertNotIn("--mtp", cfg["args"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


## tests/terminal/test_tui2_023_shards.py

"""0.2.3 RC stress test #9 (C05, #3478): a missing shard is named, with its file name, in the CLI and in the TUI's own-files message."""

from strata_control import models
from tests.terminal.test_own_files import Base, Q2


class MissingShardIsNamed(Base):
    def test_the_plan_names_the_missing_second_shard(self):
        folder = self.put(self.base / "half", Q2[:1], ["Q2_0"])
        plan = models.plan_import(str(folder))
        self.assertEqual(plan["issues"], ["incomplete_or_invalid_shard_set"])
        self.assertEqual(len(plan["missing_shards"]), 1)
        name = plan["missing_shards"][0]
        self.assertRegex(name, r"-00002-of-0000[0-9]\.gguf$")
        self.assertEqual(models.problem_words(plan["issues"], missing=plan["missing_shards"]), f"{name} is missing")
        self.assertEqual(plan["plain_issues"], [f"{name} is missing"])

    def test_without_a_name_the_old_sentence_stays(self):
        self.assertEqual(models.problem_words(["incomplete_or_invalid_shard_set"]), "some parts of the model are missing")

    def test_several_missing_shards_are_counted(self):
        self.assertEqual(models.missing_words(["a-00002-of-00004.gguf", "a-00003-of-00004.gguf"]),
                         "a-00002-of-00004.gguf and a-00003-of-00004.gguf are missing")
        self.assertEqual(models.missing_words(["a-2", "a-3", "a-4", "a-5"]), "a-2, a-3 and 2 more files are missing")

    def test_launch_plan_message_carries_the_file_name(self):
        from tests.terminal.launch_support import run_cli
        folder = self.put(self.base / "half2", Q2[:1], ["Q2_0"])
        code, out, err = run_cli(["launch", "--plan", "--model-path", str(folder)])
        self.assertNotEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertRegex(err + out, r"-00002-of-0000[0-9]\.gguf is missing")


## tests/terminal/test_tui2_023_versions.py

"""0.2.3 RC stress test, #3 (H01): the version bump is complete and consistent, and a 0.2.2 install sees the update."""

import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

import strata_cli
from strata_control import feed as feedmod, updater
from tests.terminal import test_updater

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


def first(path, pattern):
    return re.search(pattern, (ROOT / path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"), re.MULTILINE).group(1)


class VersionBump(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_the_terminal_is_0_2_4_1_and_control_is_0_1_49_1_while_the_app_stays_0_2_3(self):
        # 0.2.4 is a Terminal / Control and engine release (DeepSeek V4.1-Flash): the app stays 0.2.3, the three DeepSeek engine packages are 0.1.49,
        # the other engine packages stay 0.1.48 (metal/CMakeLists.txt keeps 0.1.48)
        self.assertEqual(strata_cli.PRODUCT_VERSION, "0.2.4.1")
        self.assertEqual(strata_cli.version(), "0.1.49.1")                # the CMake project version: Control
        self.assertEqual(first("CMakeLists.txt", r"^project\(strata VERSION ([0-9.]+) "), "0.1.49.1")
        self.assertIn('STRATA_VERSION="0.1.48-metal"', (ROOT / "metal" / "CMakeLists.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    def test_every_place_the_app_version_lives_says_0_2_3(self):
        self.assertEqual(first("apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml", r'^version = "([^"]+)"'), "0.2.3")
        lock = (ROOT / "apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertRegex(lock, r'name = "strata-desktop"\r?\nversion = "0.2.3"')
        self.assertEqual(json.loads((ROOT / "apps/desktop/package.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["version"], "0.2.3")
        host = json.loads((ROOT / "apps/host/package.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertEqual(host["version"], "0.2.3")
        locked = json.loads((ROOT / "apps/host/package-lock.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertEqual((locked["version"], locked["packages"][""]["version"]), ("0.2.3", "0.2.3"))

    def test_the_documents_that_state_the_current_version_agree(self):
        self.assertIn("Version 0.2.3, engine 0.1.48.", (ROOT / "AGENTS.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        for name in ("README.md", "README.de.md", "README.es.md", "README.fr.md", "README.ja.md", "README.pt-BR.md", "README.zh-CN.md"):
            text = (ROOT / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertIn("0.2.3 · ", text, name)
            self.assertIn("0.1.48", text, name)
            self.assertNotIn("Strata-0.2.2-", text, name)

    def test_version_prints_the_product_and_the_build(self):
        done = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / "strata.py"), "--version"], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=str(ROOT),
                              env={**os.environ, "STRATA_NO_HANDOVER": "1"})
        self.assertTrue(done.stdout.startswith("strata 0.2.4.1 (build 0.1.49.1;"), done.stdout)


class UpdateFromTheLastRelease(test_updater.UpdaterCase):
    def feed_with_control(self, version):
        bundle = self.root / "control-bundle"
        (bundle / "strata_control").mkdir(parents=True)
        (bundle / "strata.py").write_text(f"print('strata 0.2.3 (build {version})')\n")
        (bundle / "strata_control" / "__init__.py").write_text("")
        from feed_tool import build_feed, pack_control
        (self.release / "control").mkdir()
        pack_control(bundle, self.release / "control", version=version, platform=test_updater.PLATFORM)
        build_feed(self.release, key=self.key, sequence=1, control_dir=self.release / "control")

    def test_a_0_2_2_install_is_offered_control_0_1_48_and_a_0_2_3_install_is_current(self):
        self.feed_with_control("0.1.48")
        (self.components / "control").mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.components / "control" / "active.json").write_text(json.dumps({"version": "0.1.47", "folder": "0.1.47"}))
        report = updater.check(self.ctx())
        self.assertEqual((report["control"]["status"], report["control"]["installed"], report["control"]["offered"]),
                         ("available", "0.1.47", "0.1.48"))
        out = updater.run_update(self.ctx(), engine=False, control=True)
        self.assertEqual((out["exit_code"], out["results"][0]["status"]), (0, "updated"), out)
        self.assertEqual(updater.active_control(self.components)["version"], "0.1.48")
        self.assertEqual(updater.check(self.ctx())["control"]["status"], "current")

    def test_the_bumped_numbers_sort_above_the_last_release(self):
        self.assertGreater(feedmod.version_key(strata_cli.version()), feedmod.version_key("0.1.47"))
        self.assertGreater(feedmod.version_key("0.1.48"), feedmod.version_key("0.1.46.3"))
        self.assertGreater(feedmod.version_key("0.1.48"), feedmod.version_key("0.1.45.3"))


## tests/terminal/test_tui3.py

"""Fixes after the TUI stress re-run on 67a48427b: a failed start cleans up and quotes this attempt's logs, the Folder text, the save/restart order,
the saved config without --mtp when drafting is off, and the reused-pack line."""

import json
import os
import socket
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from strata_cli.launch import settings as S
from strata_cli.launch import runner as R
from strata_cli.launch.catalog import Catalog
from strata_cli.launch.runner import LaunchError, Runner
from tests.terminal.launch_support import HW_12, Home, catalog


class FailedStart(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.home = Home().__enter__()
        self.addCleanup(self.home.__exit__, None, None, None)
        p = mock.patch.object(Catalog, "hardware", lambda self, fresh=False: dict(HW_12, disk_free_gb=500.0))
        p.start()
        self.addCleanup(p.stop)
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.base = Path(self.tmp.name)

    def runner(self, port=8080):
        s = S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="IQ3_XXS", context=32768, name="gyro", port=port)
        r = Runner(s, catalog=catalog())
        r.said = []
        r.emit_cb = lambda e: r.said.append(e.text)
        return r

    def test_a_busy_port_is_said_before_anything_starts(self):
        with socket.socket() as srv:
            srv.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
            srv.listen(1)
            port = srv.getsockname()[1]
            r = self.runner(port)
            with mock.patch("strata_control.runtime.status", return_value={"state": "stopped"}), \
                 mock.patch("strata_control.runtime.start", side_effect=AssertionError("must not start")):
                with self.assertRaises(LaunchError) as cm:
                    r.start()
        self.assertIn(f"Port {port} is already in use by another program.", cm.exception.text)
        self.assertIn("--port", cm.exception.next)

    def test_the_cause_comes_from_this_attempts_server_log_not_the_old_engine_log(self):
        engine = self.base / "engine.log"
        server = self.base / "srv.log"
        engine.write_text("strata verify: captured the 2-token window\nlong ago error: old cause\n")
        server.write_text("")
        cfg = self.base / "cfg.json"
        cfg.write_text(json.dumps({"log": str(engine)}))
        marks = {str(engine): engine.stat().st_size, str(server): 0}
        with open(server, "a") as f:
            f.write("server.py: error: port 8190 is already in use - is Strata (or another server) already running?\n")
        text, nxt = R.explain_engine_exit({"state": "failed", "error": "server_exited", "engine_exit_code": 2}, cfg, marks=marks, server_log=server)
        self.assertIn("Port 8190 is already in use by another program.", text)
        self.assertIn("--port 8191", nxt)
        self.assertNotIn("old cause", text + nxt)
        self.assertNotIn("captured the 2-token", text + nxt)

    def test_an_old_engine_log_is_never_quoted_when_this_attempt_wrote_nothing(self):
        engine = self.base / "engine.log"
        engine.write_text("error: from the earlier successful run\n")
        cfg = self.base / "cfg.json"
        cfg.write_text(json.dumps({"log": str(engine)}))
        marks = {str(engine): engine.stat().st_size}
        text, _ = R.explain_engine_exit({"state": "failed", "error": "server_exited"}, cfg, marks=marks, server_log=None)
        self.assertNotIn("earlier successful run", text)

    def test_a_failed_start_ends_its_own_host(self):
        r = self.runner()
        r.config_path = None
        calls = []
        with mock.patch("strata_control.runtime.status", return_value={"state": "stopped"}), \
             mock.patch.object(Runner, "check_port_free"), \
             mock.patch("strata_control.runtime.start", return_value={"ok": False, "state": "failed", "error": "server_exited", "engine_exit_code": 2}), \
             mock.patch("strata_control.runtime.stop", side_effect=lambda n, timeout=0: calls.append(("stop", n))), \
             mock.patch("strata_control.runtime.cleanup", side_effect=lambda n=None: calls.append(("cleanup", n))):
            with self.assertRaises(LaunchError):
                r.start()
        self.assertEqual(calls, [("stop", "launch-gyro"), ("cleanup", "launch-gyro")])

    def test_a_start_that_raises_also_ends_its_host(self):
        r = self.runner()
        calls = []
        with mock.patch("strata_control.runtime.status", return_value={"state": "stopped"}), \
             mock.patch.object(Runner, "check_port_free"), \
             mock.patch("strata_control.runtime.start", side_effect=RuntimeError("runtime host failed to start")), \
             mock.patch("strata_control.runtime.stop", side_effect=lambda n, timeout=0: calls.append("stop")), \
             mock.patch("strata_control.runtime.cleanup", side_effect=lambda n=None: calls.append("cleanup")):
            with self.assertRaises(LaunchError):
                r.start()
        self.assertEqual(calls, ["stop", "cleanup"])


class FolderChangeMovesNothing(unittest.TestCase):
    """The Folder step text: changing the folder never moves the models Strata already keeps (only --move-data / strata models move do)."""

    def setUp(self):
        self.home = Home().__enter__()
        self.addCleanup(self.home.__exit__, None, None, None)
        p = mock.patch.object(Catalog, "hardware", lambda self, fresh=False: dict(HW_12, disk_free_gb=500.0))
        p.start()
        self.addCleanup(p.stop)

    def test_start_passes_no_move_flag_unless_asked(self):
        s = S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="IQ3_XXS", context=32768, data_dir=str(self.home.base / "new"))
        self.assertNotIn("--move-data", Runner(s, catalog=catalog()).setup_args())
        self.assertIn("--move-data", Runner(s, catalog=catalog(), move_data=True).setup_args())

    def test_setup_keeps_the_existing_models_where_they_are(self):
        import contextlib
        import io
        import setup
        base = self.home.base
        old, new, root = base / "old-data", base / "new-data", base / "Strata"
        root.mkdir()
        weights = old / "models" / "Q2_0" / "w.gguf"
        weights.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        weights.write_bytes(b"x" * 100)
        env = {"APPDATA": str(base / "appdata"), "XDG_CONFIG_HOME": str(base / "appdata")}
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, env), mock.patch.object(setup, "ROOT", root), mock.patch.object(setup, "_CONTROL_HOME", None):
            os.environ.pop("STRATA_SETTINGS_FILE", None)
            setup.settings_path().parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            setup.settings_path().write_text(json.dumps({"data_dir": str(old), "installs": []}), encoding="utf-8")
            with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
                setup.data_folder(str(new), move=False, yes=True, set_default=True)
        self.assertTrue(weights.is_file())
        self.assertFalse((new / "models").exists())

    def test_the_screen_text_says_they_stay(self):
        src = open(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(R.__file__), "screens.py"), encoding="utf-8").read()
        self.assertIn("stay there and keep working", src)
        self.assertNotIn("are moved into this folder when you start", src)


class SaveWaitsForRestartAnswer(unittest.TestCase):
    """Save as a preset and launch: nothing is saved before the restart question is answered Restart."""

    def _runner(self, **kw):
        s = S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="IQ3_XXS", context=32768, name="gyro")
        return Runner(s, catalog=catalog(), **kw)

    def setUp(self):
        self.home = Home().__enter__()
        self.addCleanup(self.home.__exit__, None, None, None)
        p = mock.patch.object(Catalog, "hardware", lambda self, fresh=False: dict(HW_12, disk_free_gb=500.0))
        p.start()
        self.addCleanup(p.stop)

    def rows(self, r):
        return [{"profile": "launch-gyro", "name": "gyro", "port": 8080,
                 "choices": {**r.choices(), "context": 65536, "family": "qwen", "model": "IQ3_XXS"}}]

    def test_cancel_saves_nothing_and_the_question_names_the_running_model(self):
        saved, asked = [], []
        r = self._runner(confirm_restart=lambda q, d: asked.append((q, d)) or False, after_check=lambda: saved.append(1))
        with mock.patch.object(Runner, "serving_launches", lambda self: self.rows_):
            Runner.rows_ = self.rows(r)
            with self.assertRaises(LaunchError):
                r.run()
        self.assertEqual(saved, [])
        self.assertIn("is running on port 8080 with 64K. Restart it with these settings?", asked[0][0])
        self.assertIn("IQ3_XXS", asked[0][0])
        self.assertEqual(asked[0][1], "Answers in progress stop.")

    def test_restart_saves_after_the_answer(self):
        order = []
        r = self._runner(confirm_restart=lambda q, d: order.append("asked") or True, after_check=lambda: order.append("saved"))
        Runner.rows_ = self.rows(r)
        with mock.patch.object(Runner, "serving_launches", lambda self: self.rows_),              mock.patch.object(Runner, "ensure_engine", side_effect=RuntimeError("went on")):
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                r.run()
        self.assertEqual(order, ["asked", "saved"])

    def test_nothing_running_saves_at_once(self):
        saved = []
        r = self._runner(after_check=lambda: saved.append(1))
        with mock.patch.object(Runner, "serving_launches", lambda self: []),              mock.patch.object(Runner, "ensure_engine", side_effect=RuntimeError("went on")):
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                r.run()
        self.assertEqual(saved, [1])

    def test_the_save_screen_no_longer_writes_the_preset_itself(self):
        import asyncio
        from strata_cli.launch import store
        from tests.terminal.test_launch_tui import Base, FakeRunner, press, make_ctx
        from strata_cli.launch.app import LaunchApp

        class Case(Base):
            def runTest(self):
                pass

        case = Case()
        case.setUp()
        self.addCleanup(case.tearDown)
        seen = {}

        class Holding(FakeRunner):
            def run(self, start=True):
                seen["presets_during_run"] = [p.name for p in store.list_presets()]
                return super().run(start)

        with mock.patch("strata_cli.launch.app.Runner", Holding):
            async def go():
                app = LaunchApp(make_ctx())
                async with app.run_test(size=(110, 34)) as pilot:
                    await pilot.pause(0.2)
                    await press(pilot, *("enter",) * 7, "n", "enter")
                    self.assertEqual(store.list_presets(), [])           # still nothing on the Save screen
                    await press(pilot, "enter")
                    await pilot.pause(0.8)
                    return [p.name for p in store.list_presets()]
            after = asyncio.run(go())
        self.assertEqual(seen["presets_during_run"], [])               # not saved before the runner's check
        self.assertEqual(after, ["IQ3_S 32K"])                          # saved once the run went on


class DraftingOffConfig(unittest.TestCase):
    """B10: the saved launch config has no --mtp in args when "mtp" is false, whatever made it false."""

    BASE = {"args": ["--model", "m.gguf", "--mtp", "C:/x/mtp", "--spec-min-p", "0.5", "--batch-mtp", "--max-context", "32768"], "exe": "x"}

    def derive(self, base, **kw):
        from strata_control import tune_knobs
        s = S.LaunchSettings(family="gyro", model="Gyro-S", context=32768, **kw)
        return R.derive_config(base, s, bool_flags=tune_knobs.BOOL_FLAGS)

    def test_drafting_off_and_mtp_off(self):
        for kw in ({"drafting": "off"}, {"mtp": "off"}, {"drafting": "off", "extra": {"prefill": "4096"}}):
            with self.subTest(kw=kw):
                cfg = self.derive(self.BASE, **kw)
                self.assertIs(cfg["mtp"], False)
                self.assertNotIn("--mtp", cfg["args"])
                self.assertIn("--max-context", cfg["args"])

    def test_an_installed_config_that_already_says_mtp_false(self):
        cfg = self.derive({**self.BASE, "mtp": False})
        self.assertIs(cfg["mtp"], False)
        self.assertNotIn("--mtp", cfg["args"])
        self.assertNotIn("--spec-min-p", cfg["args"])

    def test_mtp_stays_when_it_is_on(self):
        cfg = self.derive(self.BASE)
        self.assertIn("--mtp", cfg["args"])


class ReusedDataLine(unittest.TestCase):
    """C08 note: one line says where the pack and the draft layer are read from."""

    def setUp(self):
        self.home = Home().__enter__()
        self.addCleanup(self.home.__exit__, None, None, None)
        p = mock.patch.object(Catalog, "hardware", lambda self, fresh=False: dict(HW_12, disk_free_gb=500.0))
        p.start()
        self.addCleanup(p.stop)
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.base = Path(self.tmp.name)

    def runner(self, cfg_args, **fields):
        cfg = self.base / "strata-x.json"
        cfg.write_text(json.dumps({"args": cfg_args}))
        s = S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="Q2_0", context=32768, **fields)
        r = Runner(s, catalog=catalog())
        r.said = []
        r.emit_cb = lambda e: r.said.append(e.text)
        return r, cfg

    def test_pack_and_draft_layer_from_the_old_folder_are_named(self):
        old = self.base / "dl-data"
        r, cfg = self.runner(["--pack", str(old / "packs" / "x"), "--mtp", str(old / "mtp" / "rt")],
                             model_path=str(self.base / "docs"), data_dir=str(self.base / "c08-data"))
        r.say_reused_data(cfg)
        self.assertEqual(len(r.said), 1)
        self.assertIn("the prepared pack and the draft layer are read from", r.said[0].lower())
        self.assertIn("dl-data", r.said[0])
        self.assertIn("nothing was copied", r.said[0])

    def test_no_line_when_they_are_in_the_given_folder_or_nothing_was_given(self):
        new = self.base / "c08-data"
        r, cfg = self.runner(["--pack", str(new / "packs" / "x")], model_path=str(self.base / "docs"), data_dir=str(new))
        r.say_reused_data(cfg)
        self.assertEqual(r.said, [])
        r, cfg = self.runner(["--pack", str(self.base / "o" / "packs" / "x")], model_path=str(self.base / "docs"))
        r.say_reused_data(cfg)
        self.assertEqual(r.said, [])

## tests/terminal/test_tui_stress.py

"""Fixes from the owner's TUI stress test of the 0.2.3 RC (status/logs discovery, key reuse, retune, folder, quit keys, --model-path)."""

import io
import json
import os
import unittest
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from unittest import mock

from strata_cli.cli import main


class StatusLogsDiscoveryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """#7 (F02): status and logs find the running launch without --url."""

    def _run(self, *argv):
        info = {"running": True, "url": "http://127.0.0.1:8080", "key": "k-launch"}
        env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k not in ("STRATA_URL", "STRATA_CONNECTION")}
        out = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, env, clear=True), \
             mock.patch("strata_cli.launch.cmd.launch_info", return_value=info), \
             mock.patch("strata_cli.monitor_commands.Endpoint") as endpoint, redirect_stdout(out):
            endpoint.return_value.snapshot.return_value = {"schema_version": 1}
            code = main(list(argv))
        return code, endpoint

    def test_status_uses_the_running_launch(self):
        code, endpoint = self._run("status", "--json")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(endpoint.call_args[0][0], "http://127.0.0.1:8080")
        self.assertEqual(endpoint.call_args[0][1], "k-launch")

    def test_logs_use_the_running_launch(self):
        with mock.patch("strata_cli.logs.run", return_value=0) as run:
            code, endpoint = self._run("logs")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(endpoint.call_args[0][0], "http://127.0.0.1:8080")

    def test_explicit_url_wins(self):
        code, endpoint = self._run("status", "--json", "--url", "http://127.0.0.1:9999")
        self.assertEqual(endpoint.call_args[0][0], "http://127.0.0.1:9999")


class KeptKeyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """#8 (E05/G01): a key made for a launch survives a restart."""

    def setUp(self):
        import tempfile
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.cfg = os.path.join(self.temp.name, "launch.json")

    def _write(self, key):
        with open(self.cfg, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump({"api_key": key}, f)

    def test_key_of_the_launch_config_is_kept(self):
        from strata_cli.launch import access
        self._write("sk-strata-AAA")
        with mock.patch("strata_control.profiles.load", return_value=({"source_config": self.cfg}, "r")):
            self.assertEqual(access.kept_key("gyro-s 32K"), "sk-strata-AAA")

    def test_no_key_and_none_are_not_kept(self):
        from strata_cli.launch import access
        self._write("none")
        with mock.patch("strata_control.profiles.load", return_value=({"source_config": self.cfg}, "r")),              mock.patch("strata_control.profiles.list_profiles", return_value=[]):
            self.assertIsNone(access.kept_key("gyro-s 32K"))

    def test_newest_launch_config_is_the_fallback(self):
        from strata_cli.launch import access
        self._write("sk-strata-BBB")
        rows = [{"id": "launch-other", "source_config": self.cfg}, {"id": "other", "source_config": "x"}]
        with mock.patch("strata_control.profiles.load", side_effect=Exception("none")),              mock.patch("strata_cli.launch.store.load", return_value=None),              mock.patch("strata_control.profiles.list_profiles", return_value=rows):
            self.assertEqual(access.kept_key("gyro-s 64K"), "sk-strata-BBB")

    def test_apply_defaults_reuses_the_key_and_new_key_is_a_different_step(self):
        from strata_cli.launch import cmd, settings as S
        from tests.terminal.launch_support import HW_12, Home, catalog
        s = S.LaunchSettings(family="qwen", model="IQ3_XXS")
        s.access = "lan"
        with Home(), mock.patch("strata_cli.launch.access.kept_key", return_value="sk-strata-KEPT"):
            s2, notes = cmd.apply_defaults(s, catalog(HW_12))
        self.assertEqual(s2.api_key, "sk-strata-KEPT")
        self.assertFalse(any("A new API key was made" in n.line() for n in notes))
