const ce = React.createElement;
const T_END = 10.4;
const ss = (a, b, x) => { x = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (x - a) / (b - a))); return x * x * (3 - 2 * x); };
const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v));
const easeOut3 = x => 1 - Math.pow(1 - clamp(x, 0, 1), 3);
const easeBack = x => { const c = 1.6; x = clamp(x, 0, 1); return 1 + (c + 1) * Math.pow(x - 1, 3) + c * Math.pow(x - 1, 2); };
const PH = [0, 2.0, 4.6, 8.6, T_END];
const STATUS = ['Checking your hardware', 'Warming up the model', 'Trying setups', 'Locking in the best one', 'Done'];
// master energy: long ease-in, sustain, long glide out
const energy = t => 0.03 + 0.97 * Math.pow(ss(0.2, 3.8, t), 1.6) * (1 - ss(7.2, 10.6, t));
// progress = normalised integral of (base + energy) so the ring fills slow → fast → slow
const PROG = (() => { const dt = 1 / 240, arr = [0]; let acc = 0; for (let t = 0; t < T_END; t += dt) { acc += (0.1 + energy(t)) * dt; arr.push(acc); } return { arr, dt, total: acc }; })();
const progAt = t => { if (t >= T_END) return 1; const i = clamp(t / PROG.dt, 0, PROG.arr.length - 1), lo = Math.floor(i), f = i - lo; const v = PROG.arr[lo] + ((PROG.arr[lo + 1] ?? PROG.arr[lo]) - PROG.arr[lo]) * f; return v / PROG.total; };
const spring = (st, target, dt, k, z) => { const c = 2 * Math.sqrt(k) * z; for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const h = dt / 4; st.v += (k * (target - st.x) - c * st.v) * h; st.x += st.v * h; } return st.x; };
const reduceMotion = () => { try { return window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches; } catch (e) { return false; } };

function TuneViz({ trials, best, baseGen, onDone }) {
  const [, force] = React.useState(0);
  const r = React.useRef(null);
  const n = trials.length, slot = (PH[3] - PH[2]) / n;
  const targetAt = t => t < PH[1] ? 0 : t < PH[2] ? baseGen * ss(PH[1] + 0.2, PH[2] - 0.2, t) : t < PH[3] ? (() => { const i = Math.min(n - 1, Math.floor((t - PH[2]) / slot)); const lp = (t - PH[2] - i * slot) / slot; return lp < 0.18 ? (i === 0 ? baseGen : trials[i - 1].tok) : trials[i].tok; })() : trials[best].tok;
  if (!r.current) r.current = { t: 0, start: null, last: null, angle: 0, angle2: 0, num: { x: 0, v: 0 }, gpu: { x: 3, v: 0 }, cpu: { x: 4, v: 0 }, mem: { x: 2, v: 0 }, lastTarget: 0, popAt: -9, status: 0, statusAt: 0, statusPrev: 0, done: false, rm: reduceMotion() };
  React.useEffect(() => {
    let raf;
    const loop = now => {
      const s = r.current;
      if (s.start == null) { s.start = now; s.last = now; }
      const dt = Math.min(0.04, (now - s.last) / 1000); s.last = now; s.t = (now - s.start) / 1000;
      const t = s.t, e = energy(t), mf = s.rm ? 0.2 : 1;
      s.angle = (s.angle + (10 + 520 * e) * dt * mf) % 360;
      s.angle2 = (s.angle2 - (6 + 210 * e) * dt * mf + 360) % 360;
      const tgt = targetAt(t);
      if (Math.abs(tgt - s.lastTarget) > 0.05 && t > PH[2]) s.popAt = t;
      s.lastTarget = tgt;
      spring(s.num, tgt, dt, 26, 0.78);
      const wob = (a, b, c) => Math.sin(t * a) * 0.55 + Math.sin(t * b + c) * 0.45;
      spring(s.gpu, 3 + 93 * e + 2.5 * e * wob(2.3, 3.7, 1), dt, 18, 1);
      spring(s.cpu, 5 + e * (58 + 16 * wob(1.3, 2.9, 2)), dt, 14, 1);
      spring(s.mem, 2 + 56 * e + 1.5 * e * wob(1.9, 3.3, 4), dt, 16, 1);
      const ph = t < PH[1] ? 0 : t < PH[2] ? 1 : t < PH[3] ? 2 : t < PH[4] ? 3 : 4;
      if (ph !== s.status) { s.statusPrev = s.status; s.status = ph; s.statusAt = t; }
      if (t >= T_END && !s.done) { s.done = true; onDone && onDone(); }
      force(x => (x + 1) % 1e6);
      if (t < T_END + 3) raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, []);

  const s = r.current, t = s.t, e = energy(t), prog = progAt(t), endT = t - T_END, finished = endT >= 0;
  const S = 320, R = 122, TICKS = 96, lit = prog * TICKS;
  const pol = (ang, rad) => [Math.cos(ang) * rad, Math.sin(ang) * rad];
  const A = f => f * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;

  // ticks with continuous fade at the head
  const ticks = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < TICKS; i++) {
    const ang = A(i / TICKS), f = clamp(lit - i, 0, 1), head = lit - i >= 0 && lit - i < 5 && !finished ? 1 - (lit - i) / 5 : 0;
    const len = 9 + head * 6, [x1, y1] = pol(ang, R - len), [x2, y2] = pol(ang, R);
    ticks.push(ce('line', { key: 'g' + i, x1: x1.toFixed(2), y1: y1.toFixed(2), x2: x2.toFixed(2), y2: y2.toFixed(2), stroke: '#e3e8ee', strokeWidth: 3, strokeLinecap: 'round' }));
    if (f > 0) ticks.push(ce('line', { key: 'o' + i, x1: x1.toFixed(2), y1: y1.toFixed(2), x2: x2.toFixed(2), y2: y2.toFixed(2), stroke: '#10b981', strokeWidth: 3, strokeLinecap: 'round', opacity: f.toFixed(3) }));
  }
  // leading head
  const [hx, hy] = pol(A(prog), R + 9);
  const head = prog > 0.002 && !finished ? ce('g', null,
    ce('circle', { cx: hx.toFixed(2), cy: hy.toFixed(2), r: 10, fill: '#10b981', opacity: (0.10 + e * 0.12).toFixed(3) }),
    ce('circle', { cx: hx.toFixed(2), cy: hy.toFixed(2), r: 4.5, fill: '#10b981', stroke: '#ffffff', strokeWidth: 2 })) : null;

  // checkpoints for each tested setup
  const cps = trials.map((tr, i) => {
    const tEnd = PH[2] + (i + 1) * slot, p = progAt(tEnd), age = t - tEnd;
    if (age < 0) return null;
    const isBest = i === best, win = isBest && finished ? easeBack(endT / 0.5) : 0;
    const sc = easeBack(age / 0.45), [cx, cy] = pol(A(p), R + 22);
    return ce('circle', { key: 'cp' + i, cx: cx.toFixed(2), cy: cy.toFixed(2), r: ((3 + win * 2.5) * sc).toFixed(2), fill: isBest && finished ? '#10b981' : '#2F384C', opacity: isBest || !finished ? 1 : 0.35 });
  });

  // inner motion rings
  const C1 = 2 * Math.PI * 100, seg1 = C1 / 14, d1 = 2 + e * 26;
  const C2 = 2 * Math.PI * 88, seg2 = C2 / 36, d2 = 1 + e * 5;
  const motion = ce('g', null,
    ce('circle', { r: 100, fill: 'none', stroke: '#10b981', strokeWidth: 3, strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeDasharray: d1.toFixed(2) + ' ' + (seg1 - d1).toFixed(2), opacity: (0.12 + e * 0.38).toFixed(3), transform: 'rotate(' + s.angle.toFixed(2) + ')' }),
    ce('circle', { r: 88, fill: 'none', stroke: '#2F384C', strokeWidth: 1.5, strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeDasharray: d2.toFixed(2) + ' ' + (seg2 - d2).toFixed(2), opacity: (0.08 + e * 0.12).toFixed(3), transform: 'rotate(' + s.angle2.toFixed(2) + ')' }));

  // finish: seal flash + ripples
  const flash = finished ? Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - endT / 0.7), 2) : 0;
  const ripples = finished && !s.rm ? [0, 0.22, 0.44].map((d, k) => { const x = (endT - d) / 1.6; if (x <= 0 || x >= 1) return null; const ex = easeOut3(x); return ce('circle', { key: 'rp' + k, r: (R + 2 + ex * 58).toFixed(2), fill: 'none', stroke: '#10b981', strokeWidth: (2.5 * (1 - ex) + 0.4).toFixed(2), opacity: (0.5 * Math.pow(1 - x, 2)).toFixed(3) }); }) : [];

  const ring = ce('svg', { viewBox: '-' + S / 2 + ' -' + S / 2 + ' ' + S + ' ' + S, style: { position: 'absolute', inset: 0, width: '100%', height: '100%', overflow: 'visible' } },
    ce('circle', { r: R - 14, fill: '#10b981', opacity: (0.025 + e * 0.04 + flash * 0.08).toFixed(3) }),
    ripples, ticks,
    ce('circle', { r: R + 1, fill: 'none', stroke: '#10b981', strokeWidth: 3, opacity: (flash * 0.9).toFixed(3) }),
    cps, head, motion,
    ce('circle', { r: 78, fill: '#ffffff', stroke: '#eeeeee', strokeWidth: 1 }));

  // centre number
  const num = Math.max(0, s.num.x), pop = Math.max(0, 1 - (t - s.popAt) / 0.45), finPop = finished ? Math.sin(clamp(endT / 0.5, 0, 1) * Math.PI) : 0;
  const scale = 1 + 0.04 * Math.sin(pop * Math.PI) * pop + 0.06 * finPop;
  const delta = (num - baseGen) / baseGen * 100;
  const showDelta = t > PH[2] + 0.3;
  const centre = ce('div', { style: { position: 'absolute', inset: 0, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 4, pointerEvents: 'none' } },
    ce('span', { style: { fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 58, lineHeight: 1, letterSpacing: '-0.035em', color: t < PH[1] ? '#c9d1db' : '#221e1f', fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums', transform: 'scale(' + scale.toFixed(4) + ')', transition: 'color 400ms' } }, num.toFixed(finished && endT > 0.8 ? 0 : 1)),
    ce('span', { style: { fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 500, color: '#6f6f6f' } }, 'tok/s'),
    ce('span', { style: { height: 18, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums', color: delta >= 0.5 ? '#0c8a60' : '#6f6f6f', opacity: showDelta ? ss(PH[2] + 0.3, PH[2] + 0.8, t).toFixed(3) : 0 } }, (delta >= 0 ? '+' : '') + delta.toFixed(0) + '% vs now'));

  // status with crossfade
  const sx = ss(s.statusAt, s.statusAt + 0.45, t);
  const lineStyle = (o, y) => ({ position: 'absolute', left: 0, right: 0, textAlign: 'center', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 16, color: '#221e1f', opacity: o.toFixed(3), transform: 'translateY(' + y.toFixed(2) + 'px)' });
  const label = i => i === 4 ? 'Done' : i === 2 ? STATUS[2] + ' · ' + Math.min(n, Math.floor((t - PH[2]) / slot) + 1) + ' of ' + n : STATUS[i] + '…';
  const status = ce('div', { style: { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 } },
    ce('div', { style: { display: 'flex', gap: 6 } }, [0, 1, 2, 3].map(i => { const active = i === Math.min(3, s.status) && !finished; return ce('span', { key: i, style: { width: active ? 24 : 6, height: 6, borderRadius: 999, background: i <= s.status || finished ? '#10b981' : '#dee5ee', opacity: active ? 0.55 + 0.45 * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 4)) : 1, transition: 'width 500ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), background 400ms' } }); })),
    ce('div', { style: { position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: 22 } },
      sx < 1 ? ce('span', { style: lineStyle(1 - sx, -8 * sx) }, label(s.statusPrev)) : null,
      ce('span', { style: lineStyle(sx, 8 * (1 - sx)) }, label(s.status))));

  // result chip
  const bestTok = trials[best].tok, gain = (bestTok - baseGen) / baseGen * 100, pc = finished ? easeBack((endT - 0.25) / 0.55) : 0;
  const result = ce('div', { style: { display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', height: 40 } },
    finished && endT > 0.25 ? ce('span', { style: { display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, height: 40, padding: '0 18px', borderRadius: 999, background: '#ecfdf5', color: '#0c8a60', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 15, transform: 'translateY(' + ((1 - clamp(pc, 0, 1)) * 6).toFixed(2) + 'px) scale(' + (0.9 + 0.1 * pc).toFixed(4) + ')', opacity: clamp((endT - 0.25) / 0.3, 0, 1).toFixed(3) } },
      ce('span', { style: { display: 'inline-block', width: 16, height: 16, background: '#0c8a60', mask: 'url(icons/check.svg) center/contain no-repeat', WebkitMask: 'url(icons/check.svg) center/contain no-repeat' } }),
      gain >= 0.5 ? '+' + gain.toFixed(0) + '% faster · ' + trials[best].label : 'Your current settings are already the fastest') : null);

  // meters
  const meter = (icon, label, v, max, unit) => ce('div', { style: { flex: '1 1 140px', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10, padding: '14px 16px', background: '#ffffff', border: '1px solid #dee5ee', borderRadius: 16 } },
    ce('div', { style: { display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 } },
      ce('span', { style: { display: 'inline-block', width: 16, height: 16, background: '#2F384C', mask: 'url(icons/' + icon + '.svg) center/contain no-repeat', WebkitMask: 'url(icons/' + icon + '.svg) center/contain no-repeat' } }),
      ce('span', { style: { flex: 1, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 500, color: '#6f6f6f' } }, label),
      ce('span', { style: { fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: '#221e1f', fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums' } }, Math.max(0, v).toFixed(0) + unit)),
    ce('div', { style: { height: 6, borderRadius: 999, background: '#eef1f4', overflow: 'hidden' } }, ce('div', { style: { width: clamp(v / max * 100, 0, 100).toFixed(2) + '%', height: '100%', borderRadius: 999, background: '#10b981' } })));

  return ce('div', { style: { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 18 } },
    ce('div', { style: { position: 'relative', width: 320, height: 320, maxWidth: '100%', margin: '0 auto' } }, ring, centre),
    status, result,
    ce('div', { style: { display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 10 } }, meter('gpu', 'Graphics card', s.gpu.x, 100, '%'), meter('cpu', 'Processor', s.cpu.x, 100, '%'), meter('memory', 'Memory', s.mem.x, 60, ' GB/s')));
}

class Component extends DCLogic {
  fileRef = React.createRef();
  state = {
    cfg: { ...DEFAULTS }, saved: { ...DEFAULTS }, goal: 'chat', savedGoal: 'chat',
    mode: this.props.startMode ?? 'simple', tab: 'params', q: '', grp: 'all', changedOnly: false, showDesc: this.props.showDescriptions ?? false,
    raw: null, rawErr: null, rawWarn: null, copied: false,
    userPresets: this.loadPresets(), naming: false, nameDraft: '',
    tuning: null, applying: null, toast: null, stream: '',
  };
  loadPresets() { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS)) || [['My coding setup', { 'ctx.length': '32768', 'sample.temperature': 0.2, 'sample.topP': 0.9, 'sample.repeatPenalty': 1.0 }]]; } catch (e) { return []; } }
  savePresets(list) { try { localStorage.setItem(LS, JSON.stringify(list)); } catch (e) {} }

  calc(c) {
    const ctxK = +c['ctx.length'] / 1024;
    const kv = c['ctx.kvMode'] === 'auto' ? (ctxK >= 256 ? 'int4' : ctxK >= 64 ? 'int8' : 'fp16') : c['ctx.kvMode'];
    const batch = c['batch.size'] === 'auto' ? (c['sys.headroom'] === 'max' ? (ctxK >= 16 ? 4096 : 2048) : (ctxK >= 32 ? 2048 : 1024)) : +c['batch.size'];
    const gpu = c['gpu.layers'] === 'auto' ? 'all' : c['gpu.layers'];
    const maxP = c['sys.headroom'] === 'max', reserve = maxP ? 0 : VRAM * 0.15;
    const threads = c['cpu.threads'] === 'auto' ? (maxP ? 8 : 6) : +c['cpu.threads'];
    const memMode = c['mem.mode'] === 'auto' ? (ctxK >= 256 ? 'offload' : 'vram') : c['mem.mode'];
    const par = Math.max(1, +c['server.parallel'] || 1), flash = !!c['gpu.flashAttn'];
    const perK = { fp16: 0.025, int8: 0.0125, int4: 0.007 }[kv] * (flash ? 1 : 1.15);
    const mCtx = ctxK * perK * par;
    const mWork = 0.3 + batch / 2048 * 0.5 + (+c['batch.ubatch']) / 1024 * 0.15;
    const slots = +c['mem.expertCache'] || 64, off = memMode === 'offload';
    const mModel = (5.0 + slots * 0.022) * (off ? 0.72 : 1) * (gpu === 'split' ? 0.6 : 1);
    const used = mModel + mCtx + mWork, over = Math.max(0, used - (VRAM - reserve)), spill = over > 0;
    let gen = 52 / (1 + ctxK / 400) * (kv === 'int4' ? 0.96 : 1);
    if (c['perf.draft']) gen *= 1.22 + (Math.min(+c['perf.draftDepth'] || 1, 6) - 1) * 0.02;
    if (off) gen *= 0.82 * (0.8 + slots / 320);
    if (gpu === 'split') gen *= 0.55 + threads * 0.03;
    if (spill) gen *= 0.4;
    if (par > 1) gen /= 1 + (par - 1) * 0.35;
    if (maxP) gen *= 1.07;
    let read = ({ 512: 640, 1024: 880, 2048: 1030, 4096: 1090 })[batch] || 880;
    if (!flash) read *= 0.8; if (maxP) read *= 1.08; if (gpu === 'split') read *= 0.6; if (spill) read *= 0.35;
    return { kv, batch, gpu, threads, memMode, mModel, mCtx, mWork, used, over, spill, reserve, free: Math.max(0, VRAM - reserve - used), gen, read };
  }
  styleOf(c) { return Object.keys(STYLES).find(k => Math.abs(STYLES[k][2] - c['sample.temperature']) < 0.001 && Math.abs(STYLES[k][3] - c['sample.topP']) < 0.001) || null; }

  componentDidMount() { this.restartStream(); }
  componentWillUnmount() { clearInterval(this.iv); clearTimeout(this.tt); (this.timers || []).forEach(clearTimeout); }
  componentDidUpdate() { const k = this.state.goal + ':' + this.calc(this.state.cfg).gen.toFixed(0); if (k !== this._lastKey) this.restartStream(); }
  restartStream() {
    clearInterval(this.iv);
    this._lastKey = this.state.goal + ':' + this.calc(this.state.cfg).gen.toFixed(0);
    const full = GOALS[this.state.goal].sample; let i = 0, pause = 0;
    this.setState({ stream: '' });
    this.iv = setInterval(() => {
      if (pause > 0) { if (--pause === 0) { i = 0; this.setState({ stream: '' }); } return; }
      const cps = this.calc(this.state.cfg).gen * 0.75 * 5.6;
      i = Math.min(full.length, i + Math.max(1, Math.round(cps * 0.05)));
      this.setState({ stream: full.slice(0, i) });
      if (i >= full.length) pause = 50;
    }, 50);
  }
  later(fn, ms) { (this.timers ||= []).push(setTimeout(fn, ms)); }

  setCfg(patch, keepRaw) { this.setState(s => ({ cfg: { ...s.cfg, ...patch }, ...(keepRaw ? {} : { raw: null, rawErr: null, rawWarn: null }) })); }
  rawText() { const s = this.state; return JSON.stringify({ schema: 'strata.engine/1', model: 'qwen3.8-flash-next', simple: { goal: s.goal, style: this.styleOf(s.cfg) || 'custom' }, engine: s.cfg }, null, 2); }
  parseRaw(text) {
    let obj;
    try { obj = JSON.parse(text); } catch (e) { const m = /position (\d+)/.exec(e.message); let line = ''; if (m) line = ` (line ${text.slice(0, +m[1]).split('\n').length})`; this.setState({ raw: text, rawErr: 'Invalid JSON' + line + ': ' + e.message.replace(/^JSON\.parse: |^Unexpected/, s => s ? s : ''), rawWarn: null }); return; }
    const eng = obj && obj.engine; if (!eng || typeof eng !== 'object') { this.setState({ raw: text, rawErr: 'Missing "engine" object.', rawWarn: null }); return; }
    const patch = {}, unknown = [], errs = [];
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(eng)) {
      const p = PM[k]; if (!p) { unknown.push(k); continue; }
      if (p.type === SEL && !p.opts.some(o => o[0] === v)) errs.push(`${k}: "${v}" is not one of ${p.opts.map(o => o[0]).join(', ')}`);
      else if (p.type === NUM && (typeof v !== 'number' || v < p.opts[0] || v > p.opts[1])) errs.push(`${k}: expected a number from ${p.opts[0]} to ${p.opts[1]}`);
      else if (p.type === BOOL && typeof v !== 'boolean') errs.push(`${k}: expected true or false`);
      else patch[k] = v;
    }
    if (errs.length) { this.setState({ raw: text, rawErr: errs.join('\n'), rawWarn: null }); return; }
    const goal = obj.simple && GOALS[obj.simple.goal] ? obj.simple.goal : this.state.goal;
    this.setState(s => ({ raw: text, rawErr: null, rawWarn: unknown.length ? `Ignored unknown key${unknown.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}: ${unknown.join(', ')}` : null, cfg: { ...s.cfg, ...patch }, goal }));
  }

  apply() {
    const steps = ['Pausing the engine…', 'Loading with new settings…', 'Warming up…'];
    const needsLoad = Object.keys(this.state.cfg).some(k => this.state.cfg[k] !== this.state.saved[k] && PM[k].applies === 'load');
    const inc = needsLoad ? 4 : 12; let p = 0;
    this.setState({ applying: { p: 0, step: needsLoad ? steps[0] : 'Saving…' } });
    const tick = () => {
      p += inc;
      if (p >= 100) {
        const g = this.calc(this.state.cfg).gen.toFixed(0);
        this.setState(s => ({ saved: { ...s.cfg }, savedGoal: s.goal, applying: null, raw: null, toast: needsLoad ? { t: 'Engine reloaded', s: `Running at ${g} tok/s. Saved to engine.json.` } : { t: 'Saved', s: 'Applies from your next message.' } }));
        clearTimeout(this.tt); this.tt = setTimeout(() => this.setState({ toast: null }), 3200); return;
      }
      this.setState({ applying: { p, step: needsLoad ? steps[Math.min(2, Math.floor(p / 34))] : 'Saving…' } });
      this.later(tick, 70);
    };
    this.later(tick, 70);
  }
  startTune() {
    const s = this.state, g = GOALS[s.goal], st = STYLES[g.style];
    const base = { ...DEFAULTS, 'sys.headroom': s.cfg['sys.headroom'], 'ctx.length': g.ctx, 'sample.temperature': st[2], 'sample.topP': st[3] };
    const cand = [
      ['batch 1024 · kv fp16', { 'batch.size': '1024', 'ctx.kvMode': 'fp16' }],
      ['batch 2048 · kv fp16', { 'batch.size': '2048', 'ctx.kvMode': 'fp16' }],
      ['batch 2048 · kv int8', { 'batch.size': '2048', 'ctx.kvMode': 'int8' }],
      ['batch 4096 · kv int8', { 'batch.size': '4096', 'ctx.kvMode': 'int8' }],
      ['batch 4096 · int8 · draft 6', { 'batch.size': '4096', 'ctx.kvMode': 'int8', 'perf.draftDepth': 6 }],
    ].map(([label, p]) => { const cfg = { ...base, ...p }, cc = this.calc(cfg); return { label, cfg, tok: +(cc.gen + cc.read / 400).toFixed(1), spill: cc.spill, used: cc.used }; });
    let best = 0; cand.forEach((c, i) => { if (!c.spill && c.tok > cand[best].tok) best = i; });
    this._run = (this._run || 0) + 1;
    this.setState({ tuning: { run: this._run, trials: cand.map(({ label, tok }) => ({ label, tok })), best, bestCfg: cand[best].cfg, vramT: cand[best].used, done: false } });
  }
  _tuneDone = () => { this.setState(x => x.tuning ? { tuning: { ...x.tuning, done: true } } : null); };

  renderVals() {
    const s = this.state, c = s.cfg, cc = this.calc(c), ca = this.calc(s.saved);
    const isExpert = s.mode === 'expert';
    const total = Math.max(VRAM, cc.used + cc.reserve), pct = v => `width:${(v / total * 100).toFixed(2)}%;`;
    const fit = cc.spill ? 'over' : cc.free < 1.2 ? 'tight' : 'ok';
    const fitMap = {
      ok: ['Fits comfortably', 'background:#ecfdf5;color:#0c8a60;', cc.reserve > 0 ? `Fits with ${cc.free.toFixed(1)} GB to spare, plus ${cc.reserve.toFixed(1)} GB kept free for your other apps.` : `Everything fits with ${cc.free.toFixed(1)} GB to spare. Full power: Strata uses the whole card.`],
      tight: ['Tight fit', 'background:#fff6e0;color:#8a5a00;', 'It fits, but only just. Other apps using the graphics card may slow it down.'],
      over: ['Too big', 'background:#fdecee;color:#b01a2e;', `It needs ${cc.over.toFixed(1)} GB more than your graphics card has, so part of it moves to slower system memory.`],
    }[fit];
    const style = this.styleOf(c), g = GOALS[s.goal], ctxV = c['ctx.length'];
    const pages = Math.round(+ctxV / 650);
    const changedKeys = Object.keys(c).filter(k => c[k] !== s.saved[k]);
    const loadN = changedKeys.filter(k => PM[k].applies === 'load').length;
    const pctD = (a, b) => { const d = (a - b) / b * 100; return Math.abs(d) < 0.5 ? 'same as now' : `${d > 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.toFixed(0)}% vs now`; };
    const anyChange = changedKeys.length > 0;

    // expert rows
    const ql = s.q.trim().toLowerCase();
    const rowsFor = gk => P.map(p => PM[p[0]]).filter(p => p.group === gk)
      .filter(p => !ql || p.label.toLowerCase().includes(ql) || p.key.toLowerCase().includes(ql) || p.desc.toLowerCase().includes(ql))
      .filter(p => !s.changedOnly || c[p.key] !== s.saved[p.key])
      .map(p => {
        const v = c[p.key], unsaved = v !== s.saved[p.key], isDef = v === p.def;
        const auto = { 'ctx.kvMode': cc.kv.toUpperCase(), 'batch.size': String(cc.batch), 'gpu.layers': cc.gpu === 'all' ? 'all on GPU' : 'split', 'cpu.threads': String(cc.threads), 'mem.mode': cc.memMode }[p.key];
        return {
          label: p.label, key: p.key, desc: p.desc, showDesc: s.showDesc, unsaved,
          meta: `${p.applies === 'load' ? 'Reloads engine' : 'Next message'} · default ${fmt(p.key, p.def)}${v === 'auto' && auto ? ` · Auto → ${auto}` : ''}${!isDef ? ' · custom' : ''}`,
          isSelect: p.type === SEL, isNumber: p.type === NUM, isBool: p.type === BOOL,
          value: p.type === BOOL ? '' : v, options: p.type === SEL ? p.opts.map(([ov, ol]) => ({ v: ov, l: ol })) : [],
          min: p.opts?.[0], max: p.opts?.[1], step: p.opts?.[2],
          onSelect: e => this.setCfg({ [p.key]: e.target.value }),
          onNumber: e => { const n = parseFloat(e.target.value); if (!isNaN(n)) this.setCfg({ [p.key]: Math.min(p.opts[1], Math.max(p.opts[0], n)) }); },
          onToggle: () => this.setCfg({ [p.key]: !v }), boolLabel: v ? 'On' : 'Off',
          track: `background:${v ? '#10b981' : '#dee5ee'};`, knob: `transform:translateX(${v ? 16 : 0}px);`,
          revert: () => this.setCfg({ [p.key]: s.saved[p.key] }), revertStyle: unsaved ? '' : 'visibility:hidden;',
          rowStyle: unsaved ? 'background:#fffbf0;' : '',
        };
      });
    const groups = GROUPS.filter(([gk]) => s.grp === 'all' || s.grp === gk).map(([gk, title]) => { const rows = rowsFor(gk); return { title, rows, count: `${rows.length} ${rows.length === 1 ? 'setting' : 'settings'}` }; }).filter(x => x.rows.length);

    const allPresets = [...BUILTIN.map(([n, p]) => [n, p, false]), ...s.userPresets.map(([n, p]) => [n, p, true])];
    const resolve = p => ({ ...DEFAULTS, ...p });
    const same = (a, b) => Object.keys(DEFAULTS).every(k => a[k] === b[k]);
    const summary = p => { const r = resolve(p); const bits = [fmt('ctx.length', r['ctx.length']), r['ctx.kvMode'] === 'auto' ? 'kv auto' : r['ctx.kvMode'], `t=${r['sample.temperature']}`]; if (r['mem.mode'] === 'offload') bits.push('offload'); return bits.join(' · '); };

    const raw = s.raw ?? this.rawText();
    const rawLines = raw.split('\n').length;
    const tsteps = [['Checking your hardware', 'RTX 4070 · 12 GB'], ['Testing speed', `${ca.gen.toFixed(0)} tok/s`], [`Picking settings for ${g.title.toLowerCase()}`, 'Done']];
    const chipOn = 'background:#221e1f;color:#ffffff;border:1px solid #221e1f;', chipOff = 'background:#ffffff;color:#303030;border:1px solid #dee5ee;';
    const seg = on => on ? 'background:#ffffff;color:#221e1f;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.06),0 4px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.03);' : 'background:transparent;color:#6f6f6f;';

    return {
      appliedGen: ca.gen.toFixed(0),
      isSimple: !isExpert, isExpert,
      toSimple: () => this.setState({ mode: 'simple' }), toExpert: () => this.setState({ mode: 'expert' }),
      modeSimpleStyle: isExpert ? 'background:transparent;color:#6f6f6f;' : 'background:#221e1f;color:#ffffff;', modeExpertStyle: isExpert ? 'background:#221e1f;color:#ffffff;' : 'background:transparent;color:#6f6f6f;',
      modeBarWidth: isExpert ? 'max-width:1360px;' : 'max-width:1200px;',
      modeHint: isExpert ? `Every parameter, presets and the raw config. Same settings as Simple.` : 'Pick what you need and Strata handles the rest.',
      paramCount: P.length,
      // simple
      startTune: () => this.startTune(),
      goals: Object.entries(GOALS).map(([k, gg]) => { const sel = s.goal === k; return {
        title: gg.title, sub: gg.sub,
        pick: () => { const st = STYLES[gg.style]; this.setState({ goal: k }); this.setCfg({ 'ctx.length': gg.ctx, 'sample.temperature': st[2], 'sample.topP': st[3] }); },
        cardStyle: sel ? 'background:#ecfdf5;border:1.5px solid #10b981;' : 'background:#ffffff;border:1.5px solid #dee5ee;',
        iconWrap: sel ? 'background:#ffffff;' : 'background:#f7f7f7;',
        iconStyle: `background:${sel ? '#0c8a60' : '#2F384C'};mask:url(icons/${gg.icon}.svg) center/contain no-repeat;`,
      }; }),
      headroom: [['shared', 'Leave room for other apps', 'Keeps 15% of graphics memory and 2 CPU cores free, so browsing, calls and video stay smooth.', 'activity'], ['max', 'Full power', 'Uses all of the graphics card and every CPU core for the fastest replies. Best when Strata is the only thing running.', 'bolt']].map(([k, t, sub, ic]) => {
        const sel = c['sys.headroom'] === k, alt = this.calc({ ...c, 'sys.headroom': k });
        return { title: t, sub, stat: `≈ ${alt.gen.toFixed(0)} tok/s · ${k === 'max' ? 'all 12 GB' : (VRAM * 0.85).toFixed(1) + ' GB for Strata'}`,
          pick: () => this.setCfg({ 'sys.headroom': k }),
          cardStyle: sel ? 'background:#ecfdf5;border:1.5px solid #10b981;' : 'background:#ffffff;border:1.5px solid #dee5ee;',
          radio: sel ? 'border:6px solid #10b981;background:#ffffff;' : 'border:1.5px solid #c9d1db;background:#ffffff;',
          iconStyle: `background:${sel ? '#0c8a60' : '#2F384C'};mask:url(icons/${ic}.svg) center/contain no-repeat;` };
      }),
      pages: pages.toLocaleString(), ctxLabel: fmt('ctx.length', ctxV), ctxIdx: Math.max(0, CTXV.indexOf(ctxV)),
      setCtxIdx: e => this.setCfg({ 'ctx.length': CTXV[+e.target.value] }),
      ctxIsRec: ctxV === g.ctx, ctxNotRec: ctxV !== g.ctx, resetCtx: () => this.setCfg({ 'ctx.length': g.ctx }),
      ctxHint: +ctxV > +g.ctx ? `More than ${g.title.toLowerCase()} usually needs. It uses more memory and writes a little slower.` : +ctxV < +g.ctx ? 'Less than recommended. Long chats or files may get cut off, but replies come a bit faster.' : `About ${pages} pages of text. The right size for ${g.title.toLowerCase()} on this PC.`,
      styles: Object.entries(STYLES).map(([k, [t, sub, temp, tp]]) => ({ title: t, sub: style === null && k === 'balanced' ? 'Custom values set in Expert' : sub, pick: () => this.setCfg({ 'sample.temperature': temp, 'sample.topP': tp }), btnStyle: style === k ? 'background:#ffffff;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.06),0 4px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.03);' : 'background:transparent;' })),
      previewTag: anyChange ? 'Preview · not applied' : 'Current settings',
      streamText: s.stream, wps: Math.round(cc.gen * 0.75), readSec: (6500 / cc.read).toFixed(1),
      genTokS: cc.gen.toFixed(0), genVs: pctD(cc.gen, ca.gen),
      usedGb: cc.used.toFixed(1), mModel: cc.mModel.toFixed(1), mCtx: cc.mCtx.toFixed(1), mWork: cc.mWork.toFixed(1), mFree: cc.free.toFixed(1),
      barModel: pct(cc.mModel), barCtx: pct(cc.mCtx), barWork: pct(Math.max(0, cc.mWork - cc.over)), barOver: pct(cc.over), barReserve: pct(cc.reserve), showReserve: cc.reserve > 0, mReserve: cc.reserve.toFixed(1),
      fitLabel: fitMap[0], fitChip: fitMap[1], fitHint: fitMap[2], fitBox: { ok: 'background:#f7f7f7;color:#303030;', tight: 'background:#fff6e0;color:#8a5a00;', over: 'background:#fdecee;color:#b01a2e;' }[fit],
      // expert
      presets: allPresets.map(([name, p, custom], i) => { const active = same(resolve(p), c); return {
        name, sub: summary(p), custom, active,
        load: () => this.setCfg(resolve(p)),
        remove: e => { e.stopPropagation(); const list = s.userPresets.filter((_, j) => j !== i - BUILTIN.length); this.savePresets(list); this.setState({ userPresets: list }); },
        style: active ? 'background:#ecfdf5;border:1.5px solid #10b981;' : 'background:#ffffff;border:1.5px solid #dee5ee;',
      }; }),
      naming: s.naming, notNaming: !s.naming, nameDraft: s.nameDraft,
      startName: () => this.setState({ naming: true, nameDraft: '' }), cancelName: () => this.setState({ naming: false }),
      onName: e => this.setState({ nameDraft: e.target.value }),
      onNameKey: e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') this._savePreset(); if (e.key === 'Escape') this.setState({ naming: false }); },
      savePreset: () => this._savePreset(),
      tabParams: s.tab === 'params', tabRaw: s.tab === 'raw',
      toParams: () => this.setState({ tab: 'params' }), toRaw: () => this.setState({ tab: 'raw', raw: null, rawErr: null, rawWarn: null }),
      tabParamsStyle: seg(s.tab === 'params'), tabRawStyle: seg(s.tab === 'raw'),
      q: s.q, onQ: e => this.setState({ q: e.target.value }),
      unsavedN: changedKeys.length, toggleChanged: () => this.setState(x => ({ changedOnly: !x.changedOnly })), changedBtnStyle: s.changedOnly ? chipOn : chipOff,
      toggleDesc: () => this.setState(x => ({ showDesc: !x.showDesc })), descBtnStyle: s.showDesc ? chipOn : chipOff,
      groupChips: [['all', 'All'], ...GROUPS].map(([k, l]) => ({ label: l, pick: () => this.setState({ grp: k }), style: s.grp === k ? chipOn : chipOff })),
      groups, noResults: groups.length === 0,
      rawValue: raw, rawRows: rawLines, gutter: Array.from({ length: rawLines }, (_, i) => i + 1).join('\n'),
      onRaw: e => this.parseRaw(e.target.value),
      rawStatus: s.rawErr ? 'Invalid — draft not updated' : s.rawWarn ? 'Valid with warnings' : 'Valid · in sync',
      rawChip: s.rawErr ? 'background:#fdecee;color:#b01a2e;' : s.rawWarn ? 'background:#fff6e0;color:#8a5a00;' : 'background:#ecfdf5;color:#0c8a60;',
      rawHasMsg: !!(s.rawErr || s.rawWarn), rawMsg: s.rawErr || s.rawWarn || '',
      rawMsgStyle: s.rawErr ? 'background:#fdecee;color:#b01a2e;white-space:pre-wrap;' : 'background:#fff6e0;color:#8a5a00;',
      rawMsgIcon: `background:currentColor;mask:url(icons/${s.rawErr ? 'error' : 'warning'}.svg) center/contain no-repeat;`,
      rawFormat: () => { if (!s.rawErr) this.setState({ raw: null, rawWarn: null }); else { try { this.parseRaw(JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(raw), null, 2)); } catch (e) {} } },
      copyLabel: s.copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy',
      rawCopy: () => { navigator.clipboard?.writeText(raw); this.setState({ copied: true }); this.later(() => this.setState({ copied: false }), 1400); },
      rawExport: () => { const b = new Blob([raw], { type: 'application/json' }); const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(b); a.download = 'engine.json'; a.click(); setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 1000); },
      rawImport: () => this.fileRef.current?.click(), fileRef: this.fileRef,
      onFile: e => { const f = e.target.files?.[0]; if (!f) return; f.text().then(t => this.parseRaw(t)); e.target.value = ''; },
      genTok: cc.gen.toFixed(1), genPct: pctD(cc.gen, ca.gen), readTok: Math.round(cc.read).toLocaleString(), readPct: pctD(cc.read, ca.read),
      resolved: [['sys.headroom', c['sys.headroom'] === 'max' ? '0% reserved' : '15% reserved'], ['ctx.kvMode', cc.kv], ['batch.size', String(cc.batch)], ['gpu.layers', cc.gpu === 'all' ? 'all (48/48)' : 'split (29/48)'], ['cpu.threads', String(cc.threads)], ['mem.mode', cc.memMode]].map(([k, v]) => ({ k, v })),
      // change bar
      hasChanges: anyChange || s.applying != null,
      changeCount: changedKeys.length === 1 ? '1 unsaved change' : `${changedKeys.length} unsaved changes`,
      applyNote: loadN ? `${loadN} reload${loadN > 1 ? '' : 's'} the engine (~4 s), chats are kept` : 'applies from the next message',
      changeList: changedKeys.map(k => `${isExpert ? k : PM[k].label} ${fmt(k, s.saved[k])} → ${fmt(k, c[k])}`).join('   ·   '),
      changeFont: isExpert ? 'font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;' : '',
      applying: s.applying != null, notApplying: s.applying == null,
      applyStep: s.applying?.step ?? '', applyBar: `width:${s.applying?.p ?? 0}%;transition:width 70ms linear;`,
      applyLabel: loadN ? 'Apply & reload' : 'Save',
      undo: () => this.setState(x => ({ cfg: { ...x.saved }, raw: null, rawErr: null, rawWarn: null })),
      apply: () => this.apply(),
      toast: !!s.toast, toastTitle: s.toast?.t ?? '', toastSub: s.toast?.s ?? '',
      tuning: !!s.tuning, tuneDone: !!s.tuning?.done,
      tuneRunning: !!s.tuning && !s.tuning.done,
      tuneTitle: s.tuning?.done ? 'Your PC is tuned' : 'Tuning for your PC',
      tuneSub: s.tuning?.done ? 'Strata found the fastest setup for ' + g.title.toLowerCase() + '. Nothing changes until you review and apply it.' : 'Strata is testing your PC with the model to find the fastest setup. About 10 seconds.',
      tuneViz: s.tuning ? ce(TuneViz, { key: s.tuning.run, trials: s.tuning.trials, best: s.tuning.best, baseGen: ca.gen, vramT: s.tuning.vramT, onDone: this._tuneDone }) : null,
      cancelTune: () => this.setState({ tuning: null }),
      discardTune: () => this.setState({ tuning: null }),
      closeTune: () => { const c = this.state.tuning?.bestCfg; this.setState({ tuning: null }); if (c) this.setCfg(c); },
    };
  }
  _savePreset() {
    const name = this.state.nameDraft.trim(); if (!name) return;
    const diff = Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(DEFAULTS).filter(k => this.state.cfg[k] !== DEFAULTS[k]).map(k => [k, this.state.cfg[k]]));
    const list = [...this.state.userPresets, [name, diff]];
    this.savePresets(list); this.setState({ userPresets: list, naming: false });
  }
}
</script>
</body>
</html>

      <span style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;"><span style="font-weight:700;">{{ toastTitle }}</span><span style="color:#6f6f6f;">{{ toastSub }}</span></span>
    </div>
  </sc-if>
</div>
</x-dc>
<script type="text/x-dc" data-dc-script data-props="{&quot;hardware&quot;:{&quot;editor&quot;:&quot;enum&quot;,&quot;options&quot;:[&quot;this&quot;,&quot;laptop&quot;,&quot;workstation&quot;],&quot;default&quot;:&quot;this&quot;,&quot;tsType&quot;:&quot;'this'|'laptop'|'workstation'&quot;}}">
const Q = [
  ['Q2_K', 'Smallest', 2.9, 90.8, '+9.1%', 96],
  ['Q3_K_M', 'Compact', 3.9, 95.4, '+3.8%', 90],
  ['Q4_K_M', 'Balanced', 4.9, 98.1, '+1.2%', 84],
  ['Q5_K_M', 'High quality', 5.7, 99.0, '+0.5%', 78],
  ['Q6_K', 'Very high', 6.6, 99.5, '+0.2%', 72],
  ['Q8_0', 'Near-original', 8.5, 99.9, '+0.04%', 64],
  ['BF16', 'Original', 16, 100, '0', 50],
].map(([id, name, bits, quality, ppl, base]) => ({ id, name, bits, quality, ppl, base, size: +(30.5 * bits / 8).toFixed(1) }));
const HW = {
  this: { label: 'RTX 4070 · 12 GB · 32 GB RAM', vram: 12, ram: 32, disk: 1000, used: 588 },
  laptop: { label: 'RTX 4060 Laptop · 8 GB · 16 GB RAM', vram: 8, ram: 16, disk: 512, used: 401 },
  workstation: { label: 'RTX 4090 · 24 GB · 64 GB RAM', vram: 24, ram: 64, disk: 2000, used: 910 },
};

class Component extends DCLogic {
  state = { running: 'Q4_K_M', installed: ['Q4_K_M', 'Q3_K_M'], selected: null, dl: {}, switching: null, toast: null };
  componentWillUnmount() { (this.timers || []).forEach(clearInterval); clearTimeout(this.tt); }
  hw() { return HW[this.props.hardware ?? 'this'] || HW.this; }
  fit(q) {
    const hw = this.hw(), vAvail = hw.vram * 0.92, cap = vAvail + hw.ram * 0.6, need = +(q.size + 2.5).toFixed(1);
    if (need > cap) return { zone: 'none', need, gpuPart: Math.min(need, vAvail), sysPart: Math.max(0, cap - vAvail), over: need - cap, speed: 0, cap };
    const frac = vAvail / need, speed = q.base * (0.35 + 0.65 * Math.min(1, frac * 1.3));
    return { zone: speed >= 60 ? 'fast' : 'slow', need, gpuPart: Math.min(need, vAvail), sysPart: Math.max(0, need - vAvail), over: 0, speed, cap, onGpu: Math.min(100, Math.round(frac * 100)) };
  }
  rec() {
    const fits = Q.map(q => [q, this.fit(q)]).filter(([, f]) => f.zone !== 'none');
    const fast = fits.filter(([, f]) => f.zone === 'fast');
    if (fast.length) return fast[fast.length - 1][0].id;
    if (fits.length) return fits[0][0].id;
    return Q[0].id;
  }
  toastMsg(t, s) { this.setState({ toast: { t, s } }); clearTimeout(this.tt); this.tt = setTimeout(() => this.setState({ toast: null }), 3000); }
  download(id) {
    if (this.state.dl[id] != null) return;
    this.setState(s => ({ dl: { ...s.dl, [id]: 0 } }));
    const iv = setInterval(() => {
      const p = (this.state.dl[id] ?? 0) + 1.6 + Math.random() * 1.4;
      if (this.state.dl[id] == null) { clearInterval(iv); return; }
      if (p >= 100) { clearInterval(iv); this.setState(s => { const dl = { ...s.dl }; delete dl[id]; return { dl, installed: [...s.installed, id] }; }); this.toastMsg('Download complete', `${Q.find(q => q.id === id).name} is ready to use.`); return; }
      this.setState(s => ({ dl: { ...s.dl, [id]: p } }));
    }, 120);
    (this.timers ||= []).push(iv);
  }
  cancel(id) { this.setState(s => { const dl = { ...s.dl }; delete dl[id]; return { dl }; }); }
  switchTo(id) {
    if (this.state.switching) return;
    const steps = ['Unloading the current version…', 'Loading weights from disk…', 'Moving experts to the graphics card…', 'Warming up…'];
    this.setState({ switching: { to: id, p: 0 } });
    const iv = setInterval(() => {
      const p = this.state.switching.p + 2.6;
      if (p >= 100) { clearInterval(iv); this.setState({ running: id, switching: null }); const q = Q.find(x => x.id === id); this.toastMsg('Now running ' + q.name, `${this.fit(q).speed.toFixed(0)} tok/s on this PC.`); return; }
      this.setState({ switching: { to: id, p, step: steps[Math.min(3, Math.floor(p / 25))] } });
    }, 60);
    (this.timers ||= []).push(iv);
  }
  remove(id) { if (id === this.state.running) return; this.setState(s => ({ installed: s.installed.filter(x => x !== id) })); this.toastMsg('Version deleted', `${Q.find(q => q.id === id).size} GB freed.`); }

  renderVals() {
    const s = this.state, hw = this.hw(), recId = this.rec();
    const selId = s.selected ?? s.running ?? recId;
    const zoneCol = { fast: ['#f3fcf8', '#10b981'], slow: ['#fffaf0', '#e39b0b'], none: ['repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,#f4f6f8 0 4px,#fafbfc 4px 8px)', '#c9d1db'] };
    const quants = Q.map((q, i) => {
      const f = this.fit(q), sel = q.id === selId, inst = s.installed.includes(q.id), run = q.id === s.running, dl = s.dl[q.id] != null;
      const [bg, zc] = zoneCol[f.zone];
      const node = run ? 'background:#10b981;border:0;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #d1fae5;' : inst ? 'background:#2F384C;border:0;' : f.zone === 'none' ? 'background:#ffffff;border:2px dashed #c9d1db;' : 'background:#ffffff;border:2px solid #2F384C;';
      return {
        id: q.id, name: q.name, sizeLabel: q.size + ' GB',
        speedLabel: f.zone === 'none' ? 'Won\u2019t fit' : f.speed.toFixed(0) + ' tok/s',
        speedStyle: f.zone === 'none' ? 'color:#9aa3ab;' : f.zone === 'slow' ? 'color:#8a5a00;' : 'color:#0c8a60;',
        stateTag: run ? 'Running' : dl ? `Downloading ${Math.floor(s.dl[q.id])}%` : inst ? 'Downloaded' : '',
        isRec: q.id === recId,
        select: () => this.setState({ selected: q.id }),
        colStyle: (sel ? 'background:#ffffff;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #221e1f inset,0 10px 24px rgba(15,23,42,.10);border-radius:16px;z-index:2;' : `background:${bg};`) + (i === 0 && !sel ? 'border-radius:14px 0 0 14px;' : '') + (i === Q.length - 1 && !sel ? 'border-radius:0 14px 14px 0;' : ''),
        zoneBar: `background:${zc};` + (sel ? 'left:14px;right:14px;border-radius:0 0 3px 3px;' : '') + (i === 0 ? 'border-top-left-radius:14px;' : '') + (i === Q.length - 1 ? 'border-top-right-radius:14px;' : ''),
        conStyle: i === 0 ? 'left:50%;right:0;' : i === Q.length - 1 ? 'left:0;right:50%;' : 'left:0;right:0;',
        node: node + (sel ? 'transform:scale(1.15);' : ''),
        nodeInner: run || inst ? 'width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#ffffff;' : 'width:0;height:0;',
      };
    });
    const q = Q.find(x => x.id === selId), f = this.fit(q), run = q.id === s.running, inst = s.installed.includes(q.id), dl = s.dl[q.id];
    const qualityTxt = q.quality >= 99.5 ? 'Practically identical to the original.' : q.quality >= 98 ? 'Hard to tell apart from the original in everyday use.' : q.quality >= 95 ? 'Slightly less precise on hard reasoning and code.' : 'Noticeably less precise. Best when memory is very tight.';
    const fitTxt = f.zone === 'none' ? `It needs about ${f.need} GB of memory, and this PC has about ${f.cap.toFixed(0)} GB free for models.` : f.sysPart < 0.05 ? 'Runs entirely on your graphics card, the fastest way to run it.' : f.zone === 'fast' ? 'Most of it runs on your graphics card. Rarely used experts sit in system memory, so it\u2019s still fast.' : 'It fits, but more of it lives in slower system memory, so replies come noticeably slower.';
    const total = Math.max(f.need, f.cap), pw = v => `width:${(v / total * 100).toFixed(1)}%;`;
    const freeDisk = hw.disk - hw.used - s.installed.reduce((a, id) => a + Q.find(x => x.id === id).size, 0);
    const chip = run ? ['Running', 'background:#ecfdf5;color:#0c8a60;'] : dl != null ? ['Downloading', 'background:#e8f4ff;color:#0668c2;'] : inst ? ['Downloaded', 'background:#f7f7f7;color:#303030;'] : f.zone === 'none' ? ['Too big', 'background:#fdecee;color:#b01a2e;'] : q.id === recId ? ['Recommended', 'background:#221e1f;color:#ffffff;'] : ['Available', 'background:#f7f7f7;color:#303030;'];
    const runQ = Q.find(x => x.id === s.running), swQ = s.switching && Q.find(x => x.id === s.switching.to);
    const modelGb = s.installed.reduce((a, id) => a + Q.find(x => x.id === id).size, 0);
    const dlLeft = dl != null ? (q.size * (1 - dl / 100)) : 0;

    return {
      hwLabel: 'Checked for ' + hw.label,
      heroSwitching: !!s.switching, heroRunning: !s.switching && !!s.running, heroIdle: !s.switching && !s.running,
      switchName: swQ ? `${swQ.name} · ${swQ.id}` : '', switchBar: `width:${s.switching?.p ?? 0}%;transition:width 60ms linear;`, switchStep: s.switching?.step ?? 'Unloading the current version…',
      runName: runQ?.name ?? '', runQuant: runQ ? runQ.id + ' · ' + runQ.size + ' GB' : '', runSpeed: runQ ? this.fit(runQ).speed.toFixed(0) : '',
      unload: () => { this.setState({ running: null }); this.toastMsg('Model unloaded', 'Your graphics card is free.'); },
      loadRec: () => { const id = s.installed.includes(recId) ? recId : s.installed[0]; if (id) this.switchTo(id); },
      loadRecLabel: 'Load ' + (Q.find(x => x.id === (s.installed.includes(recId) ? recId : s.installed[0]))?.name ?? 'model'),
      quants,
      sel: {
        id: q.id, name: q.name, chip: chip[0], chipStyle: chip[1],
        blurb: qualityTxt + ' ' + fitTxt,
        quality: q.quality.toFixed(1), qualityBar: `width:${((q.quality - 85) / 15 * 100).toFixed(1)}%;`,
        speed: f.zone === 'none' ? '—' : f.speed.toFixed(0),
        speedBar: `width:${(f.speed / 96 * 100).toFixed(1)}%;background:${f.zone === 'slow' ? '#e39b0b' : '#10b981'};`,
        size: q.size, diskNote: inst ? 'Already on this PC' : `${freeDisk.toFixed(0)} GB free on disk`,
        need: f.need, memGpu: pw(f.gpuPart), memSys: pw(f.sysPart), memOver: pw(f.over),
        memNote: f.zone === 'none' ? `${f.over.toFixed(1)} GB more than this PC has` : f.sysPart < 0.05 ? `All ${f.need} GB on graphics card` : `${f.gpuPart.toFixed(1)} GB graphics card + ${f.sysPart.toFixed(1)} GB system`,
        bits: q.bits.toFixed(1), ppl: q.ppl, expertsVram: f.zone === 'none' ? '—' : (f.onGpu ?? 100) + '%', file: `qwen3.8-flash-next-${q.id}.gguf`,
      },
      act: {
        running: run, installed: inst && !run && dl == null, downloading: dl != null, available: !inst && dl == null && f.zone !== 'none', tooBig: !inst && dl == null && f.zone === 'none',
        switchNote: s.running ? `Switching takes about 5 seconds. Your chats stay open.` : 'Load it to start chatting.',
        switchTo: () => this.switchTo(q.id), remove: () => this.remove(q.id), btnState: s.switching ? 'opacity:.5;pointer-events:none;' : '',
        dlPct: dl != null ? Math.floor(dl) : 0, dlBar: `width:${dl ?? 0}%;`, dlNote: dl != null ? `${(q.size - dlLeft).toFixed(1)} of ${q.size} GB · 112 MB/s · about ${Math.max(1, Math.round(dlLeft * 1024 / 112 / 60))} min left` : '',
        cancel: () => this.cancel(q.id), download: () => this.download(q.id),
        availNote: f.zone === 'fast' ? `Fits well on this PC. You'll be able to switch to it as soon as it's downloaded.` : 'It will run, but slower than the recommended version.',
        bigNote: `It needs about ${f.need} GB and this PC has about ${f.cap.toFixed(0)} GB. A PC with more graphics or system memory could run it.`,
        pickRec: () => this.setState({ selected: recId }),
      },
      installedRows: [...s.installed, ...Object.keys(s.dl)].map(id => {
        const qq = Q.find(x => x.id === id), ff = this.fit(qq), isRun = id === s.running, isDl = s.dl[id] != null;
        return {
          id, name: qq.name, isRunning: isRun, isDl, canSwitch: !isRun && !isDl, dlPct: isDl ? Math.floor(s.dl[id]) : 0,
          meta: `${qq.size} GB on disk · ${qq.quality}% quality · ${ff.zone === 'none' ? 'won\u2019t fit' : ff.speed.toFixed(0) + ' tok/s'}${isDl ? ' · downloading' : ''}`,
          dot: isRun ? 'background:#10b981;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #d1fae5;' : isDl ? 'background:#0f97ff;' : 'background:#2F384C;',
          style: id === selId ? 'background:#f7f7f7;' : '',
          switchTo: () => this.switchTo(id), remove: () => this.remove(id),
        };
      }),
      storageLabel: `${modelGb.toFixed(1)} GB of model files`,
      storageBar: `width:${((hw.used + modelGb) / hw.disk * 100).toFixed(1)}%;`,
      storageNote: `${freeDisk.toFixed(0)} GB free of ${hw.disk >= 1000 ? (hw.disk / 1000) + ' TB' : hw.disk + ' GB'} · models use ${modelGb.toFixed(1)} GB`,
      toast: !!s.toast, toastTitle: s.toast?.t ?? '', toastSub: s.toast?.s ?? '',
    };
  }
}
