    installed = sum(p.stat().st_size for _, p in files)
    name = f"{prefix}-{folder.name}.{fmt}"        # prefix strata-dsv41 for the separate DeepSeek engine packages
    archive = Path(out) / name
    _write_archive(files, archive, fmt, component.entrypoint)
    entry = {"version": component.version, "platform": component.platform, "backend": component.backend,
             "variant": component.variant, "archs": list(component.archs), "min_driver": dict(component.min_driver),
             "min_runtime": component.min_runtime, "build_id": component.build_id, "format": fmt,
             "url": f"{url_prefix}{name}", "size": archive.stat().st_size, "sha256": _sha256(archive),
             "manifest_sha256": _sha256(folder / ec.MANIFEST), "installed_bytes": installed, "notes": component.notes}
    (Path(out) / (name + ".entry.json")).write_text(json.dumps(entry, indent=1) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return entry


def pack_control(folder: Path, out: Path, *, version: str, platform: str, fmt: str = "tar.gz",
                 entry_file: str = "strata.py", url_prefix: str = "control/") -> dict:
    folder = Path(folder)
    files = _tree(folder, links=True)
    installed = sum(p.stat().st_size for _, p in files if not p.is_symlink())
    name = f"strata-control-{version}-{platform}.{fmt}"
    archive = Path(out) / name
    _write_archive(files, archive, fmt, entry_file)
    entry = {"platform": platform, "format": fmt, "url": f"{url_prefix}{name}", "size": archive.stat().st_size,
             "sha256": _sha256(archive), "installed_bytes": installed, "entry": entry_file, "version": version}
    (Path(out) / (name + ".entry.json")).write_text(json.dumps(entry, indent=1) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return entry


def build_feed(out: Path, *, key: dict, sequence: int, channel: str = "stable", engine_dir: Path | None = None,
               control_dir: Path | None = None, app_json: Path | None = None, expires_days: int | None = None,
               now: dt.datetime | None = None, dsv41_dir: Path | None = None) -> dict:
    now = now or dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
    install_manifest = ""
    document: dict = {"schema_version": feedmod.SCHEMA_VERSION, "feed": "strata-updates", "channel": channel,
                      "sequence": sequence, "generated_at": now.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
                      "expires_at": (now + dt.timedelta(days=expires_days)).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") if expires_days else None}
    if engine_dir:
        document["engine"] = {"packages": [json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                                           for p in sorted(Path(engine_dir).glob("*.entry.json"))]}
    if dsv41_dir:
        document["dsv41"] = {"packages": [json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                                          for p in sorted(Path(dsv41_dir).glob("*.entry.json"))]}
    if control_dir:
        entries = [json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) for p in sorted(Path(control_dir).glob("*.entry.json"))]
        versions = {e["version"] for e in entries}
        if len(versions) > 1:
            raise SystemExit(f"the control packages are for different versions: {sorted(versions)}")
        if entries:
            document["control"] = {"version": versions.pop(), "packages": [{k: v for k, v in e.items() if k != "version"} for e in entries]}
            for e in entries:     # install.sh unpacks with tar -xzf, install.ps1 with Expand-Archive: a pack in the other format cannot be installed that way
                want = "zip" if e["platform"].startswith("windows") else "tar.gz"
                if e.get("format") != want:
                    print(f"note: the {e['platform']} control package is {e.get('format')}, so it is left out of install-manifest.txt "
                          f"(the one-line installer needs {want}; pack-control --format {want})", file=sys.stderr)
                    continue
                install_manifest += f"{e['platform']} {e['version']} {e['url']} {e['sha256']} {e['size']}\n"
    if app_json:
        document["app"] = json.loads(Path(app_json).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    payload = (json.dumps(document, indent=1, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
    Path(out).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (Path(out) / feedmod.FEED_NAME).write_bytes(payload)
    signature = signing.sign_bytes(key, payload)
    (Path(out) / (feedmod.FEED_NAME + feedmod.SIGNATURE_SUFFIX)).write_text(json.dumps(signature) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    if install_manifest:                        # what install.sh / install.ps1 read: platform version url sha256 size, one line per Terminal (Control) package
        (Path(out) / "install-manifest.txt").write_text(install_manifest, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    if "app" in document:                       # the file the Tauri updater plugin reads
        latest = Path(out) / "app" / "latest.json"
        latest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        latest.write_text(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in document["app"].items()}, indent=1) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    # a parse of what was written is the last check: a feed this tool makes must be a feed Control accepts
    feedmod.verify_and_parse(payload, json.dumps(signature).encode(), source=str(Path(out) / feedmod.FEED_NAME),
                             trusted={key["key_id"]: __import__("base64").b64decode(key["public"])}, now=now)
    return document


TAURI_TARGET_NAMES = tuple(feedmod.TAURI_TARGETS.values()) + ("linux-aarch64",)


def _default_app_pubkey() -> str:
    conf = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "apps" / "desktop" / "src-tauri" / "tauri.conf.json"
    return json.loads(conf.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["plugins"]["updater"]["pubkey"]


def _check_mac_archive(archive: Path) -> None:
    """A Mac updater archive is a gzip tar with exactly one top-level ``<Name>.app`` folder (what Tauri's bundler makes)."""
    try:
        with tarfile.open(archive, "r:gz") as tar:
            tops = {m.name.lstrip("./").split("/", 1)[0] for m in tar.getmembers() if m.name.lstrip("./")}
            names = set(tar.getnames())
    except (tarfile.TarError, OSError) as exc:
        raise SystemExit(f"{archive.name} is not a readable .tar.gz ({exc})")
    if len(tops) != 1 or not next(iter(tops)).endswith(".app"):
        raise SystemExit(f"{archive.name} must hold one <Name>.app folder at its root; found {sorted(tops)[:5]}")
    app = next(iter(tops))
    if not any(n.lstrip("./") == f"{app}/Contents/Info.plist" for n in names):
        raise SystemExit(f"{archive.name} has no {app}/Contents/Info.plist")


def set_app_platform(app_json: Path, *, target: str, archive: Path, signature_file: Path, url: str, version: str | None = None,
                     notes: str | None = None, pub_date: str | None = None, pubkey: str | None = None,
                     now: dt.datetime | None = None) -> dict:
    """Add or replace one platform in the Tauri updater JSON (the file ``build-feed --app-json`` takes; it becomes ``latest.json``).

    The ``.sig`` is made by ``npx tauri signer sign`` (or by ``tauri build`` for the Windows / Linux installers) and is only READ here;
    this tool never touches the Tauri private key. It is checked against the public key in ``tauri.conf.json`` (or ``pubkey``) over the
    exact archive bytes, so a signature of an older or unsigned file, or one from another key, is refused before it can be published.
    ``sha256`` and ``size`` are taken from the archive."""
    if target not in TAURI_TARGET_NAMES:
        raise SystemExit(f"unknown target {target!r}; use one of {', '.join(TAURI_TARGET_NAMES)}")
    archive, signature_file = Path(archive), Path(signature_file)
    if target.startswith("darwin-"):
        _check_mac_archive(archive)
    signature = signature_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    try:
        with archive.open("rb") as stream:
            signing.minisign_verify(pubkey or _default_app_pubkey(), signature, iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""))
    except signing.SignatureError as exc:
        raise SystemExit(f"{signature_file.name} does not verify for {archive.name}: {exc}")
    document: dict = {}
    if Path(app_json).exists():
        document = json.loads(Path(app_json).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if version:
        if document.get("version") not in (None, version):
            raise SystemExit(f"{app_json} is for version {document['version']}, not {version}")
        document["version"] = version
    if not document.get("version"):
        raise SystemExit("a new app json needs --version")
    document.setdefault("notes", notes or "")
    if notes:
        document["notes"] = notes
    document["pub_date"] = pub_date or document.get("pub_date") or (now or dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    document.setdefault("platforms", {})[target] = {"url": url, "signature": signature, "sha256": _sha256(archive),
                                                    "size": archive.stat().st_size}
    Path(app_json).write_text(json.dumps(document, indent=1) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return document["platforms"][target]


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    k = sub.add_parser("keygen")
    k.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    sp = sub.add_parser("sign-package")
    sp.add_argument("folder", type=Path)
    sp.add_argument("--key", type=Path, required=True)
    pe = sub.add_parser("pack-engine")
    pe.add_argument("folder", type=Path)
    pe.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    pe.add_argument("--format", choices=feedmod.FORMATS, default="tar.gz")
    pe.add_argument("--url-prefix", default="engine/", help='where the archive sits relative to the feed ("" for flat GitHub release assets)')
    pe.add_argument("--prefix", default="strata-engine", help="archive name prefix (strata-dsv41 for the DeepSeek engine packages)")
    pc = sub.add_parser("pack-control")
    pc.add_argument("folder", type=Path)
    pc.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    pc.add_argument("--version", required=True)
    pc.add_argument("--platform", required=True, choices=feedmod.PLATFORMS)
    pc.add_argument("--format", choices=feedmod.FORMATS, default="tar.gz")
    pc.add_argument("--url-prefix", default="control/")
    bf = sub.add_parser("build-feed")
    bf.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    bf.add_argument("--key", type=Path, required=True)
    bf.add_argument("--sequence", type=int, required=True)
    bf.add_argument("--channel", default="stable")
    bf.add_argument("--engine", type=Path)
    bf.add_argument("--dsv41", type=Path, help="folder of the DeepSeek engine packages' .entry.json files (feed member dsv41)")
    bf.add_argument("--control", type=Path)
    bf.add_argument("--app-json", type=Path)
    bf.add_argument("--expires-days", type=int)
    sa = sub.add_parser("set-app-platform", help="add one signed app installer to the Tauri updater json")
    sa.add_argument("--app-json", type=Path, required=True, help="the file to create or patch (what build-feed --app-json takes)")
    sa.add_argument("--target", required=True, help="darwin-aarch64, darwin-x86_64, windows-x86_64 or linux-x86_64")
    sa.add_argument("--archive", type=Path, required=True)
    sa.add_argument("--sig", type=Path, required=True, help="the .sig file made by tauri signer sign")
    sa.add_argument("--url", help="where the archive is published (default: the latest GitHub release)")
    sa.add_argument("--version")
    sa.add_argument("--notes")
    sa.add_argument("--pub-date")
    sa.add_argument("--pubkey", help="the Tauri public key (default: tauri.conf.json plugins.updater.pubkey)")
    vf = sub.add_parser("verify-feed")
    vf.add_argument("source")
    vf.add_argument("--pub", type=Path, required=True)
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    if a.cmd == "keygen":
        public = keygen(a.out)
        print(f"wrote {a.out / 'feed-key.json'} (SECRET, keep it offline and backed up) and {a.out / 'feed-key.pub.json'}")
        print(f"key_id {public['key_id']}")
    elif a.cmd == "sign-package":
        print("manifest sha256", sign_package(a.folder, _load_key(a.key)))
    elif a.cmd == "pack-engine":
        entry = pack_engine(a.folder, a.out, a.format, url_prefix=a.url_prefix, prefix=a.prefix)
        print(json.dumps({k: entry[k] for k in ("version", "backend", "variant", "size", "sha256", "manifest_sha256")}, indent=1))
    elif a.cmd == "pack-control":
        entry = pack_control(a.folder, a.out, version=a.version, platform=a.platform, fmt=a.format, url_prefix=a.url_prefix)
        print(json.dumps({k: entry[k] for k in ("version", "platform", "size", "sha256")}, indent=1))
    elif a.cmd == "build-feed":
        doc = build_feed(a.out, key=_load_key(a.key), sequence=a.sequence, channel=a.channel, engine_dir=a.engine,
                         control_dir=a.control, app_json=a.app_json, expires_days=a.expires_days, dsv41_dir=a.dsv41)
        print(f"wrote {a.out / feedmod.FEED_NAME} (+ .sig); engines {len((doc.get('engine') or {}).get('packages', []))}, "
              f"deepseek engines {len((doc.get('dsv41') or {}).get('packages', []))}, control {'yes' if 'control' in doc else 'no'}, app {'yes' if 'app' in doc else 'no'}")
    elif a.cmd == "set-app-platform":
        url = a.url or f"https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/{a.archive.name}"
        entry = set_app_platform(a.app_json, target=a.target, archive=a.archive, signature_file=a.sig, url=url, version=a.version,
                                 notes=a.notes, pub_date=a.pub_date, pubkey=a.pubkey)
        print(f"{a.app_json}: {a.target} -> {entry['url']} ({entry['size']} bytes, sha256 {entry['sha256'][:16]}..., signature verified)")
    elif a.cmd == "verify-feed":
        trusted = signing.load_trusted_keys(a.pub, environ={})
        loaded = feedmod.fetch(a.source, trusted)
        print(f"ok: sequence {loaded.sequence}, channel {loaded.channel}, signed by {loaded.key_id}, "
              f"{len(loaded.engine)} engine packages, control {len(loaded.control)}, app {'yes' if loaded.app else 'no'}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())


## packaging/lock_wheels.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Write the hash-pinned runtime lock of one terminal target.

The terminal archive installs its Python packages from `packaging/locks/runtime-<target>-cp312.txt` with
`pip install --require-hashes --no-deps --only-binary=:all:`: every package, direct or not, is named with an exact
version and the SHA-256 of the wheel(s) accepted for it, so a build can only ever install the files this lock lists.
The lock is made here, from `requirements.txt` + `requirements-monitor.txt` (the direct, version-pinned runtime
packages) by letting pip resolve and download the wheels for the target's tags and hashing what it fetched.

    python packaging/lock_wheels.py --target windows-x86_64          # writes packaging/locks/...
    python packaging/lock_wheels.py --target linux-x86_64 --check    # fails when the committed lock differs
    python packaging/lock_wheels.py --target linux-x86_64 --download wheelhouse/   # exactly the locked wheels

Run it when a pin in requirements.txt changes, review the diff, commit. Building an archive never runs it.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
LOCKS = ROOT / "packaging" / "locks"
INPUTS = ("requirements.txt", "requirements-monitor.txt")

#: pip's tags for each target, and the environment markers evaluate under for it.
TARGETS = {
    "windows-x86_64": {"platforms": ["win_amd64"], "env": {"sys_platform": "win32", "platform_system": "Windows",
                                                            "os_name": "nt"}},
    "linux-x86_64": {"platforms": ["manylinux2014_x86_64", "manylinux_2_17_x86_64", "manylinux_2_28_x86_64",
                                   "manylinux_2_34_x86_64", "linux_x86_64"],
                     "env": {"sys_platform": "linux", "platform_system": "Linux", "os_name": "posix"}},
    "darwin-arm64": {"platforms": ["macosx_11_0_arm64", "macosx_12_0_arm64", "macosx_13_0_arm64",
                                   "macosx_14_0_arm64"],
                     "env": {"sys_platform": "darwin", "platform_system": "Darwin", "os_name": "posix"}},
}
PYTHON = "3.12"
ABI = "cp312"


def lock_path(target: str) -> Path:
    return LOCKS / f"runtime-{target}-{ABI}.txt"


def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as fh:
        for block in iter(lambda: fh.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()


def norm(name: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[-_.]+", "-", name).lower()


def _dropped_for_target(target: str) -> set[str]:
    """Direct requirements whose environment marker is false for the target (pip evaluated markers for the host that
    runs this script: a Windows-only package must not land in the Linux lock, nor the reverse)."""
    from packaging.requirements import Requirement
    env = {"python_version": PYTHON, "python_full_version": PYTHON + ".15", "implementation_name": "cpython",
           "platform_python_implementation": "CPython", **TARGETS[target]["env"]}
    dropped = set()
    for name in INPUTS:
        for line in (ROOT / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            line = line.split(" #")[0].strip()
            if not line or line.startswith("#"):
                continue
            req = Requirement(line)
            if req.marker is not None and not req.marker.evaluate(env):
                dropped.add(norm(req.name))
    # a requirement listed twice with different markers (numpy) is kept when any line applies
    kept = set()
    for name in INPUTS:
        for line in (ROOT / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            line = line.split(" #")[0].strip()
            if not line or line.startswith("#"):
                continue
            req = Requirement(line)
            if req.marker is None or req.marker.evaluate(env):
                kept.add(norm(req.name))
    return dropped - kept


def build_lock(target: str) -> str:
    spec = TARGETS[target]
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="strata-lock-") as tmp:
        cmd = [sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "download", "--quiet", "--only-binary=:all:",
               "--python-version", PYTHON, "--implementation", "cp", "--abi", ABI, "-d", tmp]
        for p in spec["platforms"]:
            cmd += ["--platform", p]
        for name in INPUTS:
            cmd += ["-r", str(ROOT / name)]
        subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
        wheels: dict[str, tuple[str, list[str]]] = {}
        for whl in sorted(Path(tmp).glob("*.whl")):
            name, version = whl.name.split("-")[:2]
            wheels.setdefault(norm(name), (version, []))[1].append(sha256(whl))
    drop = _dropped_for_target(target)
    out = [
        "# Hash-pinned runtime packages for the " + target + " terminal archive (CPython 3.12, " + ABI + ").",
        "# Made by packaging/lock_wheels.py from requirements.txt + requirements-monitor.txt; installed at BUILD time with",
        "#   pip install --require-hashes --no-deps --only-binary=:all: -r <this file>",
        "# and never on the user's PC. To change a package: edit requirements.txt, run lock_wheels.py, review the diff.",
    ]
    for name in sorted(wheels):
        if name in drop:
            continue
        version, hashes = wheels[name]
        out.append(f"{name}=={version} \\")
        out.append(" \\\n".join(f"    --hash=sha256:{h}" for h in sorted(set(hashes))))
    return "\n".join(out) + "\n"


def download_locked(target: str, dest: Path) -> int:
    """Fetch exactly the wheels the committed lock names (pip verifies every hash) into `dest`, for a build on a
    machine with no internet: package_terminal.py --wheelhouse dest. Works from any host for any target."""
    spec = TARGETS[target]
    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cmd = [sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "download", "--quiet", "--only-binary=:all:", "--require-hashes", "--no-deps",
           "--python-version", PYTHON, "--implementation", "cp", "--abi", ABI, "-d", str(dest),
           "-r", str(lock_path(target))]
    for p in spec["platforms"]:
        cmd += ["--platform", p]
    subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
    count = len(list(dest.glob("*.whl")))
    print(f"{count} wheels in {dest}")
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--target", choices=sorted(TARGETS), required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="compare with the committed lock instead of writing")
    ap.add_argument("--download", metavar="DIR", help="fetch the locked wheels into DIR (hash-checked) and stop")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    if a.download:
        return download_locked(a.target, Path(a.download))
    text = build_lock(a.target)
    path = lock_path(a.target)
    if a.check:
        same = path.exists() and path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == text
        print(("lock is current: " if same else "lock DIFFERS: ") + str(path))
        return 0 if same else 1
    LOCKS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    print(f"wrote {path} ({text.count('==')} packages)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())


## packaging/make_local_feed.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build a LOCAL, TEST-SIGNED release folder (a feed) from a Terminal archive and engine packages, to try `install.sh`, `install.ps1`,
`strata update` and `strata launch` end to end without any hosting. Nothing is uploaded.

    python packaging/make_local_feed.py --out FEED --terminal strata-terminal-0.1.45-linux-x86_64.tar.gz \
        --engine /path/to/components/engine/0.1.45-linux-x86_64-cuda [--engine ...] \
        [--keys KEYDIR] [--url http://127.0.0.1:8099] [--sequence 1]
    python -m http.server 8099 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory FEED         # serve it (foreground; stop it with Ctrl+C)

What it writes into FEED (the folder a person would host):
    strata-feed.json + .sig        the signed feed (Ed25519, the key in KEYDIR, made once, never inside a git checkout)
    control/*, engine/*            the Terminal (as a "control" package) and each engine package, archived
    install-manifest.txt           one line per platform for install.sh / install.ps1: platform version url sha256 size (written by feed_tool build-feed)
    install.sh, install.ps1        the one-line installers with this feed's address filled in (--url)
    test-trust.json                the PUBLIC test key: `STRATA_UPDATE_TRUSTED_KEYS=<this file>` lets this build trust the feed
                                   (the real key goes into strata_control/update_keys.json at release; this one never does)

The engine package folders are copied (never changed in place) before they are signed with the test key.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
RELEASE_FEED = "https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download"      # the address built into install.sh / install.ps1; a local feed bakes its own in its place
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "packaging"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

import feed_tool as ft  # noqa: E402


def extract_terminal(archive: Path, into: Path) -> Path:
    """Unpack a terminal archive; returns the folder that holds python/ and strata.py."""
    if archive.name.endswith(".zip"):
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zf:
            zf.extractall(into)
    else:
        with tarfile.open(archive) as tf:
            try:
                tf.extractall(into, filter="data")
            except TypeError:                       # Python before 3.12 (a Mac's system 3.9): no extraction filters; the archive is our own
                tf.extractall(into)
    (inner,) = [p for p in into.iterdir() if p.is_dir()]
    return inner


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--terminal", type=Path, action="append", default=[], help="a terminal archive (.tar.gz or .zip); repeat per platform")
    ap.add_argument("--engine", type=Path, action="append", default=[], help="an engine package folder (with engine-component.json)")
    ap.add_argument("--keys", type=Path, default=None, help="folder for the test key (default: <out>/../feed-test-keys)")
    ap.add_argument("--url", default="http://127.0.0.1:8099", help="the address this feed will be served at (baked into install.sh/.ps1)")
    ap.add_argument("--sequence", type=int, default=1)
    ap.add_argument("--version", default=None, help="control version label (default: from the first terminal archive's VERSION)")
    ap.add_argument("--channel", default="stable")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)

    out = a.out.resolve()
    keys = (a.keys or out.parent / "feed-test-keys").resolve()
    if not (keys / "feed-key.json").exists():
        ft.keygen(keys, allow_git=True)
    key = ft._load_key(keys / "feed-key.json")
    shutil.rmtree(out, ignore_errors=True)
    (out / "engine").mkdir(parents=True)
    (out / "control").mkdir(parents=True)
    version = a.version
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="strata-feed-") as tmp:
        tmpdir = Path(tmp)
        for n, term in enumerate(a.terminal):
            work = tmpdir / f"t{n}"
            work.mkdir()
            folder = extract_terminal(term.resolve(), work)
            v = version or (folder / "VERSION").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
            version = v
            platform = ("windows-x86_64" if (folder / "python" / "python.exe").exists() else
                        "macos-arm64" if ("darwin" in term.name or "macos" in term.name) else "linux-x86_64")      # the feed's own platform names
            fmt = "zip" if platform.startswith("windows") else "tar.gz"
            entry = ft.pack_control(folder, out / "control", version=v, platform=platform, fmt=fmt)
            print(f"control {platform} {v}: {entry['size'] // 1048576} MB")
        for n, pkg in enumerate(a.engine):
            copy = tmpdir / f"e{n}" / pkg.name
            shutil.copytree(pkg, copy, symlinks=True)
            ft.sign_package(copy, key)
            entry = ft.pack_engine(copy, out / "engine")
            print(f"engine {entry['platform']}-{entry['backend']} {entry['version']}: {entry['size'] // 1048576} MB")
            shutil.rmtree(copy.parent, ignore_errors=True)
    ft.build_feed(out, key=key, sequence=a.sequence, channel=a.channel, engine_dir=out / "engine" if a.engine else None,
                  control_dir=out / "control" if a.terminal else None)
    base = a.url.rstrip("/")
    for name in ("install.sh", "install.ps1"):
        text = (ROOT / "packaging" / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace(RELEASE_FEED, base)
        (out / name).write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n" if name.endswith(".sh") else None)
    (out / "test-trust.json").write_text((keys / "feed-key.pub.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"feed written to {out}\n  serve it:  python -m http.server {base.rsplit(':', 1)[-1]} --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory {out}\n"
          f"  trust it:  STRATA_UPDATE_TRUSTED_KEYS={out / 'test-trust.json'}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())


## packaging/monitor_bundle.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build and manage the thin, read-only Strata monitor zipapp.

The bundle contains no engine, model, installer or terminal framework. One-shot
JSON status uses stdlib only; interactive mode needs the explicit Textual add-on.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import stat
import tempfile
import zipapp
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCES_V2 = (
    "strata_cli/__init__.py",
    "strata_cli/client.py",
    "strata_cli/connections.py",
    "strata_cli/render.py",
    "strata_cli/monitor.py",
    "strata_cli/monitor_commands.py",
    "strata_cli/logs.py",
)
SOURCES_V3 = (*SOURCES_V2, "strata_cli/dashboard.py")
SOURCES_V4 = (*SOURCES_V3, "strata_cli/detail_dashboard.py")
SOURCES_V5 = (*SOURCES_V4, "strata_cli/nav.py")      # schema 5: the view tabs every screen shares (strata_cli/nav.py)
# schema 6: the two modules the interactive Monitor imports at run time (strata_cli/monitor.py, render.py) that earlier lists missed.
# tests/terminal/test_monitor_bundle.py derives the import closure of the bundle's entry point and fails if this list falls behind.
SOURCES = (*SOURCES_V5, "strata_cli/consoleinfo.py", "strata_cli/overview.py")
BOOTSTRAP = b"from strata_cli.monitor_commands import main\nraise SystemExit(main())\n"
MEMBERS_V1 = ("__main__.py", *SOURCES_V2)
LICENSE_NOTICE = "LICENSE"
MEMBERS_V2 = (*MEMBERS_V1, LICENSE_NOTICE)
MEMBERS_V3 = (*MEMBERS_V2, "strata_cli/dashboard.py")
MEMBERS_V4 = (*MEMBERS_V3, "strata_cli/detail_dashboard.py")
MEMBERS_V5 = (*MEMBERS_V4, "strata_cli/nav.py")
MEMBERS = (*MEMBERS_V5, "strata_cli/consoleinfo.py", "strata_cli/overview.py")
COMPATIBILITY = {"python_min": "3.10", "telemetry_schema": [1]}
MAX_BUNDLE_BYTES = 1024 * 1024
MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES = 64 * 1024
MAX_MEMBER_BYTES = 256 * 1024


def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def manifest_path(bundle: Path) -> Path:
    return bundle.with_name(bundle.name + ".manifest.json")


def build(bundle: Path) -> dict:
    if bundle.exists() or manifest_path(bundle).exists():
        raise FileExistsError("bundle or manifest already exists; choose a new output path")
    bundle.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=".strata-monitor-build-", dir=bundle.parent) as directory:
        stage = Path(directory) / "source"
        stage.mkdir()
        (stage / "__main__.py").write_bytes(BOOTSTRAP)
        for name in SOURCES:
            target = stage / name
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copyfile(ROOT / name, target)
        shutil.copyfile(ROOT / LICENSE_NOTICE, stage / LICENSE_NOTICE)
        temp_bundle = Path(directory) / bundle.name
        zipapp.create_archive(stage, target=temp_bundle, interpreter="/usr/bin/env python3",
                              compressed=True)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(temp_bundle) as archive:
            names = archive.namelist()
            if set(names) != set((*MEMBERS, "strata_cli/")) or len(names) != len(MEMBERS) + 1:
                raise ValueError("bundle member list changed during build")
            files = {name: digest(archive.read(name)) for name in MEMBERS}
        report = {"schema_version": 6, "kind": "strata-monitor-bundle",
                  "bundle": bundle.name, "sha256": digest(temp_bundle.read_bytes()),
                  "files": files, "interactive_dependency": "textual==8.2.8",
                  "compatibility": COMPATIBILITY, "license": "MIT", "license_file": LICENSE_NOTICE,
                  "publisher_signature": None}
        temp_manifest = Path(directory) / manifest_path(bundle).name
        temp_manifest.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
        os.replace(temp_bundle, bundle)
        try:
            os.replace(temp_manifest, manifest_path(bundle))
        except OSError:
            bundle.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            raise
    return report


def verify(bundle: Path) -> dict:
    for path, limit in ((bundle, MAX_BUNDLE_BYTES), (manifest_path(bundle), MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES)):
        if not stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode) or path.stat().st_size > limit:
            raise ValueError("bundle and manifest must be bounded regular files")
    report = json.loads(manifest_path(bundle).read_text())
    if (not isinstance(report, dict) or type(report.get("schema_version")) is not int or
            report["schema_version"] not in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6) or
            report.get("kind") != "strata-monitor-bundle" or
            report.get("publisher_signature") is not None or
            report.get("bundle") != bundle.name or report.get("sha256") != digest(bundle.read_bytes())):
        raise ValueError("bundle manifest or SHA-256 mismatch")
    members = {1: MEMBERS_V1, 2: MEMBERS_V2, 3: MEMBERS_V3, 4: MEMBERS_V4,
               5: MEMBERS_V5, 6: MEMBERS}[report["schema_version"]]
    if report["schema_version"] >= 2:
        if (report.get("compatibility") != COMPATIBILITY or report.get("license") != "MIT" or
                report.get("license_file") != LICENSE_NOTICE):
            raise ValueError("bundle compatibility or license notice mismatch")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(bundle) as archive:
        names = archive.namelist()
        if len(names) != len(members) + 1 or set(names) != set((*members, "strata_cli/")):
            raise ValueError("bundle contains missing, duplicate or unexpected files")
        if any(info.flag_bits & 1 for info in archive.infolist()):
            raise ValueError("encrypted bundle members are unsupported")
        if any(info.file_size > MAX_MEMBER_BYTES for info in archive.infolist()):
            raise ValueError("bundle member exceeds the size limit")
        if archive.testzip() is not None:
            raise ValueError("bundle CRC failure")
        files = {name: digest(archive.read(name)) for name in members}
        if report["schema_version"] >= 2 and not archive.read(LICENSE_NOTICE).replace(b"\r\n", b"\n").startswith(b"MIT License\n"):
            raise ValueError("bundle license notice is invalid")
    if report.get("files") != files:
        raise ValueError("bundle member checksum mismatch")
    return report


def _target(target: Path) -> Path:
    target = target.expanduser()
    if not target.is_absolute() or target.name in ("", ".", ".."):
        raise ValueError("install target must be an absolute new directory")
    parent = target.parent
    parent_info = parent.lstat()
    if not stat.S_ISDIR(parent_info.st_mode) or \
            (os.name == "posix" and (parent_info.st_uid != os.getuid() or parent_info.st_mode & 0o022)):
        raise ValueError("install target parent must be an existing owner-controlled directory")
    return target


def _present(path: Path) -> bool:
    return path.exists() or path.is_symlink()


def _previous(target: Path) -> Path:
    return target.with_name(target.name + ".previous")


def _installed(target: Path) -> tuple[Path, dict]:
    if not stat.S_ISDIR(target.lstat().st_mode):
        raise ValueError("install target must be a regular directory")
    candidates = [path for path in target.iterdir() if path.name.endswith(".pyz")]
    if len(candidates) != 1:
        raise ValueError("install target has no unique monitor bundle; inspect it manually")
    bundle = candidates[0]
    expected = {bundle.name, manifest_path(bundle).name}
    if {path.name for path in target.iterdir()} != expected:
        raise ValueError("install target has unexpected or missing files; inspect it manually")
    return bundle, verify(bundle)


def _stage_copy(bundle: Path, report: dict, target: Path) -> Path:
    stage = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=".strata-monitor-install-", dir=target.parent))
    try:
        staged_bundle = stage / bundle.name
        shutil.copyfile(bundle, staged_bundle, follow_symlinks=False)
        shutil.copyfile(manifest_path(bundle), manifest_path(staged_bundle), follow_symlinks=False)
        os.chmod(staged_bundle, 0o600)
        os.chmod(manifest_path(staged_bundle), 0o600)
        if verify(staged_bundle)["sha256"] != report["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("bundle changed during copy")
        return stage
    except Exception:
        shutil.rmtree(stage)
        raise


def _remove_install(bundle: Path) -> None:
    manifest_path(bundle).unlink()
    bundle.unlink()
    bundle.parent.rmdir()


def install(bundle: Path, target: Path, *, plan: bool = False,
            if_candidate_sha256: str | None = None) -> dict:
    """Copy a verified client into a new directory without touching the server."""
    report = verify(bundle)
    target = _target(target)
    if _present(target) or _present(_previous(target)):
        raise FileExistsError("install target already exists; choose a new directory")
    result = {"target": str(target), "sha256": report["sha256"],
              "bundle": bundle.name, "would_install": plan}
    if plan:
        return result
    if if_candidate_sha256 != report["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("monitor install digest changed or is missing; preview again")
    stage = _stage_copy(bundle, report, target)
    try:
        if _present(target) or _present(_previous(target)):
            raise FileExistsError("install target appeared during copy; inspect it manually")
        os.rename(stage, target)
    finally:
        if stage.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(stage)
    return {**result, "installed": True, "would_install": False}


def update(bundle: Path, target: Path, *, plan: bool = False,
           if_current_sha256: str | None = None, if_candidate_sha256: str | None = None) -> dict:
    """Promote a verified candidate and retain one verified rollback copy."""
    target = _target(target)
    current_bundle, current = _installed(target)
    candidate = verify(bundle)
    previous = _previous(target)
    if _present(previous):
        raise FileExistsError("previous monitor version exists; rollback or commit it before another update")
    changed = candidate["sha256"] != current["sha256"]
    result = {"target": str(target), "previous": str(previous),
              "current_sha256": current["sha256"], "candidate_sha256": candidate["sha256"],
              "current_bundle": current_bundle.name, "candidate_bundle": bundle.name,
              "would_update": plan and changed}
    if plan:
        return result
    if if_current_sha256 != current["sha256"] or if_candidate_sha256 != candidate["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("monitor update digests changed or are missing; preview again")
    if not changed:
        return result
    stage = _stage_copy(bundle, candidate, target)
    try:
        if _present(previous):
            raise FileExistsError("previous monitor version appeared during copy")
        if _installed(target)[1]["sha256"] != current["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("active monitor changed during copy; preview again")
        os.rename(target, previous)
        try:
            os.rename(stage, target)
        except OSError as exc:
            try:
                os.rename(previous, target)
            except OSError:
                raise OSError(f"monitor update interrupted; inspect {previous} and {target}") from exc
            raise
    finally:
        if stage.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(stage)
    return {**result, "updated": True, "would_update": False}


def rollback(target: Path, *, plan: bool = False,
             if_active_sha256: str | None = None, if_rollback_sha256: str | None = None) -> dict:
    """Exchange the active and previous verified clients without deleting either."""
    target = _target(target)
    active_bundle, active = _installed(target)
    previous = _previous(target)
    prior_bundle, prior = _installed(previous)
    result = {"target": str(target), "previous": str(previous),
              "active_sha256": active["sha256"], "rollback_sha256": prior["sha256"],
              "active_bundle": active_bundle.name, "rollback_bundle": prior_bundle.name,
              "would_rollback": plan}
    if plan:
        return result
    if if_active_sha256 != active["sha256"] or if_rollback_sha256 != prior["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("monitor rollback digests changed or are missing; preview again")
    swap = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=".strata-monitor-swap-", dir=target.parent))
    if os.name == "nt":
        # os.rename onto an existing directory fails on Windows (POSIX replaces an empty one):
        # keep only the unique name mkdtemp reserved.
        swap.rmdir()
    try:
        os.rename(target, swap)
        try:
            os.rename(previous, target)
        except OSError as exc:
            try:
                os.rename(swap, target)
            except OSError:
                raise OSError(f"monitor rollback interrupted; inspect {swap} and {previous}") from exc
            raise
        try:
            os.rename(swap, previous)
        except OSError as exc:
            try:
                os.rename(target, previous)
                os.rename(swap, target)
            except OSError:
                raise OSError(f"monitor rollback interrupted; inspect {target}, {previous} and {swap}") from exc
            raise
    finally:
        if swap.is_dir() and not any(swap.iterdir()):
            swap.rmdir()
    return {**result, "rolled_back": True, "would_rollback": False}


def commit(target: Path, *, plan: bool = False,
           if_active_sha256: str | None = None, if_previous_sha256: str | None = None) -> dict:
    """Accept the active client and remove its verified rollback copy."""
    target = _target(target)
    _, active = _installed(target)
    previous = _previous(target)
    old_bundle, old = _installed(previous)
    result = {"target": str(target), "previous": str(previous),
              "active_sha256": active["sha256"], "previous_sha256": old["sha256"],
              "would_commit": plan}
    if plan:
        return result
    if if_active_sha256 != active["sha256"] or if_previous_sha256 != old["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("monitor commit digests changed or are missing; preview again")
    _remove_install(old_bundle)
    return {**result, "committed": True, "would_commit": False}


def uninstall(target: Path, *, plan: bool = False,
              if_active_sha256: str | None = None) -> dict:
    """Remove only the two verified files installed by this command."""
    target = _target(target)
    bundle, report = _installed(target)
    if _present(_previous(target)):
        raise ValueError("previous monitor version exists; commit or rollback it before uninstall")
    result = {"target": str(target), "sha256": report["sha256"],
              "bundle": bundle.name, "would_remove": plan}
    if plan:
        return result
    if if_active_sha256 != report["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("monitor uninstall digest changed or is missing; preview again")
    _remove_install(bundle)
    return {**result, "removed": True, "would_remove": False}


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Build or locally manage a thin Strata monitor bundle")
    sp = ap.add_subparsers(dest="action", required=True)
    sp.add_parser("build").add_argument("bundle", type=Path)
    sp.add_parser("verify").add_argument("bundle", type=Path)
    install_parser = sp.add_parser("install", help="copy a verified bundle into a new local directory")
    install_parser.add_argument("bundle", type=Path)
    install_parser.add_argument("--target", type=Path, required=True)
    install_parser.add_argument("--plan", action="store_true")
    install_parser.add_argument("--if-candidate-sha256")
    update_parser = sp.add_parser("update", help="replace a verified monitor and retain one rollback copy")
    update_parser.add_argument("bundle", type=Path)
    update_parser.add_argument("--target", type=Path, required=True)
    update_parser.add_argument("--plan", action="store_true")
    update_parser.add_argument("--if-current-sha256")
    update_parser.add_argument("--if-candidate-sha256")
    rollback_parser = sp.add_parser("rollback", help="exchange active and previous monitor clients")
    rollback_parser.add_argument("--target", type=Path, required=True)
    rollback_parser.add_argument("--plan", action="store_true")
    rollback_parser.add_argument("--if-active-sha256")
    rollback_parser.add_argument("--if-rollback-sha256")
    commit_parser = sp.add_parser("commit", help="keep active client and discard previous")
    commit_parser.add_argument("--target", type=Path, required=True)
    commit_parser.add_argument("--plan", action="store_true")
    commit_parser.add_argument("--if-active-sha256")
    commit_parser.add_argument("--if-previous-sha256")
    uninstall_parser = sp.add_parser("uninstall", help="remove a verified local monitor installation")
    uninstall_parser.add_argument("--target", type=Path, required=True)
    uninstall_parser.add_argument("--plan", action="store_true")
    uninstall_parser.add_argument("--if-active-sha256")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        if args.action == "build":
            result = build(args.bundle)
        elif args.action == "verify":
            result = verify(args.bundle)
        elif args.action == "install":
            result = install(args.bundle, args.target, plan=args.plan,
                             if_candidate_sha256=args.if_candidate_sha256)
        elif args.action == "update":
            result = update(args.bundle, args.target, plan=args.plan,
                            if_current_sha256=args.if_current_sha256,
                            if_candidate_sha256=args.if_candidate_sha256)
        elif args.action == "rollback":
            result = rollback(args.target, plan=args.plan,
                              if_active_sha256=args.if_active_sha256,
                              if_rollback_sha256=args.if_rollback_sha256)
        elif args.action == "commit":
            result = commit(args.target, plan=args.plan,
                            if_active_sha256=args.if_active_sha256,
                            if_previous_sha256=args.if_previous_sha256)
        else:
            result = uninstall(args.target, plan=args.plan,
                               if_active_sha256=args.if_active_sha256)
    except (OSError, ValueError, zipfile.BadZipFile, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        ap.exit(1, f"monitor bundle {args.action} failed: {exc}\n")
    print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "action": args.action,
                      **({"bundle": str(args.bundle), "files": len(result["files"]),
                          "sha256": result["sha256"]}
                         if args.action in ("build", "verify") else result)}, sort_keys=True))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())


## packaging/package_engine.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Make a local, unpublished engine package for the component folder (strata_control/engine_component.py).

    python packaging/package_engine.py --src <folder with strata[.exe] and its libraries> --backend cuda \
        --version 0.1.45 --out <components>/engine --arch sm_86 --arch compute_89 \
        --min-driver nvidia=580.65 [--build-id <id>] [--platform linux-x86_64] [--tree] [--include GLOB ...]

    python packaging/package_engine.py --verify <components>/engine/<package folder>     # full hash check, exit 0 / 1

The result is one folder `<out>/<version>-<platform>-<backend>/` holding the engine binary, the libraries it loads,
BUILD.json when the source has one, and `engine-component.json` (schema 2: every file's SHA-256 and size, the arch
list, the oldest driver, the engine build id, and an empty `signature` for S6). It is the thing Control resolves,
checks and starts; it is not signed, not published, and nothing here uploads it. Signing is stream S6
(`engine_component.register_signature_verifier`); `--sign-with` is deliberately absent until then.

Files taken from --src, by default: the entrypoint, every `*.dll` / `*.so` / `*.so.*` / `*.dylib` / `*.metallib`
beside it, `BUILD.json`, `LICENSE*`, the picture reader `strata-vision[.exe]` when the build has one (without it the
engine answers text only: setup.py Control mode keeps the person's picture choice only when it is there) and the DeepSeek-V4.1
engine `strata-dsv41[.exe]` (setup.py dsv41_exe() looks for it beside the engine; `--require-dsv41` refuses a package without it). `--include GLOB` (repeatable, relative to --src, `**` allowed) adds more, for
example `strata-vision.exe`, `strata-device.exe` or `rocm/**`. `--tree` takes every regular file under --src (the HIP
package ships a `rocm/` tree of kernels). Symlinks are never followed or copied.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import fnmatch
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))

import binary_deps  # noqa: E402
from strata_control import engine_component as ec  # noqa: E402
from strata_control.components import BACKEND_MATRIX, host_platform  # noqa: E402


DSV41_EXE = "strata-dsv41"


def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def wanted(path: Path) -> bool:
    name = path.name.lower()
    return (name.endswith((".dll", ".so", ".dylib", ".metallib")) or ".so." in name or name == "build.json"
            or name.startswith("license") or name in ("strata-vision", "strata-vision.exe", "strata-vision-hip", "strata-vision-hip.exe",
                                                       DSV41_EXE, DSV41_EXE + ".exe"))   # the picture readers (CPU, AMD GPU) and the DeepSeek-V4.1 engine beside the engine


READER_NAMES = ("strata-vision", "strata-vision.exe")


def _arch_numbers(value) -> set[int]:
    """The CUDA architectures in a BUILD.json `archs` / `vision_archs` value ("60;61;70", [60, "sm_61", "70-real"], ...), as numbers."""
    if isinstance(value, str):
        value = re.split(r"[;,\s]+", value)
    found: set[int] = set()
    for item in value or []:
        m = re.fullmatch(r"(?:sm_|compute_)?(\d+)(?:a|f)?(?:-real|-virtual)?", str(item).strip().lower())
        if m:
            found.add(int(m.group(1)))
    return found


def check_picture_reader(src: Path, backend: str, target: str, archs: tuple[str, ...], *, variant: str = "",
                         allow_stale: bool = False, allow_none: bool = False) -> list[str]:
    """The picture reader of a package must run on every card and Mac the package does (tools tests: I1, I2, #3669, #3697).

    * CUDA package with a reader: BUILD.json (beside the engine) must list `vision_archs`, and every `sm_NN` the package carries
      code for must be there. A reader reused from an older build (the Windows zips' strata-vision.exe, unchanged since 0.1.44, had no
      sm_60) stops with "device kernel image is invalid" on a Pascal card while the engine runs. Refused, unless allow_stale.
    * macOS package without a reader: refused (a Mac with this package cannot read a picture), unless allow_none.
    * CUDA package without a reader: allowed (text-only), reported in the returned notes so the build log says it.
    Returns notes to print."""
    reader = next((n for n in READER_NAMES if (src / n).is_file()), None)
    notes: list[str] = []
    if target.startswith("macos"):
        if reader is None and not allow_none:
            raise SystemExit("refusing to package the macOS engine without its picture reader: a Mac with this package could not read "
                             "a picture (#3697). Build it with packaging/build_vision_mac.sh and copy strata-vision beside strata "
                             "(or give --no-picture-reader to ship a text-only package on purpose).")
        if reader is None:
            notes.append("no picture reader in this macOS package: pictures are off for it")
        return notes
    if backend != "cuda":
        return notes
    if reader is None:
        notes.append("no picture reader in this CUDA package: the engine answers text only (the app says pictures need the reader)")
        return notes
    needed = {n for n in _arch_numbers([a for a in archs if str(a).lower().startswith("sm_")])}
    have: set[int] = set()
    build_json = src / "BUILD.json"
    try:
        have = _arch_numbers(json.loads(build_json.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")).get("vision_archs"))
    except (OSError, ValueError, AttributeError):
        pass
    missing = sorted(needed - have)
    if missing and not allow_stale:
        what = ("BUILD.json has no vision_archs: the reader's build is not recorded" if not have
                else "the reader has no code for " + ", ".join(f"sm_{n}" for n in missing))
        raise SystemExit(f"refusing to package the {variant or backend} engine with this picture reader: {what}. A reader reused from an "
                         "older build stops with 'device kernel image is invalid' on a card it was not built for (#3669). Build it for the "
                         "package's architectures (packaging/build_vision_windows.bat, packaging/build_cuda_linux.sh) and record them as "
                         "vision_archs in BUILD.json (or give --allow-stale-vision).")
    if missing:
        notes.append("picture reader NOT built for " + ", ".join(f"sm_{n}" for n in missing) + " (allowed by --allow-stale-vision)")
    return notes


def stamp_vision_archs(stage: Path, archs: str) -> None:
    """Record the architectures the picture reader in `stage` was built for as BUILD.json `vision_archs` (the build recipes for Windows
    call this after building strata-vision.exe; check_picture_reader compares it with the package's archs)."""
    path = stage / "BUILD.json"
    try:
        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")) if path.is_file() else {}
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        data = {}
    data["vision_archs"] = ";".join(str(n) for n in sorted(_arch_numbers(archs)))
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=1) + chr(10), encoding="utf-8")


def git_build_id(repo: Path = ROOT) -> str:
    """The source commit of the engine build, `-dirty` when the tree had changes. `unknown` outside a checkout."""
    try:
        head = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "rev-parse", "--short=12", "HEAD"], capture_output=True,
                              text=True, timeout=20).stdout.strip()
        dirty = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=no"],
                               capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60).stdout.strip()
    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
        return "unknown"
    return (head + ("-dirty" if dirty else "")) if head else "unknown"


def select(src: Path, entrypoint: str, *, tree: bool, include: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Relative POSIX paths to package, entrypoint first, the rest sorted."""
    chosen: set[str] = set()
    for path in sorted(src.rglob("*") if (tree or include) else src.iterdir()):
        if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
            continue
        rel = path.relative_to(src).as_posix()
        if rel == ec.MANIFEST:
            continue
        top_level = "/" not in rel
        if tree or (top_level and wanted(path)) or any(fnmatch.fnmatch(rel, pattern) for pattern in include):
            chosen.add(rel)
    for path in sorted((src / "tuning").glob("*.txt")) if (src / "tuning").is_dir() else []:
        if path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink():      # the hipBLASLt tuning tables of an AMD package (strata_control/hipblaslt_tuning.py)
            chosen.add(path.relative_to(src).as_posix())
    chosen.discard(entrypoint)
    return [entrypoint] + sorted(chosen)


def build(src: Path, backend: str, version: str, target: str, out: Path, *, entry: str | None = None,
          archs: tuple[str, ...] = (), min_driver: dict | None = None, build_id: str | None = None,
          min_runtime: str | None = None, notes: str = "", tree: bool = False, include: list[str] | None = None,
          variant: str = "", search: list[Path] | None = None, allow_libs: list[str] | None = None,
          check_reader: bool = False, allow_stale_vision: bool = False, allow_no_reader: bool = False,
          require_dsv41: bool = False) -> Path:
    if backend not in BACKEND_MATRIX:
        raise SystemExit(f"unknown backend {backend!r}")
    if backend != "cpu" and not archs:
        raise SystemExit(f"a {backend} package needs at least one --arch (sm_86, gfx1201, ...)")
    if backend == "cuda" and variant == "cuda12" and not any(a in ("sm_60", "sm_61", "sm_70") for a in archs):
        # #3503: the cuda12 package is what the feed and docs/DOCKER.md offer to GTX 10 / P100 / V100; one built for
        # sm_75 and up starts a restart loop on those cards ("this PC's GPU is sm_60")
        raise SystemExit("refusing to package the cuda12 engine without sm_60, sm_61 or sm_70: it is the Pascal and Volta build "
                         "(CUDA 12.9, -DSTRATA_EXPERIMENTAL_SM60=ON, --arch sm_60 --arch sm_61 --arch sm_70 ...; see packaging/build_cuda_linux.sh)")
    if backend == "hip":
        from strata_control import hipblaslt_tuning
        problems = hipblaslt_tuning.check_stage(src, archs)
        if problems:
            raise SystemExit("refusing to package the AMD engine:\n  " + "\n  ".join(problems))
    entrypoint = entry or ("strata.exe" if target.startswith("windows") else "strata")
    if not (src / entrypoint).is_file():
        raise SystemExit(f"{src / entrypoint} does not exist")
    if check_reader:                       # the release recipes and the CLI ask for it; the library call keeps its old behaviour
        for note in check_picture_reader(src, backend, target, archs, variant=variant, allow_stale=allow_stale_vision,
                                         allow_none=allow_no_reader):
            print("note: " + note)
    if require_dsv41 and not any((src / n).is_file() for n in (DSV41_EXE, DSV41_EXE + ".exe")):
        raise SystemExit(f"refusing to package: {src} has no {DSV41_EXE}[.exe] (--require-dsv41); build it with -DSTRATA_BUILD_DSV41=ON "
                         "(--target strata-dsv41) and copy it beside the engine")
    folder = out / (f"{version}-{target}-{backend}" + (f"-{variant}" if variant else ""))
    if folder.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"{folder} already exists; remove it first (packages are immutable)")
    staging = out / f".{folder.name}.partial"
    if staging.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(staging)
    staging.mkdir(parents=True)
    try:
        files = []
        for rel in select(src, entrypoint, tree=tree, include=include or []):
            destination = staging / rel
            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(src / rel, destination)
            files.append({"path": rel, "sha256": sha256(destination), "bytes": destination.stat().st_size})
        files += _bundle_missing_libraries(staging, target, [f["path"] for f in files], search or [], allow_libs or [])
        manifest = {"schema_version": ec.SCHEMA_VERSION, "id": ec.COMPONENT_ID, "name": ec.COMPONENT_ID,
                    "version": version, "platform": target, "backend": backend, "archs": list(archs),
                    "min_driver": dict(min_driver or {}), "build_id": build_id or git_build_id(),
                    "entrypoint": entrypoint, "files": files, "signature": None}
        if variant:
            manifest["variant"] = variant
        if min_runtime:
            manifest["min_runtime"] = min_runtime
        if notes:
            manifest["notes"] = notes
        (staging / ec.MANIFEST).write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=1) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        if os.name != "nt":
            for exe_name in (entrypoint, DSV41_EXE, "strata-vision", "strata-vision-hip"):      # the programs setup starts: executable in the tar
                if (staging / exe_name).is_file():
                    (staging / exe_name).chmod(0o755)
        ec.verify(ec.read_manifest(staging), full=True)
        staging.rename(folder)
    except BaseException:
        shutil.rmtree(staging, ignore_errors=True)
        raise
    return folder


def _default_search(target: str) -> list[Path]:
    """Where a Windows build finds the redistributable DLLs its engine imports: the CUDA/HIP toolkits and PATH."""
    if not target.startswith("windows"):
        return []
    found: list[Path] = []
    for var in ("CUDA_PATH", "HIP_PATH"):
        root = os.environ.get(var)
        if root:
            found += [Path(root) / "bin" / "x64", Path(root) / "bin"]
    found += [Path(x) for x in os.environ.get("PATH", "").split(os.pathsep) if x]
    return [d for d in found if d.is_dir()]


def _bundle_missing_libraries(staging: Path, target: str, rels: list[str], search: list[Path], allow: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
    """Every library the package's binaries import must be in the package, or belong to the OS or the GPU driver
    (binary_deps.py). Windows builds copy a missing one from the search folders (the CUDA toolkit's bin/x64, PATH): the packager
    runs on a PC that has the toolkit, the person's PC does not. Anything still missing refuses the package."""
    added: list[dict] = []
    roots = search or _default_search(target)
    for _ in range(8):                                   # a copied DLL can import more DLLs
        missing = [(f, n) for f, n in binary_deps.uncovered(staging) if n.lower() not in {a.lower() for a in allow}]
        if not missing:
            return added
        progressed = False
        for _file, name in sorted(set(missing), key=lambda x: x[1].lower()):
            if not target.startswith("windows"):
                continue
            hit = next((d / name for d in roots if (d / name).is_file()), None)
            if hit is None:
                hit = next((c for d in roots for c in d.glob("*") if c.name.lower() == name.lower() and c.is_file()), None)
            if hit is None or (staging / hit.name).exists():
                continue
            shutil.copy2(hit, staging / hit.name)
            added.append({"path": hit.name, "sha256": sha256(staging / hit.name), "bytes": (staging / hit.name).stat().st_size})
            progressed = True
            print(f"bundled {hit.name} (imported by the engine; from {hit.parent})")
        if not progressed:
            break
    left = [(f, n) for f, n in binary_deps.uncovered(staging) if n.lower() not in {a.lower() for a in allow}]
    if left:
        lines = "\n".join(f"  {f} needs {n}" for f, n in sorted(set(left)))
        raise SystemExit("refusing to package: these libraries are neither bundled nor part of the OS or the GPU driver, so a clean PC could not "
                         f"start the engine (0xC0000135 / 'library not found'):\n{lines}\nGive --search <folder holding them> or fix the build.")
    return added


def package_sha256(folder: Path) -> str:
    """One digest for the whole package: SHA-256 of the manifest file (it holds every file's hash)."""
    return sha256(folder / ec.MANIFEST)


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--verify", type=Path, metavar="FOLDER", help="hash-check an existing package and exit")
    ap.add_argument("--src", type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--backend", choices=sorted(BACKEND_MATRIX))
    ap.add_argument("--version")
    ap.add_argument("--platform", default=None, help="default: this machine")
    ap.add_argument("--out", type=Path, help="the component folder's engine/ directory")
    ap.add_argument("--entrypoint", default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--arch", "--cuda-arch", dest="arch", action="append", default=[],
                    help="sm_86 (code for that card), compute_89 (PTX), gfx1201, ...; repeat for several")
    ap.add_argument("--min-driver", action="append", default=[], metavar="VENDOR=VERSION",
                    help="the oldest driver, e.g. nvidia=580.65; repeat for several vendors")
    ap.add_argument("--variant", default="", help="tag when one backend has several builds (cuda13, cuda12); goes in the folder name")
    ap.add_argument("--build-id", default=None, help="default: the source commit of this checkout")
    ap.add_argument("--min-runtime", default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--notes", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--tree", action="store_true", help="every regular file under --src, recursively")
    ap.add_argument("--search", action="append", default=[], type=Path, metavar="DIR",
                    help="folder to copy a missing imported DLL from (default on Windows: CUDA_PATH/bin/x64, HIP_PATH/bin, PATH)")
    ap.add_argument("--allow-lib", action="append", default=[], metavar="NAME",
                    help="an imported library that really is provided by the target system (rare; named so the check passes)")
    ap.add_argument("--require-dsv41", action="store_true",
                    help="refuse the package when --src has no strata-dsv41[.exe] (the DeepSeek-V4.1 engine that setup.py looks for beside the engine)")
    ap.add_argument("--include", action="append", default=[], metavar="GLOB", help="more files, relative to --src")
    ap.add_argument("--stamp-vision", type=Path, metavar="STAGE", help="write --vision-archs into STAGE/BUILD.json and exit")
    ap.add_argument("--vision-archs", default="", help="with --stamp-vision: the architectures the reader was built for, e.g. '60;61;70;75;80;86;89'")
    ap.add_argument("--allow-stale-vision", action="store_true",
                    help="package a CUDA picture reader whose BUILD.json vision_archs do not cover the package's archs (it will fail on those cards)")
    ap.add_argument("--no-picture-reader", action="store_true", help="ship a macOS package without strata-vision on purpose (pictures stay off)")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    if a.verify:
        try:
            component = ec.read_manifest(a.verify)
            ec.verify(component, full=True)
        except ec.ComponentProblem as exc:
            print(f"{a.verify}: REFUSED: {exc}")
            return 1
        if a.require_dsv41 and not any(f[0] in (DSV41_EXE, DSV41_EXE + ".exe") for f in component.files):
            print(f"{a.verify}: REFUSED: no {DSV41_EXE}[.exe] in the manifest (--require-dsv41)")
            return 1
        bad = binary_deps.uncovered(a.verify)
        if bad:
            for rel, name in bad:
                print(f"{a.verify}: REFUSED: {rel} needs {name}, which is neither bundled nor an OS / GPU driver library")
            return 1
        print(f"{a.verify}: ok ({len(component.files)} files, manifest sha256 {package_sha256(a.verify)})")
        return 0
    if a.stamp_vision:
        if not _arch_numbers(a.vision_archs):
            ap.error("--stamp-vision needs --vision-archs, for example '60;61;70;75;80;86;89'")
        stamp_vision_archs(a.stamp_vision, a.vision_archs)
        print(f"{a.stamp_vision / 'BUILD.json'}: vision_archs {a.vision_archs}")
        return 0
    for needed in ("src", "backend", "version", "out"):
        if getattr(a, needed) is None:
            ap.error(f"--{needed} is required")
    drivers = {}
    for item in a.min_driver:
        vendor, _, version = item.partition("=")
        if not vendor or not version:
            ap.error(f"--min-driver {item!r} is not VENDOR=VERSION")
        drivers[vendor] = version
    a.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    folder = build(a.src, a.backend, a.version, a.platform or host_platform(), a.out, entry=a.entrypoint,
                   archs=tuple(a.arch), min_driver=drivers, build_id=a.build_id, min_runtime=a.min_runtime,
                   notes=a.notes, tree=a.tree, include=a.include, variant=a.variant,
                   search=a.search, allow_libs=a.allow_lib, check_reader=True, allow_stale_vision=a.allow_stale_vision,
                   allow_no_reader=a.no_picture_reader, require_dsv41=a.require_dsv41)
    entries = [p for p in folder.rglob("*") if p.is_file()]
    total = sum(p.stat().st_size for p in entries)
    print(f"{folder}  ({total / (1 << 20):.1f} MiB, {len(entries)} files, manifest sha256 {package_sha256(folder)})")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())


## packaging/package_terminal.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the self-contained Strata Terminal distribution for Windows x64, Linux x86_64 or macOS arm64.

The requirement this exists for (checklist P04, and the owner's rule that starting or serving never fetches Python
packages from the internet): a user installs the terminal without Desktop, and needs no development checkout, no
system Python, no pip run, no compiler. So the archive carries its own Python runtime and its own dependencies, and
the `strata` launchers prefer them.

What goes in
------------
* a pinned **standalone CPython 3.12.15** (python-build-standalone 20261009, `install_only`), downloaded at BUILD
  time and SHA-256-verified against the pin below (the digests are the ones in that release's SHA256SUMS, the Mac one
  is also what `setup.sh` pins), so the terminal and the installer cannot drift apart;
* the runtime wheels from the target's lock, `packaging/locks/runtime-<target>-cp312.txt` (made by
  `packaging/lock_wheels.py`), installed into that interpreter with
  `pip install --require-hashes --no-deps --only-binary=:all:` at BUILD time only: every package, direct or
  transitive, is named with an exact version and the SHA-256 of the wheel(s) accepted, so nothing else can land in
  the bundle. pip itself is the one the interpreter shipped with (not upgraded);
* the application: `strata.py`, `strata_control`, `strata_cli`, `serve`, a `VERSION` file and the docs the CLI
  references;
* the read-only tooling under `tools/` that the terminal paths import. Everything else under `tools/` is engine
  installation and preparation work and is deliberately excluded: the serving import graph must not pull it in
  (tests/terminal/test_no_acquisition.py checks that);
* launchers: `bin/strata.cmd` and `bin/strata.ps1` (Windows), `bin/strata` (Linux, macOS).

What does NOT go in
-------------------
* the engine binary. That is a separate, independently versioned component (`packaging/README.md`);
* model weights or prepared data;
* `node_modules` or the UI. The terminal does not need a browser.

Usage
-----
    python packaging/package_terminal.py --out release/artifacts                    # the host's target
    python packaging/package_terminal.py --out /tmp/x --target linux-x86_64        # on a Linux x86_64 host
    python packaging/package_terminal.py --out /tmp/x --skip-deps                  # layout check only

An archive for a target must be built on that target: the lock is installed with the bundled interpreter, which runs
only there. `packaging/smoke_terminal.py <archive>` extracts one into a clean environment and runs it.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import platform
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile
import urllib.request
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
LOCKS = ROOT / "packaging" / "locks"

PBS_RELEASE = "20261009"
PYTHON_VERSION = "3.12.15"
PBS_BASE = f"https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/releases/download/{PBS_RELEASE}/"

#: The standalone CPython pins, one per target, from the release's SHA256SUMS. `darwin-arm64` is also what
#: `setup.sh` pins: a terminal built from one and an installer built from the other are the same interpreter.
PYTHON_PINS = {
    "windows-x86_64": {
        "file": f"cpython-{PYTHON_VERSION}+{PBS_RELEASE}-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc-install_only.tar.gz",
        "sha256": "194c8f0d9e0de6f1c4576e5dfa67819a48c764be87608b74b8ad43387a57b93b",
        "python": "python/python.exe", "archive": "zip",
    },
    "linux-x86_64": {
        "file": f"cpython-{PYTHON_VERSION}+{PBS_RELEASE}-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu-install_only.tar.gz",
        "sha256": "5864001bf969db329fadc2b654c4878c6027d170c6bd77e28f88666260bcaf63",
        "python": "python/bin/python3", "archive": "tar.gz",
    },
    "darwin-arm64": {
        "file": f"cpython-{PYTHON_VERSION}+{PBS_RELEASE}-aarch64-apple-darwin-install_only.tar.gz",
        "sha256": "83dcb04777c798bd95f3687acf9ae84b09860272ee6bdfb05be8bcf9447f75b8",
        "python": "python/bin/python3", "archive": "tar.gz",
    },
}
for _pin in PYTHON_PINS.values():
    _pin["url"] = PBS_BASE + _pin["file"].replace("+", "%2B")

#: Kept for callers of the Mac-only script: the macOS pin.
PYTHON_PIN = {**PYTHON_PINS["darwin-arm64"], "target": "darwin-arm64"}

#: The application, as paths relative to ROOT (copied to the same place in the archive).
PAYLOAD = (
    "strata.py",
    "strata_control",
    "strata_cli",
    "serve",
    "requirements.txt",
    "requirements-monitor.txt",
    "docs/MANAGEMENT_PROTOCOL.md",
    "docs/TERMINAL_LAUNCH.md",         # the README below points at it (`strata launch`); it used to be missing from the archive
    "data/gguf_fingerprints.json",     # `strata models import --plan` names a known file set from this table
    "bench/prompts/standard-v1",       # `strata bench run` (the standard benchmark) sends these frozen requests; hashed byte for byte
)

#: `tools/` modules the terminal paths import. Adding one here is a deliberate act: this list is what keeps
#: installation/preparation code out of the serving import graph.
TOOLS_SUBSET = (
    "strata_tokenizer.py",

    "dflash2_pack.py",     # the DFlash2 drafter: strata_control/drafting_fetch.py packs the download with it (numpy only)
)

#: What `strata launch` and the desktop app's installer need on top of the read-only terminal: the model catalog and GPU probe
#: (tools/strata_mcp.py reads setup.py's tables) and the install job, which downloads the model the user chose, prepares it with
#: the bundled tools and writes a run config naming "component:strata-engine". setup.py runs in its CONTROL mode there
#: (STRATA_CONTROL_INSTALL=1: no pip, no engine fetch, no compiler). Entry points; their local imports under tools/ come with them.
#: The same list the app's Control component stages (apps/desktop/scripts/stage-control.py uses these names).
INSTALLER_FILES = ("setup.py", "ref/load.py")   # ref/load.py: strata_pack.py (the Q2_0 AVX-512 repack) imports it
#: calibrate: setup.py imports it after a tune (calibrate_config, and the earlier tuning that a rerun applies); it was missing from this
#: list in 0.1.47, so every launch after a tune failed (#3613, #3467). setup_tool_imports() below also reads setup.py itself, so a tools/
#: module it starts to import is never forgotten again; tests/terminal/test_bundle_imports.py checks the staged bundle.
INSTALLER_TOOLS = ("strata_mcp", "iq_pack", "strata_pack", "pack_index", "mtp_fetch", "mtp_pack", "mtp_rt", "draft_vocab",
                   "strata_tokenizer", "gguf_reader", "calibrate")
